AILMINT_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}Click on it to arm, then click on a tile to send nuke

{KEYWORD}Range: {STAT}Anywhere

{KEYWORD}Special:{STAT}The nuke hits the zombies and explodes in a small area

{KEYWORD}Additional effect: {STAT}Leave behind radiation which strip off their clothes... ask Talkweb why

{FLAVOR}Earthstar Nuclear Silo looks very short, and all the other plants thinks he belongs to the short family, this irks Earthstar Nuclear Silo, he just has a large portion of his height underground!

{KEYWORD}范围：{STAT}草坪上的任何地方
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}炮弹撞向僵尸，并在小范围内爆炸

ALMANAC_EMPTY_FILTER.zh: 没有符合选定条件的项目。

ALMANAC_FIND_MORE_DESCRIPTION.en: Obtain {PLANT_NAME} and seed packets from these places:
ALMANAC_FIND_MORE_DESCRIPTION.zh: 从这些地方获取{PLANT_NAME}的种子包：

ALMANAC_FIND_MORE_NO_PRODUCTS.en: There are currently no offers available for this plant. Please check back later!
ALMANAC_FIND_MORE_NO_PRODUCTS.zh:
世界地图上和商城里都没有该植物的相关信息！
你可以去旅行原木、主题任务和签到里看看哦！

ALMANAC_FIND_MORE_TITLE.en: Find This Plant and More Seed Packets
ALMANAC_FIND_MORE_TITLE.zh: 该植物和其种子包的获取途径

ALMANAC_PLANT_COUNT_TEXT.zh: 共 {TOTAL} 株植物，已收集 {CURRENT} 株

ALMANAC_PLANT_WORLD_LOCKED.zh: 可以在{WORLD}世界获得种子包！

ALMANAC_SEASONAL_AVAILABILITY_MESSAGE.en: This is a seasonal plant that has limited availability. Please check back later!
ALMANAC_SEASONAL_AVAILABILITY_MESSAGE.zh: 这是一株季节限定植物，供应有限。请过段时间再来看看吧！

ALOES_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}Immune to some negative effects, excluding hard crowd control

{FLAVOR}You can find Aloe Doctor pushing her brand of fluids in the beauty sector. The current trend's all about skin cleansing, and she's good at it.
ALOES_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}免疫部分负面效果，强力控制除外

{FLAVOR}芦荟医师游走于各大化妆品新品发布会，借机推销她的产品“芦荟水”。今年整个护肤品市场都在讲美白，这可是芦荟医师的强项。

ALOES_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Aloe Doctors grant attack damage and attack speed bonuses to all nearby plants, and randomly remove all negative effects from one afflicted plant.
ALOES_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 芦荟医师可以使周围的所有植物获得攻击伤害加成和攻击速度加成，并随机解除一株处于负面状态的植物的所有负面状态。

ALOES_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Additionally increases the attack speed of nearby plants and removes their negative effects.
ALOES_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}额外提高周围的植物的攻击速度，并解除其负面状态。

ALOES_TOOLTIP.en: Provides damage and attack speed bonuses, and removes negative effects
ALOES_TOOLTIP.zh: 提供伤害加成和攻速加成，并解除负面状态

ALOE_DESCRIPTION.en: In a mysterious western town, Rotten Red is a sharpshooter cowboy, fighting all sorts of zombie bullies that invade his town, zombies tremble as soon as his name is mentioned. He almost became the town sheriff, but he turned it down and went to the Renaissance.
ALOE_DESCRIPTION.zh: 在一个神秘的西部小镇，双枪石榴是个神枪手牛仔。与入侵他的小镇的各种僵尸恶霸搏斗。他差那么一点就能成为镇上的保安，但他拒绝了，他去了复兴时代。

ALOE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Rotten Red can fire pomegranate seeds forward to immobilize zombies.
ALOE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 双枪石榴可以向前方发射使僵尸定身的石榴籽。

ALOE_TOOLTIP.en: Fires pomegranate seeds forward to immobilize zombies
ALOE_TOOLTIP.zh: 向前方发射使僵尸定身的石榴籽

APPEASEMINT_DESCRIPTION.en: Jackfruit looks a little silly, but actually he's... well, he's just silly.
APPEASEMINT_DESCRIPTION.zh: 菠萝蜜看起来有点儿傻乎乎的，但其实他……好吧，他就是傻乎乎的。

APPEASEMINT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Jackfruit can roll to kill all zombies in an entire row in front of it.
APPEASEMINT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 菠萝蜜可以滚动杀死前方一整行的所有僵尸。

APPEASEMINT_TOOLTIP.en: Kill a lane of zombies in front of you
APPEASEMINT_TOOLTIP.zh: 滚动杀死前方一整行僵尸

APPLEMORTAR_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Apple Mortar stuns three zombies dead in their tracks. SPAF! That'll show 'em! That'll show ALL of them!

APPLEMORTAR_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Apple Mortars lob apple cores that damage and briefly stun zombies over three lanes.
APPLEMORTAR_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 苹果迫击炮可以攻击邻近三行的僵尸，并对僵尸造成短暂的僵直。

APPLEMORTAR_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Lobs large apples at every zombie on the lawn, dealing damage and temporarily stunning them.
APPLEMORTAR_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}向草坪上的所有僵尸投出大号的苹果，对它们造成伤害、减慢速度。

APPLEMORTAR_TOOLTIP.en: Lobs stunning cores down three lanes
APPLEMORTAR_TOOLTIP.zh: 向三行投掷带眩晕效果的果核

APPLIES.en: applies to my use of EA's services.

APPLY_CONDITION_DESCRIPTION.zh: 每 {TIME} 秒让僵尸获得一次{CONDITION}效果，持续 {DURATION} 秒！

APPLY_CONDITION_DESCRIPTION_HYPNOTIZED.zh: 每 {TIME} 秒让 {NUMBER} 只僵尸{CONDITION}一次！

APPLY_CONDITION_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: 每 {TIME} 秒让 {NUMBER} 只僵尸额外携带一次{CONDITION}效果！

APPLY_CONDITION_DESCRIPTION_SHRINKING.zh: 每 {TIME} 秒让 {NUMBER} 只僵尸{CONDITION}！

APPLY_DAMAGE_CONDITION_DESCRIPTION.en: Applies {DAMAGE} {CONDITION} damage for {DURATION} seconds every {TIME} seconds!
APPLY_DAMAGE_CONDITION_DESCRIPTION.zh: 每 {TIME} 秒造成持续 {DURATION} 秒，伤害为 {DAMAGE} 的{CONDITION}伤害！

APP_UPDATE_REQUIRED.en: Download the latest version of Plants vs. Zombies 2 to continue.
APP_UPDATE_REQUIRED.zh: 下载最新版本的《植物大战僵尸 2》之后才可以继续。

APRILFOOLS_LEVEL_NAME.zh: 离谱位面 - 第 {LEVEL_NUMBER} 关

APSARLOTUS_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}Provides buffs to surrounding plants, causing plants planted in front to trigger their Plant Food effect upon planting. This effect can only trigger once per plant, but can be triggered again after the plant is fused.
{FLAVOR}To maintain that translucent auspicious cloud, she has to spend a staggering amount of sun every day to pay the "floating fee."
APSARLOTUS_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}为周围植物提供增益效果，使前方植物种植后释放叶绿素大招，该效果同一植物只能生效一次，植物融合后可重复生效。
{FLAVOR}为了维持那朵半透明的祥云，她每天要消耗惊人的阳光来支付“悬浮费”。

APSARLOTUS_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Buffs surrounding plants, causing plants planted in front to trigger their Plant Food upon planting.
APSARLOTUS_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 强化周围植物，使前方植物种植后释放叶绿素大招。

APSARLOTUS_TOOLTIP.en: Buffs surrounding plants, causing plants planted in front to trigger their Plant Food upon planting
APSARLOTUS_TOOLTIP.zh: 强化周围植物，使前方植物种植后释放叶绿素大招。

AQUAVINE_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR} Once during its regular morning jog, Aqua Vine tied a taco to the end of a string in the hopes of getting Dave to exercise. Who knew Dave could be so fast?
AQUAVINE_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}某天早上，绿水藤蔓照常去晨跑。它用一根绳子绑住一块玉米卷，想着能不能让戴夫也跟着一起做运动。结果谁知道戴夫居然可以跑这么快！

AQUAVINE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: An amphibious plant that can support both ground and water type plants. Its abilities will change based on the type plant it is host to.
AQUAVINE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 两栖植物，无论植物是陆生还是水生，它都能为其提供辅助。寄生在不同类型的植物身上，其能力也会有所不同。

AQUAVINE_DESCRIPTION_HINT.en: Aqua Vine can support ground type plants in water and water type plants on ground. Use this versatility to optimize your plant placement.
AQUAVINE_DESCRIPTION_HINT.zh: 无论是水面上的陆生植物，还是陆地上的水生植物，绿水藤蔓都能为其提供辅助。灵活利用这样的多功能性，优化你的植物布阵。

AQUAVINE_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Attracts zombies and then blasts them away with a jet of water.
AQUAVINE_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}吸引僵尸，随后喷出水柱将其吹飞。

AQUAVINE_TOOLTIP.en: Amphibious support plant, with a powerful water jet.
AQUAVINE_TOOLTIP.zh: 两栖辅助类植物，拥有强力喷水管。

AQUAWEED_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}Summons sharks to attack and devour enemies. When conditions are met, a giant shark can be summoned.

{FLAVOR}Because it has a beard, it is regarded by other plants as a wise leader, guiding the ocean plants in their life under the sea—and that includes the little sharks too.
AQUAWEED_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特点：{STAT}召唤鲨鱼攻击并吞噬敌人，满足条件可召唤大型鲨鱼

{FLAVOR}因为长有胡子所以被其他植物奉为智者和领导，引领着海洋植物们在海里生活，当然还包括小鲨鱼。

AQUAWEED_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: Poseidon Weed releases a giant shark to attack all zombies in the row, also applying a chilling slow effect.
AQUAWEED_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}释放大鲨鱼攻击整行僵尸，并造成冷缓效果。

ARCADE_DIALOG_FOOTER.en: Unlock Power Ups to use in Endless!
ARCADE_DIALOG_FOOTER.zh: 在无尽模式解锁金手指！

ARENA_LOCKED_PROMPT_INFO.en: Play Arena matches to earn mints! Mints can be used to acquire mint-family plants and give you the edge in Adventure and Arena!
ARENA_LOCKED_PROMPT_INFO.zh: 参加竞技场比赛，赢取薄荷糖！你可以通过薄荷糖来获取薄荷家族植物，使你在冒险模式和竞技场中占据优势！

ARMAMINT_DESCRIPTION.en: As the best and most powerful shooter plant, his offensive ability should not be underestimated.
ARMAMINT_DESCRIPTION.zh: 作为最棒，最厉害的的射手植物，他的攻击能力不应该被低估。

ARMAMINT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 可以向高级僵尸发射超级能量子弹。

ATLANTIS_LEVEL_NAME.zh: 海底世界 - 第 {LEVEL_NUMBER} 天

AUTH_AWARD_BODY.en: Each profile on your account has been given a reward for successfully registering your account!
AUTH_AWARD_BODY.zh: 成功注册账户后，每个档案都能获得奖励！

AUTOMATIC_COLLECTION.en: Automatic Collection (Need Pass Lunar Rainbow Market)
AUTOMATIC_COLLECTION.zh: 自动收集（需先通关月虹市场）

AWAITING_EMAIL_VERIFICATION.zh: 正在尝试验证电子邮箱地址…

AWARD_SCREEN_COSTUME_DESCRIPTION.zh: 你的{PLANT}得到了一件新装扮！

AWARD_SCREEN_DANGER_ROOM_BEACH.zh: 成为提基文明传承者的通行证！

AWARD_SCREEN_DANGER_ROOM_COWBOY.en: Access to the Big Bad Butte!

AWARD_SCREEN_DANGER_ROOM_EGYPT.en: Access to the Pyramid of Doom!

AWARD_SCREEN_DANGER_ROOM_GENERIC.en: Survive level after level of escalating zombie attacks. Test your skills in this Endless Zone.
AWARD_SCREEN_DANGER_ROOM_GENERIC.zh: 随着关卡的推进，僵尸的进攻会越来越激烈。试着在无尽模式中生存下来，考验你的技术吧。

AWARD_SCREEN_DANGER_ROOM_ICEAGE.zh: 进入冰封战场的通行证！

AWARD_SCREEN_DANGER_ROOM_MODERN.en: Access to Highway to the Danger Room!

AWARD_SCREEN_FIRSTKEY_DESCRIPTION.en: It's an ancient key.  Now all you need is an ancient lock.
AWARD_SCREEN_FIRSTKEY_DESCRIPTION.zh: 这是一个上古时代的钥匙。现在你需要一个上古时代的锁。

AWARD_SCREEN_LAWN_MOWER_TRIGGERED.en: ONE OR MORE LAWN MOWERS WERE TRIGGERED!

AWARD_SCREEN_LRM_VIPCARD.en: Reward from the Market God, seems to attract certain drops?
AWARD_SCREEN_LRM_VIPCARD.zh: 市场之神给予的奖励，似乎可以吸引某些掉落物？

AWARD_SCREEN_MAPGADGET_DESCRIPTION.en: A parchment of ancient lands, with cosmic implications.
AWARD_SCREEN_MAPGADGET_DESCRIPTION.zh: 一张来自远古土地的羊皮纸，上面预示着宇宙的奥秘。

AWARD_SCREEN_MONEYBAG_DESCRIPTION_01.en: Like your head is full of brains, this bag is full of coins!
AWARD_SCREEN_MONEYBAG_DESCRIPTION_01.zh: 这个袋子里装满了金币，就像你的脑袋里装满了脑子一样！

AWARD_SCREEN_MONEYBAG_DESCRIPTION_02.en: Coins, coins, coins! For all your Power Up and Plant Food needs!
AWARD_SCREEN_MONEYBAG_DESCRIPTION_02.zh: 金币，金币，金币！让你叶绿素、金手指使用随心！

AWARD_SCREEN_MONEYBAG_DESCRIPTION_03.en: It's better than a bag of imps, there are coins!
AWARD_SCREEN_MONEYBAG_DESCRIPTION_03.zh: 这个袋子里面装满了金币…这起码比一袋子小鬼僵尸要好吧。

AWARD_SCREEN_MONEYBAG_DESCRIPTION_04.en: Sorry, your epic bag of infinite coins was on another zombie.
AWARD_SCREEN_MONEYBAG_DESCRIPTION_04.zh: 真遗憾，那个有无限金币的袋子在另一只僵尸身上。

AWARD_SCREEN_MONEYBAG_DESCRIPTION_05.en: A coin in the bag is way better than looking a gift zombie in the mouth.
AWARD_SCREEN_MONEYBAG_DESCRIPTION_05.zh: 看到袋子里的金币，可比从袋口里看到礼物是僵尸要好多了。

AWARD_SCREEN_NEW_UPGRADE.zh: 你得到了一个新的升级道具！

AWARD_SCREEN_POWERUPGADGET_DESCRIPTION.en: Use only in a jam. Do not use if quality seal is broken.
AWARD_SCREEN_POWERUPGADGET_DESCRIPTION.zh: 只能在罐子中使用。如果密封不严实，请勿使用。

AWARD_SCREEN_POWERUP_TITLE.en: Crazy Dave's jar of preserved powers
AWARD_SCREEN_POWERUP_TITLE.zh: 疯狂戴夫用来储存力量的罐子

AWARD_SCREEN_POWERUP_VASEBREAKERBUTTER_D.en: Butters a single Zombie in Vasebreaker
AWARD_SCREEN_POWERUP_VASEBREAKERBUTTER_D.zh: 在破罐者中给一只僵尸涂上黄油！

AWARD_SCREEN_POWERUP_VASEBREAKERMOVE_DES.zh: 在破罐者关卡中改变一个花瓶的位置

AWARD_SCREEN_POWERUP_VASEBREAKERREVEAL_D.en: Reveals the contents of one Vase in Vasebreaker
AWARD_SCREEN_POWERUP_VASEBREAKERREVEAL_D.zh: 在破罐者关卡中显示一个花瓶里面的东西

AWARD_SCREEN_WORLDKEY_BEACH.en: You can now enjoy a seaside holiday at Big Wave Beach
AWARD_SCREEN_WORLDKEY_BEACH.zh: 你现在可以享受巨浪海滩的海滨假日了。

AWARD_SCREEN_WORLDKEY_COWBOY.en: You can now experience the sandy sky of the Wild West.
AWARD_SCREEN_WORLDKEY_COWBOY.zh: 你现在可以感受狂野西部的漫天黄沙了。

AWARD_SCREEN_WORLDKEY_DARK.en: You have secured access to the feudal savagery of the Dark Ages.
AWARD_SCREEN_WORLDKEY_DARK.zh: 你现在可以感受黑暗时代的封建社会了。

AWARD_SCREEN_WORLDKEY_DESCRIPTION.en: Use to unlock new Worlds and travel to other times!
AWARD_SCREEN_WORLDKEY_DESCRIPTION.zh: 用来解锁新的世界，穿越到其它时空！

AWARD_SCREEN_WORLDKEY_DINO.en: You have secured access to the saurian jeopardy of Jurassic Marsh.
AWARD_SCREEN_WORLDKEY_DINO.zh: 你现在可以遭遇侏罗纪沼泽的蜥蜴危机了。

AWARD_SCREEN_WORLDKEY_EIGHTIES.en: You have secured access to the urgent rhythms of the Neon Mixtape Tour.
AWARD_SCREEN_WORLDKEY_EIGHTIES.zh: 你现在可以感受炫光魔音游的跃动节拍了。

AWARD_SCREEN_WORLDKEY_FUTURE.en: You have secured access to the technological conundrum of the Far Future.
AWARD_SCREEN_WORLDKEY_FUTURE.zh: 你现在可以预见遥远未来的技术瓶颈了。

AWARD_SCREEN_WORLDKEY_ICEAGE.en: You have secured access to chilling enclosure of the Frostbite Caves.
AWARD_SCREEN_WORLDKEY_ICEAGE.zh: 你现在可以面对极寒冰窟的凛冽寒风了。

AWARD_SCREEN_WORLDKEY_LOSTCITY.en: You have secured access to the secluded wonder of the Lost City.
AWARD_SCREEN_WORLDKEY_LOSTCITY.zh: 你现在可以探寻失落之城的神秘遗迹了。

AWARD_SCREEN_WORLDKEY_MODERN.en: You have secured access to the mundane horror of the Modern Day.
AWARD_SCREEN_WORLDKEY_MODERN.zh: 你现在可以回到现代年华的平凡生活了。

AWARD_SCREEN_WORLDKEY_PIRATE.en: You have secured access to the aquatic banditry of the Pirate Seas.
AWARD_SCREEN_WORLDKEY_PIRATE.zh: 你现在可以体验海盗港湾的海盗生活了。

AWARD_SCREEN_WORLDKEY_RAINBOWMARKET.en: You have secured access to the ability cards of the Lunar Rainbow Market!
AWARD_SCREEN_WORLDKEY_RAINBOWMARKET.zh: 你现在可以挑选月虹市场的能力卡牌了。

AWARD_SCREEN_WORLDTROPHY_BEACH.en: You have defeated Dr. Zomboss' creation, the Zombot Sharktronic Sub.
AWARD_SCREEN_WORLDTROPHY_BEACH.zh: 你击败了僵王博士的造物，巨鲨潜袭者。

AWARD_SCREEN_WORLDTROPHY_CHINESEGARDEN.en: You have defeated Dr. Zomboss' creation, the Zombot Opera Wrecker 1598.
AWARD_SCREEN_WORLDTROPHY_CHINESEGARDEN.zh: 你击败了僵王博士的造物，游园惊魂 - 1598 型。

AWARD_SCREEN_WORLDTROPHY_COWBOY.en: You have defeated Dr. Zomboss' creation, the Zombot War Wagon.
AWARD_SCREEN_WORLDTROPHY_COWBOY.zh: 你击败了僵王博士的造物，牛车狂战者。

AWARD_SCREEN_WORLDTROPHY_DARK.en: You have defeated Dr. Zomboss' creation, the Zombot Dark Dragon.
AWARD_SCREEN_WORLDTROPHY_DARK.zh: 你击败了僵王博士的造物，黑龙驾驭者。

AWARD_SCREEN_WORLDTROPHY_DINO.en: You have defeated Dr. Zomboss' creation, the Zombot Dinotronic Mechasaur.
AWARD_SCREEN_WORLDTROPHY_DINO.zh: 你击败了僵王博士的造物，机龙速袭者。

AWARD_SCREEN_WORLDTROPHY_EGYPT.en: You have defeated Dr. Zomboss' creation, the Zombot Sphinx-inator.
AWARD_SCREEN_WORLDTROPHY_EGYPT.zh: 你击败了僵王博士的造物，狮身终结者。

AWARD_SCREEN_WORLDTROPHY_EIGHTIES.en: You have defeated Dr. Zomboss’ creation, the Zombot Multi-stage Masher.
AWARD_SCREEN_WORLDTROPHY_EIGHTIES.zh: 你击败了僵王博士的造物，狂舞碎灭者。

AWARD_SCREEN_WORLDTROPHY_FUTURE.en: You have defeated Dr. Zomboss' creation, the Zombot Tomorrow-tron.
AWARD_SCREEN_WORLDTROPHY_FUTURE.zh: 你击败了僵王博士的造物，明日破译者。

AWARD_SCREEN_WORLDTROPHY_ICEAGE.en: You have defeated Dr. Zomboss' creation, the Zombot Tuskmaster 10,000 BC.
AWARD_SCREEN_WORLDTROPHY_ICEAGE.zh: 你击败了僵王博士的造物，獠牙驯服者。

AWARD_SCREEN_WORLDTROPHY_LOSTCITY.en: You have defeated Dr. Zomboss' invention, the Zombot Aerostatic Gondola.
AWARD_SCREEN_WORLDTROPHY_LOSTCITY.zh: 你击败了僵王博士的造物，飞船远航者。

AWARD_SCREEN_WORLDTROPHY_MODERN.en: You have acquired a taco with a waffle in it!
AWARD_SCREEN_WORLDTROPHY_MODERN.zh: 你得到了一块夹着华夫饼的玉米卷！

AWARD_SCREEN_WORLDTROPHY_MODERN_TITLE.en: Taco With a Waffle In It

AWARD_SCREEN_WORLDTROPHY_PIRATE.en: You have defeated Dr. Zomboss' creation, the Zombot Plank Walker.
AWARD_SCREEN_WORLDTROPHY_PIRATE.zh: 你击败了僵王博士的造物，甲板踏行者。

BALLISTA_INHIBITOR_DESCRIPTION.zh: 把关卡中的罗马投石机僵尸替换掉！

BAMBOOSPARTAN_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}Bamboo Spartan enters a Battle Trance once his shield shatters, increasing his damage.

{FLAVOR}"For Tacos and Liberty! Scratch that... for TACOOS!!"
BAMBOOSPARTAN_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}斯巴达竹的盾牌一旦破碎，就会进入战斗恍惚状态，增加他的攻击力。

{FLAVOR}“为了玉米卷和自由！为了玉米卷！！”

BAMBOOSPARTAN_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: A Fierce Bamboo Warrior that can withstand massive damage. When his shield breaks, his attacks will deal even more damage.
BAMBOOSPARTAN_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 一个凶猛的竹勇士，可以承受巨大的伤害。当他的护盾断裂时，他的攻击会造成更大的伤害。

BAMBOOSPARTAN_DESCRIPTION_HINT.en: Bamboo Spartan can give and take a lot of punishment, making him a very effective frontliner.
BAMBOOSPARTAN_DESCRIPTION_HINT.zh: 斯巴达竹可以给予和接受很多惩罚，这使他成为一名非常有效的前锋。

BAMBOOSPARTAN_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Slams its Spear to knockback zombies multiple times.
BAMBOOSPARTAN_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}多次用长矛猛击击退僵尸。

BAMBOOSPARTAN_TOOLTIP.en: Tanky Melee Plant that can hit Zombies upto 2 tiles away.
BAMBOOSPARTAN_TOOLTIP.zh: 攻击前方两个格子的僵尸。

BANANA_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}It's important to avoid stereotyping as much as possible. Stereotypes are often flat-out wrong. And also hurtful. But honestly ... Banana Launcher is TOTALLY bananas.
BANANA_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}使用：{STAT}轻点进行武装，然后轻点目标地砖进行开火
{KEYWORD}范围：{STAT}草坪上的任何地方
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}炮弹撞向僵尸，并在小范围内爆炸

{FLAVOR}尽量避免刻板印象很重要。因为这些刻板印象很多时候根本不正确，而且还很伤人。但是…香蕉火箭炮确实是香蕉。

BANANA_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Banana Launchers can fire explosive bananas at any tile on the lawn.
BANANA_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 香蕉火箭炮可以向草坪上的任何一块地砖上发射爆炸香蕉。

BANANA_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Launches four explosive bananas that target random zombies.
BANANA_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}向随机僵尸发射四枚爆炸香蕉。

BANANA_TOOLTIP.en: Tap on banana, then a tile, to launch explosive banana
BANANA_TOOLTIP.zh: 轻点香蕉，再轻点一块地砖，即可发射爆炸香蕉弹

BDAY_24_PREMIUM_PINATA_BUNDLE.zh: 生日庆典高级彩陶捆绑包

BEANCHEMIST_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}Lobs transformative peas that turn zombies into Pea plants.
{KEYWORD}Basic Attack Chance: {STAT}Peashooter: 50%, Snow Pea: 25%, Primal Peashooter: 25%.
{KEYWORD}Plant Food Chance: {STAT}20% chance each for Goo Peashooter, Shadow Peashooter, Threepeater, Gatling Pea, or Mega Gatling Pea. If a Shadow Peashooter is created, it will be permanently powered.

{FLAVOR}Pea Pharmacist loves peas, so he wants to turn everything into peas. However, he forgot one thing: the more peas there are, the more peas get eaten.
BEANCHEMIST_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}扔出变形豌豆将僵尸变成豌豆。
{KEYWORD}普通攻击概率：{STAT}豌豆射手：50%，寒冰豌豆：25%，原始豌豆射手：25%。
{KEYWORD}叶绿素概率：{STAT}毒液豌豆、暗影豌豆、三线射手、机枪豌豆、超级机枪豌豆各占20%，如果生成的是暗影豌豆，则为其赋予永久的暗影强化效果。
{FLAVOR}豌豆药剂师非常喜欢豌豆，所以它想把什么都变成豌豆，但是它忘记了一点，出现的豌豆越多，被吃掉的豌豆也就越多。

BEANCHEMIST_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Pea Pharmacist lobs transformative peas to turn zombies into Pea plants.
BEANCHEMIST_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 豌豆药剂师扔出变形豌豆将僵尸变成豌豆。

BEANCHEMIST_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Lobs transformative peas at the zombies closest to the house in the top, middle, and bottom lanes.
BEANCHEMIST_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}向上中下三行离房子最近的僵尸投出变形豌豆。

BEANCHEMIST_TOOLTIP.en: Pea Pharmacist lobs transformative peas to turn zombies into Pea plants.
BEANCHEMIST_TOOLTIP.zh: 豌豆药剂师扔出变形豌豆将僵尸变成豌豆

BEANSPROUT_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}With multiple advanced degrees in Botany and Space-Time Relativity, no one will argue that Bean Sprout is a plant genius. Which makes it incredibly difficult for him to watch Dave work in his kitchen. "No... No... Why are you doing that?!? Don’t cut the Red wires!"
BEANSPROUT_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}作为多个植物学、时空相对论高级学位的持有者，毋庸置疑，斗芽是一位植物天才。所以，在看到戴夫在厨房里折腾的时候，他实在忍受不了了。“不……不……你在干什么？！？不要剪红线啊！”

BEANSPROUT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Mild mannered Wall plant with a dark monstrous side. When Bean Sprout takes too much damage, it transforms into a fist swinging monster.
BEANSPROUT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 一株表面温文尔雅，内心却黑暗恐怖的防御类植物。当斗芽受到太多伤害时，它就会摇身一变成为一个挥舞拳头的怪物。

BEANSPROUT_DESCRIPTION_HINT.en: Planting another Bean Sprout on an existing one, will force him into its monster form.
BEANSPROUT_DESCRIPTION_HINT.zh: 在一株斗芽上方再叠种一株，即可强制激活它的怪物形态。

BEANSPROUT_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Transforms into its monster form, if it wasn’t already, and sends massive shockwaves both in front and behind him.
BEANSPROUT_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}如果还未变身，则立刻转变为怪物形态，随后同时向前后方发射强力冲击波。

BEANSPROUT_TOOLTIP.en: Wall plant that transforms into a monster when taking damage.
BEANSPROUT_TOOLTIP.zh: 当受到伤害时从防御类植物变为攻击类怪物。

BEGONIA_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Icy Spikeleaf: {STAT}Pierces 4 zombies in front and applies Heartbreak to zombies hit.
{KEYWORD}Fiery Spikeleaf: {STAT}Pierces 2 zombies in front, deals fire damage, and applies Lovesick to zombies hit.
{KEYWORD}Heartbreak: {STAT}Reduces movement speed (50%). This effect is considered a special chill effect and cannot be removed by fire damage.
{KEYWORD}Lovesick: {STAT}Reduces attack damage (30%).
{KEYWORD}Heartbroken: {STAT}Reduces movement speed (35%) and attack damage (40%), and increases damage taken (50%).
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}Zombies with Lovesick and Heartbreak will clear both effects and gain Heartbroken.
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}Zombies with Heartbroken cannot gain Heartbreak or Lovesick.

{FLAVOR}A story of love, a story of heartbreak, this is her tale. Even zombies slow their pace upon hearing it, deeply stirred. But the truth is, zombies are commonly allergic to begonia pollen. Special thanks to our guest today, Doctor Zombie. Thank you for watching "Approaching Brain Philosophy." I'm your zombie host, and we'll see you next time.
BEGONIA_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}冰穗叶：{STAT}穿透前方 4 只僵尸，并使攻击到的僵尸陷入【苦情】状态
{KEYWORD}火穗叶：{STAT}穿透前方 2 只僵尸，且带有火焰性质，并使攻击到的僵尸陷入【相思】状态
{KEYWORD}苦情：{STAT}降低移动速度（50%），且该效果被视为特殊的冷缓效果，无法被火焰伤害解除
{KEYWORD}相思：{STAT}降低啃咬伤害（30%）
{KEYWORD}断肠：{STAT}降低移动速度（35%）、啃咬伤害（40%），并提高受到的伤害（50%）
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}同时陷入【相思】与【苦情】状态的僵尸将会清除自身的两种状态并陷入【断肠】状态
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}处于【断肠】状态的僵尸无法陷入【苦情】和【相思】状态

{FLAVOR}一份恋情，一份苦情，这是她的故事，就连僵尸听到这段故事都会慢下脚步，感到刺激，但真相是僵尸普遍都有秋海棠花粉过敏症，感谢今天的嘉宾，医生僵尸，感谢收看《走进脑学》，我是主持人僵尸，咱们下期见。

BEGONIA_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Begonias randomly throw two types of spikeleaves that stack to increase damage taken by zombies.
BEGONIA_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 秋海棠可以随机扔出两种不同效果的穗叶，两种穗叶效果叠加后使僵尸所受到的伤害提高。

BEGONIA_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Sprays pollen forward, causing zombies hit to directly gain Heartbroken.
BEGONIA_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}向前方喷射花粉，使受到攻击的僵尸直接陷入【断肠】状态。

BEGONIA_TOOLTIP.en: Throws icy and fiery spikeleaves that increase damage taken by zombies
BEGONIA_TOOLTIP.zh: 可以扔出冰火穗叶，提高僵尸所受到的伤害
