BIRDOFPARADISE_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Bliss: {STAT}Upon reaching 10 stacks, it instantly creates a Plant Food on the lawn. All Birds of Paradise on the field can only create one Plant Food from this effect every 25 seconds. "Bliss" stacks are capped at 10.

{FLAVOR}"I used to work as a supplier for a pinto bean processing factory," said Bird of Paradise. "That was until Yucca, who also just resigned, told me about this opportunity to support our allies. Now I feel like a completely different plant. I just haven't found a lawyer to help me deal with the breach of contract with the bean factory."

{KEYWORD}Programmer: {STAT}jaynkrow
BIRDOFPARADISE_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}极乐：{STAT}当【极乐】达到 10 层时，极乐草会立即在场上创造一份叶绿素。场上所有极乐草每 25 秒内最多只能通过【极乐】效果创造一份叶绿素。【极乐】层数上限为 10 层。

{FLAVOR}“我以前的工作是给一个绿豆加工厂当供货商。”极乐鸟说道，“直到刚刚也辞职了的红丝兰告诉我了这个支援友军的机会，现在我真的觉得自己完全不同了，只是没有找到律师帮我解决绿豆厂的合同违约。”

{KEYWORD}代码：{STAT}jaynkrow

BIRDOFPARADISE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Bird of Paradise pecks targets across three lanes, reaching up to 2 tiles ahead. Each time it hits a zombie, Bird of Paradise gains 1 stack of "Bliss."
BIRDOFPARADISE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 极乐草可以对前方 3 行的目标进行啄击，最多可攻击到前方 2 列。每击中僵尸一次，极乐草获得 1 层【极乐】。

BIRDOFPARADISE_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Launches her bird head forward, pecking a whole row of zombies and accumulating "Bliss" stacks based on the number of zombies hit.
BIRDOFPARADISE_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}向前方射出鸟头，啄击前方一整行僵尸，同时根据命中僵尸数积攒【极乐】层数。

BIRDOFPARADISE_TOOLTIP.en: Pecks targets in a range and creates Plant Food based on hits
BIRDOFPARADISE_TOOLTIP.zh: 啄击前方范围内的目标并根据命中数生成叶绿素

BIRTHDAYZ_AD_OFFER.zh: 生日庆典广告观看激励

BIRTHDAYZ_PREMIUM_PINATA_BUNDLE.zh: 生日庆典高级彩陶捆绑包

BIRTHSUNFLOWER_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Sunflower Singer is super stylish and very popular. She is so popular that she couldn't travel normally in a crowd of people.
BIRTHSUNFLOWER_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}为了准备两周年的庆典活动，组织方特意邀请了植物界最著名的歌手向日葵作为特邀嘉宾出席。除了大把阳光的出场费，组织方还花费了数天时间说服领导、找回失踪的经纪人小豌豌、并答应邀请著名的发型师三叶草为向日葵制作新发型才成功。届时你将能在庆典会场聆听她献唱成名曲《有僵尸在你的草坪上》，如果你能买到票或者干掉高大的追秒草保镖的话……

BIRTHSUNFLOWER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Sunflower Singer can produce 100 sun by singing.
BIRTHSUNFLOWER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 向日葵歌手可以通过演唱产出 100 阳光。

BIRTHSUNFLOWER_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Immediately produces a large amount of sun.
BIRTHSUNFLOWER_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}举行一次演唱会，产生大量阳光。

BIRTHSUNFLOWER_TOOLTIP.en: Gives twice as much sun as a sunflower
BIRTHSUNFLOWER_TOOLTIP.zh: 提供两倍于向日葵的阳光

BIRTTHDAYZ_INHIBITOR_DESCRIPTION.zh: 生日僵尸，来参加生日派对吧！

BLACK_FRIDAY_PINATA_BUNDLE.zh: 黑色星期五彩陶捆绑包

BLASTBERRY_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}In a mysterious western town, Dual Pistol Pinecone is a sharpshooter cowboy, fighting all sorts of zombie bullies that invade his town, zombies tremble as soon as his name is mentioned. He almost became the town sheriff, but he turned it down, because he feels that sheriffs think that they're too good to go to the bar and drink.
BLASTBERRY_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}在一个西部神秘小镇，松果是个牛仔枪手，他粉碎了每一个入侵他镇子的恶霸僵尸，让僵尸们一提到他的名字就不寒而栗。他就差这么一点就能成为镇上的警长，但他拒绝了，因为他认为警长太无聊了，还不如去酒馆喝酒呢。

BLASTBERRY_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: After defeating a zombie, releases a special attack.
BLASTBERRY_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 打败僵尸后，下一次普攻可以释放出特殊攻击。

BLASTBERRY_TOOLTIP.en: After defeating a zombie, releases a special attack.
BLASTBERRY_TOOLTIP.zh: 打败僵尸后，下一次普攻可以释放出特殊攻击

BLASTSPINNER_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Blast Spinner suddenly showed up on the lawn one day, eager to join the fight against Dr. Zomboss. Even after multiple attempts, neither Penny nor Dave are any closer in determining where she is from. The one thing Penny can conclude is that she must be from a world in an uncharted part of Space-Time.
BLASTSPINNER_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}不知哪天，爆网织株突然空降到草坪上，渴求加入反抗僵王博士的队伍。潘妮和戴夫屡次试图寻找她的来历，但最终都以失败告终。不过潘妮可以断定一点：她肯定来自时空中不为人知的那部分世界。

BLASTSPINNER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Lobs immobilizing, sticky webs at zombies on adjacent lanes. Affected zombies may be turned into cocoons that will explode and deal damage to all surrounding zombies.
BLASTSPINNER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 向周围行的僵尸投掷黏性蛛网，将其定住。被命中的僵尸有概率化为可以爆炸的茧，爆炸后对周围的所有僵尸造成伤害。

BLASTSPINNER_DESCRIPTION_HINT.en: It takes a few seconds for Blast Spinner’s cocoons to explode, clump zombies up to maximize the damage potential.
BLASTSPINNER_DESCRIPTION_HINT.zh: 爆网织株的茧得过几秒才会爆炸，把僵尸聚在一起，最大利用爆炸造成的伤害。

BLASTSPINNER_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Launches multiple web cocoons at nearby zombies, turning them into explosive cocoons.
BLASTSPINNER_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}向周围的僵尸发射数枚茧囊，将其变为可以爆炸的茧。

BLASTSPINNER_TOOLTIP.en: Immobilizes zombies using webs and explosive cocoons.
BLASTSPINNER_TOOLTIP.zh: 使用蛛网、爆炸茧囊定住僵尸。

BLAZELEAF_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Blaze Leaf actually meditates in the Zen Garden to control his temper. Anyone to disturb that can expect all hell to break loose on the lawn as Blaze Leaf can be seen chasing the poor soul, launching its flame waves at them. This can go on for the whole morning, often destroying the lawn. Dave hasn’t even dared to suggest an anger management course knowing what may follow. He has just accepted the fact and actually treats it as a morning call to wake up.
BLAZELEAF_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}其实炽叶常在禅境花园冥想，想要压制自己的脾气。任何胆敢打扰他的人，都将在草坪上被他喷着烈火追得到处跑。大战经常一个上午都不消停，把草坪弄得黄沙漫天。戴夫想推荐一门情绪管理课给他，但他也知道后果会怎样，所以一直不敢。只得接受这个事实，把它当作自己每天早上的起床铃。

BLAZELEAF_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Blaze Leaf attacks Zombies in a large radius. Every third strike, it releases the Blaze Wave attack which damages zombies in multiple lanes as it travels along a straight path.
BLAZELEAF_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 炽叶可以攻击大范围的僵尸。每攻击三次，它都会释放“炽浪”攻击，“炽浪”向前推进，伤害数行的僵尸。

BLAZELEAF_DESCRIPTION_HINT.en: Blaze Leaf can target zombies in the front and back as well so position it wisely.
BLAZELEAF_DESCRIPTION_HINT.zh: 炽叶可以锁定前后两个方向的僵尸，要记得合理选择位置。

BLAZELEAF_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Launches a swirling fiery wave of energy damaging all the zombies on the lawn.
BLAZELEAF_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}发射旋转的炽热能量波，伤害草坪上的所有僵尸。

BLAZELEAF_TOOLTIP.en: Deals damage in an area and releases flame wave attack.
BLAZELEAF_TOOLTIP.zh: 造成范围伤害，释放热浪攻击。

BLOCKOLI_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}"Hey, guys! Blockoli here! What's goin' on? Here comes a zombie! I'm gonna SLAM 'IM! With FISTS!" says Blockoli. And he really means it!
BLOCKOLI_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}嘿，老铁们！西拦花在此！咋地了？有僵尸啊！看我把他揍得满地找牙！”然后，他还真就这么干了！

BLOCKOLI_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Blockoli dual-wields two sturdy floret shields, slamming them down to stun and block approaching zombies.
BLOCKOLI_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 西拦花双持坚固的花盾，猛击下来，眩晕并阻挡接近的僵尸。

BLOCKOLI_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Swings his florets around dealing damage and stunning Zombies in the surrounding area. Gain two iron shields that can absorb a large amount of damage.
BLOCKOLI_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}挥动他的小花茎，对周围的僵尸造成伤害、产生眩晕效果。随后获得两面可以阻挡大量伤害的铁盾。

BLOOMERANG1_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}As the first new member to your home defense team, Bloomerang enjoys long walkabouts with his friend, Koala Bear, and listening to his Bob Barley albums out back.
BLOOMERANG1_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}能一次击中三个目标，每个目标攻击两次

{FLAVOR}回旋镖射手是防守团队的新成员。它最爱和朋友考拉熊一起，散散步，听听流行歌，无比惬意。

BLOOMERANG1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Bloomerangs can hit multiple targets in their lane, twice each coming and going!
BLOOMERANG1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 回旋镖射手投出回旋镖，对最多三个目标造成两次伤害！

BLOOMERANG1_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Throws boomerangs in four directions damaging all zombies in the area.
BLOOMERANG1_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}向上、下、左、右投掷大量回旋镖，对区域内的所有僵尸造成伤害。

BLOOMERANG1_PLANTFOOD.en: Throws many boomerangs that hit all the zombies to the left, right, above, and below.
BLOOMERANG1_PLANTFOOD.zh: 扔出多枚回旋镖，能击中上下左右所有僵尸。

BLOOMERANG1_TOOLTIP.en: Hits up to three targets in its lane, twice
BLOOMERANG1_TOOLTIP.zh: 投出回旋镖，对最多三个目标造成二次伤害。

BLOOMERANG_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Magic-shroom likes to play tricks on others, but he has no bad intentions.
BLOOMERANG_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}魔术菇喜欢跟别人耍把戏，但他并没有恶意。

BLOOMERANG_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Magic-shrooms have chance to fire magic card to attack multiple targets in a row.
BLOOMERANG_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 魔术菇可以攻击一行上的多个目标，并且一来一回攻击两次。

BLOOMERANG_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Fires a large number of magic cards in a frontal fan-shaped area and summons a Magic Hat at the leftmost tile of each row, which randomly spawns one zombie ally.

BLOOMERANG_PLANTFOOD.en: Throws many cards that hit all the zombies up to 3 nearby lanes.
BLOOMERANG_PLANTFOOD.zh: 向僵尸发射许多魔术牌。

BLOOMINGHEARTDEBUFF.en: Hit zombies with Blooming Hearts' projectiles
BLOOMINGHEARTDEBUFF.zh: 被铃儿草投手的心之蕊砸中

BLOOMINGHEARTS1_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Blooming Heart loves zombies. She gets guff from her fellow plants over it, but she stands firm. She's into zombies and makes no apologies about it.
BLOOMINGHEARTS1_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}多个铃儿草可以造成更高的额外伤害

{FLAVOR}铃儿草深爱着僵尸。尽管她总是因此被她的植物伙伴恶语相向，但这依然改变不了她的观点。她就是这么爱僵尸，而爱不需要道歉。

BLOOMINGHEARTS1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Blooming Hearts lob projectiles that infatuate zombies, causing increasing damage the more they hit.
BLOOMINGHEARTS1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 铃儿草可以投掷令僵尸迷恋的心之蕊，僵尸被攻击的次数越多，受到的伤害越大。

BLOOMINGHEARTS1_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Throw large projectiles at every zombie, dealing massive damage.
BLOOMINGHEARTS1_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}向每只僵尸投掷大号子弹，造成大量伤害。

BLOOMINGHEARTS1_TOOLTIP.en: Lobs projectiles that do more damage the more they hit
BLOOMINGHEARTS1_TOOLTIP.zh: 向僵尸投掷心之蕊，同一只僵尸受击次数越多，伤害越大

BLOOMINGHEARTS_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}Damage will be doubled when killing low HP zombies

{FLAVOR}Elaeocarpus-pult is a national first-class athlete and every new plant gets the same question from it, "sporting is the essence of life, fancy some badminton?"
BLOOMINGHEARTS_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}扣杀时伤害会倍增

{FLAVOR}杜英投手是国家一级运动员，每遇到一株新的植物，他都会问他们：“生命在于运动，你想和我一起打羽毛球吗？”

BLOOMINGHEARTS_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Will bounce shuttlecocks off of zombies when they're far away, and will kill lower-health zombies when they're at close range.
BLOOMINGHEARTS_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 当僵尸离得远时，他们会发射普通子弹，当僵尸近在咫尺，他会扣杀血量低的僵尸。

BLOOMINGHEARTS_TOOLTIP.en: When the zombies are far away, they will fire normal shuttlecocks. When the zombies are close, they will kill lower-health zombies.
BLOOMINGHEARTS_TOOLTIP.zh: 当僵尸离得远时，他们会发射普通子弹，当僵尸近在咫尺，他会扣杀血量低的僵尸

BLOVER_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}The luckiest stunt clover around, Blover is the most recent recipient of the Stunty Award. You can see his work in "Bulb Fiction," "Rooty," and "Finding Flower." He also teaches a stunt class on Tuesdays at the community center.
BLOVER_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}使用：{STAT}一次性使用，立即生效
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}吹走屏幕中所有腾空或飞行的僵尸

{FLAVOR}他是最幸运的三叶草，最近还刚被授予了“最佳特技奖”的荣誉。他的特技表演家喻户晓，像是“球茎小说”、“寻根究底”、“找花”等大作中都有他的身影。不仅如此，每周二他还在社区中心讲授一门有关特技技巧的课程。

BLOVER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Blovers blow away all zombies in the air.
BLOVER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 三叶草可以吹走在空中的僵尸。

BLOVER_TOOLTIP.en: Blows away all flying and floating zombies
BLOVER_TOOLTIP.zh: 吹走所有飞行或飘浮着的僵尸

BOINGSETTA1_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Boingsetta's a springy plant whose positive outlook is infectiously delightful! The chilling effect is merely a secondary consequence.
BOINGSETTA1_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}一品红其实是一株富有春意的植物，她积极的态度很令人愉快！不过她同时也能给予僵尸如寒冬般的感受。

BOINGSETTA1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Boingsettas slam the ground in a "boing" that heavily damages grid items, bounces zombies back and chills them.
BOINGSETTA1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 一品红可以“轰”地一声猛击地面上的障碍物，击退僵尸，并让它们冷缓。

BOINGSETTA1_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Deal heavy damage to all obstacles and slight damage to all zombies, knocking them back and chilling them for a short duration.
BOINGSETTA1_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}对所有障碍物造成大量伤害，对所有僵尸造成轻微伤害，随后将它们击退一段距离，并使其获得一段时间的冷缓效果。

BOINGSETTA_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Range: {STAT}2x3 area ahead.

{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}Let out a roar to stun the zombies in front, and then send out a spirit to attack the zombies.

{FLAVOR}In action, Tigerstool excels with his rapid, devastating combos that crush all opposition and his agility. He spends his spare time at home searching for cat videos. It is said that Tigerstool's computer has accumulated tens of thousands of high-quality cat movies organized by category.
BOINGSETTA_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}范围：{STAT}前方2×3范围
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}发出吼叫震晕前方僵尸，随后发出数道幻影从多个方向对僵尸进行攻击。

{FLAVOR}虎头菇在工作中擅长以迅雷不及掩耳之势的连击击溃对手，能够在战斗中进退自如。而回家后虎头菇则喜欢在网上搜索自己中意的猫片，据传虎头菇的电脑中已经积攒了数以万计的按照品种类别分门别类整理好的优质猫片。

BOINGSETTA_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Stuns the zombies ahead with a roar, then sends out a spirit to attack..
BOINGSETTA_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 虎头菇可以用吼叫震晕前方僵尸，随后发出幻影对僵尸进行攻击。

BOINGSETTA_TOOLTIP.en: Send out spirits to attack zombies

BOMBARDMINT_DESCRIPTION.en: Ice-shrooms temporarily immobilize all zombies on the screen.
BOMBARDMINT_DESCRIPTION.zh: 冰川菇可以冻结整个场地上的僵尸。

BOMBARDMINT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Self-destruction causes 20 damage to zombies in the whole screen. Freezes all frozen targets for 4 seconds, then slows them down for 15 seconds.Ice-shroom frowns, not because he's unhappy or because he disapproves, but because of a childhood injury that left his facial nerves paralyzed.
BOMBARDMINT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 自爆对全屏的僵尸造成20的伤害。冻结所有冰冻目标4秒，然后减速15秒。冰川菇眉头紧锁，并不是因为他不开心或者不赞同别人，而是因为童年的意外受伤使得他的面部神经瘫痪了。

BOMBARDMINT_TOOLTIP.en: Freezes all zombies for 4 seconds and slows them down for 15 seconds
BOMBARDMINT_TOOLTIP.zh: 冻结所有僵尸4秒，减速15秒

BOMBEGRANATE_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Use: {STAT}Instant

{FLAVOR}Oranboom comes from PVZ TAT (Travel Around Time). Sometimes, plants will ask him: "Your bro Tangerine Batter has come to SHUTTLE a long time ago, why are you here?" He will say without hesitation: "We are not the same!"
BOMBEGRANATE_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}使用：{STAT}一次性使用，立即生效

{FLAVOR}橘子炸弹来自PvZ TAT版本，有人会问他：“你的同胞兄弟棒打鲜橙早就来SHUTTLE了，你还来干嘛？”他会毫不犹豫地说：“我们不一样！”

BOMBEGRANATE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Oranboom explodes in a 3x3 area, dealing low damage but leaving juice behind and stall zombies for 4.15 seconds.
BOMBEGRANATE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 橘子炸弹可以在 3x3 的区域内爆炸，伤害中等，但会留下果汁，僵尸会定身4秒减速15秒。

BOMBEGRANATE_TOOLTIP.en: Immobilize and slow down zombies after explosion

BONKCHOY_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}A freelance dentist on the side, he's offering a special this month - he'll knock two of your teeth out for the price of one!
BONKCHOY_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}可以前后攻击

{FLAVOR}作为一个兼职牙医，他在这个月开出了一个优惠 - 拔牙拔一送一！

BONKCHOY_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Bonk Choys rapidly punch nearby enemies that are ahead or behind them.
BONKCHOY_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 菜问能快速攻击前后的敌人。

BONKCHOY_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Rapidly punches in a 3x3 area around it, dealing heavy damage.
BONKCHOY_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}在它周围的 3x3 区域快速出拳，造成大量伤害。

BONKCHOY_PLANTFOOD.en: Attacks with a flurry of fists, doing massive damage to anything on nearby tiles.
BONKCHOY_PLANTFOOD.zh: 打出一连串重拳，对附近格子上的任何东西造成伤害。

BONKCHOY_TOOLTIP.en: Rapidly punches enemies ahead or behind
BONKCHOY_TOOLTIP.zh: 快速拳击前方或后方的僵尸

BOOMBERRY_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}"How to make the best explosions! First fuel. Mix in a spark and an oxidizing agent. Finally, you’ll need me!"
BOOMBERRY_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}“怎样制造一场最绝妙的爆炸？首先，加入燃料，把它和火花、氧化物充分混合。然后，你需要我！”

BOOMBERRY_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Launches explosive berries at the last zombie in its lane, stunning them for a short time.
BOOMBERRY_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 向所在行的最后一只僵尸发射可以爆炸的浆果，让它们短暂眩晕。

BOOMBERRY_DESCRIPTION_HINT.en: Especially effective against Zcorpion, Octo and Wizard zombies.
BOOMBERRY_DESCRIPTION_HINT.zh: 对 Z 公司员工、章鱼、巫师僵尸格外有效。

BOOMBERRY_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Launches multiple projectiles, blanketing the target column with explosive berries.
BOOMBERRY_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}发射多枚子弹，用可以爆炸的浆果盖满目标排。

BOOMBERRY_TOOLTIP.en: Launches explosive berries at the last zombie in its lane.
BOOMBERRY_TOOLTIP.zh: 向所在行的最后一只僵尸发射可以爆炸的浆果。

BOOMFLOWER_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Boom Balloon Flower's balloons are inflated with hydrogen and aerosolized kerosene. It's an anti-safety measure.
BOOMFLOWER_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}使用：{STAT}点击或拖动到地砖上放置一个气球

{FLAVOR}爆炸桔梗的气球里充满了氢气和雾化煤油气，十分危险！

BOOMFLOWER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Boom Balloon Flowers spawn exploding balloons that can be placed anywhere on the lawn as traps for zombies.
BOOMFLOWER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 爆炸桔梗可以在草坪上的任何地方生成一个爆炸气球，气球会在僵尸接近时爆炸。

BOOMFLOWER_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Spawns a giant Doom-shroom balloon named the "Doom Balloon", that will explode once it reaches the fifth column.
BOOMFLOWER_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}生成一枚巨大的毁灭菇气球——“毁灭气球”，达到第五排后即可爆炸。

BOOST_ALREADY_ACTIVE.en: This plant is already boosted! Use it in a level!
BOOST_ALREADY_ACTIVE.zh: 这株植物已经获得过强化了！先在一个关卡里用一次吧！

BOOST_COMBAT_BOUNTY_HUNTER.zh: 击败的僵尸会掉落金币

BOOST_DETAIL_BOUNTY_HUNTER.en: Zombies defeated by this plant drop coins. This boost lasts for 1 level.
BOOST_DETAIL_BOUNTY_HUNTER.zh: 强化后，被该植物击败的僵尸将会掉落金币。该强化只在一关内有效。

BOOST_DETAIL_EXTRA_TOUGH.en: Extra protection from zombies. This boost lasts for 1 level.
BOOST_DETAIL_EXTRA_TOUGH.zh: 强化后，该植物将拥有更高的生命值。该强化只在一关内有效。

BOOST_DETAIL_FAST_RECHARGE.en: Recharges more quickly. This boost lasts for 1 level.
BOOST_DETAIL_FAST_RECHARGE.zh: 强化后，该植物的冷却时间将会变短。该强化只在一关内有效。

BOOST_DETAIL_FIRST_STRIKE.en: Gets free Plant Food effect when planted. This boost lasts for 1 level.
BOOST_DETAIL_FIRST_STRIKE.zh: 强化后，该植物将在种植时免费获得一次叶绿素效果。该强化只在一关内有效。

BOOST_DETAIL_RAPID_FIRE.en: Attacks at a faster rate. This boost lasts for 1 level.
BOOST_DETAIL_RAPID_FIRE.zh: 强化后，该植物的攻击速度将会得到提升。该强化只在一关内有效。

BOOST_DETAIL_SHOVEL_BOMB.en: Explodes when shoveled. This boost lasts for 1 level.
BOOST_DETAIL_SHOVEL_BOMB.zh: 强化后，该植物被铲除时将会发生爆炸。该强化只在一关内有效。

BOOST_DETAIL_SUN_DISCOUNT.en: Costs less sun to plant. This boost lasts for 1 level.
BOOST_DETAIL_SUN_DISCOUNT.zh: 强化后，种植该植物将花费更少的阳光。该强化只在一关内有效

BOSS_BUSTER_CANNON_DESCRIPTION.en: Inflicts up to {DAMAGE} damage to bosses every {TIME} seconds!
BOSS_BUSTER_CANNON_DESCRIPTION.zh: 潘妮每 {TIME} 秒对 BOSS 造成高达 {DAMAGE} 的伤害！

BOWLINGBULB_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Guess which team has won the League Championship for five years running now? Team Bowling Bulb, that's who. They are on a ROLL. You and your pals think you got what it takes to stop 'em? Yeah, sure. Keep dreamin, bub.
BOWLINGBULB_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}攻击细节：{STAT}泡泡越大，破坏力更大

{FLAVOR}猜猜是哪一支球队又一次夺冠，并且已经守擂五年了？保龄泡泡队，就是他们。他们现在正忙着呢，你觉得你能击败他们吗？如果你觉得可以的话，那就继续做梦吧，小家伙。

BOWLINGBULB_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Bowling Bulbs roll shots that can bounce into multiple zombies. The Larger bulbs deal more damage.
BOWLINGBULB_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 保龄泡泡可以发射在多个僵尸之间弹射的滚动泡泡。

BOWLINGBULB_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Shoots three charged explosive bulbs at zombies, dealing heavy damage. Waits until zombies appear on the lawn before shooting.
BOWLINGBULB_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}向僵尸发射三枚可以爆炸的充能泡泡，造成巨大伤害。可以等到僵尸出现在草坪上后再发射。

BOWLINGBULB_TOOLTIP.en: Rolls bouncing shots that can hit multiple zombies
BOWLINGBULB_TOOLTIP.zh: 滚出可反弹的泡泡，能击中多只僵尸

BRAMBLEBUSH_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Bramble Bush is a prickly sort. In fact, let's not beat around the Bramble Bush here; he's covered in extraordinarily dangerous spikes.
BRAMBLEBUSH_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}用法：{STAT}浆果丛模样的陷阱持续存在并对僵尸造成伤害

{FLAVOR}莓棘灌木丛浑身上下都是刺，非常危险——险象“丛”生。

BRAMBLEBUSH_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Bramble Bush traps and damages a zombie. The berry clusters show the number of traps remaining.
BRAMBLEBUSH_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 荆棘灌木丛诱捕并伤害一只僵尸。

BRAMBLEBUSH_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Regenerate all of his berry traps and trap the leftmost zombie in his column, dealing 2x damage for a short duration.
BRAMBLEBUSH_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}重生所有的莓果陷阱，并将所在排最左边的僵尸困住，在短时间内造成 2 倍伤害。

BTL_AF_12_DESC.en: That snake-oil salesman Kakaa is back to torment players!
BTL_AF_12_DESC.zh: 卖假药的咔咔又来祸害玩家了！

BTL_AF_13_DESC.en:
Shadows are haunting this level, good luck!
(P.S. The shadows here are weaker than usual, but they make up for it in numbers!)
BTL_AF_13_DESC.zh:
本关有影子出没，祝你好运！
（ps：这里的影子比平时更虚弱但也更多！）

BTL_AF_16_DESC.en: Keep an eye on the shadows on the ground and reach 634000325.799 points!
BTL_AF_16_DESC.zh: 留意地上的影子并达到 634000325.799 点分数！

BTL_AF_21_DESC.en: Exposing SHUTTLE! His creations aren't all that cracked up to be!
BTL_AF_21_DESC.zh: 打假 SHUTTLE，他做的东西根本没那么神！

BTL_AF_3_DESC.en: Plants have zero cooldown. And what, Gul'dan, must we give in return?
BTL_AF_3_DESC.zh: 植物无冷却，那么古尔丹，代价是什么呢？

BTL_MIRROR_MINIGAME.en: The original plant and its image share the same life and death.
BTL_MIRROR_MINIGAME.zh: 植物将与镜像同生共死。

BTL_TIMESPACEECHOES_0011_11_DESC.en: Switch to the second set of seed packets at Wave 6, with packet limits of "6" and "6" respectively
BTL_TIMESPACEECHOES_0011_11_DESC.zh: 第六波切换第二组选卡，卡片数量分别为“6”、“6”

BTL_TIMESPACEECHOES_0011_14_DESC.en: Switch to the second and third sets of seed packets at Waves 6 and 11, with packet limits of "6", "6", and "6" respectively
BTL_TIMESPACEECHOES_0011_14_DESC.zh: 第六、十一波切换第二、三组选卡，卡片数量分别为“6”、“6”、“6”

BTL_TIMESPACEECHOES_0011_3_DESC.en: Switch to the second set of seed packets at Wave 11, with packet limits of "6" and "6" respectively
BTL_TIMESPACEECHOES_0011_3_DESC.zh: 第十一波切换第二组选卡，卡片数量分别为“6”、“6”

BTL_TIMESPACEECHOES_0011_7_DESC.en: Switch to the second set of seed packets at Wave 8, with packet limits of "8" and "8" respectively
BTL_TIMESPACEECHOES_0011_7_DESC.zh: 第八波切换第二组选卡，卡片数量分别为“8”、“8”

BUBBLECORAL_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Range: {STAT}Whole lane
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}Click to switch between different forms.

{FLAVOR}"D-dummy! If you keep tapping, I can't attack anymore!" Bubble Coral said angrily. "Fine, I guess I have no choice—hmph!"
BUBBLECORAL_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}范围：{STAT}整行
{KEYWORD}特点：{STAT}点击切换不同形态

{FLAVOR}“笨...笨蛋，你一直点没法攻击了啦！”泡泡姬珊瑚生气的说，“真拿你没办法，哼！”

BUBBLECORAL_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Can launch bubbles with different functions to attack, dealing damage to zombies ahead.
BUBBLECORAL_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 可以发射不同功能的泡泡进行攻击，对前方僵尸造成伤害。

BUBBLECORAL_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Blows out a giant bubble that bursts and scatters into a ton of smaller bubbles.
BUBBLECORAL_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}吹出一个超大的泡泡，炸开后分散出超多泡泡

BUDUHBOOM_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Bud'uh Boom's buttery obsession always had him on a hair trigger, but when Zomboss served up "You-can't-believe-it's-not-butter!" – it was poppin' pandemonium on the lawn! Now, he's ready to butter up zombies and explode with boiling, buttery, BOOM!
BUDUHBOOM_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}爆浆玉露对黄油无比痴迷，光是轻轻提一嘴黄油的不好，就能让他顺间警觉。但在僵王推出了“鬼都不信这不是黄油！”牌人造黄油后——他终于忍不下去了，整个草坪都淹没在他含怒喷涌出的黄油之下。如今，他已整装待发，要把真正的黄油糊在僵尸脸上，用爆汁、爆浆的爆炸，向它们发起警示！

BUDUHBOOM_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: An over-pressurized bulb of boiling butter, this instant plant will go BOOM! Burning away zombies around it and flinging blobs of butter across the lawn, stunning any zombie unfortunate to be caught in its shower of buttery goop.
BUDUHBOOM_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 一颗加压过度的鳞茎，里面装满了沸腾的黄油。一种下去，就会瞬间爆浆！焚灭周围的僵尸，并向草坪各处扔出黄油，眩晕任何待在黄油雨中的倒霉僵尸。

BUDUHBOOM_DESCRIPTION_HINT.en: Bud’uh Boom makes short work of clumped up zombies. Level it up to increase the amount of butter traps he will fling around the board.
BUDUHBOOM_DESCRIPTION_HINT.zh: 爆浆玉露可以轻松处理聚在一起的尸群。

BUDUHBOOM_TOOLTIP.en: Deals massive damage in an area and leaves behind butter trap tiles.
BUDUHBOOM_TOOLTIP.zh: 在一定范围内造成大量伤害，随后留下黄油陷阱地砖。

BUNDLEPRODUCT_BUNDLE_LEVITATER_UPG_CONSU.zh: 200 包悬浮洋芋种子 + 50 颗钻石 + 5000 枚金币

BUNDLEPRODUCT_BUNDLE_MEGAGATLING_UPG_CON.zh: 200 包超级机枪种子 + 50 颗钻石 + 5000 枚金币

BUNDLE_PRIMALPOTATO_SYN.zh: 原始土豆地雷协作捆绑包

BUNDLE_ROMAN_55G.zh: 僵王斗兽场种子捆绑包

BURNADE_DESCRIPTION.en: All the zombies on-screen will die after a few seconds of planting it.
BURNADE_DESCRIPTION.zh: 见过他的僵尸都成了一堆灰烬。

BURNADE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 每次爆炸都会对场地上的僵尸造成 900000 点伤害。

BUTTERCUP_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Buttercup's sweet as can be, but she packs a wallop! "I'm not cheap," she says, referring to her flat sun cost. "I'm reasonable."
BUTTERCUP_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}产生飞溅的黄油

{FLAVOR}黄油毛茛虽然很便宜——只需要花费一点点阳光，但她其实非常厉害！“啥叫便宜啊？”她反驳说，“这明明是‘物美价廉’好吗！”

BUTTERCUP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Buttercup butters butter onto attacking zombies, stunning them with butter. Butter!
BUTTERCUP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 黄油毛茛可以往攻击她的僵尸脸上砸黄油，让它们被黄油眩晕。黄油，永远的神！

BUTTERCUP_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Throws butter immediately in front of her, dealing damage and stunning zombies for a long duration.
BUTTERCUP_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}立即向她前方投掷黄油，对僵尸造成伤害，产生长时间的眩晕效果。

BUZZBUTTON_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}Fire balls of electricity that can penetrate zombies and slow them.

{FLAVOR}Ever since Electric Pine won the power-generating competition with Thunder Snapdragon, Electric Pine was "invited" by other plants to generate electricity for various reasons. Over time, it became "crazy."
BUZZBUTTON_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}发射的电球可以穿透僵尸并让他们变得迟钝！

{FLAVOR}自从电海松在那次和雷龙草的发电比赛中大获全胜之后，电海松就被其他植物以各种理由“请”去发电，久而久之，就变成发“癫”了。

BUZZBUTTON_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: The power of electric pine is so strong that it can make zombies slow!
BUZZBUTTON_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 电海松的发电能力极强，可以让僵尸迟钝！

BUZZBUTTON_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Fires multiple large electric balls at the closest zombies.

BUZZBUTTON_TOOLTIP.en: Fires an electric ball that penetrates zombies and slows them!
BUZZBUTTON_TOOLTIP.zh: 发射的电球可以穿透僵尸并且使他们迟钝！

CABBAGEPULT_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Cabbage-pult received his doctorate in pulting from Harvest University. He knows a thing or two about launching his way to the top. He also makes a mean soup.
CABBAGEPULT_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}卷心菜投手从哈佛大学荣获投手博士学位。关于如何成为人生赢家，它总是滔滔不绝。他也常常吹嘘他做的汤，不过喝过的人都不愿意提及这个话题。

CABBAGEPULT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Cabbage-pults hurl cabbages at the enemy.
CABBAGEPULT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 卷心菜投手可以向敌人投掷卷心菜。

CABBAGEPULT_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Launches multiple cabbages at every zombie, dealing heavy damage.
CABBAGEPULT_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}向每只僵尸投掷多颗卷心菜，造成大量伤害。

CABBAGEPULT_PLANTFOOD.en: Hits every zombie on the lawn with a large cabbage.
CABBAGEPULT_PLANTFOOD.zh: 用大卷心菜攻击草坪上的每只僵尸。

CABBAGEPULT_TOOLTIP.en: Hurls cabbages over obstacles at the enemy
CABBAGEPULT_TOOLTIP.zh: 越过障碍物向僵尸投掷卷心菜

CACTUS1_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Things have really changed for Cactus lately. Book deals, movies, truck show appearances... she’s just trying to focus on staying humble and launching thorns like always.'
CACTUS1_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}隐藏自身，等僵尸靠近的时候会对他们造成地面伤害
{KEYWORD}植物特征：{STAT}绿色植物、十万伏特、高个子

{FLAVOR}最近对仙人掌来说，情况发生了巨大变化。图书交易，电影，卡车表演什么的…她只想保持谦虚，跟平时一样发射尖刺就行了。

CACTUS1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Cactus fires a penetrating thorn that can damage multiple enemies! Hides underground when zombies are close.
CACTUS1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 仙人掌可以发射穿透性尖刺，对多个敌人造成伤害！

CACTUS1_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Permanently increases piercing power and damage.
CACTUS1_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}永久提升穿刺能力和伤害。

CACTUS1_TOOLTIP.en: Fires a penetrating thorn, hides for ground damage
CACTUS1_TOOLTIP.zh: 发射穿透性尖刺，躲避地面伤害

CACTUS_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}As a member of the Lightning Family, Thunder Snapdragon is a known menace proclaiming to hail from Asgard, his spiteful catchphrases being "I am dragon of thunder." "They all say I'm Snapdragon by my looks. Please, that ain't me, I'm miles better!"
CACTUS_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}电击僵尸，偶尔造成眩晕效果

{FLAVOR}作为雷电家族的一员，雷龙草总是声称自己来自阿斯嘉特。不仅如此，就算是在家族里，他也是个十足的霸道总裁。他总是喃喃自语到：“我是雷之神龙！”
“所有人都说我长得像火龙草。不能说一模一样，只能说毫不相关好吧。明显我好看多了！”他不屑地说。

CACTUS_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Spit out an electric ball that releases electricity, causing long-range damage to approaching zombies.
CACTUS_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 吐出一个电球，释放电流，对接近的僵尸造成远程伤害。

CACTUS_PLANTFOOD.en: Fires a giant electric ball that temporarily stuns zombies
CACTUS_PLANTFOOD.zh: 发射一个巨大的电球，可以暂时击晕僵尸

CACTUS_TOOLTIP.en: Fires an electric ball that temporarily stuns zombies
CACTUS_TOOLTIP.zh: 发射一个电球，可以暂时击晕僵尸

CALENDAR_DISABLED.en: Daily rewards is currently unavailable. Please try again in a few minutes.
CALENDAR_DISABLED.zh: 日常奖励目前不可用。请过几分钟再来试试吧。

CALENDAR_NO_REWARDS.en: You have already claimed this reward. The next reward is at {DATETIME}.
CALENDAR_NO_REWARDS.zh: 你已经领取了今天的奖励，下一份奖励将在 {DATETIME}发放。

CALENDAR_REWARDS_ENABLED_CANNOT_COLLECT.en: Please collect the reward from the previous tab first.
CALENDAR_REWARDS_ENABLED_CANNOT_COLLECT.zh: 请先收集上一个标签页的奖励。

CALENDAR_STREAK_RETENTION_CALL_TO_ACTION.en: Yowsers, your calendar streak's at risk! Spend gems to keep it?
CALENDAR_STREAK_RETENTION_CALL_TO_ACTION.zh: 兄弟，你的连续签到快要中断了！要花点钻石来保留它吗？

CALENDAR_UNLOCK_DESCRIPTION.en:
- Earn rewards each day by opening Plants vs. Zombies 2!
- Earn extra rewards during Seasonal Events.
- This feature requires a network connection.
CALENDAR_UNLOCK_DESCRIPTION.zh:
- 每天登陆《植物大战僵尸 2》，赢取丰厚奖励！
- 在赛季活动期间获得额外奖励！
- 这项功能需要互联网连接。

CAMEL_MINIGAME_TUTORIAL_1.en: Tap on a zombie to flip its panel
CAMEL_MINIGAME_TUTORIAL_1.zh: 点击任意一只僵尸，翻转他手里的卡牌

CAMEL_MINIGAME_TUTORIAL_2.en: Great! Now tap on another one
CAMEL_MINIGAME_TUTORIAL_2.zh: 干得漂亮！现在试试点击另一个

CAMEL_MINIGAME_TUTORIAL_3.en: Awesome! Keep matching symbols to win the game
CAMEL_MINIGAME_TUTORIAL_3.zh: 好样的！继续配对这些符号，赢得游戏

CANNON_TUTORIAL_1.en: Tap on the coconut cannon to make it fire
CANNON_TUTORIAL_1.zh: 点击椰子加农炮让它开火

CANNON_TUTORIAL_2.en: Great! Now blow up as many zombies as you can
CANNON_TUTORIAL_2.zh: 棒极了！现在尽你所能击败僵尸吧！

CARROTMISSILE_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Range: {STAT}Straight

{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}3x3 splash, can attack both armor and zombie at the same time

{FLAVOR}Carrot Rocket was a robot fan during his teens. His room was full of robots, he nearly played all robot themed video games, and he even tried putting on a robot tattoo. When he became a scientist, he researched intensively on how to harness solar power as fuel for robots. There, he used the results on himself. So people call him Carrot Rocket, but he prefers to call himself Optimus Prime.
CARROTMISSILE_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}范围：{STAT}前方一行
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}3x3溅射、可同时攻击防具和本体

{FLAVOR}胡萝卜在少年时代是机器人动画的狂热爱好者，他的房间摆满了各种机器人模型，他玩过几乎每一款机器人题材的电子游戏，他甚至尝试过在自己身上纹上一些代表某些机器人的纹身。当他成为一名科学家后，他开始疯狂地研究如何将太阳能作为机器人的动力来源……后来他把自己的研究成果应用在了自己身上。于是有人叫他胡萝卜导弹，但是他更愿意称呼自己为柯博文。

CARROTMISSILE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Carrot Rocket can launch carrot missiles, causing damage and slowing down zombies in the front range.
CARROTMISSILE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 胡萝卜导弹可以发射胡萝卜飞弹，对前方范围内僵尸造成伤害并减速。

CARROTMISSILE_LEVEL_NAME.zh: 不上膛就导弹 - 第 {LEVEL_NUMBER} 步

CARROTMISSILE_TOOLTIP.en: Launch carrot missiles, causing damage and slowing down zombies in the front range.
CARROTMISSILE_TOOLTIP.zh: 发射胡萝卜飞弹，对前方范围内僵尸造成伤害并减速。

CATEGORY_13_NAME.zh: iOS 植物大战僵尸 2 金币商店

CATEGORY_15_NAME.zh: iOS 植物大战僵尸 2 地图商店

CAULIPOWER_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Caulipower's eyes spin with distress. He's just thought of a really great ending for his novel, but he's afraid his cousin won't understand it.
CAULIPOWER_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}可以悬在地上或水上

{FLAVOR}超能花菜的眼睛因为焦虑而旋转。他刚刚为自己的小说想到了一个很棒的结局，不过他害怕自己的表哥不能理解。

CAULIPOWER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Caulipowers use their mental powers to hypnotize random zombies and turn them against their former friends.
CAULIPOWER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 超能花菜可以使用精神攻击来魅惑僵尸，使其变成我们的友军。

CAULIPOWER_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Tosses 5 random zombies off the lawn.
CAULIPOWER_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}随机将 5 只僵尸甩出草坪。

CDN_DOWNLOAD_DESCRIPTION.en: We need to update game data. This may take a short while. The game will return to the Main Menu when the update is complete.
CDN_DOWNLOAD_DESCRIPTION.zh: 我们需要更新游戏数据，这可能会花一点时间。更新完成后，游戏将返回到主菜单。

CDN_DOWNLOAD_PROGRESS_DESCRIPTION.en: Downloading update data. The game will return to the Main Menu when the download is complete.
CDN_DOWNLOAD_PROGRESS_DESCRIPTION.zh: 正在下载更新数据。下载完成后，游戏将返回主菜单。

CDN_ERROR_DISABLED.en: The download has been disabled. Try again later.
CDN_ERROR_DISABLED.zh: 下载功能已禁用。请稍后再试。

CDN_ERROR_GENERIC.en: There is an error with the download. Try again later.

CDN_ERROR_IN_PROGRESS.en: There is already a download in progress.
CDN_ERROR_IN_PROGRESS.zh: 已经有一个下载进程了。

CDN_RETRY_DESCRIPTION.en: You can retry the download, or cancel and not proceed to the feature.
CDN_RETRY_DESCRIPTION.zh: 你可以重新尝试，也可以取消下载，放弃这项功能。

CELERYSTALKER_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Celery Stalker resents the implication that there’s anything unsavory about his attack style. He simply believes that discretion is the better part of vegetation.
CELERYSTALKER_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}潜伏芹菜对那些暗示他攻击方式不光彩的人感到不满。他只是觉得小心驶得万年船罢了。

CELERYSTALKER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Celery Stalkers wait until zombies pass, then pop up and bash them from behind.
CELERYSTALKER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 潜伏芹菜等僵尸经过他之后，突然跳起在僵尸背后偷袭。

CELERYSTALKER_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Heals itself to full and spawns three Celery Stalker.
CELERYSTALKER_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}治愈自己，并生成三株潜伏芹菜。

CELERYSTALKER_TOOLTIP.en: Pops up and bashes zombies from behind
CELERYSTALKER_TOOLTIP.zh: 钻出地面并从后方猛击僵尸

CELLULAR_PERMISSION_BODY.en: Do you want to use cellular data to download additional content? You can change this setting in the options menu later.
CELLULAR_PERMISSION_BODY.zh: 你想要使用蜂窝数据来下载额外内容吗？你可以随时在设置中改变这一设定。

CERYDRA_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Glory: {STAT}Increases attack speed.

{KEYWORD}Military Merit: {STAT}Increases damage dealt. When a plant with "Military Merit" uses its Plant Food, "Military Merit" is upgraded to "Peerage."
{KEYWORD}Peerage: {STAT}The plant with "Peerage" is considered to have "Military Merit" simultaneously, and plants with "Peerage" deal an additional damage. "Military Merit" can stack with "Glory," but "Peerage" cannot. The plant with "Peerage" triggers Coup de Main when using its Plant Food, instantly repeating the ability. After Coup de Main ends, "Peerage" reverts to "Military Merit."

{FLAVOR}The Northern Empire, a lost dynasty, where its frozen lands burn with the fever of conquest. Fluorescent Fungus, who wields the Coreflame of "Law," weaves her schemes, contends with the zombies.
CERYDRA_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}荣光：{STAT}攻击速度提高。

{KEYWORD}军功：{STAT}造成的伤害提高。持有【军功】的植物释放叶绿素大招时，【军功】升级为【爵位】。

{KEYWORD}爵位：{STAT}持有【爵位】的植物被视为同时持有【军功】。持有【爵位】的植物造成的伤害额外提高。【军功】可与【荣光】叠加，【爵位】不可与【荣光】叠加。持有【爵位】的植物释放叶绿素大招后，幽灯蕈会使其额外释放一次叶绿素大招，同时【爵位】变回【军功】。
{KEYWORD}连携 - 征服的剑旗：{STAT}首次触发技能的为任意范围内植物自动释放一次叶绿素后，每隔45秒会额外使范围内任意一个蔓溢草释放叶绿素，无次数限制。
{FLAVOR}北境帝国，失落的王朝，寒冷的疆土燃烧着征伐的野心。幽灯蕈执握【律法】的火种，布局设子，与尸相弈。

CERYDRA_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Fluorescent Fungi summon Light Tiles and Dark Tiles. Plants on Light Tiles gain "Glory", and plants on Dark Tiles gain "Military Merit," and after being planted for a while, they apply Plant Food to a nearby plant with "Military Merit."
CERYDRA_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 幽灯蕈可以召唤浅色棋盘和深色棋盘，使浅色棋盘上的植物获得【荣光】，深色棋盘上的植物获得【军功】，并在种下一段时间后为它周围持有【军功】的一株植物施用叶绿素。

CERYDRA_TOOLTIP.en: Summons Light Tiles and Dark Tiles to bonus plants
CERYDRA_TOOLTIP.zh: 召唤浅色棋盘和深色棋盘，为植物提供增益

CHALLENGE_DESTROY_HEALERSTAFFS.zh: 摧毁 {GRID_ITEMS} 根治疗师蛇杖

CHARDGUARD_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}You might remember Chard Guard from his days in the WWF (that's World Wrestling Foliage). When he was in the ring – boy-oh-boy – he was something to behold! His moves! His style! His attitude! The crowd loved him. He was quite the star for a while there. Sure, those days are behind him. But if you watch carefully, when Chard Guard is fighting zombies, you'll see him use the wrestling move he made famous. The ol' Knock 'Em Dead maneuver – it gets 'em every time.
CHARDGUARD_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}你还记得甜菜护卫在 WWF 的日子吧（指世界摔跤树叶联盟）。他还在拳击场上的时候，我的天，没有人不被他威猛的身姿所吸引！他的动作！他的风格！他的态度！观众爱他都爱疯了。他曾一度是那里的明星。当然，现在已经物是人非了。但如果你仔细观察的话，甜菜护卫在与僵尸战斗时，你都能看到他使用他最出名的摔跤动作。老一套的战略每次都能撂倒他们。

CHARDGUARD_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Chard Guards are defensive blockers that can hurl zombies backwards.
CHARDGUARD_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 甜菜护卫擅长防御僵尸，可以把僵尸扔回去。

CHARDGUARD_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Regenerates leaves and hurls zombies in front, dealing a small amount of damage.
CHARDGUARD_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}重生所有叶子，抛开前方的僵尸，造成少量伤害。

CHARDGUARD_PLANTFOOD.en: Returns to full health, then damages and pushes back zombies in 6 adjacent tiles.
CHARDGUARD_PLANTFOOD.zh: 恢复所有生命值，并对附近六块地砖上的僵尸造成伤害并击退他们。

CHARDGUARD_TOOLTIP.zh: 阻碍僵尸，并将僵尸向后扔

CHEAT_DETECTED_MESSAGE.zh:
抵制不良游戏，拒绝盗版游戏。
注意自我保护，谨防受骗上当。
适度游戏益脑，沉迷游戏伤身。
合理安排时间，享受健康生活。

CHERRY_BOMB_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}The Cherry Bomb Brothers attempted to start their own band. "We tried to figure out what the sound would be, but we kept explodonating speakers, stages, fans, and of course, zombies. Look for our LP next year."
CHERRY_BOMB_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}使用：{STAT}一次性使用，立即生效

{FLAVOR}樱桃炸弹兄弟曾试着组建他们的乐队。“我们明明已经在想节目内容了的，但是我们现在必须去找扩音器、舞台、粉丝以及僵尸。明年就去找人签合约吧。”

CHERRY_BOMB_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Cherry Bombs can blow up all zombies in an area. They have a short fuse so plant them near zombies.
CHERRY_BOMB_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 樱桃炸弹能炸死一个区域内的所有僵尸。他们在种下后立即生效，所以把他们放在靠近僵尸的地方吧。

CHERRY_BOMB_TOOLTIP.en: Blows up all zombies in a medium area
CHERRY_BOMB_TOOLTIP.zh: 炸掉中等区域内的所有僵尸

CHILIBEAN_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}He's not blushing, he's trying to hold it in.
CHILIBEAN_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}使用：{STAT}被吃掉时
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}在被僵尸吃掉后释放有毒气体

{FLAVOR}他并不是因为害羞才脸红，而是因为他在憋——你自己想象吧…

CHILIBEAN_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Chili Beans deliver a crippling bout of gastrointestinal distress when eaten by a zombie.
CHILIBEAN_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 巴豆能让僵尸的肠道翻云覆雨。

CHILIBEAN_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Launches out 3 Chili Bean clones to random locations on the lawn.
CHILIBEAN_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}向草坪的随机位置发射 3 株复制体巴豆。

CHILIBEAN_PLANTFOOD.en: Launches out 3 Chili Bean clones to random locations on the lawn.
CHILIBEAN_PLANTFOOD.zh: 向草坪上的随机位置投出三颗巴豆的复制体。

CHILIBEAN_TOOLTIP.en: Zombies that eat it are defeated and release gas
CHILIBEAN_TOOLTIP.zh: 吃掉它的僵尸会死去并释放肠气

CHILLYPEPPER_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}"Get up and freeze the day!! Chilly Pepper might look innocent and unassuming but deep down he’s cold as ice. Compare him to Jalapeño and watch him EXPLODE!"
CHILLYPEPPER_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}使用：{STAT}一次性使用，立即生效

{FLAVOR}“早晨起床第一件事，冻住一切！！ 寒冰辣椒看似人畜无害，内心深处却冷若冰霜。把他和火爆辣椒比一比，见识一下他的爆炸！”

CHILLYPEPPER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Chilly Pepper’s explosion deals heavy damage to zombies and radius damage to tiles in his lane freezing 3 lanes in the aftermath.
CHILLYPEPPER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 寒冰辣椒的爆炸可以对僵尸造成大量伤害，并对所在行地砖上的僵尸造成范围性伤害，随后冻结 3 条路上的僵尸。

CHILLYPEPPER_TOOLTIP.en: Chilly Pepper’s explosion is as destructive as he is frigid.
CHILLYPEPPER_TOOLTIP.zh: 寒冰辣椒的爆炸破坏性极强，冷酷无比。

CHINESECHOMPINGCABBAGE_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}Attacks zombies within range. Has a chance to stun zombies and reduce their bite damage. Rests after attacking a certain number of times.
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}Increases its own attack speed after resting. While in this self-granted attack speed boost state, it will not enter the resting state.
{FLAVOR}According to a certain herbology book:
This ferocious plant may look similar to an ordinary cabbage, but sports a set of terrifying teeth and uses its large leaves to move around. When released, this plant will chase and chomp whatever it can get its jaws on.
CHINESECHOMPINGCABBAGE_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}攻击范围内僵尸，有概率眩晕僵尸并降低啃咬伤害，攻击一定次数后会休息。
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}休息后可以提高自身攻击速度，处于自身给予的攻速提高状态时，不会进入休息状态。
{FLAVOR}据某本草药学书记载：
这种凶猛的植物看起来可能与普通的甘蓝无异，但它却长着一排可怕的牙齿，并利用其宽大的叶子来移动。当被释放时，它会追逐并用它的下颚咬碎任何能咬到的东西。

CHINESECHOMPINGCABBAGE_DESCRIPTION_HEADE.en: Chinese Chomping Cabbages attack zombies within range and rest after a certain number of attacks.
CHINESECHOMPINGCABBAGE_DESCRIPTION_HEADE.zh: 攻击范围内的僵尸一定次数后进入休息。

CHINESECHOMPINGCABBAGE_DESCRIPTION_PLANT.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Spawns multiple copies of itself and immediately enters the attack speed boost state.
CHINESECHOMPINGCABBAGE_DESCRIPTION_PLANT.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}在草坪上生成一定数量的中国咬人甘蓝，并使自身直接进入攻击速度提升状态。

CHINESECHOMPINGCABBAGE_TOOLTIP.en: Attacks to reduce zombie damage and rests
CHINESECHOMPINGCABBAGE_TOOLTIP.zh: 攻击范围内的僵尸一定次数后进入休息

CHINESEGARDEN_LEVEL_NAME.zh: 中国园林 - 第 {LEVEL_NUMBER} 天

CHINESEGARDEN_NIGHT_LEVEL_NAME.zh: 中国园林 - 第 {LEVEL_NUMBER} 夜

CHOMPER_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Everyone appreciates what Chomper does. His appetite has saved them on numerous occasions. But truth be told, Chomper's friends think that eating zombies is gross. And his breath! No one has the heart to tell him, and he never gets the hint when you offer him a mint.
CHOMPER_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}攻击后需要一段时间恢复

{FLAVOR}每位植物都很感激大嘴花所做的事。他的大胃口曾拯救无数植物。但说实话，他的朋友其实觉得他吃僵尸的行为超级恶心，他嘴里呼出来的气就更别提了！大家都不好意思给他说这件事，就想着给他薄荷糖来暗示一下他。但他显然从来都没有 get 到他们的意思。

CHOMPER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Chompers can devour a zombie whole, but they are vulnerable while chewing.
CHOMPER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 大嘴花可以吞掉整只僵尸，但在咀嚼的时候会很脆弱。

CHOMPER_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Consumes several nearby zombies in the column, then releases a burp that knocks back any surviors.
CHOMPER_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}就近吃掉所在排的若干只僵尸，随后通过打嗝来把剩余的僵尸击退。

CHOMPER_TOOLTIP.en: Devours a zombie, then chews on it for a while
CHOMPER_TOOLTIP.zh: 吞下整只僵尸，然后咀嚼一段时间

CHRYSANTHEAUTUMN_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Chrysanthe Autumn was once swept up in a portal of time and space, spending an eternity adrift and even being reshaped by spacetime itself—granting it the power to influence other visitors from different universes. According to detector readings, Chrysanthe Autumn traversed here from the universe known as PvZ: Ultimate. "Time is growing ever more chaotic; we must remain ever ready for the challenges ahead."
CHRYSANTHEAUTUMN_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}清蕊秋菊曾被卷入到时空裂缝之中，在时空中待了很久，甚至被时空本身影响，让它获得了能够影响其他异时空访客的能力。根据探测器显示，清蕊秋菊是从名为《植物大战僵尸：精华版》的时空穿越到了这里。“时空正在变得更加混乱，我们需要随时准备好应对接下来的挑战。”

CHRYSANTHEAUTUMN_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Chrysanthe Autumns provide a temporary boost to all plants from other universes on the lawn.
CHRYSANTHEAUTUMN_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 清蕊秋菊可以暂时加强草坪上所有的异时空植物。

CITRON1_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}As the owner and primary user of "Vitamin C-U-Later" 20-hour energy shots, Citron is always on and always ready for action. "Let's make this happen!!"
CITRON1_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}作为“维 C 永别”号能量射击大炮的主人以及主要用户，充能柚子时刻准备着行动。“准备好开炮吧！！”

CITRON1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Citrons shoot powerful balls of plasma.
CITRON1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 充能柚子能发射出威力巨大的等离子球。

CITRON1_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Shoots a giant plasma ball that can destroy most mech type zombies and flings zombies to adjacent columns.
CITRON1_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}发射一个巨大的等离子球，击飞前方大部分僵尸，对机械类僵尸造成超高伤害。

CITRON1_TOOLTIP.zh: 发射威力巨大的等离子球

CITRON_DESCRIPTION.en: Drawing inspiration from a certain cartoon, Pineapple modified his leaves into helicopter blades in hopes of taking flight. As it turned out, this peculiar idea was practical. The catch is he'll have offset torque by rotating himself once in a while.
CITRON_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}旋转时可以反弹子弹

{FLAVOR}为了满足飞上天空的梦想，菠萝从小时候看过的动画片中寻得了灵感：他把头上的叶子改造成了竹蜻蜓并希望自己能在天空中自由的翱翔。如我们所见的一样，这个异想天开的点子居然成功了！不过副作用也很明显：他不得不每隔一段时间跟着旋转一下以抵消一部分叶子旋转带来的压力。

CITRON_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 旋转菠萝可以阻挡僵尸前进，并反弹远程子弹。

CITRON_TOOLTIP.zh: 阻挡僵尸前进并反弹远程子弹

CLAIM_FREE_GIFT_TITLE.en: Collect your Daily Gift from the Store!
CLAIM_FREE_GIFT_TITLE.zh: 在商店里收集你的每日礼物！

CLAIM_X_JOUST_FREE_PLAYS_DESC.en: Use your Arena Free Plays and get gems!
CLAIM_X_JOUST_FREE_PLAYS_DESC.zh: 使用你的 {COUNT} 张竞技场免费游玩券，赢得钻石吧！

CLAIM_X_JOUST_FREE_PLAYS_REMAINING.zh: 还剩 {ACTIONS_LEFT} 张竞技场免费游玩券！

CLAIM_X_JOUST_FREE_PLAYS_TITLE.zh: 获取竞技场免费游玩券！

COCONUTCANNON_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Sure, he's a hairy old man, but Coconut Cannon can still fire on all cylinders. The reason he's so hairy: he's in-between waxings.
COCONUTCANNON_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}使用：{STAT}轻点即可开火
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}炮弹撞到僵尸时会在中等范围内爆炸

{FLAVOR}椰子加农炮虽不再年轻，却有着一头锃亮的秀发，而且他仍能在前线威震四方。至于秀发闪亮的原因，我们猜测大概是上了蜡。

COCONUTCANNON_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Coconut Cannons fire down a single lane, causing a medium explosion on impact.
COCONUTCANNON_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 椰子加农炮可以向所在行开火，炮弹撞向僵尸后对僵尸造成中等的伤害。

COCONUTCANNON_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Fires a huge cannonball that pushes the zombies it hits to the right side of the lawn and then explodes.
COCONUTCANNON_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}发射一枚大炮弹，先把僵尸推向草坪右边，随后爆炸。

COCONUTCANNON_PLANTFOOD.en: Fires a huge cannonball that pushes the zombies it hits to the right side of the lawn and then explodes.
COCONUTCANNON_PLANTFOOD.zh: 发射一枚巨大的炮弹，把僵尸推到草坪右边，随后爆炸。

COCONUTCANNON_TOOLTIP.en: Tap on the cannon to fire an explosive coconut
COCONUTCANNON_TOOLTIP.zh: 轻点大炮，即可发射会爆炸的椰子

COINSPRODUCT_BUNDLE_LEVITATER_SUPG_CONSU.zh: 400 包悬浮洋芋种子 + 100 颗钻石 + 1,0000 枚金币

COINSPRODUCT_BUNDLE_MEGAGATLING_SUPG_CON.zh: 400 包超级机枪种子 + 100 颗钻石 + 1,0000 枚金币

COINSPRODUCT_SG_LEVITATER_CONSUME_G.zh: 10 包悬浮洋芋种子 + 10 包限制薄荷家族种子

COINSPRODUCT_SG_MEGAGATLING_CONSUME_G.zh: 10 包超级机枪种子 + 10 包限制薄荷家族种子

COIN_STORE_TEXT.en: You need more coins.  Choose a package below.
COIN_STORE_TEXT.zh: 你需要更多金币。在下方选择一个金币包吧！

COLDSNAPDRAGON_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Cold Snapdragon gets chilly when anyone brings up his cousin Snapdragon. "We just view temperature very differently, and I'd really rather not discuss it," he says. Yikes.
COLDSNAPDRAGON_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}范围：{STAT}攻击他前面 6 块地砖内的所有僵尸

{FLAVOR}当有人提起冰龙草的堂兄弟火龙草时，他会很生气。“我们对温度的看法非常不同，我可不想讨论这个，”他是这么说的。

COLDSNAPDRAGON_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Cold Snapdragons breathe icy mist into 6 adjacent tiles that both slows and damage zombies.
COLDSNAPDRAGON_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 冰龙草可以向六块地砖内的僵尸喷出冰雾。

COLDSNAPDRAGON_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Fires an ice blast in front, dealing heavy damage and either freezing or chilling zombies.
COLDSNAPDRAGON_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}向前发射一股冰爆冲击，对僵尸造成大量伤害，并造成冻结或冷缓效果。

COLDSNAPDRAGON_TOOLTIP.en: Breathes icy mist in an area in front of it
COLDSNAPDRAGON_TOOLTIP.zh: 向前方一片区域内喷出冰雾

COMING_SOON_DESCRIPTION_ADV-PIRATE.en: How do zombies survive on the sea? They're back on land and trying to eat your brains. You need to help save the lawn! Think of Dave!
COMING_SOON_DESCRIPTION_ADV-PIRATE.zh: 僵尸在海上都能活下来？现在，它们重返陆地，又在对你的脑子虎视眈眈。来吧，拯救你的草坪！为了戴夫！

COMING_SOON_DESCRIPTION_ADV_MGP.en: Prepare to answer the call of Adventure. Mega Gatling Pea's Adventure will be here soon.
COMING_SOON_DESCRIPTION_ADV_MGP.zh: 准备回应冒险的呼唤。超级机枪豌豆大冒险即将启程。

COMING_SOON_DESCRIPTION_BEACH.en: Surf's up...and so are the zombie! The Big Beach Brawl is about to roll in with the tide!
COMING_SOON_DESCRIPTION_BEACH.zh: 冲浪开始了...僵尸也是！大海滩风暴即将随着潮水滚滚而来！

COMING_SOON_DESCRIPTION_BIRTHDAY.en: Happy birthday, Plants vs. Zombies! Celebrate our birthday with a new Thymed Event (so many levelz), exclusive store offers and of course, caketank!
COMING_SOON_DESCRIPTION_BIRTHDAY.zh: 《植物大战僵尸》13 周岁快乐！快来参与本次的限时活动，与我们一起欢庆生日吧（超多关卡）！不仅如此，商店里还有许多限定商品。当然，也少不了蛋糕坦克！

COMING_SOON_DESCRIPTION_BIRTHDAYZ.en: Celebrate PvZ 2's birthday with an exciting all new Limited Thyme Event!
COMING_SOON_DESCRIPTION_BIRTHDAYZ.zh: 游玩 31 个限时活动关卡，一起庆祝《植物大战僵尸》的 13 岁生日！

COMING_SOON_DESCRIPTION_CARNIVAL.en: New zombies are coming your way - literally - defend and protect your lawn! The carnival is only available for a limited amount of time - so fight them before they move to a new backyard!
COMING_SOON_DESCRIPTION_CARNIVAL.zh: 全新僵尸即将来袭，赶紧建立防线，保卫草坪吧！游乐园活动时间有限，在它们进攻别的院子前击败它们吧！

COMING_SOON_DESCRIPTION_CERYDRA.en: Get ready! This is a journey set starward!
COMING_SOON_DESCRIPTION_CERYDRA.zh: 做好准备！征途只在，星辰大海！

COMING_SOON_DESCRIPTION_FEASTIVUS.en: Deck the lawns with bites of holly – Feastivus is shambling in soon!
COMING_SOON_DESCRIPTION_FEASTIVUS.zh: 咬碎冬青装扮草坪——仲冬圣诞蹒跚来临！

COMING_SOON_DESCRIPTION_FOODFIGHT.en: Set the table and polish your silverware. It's Food Fight, where everything is on the menu, including your brainz!!!
COMING_SOON_DESCRIPTION_FOODFIGHT.zh: 摆好餐桌，擦亮餐具。食物大战——菜单应有尽有，脑子鲜美可口!!!

COMING_SOON_DESCRIPTION_GENERAL.en: Get ready! Defeat all the zombies that want your brain hard with plants!
COMING_SOON_DESCRIPTION_GENERAL.zh: 做好准备！用植物狠狠地打败所有想要你的大脑的僵尸！

COMING_SOON_DESCRIPTION_HARVEST.en: It's a harvest like no other - Join the Harvest Festival and reap the laughs!
COMING_SOON_DESCRIPTION_HARVEST.zh: 独一无二、与众不同——一起加入丰收节，收获无穷的乐趣与欢笑！

COMING_SOON_DESCRIPTION_HARVESTFESTIVAL.en: It's a harvest like no other - Join the Harvest Festival and reap the laughs!
COMING_SOON_DESCRIPTION_HARVESTFESTIVAL.zh: 独一无二、与众不同——一起加入丰收节，收获无穷的乐趣与欢笑！

COMING_SOON_DESCRIPTION_LAWNBOWL.en: Plants and zombies come together, once a year, to fight for the Golden Taco Trophy! Can you win it!?
COMING_SOON_DESCRIPTION_LAWNBOWL.zh: 植物、僵尸，为了闪闪发光的“金玉米卷杯”，共同角逐一年一度的草坪碗！你能把它收入囊中吗！？

COMING_SOON_DESCRIPTION_LAWNOFDOOM.en: Prepare for pumpkin-smashing, zombie-bashing fun on the Lawn of Doom!
COMING_SOON_DESCRIPTION_LAWNOFDOOM.zh: 做好准备！砸砸南瓜、打打僵尸，一同畅游末日草坪！

COMING_SOON_DESCRIPTION_LUCKOTHEZOMBIE.en: Why do zombies get all the luck?! Take them down and defend your lawn in the new Luck o' the Zombie Thymed Event! Dave's waiting for you - you're his lucky charm!
COMING_SOON_DESCRIPTION_LUCKOTHEZOMBIE.zh: 僵尸也配当幸运星？在全新的僵尸幸运星限时活动中击败它们，保卫你的草坪！来吧，向戴夫证明你才是他的幸运星！

COMING_SOON_DESCRIPTION_LUNARNEWYEAR.en: Start the New Zoo Year with a Bang! Defend your lawn and check out the Zodiac plants.
COMING_SOON_DESCRIPTION_LUNARNEWYEAR.zh: 新的一年，有虎草与你相伴——来试试妙趣横生、充满挑战的全新关卡！

COMING_SOON_DESCRIPTION_LUNARZOOYEAR.en: Start the New Zoo Year with a Bang! Defend your lawn and check out the Zodiac plants.
COMING_SOON_DESCRIPTION_LUNARZOOYEAR.zh: 点燃鞭炮，新年来到！守护草坪，结识植物生肖。

COMING_SOON_DESCRIPTION_MISSILE.en: Get ready! The missile onslaught is unstoppable. Prepare to protect your plants!
COMING_SOON_DESCRIPTION_MISSILE.zh: 做好准备！导弹攻势，势不可挡，准备保护好你的植物！

COMING_SOON_DESCRIPTION_OTHERWORLDLETTER.en: Get ready! Follow the clues in the letters to find the otherworldly "artifacts" before the time warp!
COMING_SOON_DESCRIPTION_OTHERWORLDLETTER.zh: 做好准备！根据信件上的线索找到异界之物，在时间错位之前！

COMING_SOON_DESCRIPTION_POTW.en: Even Plants need training. Prepare for the next Dr. Zomboss scheme by checking out the Plant of the Week!
COMING_SOON_DESCRIPTION_POTW.zh: 植物也需要训练。看看周度植物星，为僵王博士的下一个计划做好准备！

COMING_SOON_DESCRIPTION_ROMANWORLD.en: Let the “Experiments” begin!!! Battle through waves of zombies to earn the right to face Dr. Zomboss’s latest creations.
COMING_SOON_DESCRIPTION_ROMANWORLD.zh: “实验”，开始吧！！！ 与一波接着一波的尸潮战斗，赢取直面僵王博士最新造物的机会。

COMING_SOON_DESCRIPTION_SPRINGENING.en: Only you can defeat these bunny-eared zombies! A new Thymed Event is coming your way - just in time for spring!
COMING_SOON_DESCRIPTION_SPRINGENING.zh: 只有你才能打败那些戴着兔耳的僵尸！一个全新的限时活动即将随着春天的步伐到来。

COMING_SOON_DESCRIPTION_SUMMERNIGHTS.en: A sunny Thymed Event is coming your way! Prepare your swimsuit, flip-flops and zombie fighting plant team!
COMING_SOON_DESCRIPTION_SUMMERNIGHTS.zh: 一场阳光明媚的限时活动即将来袭！准备好你的泳衣、人字拖，组建起植物队伍与僵尸作战！

COMING_SOON_DESCRIPTION_TIMESPACEECHOES.en: Time-travelers will hear the call of time in the temporal tunnel, with defeated zombies from the past reappearing.
COMING_SOON_DESCRIPTION_TIMESPACEECHOES.zh: 时空旅行者在时间隧道听到已经走过的时间呼唤，过去打败的僵尸再次浮现，他们不仅不是真实的，还是时空对你下达的挑战。

COMING_SOON_DESCRIPTION_TOMBASTIC.en: Descend into the tomb to explore hidden rooms, secret room and find treasures that time forgot. What exciting adventures await our Heroes? Find out in the Tombastic Adventures Event!
COMING_SOON_DESCRIPTION_TOMBASTIC.zh: 潜入陵墓，探寻隐密暗室、阴暗密室，发掘其中被时光忘却的宝藏。英雄们会面临怎样惊心动魄的冒险？来探陵奇遇活动中一探究竟！

COMING_SOON_DESCRIPTION_TOMBTANGLER.en: A new plant is coming to your lawn - let's meet Tomb Tangler and see what he's all about! Can you beat this Limited Thyme Event with his help?
COMING_SOON_DESCRIPTION_TOMBTANGLER.zh: 一株新植物即将踏上你的草坪 - 来认识认识坟墓缠绕者吧，看看他的身手如何！在他的帮助下，你有能力完成这个逆时草限时任务吗？

COMING_SOON_DESCRIPTION_TRIGGER.en: Learn more about your new seedlings in the New Plant nursery and help it grow into a powerful ally.
COMING_SOON_DESCRIPTION_TRIGGER.zh: 在新芽苗圃里了解你的新幼苗，助其生长为强力队友。

COMING_SOON_DESCRIPTION_UNSODDED.en: Be prepared! Deserted land, sandy winds, silence, only the remnants of the sun reflecting the old dream!
COMING_SOON_DESCRIPTION_UNSODDED.zh: 做好准备！荒芜之地，风沙漫卷，寂寥无声，唯有残阳映照旧梦！

COMING_SOON_DESCRIPTION_VALENBRAINZ.en: Love is in the air! Defend your lawn and check out the Valentines' plants.
COMING_SOON_DESCRIPTION_VALENBRAINZ.zh: 空气里充满了爱的味道！守护草坪，结识春意“情种”。

COMING_SOON_DESCRIPTION_ZCORP.en: ZCorp Takeover - because even zombies need to diversify their portfolios.
COMING_SOON_DESCRIPTION_ZCORP.zh: Z 公司大收购 - 因为就连僵尸都知道要让自己的投资多元化。

COMING_SOON_TAGLINE_ADV-PIRATE.en: Is that a ship on the horizon? Arrghh it's pirates!
COMING_SOON_TAGLINE_ADV-PIRATE.zh: 地平线那边是艘船吗？恶，是海盗！

COMING_SOON_TAGLINE_ADV_MGP.en: Live the adventure's life with Mega Gatling Pea's Adventures.
COMING_SOON_TAGLINE_ADV_MGP.zh: 加入超级机枪豌豆大冒险，生活不惧艰险。

COMING_SOON_TAGLINE_BEACH.en: Looks like trouble is afloat, Zombies are rolling in with the tide!
COMING_SOON_TAGLINE_BEACH.zh: 看起来麻烦正在来临，僵尸们正随着潮水滚滚而来！

COMING_SOON_TAGLINE_BIRTHDAYZ.en: Happy Birthday to us! Join the revelry!

COMING_SOON_TAGLINE_CARNIVAL.en: Come one, come all, to the Backyard Big Top Carnival Event!
COMING_SOON_TAGLINE_CARNIVAL.zh: 后院游乐园活动现已开启！来者不拒！

COMING_SOON_TAGLINE_CERYDRA.en: A flame is soon to ignite!

COMING_SOON_TAGLINE_FEASTIVUS.en: Zombie tidings we bring to you – Feastivus chaos will ensue!
COMING_SOON_TAGLINE_FEASTIVUS.zh: 僵尸成群，把祝福带给您——仲冬圣诞，充满混乱和惊喜！

COMING_SOON_TAGLINE_FOODFIGHT.en: Coming to a lawn near you, it's Food Fight. Only one may stand.
COMING_SOON_TAGLINE_FOODFIGHT.zh: 食物大战，即将扩张到你的草坪。龙争虎斗，你死我活。

COMING_SOON_TAGLINE_GENERAL.en: Zombies are about to arrive on your lawn!
COMING_SOON_TAGLINE_GENERAL.zh: 僵尸即将到达你的草坪！

COMING_SOON_TAGLINE_HARVEST.en: Its a Gourd-geous Harvest! Coming Soon.
COMING_SOON_TAGLINE_HARVEST.zh: 五谷丰登大丰收！敬请期待。

COMING_SOON_TAGLINE_HARVESTFESTIVAL.en: It's a Gourd-geous Harvest! Coming Soon.
COMING_SOON_TAGLINE_HARVESTFESTIVAL.zh: 五谷丰登大丰收！敬请期待。

COMING_SOON_TAGLINE_LAWNBOWL.zh: 球植若渴！欢迎来到草坪碗！

COMING_SOON_TAGLINE_LUCKOTHEZOMBIE.en: Is that a four leaf clover?! The Luck o' the Zombie is almost here!
COMING_SOON_TAGLINE_LUCKOTHEZOMBIE.zh: 那是四叶草吗？！僵尸幸运星活动即将来袭！

COMING_SOON_TAGLINE_LUNARNEWYEAR.en: Lunar Zoo Year is coming soon! Check back in to see what awaits you!
COMING_SOON_TAGLINE_LUNARNEWYEAR.zh: 牲年快乐活动即将到来！待会儿再来看看有什么好东西在等着你吧！

COMING_SOON_TAGLINE_LUNARZOOYEAR.en: Lunar Zoo Year will be here soon! Check back later!
COMING_SOON_TAGLINE_LUNARZOOYEAR.zh: 笼笠新年活动即将到来！过段时间再来看看吧！

COMING_SOON_TAGLINE_MISSILE.en: The missiles on Z-Mechs' hand can't wait any longer!
COMING_SOON_TAGLINE_MISSILE.zh: Z机甲手上的导弹已经迫不及待了！

COMING_SOON_TAGLINE_OTHERWORLDLETTERS.en: Mysterious letters from otherworld have reached you!
COMING_SOON_TAGLINE_OTHERWORLDLETTERS.zh: 你收到了几封来自异界的信件！

COMING_SOON_TAGLINE_POTW.en: No time to waste, get ready for this Plant of the Week!
COMING_SOON_TAGLINE_POTW.zh: 为这次的周度植物星做好准备，刻不容缓！

COMING_SOON_TAGLINE_ROMANWORLD.en: Battle Dr. Zomboss’s latest creations in The Zombosseum!
COMING_SOON_TAGLINE_ROMANWORLD.zh: 与僵王博士的最新造物相战僵王斗兽场！

COMING_SOON_TAGLINE_SPRINGENING.en: Are those zombies dressed as bunnies? Precisely!
COMING_SOON_TAGLINE_SPRINGENING.zh: 僵尸穿着兔子装？你没看错！

COMING_SOON_TAGLINE_SUMMERNIGHTS.en: Summer break activated! Let's relax and fight some zombies!
COMING_SOON_TAGLINE_SUMMERNIGHTS.zh: 暑假到了！放松下来，与僵尸酣战到底吧！

COMING_SOON_TAGLINE_TIMESPACEECHOES.en: The echoes from the time and space are calling out to you!
COMING_SOON_TAGLINE_TIMESPACEECHOES.zh: 来自时空的回响正在呼唤着你！

COMING_SOON_TAGLINE_TOMBASTIC.en: Get Ready to dive into the Tomb!!!

COMING_SOON_TAGLINE_TOMBTANGLER.zh: 现在是坟墓缠绕者的主场！

COMING_SOON_TAGLINE_TRIGGER.en: Help your seedlings grow in the New Plant Nursery.
COMING_SOON_TAGLINE_TRIGGER.zh: 在新芽苗圃协助你的幼苗成长。

COMING_SOON_TAGLINE_UNSODDED.en: About to arrive at the unsodded place!

COMING_SOON_TAGLINE_VALENBRAINZ.en: Valenbrainz is almost here! Check back later!
COMING_SOON_TAGLINE_VALENBRAINZ.zh: 情尸节活动即将到来！过段时间再来看看吧！

COMING_SOON_TAGLINE_ZCORP.en: Resumes ready? - ZCorp Takeover is looking for fresh Brainz!
COMING_SOON_TAGLINE_ZCORP.zh: 简历准备好了吗？- Z 公司大收购正在招贤纳尸！

COMMUNITY_QUEST_DESC_FEASTIVUS_1.en: Treasure Yetis are overrunning Feastivus! Defeat them to win 100 Cold plant seed packets and contribute to the Community Challenge!
COMMUNITY_QUEST_DESC_FEASTIVUS_1.zh: 仲冬圣诞节日庆典怎么来了这么多宝藏雪人？击败他们，赢取 100 包冰系植物种子，并为社区挑战献力！

COMMUNITY_QUEST_GRAPESHOT_DESC_60.en: Play with Grapeshot to win 60 Grapeshot seed packets and contribute to the Community Challenge!
COMMUNITY_QUEST_GRAPESHOT_DESC_60.zh: 试玩爆裂葡萄，赢取 60 包爆裂葡萄种子，并为社区挑战献力！

COMMUNITY_QUEST_GRAPESHOT_TITLE.zh: 社区挑战史诗任务：爆裂葡萄！

COMMUNITY_QUEST_INZANITY_DESC.en: Play a fresh crop of inzane, organically-grown levels and contribute to the Community Challenge!
COMMUNITY_QUEST_INZANITY_DESC.zh: 游玩一组全新的、疯狂的、有机培植的关卡，并为社区挑战献力！

COMMUNITY_QUEST_INZANITY_TITLE.zh: 社区挑战史诗任务 - 精神错乱！

COMMUNITY_QUEST_TOADSTOOL_DESC_60.en: Play with Toadstool to win 60 Toadstool seed packets and contribute to the Community Challenge!
COMMUNITY_QUEST_TOADSTOOL_DESC_60.zh: 试玩蟾蜍毒菌，赢取 60 包蟾蜍毒菌种子，并为社区挑战献力！

COMMUNITY_QUEST_TOADSTOOL_TITLE.zh: 社区挑战史诗任务：蟾蜍毒菌！

CONCEALMINT_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}The swordsman Lily acquired the skill after accepting the inheritance of Dark Night Rose, which can blow a whole row of zombies away.
CONCEALMINT_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}范围：{STAT}整行

{FLAVOR}剑客莉莉接受暗夜玫瑰传承后获得的技能，可以将一整行僵尸吹飞。

CONCEALMINT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Rose Storm can blow away an entire lane of zombies.
CONCEALMINT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 玫瑰风暴可以将一整行僵尸吹飞。

CONCEALMINT_TOOLTIP.en: Blows away an entire lane of zombies

CONTAINMINT_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}After receiving the inheritance of the Crown of Hearts. Elegant and calm, she sends a shockwave to zombies, making them stunned and stunned for 10 seconds.
CONTAINMINT_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}范围：{STAT}全屏

{FLAVOR}公主玛丽接受红桃皇冠传承后获得的技能，优雅从容的她向僵尸们释放视觉和精神冲击，使僵尸们目瞪口呆，眩晕10秒。

CONTAINMINT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Send a shockwave to on-screen zombies, stunning them for 10 seconds.
CONTAINMINT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 向全屏僵尸释放视觉和精神冲击，使它们目瞪口呆，眩晕10秒。

CONTINUE_GAME_OR_RESTART.en: Do you want to continue your current game or restart the level?
CONTINUE_GAME_OR_RESTART.zh: 你是想继续当前的游戏还是重新开始关卡？

CONVERSION_KEY_DESCRIPTION.en:
Your progress and rewards have been preserved. Your unused keys have been turned into coins!

{COINT_AMT} Coins!
CONVERSION_KEY_DESCRIPTION.zh:
你的进度和奖励都顺利地保留下来了。而你没有使用过的钥匙都已经转换成了金币！

{COINT_AMT} 枚金币！

CONVERSION_REWARDS_DESCRIPTION.en:
Updating your progress has given you new rewards!

Details are available in the Almanac.
CONVERSION_REWARDS_DESCRIPTION.zh:
你因为更新了进度而获得了一些奖励！

去图鉴里看看吧！

CONVERSION_SPLASH_DESCRIPTION.en:
• Travel to new worlds faster.
• NEW Turbo speed feature.
• Gargantuar battles in every world.
CONVERSION_SPLASH_DESCRIPTION.zh:
• 更快地遨游不同世界
• 全新加速功能
• 每个世界都有全新巨人僵尸之战

CONVERSION_STARS_DESCRIPTION.en:
Your progress and rewards have been preserved. Plant costumes have been awarded to you for the extra Stars you've earned.

{COSTUME_AMT} New Costumes!
CONVERSION_STARS_DESCRIPTION.zh:
你的游戏进度和得到的奖励都已经顺利保留了！而你多出来的星星都已经被转换成了植物装扮！

你得到了 {COSTUME_AMT} 款全新装扮！

CONVERSION_WORLDKEY_DESCRIPTION.en: You've been awarded a World Key for your progress in the game. Use it to unlock the world of your choice!
CONVERSION_WORLDKEY_DESCRIPTION.zh: 已将你在游戏里的进度转换成了世界钥匙。你可以用它们来随心解锁各个世界！

COPA_PICTURE_WARNING.en: Your photo will only be saved to this device.
COPA_PICTURE_WARNING.zh: 你的照片只会储存在这部设备上。

CORNFETTI_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Everyday is a party with Corn-fetti Popper, and every zombie crash is just another reason to celebrate! Corn-fetti Popper learned early that life is short not to be explosive. Its favorite pastime? Sending zombies flying with colourful confetti blasts and proving that even the apocalypse could use a bit of fun.
CORNFETTI_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}有了爆礼花，每天都是一场派对；每只僵尸的倒下，都是一个狂欢的理由。爆礼花很早就明白了人生苦短，何不活得轰轰烈烈。它最爱的消遣是什么？那一定是把僵尸随着五彩礼花炸上天空，向人们证明——即便是末世，也总有办法为生活添一抹乐趣。

CORNFETTI_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Corn-fetti Popper fires zombie piercing cobs that can push back zombies close enough to it.
CORNFETTI_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 爆礼花可以发射能穿透僵尸的玉米棒，击退靠得足够近的僵尸。

CORNFETTI_DESCRIPTION_HINT.en: Corn-fetti Popper’s attacks can go through zombies, so choose your placement wisely.
CORNFETTI_DESCRIPTION_HINT.zh: 爆礼花的攻击可以穿过僵尸，所以要合理选择你的布阵。

CORNFETTI_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Corn-fetti Popper releases a huge blast of corn in 3 lanes damaging and pushing back all zombies that get hit.
CORNFETTI_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}爆礼花向 3 行爆发出大量玉米，对命中的僵尸造成伤害和击退效果。

CORNFETTI_TOOLTIP.en: Pushes back zombies if they get too close.

CORNUCOPIA_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Obviously, Corn-U-Copia went astray in the course of "Cannon Design and Cultivation for Corn Launchers." Launch it? Well, it's a launch. Can the projectiles attack zombies? Indeed, they can, and even do more. Can it be placed on the lawn? That explosive enthusiast seems eager to recruit it.
CORNUCOPIA_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}很明显，丰饶玉米角在“玉米投手的加农炮设计与培养”这门课程上学歪了。发射吗？也算是发射吧。发射物能攻击僵尸吗？也确实，甚至还能干更多事情。能上草坪吗？倒是那堆爆炸狂挺想拉他入伙的。

CORNUCOPIA_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Produces and launches plant seed packets within the selected seed packet range.
CORNUCOPIA_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 在你所选的种子包范围内生产并发射可种植的植物种子包。

CORNUCOPIA_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Produces and launches a large number of plant seed packets.
CORNUCOPIA_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}生产并发射大量植物种子包。

COWBOY_MINIGAME_TUTORIAL_2.zh: 种植魔术菇以开始游戏

COWBOY_MINIGAME_TUTORIAL_3.zh: 种植玉米投手以开始游戏

CRANJELLY_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Cran Jelly is more than capable of changing into any other shapes. Cubes. Pyramids Cones. Icosahedron. It can do it all. But few shapes are as structurally strong or offer as much zombie crushing power as the cylinder. Not to mention, it lets him go really fast.
CRANJELLY_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}蔓越莓果冻完全可以变换成任何其它的形状。无论是长方体、圆锥体、二十面体，它都没问题。但是很少有形状能像圆柱体那般坚固，也很少能把僵尸撞得满地找牙。更别说，只有圆柱体才能让他的速度这么快，离谱的快。

CRANJELLY_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Instant plant that crushes zombies in the lane under its girthy jellified mass. Leaves behind a pool of acidic goo that both slows and damages zombies when a zombie is crushed.
CRANJELLY_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 一株可以撞向所在行僵尸，往它们身上铺满粘稠果冻状物质的植物，种植后立即生效。当僵尸被撞死时，会留下一滩酸性黏液，不仅可以减缓僵尸的速度，也能造成伤害。

CRANJELLY_DESCRIPTION_HINT.en: Cran Jelly works best when zombies are clumped together. Level it up to increase the number of lanes it will roll down.
CRANJELLY_DESCRIPTION_HINT.zh: 当僵尸聚在一起时，蔓越莓果冻的效果最佳。给它升级，就能让它滚过更多行。

CRANJELLY_TOOLTIP.en: Crushes all zombies in the lane it’s planted.
CRANJELLY_TOOLTIP.zh: 撞扁种植行的所有僵尸。

CS_DESC.zh: 此主题事件即将开始！你准备好了吗？

CUTEBUBUSEED_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Cute Bubu Seed is the cute version of Bubu Seed. He has a delicate appearance, but is naughty by nature. He always likes to jump forward when walking. He has dreamed of becoming a doctor since he was a child.
CUTEBUBUSEED_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}萌布布种子是布布种子的可爱版，有一副娇气的外表，但生性比较顽皮，走路时总爱一跳一跳的前进，从小就有当医生的梦想。

CUTEBUBUSEED_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Cute Bubu Seed can protect plants and attack neaby zombies.
CUTEBUBUSEED_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 萌布布种子可以保护植物，而且具有攻击性，可以攻击近身的僵尸。

CUTEBUBUSEED_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Cause continuous damage to the zombies in front.
CUTEBUBUSEED_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}萌布布种子连续对前方僵尸造成爆炸性伤害。

DAILY_2_WILDWEST.zh: 通过 2 道狂野西部关卡

DAILY_ACTIVITIES_APP_UPDATE.en: There’s nothing here, go to the "EVENTS" section and take a look
DAILY_ACTIVITIES_APP_UPDATE.zh: 这里什么都没有哦，前往 “活动” 栏位看看吧

DAILY_ACTIVITIES_DESC.en: Complete Daily Activities for fruitful rewards!
DAILY_ACTIVITIES_DESC.zh: 完成每日活动，赢取丰厚奖励！

DAILY_ACTIVITIES_DOWN_FOR_MAINTENANCE.en: Oops! Daily Activities are down for maintenance! Come back in 5 to 10 minutes!
DAILY_ACTIVITIES_DOWN_FOR_MAINTENANCE.zh: 诶！日常活动还在维护！请等个 5 到 10 分钟之后再回来看看吧！

DAILY_QUEST_COMPLETED.en: All Daily Goals have been completed! Great job!
DAILY_QUEST_COMPLETED.zh: 所有的每日目标都完成了！干得好！

DAILY_QUEST_COMPLETED_TIMER.en: New Daily Goals unlock in {VARIABLE HOURS}h {VARIABLE MINUTES}m
DAILY_QUEST_COMPLETED_TIMER.zh: 新的日常目标将在 {VARIABLE HOURS} 时 {VARIABLE MINUTES} 分后解锁

DAILY_STORE_GIFT_CLAIM.zh: 领取你的每日彩陶礼物！

DANDELION_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}Attacks zombies in the upper, middle, and lower lanes, one lane per attack.
{FLAVOR}"Acid Lemon is more of a landlubber despite loving water. He doesn't even move an inch talking about catches from the past, though as of now the cute little buoy isn't adding any bonus points.
DANDELION_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}攻击上中下三行的僵尸，每次攻击一行。

{FLAVOR}“看，” 柠檬说，摇了摇头。“我总是很开心，很神经质！”

DANDELION_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Fires lemon juice to attack zombies in three lanes, but can only attack one lane at a time.
DANDELION_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 强酸柠檬可以攻击上中下三行的僵尸，每次攻击一行。

DANDELION_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}PlantFood: {STAT}Summons acid rain, attacking all zombies on the screen. Turns seawater into acidic seawater that deals damage to zombies for a period of time.
DANDELION_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}降下强酸雨，攻击全屏僵尸。将海水转变为带有强酸性质的海水对僵尸造成伤害，持续一段时间。

DANDELION_TOOLTIP.en: Fires lemon juice to attack zombies in three lanes.
DANDELION_TOOLTIP.zh: 发射柠檬汁攻击三行的僵尸

DANGER_ROOM_ATLANTIS_LEVEL_NAME.zh: 海底世界 - 第 {LEVEL_NUMBER} 关

DANGER_ROOM_BEACH_LEVEL_NAME.zh: 提基文明传承者 - 第 {LEVEL_NUMBER} 关

DANGER_ROOM_BEACH_TITLE_WELCOME.zh: 欢迎来到提基文明传承者！
