DANGER_ROOM_REWARD_FLICK_ZOMBIE.en: Adds a free use of Power Toss

DANGER_ROOM_REWARD_FOURTH_CARD_DESC.en: Use coins to show fourth choice
DANGER_ROOM_REWARD_FOURTH_CARD_DESC.zh: 使用金币，展示第四个选择

DANGER_ROOM_REWARD_MOWER_DESC.en: Restores up to {MOWER_COUNT} missing lawn mowers at the start of the level
DANGER_ROOM_REWARD_MOWER_DESC.zh: 最多可以在该等级的关卡开始时恢复 {MOWER_COUNT} 个割草机

DANGER_ROOM_REWARD_MOWER_DESC_SINGULAR.en: Restores one missing lawn mower at the start of the level
DANGER_ROOM_REWARD_MOWER_DESC_SINGULAR.zh: 在该等级的关卡开始时恢复一个割草机

DANGER_ROOM_REWARD_PLANTFOOD_DESC.en: Starts you off with {PF_COUNT} extra Plant Foods
DANGER_ROOM_REWARD_PLANTFOOD_DESC.zh: 开局额外携带 {PF_COUNT} 份叶绿素

DANGER_ROOM_REWARD_PLANTFOOD_DESC_SINGUL.en: Starts you off with an extra Plant Food
DANGER_ROOM_REWARD_PLANTFOOD_DESC_SINGUL.zh: 开局额外携带一份叶绿素

DANGER_ROOM_REWARD_SNOWBALL.en: Adds a free use of Power Snow

DANGER_ROOM_REWARD_SUN_DESC.en: Starts you off with an extra {SUN_COUNT} sun
DANGER_ROOM_REWARD_SUN_DESC.zh: 开局额外携带 {SUN_COUNT} 阳光

DANGER_ROOM_REWARD_WIZARD_FINGER.en: Adds a free use of Power Zap

DANGER_ROOM_TITLE_PICK_REWARD.en: Select a card to add to your progression!
DANGER_ROOM_TITLE_PICK_REWARD.zh: 选择一张卡片，把它加入到你的收集进度！

DANGER_ROOM_TITLE_WELCOME.zh: 欢迎来到危机四伏的无尽模式！

DARKAGES_LEVEL_NAME.zh: 复兴时代 - 第 {LEVEL_NUMBER} 天

DARKTWINSUNFLOWER_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}If you ask which plant loves afternoon tea the most, everyone will immediately think of Dark Twin Sunflower. Every afternoon, she pulls some other plants into her tea party. Chomper is quite fond of the zombie pie she bakes.
DARKTWINSUNFLOWER_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}要问最喜欢喝下午茶的植物，大家都会第一时间想到黑暗双子葵，每一到下午，都会拉上一些植物去开她的下午茶派对，大嘴花还挺喜欢吃她烤的僵尸派。

DARKTWINSUNFLOWER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Dark Twin Sunflowers give twice as much sun as a normal sunflower while summoning Sun Bombs to attack zombies.
DARKTWINSUNFLOWER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 黑暗双子葵可以在生产阳光时召唤不可名状的紫色阳光炸弹攻击僵尸，像一个中世纪的...？

DARKTWINSUNFLOWER_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Immediately produces a large amount of sun while creating Shine Vine and duplicating itself on the right.
DARKTWINSUNFLOWER_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}立即产生大量阳光，同时创建阳光藤蔓，并在右侧复制自身。

DARKTWINSUNFLOWER_TOOLTIP.en: Gives twice as much sun as a sunflower and attacks zombies
DARKTWINSUNFLOWER_TOOLTIP.zh: 提供两倍于向日葵的阳光，并对僵尸造成攻击

DARTICHOKE_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}"Why waste shots on foot soldiers when you can win the battle with one well-chosen dart to the dome?" wonders Dartichoke. "Why would you do it? Why would ANYONE do it?"
DARTICHOKE_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}每次发射都有几率产生暴击
{KEYWORD}使用：{STAT}飞镖的数量有限，发射完之后需要时间来重新填装
{KEYWORD}飞镖洋蓟的优先攻击目标：
{STAT}全明星僵尸
{STAT}探险家僵尸
{STAT}渔夫僵尸
{STAT}章鱼僵尸
{STAT}海盗船长僵尸
{STAT}勘探者僵尸
{STAT}罗马治疗师僵尸
{STAT}宝藏雪人
{STAT}巫师僵尸

{FLAVOR}“如果能绕过前面的炮灰，直接一镖先擒王，那又何必浪费子弹去打那些炮灰呢？”飞镖洋蓟心想。“为什么？为什么就是有人想不通这个道理？为！什！么！”

DARTICHOKE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Dartichokes fire high-damage darts down the lane, prioritizing especially dangerous zombies such as Wizards, Octo Zombies, and Healers.Has a limited supply of darts that can deal critical damage.
DARTICHOKE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 飞镖洋蓟可以向所在行发射高伤害的飞镖，并且会优先攻击诸如巫师、章鱼僵尸、治疗师等高危险度的僵尸。

DARTICHOKE_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Shoots darts that deal with damage to a multiple of zombies on the lawn.
DARTICHOKE_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}发射飞镖，对草坪上的多只僵尸造成伤害。

DAVE_CANNONMINIGAME_8_KILLED_3.zh: 哇啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！

DAZEYCHAIN_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}"I use they/them pronouns," says Dazey Chain. "Duh," they add.
DAZEYCHAIN_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}“请用复数代词来称呼我们，”眩晕雏菊说。“喂”，眩晕雏菊“们”补充道。

DAZEYCHAIN_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Dazey Chains grow through stages, becoming more powerful and releasing a stunning puff of gas at each stage.
DAZEYCHAIN_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 眩晕雏菊可以通过生长来变得更加强大，每次生长，有毒气体就会提升一个等级。

DAZEYCHAIN_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Releases a large plume of stunning gas toward zombies in its column and adjacent columns.
DAZEYCHAIN_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}发射大量气体，眩晕所在排和相邻排的僵尸。

DAZEYCHAIN_TOOLTIP.zh: 生长后可以释放气体眩晕僵尸

DEFEAT_8BIT_REPEATABLE_DESC.zh: 它们根本不符合计算机图形标准！

DEFEAT_ALLSTAR_REPEATABLE_DESC.en: Their team spirit is too overwhelming!
DEFEAT_ALLSTAR_REPEATABLE_DESC.zh: 它们的团队精神太过头了！

DEFEAT_ARCADE_REPEATABLE_DESC.en: Gamers in a game? Too meta!
DEFEAT_ARCADE_REPEATABLE_DESC.zh: 在游戏里玩游戏？什么元游戏！

DEFEAT_BALLOON_REPEATABLE_DESC.zh: 它们的气球也太耐用了吧！

DEFEAT_BARREL_ROLLER_REPEATABLE_DESC.en: Barrels are for storing things, not for smushing plants!
DEFEAT_BARREL_ROLLER_REPEATABLE_DESC.zh: 桶是用来放东西的，不是用来碾扁植物的！

DEFEAT_BASICS_REPEATABLE_DESC.en: Time to get back to basics, and thin out the zombie horde!
DEFEAT_BASICS_REPEATABLE_DESC.zh: 把视线放回普通僵尸身上吧。是时候让成群的僵尸变得稀疏一点了！

DEFEAT_BEACH_BASICS_SCHEDULED_DESC.en: Defeat the stylish basic zombies of Big Wave Beach!
DEFEAT_BEACH_BASICS_SCHEDULED_DESC.zh: 它们的蓬巴杜发型和比基尼可能确实很时髦，不过它们仍然是一群食脑者！

DEFEAT_BEACH_BASICS_SCHEDULED_TITLE.en: Defeat Basic Big Wave Beach Zombies!
DEFEAT_BEACH_BASICS_SCHEDULED_TITLE.zh: 击败巨浪海滩普通僵尸！

DEFEAT_BEACH_BUCKETHEAD_SCHEDULED_DESC.en: Teach these zombies that buckets are for making sand castles.
DEFEAT_BEACH_BUCKETHEAD_SCHEDULED_DESC.zh: 教教那些僵尸，桶是用来堆沙堡的。

DEFEAT_BEACH_CONEHEAD_SCHEDULED_DESC.en: Better beat these beach blanket bozos!
DEFEAT_BEACH_CONEHEAD_SCHEDULED_DESC.zh: 最好击败这些沙滩毯傻瓜！

DEFEAT_BEACH_GARGANTUAR_REPEATABLE_DESC.en: They're zombies, but they look like weird crabs! Ick!
DEFEAT_BEACH_GARGANTUAR_REPEATABLE_DESC.zh: 它们是僵尸，但是看着像诡异的螃蟹！呕！

DEFEAT_BEACH_IMP_SCHEDULED_DESC.en: Half fish, half imp. Entirely gross.
DEFEAT_BEACH_IMP_SCHEDULED_DESC.zh: 半鱼半小鬼，真够恶心的。

DEFEAT_BLOCKHEAD_REPEATABLE_DESC.en: Their headgear is simply too geometric!
DEFEAT_BLOCKHEAD_REPEATABLE_DESC.zh: 它们的头饰简直不要太几何了！

DEFEAT_BOOMBOX_REPEATABLE_DESC.en: Their emotions are too raw, too honest!
DEFEAT_BOOMBOX_REPEATABLE_DESC.zh: 它们的情感太原始、太诚实了！

DEFEAT_BREAKDANCER_REPEATABLE_DESC.en: Their fly moves are simply intolerable!
DEFEAT_BREAKDANCER_REPEATABLE_DESC.zh: 它们的飞行动作真让人难受！

DEFEAT_BUCKETS_REPEATABLE_DESC.en: Time to make these zombies kick the bucket!
DEFEAT_BUCKETS_REPEATABLE_DESC.zh: 是时候让这些僵尸桶飞头掉了！

DEFEAT_BUG_REPEATABLE_DESC.en: Bug/zombie symbiosis is just too creepy!
DEFEAT_BUG_REPEATABLE_DESC.zh: 飞虫和僵尸居然能互利共生…真是令人不寒而栗！

DEFEAT_BULLRIDER_REPEATABLE_DESC.en: They look like bulls, but they're actually robots! GET 'EM!
DEFEAT_BULLRIDER_REPEATABLE_DESC.zh: 看上去像牛，但它们其实是机器人！干掉它们！

DEFEAT_BULLY_REPEATABLE_DESC.en: Bones in beards are questionably fashionable!
DEFEAT_BULLY_REPEATABLE_DESC.zh: 胡子里藏骨头可能算不上时尚吧！

DEFEAT_CAMEL_REPEATABLE_DESC.en: That camel-flauge isn't fooling anyone. Defeat camel zombies!
DEFEAT_CAMEL_REPEATABLE_DESC.zh: 小样，躲牌后面我就认不出你了？快，把那些躲在牌背后的僵尸给揪出来！

DEFEAT_CARDIO_X_TIMES.zh: 击败 {NUMBER} 只有氧运动僵尸

DEFEAT_CHICKEN_FARMER_REPEATABLE_DESC.en: They wrangled just one too many chickens!
DEFEAT_CHICKEN_FARMER_REPEATABLE_DESC.zh: 它们养的鸡也太多了吧！

DEFEAT_CONES_REPEATABLE_DESC.en: Practice a little garden safety by culling out Conehead Zombies!
DEFEAT_CONES_REPEATABLE_DESC.zh: 把路障僵尸清理出你的草坪，保障你花园的安全！

DEFEAT_COWBOY_BASICS_SCHEDULED_DESC.en: Defeat the boot-wearing basic zombies of the Wild West!
DEFEAT_COWBOY_BASICS_SCHEDULED_DESC.zh: 这些穿靴子赶牛的僵尸需要被一位老派的边境法官制裁！

DEFEAT_COWBOY_BASICS_SCHEDULED_TITLE.zh: 击败狂野西部普通僵尸！

DEFEAT_COWBOY_BUCKETHEAD_SCHEDULED_DESC.en: In my day, buckets were for mucking the stables!
DEFEAT_COWBOY_BUCKETHEAD_SCHEDULED_DESC.zh: 我们那个年代啊，铁桶是用来清扫马厩的！

DEFEAT_COWBOY_CONEHEAD_SCHEDULED_DESC.en: Send these cone rangers to the pokey!
DEFEAT_COWBOY_CONEHEAD_SCHEDULED_DESC.zh: 把这些路障骑警送到监狱去！

DEFEAT_CRYSTALSKULL_REPEATABLE_DESC.en: Those weird skulls shouldn't be able to do what they do!
DEFEAT_CRYSTALSKULL_REPEATABLE_DESC.zh: 这些奇怪的头骨不应该有这种能力！

DEFEAT_DARK_BASICS_SCHEDULED_DESC.en: They're not pleasant, they're peasant! And that's terrible!
DEFEAT_DARK_BASICS_SCHEDULED_DESC.zh: 他们不是农民，他们是农冥！大大的坏事！

DEFEAT_DARK_BUCKETHEAD_SCHEDULED_DESC.en: They'll never be knights with low-tier equipment like that!
DEFEAT_DARK_BUCKETHEAD_SCHEDULED_DESC.zh: 他们永远不会成为那种只有低级装备的骑士！

DEFEAT_DARK_GARGANTUAR_REPEATABLE_DESC.en: Their big stone hammers are clumsy and all too effective!
DEFEAT_DARK_GARGANTUAR_REPEATABLE_DESC.zh: 他们的大石锤笨拙但有效！

DEFEAT_DARK_GARGANTUAR_REPEATABLE_TITLE.zh: 击败黑暗时代巨人僵尸！

DEFEAT_DARK_IMP_SCHEDULED_DESC.en: These monks ain't funky! Except for their smell.
DEFEAT_DARK_IMP_SCHEDULED_DESC.zh: 这些僧侣一点都不时髦！除了它们的气味。

DEFEAT_DINO_BASICS_SCHEDULED_DESC.zh: 他们的服装完全不符合历史！

DEFEAT_DINO_BASICS_SCHEDULED_TITLE.zh: 击败侏罗纪沼泽普通僵尸！

DEFEAT_DINO_BUCKETHEAD_SCHEDULED_DESC.zh: 呃…铁桶，坏耶。把它们砸碎！

DEFEAT_DINO_CONEHEAD_SCHEDULED_DESC.en: Zombie like cone. You not a zombie. Crush cone!
DEFEAT_DINO_CONEHEAD_SCHEDULED_DESC.zh: 僵尸喜欢路障，但你又不是僵尸，所以把那些路障打得稀巴烂吧！

DEFEAT_DINO_GARGANTUAR_REPEATABLE_DESC.zh: 它们的骨头棒也太钝了吧！

DEFEAT_DINO_IMP_REPEATABLE_DESC.en: Their mean little giggles are super unsettling!
DEFEAT_DINO_IMP_REPEATABLE_DESC.zh: 它们卑鄙的傻笑真是让人不安！

DEFEAT_DISCO_MECH_REPEATABLE_DESC.en: Their 70s disco rhythms don't belong in their far-future era!
DEFEAT_DISCO_MECH_REPEATABLE_DESC.zh: 它们那 70 年代的迪斯科旋律与这个遥远的未来时代格格不入！

DEFEAT_DODO_REPEATABLE_DESC.en: Who knew dodos could be such jerks?
DEFEAT_DODO_REPEATABLE_DESC.zh: 谁知道渡渡鸟也这么混蛋呢？

DEFEAT_EGYPT_BASICS_SCHEDULED_DESC.en: Defeat the bandaged basic zombies of Ancient Egypt!
DEFEAT_EGYPT_BASICS_SCHEDULED_DESC.zh: 秃头的、戴路障的、支铁桶的，这些木乃伊三人组我看着就烦！

DEFEAT_EGYPT_BASICS_SCHEDULED_TITLE.zh: 击败上古埃及普通僵尸！

DEFEAT_EGYPT_BUCKETHEAD_SCHEDULED_DESC.en: These pail-packers need to go pound sand!
DEFEAT_EGYPT_BUCKETHEAD_SCHEDULED_DESC.zh: 它们头上的桶应该拿来装沙子的啊！

DEFEAT_EGYPT_CONEHEAD_SCHEDULED_DESC.en: Don't they have a pyramid to build, or something?
DEFEAT_EGYPT_CONEHEAD_SCHEDULED_DESC.zh: 它们不应该去建金字塔吗？

DEFEAT_EGYPT_GARGANTUAR_REPEATABLE_DESC.en: Wrap things up by taking care of some Mummified Gargantuars!
DEFEAT_EGYPT_GARGANTUAR_REPEATABLE_DESC.zh: 击败木乃伊巨人，终结这一切！

DEFEAT_EIGHTIES_BASICS_SCHEDULED_DESC.en: They're always growling about obscure bands!
DEFEAT_EIGHTIES_BASICS_SCHEDULED_DESC.zh: 它们总是为小众乐队尖叫！

DEFEAT_EIGHTIES_BASICS_SCHEDULED_TITLE.en: Defeat Basic Neon Mixtape Tour Zombies!
DEFEAT_EIGHTIES_BASICS_SCHEDULED_TITLE.zh: 击败炫光魔音游普通僵尸！

DEFEAT_EIGHTIES_BUCKETHEAD_SCHEDULED_DES.en: They don't know what it means to be a metalhead!
DEFEAT_EIGHTIES_BUCKETHEAD_SCHEDULED_DES.zh: 它们才不知道金属头代表着什么！

DEFEAT_EIGHTIES_CONEHEAD_SCHEDULED_DESC.en: Their traffic cone and denim look is SO out of style.
DEFEAT_EIGHTIES_CONEHEAD_SCHEDULED_DESC.zh: 它们头上的路障和身上的牛仔裤实在是太过时了。

DEFEAT_EIGHTIES_GARGANTUAR_REPEATABLE_DE.en: They need to learn at least two chords!
DEFEAT_EIGHTIES_GARGANTUAR_REPEATABLE_DE.zh: 它们至少得学习两种和弦！

DEFEAT_EXCAVATOR_REPEATABLE_DESC.en: Shovels just shouldn't be that effective! Punish them!
DEFEAT_EXCAVATOR_REPEATABLE_DESC.zh: 有铲子了不起啊？让它们长长教训！

DEFEAT_EXPANSION_RANDOM_LEVEL_REPEATABLE.en: Use your leveled-up plants to tackle extra-tough veteran zombies in expert levels! Warning: May Be Tense!
DEFEAT_EXPANSION_RANDOM_LEVEL_REPEATABLE.zh: 请使用高等级植物来应对专家关卡中超强的高级僵尸！警告：局势可能会很紧张！

DEFEAT_EXPLORER_REPEATABLE_DESC.en: Teach the explorer zombies that playing with fire is dangerous!
DEFEAT_EXPLORER_REPEATABLE_DESC.zh: 没有人告诉过那些僵尸玩火会自焚吗？那就让它们长长教训吧。

DEFEAT_FISHERMAN_REPEATABLE_DESC.en: Because seriously. These guys. They need to go away.
DEFEAT_FISHERMAN_REPEATABLE_DESC.zh: 因为说真的，这些家伙，应该离开。

DEFEAT_FOOTBALL_MECH_REPEATABLE_DESC.en: How dare they shove your plants like they do?
DEFEAT_FOOTBALL_MECH_REPEATABLE_DESC.zh: 它们凭什么铲走你的植物？

DEFEAT_FOSSILHEAD_REPEATABLE_DESC.en: A skull on a head is one skull too many!
DEFEAT_FOSSILHEAD_REPEATABLE_DESC.zh: 脑袋上再套一个脑袋？套娃是吧！

DEFEAT_FUTURE_BASICS_SCHEDULED_DESC.en: They have shiny jumpsuits and awful, carnivorous intentions!
DEFEAT_FUTURE_BASICS_SCHEDULED_DESC.zh: 那些闪亮的连身衣，掩盖着它们那可怕的食肉之欲！

DEFEAT_FUTURE_BASICS_SCHEDULED_TITLE.zh: 击败未来世界普通僵尸！

DEFEAT_FUTURE_CONEHEAD_SCHEDULED_DESC.en: They need to upgrade to the zCone 7 anyway.
DEFEAT_FUTURE_CONEHEAD_SCHEDULED_DESC.zh: 不管怎样，它们必须得升级到 zCone 7。

DEFEAT_FUTURE_GARGANTUAR_REPEATABLE_DESC.en: They have telephone poles for arms! TELEPHONE POLES!
DEFEAT_FUTURE_GARGANTUAR_REPEATABLE_DESC.zh: 它们把电线杆当作武器！电线杆诶！

DEFEAT_FUTURE_IMP_REPEATABLE_DESC.en: They scamper around in creepy little spider-bots! Brrrrrr!
DEFEAT_FUTURE_IMP_REPEATABLE_DESC.zh: 它们坐在那令人毛骨悚然的机器蛛虫里蹦蹦跳跳！脑——！

DEFEAT_FUTURE_IMP_REPEATABLE_TITLE.zh: 击败未来世界小鬼僵尸！

DEFEAT_GARGANTUARS_REPEATABLE_DESC.en: Take on the big boys by taking out some random Gargantuars!
DEFEAT_GARGANTUARS_REPEATABLE_DESC.zh: 随便击败几只巨人僵尸，让这些大个子臣服！

DEFEAT_GLITTER_REPEATABLE_DESC.en: Roller skates are more of a 70s thing anyway!
DEFEAT_GLITTER_REPEATABLE_DESC.zh: 旱冰鞋？70 年代的老东西了吧！

DEFEAT_HUNTER_REPEATABLE_DESC.en: Because snowballs are preposterous hunting gear!
DEFEAT_HUNTER_REPEATABLE_DESC.zh: 雪球是什么奇奇怪怪的狩猎工具啊！

DEFEAT_ICEAGE_BASICS_SCHEDULED_DESC.en: They lack technological sophistication! Punish them for it!
DEFEAT_ICEAGE_BASICS_SCHEDULED_DESC.zh: 原始人还敢和我们斗？让它们长长教训！

DEFEAT_ICEAGE_BASICS_SCHEDULED_TITLE.zh: 击败极寒冰窟普通僵尸！

DEFEAT_ICEAGE_BUCKETHEAD_SCHEDULED_DESC.en: I've heard of ice buckets, but this is ridiculous!
DEFEAT_ICEAGE_BUCKETHEAD_SCHEDULED_DESC.zh: 这难道就是传说中的…“冰桶”挑战…？

DEFEAT_ICEAGE_CONEHEAD_SCHEDULED_DESC.en: They're all just evolutionary dead ends!
DEFEAT_ICEAGE_CONEHEAD_SCHEDULED_DESC.zh: 它们已经掉进进化的死胡同里了！

DEFEAT_ICEAGE_GARGANTUAR_REPEATABLE_DESC.en: These lunkheads don't even have the decency to be slothful!
DEFEAT_ICEAGE_GARGANTUAR_REPEATABLE_DESC.zh: 这些原始僵尸也配用“地懒”来称呼自己吗！

DEFEAT_ICEAGE_IMP_SCHEDULED_DESC.en: Unfortunately these yetis are anything but scarce.
DEFEAT_ICEAGE_IMP_SCHEDULED_DESC.zh: 这个时候，雪人僵尸可能还不算什么稀有物种吧。

DEFEAT_IMPPORTER_REPEATABLE_DESC.en: How do they pack all those zombies in there? It strains credulity!
DEFEAT_IMPPORTER_REPEATABLE_DESC.zh: 它们是怎么把那些僵尸包起来的？太不可思议了！

DEFEAT_IMPS_REPEATABLE_DESC.en: These things are just weird. Please get rid of them!
DEFEAT_IMPS_REPEATABLE_DESC.zh: 这些东西太奇怪了，把它们统统赶走！

DEFEAT_IMPUNK_REPEATABLE_DESC.zh: 莫霍克发型的小鬼僵尸？脑——！

DEFEAT_JETPACK_REPEATABLE_DESC.en: Why do they get jetpacks? It's so unfair!
DEFEAT_JETPACK_REPEATABLE_DESC.zh: 为什么它们有喷气背包？太不公平了！

DEFEAT_JUGGLER_REPEATABLE_DESC.en: They're constantly ripping off other funnier zombies' material!
DEFEAT_JUGGLER_REPEATABLE_DESC.zh: 它们一直在偷其他僵尸的笑话！

DEFEAT_KING_REPEATABLE_DESC.en: They refuse to govern with the consent of the governed!
DEFEAT_KING_REPEATABLE_DESC.zh: 它们才不用管人民的意见。它们说自己是王，它们就是王。

DEFEAT_KNIGHT_REPEATABLE_DESC.en: They work too hard upholding a regressive feudal system!
DEFEAT_KNIGHT_REPEATABLE_DESC.zh: 它们还在不遗余力地维护那封建制度，别费功夫了。

DEFEAT_LOSTCITY_BASICS_SCHEDULED_DESC.en: Their exploratory efforts are highly questionable!
DEFEAT_LOSTCITY_BASICS_SCHEDULED_DESC.zh: 它们无畏的探索精神值得被世人质疑！

DEFEAT_LOSTCITY_BASICS_SCHEDULED_TITLE.zh: 击败失落之城普通僵尸！

DEFEAT_LOSTCITY_BUCKETHEAD_SCHEDULED_DES.en: Buckets. Why did it have to be buckets?
DEFEAT_LOSTCITY_BUCKETHEAD_SCHEDULED_DES.zh: 铁桶…为什么一定要是桶呢？

DEFEAT_LOSTCITY_CONEHEAD_SCHEDULED_DESC.en: Impressive mustache or no, these guys have got to go!
DEFEAT_LOSTCITY_CONEHEAD_SCHEDULED_DESC.zh: 不管有没有留着令人印象深刻的胡子，这些家伙都得出发了！

DEFEAT_LOSTCITY_GARGANTUAR_REPEATABLE_DE.en: They just lug too much stuff around!
DEFEAT_LOSTCITY_GARGANTUAR_REPEATABLE_DE.zh: 它们不过是卖力地搬运过多乘客罢！

DEFEAT_LOSTCITY_IMP_SCHEDULED_DESC.en: Their helmets are just the piths!
DEFEAT_LOSTCITY_IMP_SCHEDULED_DESC.zh: 它们头顶的安全帽才是要点所在！

DEFEAT_LOSTCITY_IMP_SCHEDULED_TITLE.zh: 击败失落之城小鬼僵尸！

DEFEAT_LOST_PILOT_REPEATABLE_DESC.en: Nobody should have ever issued them a license to fly!
DEFEAT_LOST_PILOT_REPEATABLE_DESC.zh: 任何人都不该给它们飞行执照！

DEFEAT_MCZOMBIE_REPEATABLE_DESC.en: How dare they spin their mics that way!
DEFEAT_MCZOMBIE_REPEATABLE_DESC.zh: 它们怎么敢那样转麦克风！

DEFEAT_MECH_CONE_REPEATABLE_DESC.en: Robo-cone zombies are too cylindrical to be allowed!
DEFEAT_MECH_CONE_REPEATABLE_DESC.zh: 机器路障僵尸不应该出现。为什么？因为它们太圆柱了！

DEFEAT_MODERN_BASICS_SCHEDULED_DESC.en: Their contemporary crimes may not be countenanced!
DEFEAT_MODERN_BASICS_SCHEDULED_DESC.zh: 它们在当代犯下的罪行可不会得到包容！

DEFEAT_MODERN_BASICS_SCHEDULED_TITLE.zh: 击败小镇奇兵普通僵尸！

DEFEAT_MODERN_BUCKETHEAD_SCHEDULED_DESC.en: Make them kick the… well, you know.
DEFEAT_MODERN_BUCKETHEAD_SCHEDULED_DESC.zh: 是时候让这些僵尸桶飞…呃，你懂的。

DEFEAT_MODERN_BUCKETHEAD_SCHEDULED_TITLE.zh: 击败现代年华铁桶僵尸！

DEFEAT_MODERN_CONEHEAD_SCHEDULED_DESC.en: Defeat the conehead zombies of Modern Day!
DEFEAT_MODERN_CONEHEAD_SCHEDULED_DESC.zh: 僵尸喜欢路障，但你又不是僵尸，所以把那些路障打得稀巴烂吧！

DEFEAT_MODERN_CONEHEAD_SCHEDULED_TITLE.zh: 击败现代年华路障僵尸！

DEFEAT_MODERN_GARGANTUAR_SCHEDULED_DESC.en: They're really just big softies. Make sure they know that.
DEFEAT_MODERN_GARGANTUAR_SCHEDULED_DESC.zh: 它们真的就只是一群大软蛋。让它们瞧瞧自己有几斤几两。

DEFEAT_MODERN_GARGANTUAR_SCHEDULED_TITLE.zh: 击败现代年华巨人僵尸！

DEFEAT_NEWSPAPER_REPEATABLE_DESC.en: They already threw out the comics section!
DEFEAT_NEWSPAPER_REPEATABLE_DESC.zh: 别盯着报纸了，它们已经把里面的漫画撕掉了！

DEFEAT_OCTOPUS_REPEATABLE_DESC.en: Enslaving octopuses for zombie purposes is just not cool!
DEFEAT_OCTOPUS_REPEATABLE_DESC.zh: 为了僵尸的想法而奴役章鱼一点也不酷！

DEFEAT_PARASOL_REPEATABLE_DESC.en: Those parasols are just too fancy and expensive!
DEFEAT_PARASOL_REPEATABLE_DESC.zh: 那些阳伞太花哨，太昂贵了！

DEFEAT_PHARAOH_REPEATABLE_DESC.en: These Pharaohs think they rule, but they'll never win this duel!
DEFEAT_PHARAOH_REPEATABLE_DESC.zh: 这些法老觉得自己才是主宰。但至少这场战斗中，主宰战场的是你！

DEFEAT_PIANO_REPEATABLE_DESC.en: They can't even read sheet music!

DEFEAT_PIRATE_BASICS_SCHEDULED_DESC.zh: 给这些臭海盗一点颜色瞧瞧！

DEFEAT_PIRATE_BASICS_SCHEDULED_TITLE.zh: 击败海盗港湾普通僵尸！

DEFEAT_PIRATE_BUCKETHEAD_SCHEDULED_DESC.en: Swab the decks with their leaky headgear!
DEFEAT_PIRATE_BUCKETHEAD_SCHEDULED_DESC.zh: 用他们的破帽子擦甲板吧！

DEFEAT_PIRATE_CAPTAIN_REPEATABLE_DESC.en: Do it before they mutate into Pirate Admiral Zombies!
DEFEAT_PIRATE_CAPTAIN_REPEATABLE_DESC.zh: 搞快点，等它们变成海军上将僵尸就晚了！

DEFEAT_PIRATE_CONEHEAD_SCHEDULED_DESC.en: Cross their crossbones off the list!
DEFEAT_PIRATE_CONEHEAD_SCHEDULED_DESC.zh: 把他们的交叉骨从名单上叉掉！

DEFEAT_PIRATE_IMP_SCHEDULED_DESC.en: Turn these cannoneers into cannon fodder!

DEFEAT_PONCHO_REPEATABLE_DESC.en: What are they hiding under their ponchos? You can never tell!
DEFEAT_PONCHO_REPEATABLE_DESC.zh: 它们的斗篷下面藏着什么？你永远不会知道！

DEFEAT_PROSPECTOR_REPEATABLE_DESC.en: And defeat their scruffy prospector beards, too!
DEFEAT_PROSPECTOR_REPEATABLE_DESC.zh: 还要打破他们那脏兮兮的勘探者胡子！

DEFEAT_PROTECTOR_REPEATABLE_DESC.en: E.M.Peaches make short work of these technological terrors!
DEFEAT_PROTECTOR_REPEATABLE_DESC.zh: 电磁脉冲桃能让这些恐怖的机械短暂失灵！

DEFEAT_PUNK_REPEATABLE_DESC.en: Their jackets and boots have too many spikes!
DEFEAT_PUNK_REPEATABLE_DESC.zh: 它们的夹克和靴子里的钉刺实在是太多了！

DEFEAT_RA_REPEATABLE_DESC.en: Ra Zombies are out to soak up your sun - make them ancient history!
DEFEAT_RA_REPEATABLE_DESC.zh: 太阳神僵尸可以迅速偷走你的阳光，太恶心了！让它们被遗忘在历史的长河里吧！

DEFEAT_RELICHUNTER_REPEATABLE_DESC.en: Teach them it's better to leave relics where they are!
DEFEAT_RELICHUNTER_REPEATABLE_DESC.zh: 告诉它们最好把宝物留在原地！

DEFEAT_SEAGULL_REPEATABLE_DESC.en: How can a seagull that small carry a zombie? It's ridiculous!
DEFEAT_SEAGULL_REPEATABLE_DESC.zh: 这么小的海鸥怎么能吊起一只僵尸？离谱！

DEFEAT_SNORKEL_REPEATABLE_DESC.en: They wear snorkels when they don't even need to breathe!
DEFEAT_SNORKEL_REPEATABLE_DESC.zh: 它们都不需要呼吸，干嘛含着根呼吸管？

DEFEAT_SURFER_REPEATABLE_DESC.en: They're throwing away a perfectly good post-secondary education!
DEFEAT_SURFER_REPEATABLE_DESC.zh: 它们放弃了接受良好的大专教育！

DEFEAT_SWASHBUCKLER_REPEATABLE_DESC.en: Who do they think they are, buckling those swashes?
DEFEAT_SWASHBUCKLER_REPEATABLE_DESC.zh: 他们以为他们是谁！我渴望有价值的对手！

DEFEAT_TOMB_RAISER_REPEATABLE_DESC.en: Teach these Tomb Raisers that messing with you was a grave mistake!
DEFEAT_TOMB_RAISER_REPEATABLE_DESC.zh: 让死神僵尸明白，随地乱丢骨头是一个致命的错误！

DEFEAT_TREASURE_YETI_REPEATABLE_DESC.en: What secrets are contained within its lunchbox? Only one way to find out!
DEFEAT_TREASURE_YETI_REPEATABLE_DESC.zh: 它的午餐盒里藏着什么秘密？只有一种方法可以知道！

DEFEAT_TROGLOBITE_REPEATABLE_DESC.en: That iceblock-shoving trick of theirs is way over the line.
DEFEAT_TROGLOBITE_REPEATABLE_DESC.zh: 它们的推冰把戏有点过分了。

DEFEAT_WEASELHOARDER_REPEATABLE_DESC.en: Who hoards weasels inside a log? WHO???
DEFEAT_WEASELHOARDER_REPEATABLE_DESC.zh: 谁？！到底是谁在原木里囤臭鼬？

DEFEAT_WEST_GARGANTUAR_REPEATABLE_DESC.en: Get them before they get you!
DEFEAT_WEST_GARGANTUAR_REPEATABLE_DESC.zh: 在它们抓住你之前反杀它们！

DEFEAT_WEST_GARGANTUAR_REPEATABLE_TITLE.zh: 击败狂野西部巨人僵尸！

DEFEAT_WIZARD_REPEATABLE_DESC.en: Their dark transformative powers must not be abided!
DEFEAT_WIZARD_REPEATABLE_DESC.zh: 绝不能容忍它们的黑暗变形术！

DEFEAT_X_ATLANTISGARGS.zh: 击杀 {NUMBER} 海底巨人僵尸

DEFEAT_X_ATLANTIS_LAND_BASICS.zh: 击杀 {NUMBER} 遗迹普通组僵尸

DEFEAT_X_CARNIE_IMP_TWINS.zh: 击败 {NUMBER} 只游乐园小鬼双子

DEFEAT_X_CONSULTANTS.zh: 击败 {NUMBER} 只 Z 公司顾问僵尸

DEFEAT_X_FAIRY_AND_FAIRY_ARMOR1.en: Defeat a total of {NUMBER} Poker Zombies and Poker Conehead Zombies
DEFEAT_X_FAIRY_AND_FAIRY_ARMOR1.zh: 击败 {NUMBER} 只扑克牌僵尸和扑克牌路障僵尸

DEFEAT_X_GARGIMPS.zh: 击败 {NUMBER} 只 Z 公司小巨人僵尸

DEFEAT_X_HELPDESK.zh: 击败 {NUMBER} 只 Z 公司技术支持僵尸

DEFEAT_X_JTTW_ZOMBIES.en: Defeat {NUMBER} zombies from Journey to the West

DEFEAT_X_LOSTCITIES.en: Defeat {NUMBER} zombies from the Lost City

DEFEAT_X_NON_ICEAGE.en: Defeat {NUMBER} zombies that are not from the Frostbite Caves
DEFEAT_X_NON_ICEAGE.zh: 击败 {NUMBER} 只非冰窟僵尸

DEFEAT_X_PROSPECTORS.zh: 击败 {NUMBER} 只勘探者僵尸

DEFEAT_X_ROMANGARGS.zh: 击败 {NUMBER} 只罗马巨人僵尸

DEFEAT_X_STATUEHEAD.zh: 击败 {NUMBER} 只半身像僵尸

DEFEAT_X_ZCORPS.zh: 击败 {NUMBER} 只 Z 公司僵尸

DEFEAT_X_ZOMBIES_IN_GIFTBOX.en: Defeat {NUMBER} special zombies from gift boxes
DEFEAT_X_ZOMBIES_IN_GIFTBOX.zh: 击败 {NUMBER} 只礼物里面的特殊僵尸

DEFEAT_ZMECH_X_TIMES.zh: 击败 Z 机甲 {NUMBER} 次。

DELETING_CHILD_PROFILES_INFO.en: By not allowing additional profiles, this will delete your non-primary profiles.  Are you sure you want to do that?
DELETING_CHILD_PROFILES_INFO.zh: 由于不允许多个档案的存在，接下来将会删除主档案之外的所有档案。确定要这样吗？

DESIREFLOWER_DESCRIPTION.en:
{FLAVOR}Beautiful flowers are born of desire, desire compels the flowers to devour the spirit, thus eradicating desire itself—only for new desires to arise anew. The heavens revolve, the earth shifts, the seasons cycle in order, all energies flow unobstructed." This is the very rhetoric the Iris of Desire (Yokangpu) peddles to deceive.

{KEYWORD}Origin: {STAT}PvZ 2: Edgest
{KEYWORD}Programmer: {STAT}jaynkrow
DESIREFLOWER_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{FLAVOR}“美丽的花朵诞生于欲望，欲望促使花朵吞噬了精神，从而消灭了欲望，而后又诞生新的欲望，天覆地转，四时顺行，万气得通。”欲望花菖蒲就是拿这套说辞行骗的。

{KEYWORD}归属：{STAT}PvZ 2 Edgest
{KEYWORD}代码：{STAT}jaynkrow

DESIREFLOWER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en:
Capable of digesting divine spirits.
With each digestion, launch a strong attack.
DESIREFLOWER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh:
吃掉小神灵程度的能力。
每吸收一次小神灵，就会发动一次强力攻击。

DESIREFLOWER_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Digest every spirit on screen.The more it digest, the more powerful Yin-Yang Orb it launches.
DESIREFLOWER_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}对于全屏的小神灵进行吞噬，吞噬的小神灵越多，凝聚出的富有大范围杀伤性的阴阳玉更加强大。

DESIREFLOWER_TOOLTIP.zh: 吃掉小神灵程度的能力

DIALOG_ARE_YOU_EXPERIENCED.en: Have you played Plants vs. Zombies before?
DIALOG_ARE_YOU_EXPERIENCED.zh: 你之前玩过《植物大战僵尸》吗？

DIALOG_SKIP_TUTORIAL.en: Would you like to play through the fundamentals of Plants vs. Zombies?
DIALOG_SKIP_TUTORIAL.zh: 你想了解一下《植物大战僵尸》的基础玩法吗？

DIALOG_TURBO_DESCRIPTION.en: The Turbo button speeds up your game. Faster sun, faster plants, and faster zombies!
DIALOG_TURBO_DESCRIPTION.zh: 加速按钮可以加快游戏速度。阳光产生得更快、植物种植得更快，而僵尸也进攻得更快！

DINONIP_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}affects all dinosaurs in a lane
{FLAVOR}Perfume-shrooms emit a pure, concentrated mist of aerosolized love.
DINONIP_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}使用：{STAT}可以影响一排内的所有恐龙
{FLAVOR}香水菇散发出的雾，是浓浓的、纯纯的爱。

DINONIP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Perfume-shrooms enchant dinosaurs and charm them into working against the zombies.
DINONIP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 香水菇可以迷惑恐龙，让它们反攻僵尸。

DINONIP_TOOLTIP.zh: 迷住恐龙，让它们对抗僵尸

DOOMBELL_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}blocks spirit zombies
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}spirit plants, can attract zombies when enhanced

{FLAVOR}Why do those spirit zombies, who could originally ignore collisions, stop to frantically gnaw on the Chime Bellzoin? After thorough investigation, the final conclusion is: it's not that his bell sound purifies the soul, but that his off-key low-frequency resonance is too much like 'scratching a blackboard with nails'.
DOOMBELL_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特点：{STAT}可阻挡灵体僵尸
{KEYWORD}特点：{STAT}灵界植物，强化后可以吸引僵尸

{FLAVOR}为什么那些原本可以无视碰撞的灵体僵尸，偏偏会停下来疯狂啃咬安息木编钟？深入调查后的最终结论是：并非他的钟声有多么净化灵魂，而是他那走调的低频共振实在太像“用指甲疯狂刮黑板”了。

DOOMBELL_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Blocks normal and spirit zombies, releases a sonic wave to stun and repel zombies upon death.
DOOMBELL_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 阻挡正常僵尸与灵体僵尸，死亡后释放音波眩晕并击退僵尸。

DOOMBELL_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Heals itself and gains a hard armor shell.
DOOMBELL_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}治疗自己，获得一副坚硬的盔甲外壳。

DOOMBELL_TOOLTIP.zh: 阻挡正常僵尸与灵体僵尸

DOOMSHROOM_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}"Things are crazy now. Back in my day, there were Browncoats, Browncoats with cones, and Browncoats with buckets. That’s it! What are all these? Jetpacks? Magicians? Dark creatures?.. Hrmph! They better not think I am old and harmless. I may be retired but I still know a thing or two about blowing up zombies."
DOOMSHROOM_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}“这年头可真是群魔乱舞啊。想我们那个年代，棕色外套僵尸、戴路障的棕色外套僵尸，戴铁桶的棕色外套僵尸，没了！现在的这都是啥？喷气背包？魔术师？暗黑生物？哼！他们可别以为我老了就不中用了。就算退休，炸僵尸这方面我还是宝刀未老的。”

DOOMSHROOM_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Doom-shroom explodes when destroyed. Depending on the growth stage, Doom-shroom explosion radius will increase and it may even spawn additional Doom-shrooms.
DOOMSHROOM_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 毁灭菇可以在被消灭时爆炸。生长阶段越高，毁灭菇的爆炸范围越大，有时甚至可以生成更多毁灭菇。

DOOMSHROOM_DESCRIPTION_HINT.en: Doom-shrooms will leave a crater when they explode, temporarily preventing planting of new plants. Be cautious to not over trigger too many Plant Foods.
DOOMSHROOM_DESCRIPTION_HINT.zh: 毁灭菇会在爆炸时留下一块坑，让地砖暂时无法种植新植物。注意，不要触发太多次叶绿素效果。

DOOMSHROOM_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}All Doom-shrooms on the lawn will grow a stage, and then explode and spawn additional Doom-shrooms.
DOOMSHROOM_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}让草坪上所有毁灭菇的生长阶段提升一级，随后爆炸，同时生成更多毁灭菇。

DOWNLOAD_ERROR_UPDATE_UNAVAILABLE.en: No update available at this time. Please try again later.
DOWNLOAD_ERROR_UPDATE_UNAVAILABLE.zh: 现在还没有更新数据包。请稍后再试。

DOWNLOAD_FAILED_BODY.en: Could not retrieve update information. Check that you are connected to the internet or try again at another time.
DOWNLOAD_FAILED_BODY.zh: 无法取得更新信息。请检查你是否已经连接到了互联网，或者稍后再试。

DRAFTODIL1_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Draftodil looks like she's full of hot air, but she isn't. She's full of highly compressed air. There's a difference!
DRAFTODIL1_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}僵直不会飞行的僵尸，吹飞飞行和小鬼僵尸。

{FLAVOR}气流水仙花看起来充满了热空气，但事实并非如此。她充满了高压气，有区别！

DRAFTODIL1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Draftodils windmill constantly, slowing flying zombies, and also shoot air cannon blasts that knock flying zombies off the lawn.
DRAFTODIL1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 发出气流短暂僵直不会飞行的僵尸，吹飞飞行和小鬼僵尸。

DRAFTODIL1_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Blows away all flying zombies in the row. Release multiple air burst that deal damage and stuns zombies in the row.
DRAFTODIL1_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}吹走所在行所有的飞行僵尸。释放数股空气聚流，对所在行的僵尸造成伤害和眩晕效果。

DRAFTODIL1_TOOLTIP.zh: 发出气流短暂僵直不会飞行的僵尸，吹飞飞行和小鬼僵尸。

DRAFTODIL_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Range: {STAT}2 tiles ahead.

{FLAVOR}Ents maintains a beautiful hairstyle every day, and sighs every time a leaf falls off.
DRAFTODIL_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}树灵护卫每天都在维护它秀丽的头发，每掉一片树叶它都会叹一口气

DRAFTODIL_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Keep attacking the zombies in front

DRAFTODIL_TOOLTIP.en: Attack zombies in front of it while being defensive
DRAFTODIL_TOOLTIP.zh: 不断攻击前方僵尸同时拥有很多血量

DRAGONBRUIT_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}While each head of Dragon Bruit doesn't have their own name, they do each have their own unique personality. The Center head is the calm, rational one. While Lefty is a bit reserved and shy. Righty is... Well... always right.
DRAGONBRUIT_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}虽然吼龙果的每一个头都没有自己的名字，但它们都有自己独特的个性。中间的头沉着冷静，左边的头矜持害羞，右边的头...嗯...总是对的。

DRAGONBRUIT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en:
Launches 3 explosive seed pod projectiles at zombies across 3 adjacent lanes. When destroyed, Dragon Bruit will split into 3 smaller plants. 

{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}When powered by Shadow Aura, projectiles will also apply poison.
DRAGONBRUIT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh:
向附近 3 行的僵尸发射 3 枚可以爆炸的种荚子弹。被消灭后，吼龙果可以分裂为 3 株稍微小一些的植物。

{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}在暗影状态下，子弹可以让僵尸中毒。

DRAGONBRUIT_DESCRIPTION_HINT.en: Properly placed your Dragon Bruit and can attack zombies across 3 adjacent lanes.
DRAGONBRUIT_DESCRIPTION_HINT.zh: 把吼龙果放在合适的地方，可以攻击附近 3 行的僵尸。

DRAGONBRUIT_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Launches projectiles at every zombie on the lawn. Can be boosted by Shadow Aura.
DRAGONBRUIT_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}向草坪上的每只僵尸发射子弹。可以通过暗影光环强化。

DRAGONBRUIT_TOOLTIP.zh: 向 3 行投掷 3 枚子弹。

DUCKPEAR_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Special:
{STAT}The chance to sweep zombies away increases as the target's remaining health percentage decreases.
{STAT}The probability is halved for massive zombies and machines. Bosses are immune.
{FLAVOR}Duck Pear placed highly in the 'Cutest Plant' competition thanks to his signature move, 'Turbo-Quack'.
DUCKPEAR_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：
{STAT}水球卷走僵尸的概率随目标僵尸的剩余生命值百分比的变化而变化，剩余生命值百分比越低，僵尸被卷走的概率越高。
{STAT}大体型僵尸和机甲僵尸被卷走的概率减半，僵尸博士无法被卷走。
{FLAVOR}鸭梨靠着成名绝技“涡轮增鸭”在植物卖萌大赛上获得了不错的成绩。

DUCKPEAR_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Charges up to spit water orbs at zombies. Has a chance to release a larger orb that sweeps them away.
DUCKPEAR_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 蓄力后吐出水球攻击僵尸，有概率吐出更大水球卷走僵尸。

DUCKPEAR_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Spits a powerful viscous water orb with a higher chance to sweep zombies away.
DUCKPEAR_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}喷出更强大的粘液水球，有更高的概率卷走僵尸。

DUCKPEAR_TOOLTIP.en: Charges up to attack. Chance to sweep zombies away.
DUCKPEAR_TOOLTIP.zh: 蓄力后吐出水球攻击僵尸，有概率吐出更大水球卷走僵尸

DUSKLOBBER_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Lobbing comes easily to Dusk Lobber, but that's only because she's had extensive training and really enjoys parabolas.
DUSKLOBBER_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}暗影强化后的幽暮投手可以向邻近三行内投射花蕾

{FLAVOR}幽暮投手似乎天生就对投掷这门技艺如鱼得水，其实那不过是她刻苦训练和对抛物线的无尽热爱所铸就的成果。

DUSKLOBBER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Dusk Lobbers are shadow plants that lob explosive buds down the lane. When powered Dusk Lobbers can lob buds down 3 lanes.
DUSKLOBBER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 幽暮投手是暗影植物，它们向本行的目标投掷可以爆炸的花蕾。

DUSKLOBBER_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Shoots multiple large buds that explode on impact.
DUSKLOBBER_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}发射多颗大号的花蕾，在僵尸接触时爆炸。

EA_AQUA_VINE_LEVELUP.zh: 绿水藤蔓抢先体验升级

EA_AQUA_VINE_UNLOCK.zh: 绿水藤蔓抢先体验解锁

EA_SQUARED_NO_ADS_AVAILABLE.zh: 抱歉，现在还没有广告。请稍候再试。

EA_SQUARED_SPROUT_AWARD_BODY.en: Watch an ad when available to earn sprouts!

EA_SQUARED_TICKETS_AWARD_HEADER.zh: 你得到了一个免费腕票

EA_SWEETHEARTSNARE_LEVELUP.en: Sweetheart Snare Early Access Level Up
EA_SWEETHEARTSNARE_LEVELUP.zh: 甜心陷阱丛抢先体验升级

EA_SWEETHEARTSNARE_UNLOCK.zh: 甜心陷阱丛抢先体验解锁

EA_ZNAKELILY_LEVELUP.en: Znake Lily Early Access Level Up
EA_ZNAKELILY_LEVELUP.zh: 尸讹百合抢先体验升级

EA_ZNAKELILY_UNLOCK.zh: 尸讹百合抢先体验解锁

ELDERBARRIER_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}blocks Cuju balls kicked by Cuju Star Zombie
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}heals other plants after taking damage while defending, slowly regenerates its own health based on the number of surrounding plants when idle
{FLAVOR}After losing the Rattle-drum Championship to Plummet and taking second place, Elderbarrier began practicing intensely. Unfortunately, he was recently arrested by Jinyiwei Peashooter for disturbing the peace with late-night noise.
ELDERBARRIER_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}可以抵挡来自蹴鞠明星僵尸的蹴鞠。
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}在防御状态下受到一定伤害后会为其他植物恢复生命值，在闲置状态下根据周围植物数量缓慢恢复自身生命值。
{FLAVOR}接骨木果在摇拨浪鼓决赛上输给了重垂李子拿了第二名之后，接骨木果开始苦练摇拨浪鼓，现在因半夜制造噪音扰民被锦衣卫豌豆射手带走。

ELDERBARRIER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Elderbarriers heal nearby plants and themselves.
ELDERBARRIER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 为附近植物提供治疗并缓慢恢复自身生命值。

ELDERBARRIER_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Heals itself and gains a hard armor shell.

ELDERBARRIER_TOOLTIP.en: Blocks off zombies and heals nearby plants
ELDERBARRIER_TOOLTIP.zh: 为附近植物提供治疗并缓慢恢复自身生命值

ELECTRICBLUEBERRY_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Electric Blueberry prides herself on being eclectic as well as electric. "I like to keep 'em guessing," she says. "A zombie should always be like, 'Whoa, didn't see that coming,' when it's disintegrated."
ELECTRICBLUEBERRY_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}电击蓝莓对自己的电击力量感到非常自豪。“我可喜欢让它们一直提心吊胆了，”她说道。“当僵尸变成灰烬的时候，它们应该总会想‘哇，我都没看到那个过来诶。’”

ELECTRICBLUEBERRY_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Electric Blueberries randomly electrocute zombies every so often.
ELECTRICBLUEBERRY_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 电击蓝莓可以频繁地给予任意一只僵尸电刑。

ELECTRICBLUEBERRY_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Creates a storm cloud that targets 3 random zombies, dealing damage.
ELECTRICBLUEBERRY_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}创造一朵随机锁定 3 只僵尸的风暴雷云，造成伤害。

ELECTRICBLUEBERRY_TOOLTIP.zh: 随机地给予某只僵尸电刑

ELECTRICCURRANT_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}"Electricity is all very well and fine as a phenomenon," says Electric Currant, "but electromagnetism as a whole is where it's really at."
ELECTRICCURRANT_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}使用：{STAT}区域效果（电网）
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}激活时可以将僵尸击退到邻路

{FLAVOR}“电真是种非常好的现象，”电流醋栗说，“但是电磁这一整体才是它真正所处的位置。”

ELECTRICCURRANT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Electric Currants create electrical fences between ones planted on the same row or column.
ELECTRICCURRANT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 电流醋栗能和同一排或同一列的电流醋栗连接并形成电网。

ELECTRICCURRANT_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Permanently increase its electric fence and melee damage.
ELECTRICCURRANT_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}永久提升它的电网和近战伤害。

ELECTRICCURRANT_TOOLTIP.zh: 与其他电流醋栗连接，制造电网

ELECTRICITEA1_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}"I want to be eaten. I NEED to be eaten," says Electrici-tea. "However, I am perfectly content to fry nearby zombies in the meantime."
ELECTRICITEA1_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}“我想要被吃掉，我也需要被吃掉。”电力绿茶说。“不过，我很乐意在这段时间里尽情地电击僵尸。”

ELECTRICITEA1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Electrici-teas wait and emit zaps of electrical energy until they are eaten, at which point the eating zombies explode in a flurry of electrical discharges.
ELECTRICITEA1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 等僵尸把它吃掉后，电力绿茶会释放出一阵雷云电死吃掉它的僵尸。

ELECTRICITEA1_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Shoots lightning bolts at random zombies on the lawn for 3 seconds, dealing large amount of damage.
ELECTRICITEA1_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}随机向草坪上的僵尸发射电束，持续 3 秒，造成大量伤害。

ELECTRICITEA1_TOOLTIP.zh: 电击附近僵尸，被吃掉后爆炸

ELECTRICITEA_DESCRIPTION.en: Eggplant Ninja loves darts. His mission is to attack zombies who want to harm Dave.
ELECTRICITEA_DESCRIPTION.zh: 茄子忍者酷爱飞镖。 他的使命是攻打那些想伤害戴夫的僵尸。

ELECTRICITEA_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 发射高伤害的飞镖攻击 5 只僵尸

ELECTRICITEA_TOOLTIP.zh: 发射高伤害的飞镖攻击 5 只僵尸

ELECTRICPEASHOOTER_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Don't be surprised by Anthurium's ability to neutralize positive and negative charge, just look at the brothers' physics exam papers with full marks and you will understand. Yet, they could never understand each other's thoughts, such as which color of tie to wear; whether to watch a documentary or a TV show; and whether to go to an Indian restaurant or a Chinese restaurant for a date. Though, they know that without each other, neither could be a talent in wielding lightning.
ELECTRICPEASHOOTER_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}电离红掌期望着电阻，但他不想用电阻碍任何人。

ELECTRICPEASHOOTER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Anthurium can shoot electric balls that pass through zombies and crackle with electrical power, doing damage all the while.
ELECTRICPEASHOOTER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 电离红掌可以发射电球穿过群僵并分岔出噼啪作响的球状闪电，对周围的个体造成持续性伤害

ELECTRICPEEL_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Electric Peel is calm and composed, it will not let anyone come near its Peel, for good reasons. Turns out it is protecting those around it from the peel. When asked, Electric Peel said, "Don't touch my Peel, you won’t like what happens next!", in a cautious tone, while emitting a buzzing electric sound.
ELECTRICPEEL_DESCRIPTION.zh: 电能蕉皮沉着、冷静，它从不让别人靠近自己闪烁着电弧的“皮”，而背后的原因却令人暖心。事实证明，它只是想保护周围的人不被自己的“皮”伤害到。每每有人问起，电能蕉皮都会说：“别碰我的皮，否则后果自负！”，它语气慎重，每个字都流露出电流嗡嗡的声音。

ELECTRICPEEL_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en:
An amphibious plant which spawns a Peel that slithers down the lane to attack zombies and returns back, dealing damage again to all zombies on its way back.

{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}When planted on water, its damage is increased. The Peel applies an Electrifying Condition to the tiles it travels on.

{KEYWORD}Electrified Condition: {STAT}Electrified Zombies take damage over time as long as they occupy the tiles that have been Electrified.
ELECTRICPEEL_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh:
一株可以生成“蕉流电鳗”的两栖植物，“蕉流电鳗”可以向前滑入所在行攻击僵尸，随后返回，返回途中可以对路上的所有僵尸再造成一次伤害。

{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}种植在水上时，伤害增加。“蕉流电鳗”可以让它所经过的地砖通电。

{KEYWORD}通电状态：{STAT}获得通电状态的僵尸在经过通电的地砖时，会随着时间的推移受到伤害。

ELECTRICPEEL_DESCRIPTION_HINT.en: Electric Peel gets boosted damage on water tiles and applies DOT damage on tiles.
ELECTRICPEEL_DESCRIPTION_HINT.zh: 电能蕉皮在水上可以得到强化，并对水流施加带有持续伤害效果的电流。

ELECTRICPEEL_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Releases a giant Super Peel down the lane to deal massive damage to all zombies in its path.
ELECTRICPEEL_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}向所在行释放一只巨型的“超级蕉流电鳗”，对路径上的所有僵尸造成大量伤害。

ELECTRICPEEL_TOOLTIP.en: Spawns a peel that slithers along the lane to attack zombies.
ELECTRICPEEL_TOOLTIP.zh: 发射蕉皮，电击路径上的僵尸。

ELEMENT_7_WAVEMASSAGE.en: The resentment of the dead makes you tremble!
ELEMENT_7_WAVEMASSAGE.zh: 亡魂的怨念令你们震颤！

ELEMENT_LEVEL_NAME.zh: 元素！很奇妙吧？ - 第 {LEVEL_NUMBER} 关

EMPEA_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Has grown tired of people lazily calling him E.M. Pea. "There's a C and H there for a reason people! And I've got the stone to prove it!"
EMPEA_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}使用：{STAT}一次性使用，立即生效
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}使机器失灵

{FLAVOR}他已经厌烦大家管他叫电磁麦了。“明明还有个桃字好不好！我是桃子，不是麦子，我可以用我的果核证明的！”

EMPEA_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: E.M.Peaches explode and disable all machines in an area.
EMPEA_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 电磁脉冲桃可以爆炸，让一片区域内的机器全部失效。

EMPEA_TOOLTIP.en: Disables all machines in an area
EMPEA_TOOLTIP.zh: 使一片区域内所有机器失灵

EMPOWERMINT_AILMINT_LEVELUP_DESC.en: Test how a max-level Ail-mint can super-boost poisonous plants!
EMPOWERMINT_AILMINT_LEVELUP_DESC.zh: 看看最高等级的疾病薄荷是如何大幅加强毒性植物的吧！

ENCHANTMINT_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Use: 
{STAT}Single use, instant

{FLAVOR}"Dude, dude, get up to see God! " Coffee Bean likes to use this quote of his favorite movie lines to wake people up. To be honest, this method is quite effective. At least every time when his friends open their eyes they will see a figure of a person with wings.
ENCHANTMINT_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}使用：{STAT}一次性使用，立即生效

{FLAVOR}“嘿，伙计们，嘿！”咖啡豆说道。“嘿！怎么了呀？那是谁啊？嘿，你见到那东西了没？什么东西？哇哦！是狮子哦！”没错，咖啡豆真的变得很兴奋呢。

ENCHANTMINT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Use Coffee Beans to get 2 Plant Foods
ENCHANTMINT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 使用咖啡豆可获得两份叶绿素。

ENCHANTMINT_TOOLTIP.en: Creates two Plant Foods for use
ENCHANTMINT_TOOLTIP.zh: 种植咖啡豆可获得两份叶绿素

ENDURIAN_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}"When other plants talk about me, they say I’m too gruff. They say I’m difficult to approach, that I’m afraid to let others get too close to me. Also, I smell terrible," said Endurian. But deep down inside, he knows that he’s so much more than that. He’s also short-tempered.
ENDURIAN_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}榴莲说：“其它植物在议论我的时候，老是说我很粗暴。还说我很难亲近，一离我太近我就会不高兴。对了，他们还说我身上老是有股异味。” 但其实在内心深处，他很清楚那些肤浅的家伙说的根本不是真正的自己。实际上，他不仅有以上的所有缺点，脾气还很倔。

ENDURIAN_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Endurians are defensive plants that deal damage to zombies attacking them.
ENDURIAN_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 榴莲不仅可以作为防御性植物，还可以对攻击他的僵尸造成伤害。

ENDURIAN_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Heals itself and permanently gains additional armor and damage.
ENDURIAN_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}治疗自己，永久获得一副更坚硬、伤害更高的盔甲。

ENDURIAN_TOOLTIP.en: Defends while dealing damage to zombies attacking it.
ENDURIAN_TOOLTIP.zh: 阻碍攻击他的僵尸并对其造成伤害。

ENFORCEMINT_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Snow Lotus comes from the snow-capped mountains of the Plantagenet Kingdom. She made weapons out of ice and became the unparalleled swordsman of the House of Plantagenet under the guidance of the swordsman Lily. "Everything is cute!" This is the slogan of Snow Lotus! She will freeze everything with her sword light!

Voicelines:
听，那冰封的歌！ (Listen, to the frozen song!)
试炼的终点是花开万里！ (The end of the trial is a blooming flower for thousands of miles!)
ENFORCEMINT_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}冰刃雪莲来自金雀花王国的雪山之上，她用冰制作了武器，在剑客莉莉的教导下成为了金雀花王朝举世无双的剑客。万物可爱！这是冰刃雪莲的口号！她将用她的剑光冻结一切！

配音文案：
听，那冰封的歌！
试炼的终点是花开万里！

ENFORCEMINT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Fire ice blades that freeze zombies.
ENFORCEMINT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 冰刃雪莲能发射冻结僵尸的冰刃。

ENFORCEMINT_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}在短时间内持续发射一大堆冰刃伤害并冻结僵尸

ENLIGHTENMINT1_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Enlighten-mint wants to stress that while "enlightenment" is properly understood as "full comprehension of a situation," she herself frequently likes to ask follow-up questions just to be sure.
ENLIGHTENMINT1_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}启明薄荷家族植物：
{STAT}原始向日葵
{STAT}阳光番茄
{STAT}阳光豆
{STAT}向日葵
{STAT}阳光蘑菇
{STAT}蟾蜍毒菌
{STAT}双子向日葵

{FLAVOR}启明薄荷想要强调一下，虽然“启明”的正确意思应该是“对某种情况的充分理解”，但她自己可能有时候也不太能完全清楚未来的事情。

ENLIGHTENMINT1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Enlighten-mints give a burst of sun when planted, and provide an additional temporary boost to Enlighten-mint Family plants.
ENLIGHTENMINT1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 启明薄荷在种下时会给予你一大堆阳光，并暂时加强草坪上所有的启明薄荷家族植物。

ENLIGHTENMINT_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Whenever you call him "Bruce Lee" in front of Bruce Bamboo, he will always be very angry because his last name is "Bamboo"!
ENLIGHTENMINT_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}每当你在竹小龙面前叫他“李小龙”的时候，他总会非常生气，因为他姓“竹”！

ENLIGHTENMINT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 快速抽打前方一个格子的僵尸并携带减速效果。

ESCAPEROOT1_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}The other plants put on a big surprise party for Escape Root last week, but he did his thing and suddenly it was a surprise party... FOR THEM!
ESCAPEROOT1_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}上周，其他植物给逃脱树根举办了一场盛大的惊喜派对，但是他却在忙自己的事。这下被惊喜的反而是他们自己了。

ESCAPEROOT1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Escape Roots explode on contact, and can be swapped with other plants that are in danger.
ESCAPEROOT1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 逃脱树根会在接触时爆炸，还可以与处于危险中的植物交换位置。

ESCAPEROOT1_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Creates 2 copies of itself, one at a time, next to a zombie and transform into a random Bombard-mint plant.
ESCAPEROOT1_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}在僵尸旁边创建两个自己的分身，一次一个，并转化为随机的爆炸类植物。

ESCAPEROOT1_TOOLTIP.en: Explodes and can be swapped with other plants
ESCAPEROOT1_TOOLTIP.zh: 接触后爆炸，可以与其他植物交换位置

ESCAPEROOT_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Cryo-shroom hates winter the most. The reason is that he can’t warm up himself while sleeping during winter. The most horrible thing is that on every morning during this period of time, he’ll see a thick layer of ice in the fireplace. At this moment, he really admires Pyro-shroom, his twin brother.
ESCAPEROOT_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}寒冰菇最讨厌冬天，因为他睡觉的时候根本暖和不起来，最可怕的是每当他早上起床都会看到壁炉里结着厚厚的一层冰棱，这个时候他就会无比羡慕他的同胞兄弟烈焰菇。

ESCAPEROOT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Cryo-shroom grows with the release of his increasingly powerful magic attack in front of the zombies.
ESCAPEROOT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 寒冰菇可以随着自身的成长释放越来越强大的法术攻击前方的僵尸。

ESCAPEROOT_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Summons three ice holes at random positions, dealing continuous ice damage to zombies.
ESCAPEROOT_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}在随机位置召唤三个冰洞，对僵尸造成持续冰属性伤害。

ESCAPEROOT_TOOLTIP.en: As he grows, he can release more and more powerful spells to attack the zombies ahead.
ESCAPEROOT_TOOLTIP.zh: 可以随着自身的成长释放越来越强大的法术攻击前方的僵尸。

EVENTS_HINT_1.en: Level up your plants to improve their stats! Better stats mean stronger plants!
EVENTS_HINT_1.zh: 升级植物以提升属性！更好的属性意味着植物更强！

EVENTS_HINT_2.en: Not all plants work well against all zombies. Try our different combinations!
EVENTS_HINT_2.zh: 根据你要对抗的僵尸合理选择植物！举个例子，玉米投手很适合延缓僵尸的进攻速度！

EVENTS_HINT_3.en: Don’t forget to use Plant Food!!! They can help you turn the tide of battle.
EVENTS_HINT_3.zh: 根据你要对抗的僵尸合理选择植物！举个例子，坚果墙后的火龙草可以同时伤害到 3 条路！

EVENTS_HINT_4.en: Some plants prefer certain areas in the lawn. Try different placements to see which one works best for you.
EVENTS_HINT_4.zh: 有些植物更适合在草坪上的特定位置作战。试着调整一下你的布阵，看看怎样放置效果最好。

EVENT_CALENDAR_MGPWINTER.zh: 超级机枪豌豆的冬日大冒险

EVENT_NAME_FEASTIVUS_1.zh: 仲冬圣诞 - 霜之前奏

EVENT_NAME_FEASTIVUS_2.zh: 仲冬圣诞 - 霜之终曲

EVENT_PREMIUM_PINATA_2_DESC.zh: 仲冬圣诞高级彩陶特惠

EVILSHROOM_SPEED_DESCRIPTION.en: {KEYWORD}Bamboo Shoot learned a Kongfu technique of instantly burrowing into the ground from Tuxing Sun, and, along with his deep determination, he finally obtained his bachelor degree from Drill Engineering College.
EVILSHROOM_SPEED_DESCRIPTION.zh: {KEYWORD}竹笋从土行孙那里习得土遁功夫，又经过不懈努力，终于获得“钻头工程学院”学士称号。

EVILSHROOM_SPEED_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Moves back and forth through the ground, damaging zombies that step on it for twice.
EVILSHROOM_SPEED_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 在地底移动，并对上方的僵尸造成穿刺伤害。

EVILSHROOM_SPEED_TOOLTIP.en: Damaging zombies that step on it for twice
EVILSHROOM_SPEED_TOOLTIP.zh: 在地面上来回移动，对经过的僵尸造成两次伤害

EVILSHROOM_TOUGHNESS_DESCRIPTION.en: {KEYWORD}Wildflower comes from the TAT (Travel Around Time) series produced by 窝窝头Runkeben. He understands the significance of this cross-dimensional journey. Yes, his existence is meant to defeat zombies.
EVILSHROOM_TOUGHNESS_DESCRIPTION.zh: {KEYWORD}野花来自窝头制作的TAT系列，他明白这次跨维度穿越的意义。嗯，是的，他的存在就是为了消灭僵尸。

EVILSHROOM_TOUGHNESS_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Wildflower has a chance to launch flower buds that can stun zombies.
EVILSHROOM_TOUGHNESS_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 野花有概率发射能眩晕僵尸的花苞。

EXIT_DANGER_ROOM_BODY.en: Are you sure that you want to leave? Doing so will end your game.
EXIT_DANGER_ROOM_BODY.zh: 你确定要离开吗？这样将会结束游戏。

EXORCISLILY_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}attacks have a chance to shrink zombies
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}spirit plants, enhanced attacks can produce area flames

{FLAVOR}Exorcist Lily always says he is a serious calligrapher, but zombies don't care about his brushwork—they just find it hard to open their eyes when these yellow papers are pasted on their foreheads.
EXORCISLILY_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特点：{STAT}攻击有概率缩小僵尸
{KEYWORD}特点：{STAT}灵界植物，强化后攻击可以产生范围火焰

{FLAVOR}钟馗石蒜总说自己是个严肃的书法家，但僵尸们根本不关心他的笔锋——他们只觉得这些黄纸贴在脑门上的时候，烧得眼睛有点睁不开。

EXORCISLILY_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Launches charms to attack normal and spirit zombies.
EXORCISLILY_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 发射符咒攻击正常僵尸与灵体僵尸。

EXORCISLILY_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Launches charms to attack zombies, causing electric damage.
EXORCISLILY_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}对僵尸发射符咒，造成雷电攻击。

EXPLODEONUT1_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}"My only regret," says Explode-O-Nut, "is that I have but one chewy center full of nitroglycerine to give in defense of this lawn."
EXPLODEONUT1_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}“我唯一后悔的事，”爆炸坚果说，“就是我只有一颗充满硝化甘油的耐嚼核心能奉献给这片草坪的防御。”

EXPLODEONUT1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Explode-O-Nuts provide protection, and when their shells are eaten, they explode to blow up zombies.
EXPLODEONUT1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 爆炸坚果可以保护他身后的植物，而在外壳被吃掉之后，还能炸飞僵尸。

EXPLODEONUT1_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Heals itself and gains an armor that will absorbs additional damage. If the armor is destroyed, unleashes a large explosion.
EXPLODEONUT1_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}治疗自身并获得一件盔甲，该盔甲将吸收额外的伤害。如果装甲被摧毁，就会引发大爆炸。

EXPLODEONUT_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Cheese Strawberry was interviewed by a reporter called Charlotte, "What do you think of Rebbit’s post saying, ‘I really want to eat strawberries. Recently, I’ve been feeling nauseous about eating, and vomiting on Skibi-toilet because of my illness, and I really, really want to eat strawberries…but strawberries are too expensive.’" Cheese Strawberry replied, "I only buy strawberry from Ohio, those are the cheapest and the best!"
EXPLODEONUT_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}芝芝莓莓接受采访时，记者问到：“你如何看待墨茶发帖‘我老想吃草莓了。最近被病折磨的吃什么吐什么，然后特别特别想吃草莓。。。可惜草莓太贵了。’”芝芝莓莓回答道：“注意你的米线，不是完美的我不吃！”

EXPLODEONUT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: The cheese thrown by Cheese Strawberry can make zombies feel nauseated and reduce their eating speed and damage per second.
EXPLODEONUT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 芝芝莓莓扔出的奶酪可以让僵尸感到反胃从而降低其每秒啃食速度。

EXPLODEONUT_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Throws cheese to all the zombies on the field.

EXPLODEONUT_TOOLTIP.en: Make zombies nauseated and slows down their eating speed and damage
EXPLODEONUT_TOOLTIP.zh: 让僵尸反胃并降低啃食速度

EXPLODEOVINE1_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Explode-O-Vine is sooooooooooooooo ready to explode. Just ridiculously ready. He's got the color picked out and everything.
EXPLODEOVINE1_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}爆炸藤蔓已经全副武装——完完全全——彻头彻尾准备好去爆炸了。准备的程度好到离谱。他已经选好了颜色，准备好了一切。

EXPLODEOVINE1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Explode-O-Vines detonate an explosion with knockback when planted, and then a larger explosion when eaten.
EXPLODEOVINE1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 爆炸藤蔓可以在种下时发生爆炸并产生击退效果，被吃掉后还会产生更大的爆炸。

EXPLODEOVINE1_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Explode dealing damage to nearby zombies and gain armor. If the armor is destroyed, the armor explode.
EXPLODEOVINE1_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}对附近僵尸造成爆炸伤害，并获得一副盔甲。盔甲被摧毁时，可以产生大爆炸。

EXPLODEOVINE_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Pyro-shroom hates summer the most. The reason is that it's so hot that he sweats too much during his summer wizardry practices. The more unlucky thing is that the air conditioner at his home often breaks down because of the high temperature. Every time this happens he starts to admire Cryo-shroom, his twin brother.
EXPLODEOVINE_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}烈焰菇最讨厌夏天，因为他练习法术的时候会因为太热而流太多的汗。更倒霉的是他家的空调老因为温度太高而坏掉，每当此时他就会无比羡慕他的同胞兄弟寒冰菇。

EXPLODEOVINE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Pyro-shroom can release more and more powerful spells to attack the zombies in front as it grows.
EXPLODEOVINE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 烈焰菇可以随着自身的成长释放越来越强大的法术攻击前方的僵尸。

EXPLODEOVINE_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Summons a line of firewalls to continuously attack zombies.
EXPLODEOVINE_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}召唤一列火墙，持续攻击僵尸。

EXPLODEOVINE_TOOLTIP.en: Grow and deal more damage over time.
EXPLODEOVINE_TOOLTIP.zh: 可以随着自身的成长释放越来越强大的法术攻击前方的僵尸。

FAIRYMUSHROOM_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Special: Initial cooldown is 30 seconds. Only one fairy mushroom can be planted in a battle.

{FLAVOR}Fairy Mushroom comes from PvZ 3 pre-2021 version. She is bad if none is protecting her and vice versa.
FAIRYMUSHROOM_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}初始冷却30秒，一场战斗中只能种植一株仙女菇。

{FLAVOR}仙女菇来自PvZ 3测试版本，比较娇弱，体力不足，容易被僵尸啃食，但有护卫保护她的时候非常强大。

FAIRYMUSHROOM_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Fairy mushrooms can intermittently emit poisonous gas that continuously harm zombies in a 5x5 area.
FAIRYMUSHROOM_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 仙女菇可以间歇向 5x5 范围发出持续掉血的毒气。

FAIRYMUSHROOM_TOOLTIP.en: Continuously slow attack on zombies within 5x5 range

FEASTIVUS_QUEST_DESC_FEASTIVUS_2B.en: Defeat Treasure Yetis to win 150 Feastivus plant seed packets!
FEASTIVUS_QUEST_DESC_FEASTIVUS_2B.zh: 仲冬圣诞节日庆典怎么来了这么多宝藏雪人？击败他们，赢取 150 包节日庆典植物种子！

FEASTIVUS_QUEST_DESC_FEASTIVUS_3A.en: Treasure Yetis are overrunning Feastivus! Defeat them to win a large Feastivus piñata!
FEASTIVUS_QUEST_DESC_FEASTIVUS_3A.zh: 仲冬圣诞节日庆典怎么来了这么多宝藏雪人？击败他们，赢取大份的节日庆典彩陶！

FEASTIVUS_QUEST_DESC_FEASTIVUS_3B.en: Defeat Treasure Yetis to win 200 Feastivus plant seed packets!
FEASTIVUS_QUEST_DESC_FEASTIVUS_3B.zh: 仲冬圣诞节日庆典怎么来了这么多宝藏雪人？击败他们，赢取 200 包节日庆典植物种子！

FEASTIVUS_QUEST_DESC_FEASTIVUS_4A.en: Treasure Yetis are overrunning Feastivus! Defeat them to win an extra large Feastivus piñata!
FEASTIVUS_QUEST_DESC_FEASTIVUS_4A.zh: 仲冬圣诞节日庆典怎么来了这么多宝藏雪人？击败他们，赢取超大份的节日庆典彩陶！

FEATURE_JOUST_UNLOCK_PROMPT_DESCRIPTION.en: Complete Pirate Seas Day 12 for Arena

FEATURE_PINATA_HUNT_SLOT1_DESCRIPTION.en: Get an additional piñata tracker slot!
FEATURE_PINATA_HUNT_SLOT1_DESCRIPTION.zh: 额外获得一个彩陶追踪槽！

FEATURE_PINATA_HUNT_SLOT2_DESCRIPTION.en: Get an additional additional piñata tracker slot!
