FILAMINT_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}A bolt of lightning cuts through the silent night sky, accompanied by the cheers of all plants. Tomorrow's Superstar descends onto the battlefield! "Keep up with my rhythm, let's put on a splendid show!" said Tomorrow's Superstar.
FILAMINT_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}全场增益

{FLAVOR}一道闪电划破寂静的夜空，伴随着所有植物的欢呼声，明日巨星降临战场！“跟上我的节奏，华丽地干一场吧！”明日巨星说。

FILAMINT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Tomorrow's Superstar inflates a balloon, and after the balloon explodes, the inspiring word "FIGHTING" appears, providing a boost to all of the plants on the lawn for over thirty seconds.
FILAMINT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 明日巨星吹起一个气球，气球爆炸后出现鼓舞斗志的“FIGHTING”字样，为所有植物提供三十秒属性增益。

FINISH_BEACH_05_DESC.en: Finish Day 5 at the Big Wave Beach
FINISH_BEACH_05_DESC.zh: 在巨浪海滩完成第 5 天

FINISH_BEACH_05_TITLE.zh: 完成巨浪海滩第 5 天！

FINISH_BEACH_11_DESC.en: Bowling Bulb rolls bulbs down rows to bop, bounce and bash multiple zombies!

FINISH_BEACH_16_DESC.en: Abolish the atrocious Gargantuar of Big Wave Beach!

FINISH_BEACH_19_DESC.en: Guacodile shoots, swims, and charges forward on defeat! REVENGE!
FINISH_BEACH_19_DESC.zh: 鳄梨可以发射，可以游泳，就算被击败了，也可以冲向僵尸复仇！

FINISH_BEACH_1_DESC.en: It's no day at the beach without Lily Pads! They let you plant on water!
FINISH_BEACH_1_DESC.zh: 在海滩，怎么能没有睡莲叶呢？毕竟有了它们，你才能种植物在水面上！

FINISH_BEACH_20_DESC.en: TIKI-TORCHER! Paste perennial partying zombies and earn rewards in this beachside bash!
FINISH_BEACH_20_DESC.zh: 在这场海滨狂欢上黏住僵尸，获得奖励！

FINISH_BEACH_27_DESC.en: Banana Launcher dispenses justice by launching missiles anywhere on the board!

FINISH_BEACH_32_DESC.en: Quash the querulous Dr. Zomboss in this surfing struggle of Big Wave Beach
FINISH_BEACH_32_DESC.zh: 击败狡猾的僵王博士，完成巨浪海滩中的这场热情似火的战斗

FINISH_BEACH_6_DESC.en: Run silent, run deep. Tangle Kelp drags marine zombies to a watery grave!
FINISH_BEACH_6_DESC.zh: 越走，越深。缠绕水草可以把僵尸拖进水汪汪的坟墓里！

FINISH_CHINESEGARDEN_12_DESC.en: Finish Day 12 in the Chinese Garden
FINISH_CHINESEGARDEN_12_DESC.zh: 在中国园林抵御第 12 天

FINISH_CHINESEGARDEN_12_TITLE.zh: 抵御中国园林第 12 天！

FINISH_COWBOY_11_DESC.en: Sun Shovel! Get an additional 25% of sun cost back when shoveling up plants!
FINISH_COWBOY_11_DESC.zh: 阳光铲！铲除植物后，可以额外回收那株植物所消耗阳光的 25%！

FINISH_COWBOY_12_DESC.en: Melon-Pult flings heavy damage melons down a lane, hitting groups of zombies!
FINISH_COWBOY_12_DESC.zh: 西瓜投手可以扔出伤害极高的西瓜，重击一群僵尸！

FINISH_COWBOY_15_DESC.en: Wall Nut Aid: Fully repair damaged defensive plants by planting on top of them!
FINISH_COWBOY_15_DESC.zh: 坚果包扎术：在被损坏的防御类植物身上再种一次，就能治愈它！

FINISH_COWBOY_18_DESC.en: Tall-Nut totally frustrates flying and hopping zombies! Serves 'em right!
FINISH_COWBOY_18_DESC.zh: 高坚果能轻松阻挡飞行和跳跃僵尸！好好招待他们吧！

FINISH_COWBOY_1_DESC.en: Sneaky zombies creeping up from behind? Split Pea shoots forward AND back!
FINISH_COWBOY_1_DESC.zh: 鬼鬼祟祟的僵尸想从你的后面背刺？裂夹豌豆可以向前后同时射击！

FINISH_COWBOY_20_DESC.en: Instant Recharge: refresh a seed packet by dragging and dropping Plant Food on it!
FINISH_COWBOY_20_DESC.zh: 即刻冷却：把叶绿素拖到种子包上就能立即完成冷却！

FINISH_COWBOY_24_DESC.en: Winter-Melon hits groups of zombies, deals heavy damage AND chills them out!
FINISH_COWBOY_24_DESC.zh: 攻击一群僵尸，造成巨大伤害，还能让它们受到冷缓效果！

FINISH_COWBOY_25_DESC.en: Attack the awful Dr. Zomboss in this desert duel of Wild West
FINISH_COWBOY_25_DESC.zh: 击败可怕的僵王博士，完成狂野西部中的这场尘土飞扬的战斗

FINISH_COWBOY_3_DESC.en: BIG BAD BUTTE: Engage endless zombies in this frontier fracas!
FINISH_COWBOY_3_DESC.zh: 大恶战：与无尽的僵尸战斗，在这场边境之争中获得奖励！

FINISH_COWBOY_4_DESC.en: Chili bean destroys a foe and stuns the group behind it!
FINISH_COWBOY_4_DESC.zh: 鬼鬼祟祟的僵尸想从你的后面背刺？裂夹豌豆可以向前后同时射击！

FINISH_COWBOY_6_DESC.en: Pile up Pea Pods for massive firepower!
FINISH_COWBOY_6_DESC.zh: 堆种豌豆荚，获得强大火力！

FINISH_COWBOY_8_DESC.en: Crush the monstrous Gargantuar of Wild West
FINISH_COWBOY_8_DESC.zh: 击败可怕的狂野西部巨人僵尸

FINISH_COWBOY_9_DESC.en: Lightning Reed shocks multiple foes at high speeds and adjacent lanes!
FINISH_COWBOY_9_DESC.zh: 闪电芦苇可以快速攻击多行道路上的多个敌人。用来炸鸡也不错哦！

FINISH_DARK_10_DESC.en: Maul the medieval Gargantuar of Dark Ages
FINISH_DARK_10_DESC.zh: 在复兴时代击败中世纪巨人僵尸！

FINISH_DARK_12_DESC.en: ARTHUR'S CHALLENGE: Punish primitive zombies in a forever feudal feud!
FINISH_DARK_12_DESC.zh: 亚瑟王的挑战：在这无尽的封建社会中获得奖励！完成复兴时代第 12 夜！

FINISH_DARK_15_DESC.en: Ug, metal! So annoying! Attract buckets and helmets away with Magnet Shroom!
FINISH_DARK_15_DESC.zh: 恶，金属！太烦人了！快快用磁力菇把那些铁桶和头盔吸走吧！

FINISH_DARK_1_DESC.en: Cheap lil' Sun-Shrooms emit ever-growing piles of sun! Radiant!
FINISH_DARK_1_DESC.zh: 物超所值的阳光蘑菇能生产越来越多的阳光！光芒四射！

FINISH_DARK_20_DESC.en: Hamper the heinous Dr. Zomboss in this tenth-century titlecard of Dark Ages
FINISH_DARK_20_DESC.zh: 击败凶恶的僵王博士，得到你应得的奖杯，在复兴时代第 20 天完成这场中世纪战斗！

FINISH_DARK_2_DESC.en: How about a quick little shooter that costs ZERO sun? Puff-shroom it is!
FINISH_DARK_2_DESC.zh: 想要一个喷得快还免费的小射手？小喷菇，就是你了！

FINISH_DARK_4_DESC.en: Fume-shroom sprays all zombies in an area. Take that, clumps of zombies!
FINISH_DARK_4_DESC.zh: 大喷菇能在一个区域内向所有的僵尸喷出烟雾。来吧，就算一大群僵尸咱也不怕！完成复兴时代第 4 天！

FINISH_DARK_6_DESC.en: What if zombies spat out sun as they took damage? Sun Bean makes it happen!
FINISH_DARK_6_DESC.zh: 如果僵尸在受到伤害时可以为你生产阳光会如何？阳光豆让你梦想成真！完成复兴时代第 6 天！

FINISH_DINO_16_DESC.en: Annihilate the antediluvian Gargantuars of Jurassic Marsh
FINISH_DINO_16_DESC.zh: 在侏罗纪沼泽第 16 天沼泽击败原始的巨人僵尸！

FINISH_DINO_17_DESC.en: Primal Sunflowers emit big, big suns!
FINISH_DINO_17_DESC.zh: 原始向日葵可以生产更大——超大的阳光！完成侏罗纪沼泽第 17 天！

FINISH_DINO_1_DESC.en: Primal Peashooters sling serious smack with heavy, stunning peas!
FINISH_DINO_1_DESC.zh: 原始豌豆射手可以发射沉重的，还能打晕僵尸的豌豆！完成侏罗纪沼泽第 1 天！

FINISH_DINO_20_DESC.en: LA BRAINSA TARPITS: Face dinosaurs and prehistoric zombies in this bygone battle!
FINISH_DINO_20_DESC.zh: 脑子焦油坑：在这场年代久远的战斗中面对恐龙和史前僵尸！

FINISH_DINO_23_DESC.en: Blast zombies with starchy goodness, courtesy of the Primal Potato Mine!
FINISH_DINO_23_DESC.zh: 轰炸僵尸，并爆出大量淀粉，这得感谢原始土豆地雷！

FINISH_DINO_32_DESC.en: Frustrate the feverish Dr. Zomboss in the swampy strife of Jurassic Marsh
FINISH_DINO_32_DESC.zh: 击败邪恶的僵王博士，完成侏罗纪沼泽中的这场沼泽池中的纷争！

FINISH_DINO_4_DESC.en: Build up defenses quickly with the fast-planting Primal Wall-nut!
FINISH_DINO_4_DESC.zh: 用冷却极快的原始坚果墙快速建立防御！

FINISH_DINO_8_DESC.en: Charm dinosaurs and sic 'em on the zombies with Perfume-shroom!
FINISH_DINO_8_DESC.zh: 用香水菇魅惑恐龙，让他们与僵尸反目成仇！

FINISH_EGYPT_12_DESC.en: PYRAMID OF DOOM: Bash zombies for rewards in this endless Egyptian survival mode!
FINISH_EGYPT_12_DESC.zh: 厄运金字塔：在无尽的埃及生存模式中，痛击僵尸，获得奖励！

FINISH_EGYPT_13_DESC.en: Bonk Choy: this pugilisitic plant beats zombies up AND backwards!

FINISH_EGYPT_17_DESC.en: Plant Food Slot: Hold onto one more Plant Food during a level! Always handy!
FINISH_EGYPT_17_DESC.zh: 让你可以在关卡中多收集一份叶绿素！

FINISH_EGYPT_19_DESC.en: Why shoot one pea when you can shoot two for twice the firepower with Repeater!
FINISH_EGYPT_19_DESC.zh: 能用双发豌豆喷射两颗豌豆使火力加倍的时候，为什么要只射一颗呢？

FINISH_EGYPT_21_DESC.en: Starting sun boost: Start every level right with 25 extra sun in the bank!
FINISH_EGYPT_21_DESC.zh: 起步阳光增益：与额外 25 点阳光一起，开启每一关的旅程！

FINISH_EGYPT_24_DESC.en: Sun-starved? Twin Sunflowers burp up twice the sun per square!
FINISH_EGYPT_24_DESC.zh: 你缺阳光吗？双子向日葵每次能生产出双倍阳光！

FINISH_EGYPT_25_DESC.en: Defeat the diabolical Dr. Zomboss in this bygone battle of Ancient Egypt
FINISH_EGYPT_25_DESC.zh: 击败恶魔般的僵王博士，完成上古埃及中的这场荒凉的战斗

FINISH_EGYPT_2_DESC.en: Lob cabbages over gravestones for a long-distance surprise! Complete Ancient Egypt Day 2!
FINISH_EGYPT_2_DESC.zh: 投掷卷心菜越过墓碑来让僵尸措手不及！完成上古埃及第 2 天！

FINISH_EGYPT_3_DESC.en: Whip boomerangs through several foes at once for double-dealing damage!
FINISH_EGYPT_3_DESC.zh: 回旋花可以一次性穿刺多只僵尸，并回弹造成双倍伤害！完成上古埃及第 3 天！

FINISH_EGYPT_5_DESC.en: Iceberg Lettuce freezes zombies in their tracks! So cool!
FINISH_EGYPT_5_DESC.zh: 冰冻生菜能在僵尸走的路上冻结他们！那些被冻住的僵尸一定很凉爽！

FINISH_EGYPT_7_DESC.en: Play more Ancient Egypt levels to unlock more plants!
FINISH_EGYPT_7_DESC.zh: 玩更多上古埃及关卡以解锁更多植物！

FINISH_EGYPT_8_DESC.en: Defeat the hideous Gargantuar of Ancient Egypt Day 6 to earn a time-leaping Pirate Seas Key!
FINISH_EGYPT_8_DESC.zh: 在上古埃及第 6 天击败可怕的上古埃及巨人僵尸，赢得海盗港湾钥匙！

FINISH_EGYPT_9_DESC.en: Crumble gravestones instantly with Grave Buster!
FINISH_EGYPT_9_DESC.zh: 用墓碑吞噬者来迅速破坏墓碑吧！

FINISH_EIGHTIES_05_DESC.en: Finish Day 5 in the Neon Mixtape Tour
FINISH_EIGHTIES_05_DESC.zh: 在炫光魔音游完成第 5 天

FINISH_EIGHTIES_05_TITLE.zh: 完成炫光魔音游第 5 天！

FINISH_EIGHTIES_16_DESC.en: Mangle the musical Gargantuar of Neon Mixtape Tour
FINISH_EIGHTIES_16_DESC.zh: 在炫光魔音游击败音乐巨人僵尸

FINISH_EIGHTIES_17_DESC.en: Use Garlic for all your lane-diversion needs!
FINISH_EIGHTIES_17_DESC.zh: 使用大蒜来满足你让僵尸走上另一条道路的愿望吧！

FINISH_EIGHTIES_1_DESC.en: Phat Beet brings the rhythm and doles out damage all around!
FINISH_EIGHTIES_1_DESC.zh: 魔音甜菜能踩着节拍，进行范围伤害！

FINISH_EIGHTIES_20_DESC.en: 80s DANGER ROOM:Rap rhythmic zombies in this melodic mashup!
FINISH_EIGHTIES_20_DESC.zh: 80年代的无尽模式：在这个音乐天堂击败那些走路都带音乐的僵尸！

FINISH_EIGHTIES_20_TITLE.zh: 解锁 80 年代无尽模式！

FINISH_EIGHTIES_21_DESC.zh: 孢子菇是其他蘑菇之母！

FINISH_EIGHTIES_26_DESC.en: Revive eaten plants with the indomitable Intensive Carrot!
FINISH_EIGHTIES_26_DESC.zh: 用医护胡萝卜复活被吃掉的植物吧！

FINISH_EIGHTIES_32_DESC.en: Irritate the irascible Dr. Zomboss in this operatic onslaught of Neon Mixtape Tour
FINISH_EIGHTIES_32_DESC.zh: 击败狂躁的僵王博士，完成炫光魔音游中的这场摇滚巨献

FINISH_EIGHTIES_5_DESC.en: Sneaky Celery Stalker hides underground to pop up and smack zombies from behind!
FINISH_EIGHTIES_5_DESC.zh: 鬼鬼祟祟的潜伏芹菜藏在地底，然后从后方对僵尸发起突然袭击！

FINISH_EIGHTIES_9_DESC.en: Want to rewind zombies back to their starting position? Let's do the Thyme Warp again!
FINISH_EIGHTIES_9_DESC.zh: 想要让僵尸回到原点吗？那就来逆时一次吧！

FINISH_FUTURE_13_DESC.en: Infi-Nut regenerates over time and blocks all rows with Plant Food! Astounding!
FINISH_FUTURE_13_DESC.zh: 全息坚果可以随着时间推移复活。而使用叶绿素后，更可以挡下所有路线的僵尸！太强了吧！

FINISH_FUTURE_17_DESC.en: Fun with Sun! Spend sun on powerful blasts with Magnifying Grass.
FINISH_FUTURE_17_DESC.zh: 阳光，汇聚光芒！花费阳光，用棱镜草汇聚出强力射线吧！

FINISH_FUTURE_1_DESC.en: Laser Bean's gaze pierces all zombies on a lane with each shot! ZAP!
FINISH_FUTURE_1_DESC.zh: 激光豆的锐利眼“光”能穿透一整行的僵尸！咻咻咻！

FINISH_FUTURE_20_DESC.en: Mower Launcher: manually launch one mower by tapping and holding! Clear 'em out!
FINISH_FUTURE_20_DESC.zh: 割草机启动器：按住割草机，手动启动它！横扫僵尸！

FINISH_FUTURE_24_DESC.en: Power Tiles boost your Plant Food effects. Create 'em with Tile Turnip!
FINISH_FUTURE_24_DESC.zh: 能量地砖可以强化你的叶绿素效果。试试用地砖芜菁来创造它们吧！

FINISH_FUTURE_25_DESC.en: Deny the devious Dr. Zomboss in this someday struggle of Far Future
FINISH_FUTURE_25_DESC.zh: 击败狡猾的僵王博士，完成遥远未来中的这场来自未来某一天的战斗

FINISH_FUTURE_3_DESC.en: Use Blover to blow away all airborne enemies on the board in one big WHOOOSH!
FINISH_FUTURE_3_DESC.zh: 三叶草可以“呼”的一声吹走所有飞在空中的敌人！

FINISH_FUTURE_4_DESC.en: TERROR FROM TOMORROW: Tackle technological zombies in an infinite imbroglio!
FINISH_FUTURE_4_DESC.zh: 明日的恐惧：击退全身是高科技武装的僵尸，在这场无尽的未来战争中赢得奖励！

FINISH_FUTURE_6_DESC.en: Citron deals overwhelming damage to one target at a time. Gargantuars beware!
FINISH_FUTURE_6_DESC.zh: 充能柚子可以一次对一个目标造成恐怖的伤害。巨人僵尸？那更不在话下！

FINISH_FUTURE_8_DESC.en: Face the furious Gargantuar of Far Future

FINISH_FUTURE_9_DESC.en: Use E.M.Peach to stun all robotic and mechanical zombies in an area!
FINISH_FUTURE_9_DESC.zh: 使用电磁脉冲桃，眩晕范围内的所有机械与机械类僵尸！

FINISH_ICEAGE_11_DESC.en: Hold the line, or better yet, push 'em back! Chard Guard is on the case.
FINISH_ICEAGE_11_DESC.zh: 谁可以守住防线…甚至把僵尸推开？甜菜护卫精通这行。

FINISH_ICEAGE_16_DESC.en: Attack the abominable Gargantuar of Frostbite Caves
FINISH_ICEAGE_16_DESC.zh: 在极寒冰窟击败可憎的巨人僵尸

FINISH_ICEAGE_19_DESC.en: Need to stun some zombies in place for a while? Stunion is ON IT!
FINISH_ICEAGE_19_DESC.zh: 想把僵尸眩晕在一个地方吗？眩晕洋葱可以办到！

FINISH_ICEAGE_1_DESC.en: Freezing wind got you down? Hot Potato breaks the ice!
FINISH_ICEAGE_1_DESC.zh: 冰窟的寒风让你浑身打颤？用热土豆来融化寒冰吧！

FINISH_ICEAGE_20_DESC.en: ICEBOUND BATTLEGROUND: Fracture frigid zombies in this ongoing glacial gambit!
FINISH_ICEAGE_20_DESC.zh: 冰封战场：在这场无尽的冰野之战中击碎冰冻的僵尸，获得奖励！

FINISH_ICEAGE_26_DESC.en: Rotobaga flies, floats and fires in four fabulous directions!
FINISH_ICEAGE_26_DESC.zh: 旋转芜菁可以飞起来浮在空中，向四个方向发射子弹！

FINISH_ICEAGE_30_DESC.en: Confound the corrupt Dr. Zomboss in this cryogenic conflict of Frostbite Caves
FINISH_ICEAGE_30_DESC.zh: 击败腐败的僵王博士，完成极寒冰窟中的这场严寒中的战斗

FINISH_ICEAGE_6_DESC.en: Fight ice with fire. Pepper-pult melts ice and lobs hot blobs over obstacles!
FINISH_ICEAGE_6_DESC.zh: 以火克冰。辣椒投手可以融化附近的冰，还可以越过障碍投射甜椒！

FINISH_LOSTCITY_10_DESC.en: The best offense is a good defense? Why not both! Endurian blocks AND damages!
FINISH_LOSTCITY_10_DESC.zh: 最好的防御是进攻？那既可以防御又可以进攻岂不美哉？榴莲可以在阻挡僵尸的同时造成伤害！

FINISH_LOSTCITY_16_DESC.en: Dash the dastardly Gargantuar of Lost City
FINISH_LOSTCITY_16_DESC.zh: 在失落之城击败卑鄙的巨人僵尸！

FINISH_LOSTCITY_19_DESC.en: Stallia slows down zombies with a burst of fragrant perfume!
FINISH_LOSTCITY_19_DESC.zh: 大丽菊可以喷发香气，令僵尸减速！

FINISH_LOSTCITY_1_DESC.en: Red Stingers shoot powerfully close to home and become more defensive further away!
FINISH_LOSTCITY_1_DESC.zh: 红针花是一个强大的后排射手，向前移动得越远，防守性就越强！

FINISH_LOSTCITY_20_DESC.en: TEMPLE OF BLOOM: Eradicate zombies in this perpetual party of botanical battle!
FINISH_LOSTCITY_20_DESC.zh: 鲜花神殿：在这场无尽的植物战争中消灭僵尸！

FINISH_LOSTCITY_26_DESC.en: Gold Leaf turns regular boring tiles into exciting sun-generating Gold Tiles!
FINISH_LOSTCITY_26_DESC.zh: 黄金叶可以把平平无奇的地砖变成可以产生阳光的黄金地砖！

FINISH_LOSTCITY_32_DESC.en: Pester the pernicious Dr. Zomboss in the adventurous arena of Lost City
FINISH_LOSTCITY_32_DESC.zh: 击败可恶的僵王博士，完成失落之城中的这场冒险

FINISH_LOSTCITY_6_DESC.en: A.K.E.E. lobs shots that bounce off of several foes down a lane. Heads up!
FINISH_LOSTCITY_6_DESC.zh: 阿开木-木可以投射在多行间穿梭的投掷物。注意头顶！

FINISH_MODERN_10_DESC.en: Poison zombies with the shadowy toxicity of Shadow-shroom!
FINISH_MODERN_10_DESC.zh: 用毒影菇的暗影剧毒令僵尸中毒！

FINISH_MODERN_16_DESC.en: Upbraid the up-to-date Gargantuars of Modern Day
FINISH_MODERN_16_DESC.zh: 在现代年华击败最新的巨人僵尸！

FINISH_MODERN_17_DESC.en: Fling explosive nuggets at hungry zombies with Dusk-Lobber!
FINISH_MODERN_17_DESC.zh: 幽暮投手向饥饿的僵尸投掷可以爆炸的投掷物！

FINISH_MODERN_1_DESC.en: Boost shadow plants with the lunar lunacy of Moonflower!
FINISH_MODERN_1_DESC.zh: 用月光花的月之能量强化暗影植物！

FINISH_MODERN_20_DESC.en: HIGHWAY TO THE DANGER ZONE: Tangle with temporal titans in this neverending nexus!
FINISH_MODERN_20_DESC.zh: 通往无尽的高速：在这无尽的时间交汇点中与僵尸决一死战！

FINISH_MODERN_20_TITLE.en: Unlock Highway to the Danger Zone!
FINISH_MODERN_20_TITLE.zh: 解锁通往无尽的高速路！

FINISH_MODERN_23_DESC.en: Drag zombies to their deserved doom with the Grimrose!
FINISH_MODERN_23_DESC.zh: 用报丧花把僵尸拖入虚空之中！

FINISH_MODERN_34_DESC.en: Defy the devilish Dr. Zomboss in this climactic clash of Modern Day
FINISH_MODERN_34_DESC.zh: 击败邪恶的僵王博士，完成现代年华中的这场高潮迭起的战斗

FINISH_MODERN_4_DESC.en: Deal major slaps with the shadow Nightshade!
FINISH_MODERN_4_DESC.zh: 用夜影龙葵给僵尸当头棒喝！

FINISH_PIRATE_11_DESC.en: BOOM! Clear entire groups of zombies with each explosive shot from Coconut Cannon!
FINISH_PIRATE_11_DESC.zh: 轰！椰子加农炮的每一发炮弹都能消灭一大群僵尸！

FINISH_PIRATE_14_DESC.en: Threepeater shoots down three lanes at once to triple your offensive firepower!
FINISH_PIRATE_14_DESC.zh: 三线豌豆可以一次攻击三条线路，让你的火力乘三！

FINISH_PIRATE_18_DESC.en: Spikeweed: Strong enough to stand up to a Gargantuar, sharp enough to de-feet zombies!
FINISH_PIRATE_18_DESC.zh: 石地刺：强大到能举起巨人僵尸，尖锐到击败僵尸游刃有余！

FINISH_PIRATE_1_DESC.en: Can Kernelpult deal damage AND stun zombies? You'd butter believe it!
FINISH_PIRATE_1_DESC.zh: 玉米投手不仅能定住僵尸，还能造成伤害吗？绝对可以！

FINISH_PIRATE_21_DESC.en: Extra Seed Slot: Carry more plants into the fray! More seed slots mean more options!
FINISH_PIRATE_21_DESC.zh: 额外种子槽：让你可以在关卡中使用更多的植物！种子槽越多，选择越多！

FINISH_PIRATE_24_DESC.en: Cherry Bomb's overwhelming blast fries whole groups of foes across lanes!
FINISH_PIRATE_24_DESC.zh: 樱桃炸弹恐怖的爆炸伤害可以轻松消灭几行内的大量敌人！

FINISH_PIRATE_25_DESC.en: Hammer the hateful Dr. Zomboss in this saltwater scrap of Pirate Seas
FINISH_PIRATE_25_DESC.zh: 击败可恶的僵王博士，完成海盗港湾中的这场海上之战

FINISH_PIRATE_3_DESC.en: Heat things up with Snapdragon's fiery attacks that hit multiple lanes at a time!
FINISH_PIRATE_3_DESC.zh: 用火龙草那可以攻击多条道路的烈焰，让战斗升温吧！

FINISH_PIRATE_4_DESC.en: DEAD MAN'S BOOTY: Endless adventures on the high seas await your command!
FINISH_PIRATE_4_DESC.zh: 逝者的宝藏：一声令下，海上的无尽探险即将启航！

FINISH_PIRATE_6_DESC.en: Damage zombies and bust barrels with the indomitable Spikeweed!
FINISH_PIRATE_6_DESC.zh: 坚强的地刺可以攻击踩在上面的僵尸，甚至是扎破轧在上面的木桶！

FINISH_PIRATE_8_DESC.en: Smash the appalling Gargantuar of Pirate Seas
FINISH_PIRATE_8_DESC.zh: 在海盗港湾击败可怕的巨人僵尸！

FINISH_PIRATE_9_DESC.en: Swashbuckler got you on the ropes? Use Spring Bean to knock 'em back to Davy Jones' locker!
FINISH_PIRATE_9_DESC.zh: 源源不断的海盗让你陷入困境了吗？用弹簧豆把他们弹回戴维·琼斯的储物柜里去吧！

FIREFLY_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}Every attack consumes health equal to a certain proportion of her current health. The lower the current health, the higher the damage dealt. When her current health first falls below a certain proportion of her maximum health, Fireflerry enters the SAM state, increasing her damage dealt and granting damage reduction.

{FLAVOR}In Reddened Chrysalis, I Once Rest,
From Shattered Sky, I Free Fall,
Amidst Silenced Stars, I Deep Sleep.
Upon Lighted Fyrefly, I Soon Gaze,
From Undreamt Night, I Thence Shine,
In Finalized Morrow, I Full Bloom.
FIREFLY_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特点：{STAT}每次攻击会消耗等同于自身当前生命值一定比例的生命值。当前生命值越低，造成的伤害越高。若当前生命值首次低于自身一定比例生命上限，灯萤果进入装甲【萨姆】状态，造成的伤害提高，且获得减伤效果。

{FLAVOR}我曾安眠，赤染之萤，自破碎的天空坠落；沉睡在静默的星河。
我会看见，飞萤之火，自无梦的长夜亮起；绽放在终竟的明天。

FIREFLY_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Fireflerries deal damage equal to a certain proportion of their maximum health to adjacent targets.
FIREFLY_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 灯萤果能对周围造成等同于自身一定比例生命上限的伤害。

FIREFLY_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Enters the Complete Combustion state, further increasing damage dealt and damage reduction, and the damage increase remains at its maximum effect. While in Complete Combustion, damage dealt can pierce armor.
FIREFLY_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}进入【完全燃烧】状态，造成的伤害和减伤效果进一步提高，且伤害提升效果维持最大值。【完全燃烧】状态下造成的伤害可以穿透防具。

FIREPEASHOOTER1_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Fire Peashooter knows that what she does looks exciting. But working with an open flame is serious and, more importantly, dangerous business. That's why, in her spare time, she talks to children about the importance of fire safety. "I'm a trained professional," she explains. "Don't try this at home, kids."
FIREPEASHOOTER1_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}免疫冻结
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}可以温暖附近的植物

{FLAVOR}火焰豌豆射手知道她做的事看上去很刺激。但是与明火共同工作很严肃，更重要的是，这是个非常危险的工作。这就是为什么在她的闲暇时间，她会与孩子谈论消防安全有多么重要。“我是受过专业训练的，”她解释道。“别在家里这么做，孩子。”

FIREPEASHOOTER1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Fire Peashooters are immune to frost and shoot flaming peas down the lane, with 25% shooting plasma peas.
FIREPEASHOOTER1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 火焰豌豆射手可以向所在行发射火焰豌豆，并有25%几率发射等离子豌豆。

FIREPEASHOOTER1_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Creates a fire trail, unfreezing plants and damaging zombies in the row.
FIREPEASHOOTER1_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}引燃所在行的道路，解冻本行植物并烧伤僵尸。

FIREPEASHOOTER1_PLANTFOOD.en: Throws a line of flame down the lane, damaging all zombies in it.
FIREPEASHOOTER1_PLANTFOOD.zh: 沿所在行吐出一行火焰，伤害所有在行内的僵尸。

FIREPEASHOOTER1_TOOLTIP.en: Shoots flaming peas and warms nearby plants
FIREPEASHOOTER1_TOOLTIP.zh: 发射火焰豌豆，并且可以温暖附近的植物

FIREPEASHOOTER_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}The Tulip Trumpeter is the greatest performer. She is good at causing high damage to zombies
FIREPEASHOOTER_DESCRIPTION.zh: 郁金香小号手是最厉害的表演者。她既擅长治疗其他植物，又能对僵尸造成高额伤害

FLATTENEDSHROOM_DESCRIPTION.en:
Usage: single-use
{KEYWORD}Special: blocks a sewer hole

{FLAVOR}Flat-shroom originally wants to quietly bask in the sunlight, but is always used to repair roads. "It's cold down in the sewers." Flat-shroom said.
FLATTENEDSHROOM_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}用法：{STAT}一次性使用

{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}堵住一个下水道洞

{FLAVOR}平顶菇本想安安静静地晒晒阳光，却总是被人拿来修马路。它表示说“下水道下面可冷了”。

FLATTENEDSHROOM_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Flat-shroom can block sewer hole on the ground.
FLATTENEDSHROOM_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 平顶菇可以堵住地面上的下水道洞。

FLATTENEDSHROOM_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Immediately splits at most 3 Flat-shrooms onto uncovered sewers.
FLATTENEDSHROOM_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}立即分裂出至多 3 个平顶菇并飞到空着的井盖上。

FLATTENEDSHROOM_TOOLTIP.en: Blocks steam and zombies when planting on sewers
FLATTENEDSHROOM_TOOLTIP.zh: 种植在井洞上时堵住蒸汽和僵尸

FLICK_PERK_DESCRIPTION.zh: 每 {TIME} 秒让 {NUMBER} 只僵尸飘走！

FLOWERPOT_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Flower Pot must be the most relaxed plant around, there's no need to fight, and the roof is nice and sunny. Yes, as a plant, Flower Pot needs to photosynthesize.
FLOWERPOT_DESCRIPTION.zh: 花盆可以让植物种在无法种植的屋顶和金雀花王朝的法阵上。

FLOWERPOT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Flower Pots allow plants to be planted on rooftops and magic floors in Plantagenet.
FLOWERPOT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 让植物种在无法种植的屋顶和金雀花王朝的法阵上

FLOWERPOT_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Creates Flower Pots in adjacent spaces.
FLOWERPOT_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}在相邻的地方创建花盆。

FLOWERPOT_TOOLTIP.en: Let plants to be planted on rooftops and magic floors
FLOWERPOT_TOOLTIP.zh: 让植物种在无法种植的屋顶和金雀花王朝的法阵上

FORCE_RESTORE_PURCHASES_BODY.en: This item has been purchased before. Restore Purchases will allow you to claim all of your past purchases in any profile.
FORCE_RESTORE_PURCHASES_BODY.zh: 这项商品你之前已经购买过了。你可以通过“恢复购买”功能来为你的所有档案重新获取之前购买的物品。

FORCE_UPDATE_POPUP_HEADER.en: A new version of the game is available

FOREVER_HEROES.zh: 永远的英雄 - 获得猫尾草

FRESHORANGE_EPIC_QUEST.en: PvZ Universe Collaboration Quest: Tangerine Batter
FRESHORANGE_EPIC_QUEST.zh: PvZ Universe联动特殊任务 - 棒打鲜橙

FROSTBONNET_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Dave has set a few rules to maintain order at the house. Keep the lawn clean. Turn off the faucet after watering. No munching on zombies after midnight. The rules are there to keep all plants comfortable and happy. There is a special rule that applies only to Frost Bonnet. No touching the thermostat! Hot or Cold? It just needs to pick one.
FROSTBONNET_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}为了让整个家井然有序，戴夫设立了几条规矩。草坪要清洁；用完水记得关水龙头；半夜不准大声嚼僵尸。有了这些规矩，才能保证所有植物都舒服、开心。不过对小霜帽，有一条特别的——就是不准碰空调的温度！到底是冷还是热？赶紧拿定主意吧。

FROSTBONNET_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Frost Bonnet can switch between Fire and Ice bloom. Each mode deals a different damage type, allowing Frost Bonnet to both either set zombies on fire or freeze them solid.
FROSTBONNET_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 小霜帽可以在火花与雪花之间进行切换。每种模式可以造成不同种类的伤害，让小霜帽既可以点燃僵尸，又能让它们“冻”弹不得。

FROSTBONNET_DESCRIPTION_HINT.en: Frost Bonnet deals bonus damage to zombies affected by chill. Tap to toggle between the firing modes to maximize its damage.
FROSTBONNET_DESCRIPTION_HINT.zh: 小霜帽可以对受到冷缓效果的僵尸造成额外伤害。轻点即可切换开火模式，最大化伤害量。

FROSTBONNET_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Launches a combo fire and ice attack at nearby zombies. Zombies destroyed may turn into an ice wall.
FROSTBONNET_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}向周围的僵尸发射一连串火、冰攻击。被消灭的僵尸可能变为冰墙。

FROSTBONNET_TOOLTIP.en: Toggle between Fire and Ice attack modes.
FROSTBONNET_TOOLTIP.zh: 在火、冰攻击模式间切换。

FROZENPEAR_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Frozen Pear, an extraordinary botanical beautician with a chilling secret - her signature "frost therapy" facials using her own cryogenic body leaves fellow plants glowing with an astonishing botanical radiance!
FROZENPEAR_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}冻梨，一位与众不同的植物美容师，她的秘诀？就是用自己冰凉的身躯给植物们做“冷敷”美容，效果出奇好！

FROZENPEAR_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Frozen Pears can release impact waves that damage, freeze, and chill all nearby zombies when they get close.
FROZENPEAR_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 当冻梨将被僵尸啃食时，冻梨会在周围 3x3 范围内释放冲击波，对范围内的僵尸造成伤害，并对僵尸施加冻结和冷缓。

FROZENPEAR_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Heals to full health, releases an stronger impact wave that damages, freezes, and chills zombies more.
FROZENPEAR_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}治愈自己，释放更为强力的冲击波，同时施加冻结和冷缓。

FROZENPEAR_TOOLTIP.en: Freeze and chill zombies in a 3x3 area
FROZENPEAR_TOOLTIP.zh: 对周围 3x3 范围内造成冻结和冷缓伤害。

FUMESHROOM_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}"I think of myself as a pretty confident shroom and an all-around fungi," says Fume-shroom. "But sometimes, when I'm eating Plant Food, I hear them chuckling. I hear them calling me 'Balloon-shroom'. I don't think they know how much that hurts."
FUMESHROOM_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}“我觉得自己是个很自信的蘑菇，很全能的那种。”大喷菇说。“但只要我一吃叶绿素，就经常会听到他们在旁边偷笑，说我是‘气球菇’。他们才不知道这话到底有多么伤人。”

FUMESHROOM_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Fume-shrooms shoot fumes that damage all zombies in an area.
FUMESHROOM_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 大喷菇可以向一个区域内的所有僵尸喷出烟雾，对它们造成伤害。

FUMESHROOM_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Sprays a stream of fumes that deal damage and pushes all zombies back.
FUMESHROOM_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}喷出一大串烟雾，造成伤害，击退所有僵尸。

FUMESHROOM_TOOLTIP.en: Shoots fumes that can damage all zombies in an area
FUMESHROOM_TOOLTIP.zh: 喷射可以伤害一定范围内所有僵尸的烟雾

FUSIONGATLING_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}The big brother of the Pea family, capable of using the abilities of various other peas.
FUSIONGATLING_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}豌豆家族中的大哥，可以使用各种豌豆的能力。

FUSIONGATLING_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Elemental Gatling Pea fires multiple peas at once. If Mega Gatling Pea is unlocked, Elemental Gatling Pea will upgrade into other forms some time after being planted.
FUSIONGATLING_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 元素机枪豌豆可以同时散射多颗豌豆。如果已经获取了超级机枪豌豆，元素机枪豌豆会在种植一定时间后会升级为其他形态。

FUSIONGATLING_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Fires peas with different effects depending on its current form.
FUSIONGATLING_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}根据不同形态，元素机枪豌豆会发射不同效果的豌豆子弹。

FUSIONGATLING_TOOLTIP.en: Fires multiple shots and transforms into different forms.
FUSIONGATLING_TOOLTIP.zh: 向右侧射出多个子弹而且会发生形态变换

FUSION_COLLAB2_LEVEL_NAME.zh: 霜凝时空的协奏 - 第 {LEVEL_NUMBER} 关

FUTUREBUBUSEED_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}The three main favorites in the Seers, the tenth anniversary version of Bubu Seed, have very powerful abilities of percent damage.
FUTUREBUBUSEED_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}未来三大主宠——布布种子，赛尔号十周年纪念版本，拥有很强大的百分比伤害能力。

FUTUREBUBUSEED_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Future Bubu Seed can attack 10 zombies in front of them to continuously make them lose health.
FUTUREBUBUSEED_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 未来·布布种子可以穿透攻击前方 10 个僵尸并使其持续百分比掉血。

FUTUREBUBUSEED_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Future Bubu Seed releases the chlorophyll ultimate move, causing continuous control damage to zombies within a 3x3 range.
FUTUREBUBUSEED_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}在 3x3 范围内对僵尸造成持续控制伤害，总共发动两次。

FUTUREBUBUSEED_TOOLTIP.en: Deal damage to 10 zombies in front of them.
FUTUREBUBUSEED_TOOLTIP.zh: 穿透攻击前方10个僵尸并使其持续百分比掉血。

FUTURE_LEVEL_NAME.zh: 未来世界 - 第 {LEVEL_NUMBER} 天

FVS23_AD_PINATA.zh: 仲冬圣诞终极种子彩陶

FVS23_SEASON_PLANTS_UNLOCK_DESC.zh: 解锁仲冬圣诞植物特惠

GAMECENTER_FAILED_DESCRIPTION.en: You must connect to Game Center outside the PvZ2 app to access achievements and leaderboards.
GAMECENTER_FAILED_DESCRIPTION.zh: 为了访问成就和排行榜，你必须在游戏外连接到 Game Center。

GARDENIA_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Gardenia, who was fond of swimming, accidentally swallowed a bubble machine while swimming in a pool one day and passed out from choking. When she woke up, she found herself becoming a new drink at the "Jinjin Tea House x ChaYan YueSe (Modern China Tea Shop)"
GARDENIA_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}栀子花热衷于游泳运动，直到有一天她在水池里游泳时误食了一台气泡机并被呛晕倒过去。当她醒来时她发现自己成为了茶颜悦色x金金茶馆的新饮品——栀晓。

GARDENIA_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: An amphibious plant that shoots out piercing bubbles in a row,  which can use air currents to immobilize zombies. When planted on water, bubbles will be ejected in 3 nearby lanes.
GARDENIA_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 栀晓是一种两栖植物，可以对本行前方吹出会穿透僵尸的气泡，被气泡击中的僵尸将被定身。在水上种植时，她会被强化，吹出三行气泡。

GARDENIA_DESCRIPTION_HINT.en: Gardenia blows bubbles that can immobilize zombies, and can attack three lanes on the water.
GARDENIA_DESCRIPTION_HINT.zh: 栀晓吹出可以定身僵尸的气泡，在水上可以攻击三行。

GARDENIA_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: Blow out powerful bubbles that can penetrate zombies and explode, blowing out three even more powerful bubbles when on water.
GARDENIA_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}吹出能穿透僵尸并爆炸的强力气泡，在水上时吹出三行更强力的气泡。

GARDENIA_TOOLTIP.en: Gardenia blows bubbles that can immobilize zombies, and can attack three lanes on the water.
GARDENIA_TOOLTIP.zh: 栀晓吹出可以定身僵尸的气泡，在水上可以攻击三行。

GARGANTUAR_INHIBITOR_DESCRIPTION.zh: 把关卡中的巨人僵尸替换掉！

GARLIC_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Good against zombies, as well as proof against any vampires who might accidentally wander by.
GARLIC_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}能够很好地对付僵尸，也能用来抵御任何可能路过的吸血鬼。

GARLIC_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Garlic diverts zombies into other lanes.
GARLIC_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 大蒜可以使僵尸转移到其他行。

GARLIC_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Heals itself and releases gas that will temporarily stun zombies in front and divert them to another column.
GARLIC_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}治疗自己，随后发射气体，暂时眩晕前方的僵尸，并将它们移到另一列。

GEMS_BUNDLE_DAVESALE_1.en: Crazy Dave's Stickybomb Strategy seed Bundle
GEMS_BUNDLE_DAVESALE_1.zh: 疯狂戴夫的黏弹糯米战略种子捆绑包

GEMS_BUNDLE_DAVESALE_2.en: Crazy Dave's A.K.E.E Strategy Seed Bundle
GEMS_BUNDLE_DAVESALE_2.zh: 疯狂戴夫的阿开木-木战略种子捆绑包

GEMS_BUNDLE_DAVESALE_3.en: Crazy Dave's Tiger Grass Strategy Seed Bundle
GEMS_BUNDLE_DAVESALE_3.zh: 疯狂戴夫的虎草战略种子捆绑包

GEMS_BUNDLE_DAVESALE_4.en: Crazy Dave's Citron Strategy Seed Bundle
GEMS_BUNDLE_DAVESALE_4.zh: 疯狂戴夫的充能柚子战略种子捆绑包

GEMS_LOD_SEED_BUNDLE.zh: 末日草坪 - 种子捆绑包

GEMS_MILESTONE_CAVES_1.zh: 极寒冰窟里程碑捆绑包

GEMS_MILESTONE_LOSTCITY_1.zh: 失落之城里程碑捆绑包

GEMS_MILESTONE_MODERN_1.zh: 现代年华里程碑捆绑包

GEMS_MILESTONE_NEON_1.zh: 炫光魔音里程碑捆绑包

GEMS_MILESTONE_WILDWEST_1.zh: 狂野西部里程碑捆绑包

GEMS_STORE_TEXT.en: Need more gems? Choose a package below.
GEMS_STORE_TEXT.zh: 需要更多钻石吗？在下方选择一个包吧！

GET_BAMBOO.en: Kong Fu World Final Battle - Get Bamboo Shoots
GET_BAMBOO.zh: 功夫世界最终之战 - 获得竹笋

GHOSTPEPPER_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}You might not know it looking at her, but Ghost Pepper didn't always wear that white sheet everywhere she went. She first put it on as a lark for a Halloween party one year. Everyone else had these elaborate costumes, and she thought it would be funny to dress like a plain ol' ghost. But she fell in love with that costume. It spoke to her. She'd found her calling.
GHOSTPEPPER_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}浮空植物

{FLAVOR}别看她现在这样，你大概不知道，幽灵辣椒以前并没有成天裹着这条白色床单。她在某年的万圣节派对第一次穿上它的时候，只是觉得好玩罢了——大伙都有精心制作的装扮，而她却只拌成一个普通幽灵的模样，这种反差肯定很有意思。结果她却爱上了这件装扮——仿佛它俩注定在一起。于是，她就这么找到了自己人生的使命。

GHOSTPEPPER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Ghost Peppers haunt zombies that pass by and explode after a limited time.
GHOSTPEPPER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 幽灵辣椒可以缠扰所有经过的僵尸，并在一段时间后爆炸。

GHOSTPEPPER_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Deals heavy damage to all nearby zombies, and resets its lifetime timer.
GHOSTPEPPER_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}对周围所有僵尸造成大量伤害，重置自己的生命计时器。

GHOSTPEPPER_TOOLTIP.en: Haunts all zombies that pass by and explodes after a limited time
GHOSTPEPPER_TOOLTIP.zh: 缠扰所有经过的僵尸，一段时间后爆炸

GLOOMBARA_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}Single use, takes effect immediately

{FLAVOR}Gloombara is a heavy 'atmosphere' enthusiast. 'Whether zombies can win or not is another matter, but the special effects must be beautiful!' For this 20-second exclusive filter, she even enrolled in a crash course in film post-production effects.
GLOOMBARA_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}用法：{STAT}一次性使用，立即生效

{FLAVOR}幽潭婆罗是个重度“氛围感”爱好者，“打僵尸能不能赢另说，但出场特效必须唯美！”为了这20秒的专属滤镜，她甚至专门去报了一个影视后期特效速成班。

GLOOMBARA_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Creates the spirit world, enhances spirit plants, and converts all spirit zombies on the board.
GLOOMBARA_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 开启灵界大门，强化灵界植物并转化全场灵体僵尸。

GLOOMBARA_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}此植物无叶绿素大招。

GLOOMVINE_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}"When two masters fight, victories or defeats are determined instantly. Those flowery swordplays are not worth mentioning." Agave would say this with scorn every time when that "Epic" duel was mentioned. However, everyone knew that it was just a game of Rock-Paper-Scissors with Zorrose.
GLOOMVINE_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}对头上有防具的僵尸并不造成额外伤害。
{KEYWORD}植物特征：{STAT}武艺高强

{FLAVOR}“高手对决，胜负往往就在一瞬间。那些花哨的剑术不值一提。”每当有人提到那次“史诗级”的决斗，龙舌兰就会一脸不屑的说道。其实大家都知道龙舌兰和玫瑰剑客比的只不过是剪刀石头布。

GLOOMVINE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Agave can attack all zombies two tiles ahead and cause additional damage to armored zombies.
GLOOMVINE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 龙舌兰可以攻击前方两格的所有僵尸，并对头上有防具的僵尸造成额外伤害。

GLOOMVINE_TOOLTIP.zh: 攻击前方两格的所有僵尸

GOLDBLOOM_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}"Your botanists were so preoccupied with whether they could," says Gold Bloom, about nothing and to nobody in particular, "they didn't stop to think if they should."
GOLDBLOOM_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}使用：{STAT}一次性使用，立即生效

{FLAVOR}“那些植物学家花费了无数心血研究‘能否做到’，”黄金蓓蕾说，“但是他们并没有停下来思考‘是否应该这样做’。”

GOLDBLOOM_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Gold Blooms produce a burst of sun all at once.
GOLDBLOOM_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 黄金蓓蕾可以立刻提供大量阳光。

GOLDBLOOM_TOOLTIP.en: Gives an instant burst of sun

GOLDLEAF_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}"For a small initial investment, you too can generate huge sun," says Gold Leaf. She’s a firm believer in solar markets.
GOLDLEAF_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}使用：{STAT}一次性使用，立即生效

{FLAVOR}“起步只需投资一点点阳光，你也能赢得巨大的阳光收益。”黄金叶说。她十分相信太阳能市场能给予她不菲的收益。

GOLDLEAF_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Gold Leaves create a Gold Tile on planting.
GOLDLEAF_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 黄金叶可以在种植的位置创造金地砖。

GOLDLEAF_TOOLTIP.zh: 在种植处制造黄金地砖

GOOGLE_PLAY_FAILED_DESCRIPTION.en: You must connect to Google Play to access achievements and leaderboards.
GOOGLE_PLAY_FAILED_DESCRIPTION.zh: 为了访问成就和排行榜，你必须连接到 Google Play。

GOT_A_POWERUP.en: You got a new POWER UP!
GOT_A_POWERUP.zh: 你获得了一个新的金手指！

GRANT_WORLDKEYS_BRIEF_BODY_TEXT.zh: 这些钥匙能解锁新世界！

GRANT_WORLDKEYS_COMPLETIONIST_BODY_TEXT.en: You already have all your keys!
GRANT_WORLDKEYS_COMPLETIONIST_BODY_TEXT.zh: 你已经拥有所有钥匙了！

GRANT_WORLDKEYS_MIDPLAYER_BODY_TEXT.en: You just got keys for all the worlds! Check them out!
GRANT_WORLDKEYS_MIDPLAYER_BODY_TEXT.zh: 你刚刚获得了可以解锁所有世界的钥匙！去看看吧！

GRANT_WORLDKEYS_NEWPLAYER_BODY_TEXT.en: You shouldn't be seeing this message, it is only for older players.
GRANT_WORLDKEYS_NEWPLAYER_BODY_TEXT.zh: 奇怪…你不应该看到这条消息的呀，应该只有老玩家才能看到。

GRANT_WORLDKEYS_TITLE_TEXT.en: Hey, time traveler! Here’s all the world keys.
GRANT_WORLDKEYS_TITLE_TEXT.zh: 嘿，时空旅行者！给你所有的世界钥匙。

GRAPESHOT_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}"Spa-BOOM!" enthuses Grapeshot. "You like that? I got a million of 'em! Wa-POW! Buh-BLAM! Za-... um... Ker-... hmmm... Okay, I guess I've only got the three."
GRAPESHOT_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}使用：{STAT}一次性使用，立即生效

{FLAVOR}“啪，轰！”爆裂葡萄热情似火。“你喜欢这声儿吗？我有上百种爆炸声音！哇，砰！蚌，砰！炸…额…吭…呃呃呃…好吧，我只有三种这样的声音。”

GRAPESHOT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Grapeshots explode and scatter bouncing projectiles in eight directions.
GRAPESHOT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 爆裂葡萄可以爆炸并散出可反弹的子弹。

GRAPESHOT_TOOLTIP.zh: 爆炸并散出可反弹的子弹

GRAVEBUSTER_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}He may appear spiky or ill-tempered, but Grave Buster just wants to give you a big hug. Unless you're a puppy. He's terrified of those.
GRAVEBUSTER_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}使用：{STAT}一次性使用，必须种在墓碑上
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}吞噬墓碑

{FLAVOR}墓碑吞噬者可能看起来很凶，但他只是想给你一个大大的拥抱。小狗除外，因为他害怕狗。

GRAVEBUSTER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Grave Busters consume graves they're planted on.
GRAVEBUSTER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 墓碑吞噬者能将所在位置的墓碑吞噬掉。

GRAVEBUSTER_TOOLTIP.en: Plant it on a grave to remove the grave
GRAVEBUSTER_TOOLTIP.zh: 种植在墓碑上除掉墓碑

GRID_IS_YOURS_BOOSTTILE3_DESCRIPTION.en: Disperse {COUNT} three-use Boost Tile every {TIME} seconds!
GRID_IS_YOURS_BOOSTTILE3_DESCRIPTION.zh: 每 {TIME} 秒产生 {COUNT} 个可以用三次的强化地砖！

GRID_IS_YOURS_BOOSTTILE_DESCRIPTION.en: Disperse {COUNT} single-use Boost Tiles every {TIME} seconds!
GRID_IS_YOURS_BOOSTTILE_DESCRIPTION.zh: 每 {TIME} 秒产生 {COUNT} 个一次性的强化地砖！

GRIMROSE_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}powered Grimroses can drag 3 zombies before expiring

{FLAVOR}"When you think about it, the proper place for a zombie is in the ground," says Grimrose. "So, really, I'm just expediting the process."
GRIMROSE_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}被暗影强化的报丧花可以将三只僵尸拖入无尽深渊

{FLAVOR}报丧花说：“仔细想一想，僵尸应该本来就在地下吧，所以，我只是在送它们回家。”

GRIMROSE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Grimroses are shadow plants that behave like landbound Tangle Kelps, dragging up to 3 zombies into the dirt.
GRIMROSE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 报丧花是一株暗影植物，可以像缠绕水草一样把僵尸拖下去，哪怕是在地面上。

GRIMROSE_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Drags the strongest small zombie into the ground. If the zombie is large or mechanical- deal damage instead.
GRIMROSE_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}将最强的小体型僵尸拖入地下。如果是大体型或者机械类僵尸，则改为造成伤害。

GROUNDCHERRY_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}Lasts for a period of time and cannot be attacked

{FLAVOR}Groundcherry, Torchwood, and Snapdragon became quick BFFs, claiming to be "the three scorchers." The Tiki Lounge doesn't welcome them however with the tables they've burned on their way.
GROUNDCHERRY_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：飞行植物

{FLAVOR}灯笼草很快就与火炬树桩和火龙草成了形影不离的好朋友，他们自称为“火焰三剑客”。不过夏威夷风情酒廊似乎不太敢招待他们三个，老板可不愿意再看见烧焦的酒桌。

GROUNDCHERRY_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Lantern Cherry can detect invisible zombies
GROUNDCHERRY_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 灯笼草能发现隐形状态下的僵尸，例如仲裁者-X型

GROUNDCHERRY_TOOLTIP.zh: 灯笼草能发现隐形状态下的僵尸

GTA_LEVEL_NAME.zh: 洛城风云 - 第 {LEVEL_NUMBER} 天

GUACODILE_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Ask Guacodile to tell you a little bit about himself and he'll give you a wry smile. "I'm a Guacodile. I've got a bite like a bear trap. I spit rock-hard pits with a force, speed and accuracy envied by every plant on the battlefield. Heck, I've been known to walk on water. I'm pretty much the whole enchilada." Yeah, the guy is a bit of a braggart but he’s good at what he does.
GUACODILE_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}使用：{STAT}冲刺攻击后会消失
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}能被种植在水面上

{FLAVOR}如果你让鳄梨告诉你些许关于他的事，他会苦笑一番。“我是鳄梨。我有着捕熊器般的咬合力。我吐出的子弹有着战场上所有植物都嫉妒的力量、速度以及爆发力。对了，所有人都知道我能行走于水面之上。我简直就是个传奇人物。”确实，这家伙有点过于吹嘘，但他也确实对他的工作很在行。

GUACODILE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Guacodiles is an amphibious plant that fire seeds from a distance. When attacked they will rush off the lawn biting any zombies they encounter.
GUACODILE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 鳄梨可以发射种子，在受到攻击时则会冲向前方的所有僵尸。

GUACODILE_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Knock back zombies near it and releases two rushing Guacodiles that deal damage down its row.
GUACODILE_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}击退周围的僵尸，向所在行释放两枚可以造成伤害的鳄梨。

GUACODILE_TOOLTIP.en: Shoots seeds, will rush all zombies ahead of him when attacked
GUACODILE_TOOLTIP.zh: 发射种子，在受到攻击时冲向前方

GUARDSHROOM_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}What does 3.154e+13 and Guard-shroom have in common? When Dave asked, it took Penny more than 4 hours to complete the Guard-shroom census and emerge from the basement. Penny vehemently states this number is accurate and has banned anyone else from going down there.
GUARDSHROOM_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}守卫菇与 3.154e+13 有什么共同点？某天，戴夫问了一嘴守卫菇的数量，潘妮立马驶入地下室对其进行菌落计数，结果花了四个多小时才从里面出来。潘妮严正声明这个数字是准确的，不准任何人去验算。

GUARDSHROOM_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: An amphibious mushroom that will spawn mini versions of itself to guard adjacent plants. These Mini-shrooms can gobble up zombies, as well as significantly boost mushrooms and other plants they share a tile with.
GUARDSHROOM_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 两栖蘑菇，可以生成迷你版的自己守卫周围植物。迷你菇可以吞噬僵尸，还能大幅强化与其处于同一块地砖的蘑菇和其他植物。

GUARDSHROOM_DESCRIPTION_HINT.en: Guard-shroom’s Minis will grant a significant boost to all shroom type plants and give an extra boost to Sea-shroom, Puff-shroom, Scaredy-shroom and Nightcap.
GUARDSHROOM_DESCRIPTION_HINT.zh: 守卫菇的迷你分身可以大幅强化所有的蘑菇类植物，更能为海蘑菇、小喷菇、胆小菇与暗夜菇提供额外增益。

GUARDSHROOM_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en:
{KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Main Body - Drags several zombies and pummels them.
Mini - Retriggers the Plant Food ability of the host plant.
GUARDSHROOM_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh:
{KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}主体 - 拖近僵尸，痛击它们。
迷你分身 - 再次触发宿主植物的叶绿素效果。

GUARDSHROOM_TOOLTIP.en: Replicates itself to guard adjacent plants.
GUARDSHROOM_TOOLTIP.zh: 自我复制，守卫周围植物。

GUMNUT_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Continuous geisha performance training has given her proficient flower fan dexterity. She'll put on a gorgeous fan performance to show her strength against the zombies.
GUMNUT_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}长久的艺伎表演训练让她拥有量纯熟的花扇操纵技巧，她将用华丽的花扇表演来展示她对抗僵尸的实力。

GUMNUT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: A returning flower fan can damage zombies within its attack range
GUMNUT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 飞回的花扇可以对攻击范围内的僵尸造成伤害。

GUMNUT_TOOLTIP.en: Throw the flower fan and damage the zombies on the lane
GUMNUT_TOOLTIP.zh: 甩出花扇并对路上的僵尸造成伤害

HAMMERUIT_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Even though Hammeruit claims that, “Patience is a virtue”, there have been multiple cases where ‘things’ around the house and lawn have been found smashed beyond repair. The more Hammeruit has to wait, the amount of smashing increases around it. Whenever confronted, Hammeruit always responds with, “Show me the evidence, and then we will talk”.
HAMMERUIT_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}虽然巨锤果嘴上说“忍耐是一种美德”，可房子、草坪周围却常常会有东西被砸得面目全非。巨锤果等得越久，周围被砸坏的东西就越多。每次找其对证，巨锤果总会答道：“先拿出证据再说吧”。

HAMMERUIT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Hammeruit smashes zombies with its charging hammer attacks.
HAMMERUIT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 巨锤果可以使用充能巨锤击打僵尸。

HAMMERUIT_DESCRIPTION_HINT.en: Hammeruit’s attack deals more damage, the more it has to wait to attack.
HAMMERUIT_DESCRIPTION_HINT.zh: 巨锤果攻击造成的伤害越高，下一次攻击等待的时间就越久。

HAMMERUIT_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Slams its hammer 3 times in a row, dealing increasing damage with each hit. Releases shockwaves at the last hit that travels in 3 directions.
HAMMERUIT_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}连续猛击 3 次巨锤，每次攻击造成更高伤害。最后一次攻击释放冲击波，向 3 个方向推进。

HARVEST_24_PREMIUM_PINATA_BUNDLE.zh: 丰收节高级彩陶捆绑包

HAYSTACK_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Compared to the cold and gloomy environment of the Underground Palace, Sod prefers the sunny roof life of his grandmother's grandfather's sister-in-law's uncle's aunt.
HAYSTACK_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}比起地宫阴冷的环境，草垛更喜欢他姥姥的姥爷的小姑的姑父的舅妈阳光明媚的屋顶生活。

HAYSTACK_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Sods allow plants to be planted on tunnels.
HAYSTACK_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 草垛能够让植物种在坑道上。

HAYSTACK_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}在相邻的坑道上创建草垛。

HAYSTACK_TOOLTIP.en: Allows plants to be planted on tunnels
HAYSTACK_TOOLTIP.zh: 草垛能够让植物种在坑道上

HEADBUTTERLETTUCE_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Headbutter Lettuce loves music and dancing, especially with Beat-tles vibe. Eventually he developed a knack, a knack of headbutting pounds and tossing head sebum.
HEADBUTTERLETTUCE_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}植物特征：{STAT}矮个子

{FLAVOR}奶油生菜酷爱音乐和跳舞，特别是听着磕头士音乐蹦迪。时间一长，他练就了一项绝技，以头抢地的攻击方式和甩出头油的绝技。

HEADBUTTERLETTUCE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Headbutter Lettuces bash zombies in front and behind while occasionally buttering zombies.
HEADBUTTERLETTUCE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 奶油生菜可以在攻击的时候甩出奶油，将远处的僵尸糊住。

HEADBUTTERLETTUCE_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Bashes and throws stunning butter at surrounding area zombies.
HEADBUTTERLETTUCE_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}猛击周围区域的僵尸，并向其投掷黄油，造成眩晕效果。

HEADBUTTERLETTUCE_TOOLTIP.zh: 奶油生菜可以在攻击的时候甩出奶油，将远处的僵尸糊住。

HEADBUTTER_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}Launch a powerful attack on zombies with low health.

{FLAVOR}This mysterious swordsman from the far east calls himself Versailles Gogh. When he drinks in taverns, he always brags about being an artist to transcend the ages. "These boorish guys simply can't comprehend what I'm trying to express!" He always says so angrily. "That famous singer Sunflower, I once painted her a ground-breaking portrait, but of course she said that what I had painted was rubbish! But this was my one and only portrait that wasn't of roses! I also deliberately signed my name at the bottom of the painting. I bet that signature alone is enough to make that painting a priceless treasure... Buuurrrp!"
HEADBUTTER_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}对生命值很低的僵尸发动强力攻击。
{KEYWORD}植物特征：{STAT}红色植物、武艺高强

{FLAVOR}这名来自遥远东方的神秘剑客自称为凡尔赛·高，他在酒馆里喝酒的时候总是吹嘘自己是一名超越时代的艺术家。“这些粗鲁的家伙根本无法理解我想表达的东西！”他总是如此愤愤不平地说道，“那位著名的向日葵歌手，我曾经给她画过一幅划时代的画像，但是她居然宣称我画的是垃圾！这可是我唯一一幅除了玫瑰之外的画像！我还特意在画的下面签上了自己名字的缩写，我敢打赌光凭这个签名就足以使这副画成为无价之宝……嗝~”

HEADBUTTER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: The Rose Swordsman can attack approaching zombies and launch powerful attacks on zombies with low health.
HEADBUTTER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 玫瑰剑客可以攻击接近的僵尸，并对低生命的僵尸发动强力攻击。

HEADBUTTER_TOOLTIP.en: Attacks approaching zombies, causing huge damage to zombies with low health.
HEADBUTTER_TOOLTIP.zh: 攻击接近的僵尸，对血量较低的僵尸造成巨大伤害。

HEATHSEEKER_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Heath Seekers have always believed that the shortest distance between two points is an elaborately curved path that passes through several zombies and also looks pretty. Needless to say, they're struggling in geometry class.
HEATHSEEKER_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}可以瞄准草坪上的任何位置
{FLAVOR}石楠导引头一直相信两点之间的最短距离是一条复杂的曲线，这样不仅可以穿过几只僵尸，而且看上去也漂亮。好吧…不用说也知道他们的几何课上得很艰难。

HEATHSEEKER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Heath Seekers are Spear-mint family instant-use plants that burst into a storm of homing, piercing darts.
HEATHSEEKER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 石楠导引头是穿刺薄荷家族的立即使用型植物，可以爆裂出一场能够穿透僵尸的制导飞镖风暴。

HEATHSEEKER_TOOLTIP.zh: 爆裂出一场制导飞镖风暴

HES_GOT_YOUR_BACK.en: He’s got your back – and front!

HOCUS_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}"Observe," says Hocus Crocus. "Have I anything up my sleeve? Do I even have sleeves? No? Prepare, then, to have your quaint and old-fashioned notions of spatial location SHATTERED FOREVER!!!"
HOCUS_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}每次传送时会同时造成伤害

{FLAVOR}“仔细看。”藏红花说。“我袖子上有藏有任何东西吗？我有袖子吗？没有？那么，准备好，我会永远地摧毁你那对于空间位置古怪而又传统的概念！！！”

HOCUS_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Hocus Crocuses use slick sleight-of-petal chicanery to magic zombies close to your home all the way back to the rightmost part of the lawn.
HOCUS_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 藏红花会使用魔法把离你的房子最近的僵尸送回草坪最右侧。

HOCUS_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}将最多三只最左边的僵尸传送到最右边的一排。

HOCUS_TOOLTIP.zh: 用魔法将最近的僵尸送回开始的位置

HOLLYBARRIERLEAFPLANTFOOD_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}The green slime thrown by Venus Flytrap can continuously repel and damage zombies.
{KEYWORD}Range:{STAT} 3 tiles ahead.

{FLAVOR}Although Venus flytrap has a huge mouth, it can bite a single enemy with its sharp teeth. But it still likes to use its mouth to shoot green slime to attack zombies, although no zombies have complained about it.
HOLLYBARRIERLEAFPLANTFOOD_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}捕蝇草发射的绿色唾液可以持续的击退并伤害僵尸，叶绿素粘液可以吸附其他行的僵尸。
{KEYWORD}攻击范围：{STAT}前方三格。

{FLAVOR}捕蝇草虽然长着血盆大口，能凭借尖牙利齿咬住单只敌人。但是他却还是喜欢用他的血盆大口来发射绿色唾液攻击僵尸，尽管并没有僵尸对此提出差评。

HOLLYBARRIERLEAFPLANTFOOD_DESCRIPTION_HE.en: Venus flytrap will use its maw to repel and damage zombies.
HOLLYBARRIERLEAFPLANTFOOD_DESCRIPTION_HE.zh: 捕蝇草会用它的血盆大口来击退并伤害僵尸。

HOLLYBARRIERLEAFPLANTFOOD_TOOLTIP.zh: 捕蝇草会用它的血盆大口来击退并伤害僵尸。

HOLLYBARRIERLEAF_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}Have a chance to throw glowing pomegranates which deal big damage to armor but can't damage the zombie itself

{FLAVOR}Pomegranate-pult's three brothers, Rotten Red, Lava Guava, and Jeweler Pomegranate, are all very successful, which inspired her to move forward. Long-term practice has enabled her to develop elite visual abilities. Three meters, five meters, she can accurately knock down the zombie's armor every time. When she was finally sorting through her loot, she realized she couldn't fit the zombie's hat.
HOLLYBARRIERLEAF_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}有概率投射对防具造成大量伤害的发光石榴，但发光的石榴无法对僵尸本体产生伤害。

{FLAVOR}石榴投手的三个哥哥双枪石榴、岩浆番石榴和钻石商石榴都颇有成就，这使她激发起了前进的动力，长期的练习使她练就了精锐的视觉能力。三米，五米，每一次她都能精准的把僵尸的防具击打下来。当她最后整理战利品时，她才发现僵尸的帽子她戴不上去。

HOLLYBARRIERLEAF_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Pomegranate-pult has developed sharp vision. She can always spot the armor on the zombie's head immediately and knock it off!
HOLLYBARRIERLEAF_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 石榴投手练就了明锐的视觉能力，她总是能第一时间发现僵尸头上的防具并击打下来！

HOLLYBARRIERLEAF_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Launchs a large pomegranate that deals massive armor damage to all zombies on the lawn.
HOLLYBARRIERLEAF_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}向草坪上的每只僵尸投掷一颗闪光穿甲石榴。

HOLLYBARRIERLEAF_TOOLTIP.en: There is a chance to launch glowing pomegranates that cause a lot of damage to armor!
HOLLYBARRIERLEAF_TOOLTIP.zh: 有概率发射对防具造成大量伤害的发光石榴！

HOLLYKNIGHT_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Gatling Pea's parents were concerned when he announced his intention to join the military. "But honey, it's so dangerous!" they said in unison. Gatling Pea refused to budge. "Life is dangerous," he replied, eyes glinting with steely conviction.
HOLLYKNIGHT_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}伤害：{STAT}普通（每颗豌豆）
{KEYWORD}攻击速度：{STAT}4 倍

{FLAVOR}当机枪射手宣布他打算参军时，他的父母很担心。“但是亲爱的，这也太危险了！”他们异口同声的说道。机枪射手拒绝让步。“生命本就是危险的，”他回答道，眼中闪烁着坚定的信念。

HOLLYKNIGHT_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Shoots a barrage of fast peas in three lanes.
HOLLYKNIGHT_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}向三行发射一连串高速豌豆。

HOLONUT1_DESCRIPTION.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Fully heals itself and creates a shield to protect the column from incoming attacks.
HOLONUT1_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}随着时间恢复生命

{FLAVOR}好好的一个坚果，就这么把时间都花在观察两面镜子之间的无限个自己了。

HOLONUT1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: A weaker Wall-nut that regains health over time
HOLONUT1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 全息坚果稍逊于坚果墙，但是它们可以在一段时间后重生。

HOLONUT1_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Fully heals itself and creates a shield to protect the column from incoming attacks.
HOLONUT1_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}治愈自己，创建一面可以保护所在排的护盾，抵御攻击。

HOLONUT1_TOOLTIP.en: A weaker Wall-nut that regains health over time
HOLONUT1_TOOLTIP.zh: 稍微弱些的坚果墙，但可以随着时间恢复生命值

HOLONUT_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Double Passion is the star of Goodme Milk Tea Shop. Whether it is simply soaked in water or used as a pairing, passion fruit must have a name in summer drinks! "I don't know why the zombies are so mad after eating my bullets, but I will kill them before they rush to the house." Double Passion said.
HOLONUT_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}百香双响炮是古茗奶茶店的明星，无论是简单的泡水、还是作为搭配，夏季饮品中百香果必须有姓名！“我也不知道为什么僵尸们吃了我的子弹后会那么如火如荼，但我会在他们冲向房子之前轰死他们。”百香双响炮说。

HOLONUT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Spit out passion fruit seeds to attack zombies, leaving them burnt but passionate.
HOLONUT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 连续吐出两颗富有激情的百香果籽攻击僵尸，同时按照僵尸血量百分比灼伤僵尸。

HOLONUT_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Launches two flaming passion fruits, shrinking and burning zombies in a 3x3 area.
HOLONUT_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}向一定角度内发射两颗带火百香果，缩小并百分比灼伤 3x3 范围内的僵尸，炮轰两次。

HOLONUT_TOOLTIP.en: Shoot passion fruit seeds to attack zombies and burn them, but will speed them up briefly.
HOLONUT_TOOLTIP.zh: 吐出百香果籽攻击僵尸并使其灼伤，但会短暂加速

HOMINGTHISTLE_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Don't even think about trying to pull one over on Homing Thistle. He's got a bead on you. He sees right through your facade. It's like he has a laser beam ... aimed at your soul.
HOMINGTHISTLE_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}不要试图套路导向蓟，他可以轻轻松松拿捏你的一切。他的目光触及你的表皮，更穿透你的表皮。目光？更像是激光。一道直击你灵魂的光。

HOMINGTHISTLE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Homing Thistles fire seeking shots at targets that are the closest to home.
HOMINGTHISTLE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 导向蓟可以发射追踪刺，攻击离房子最近的目标。

HOMINGTHISTLE_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Shoots homing projectiles at all zombies on the lawn, dealing moderate damage to each.
HOMINGTHISTLE_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}向草坪上的所有僵尸发射导向弹，对每只僵尸造成中等伤害。

HOMINGTHISTLE_TOOLTIP.en: Attacks farthest left target in any lane
HOMINGTHISTLE_TOOLTIP.zh: 攻击全场最靠左的目标

HORSEBEAN_DESCRIPTION.en:
{FLAVOR}Horsebeans earned the title of "Best Pilot" when studying at flight school. After graduation, they couldn't wait to form a flight squadron. Although Horsebeans often brag about their flying skills, it seems no one really dares to step onto their bumpy mothership.

{KEYWORD}Programmer: {STAT}jaynkrow
HORSEBEAN_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{FLAVOR}蚕豆们在飞行学校学习的时候获得了“最佳飞行员”的称号，毕业后，他们迫不及待地组成了一支飞行队。尽管蚕豆们常常吹嘘自己的飞行技术，不过大家似乎都不太敢踏上他们颠簸的母舰。

{KEYWORD}代码：{STAT}jaynkrow

HORSEBEAN_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Horsebeans dispatch commandos that attack nearby zombies.
HORSEBEAN_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 蚕豆突击队能发动突击队员攻击周围的僵尸。

HORSEBEAN_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Dispatchs more commandos that attack nearby zombies.
HORSEBEAN_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}发动更多突击队员攻击周围的僵尸。

HORSEBEAN_TOOLTIP.zh: 蚕豆突击队能发动蚕豆突击队员攻击周围的僵尸

HOTDATE_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Hot Date's a charmer. He's polite, well-read, has lots of interesting opinions, and practices active listening. Zombies line up around the block to be incinerated by him.
HOTDATE_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}可以温暖附近的植物

{FLAVOR}热辣海枣可以说是很有魅力了。他不仅彬彬有礼、博闻强识、见多识广、幽默风趣，而且最近都还在学习听人说话的技巧。看呐，僵尸现在都已经排好长队想要看看他有多么热辣了。

HOTDATE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Hot Dates attract zombies from lanes above and below them, and then unleash a lane of flame when they're eaten.
HOTDATE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 当僵尸接近热辣海枣时，它们会被吸引到热辣海枣那一列，在被吃掉时会燃起一行的火焰。

HOTDATE_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Heals itself and attracts zombies in the surrounding area.
HOTDATE_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}治疗自己，吸引附近的僵尸。

HOTDATE_TOOLTIP.zh: 吸引其它行的僵尸，被吃掉时烧伤整行僵尸

HOTPOTATO_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}How does Hot Potato stay so positive and even-peeled all the time? Yoga, that’s how. She never misses a class. Also, regular meditation. It's the only way she can handle the hard work of fighting zombies, day in and day out, without melting down.
HOTPOTATO_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}使用：{STAT}一次性使用
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}可以融化冰块

{FLAVOR}热土豆是怎么做到无论遇到什么状况都能积极面对的呢？答案就是瑜伽。她一节瑜伽课都没有缺席过。此外，定期的冥想也是她如此坚韧的原因。虽然她的身体并不算很坚韧啦。

HOTPOTATO_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Hot Potatoes melt the ice blocks they’re planted on.
HOTPOTATO_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 热土豆可以融化它们的格子下的冰块。

HOTPOTATO_TOOLTIP.en: Plant it on an ice block to melt the block
HOTPOTATO_TOOLTIP.zh: 种植在冰块上融化冰块

HUNTER_INHIBITOR_DESCRIPTION.zh: 把关卡中的猎人僵尸替换掉！

HURRIKALE_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}You could say Hurrikale is a "blow hard" in the truest sense of the phrase. He is the first chair trombonist in the Biennial Philharmonic Orchestra. He is also proficient in the trumpet, saxophone and the tuba. But man o' man, you should really see him on the flugelhorn. Dude absolutely kills it.
HURRIKALE_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}使用：{STAT}一次性使用，立即生效
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}被吹到的僵尸会受到冷缓效果
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}可以吹走所在行内的飞行僵尸

{FLAVOR}没错，飓风甘蓝真的很会吹…我是说乐器啦。他可是“双年爱乐管弦乐团”的首席长号手。不仅如此，小号、萨克斯和大号对他来说都不是问题，但这些最多只能算是他的业余爱好。你绝对不能错过他的柔音号。只需要听一个音符，你都会觉得这辈子值了。

HURRIKALE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Hurrikales push back all zombies in their lane with a chilling wind.
HURRIKALE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 飓风甘蓝可以吹出寒风，将所在行上的僵尸往后吹。

HURRIKALE_TOOLTIP.en: Blows a chilling wind that pushes back zombies in lane
HURRIKALE_TOOLTIP.zh: 吹动一阵寒风，击退同一行中的僵尸

HYPNOSHROOM_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Hypno-shroom has no trouble persuading zombies to fight on behalf of the plants. But he has yet to convince one to cluck like a chicken. "One day," he says. "One day."
HYPNOSHROOM_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}魅惑菇可以轻轻松松让僵尸为植物作战，却至今也没能成功魅惑它们去学鸡叫。“哼，早晚会的…”他嘀咕道，“早晚会的。”

HYPNOSHROOM_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: When zombies eat Hypno-shrooms, they will turn around and fight for you.
HYPNOSHROOM_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 僵尸吃掉魅惑菇后，会成为你的盟友，为你战斗。

HYPNOSHROOM_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Turns a hypnotized zombie into a Gargantuar.
HYPNOSHROOM_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}将吃下魅惑菇的僵尸变为巨人僵尸。

HYPNOSHROOM_TOOLTIP.en: Makes a zombie fight for you

HYSILENS_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}Inflicts four different Echo effects on zombies, which are considered Damage over Time (DoT).
{KEYWORD}Echo Effects:
{STAT}Bleed: Deals damage equal to 4% of the zombie's maximum health per second, up to a maximum of 20 damage.
Burn: Deals 15 fire damage to zombies per second.
Shock: Stuns the zombie for 3 seconds, and deals 10 electric damage per second.
Wind Shear: Deals 5 wind damage per second, and reduces the zombie's defense by 30%.
{KEYWORD}Synergy - The Gladius of Conquest: {STAT}When under a buff applied by Fluorescent Fungus, Hysilix's normal attack water orbs can additionally increase the damage taken by zombies by 30% for 4 seconds.
{FLAVOR}"You Ask Why Hearts Cry,
Tell Me Why Waves Roar High,
Why Do Lights Bid Goodbye,
Lo, How Time Flows By,
In Ablution, I Hum and Sigh,
When to Return From Where You Lie."
HYSILENS_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}可以为僵尸施加四种不同的『余音』效果，该效果视为持续伤害。
{KEYWORD}『余音』：
{STAT}裂伤：每秒根据僵尸4%最大生命值造成伤害，该伤害最高不超过20点。
灼烧：每秒使僵尸受到固定15点火焰伤害。
触电：赋予该状态时造成眩晕3秒，每秒使僵尸受到固定10点触电伤害。
风化：每秒受到固定5点风化伤害，并使僵尸防御力降低30%。
{KEYWORD}连携 - 征服的剑旗：{STAT}当存在幽灯蕈施加的增益效果时，普通攻击的水球可以额外使僵尸受到的伤害提升30%，持续4秒。
{FLAVOR}你问我心为何悲伤，你说浪花为何喧响？可知灯火为何遗忘！看呀，时间为何流淌？于梳洗中，我轻吟浅唱；沉默的你，何日返乡。

HYSILENS_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Hysilixes inflict multiple Damage over Time (DoT) effects on zombies and detonate them.
HYSILENS_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 蔓溢草可以为僵尸施加多种持续伤害。

HYSILENS_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Summons a whale to unleash a shockwave against all zombies on the lawn, inflicting all four Echo effects on them and detonating all DoTs.
HYSILENS_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}召唤鲸鱼对全场僵尸造成一次震击，为所有僵尸同时施加四种『余音』效果，并引爆所有持续伤害，僵尸拥有的其他减益效果越多，伤害越高，最高提升200%。

HYSILENS_TOOLTIP.en: Inflicts DoT effects and detonate them
HYSILENS_TOOLTIP.zh: 施加多种持续伤害并引爆

ICEAGEEX_LEVEL_NAME.zh: 冰窟大救援 - 第 {LEVEL_NUMBER} 天

ICEAGE_LEVEL_NAME.zh: 极寒冰窟 - 第 {LEVEL_NUMBER} 天

ICEBLOOM_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}She was very angry, some people thought she was spitting
ICEBLOOM_DESCRIPTION.zh: 作为植物世界风云榜“越丑越厉害”大奖的获得者，原始大王花看到自己不争气的小辈时只能感叹：“没想到褪了毛之后连战斗力都退化了，战斗力可不是靠吹出来的。”

ICEBLOOM_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Spit out slime that has slowing effect
ICEBLOOM_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: {KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}可以吐出具有减速效果的毒液

ICEBLOOM_TOOLTIP.zh: 吐出有减速效果的黏液

ICEBURG_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Don't get lost staring into Iceberg's adorably cute eyes. If you do, it will be your last step… but only if you're a zombie.
ICEBURG_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}使用：{STAT}一次性使用，接触时生效
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}自己爆炸，暂时冻结僵尸

{FLAVOR}别傻傻地盯着冰冻生菜的眼睛，如果你这样做了，这将是你生命中做的最后一件事…当然啦，这只对僵尸管用。

ICEBURG_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Iceberg Lettuces freeze a zombie when stepped on.
ICEBURG_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 冰冻生菜可以冻结踩到他的僵尸。

ICEBURG_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Freezes or chills every zombie on lawn.
ICEBURG_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}冻结或冷缓草坪上的每只僵尸。

ICEBURG_PLANTFOOD.en: Flash freezes all zombies on the lawn.
ICEBURG_PLANTFOOD.zh: 发光，接着冻结草坪上的所有僵尸。

ICEBURG_TOOLTIP.en: Freezes zombies that step on it, and extinguishes flames
ICEBURG_TOOLTIP.zh: 冻结踏上他的僵尸，熄灭火焰

ICELOTUS_COSTUME.zh: B级-滴水冰莲冰晶围巾装扮

ICESHROOM_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}“It’s not easy re-inventing yourself” says Ice-shroom after returning from an intensive stint of training in the coldest parts of the Antarctic. “It’s not often you get a second chance, but I’m back now, and this time I won’t be letting my fans or any of my friends down.” Cheering erupts as Ice-shroom steps onto the lawn.
ICESHROOM_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}“想要重塑自己并不容易”，从南极最寒冷的地带进行强化训练归来后，寒冰菇说。“不是每件事都有第二次机会。如今，我受训归来，我不会再让我的粉丝、我的挚友失望。”寒冰菇踏上草坪，掌声雷动。

ICESHROOM_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Smashes zombies in melee range. Emits a chilling aura that chills zombies.
ICESHROOM_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 击打近距离内的僵尸。释放寒气光环，冷缓僵尸。

ICESHROOM_DESCRIPTION_HINT.en: Cluster other Winter-mints plants around Ice-shroom to gain a massive damage bonus.
ICESHROOM_DESCRIPTION_HINT.zh: 把其它寒冬薄荷家族植物集中种植在寒冰菇附近，获取巨额伤害加成。

ICESHROOM_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Lobs several icicles at random zombies across the field.
ICESHROOM_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}随机向场地上的僵尸扔出数根冰柱。

ICEWEED_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Iceweed is excited to get the call-up to the big leagues and can't wait to start refrigerating zombies whilst inflicting damage on them. He insisted we say "whilst."
ICEWEED_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}无法被僵尸吃掉
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}免疫冻结
{FLAVOR}受到大联盟征召，寒冰地刺非常兴奋，等不及要冷藏僵尸並让他们吃吃苦头了。他执意要我们使用“並”字。

ICEWEED_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Iceweeds damage and chill zombies that walk over them.
ICEWEED_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 寒冰地刺可以冷缓并伤害踏在上面的僵尸。

ICEWEED_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Summons a sawblade that knockbacks and freezes all zombies in the column. Permanently increases damage.
ICEWEED_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}召唤一把锯片，将所在行的所有僵尸击退、冻结。还能永久提升它的伤害。

ICEWEED_TOOLTIP.zh: 伤害并冷缓踏在上面的僵尸

IDENTITY_RECONCILIATION_INTRO_TEXT.en: We have detected multiple different identities associated with you. On the following screen please review the data with each identity and select which one you would like to proceed with.
IDENTITY_RECONCILIATION_INTRO_TEXT.zh: 我们探测到有多个不同的身份与你相关连。请在之后的界面上检查每个身份的数据，并选择你想继续使用的。

IDENTITY_RECONCILIATION_SAVE_FAILURE.en: Identity save has failed. Please check your internet connection and try again.
IDENTITY_RECONCILIATION_SAVE_FAILURE.zh: 身份保存失败。请检查你的互联网连接，然后再试一次。

IDENTITY_RECONCILIATION_WARNING_TEXT.en: Are you sure you would like to proceed with this identity? This will be the permanent identity associated with you. All Arena Winstreak, Arena League, and Adventure progress will be lost on other identities.
IDENTITY_RECONCILIATION_WARNING_TEXT.zh: 你确定想要用这个身份来进行游戏吗？一旦确认，这个身份将会永远和您绑定。其它身份的竞技场连胜数、竞技场联赛阶级，甚至冒险进度都将会永远丢失。

IMITATER_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Having studied French Theater at Julienne, the Imitater went to the streets with his art, and has perfected his technique he calls "Potato stuck in a box."
IMITATER_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}可以模仿成大多数植物来让你在同一关卡内携带两株相同的植物

{FLAVOR}在切呈丝学会了法式喜剧后，模仿者完善了那项他称为“困在箱子里的土豆”的独门绝技，并带着他的杰作来到了街上。

IMITATER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Imitaters let you use two of the same plant during a level!
IMITATER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 模仿者可以让你在一个关卡内使用两株相同的植物！

IMITATER_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Performs Plant Food effect of the plant it's imitating.
IMITATER_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}执行所模仿植物的叶绿素效果。

IMITATER_PLANTFOOD.en: Performs Plant Food effect of the plant it's imitating.
IMITATER_PLANTFOOD.zh: 使它模仿的植物有叶绿素效果。

IMITATER_TOOLTIP.en: Lets you have two of the same plant

IMPATIENSSHOOTER_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}Periodically dyes herself, and when she reaches the third stage, she can release Plant Food to further enhance itself.

{FLAVOR}Impatiens Shooter, who has always wanted to be a high-rate makeup artist, has gained quite a following by posting selfies of herself with her petals dyed all sorts of different colors on social media, but doesn't know that everyone prefers her in her natural white petals.
IMPATIENSSHOOTER_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}隔一段时间会对自己染色，染色到第三阶段后可以释放叶绿素进一步强化自己。

{FLAVOR}一直想成为顶级化妆师的凤仙花射手虽然靠坚持不懈地在社交网络上上传自己染成各种颜色时的照片收获了一定的人气，可是她并不知道大家喜欢的其实是白色时的她。

IMPATIENSSHOOTER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Impatiens Shooters spit out dyed bullets to attack zombies in front of her. After a while, they dye themselves and fire more powerful bullets.
IMPATIENSSHOOTER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 凤仙花射手会吐出染色子弹攻击前方的僵尸。一段时间后，它们会为自己染色，发射更强大的子弹。

IMPATIENSSHOOTER_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: Immediately dye herself to her next coloration and fire a large barrage of dye seeds ahead of her.
IMPATIENSSHOOTER_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: 吐出大量染色子弹攻击前方的僵尸并使自身获得进阶染色效果。

IMPATIENSSHOOTER_TOOLTIP.en: Spits out dyed bullets to attack zombies ahead.
IMPATIENSSHOOTER_TOOLTIP.zh: 吐出染色子弹攻击前方的僵尸

IMPPEAR_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}Shoots frozen stars in ten directions.

{FLAVOR}Angel Starfruit often looks down Starfruit from the small towns, she believes that he is too lazy to even rotate and uninteresting.
IMPPEAR_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}可以向十个方向发射冰冻星星。

{FLAVOR}粉嫩的天使星星果小公举非常瞧不起来自小地方的星星果，她认为星星果连转动一下都懒，太没追求了。

IMPPEAR_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Angel Starfruits shoot frozen stars in ten directions
IMPPEAR_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 天使星星果可以向十个方向发射冰冻星星

IMPPEAR_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: Emit a large number of random stars in multiple directions.
IMPPEAR_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: 向多个方向发射大量随机星星。

IMPPEAR_TETO_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Synergy - [Strongest in Human History: Teto]: {STAT}When activating Plant Food, if Leeku is on the lawn, deals a certain amount of true damage to all obstacles and zombies on the lawn.
{FLAVOR}Teto Imp Pear makes zombies weaker. Of course, Imps don't like this setting. But... who cares about them anyway.

{KEYWORD}Artist: {STAT}Samie
{KEYWORD}Animator: {STAT}Geometry123
{KEYWORD}Origin: {STAT}PvZ 2: Reflourished
IMPPEAR_TETO_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}连携 - 【人类史上最强·重音】：{STAT}释放叶绿素时若场上存在初音葱，则额外对全场障碍物、僵尸造成一定量的真实伤害。
{FLAVOR}重音小鬼梨可以让僵尸变弱。当然，小鬼才不喜欢这种设定。不过……谁管它们啊。

{KEYWORD}美术：{STAT}Samie
{KEYWORD}动画：{STAT}Geometry123
{KEYWORD}归属：{STAT}PvZ 2 Reflourished

IMPPEAR_TETO_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: When zombies eat Teto Imp Pears, they become Imps. When Imps eat Teto Imp Pears, they are destroyed, releasing stunning gas.
IMPPEAR_TETO_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 吃了重音小鬼梨的僵尸会变成小鬼。如果小鬼吃了重音小鬼梨，它们则会死亡并释放晕眩气体。

IMPPEAR_TETO_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Randomly transforms five zombies on the lawn into Imps.
IMPPEAR_TETO_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}随机将草坪上的几只僵尸转换成小鬼。

IMPPEAR_TOOLTIP.en: Shoots frozen stars in ten directions
IMPPEAR_TOOLTIP.zh: 向十个方向发射高伤害的减速星星

INFERNO_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}cause continuous damage to zombies within the attack range.

"The Great Sage Equalling Heaven, the Winning Buddha, the Monkey King..." Kiwifruit wanted to show off all his titles to speak for himself. But reality is always cruel. In the eyes of zombies, he is just an edible fruit... nothing more...
INFERNO_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}可对攻击范围内的僵尸造成持续伤害。

{FLAVOR}“齐天大圣、斗战胜佛、美猴王……”猕猴桃恨不得把所有头衔都亮出来为自己代言。但现实总是残酷的，在僵尸眼里他只是个能吃的水果……而已……

INFERNO_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Kiwifruits pull out their staff to attack the nearest zombie and also do damage to the zombie in the range.
INFERNO_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 猕猴桃可以变出金箍棒攻击最近的僵尸，并对范围内的僵尸造成持续伤害。

INFERNO_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Enhances the power of the staff to inflict greater damage on zombies.
INFERNO_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}强化金箍棒的威力，使其能够对僵尸造成更高的伤害。

INFERNO_TOOLTIP.en: Conjures a staff to attack the nearest zombie
INFERNO_TOOLTIP.zh: 变出金箍棒攻击最近的僵尸，并对范围内的僵尸造成持续伤害。

INFLICT_CONDITION_ASH_COUNT_LABEL.zh: 让僵尸灰飞烟灭 {ACTIONS_LEFT} 次！

INFLICT_CONDITION_ASH_DESC.en: Use Cherry Bombs, Jalapenos and more to incinerate zombies!
INFLICT_CONDITION_ASH_DESC.zh: 使用樱桃炸弹、闪电芦苇、火爆辣椒等植物焚烧那些罪恶的灵魂！

INFLICT_CONDITION_DELAY_COUNT_LABEL.en: Butter, Sap or Stall Zombies {ACTIONS_LEFT} Times!
INFLICT_CONDITION_DELAY_COUNT_LABEL.zh: 让僵尸被缓速、被砸黄油或被树脂减速 {ACTIONS_LEFT} 次！

INFLICT_CONDITION_ELECTROCUTE_DESC.en: Use Electric Blueberries and more to zap zombies!
INFLICT_CONDITION_ELECTROCUTE_DESC.zh: 使用闪电芦苇、电击蓝莓等植物电死来势汹汹的僵尸大军！

INFLICT_CONDITION_KNOCKBACK_DESC.en: Use Chard Guard, Hurrikale and more to bounce back pesky zombies!
INFLICT_CONDITION_KNOCKBACK_DESC.zh: 使用原始豌豆射手、甜菜护卫、飓风甘蓝等植物击退可恶的僵尸！

INFLICT_CONDITION_REFRIGERATE_DESC.en: Use Winter Melons, Snow Peas and more to chill the undead!
INFLICT_CONDITION_REFRIGERATE_DESC.zh: 使用冰瓜投手、冰冻生菜、寒冰豌豆等植物冷缓、冻结前来的不死军团！

INFLICT_CONDITION_SUNBEAN_COUNT_LABEL.zh: 让 {ACTIONS_LEFT} 只僵尸获得阳光豆效果！

INTENSIVECARROT_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}"How do I revive defeated plants?" asks Intensive Carrot. "In a word: vitamins. Vitamins and sorcery."
INTENSIVECARROT_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}“你问我是怎么复活阵亡的植物的？”复活萝卜说：“很简单：维生素。维生素再加一点魔法。”

INTENSIVECARROT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Intensive Carrots bring eaten plants back to life.
INTENSIVECARROT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 复活萝卜可以救回堕入死亡深渊的植物。

INTENSIVECARROT_TOOLTIP.en: Brings eaten plants back to life

JACKOLANTERN_BACK_FOR_LIMITED_TIME.en: Jack o' Lantern is back for a limited time!

JACKOLANTERN_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}"When viewed from a far distance, Flame Flower Queen may be the most elegant and beautiful plant, but when you get closer, you will find that she is basically a fire-breathing female dinosaur." - A Zombie Adventurer's dying words (Cause of death: He was beaten to death by a group of army for daring to say that Fire Flower was a dinosaur).
JACKOLANTERN_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}「在远处观赏时，火焰花女王也许是我见过最优雅矜持的植物了，可当你靠近她时，就会发现她简直就是一头喷火的母恐龙。」——一位僵尸探险家的绝笔（死因：胆敢说火焰花是恐龙而被女神亲卫队群殴至死）

JACKOLANTERN_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Releases a line of flames to the ground

JACKOLANTERN_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Summons purple flames on random tiles on the lawn, that continuously deal fire damage to zombies.
JACKOLANTERN_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}在草坪上的随机地砖上召唤鬼火幽灵，持续对僵尸造成火焰伤害。

JACKOLANTERN_TOOLTIP.en: Releases a line of flames to the ground

JALAPENO_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}This jalapeno is one spicy character by day and The Macramé Vigilante by night. You might be wondering what his secret weapon is… it's knots.
JALAPENO_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}使用：{STAT}一次性使用，立即生效

{FLAVOR}火爆辣椒在白天只是个普普通通的辣椒，但到了晚上，他就会摇身一变成为花结守护侠！你问他的超能力是什么？那还用说吗，打结啊。

JALAPENO_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Jalapenos destroy an entire lane of zombies.
JALAPENO_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 火爆辣椒可以消灭整行的僵尸。

JALAPENO_TOOLTIP.en: Destroys an entire lane of zombies

JASMINE_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Jasmine, masquerading as a wolf in sheep's clothing, uses leaves and flowers to conceal her identity. It's truly cunning. Accidentally exposed, she turns adversity into fortune, winning the Gold Award for "Sheep's Clothing" and capturing the favor of the domineering CEO. In the end, she leads a happy life and rises to become the best-selling product at Jinjin Tea House.
JASMINE_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}茉莉奶绿作为一个绿茶婊为了掩饰自己，用叶子和花朵掩饰自己绿茶的身份实在是心机，一不小心被发现，但是因祸得福，获得了金金百花绿茶婊特等奖并获得霸道总裁青睐，最后过上了幸福的生活并登顶成为金金茶馆爆品。

JASMINE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Can release perfume to cause zombies within a 3x3 area to be affected by various negative status effects such as freeze, chill, nausea.
JASMINE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 可以释放香气使3x3范围内僵尸受到多种负面状态影响。

JASMINE_TOOLTIP.en: Causes various negative effects on zombies in a 3x3 area
JASMINE_TOOLTIP.zh: 可以释放香气使3x3范围内僵尸受到多种负面状态影响

JOUST_DOWN_FOR_MAINTENANCE.en: Oops! Arena is down for maintenance! Come back in 5 to 10 minutes!
JOUST_DOWN_FOR_MAINTENANCE.zh: 哎呀！竞技场还在维护！请等个 5 到 10 分钟之后再回来看看吧！

JOUST_DOWN_FOR_SERVER_STABILITY.en: Oops! Arena is down for maintenance! Come back in 5 to 10 minutes!
JOUST_DOWN_FOR_SERVER_STABILITY.zh: 哎呀！竞技场还在维护！请等个 5 到 10 分钟之后再回来看看吧！

JOUST_EXIT_DESCRIPTION.en: If you stop now you will lose this match.
JOUST_EXIT_DESCRIPTION.zh: 如果你现在退出，这场比赛将被记为失败。

JOUST_HOWTOPLAY_1_DESCRIPTION.en: Defeat zombies to score points. Score more than your opponent before time runs out to win!
JOUST_HOWTOPLAY_1_DESCRIPTION.zh: 击败僵尸来获得分数。于既定时间内获得比对手更多的分数即可获胜！

JOUST_HOWTOPLAY_2_DESCRIPTION.en: Zombies get more difficult and more valuable as you defeat them quickly. The further from your house they fall, the more you'll score!
JOUST_HOWTOPLAY_2_DESCRIPTION.zh: 击败僵尸的速度越快，僵尸就会变得更加耐打且更有价值。他们倒下时离你家越远，你获得的分数就越多！

JOUST_HOWTOPLAY_3_DESCRIPTION.en: Winning Arena matches rewards Crowns. Earn as many Crowns as you can to climb to the top of your leaderboard!
JOUST_HOWTOPLAY_3_DESCRIPTION.zh: 赢得竞技场比赛会回馈王冠。赚取尽可能多的王冠，登顶排行榜！

JOUST_HOWTOPLAY_4_DESCRIPTION.en: Place in the top ranks of your leaderboard for a promotion into a more competitive league with better rewards, and more challenging opponents.
JOUST_HOWTOPLAY_4_DESCRIPTION.zh: 位于排行榜前列的你将晋升至下一个竞争更为激烈的段位，这往往伴随着更丰厚的奖励和更具挑战性的对手。

JOUST_HOWTOPLAY_5_DESCRIPTION.en: Crowns from Arena matches also unlock Season prizes.
JOUST_HOWTOPLAY_5_DESCRIPTION.zh: 竞技场比赛获得的王冠也可以解锁赛季奖励。

JOUST_NEED_CONNECTION.en: Connect to the Internet for Arena
JOUST_NEED_CONNECTION.zh: 需要连接到互联网才能游玩竞技场

JOUST_NEED_PROGRESS.zh: 再收集 {COUNT} 株植物即可解锁。

JOUST_NOTIFICATION_TICKETS.en: A free Gauntlet for Arena is now available!
JOUST_NOTIFICATION_TICKETS.zh: 一支免费竞技场腕票现已可用！

JOUST_NOTIFICATION_TOURNAMENT_BEGIN.en: A new Arena tournament has begun. Aim for the top!
JOUST_NOTIFICATION_TOURNAMENT_BEGIN.zh: 新的竞技场赛程已经开始。瞄准最高点吧！

JOUST_NOTIFICATION_TOURNAMENT_ENDED.en: The Arena tournament has ended. Log in to collect your rewards!
JOUST_NOTIFICATION_TOURNAMENT_ENDED.zh: 当前赛程已经结束。登录收集你的奖励吧！

JOUST_NOTIFICATION_TOURNAMENT_ENDING.en: The Arena tournament is ending soon, secure your ranking!
JOUST_NOTIFICATION_TOURNAMENT_ENDING.zh: 当前赛程快要终止了，确保你的联赛等级不会下降！

JOUST_POINT_OF_LOSS_CALL_TO_ACTION.en: Would you like to add more time to beat this score?
JOUST_POINT_OF_LOSS_CALL_TO_ACTION.zh: 想要获得额外的时间来赢取更高分吗？

JOUST_POINT_OF_LOSS_CONFIRM_DESCRIPTION.en: {TIME} seconds have been added to the clock.  Good luck!
JOUST_POINT_OF_LOSS_CONFIRM_DESCRIPTION.zh: 计时器已增加 {TIME} 秒。祝你好运！

JOUST_POINT_OF_LOSS_DIALOG_TITLE.zh: 不要失去你的段位奖励！

JOUST_RESULTS_WINSTREAK_CALL_TO_ACTION.en: Win multiple games in a row, earn rewards!
JOUST_RESULTS_WINSTREAK_CALL_TO_ACTION.zh: 连续赢得多场比赛，赢取更多奖励！

JOUST_RESULTS_WINSTREAK_DIALOG.zh: 你拿到了所有的连胜奖励！

JOUST_RESULTS_WINSTREAK_TITLE_LOSS.zh: 你的连胜奖励已经被重置了。

JOUST_RESULTS_WINSTREAK_TITLE_RETAIN.zh: 你的连胜奖励被保留了。

JOUST_REWARD_STREAK_RETENTION_CALL_TO_AC.en: You lost, but you can still save your reward streak for the next match!
JOUST_REWARD_STREAK_RETENTION_CALL_TO_AC.zh: 你输了，但是你仍然可以在下一局保留你的连胜进度！

JOUST_REWARD_STREAK_RETENTION_TITLE.zh: 保持你的连胜奖励进度！

JOUST_TOURNAMENT_LEAGUE_REWARDS_DESCRIPT.en: Collect the most Crowns in your league and win the tournament!
JOUST_TOURNAMENT_LEAGUE_REWARDS_DESCRIPT.zh: 在你的段位获得最多王冠，即可赢得本赛程！

JOUST_TOURNAMENT_LEAGUE_REWARDS_DESCRIPT.en: Challengers who place in the top 3 each tournament move up a league, while the bottom 3 move down a league.
JOUST_TOURNAMENT_LEAGUE_REWARDS_DESCRIPT.zh: 每个赛程的前三名玩家将会上升一个段位，最后三名则会掉一个段位。

JOUST_TOURNAMENT_LEAGUE_REWARDS_SUBHEADE.zh: 各段位可以获得的最高奖励

JOUST_TOURNAMENT_PLACEMENT_RESULT_FTUE.en: Here are 5 Gauntlets to help you get started!
JOUST_TOURNAMENT_PLACEMENT_RESULT_FTUE.zh: 送你 5 个腕票，助你由此起步！

JOUST_UPDATE_AVAILABLE.en: A new Arena update is available. Update now!
JOUST_UPDATE_AVAILABLE.zh: 竞技场有更新了。现在更新吧！

KELPGUARD_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Kelp Guard keeps trying to break through its own speed bump, but has never succeeded.
KELPGUARD_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}植物特征：{STAT}绿色植物
{FLAVOR}海带守卫一直试图冲破自己的减速带，但是从来没有成功过。

KELPGUARD_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: The Kelp Guard can only be planted in seawater. It creates a speed bump that blocks both zombies and ocean currents.
KELPGUARD_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 海带守卫只能种在海水中，生成减速带并阻挡僵尸和洋流。

KELPGUARD_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Generates an indestructible speed bump. After a short charge, it knocks back zombies on it.
KELPGUARD_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}生成完好的减速带，此时减速带不会被破坏，并在短暂蓄力后击退减速带上的僵尸。

KELPGUARD_TOOLTIP.en: Creates a speed bump that blocks both zombies and ocean currents
KELPGUARD_TOOLTIP.zh: 生成减速带,阻挡僵尸和洋流

KERNELPULT_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}While working as an usher at the local movieplex, he saw "Fried Green Tomatoes" and found his higher calling. He packed up his husks, his kernels, his butter, and enlisted.
KERNELPULT_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}攻击细节：{STAT}微弱（玉米），普通（黄油）
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}黄油能让僵尸定身

{FLAVOR}当他还在当地的一家电影院当服务员时，他看到了“油炸绿西红柿”，从此他便找到了更高的植生目标。他收拾好谷壳、谷粒和黄油，应征入伍。

KERNELPULT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Kernel-pults fling corn kernels and immobilizing butter at zombies.
KERNELPULT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 玉米投手可以向僵尸投掷玉米粒和黄油。

KERNELPULT_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Triggers a butter storm that stuns every zombie on the lawn for a few seconds.
KERNELPULT_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}制造一场黄油风暴，使草坪上的所有僵尸眩晕几秒钟。

KERNELPULT_PLANTFOOD.en: Triggers a butter storm that stuns every zombie on the lawn for a few seconds.
KERNELPULT_PLANTFOOD.zh: 发射黄油风雷，让草坪上的每只僵尸眩晕几秒钟。

KERNELPULT_TOOLTIP.en: Flings corn kernels and butter at zombies
KERNELPULT_TOOLTIP.zh: 向僵尸投掷玉米粒或黄油

KIWIBEAST_DEPRECATED_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}The origin of the Pixel Peashooter has always been an unsolved mystery, with many people debating whether it is a plant or not. "Actually, I don't think it's important. I can defend the zombie invasion with my friends on the lawn is enough." he said this!
KIWIBEAST_DEPRECATED_DESCRIPTION.zh: 像素豌豆射手的问世一直是一个未解之谜，很多人都在为它是否是植物而争论。“其实，我觉得这并不重要，我能在战场上和我的伙伴们一起抵挡僵尸的入侵，这就足够了。”它对此这样说！

KIWIBEAST_DEPRECATED_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Damage will increases with the number of fired peas.
KIWIBEAST_DEPRECATED_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 发射的豌豆伤害随着数量的增加而增加。

KIWIBEAST_DEPRECATED_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFO.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Shoots a barrage of fast pixel peas, with damage increasing based on the number of Pixel Peashooters currently on the lawn.
KIWIBEAST_DEPRECATED_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFO.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}发射一连串高速像素豌豆，伤害随当前场上存在的像素豌豆射手的数量而增加。

KIWIBEAST_DEPRECATED_TOOLTIP.en: Increases damage with the number of fired peas.
KIWIBEAST_DEPRECATED_TOOLTIP.zh: 发射的豌豆伤害随着数量的增加而增加

KIWIBEAST_DESCRIPTION.en: {KEYWORD}"I like to keep an even keel," says Kiwibeast. "But zombies... oooh... zombies make me so mad! And when I get mad... RARRRRRGGG!"
KIWIBEAST_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}长大时可以击退僵尸

{FLAVOR}“我是想冷静的啊！但那些僵尸…”野兽猕猴桃愤怒地说道：“啊啊…那些僵尸弄得我好生气！！ 我只要一生气…就…哼哼…啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！”

KIWIBEAST_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Kiwibeasts emit damaging thumps, and become bigger and more powerful the more they are hurt by zombies.
KIWIBEAST_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 野兽猕猴桃可以发出具有极大破坏力的撞击声，僵尸对他的伤害得越多，他就会变得越强。

KIWIBEAST_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Immediately grows to its last stage and deal massive damage in the surrounding area.
KIWIBEAST_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}立即成长到终极阶段，对周围区域造成巨大伤害。

KIWIBEAST_TOOLTIP.en: Becomes more powerful as it takes damage
KIWIBEAST_TOOLTIP.zh: 震击附近僵尸，随着受到伤害变得更强力

KONGFU_FINAL_BATTLE_LEVEL_NAME.zh: 功夫世界 - 最终之战

LASER_BEAN_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}After a laser eye surgery had gone horribly right, Laser Bean gained a sense of purpose and a new-found affinity for competitive staring contests.
LASER_BEAN_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}范围：{STAT}一行内的全部僵尸

{FLAVOR}在一场成功得令人发指的眼部激光手术之后，激光豆终于找到了植生的意义——他现在已经在瞪眼比赛中战无不胜了。

LASER_BEAN_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Laser Beans fire down a lane, hitting all zombies ahead of it.
LASER_BEAN_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 激光豆可以攻击前方一行的僵尸。

LASER_BEAN_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Fires a huge laser beam at all zombies in the row, dealing huge damage to each zombie.
LASER_BEAN_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}向一行的所有僵尸发射巨大的激光束，对每只僵尸造成巨大伤害。

LASER_BEAN_TOOLTIP.en: Shoots a laser that pierces through zombies
LASER_BEAN_TOOLTIP.zh: 发射可以穿透僵尸的激光

LAVAGUAVA_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Lava Guava frowns with barely-repressed rage. He’s trying to keep it in check. He’s trying so hard. But one day some zombie’s going to push him too far, and he can’t be held responsible for the consequences.
LAVAGUAVA_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}使用：{STAT}一次性使用，需要接触
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}自己爆发，伤害附近僵尸
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}在一个地砖内创建一个燃烧着的岩浆湖

{FLAVOR}岩浆番石榴皱着眉头，怒气冲冲。他想努力克制自己的这种情绪，但总会有几只僵尸会不知死活地跑去惹他。没办法，这是它们自找的，他也不用负责任了。

LAVAGUAVA_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Lava Guavas erupt, creating a lava pool that burns zombies.
LAVAGUAVA_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 岩浆番石榴可以喷发，随后创造一个岩浆池，燃烧踏上的僵尸。

LAVAGUAVA_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Fractures the ground in front, dealing damage over several seconds.
LAVAGUAVA_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}撕裂前方的地面，造成数秒伤害。

LAVAGUAVA_TOOLTIP.en: Erupts and leaves behind a burning lava pool
LAVAGUAVA_TOOLTIP.zh: 爆发并留下一池炙热的岩浆

LAWNBOWL_2023_PINATA_MEGA.zh: 草坪碗彩陶至尊捆绑包

LAWNBOWL_2023_PINATA_MINI.zh: 草坪碗彩陶迷你捆绑包

LAWNBOWL_24_PREMIUM_PINATA_BUNDLE.zh: 草坪碗高级彩陶捆绑包

LEAVE_DANGER_ROOM_GAME.en: Do you want to return to the world map? Leaving will count as a loss and you will need to restart this level.
LEAVE_DANGER_ROOM_GAME.zh: 你确定要回到世界地图吗？离开会被算作失败一次，并且下次需要重新游玩该等级关卡。

Are you sure you want to exit the level?

LEAVE_GAME_BODY.zh:
你确定要退出这个关卡吗？
退出之后，本关的所有进度都会丢失。
