LEAVE_GAME_BODY_SHORT.zh: 你确定要退出这个关卡吗？

LEAVE_GAME_BODY_THYMED_EVENT.en:
Are you sure you want to exit the level?
Doing so will lose your current progress and earned energy in this level.
LEAVE_GAME_BODY_THYMED_EVENT.zh:
你确定要退出这个关卡吗？
退出之后，本关的所有进度都会丢失。

LEMONAIDER_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}Randomly throw a bottle of lemonade which can freeze and slow down zombies within range.

{FLAVOR}Lemonaider is very sour and also a bartender at Vincent's underground bar.
LEMONAIDER_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}随机投射整颗柠檬和柠檬汽水，柠檬可以让僵尸减速，柠檬汽水可以让范围内僵尸冰冻定身并减速。

{FLAVOR}冰汽青柠很酸，是Vincent地下酒吧的酒保。

LEMONAIDER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Randomly throw lemons or a bottle of lemonade.
LEMONAIDER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 随机投射整颗柠檬和柠檬汽水。

LEMONAIDER_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Throws bottle of lemonades at every zombie on the lawn.
LEMONAIDER_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}向草坪上的每个僵尸扔出一瓶柠檬汽水。

LEMONAIDER_TOOLTIP.en: Randomly throw lemons or a powerful one.
LEMONAIDER_TOOLTIP.zh: 随机投射整颗柠檬和柠檬汽水

LEVELUPQUEST_PEASHOOTER_TITLE.zh: 免费试用高等级的豌豆射手！

LEVELUPQUEST_REPEATER_TITLE.zh: 免费试用高等级的双发豌豆！

LEVELUPQUEST_SUNFLOWER_TITLE.zh: 免费试用高等级的向日葵！

LEVITATER_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}Levitated zombies cannot be Blovered.

{FLAVOR}"I'm a bit different from my other 'tater cousins," explains Levitater. "Chief among those differences, I'd say, is that I don't explode on contact, or at all. I stick around!"
LEVITATER_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}被该植物悬浮的僵尸无法再被三叶草吹走

{FLAVOR}“我的其它土豆兄弟们与我有些不一样”，悬浮洋芋说：“首先，我觉得吧，最大的不同点就是——我不会一碰就炸，我甚至根本就不会炸！更不会凭空消失！”

LEVITATER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 悬浮洋芋可以让随机僵尸悬浮起来。

LEVITATER_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Knock back multiple zombies through levitation. Zombies knocked back have a chance of being tossed off the lawn.
LEVITATER_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}让僵尸悬浮起来，击退它们。被击退的僵尸有概率被扔出草坪。

LIGHTNINGREED_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}He can remove the invisibility effect of Arbiter-X.

{FLAVOR}This may come as a shock, but Lightning Reed has a serious passion for ham radio. His call sign is "sHaN d1AN Lu Way." You can tune in every Tuesday to hear him read the classics to elderly plants. This week: Seeds and Sensibility. Back then he was known as "Purple Reed" but today... not anymore...
LIGHTNINGREED_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}可以解除仲裁者 X 的隐身效果。

{FLAVOR}说出来可能会让你大吃一惊：闪电芦苇对主持业余电台拥有着无比的热情。他甚至还有自己的呼号：“sHaN d1AN Lu Way”。你可以在每周二收听他给老植物诵读经典。本周的节目是：《种子与情感》。

LIGHTNINGREED_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Lightning Reeds shoot lightning at the nearest zombie up to one lane away. The bolt will then arc and hit other zombies.
LIGHTNINGREED_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 闪电芦苇可以向周围发射闪电链，闪电链会波及到附近的其他僵尸。

LIGHTNINGREED_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Create a storm cloud that damages random zombies on the lawn.
LIGHTNINGREED_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}创造一朵风暴雷云，随机对草坪上的僵尸造成伤害。

LIGHTNINGREED_PLANTFOOD.en: Launches a cloud that travels around the lawn, zapping zombies with lightning as it hovers over them.
LIGHTNINGREED_PLANTFOOD.zh: 喷出一朵雷云环绕草坪，盘旋在僵尸上空，用闪电轰击僵尸。

LIGHTNINGREED_TOOLTIP.en: Zaps several chickens or zombies per strike
LIGHTNINGREED_TOOLTIP.zh: 每次攻击会电击多只鸡或僵尸

LILYPAD_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}Can also be planted under non-aquatic plants.

{FLAVOR}Not many people know this, but Lily Pad absolutely loves square dancing. There he is, a circular plant gliding across the dance floor making squares. He loves how it pushes his boundaries and really makes him think outside the sphere.
LILYPAD_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}使用：{STAT}水生植物，非水生植物可以种在他身上

{FLAVOR}很少有植物知道睡莲叶其实很喜欢跳方块舞。瞧，一株圆形的植物，却在舞池中划出了方形的轮廓。跳脱“形”的拘束，投入对于“真我”的思考，这才是他所爱的。

LILYPAD_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Lily Pads let you plant non-aquatic plants on top of them.
LILYPAD_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 睡莲叶能让你在水上种植非水生植物。

LILYPAD_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Creates Lily Pads in adjacent spaces. If the adjacent space has Lily Pads- it will heal them instead.
LILYPAD_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}在相邻的地方创建睡莲叶。如果那里已经有睡莲叶了，则会治愈它们。

LILYPAD_TOOLTIP.en: Lets you plant non-aquatic plants on top of it

LITTLEREPEATER_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}Each time, it fires two different types of pea shots.
{FLAVOR}If you're good to Mini Repeater, he'll repay you double. If you cross him, you might get double the payback. Of course, he has great relationships—everyone's favorite thing to do is lend him money.
LITTLEREPEATER_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}每次会发射不同的两种豌豆子弹。
{FLAVOR}如果你对迷你双重射手好，他会加倍报答。如果你惹了他，那你可能会得到加倍的反击。当然他的人际关系相当好，大家最愿意做的就是借钱给他。

LITTLEREPEATER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Mini Repeater can fire two peas at once.
LITTLEREPEATER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 迷你双重射手能一次发射两颗豌豆。

LITTLEREPEATER_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Fires a continuous string of random types of peas, with a giant pea as the finale that deals massive damage to the target.
LITTLEREPEATER_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}连续发射一串随机种类的豌豆，压轴的巨型豌豆对目标造成巨大伤害。

LITTLEREPEATER_TOOLTIP.en: Fires two peas in a row to attack enemies
LITTLEREPEATER_TOOLTIP.zh: 连续发射两发豌豆攻击敌人。

LOCAL_NOTE_LOD_BIRTHDAY_1.en: Day 3 of Birthdayz Party is on! Play now and take a bite out of Birthday Cake Pharoah.
LOCAL_NOTE_LOD_BIRTHDAY_1.zh: 生日派对第三天开始啦！快来尝尝生日蛋糕（法老僵尸）吧！

LOCAL_NOTE_LOD_BIRTHDAY_2.en: Play day 4 of the Birthdayz Party event right now for zombies jet-packed with presents!
LOCAL_NOTE_LOD_BIRTHDAY_2.zh: 现在游玩生日派对第四天，打败背着礼包外壳喷射器的僵尸！

LOCAL_NOTE_LOD_BIRTHDAY_3.en: Gargantuar has crashed today’s Birthdayz Party. Play now to wrap him up!
LOCAL_NOTE_LOD_BIRTHDAY_3.zh: 巨人僵尸闯入了今日的生日派对。立即开玩，把他重新打包回礼物盒中！

LOCAL_NOTE_LOD_FEASTIVUS_2014_1.en: Feastivus Day 2 is on! Do I hear reindeer on the lawn? Play now!
LOCAL_NOTE_LOD_FEASTIVUS_2014_1.zh: 仲冬圣诞第2天来了！我听见草坪上驯鹿的声音了吗？现在游玩！

LOCAL_NOTE_LOD_FEASTIVUS_2014_10.en: It’s beginning to look a lot like the end of Feastivus. Only a few days left. Play now!
LOCAL_NOTE_LOD_FEASTIVUS_2014_10.zh: 仲冬圣诞已至末梢，佳节余下不足数日，快快开玩吧！

LOCAL_NOTE_LOD_FEASTIVUS_2014_11.en: It’s the final day of Feastivus! Fa-la-la-la-last chance!
LOCAL_NOTE_LOD_FEASTIVUS_2014_11.zh: 今日已是仲冬圣诞佳节最后一天！抓紧最后时机颂唱圣歌！

LOCAL_NOTE_LOD_FEASTIVUS_2014_2.en: Get double Snowballs when you win a power up in Feastivus. Snowball fight is on!
LOCAL_NOTE_LOD_FEASTIVUS_2014_2.zh: 佳节期间可赢取成双的雪球指。快快搓起雪球开战互丢吧！

LOCAL_NOTE_LOD_FEASTIVUS_2014_3.en: Win Snow Pea’s winter hat collection. Keep your brains warm. Feastivus is on!
LOCAL_NOTE_LOD_FEASTIVUS_2014_3.zh: 赢取寒冰豌豆的冬日帽子装束，暖和你的脑子！仲冬圣诞佳节已至！

LOCAL_NOTE_LOD_FEASTIVUS_2014_4.en: Try out Sap-fling in Feastivus today. Stickier than fruitcake! Play now.
LOCAL_NOTE_LOD_FEASTIVUS_2014_4.zh: 于仲冬圣诞之日试用树脂投手。感受那比水果蛋糕还如胶似漆的浆果！开玩，就现在。

LOCAL_NOTE_LOD_FEASTIVUS_2014_5.en: Win 5 in a row and get special Feastivus rewards from Señor Piñata. He loves a good holiday bash!
LOCAL_NOTE_LOD_FEASTIVUS_2014_5.zh: 连续完成 5 场复活节彩陶盛宴，赢取来自彩陶玩偶的奖励。耶稣会喜欢这次节日盛典的！

LOCAL_NOTE_LOD_FEASTIVUS_2014_6.en: Day 11 of Feastivus is on. The Imps have been hung by the Gargantuars with care. Don't miss out!
LOCAL_NOTE_LOD_FEASTIVUS_2014_6.zh: 仲冬圣诞第十一天开始了，小鬼僵尸被巨人僵尸小心地背着，不要放过他们！

LOCAL_NOTE_LOD_FEASTIVUS_2014_7.en: Sap-fling is back for Day 12 of Feastivus. Pinecones, away!
LOCAL_NOTE_LOD_FEASTIVUS_2014_7.zh: 树脂投手在仲冬圣诞第十二天回归。松果走起！

LOCAL_NOTE_LOD_FEASTIVUS_2014_8.en: Play Feastivus and start off the New Year with a fresh brain!
LOCAL_NOTE_LOD_FEASTIVUS_2014_8.zh: 圣诞佳节畅玩之后用一副清爽的脑子开始新的一年！

LOCAL_NOTE_LOD_FEASTIVUS_2014_9.en: Feastivus is on! The holidays haven’t stopped, and neither has Gargantuar in his ugly sweater. Play now.
LOCAL_NOTE_LOD_FEASTIVUS_2014_9.zh: 圣诞佳节已经开始了！假期尚未结束，巨人僵尸同样不会脱下那件丑陋的毛衣。开玩，就现在。

LOCAL_NOTE_LOD_GOLIVE_01.en: 24-hour zombie sneak attack! Battle zombies from all worlds in a special level for big prizes!
LOCAL_NOTE_LOD_GOLIVE_01.zh: 全天候僵尸秘密进攻！在特殊关卡中打败来自各个世界的僵尸，赢得大奖！

LOCAL_NOTE_LOD_GOLIVE_02.en: 24-hour zombie party level is live! Complete {LARGE_PINATA_INTERVAL} parties in a row and win bigger prizes.
LOCAL_NOTE_LOD_GOLIVE_02.zh: 全天候的僵尸盛宴正在进行！完成累计 {LARGE_PINATA_INTERVAL} 次彩陶盛宴，就能赢得大奖！

LOCAL_NOTE_LOD_GOLIVE_03.en: Piñata Party is now live! Frantic Zombie Mayhem from all worlds at once. Play now!
LOCAL_NOTE_LOD_GOLIVE_03.zh: 彩陶盛宴正在进行！来自各个世界的疯狂僵尸大杂烩，现在游玩！

LOCAL_NOTE_LOD_GOLIVE_04.en: It's Piñata Party Time. Complete {LARGE_PINATA_INTERVAL} parties in a row and meet Senor Piñata!
LOCAL_NOTE_LOD_GOLIVE_04.zh: 到了欢度彩陶盛宴的时候了。完成累计 {LARGE_PINATA_INTERVAL} 次彩陶盛宴，就能遇见超大号的彩陶玩偶！

LOCAL_NOTE_LOD_GOLIVE_05.en: It's 24 hours of Zombie Party Time! Your next Piñata Party is ready. Play now!
LOCAL_NOTE_LOD_GOLIVE_05.zh: 现在到了全天候的僵尸派对时间！下一场彩陶盛宴已到来，可以开始畅玩了！

LOCAL_NOTE_LOD_GOLIVE_06.en: The latest Piñata Party is closing soon! Finish now to beat Señor Piñata.
LOCAL_NOTE_LOD_GOLIVE_06.zh: 当前彩陶盛宴即将闭幕！立即完成挑战来敲开彩陶玩偶！

LOCAL_NOTE_LOD_GOLIVE_07.en: Just one more Piñata Party to get the {LARGE_PINATA_INTERVAL}-streak Señor Piñata! Ending soon.
LOCAL_NOTE_LOD_GOLIVE_07.zh: 再来一场彩陶盛宴，就能获得{LARGE_PINATA_INTERVAL}连击彩陶玩偶！马上结束了。

LOCAL_NOTE_LOD_GOLIVE_08.en: Hey, Piñata Party animal! Hurry on over for a shot at Señor Piñata. Ends soon.
LOCAL_NOTE_LOD_GOLIVE_08.zh: 你好，爱玩彩陶盛宴的小家伙！赶紧来这边与大彩陶玩偶合个影，盛宴就要结束了。

LOCAL_NOTE_LOD_PARTY_ANIMAL.en: Piñata Party animal! Play now for a shot at Señor Piñata.
LOCAL_NOTE_LOD_PARTY_ANIMAL.zh: 爱玩彩陶盛宴的小家伙！快来完成挑战，与大彩陶玩偶合影。

LOCAL_NOTE_LOD_PARTY_TIME.en: It's Piñata Party time. Win {LARGE_PINATA_INTERVAL} in a row to meet Señor Piñata!
LOCAL_NOTE_LOD_PARTY_TIME.zh: 到了欢度彩陶盛宴的时候了。完成累计 {LARGE_PINATA_INTERVAL} 次彩陶盛宴，就能遇见超大号的彩陶玩偶！

LOCAL_NOTE_LOD_PLAY_TODAY.zh: 游玩今天的彩陶盛宴，从而在明天赢得更多！

LOCAL_NOTE_LOD_TODAY.zh: 今天的彩陶盛宴开启了！快去击败僵尸吧！

LOCAL_NOTE_LOD_WIN_5.en: Win {LARGE_PINATA_INTERVAL} Piñata Parties in a row for big prizes!

LONGMALILY_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}Can attack independently or be planted on top of other plants, enhancing its own abilities when stacked.
{FLAVOR}Longma Lily has a bit of an identity crisis. "Am I a dragon? A horse? Or just a flower?" he always wonders. He used to hang out with a monk, a pig, and a monkey, but retired to the lawn in search of a peaceful life. Just please don't ask him to carry luggage anymore.
LONGMALILY_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}能够独立攻击或与其他植物叠种，叠种后增强自身能力。
{FLAVOR}藕花白龙有点身份认知危机。“我是条龙？是匹马？还是仅仅是一朵花？”他总是这样想。他过去常和一个和尚、一头猪以及一只猴子混在一起，但他为了追求平静的生活退休到了草坪上。只是千万别让他再挑担子了。

LTE_EVENTS_BTL_DESC_FUNTIME_LVL_18.en:
Defeat 80 Ice Weasels
Ara...☆ It's♡the♡eighteenth♡level♡ne~♡...Meow~♪ (Kakaa's backlit cheek-holding.jpg) Those baka won't understand... About the 'beauty of difficult levels'♡. If my existence has meaning, it must be 'making levels'☆. So—humans trying using Power Ups will be 'eliminated'♪ (whisper) Well... Cheaters in 3D reality are the worst! ★ Made by Kakaa
LTE_EVENTS_BTL_DESC_FUNTIME_LVL_18.zh:
击杀80只冰鼬
诶多……☆是♡十♡八♡关♡呢♡～喵～♪（kakaa逆光捧脸.jpg）那群八嘎是不会懂的呀……关于「难关の美好」♡呐，如果说吾の存在有意义的话、那一定是因为「做·关·卡」吧☆？所以呢—妄图用金手指污染这份「爱」的人类、都会被吾「抹」「杀」「掉」喔♪（小声）嘛……用金手指的讨厌的八嘎三次元最恶心了啊混蛋！★                                                            made by kakaa

LTE_EVENTS_BTL_DESC_NEWYEAR_LVL_1.en: During the Spring Festival, mummified monsters suddenly invaded the city. People were both shocked and delighted, treating the zombies as part of the holiday performance. Everyone transcended time and space, dancing fervently, and shared joyful moments with the zombies!
LTE_EVENTS_BTL_DESC_NEWYEAR_LVL_1.zh: 春节时节，埃及僵尸突然闯入了城市。人们既惊又乐，将僵尸当作节日表演。大家穿越时空，跳起热烈的舞蹈，与僵尸共度欢乐时光！

LTE_EVENTS_BTL_DESC_NEWYEAR_LVL_11.en: It is said that dinosaurs became extinct due to a meteorite impact...
LTE_EVENTS_BTL_DESC_NEWYEAR_LVL_11.zh: 据说恐龙是因流星而灭绝的哦...

LTE_EVENTS_BTL_DESC_NEWYEAR_LVL_12.en:
Level Feature: Each wave of zombies will unleash harmless Bug Bot Imps from the sap.
Objective: Defeat {NUMBER} Bug Bot Imps.
LTE_EVENTS_BTL_DESC_NEWYEAR_LVL_12.zh:
本关特性：每波僵尸到来时树脂上就会钻出无害的机械虫小鬼
目标：击败 {NUMBER} 只机器蛛虫小鬼僵尸

LTE_EVENTS_BTL_DESC_NEWYEAR_LVL_13.en: The breath of the Jurassic, the exhalation of dinosaurs. They roam in the twilight, armored zombies, guarding this ancient and mysterious land.
LTE_EVENTS_BTL_DESC_NEWYEAR_LVL_13.zh: 侏罗纪的气息，是恐龙的呼吸，它们在黄昏的余晖中巡游，身披着盔甲的僵尸，守卫着这片古老而神秘的土地。

LTE_EVENTS_BTL_DESC_NEWYEAR_LVL_16.en: The distant sea, even if mountains and rivers stretch for thousands of miles, without a hundred thoughts embedded, following the waves, becomes a remarkable rainbow. Glaring in the shimmer, crossing through the darkness, moving towards dawn, encountering the first light marks the beginning of success.
LTE_EVENTS_BTL_DESC_NEWYEAR_LVL_16.zh: 遥远的海，纵使山河万里，不镶百点思绪，与海浪相追随，便是出奇的彩虹，于闪光中刺眼，跨过黑暗，走向黎明，遇见了曙光，便是成功的开始

LTE_EVENTS_BTL_DESC_NEWYEAR_LVL_2.en: Ignite the entire desolate land, turning sand and stones into scorched earth!
LTE_EVENTS_BTL_DESC_NEWYEAR_LVL_2.zh: 点燃整片荒芜之地，沙石化为焦土！

LTE_EVENTS_BTL_DESC_TIMESPACEECHOES_S13_.en: Use selected plants to protect at least 1 plant in danger
LTE_EVENTS_BTL_DESC_TIMESPACEECHOES_S13_.zh: 使用选定的植物保护至少 1 株处于危险中的植物

LTE_EVENTS_BTL_DESC_TIMESPACEECHOES_S5_L.en: In the deep recesses of the Fairytale Forest, a tenacious garlic stands tall like a brilliant star, proudly rising from the abyss of despair. Wielding a magical staff bestowed by nature, it faces the chaotic zombie horde with fearless resolve. Its bravery and hope illuminate the hearts of all living beings, protecting this once verdant paradise.
LTE_EVENTS_BTL_DESC_TIMESPACEECHOES_S5_L.zh: 在童话森林的幽邃深处，坚韧不拔的大蒜犹如一颗璀璨星辰，傲然挺立于绝望的深渊。它挥舞着自然赋予的魔法权杖，以无畏之姿，独挑群魔乱舞的僵尸大军。它的英勇与希望，点亮着所有生灵心中的光芒，守护着这片曾经的绿色乐土。

LTE_EVENTS_DESC_3RD_ANNIVERSARY.en: Welcome to the 3rd Anniversary Thymed Event! Here, you can earn rich rewards. With you on this journey, it truly becomes the anniversary celebration!
LTE_EVENTS_DESC_3RD_ANNIVERSARY.zh: 欢迎来到三周年主题任务，在这里你可以获得丰富的奖励，一路有你才是三周年！

LTE_EVENTS_DESC_4TH_ANNIVERSARY.en: Four years, it seems like just a dream, and the dream and reality, seem to have no boundaries.
LTE_EVENTS_DESC_4TH_ANNIVERSARY.zh: 四年，似乎只是一场梦，而梦与现实，好像没有分界。

LTE_EVENTS_DESC_ADV-PIRATE.en: These swashbuckling zombies ain't landlubbers but they're making an exception for your lawn! Play through the Pirates o' the Seas event and send these pirates sailing! The Limited Thyme Event is active for a limited thyme!
LTE_EVENTS_DESC_ADV-PIRATE.zh: 这些侠盗剑客僵尸可不是旱鸭子，但望到你的草坪，它们决定强势登陆！快来参加港湾海盗活动，让这些海盗回到海上去！限时活动时间有限，赶紧来玩吧！

LTE_EVENTS_DESC_ADV_MGP.en: Join Mega Gatling Pea and a squad of toughest friends in the latest installment of Mega Gatling Pea Adventures.
LTE_EVENTS_DESC_ADV_MGP.zh: 在最新一期的超级机枪豌豆大冒险中，加入超级机枪豌豆，加入一队最强大的朋友。

LTE_EVENTS_DESC_ADV_PIRATE.en: Taar'be zombies in ey waters! Make ready for em' boarding partiez and prepare for a zailing in them Zeas.
LTE_EVENTS_DESC_ADV_PIRATE.zh: 海里有僵尸！准备迎接他们的登船队伍，咱要在这海域扬帆起航！

LTE_EVENTS_DESC_BEACH.en: Sun, Sand and Zombie-slaying fun! Grab your sunscreen and play through the Big Beach Brawl event, it's time to make some waves and take down those beach-bumming zombies! The Limited Thyme Event is active for a limited thyme!
LTE_EVENTS_DESC_BEACH.zh: 太阳，沙子和僵尸杀戮的乐趣！带上防晒霜，参加“海滩大混战”活动，是时候掀起波澜，打倒那些在海滩上流浪的僵尸了！限定可使用逆时草！

LTE_EVENTS_DESC_BIRTHDAY.en: Happy Birthdayz! Embark on a brand new Thymed Adventure with Dave, Penny and the gang to celebrate the start of PvZ2. There will be cake, zombies and even a special guest. Don't miss out on the fun as this Thymed Event is only available for a limited time!
LTE_EVENTS_DESC_BIRTHDAY.zh: 祝你生日快乐！快来游玩 31 个限时活动关卡，一起庆祝《植物大战僵尸》的 13 岁生日！欢迎进入青春期，僵王博士！限时活动时间有限，赶紧来玩吧！

LTE_EVENTS_DESC_BIRTHDAYZ.en: Happy Birthdayz! Embark on a new Thymed Adventure with Dave, Penny and the gang to celebrate the start of PvZ2.
LTE_EVENTS_DESC_BIRTHDAYZ.zh: 生日快乐！快来与戴夫、潘妮，以及其他伙伴一起踏上新的限时冒险之旅，一同庆祝《植物大战僵尸 2》诞辰。

LTE_EVENTS_DESC_CARNIVAL.en: Is that a zombie on stilts?! Play through our Backyard Big Top experience! The Thymed Event is only active for a limited time!
LTE_EVENTS_DESC_CARNIVAL.zh: 啥？踩高跷的僵尸？来试试 30 个全新的“后院马戏团”关卡吧！活动时间有限，赶紧来玩吧！

LTE_EVENTS_DESC_CERYDRA.en: Chess is the art of sacrifice. Your hands must accept death before touching the board.
LTE_EVENTS_DESC_CERYDRA.zh: 棋是牺牲的艺术。因此，棋手须首先立下必死的决心。

LTE_EVENTS_DESC_FEASTIVUS.en: Even Zomboss loves Feastivus! Play 30 levels, earn coins and seeds to some pretty special plants! Remember, Feastivus only comes once a year.
LTE_EVENTS_DESC_FEASTIVUS.zh: 就连僵王都喜欢仲冬圣诞！游玩 30 道关卡，赚取金币和某些特别特殊的植物种子！记住，每年只有一次仲冬圣诞。

LTE_EVENTS_DESC_FIFTHANNIVERSARY.en: Five autumns shared the helm with grace, we brew stardust in time's embrace!
LTE_EVENTS_DESC_FIFTHANNIVERSARY.zh: 幸得同舟五度秋，今邀星斗酿醴泉！欢迎来到一年一度的周年主题任务！

LTE_EVENTS_DESC_FOODFIGHT.en: It's time to Food Fight! Battle your way through 20 new zombie filled levels to earn piñata, coins and seeds! This Food Fight Event is only active for a limited time!
LTE_EVENTS_DESC_FOODFIGHT.zh: 有人提到了食物大战吗？！完成 15 个全新关卡，赢取彩陶、金币和火鸡投手种子！食物大战活动时间有限，赶紧来玩吧！

LTE_EVENTS_DESC_FUNTIME.en: Spring banquet, a cup of green wine, and a song to accompany.
LTE_EVENTS_DESC_FUNTIME.zh: 春日宴，绿酒一杯歌一遍。

LTE_EVENTS_DESC_HARVESTFESTIVAL.en: Welcome to the Harvest! Protect our lawn and your crops against an onslaught of zombies. Plants to the rescue! Remember that Thymed Events are only active for a limited time.
LTE_EVENTS_DESC_HARVESTFESTIVAL.zh: 欢迎来到丰收节！尸潮蜂拥而至，快来保护你的草坪，守护你的植物吧——他们非常需要你的援助！别忘了，限时活动时间有限，赶紧来玩吧！

LTE_EVENTS_DESC_LAWNBOWL.en: Plants love sportz - and so do zombies! Help defeat Team Zombie in our inaugural Lawnbowl! The Thymed Event is only active for a limited time!
LTE_EVENTS_DESC_LAWNBOWL.zh: 植物们可喜欢运动了——僵尸也是！快来首届草坪碗大赛中，帮助植物们击败僵尸队吧！限时活动时间有限，赶紧来玩吧！

LTE_EVENTS_DESC_LAWNBOWL2.en: It’s back, time for the second season of Lawnbowl! Zomboss has a new trick and he’s ready to unleash it onto the field. We are headed for Overtime during this Thymed event!
LTE_EVENTS_DESC_LAWNBOWL2.zh: 盛大回归——草坪碗第二赛季正式开幕！僵王又想了些坏点子，想在赛场上耍花招。一起在本次的限时活动中激情角逐，直到加时赛！

LTE_EVENTS_DESC_LAWNOFDOOM.en: Prepare to be spooked during the Lawn of Doom! Dodge hordes of zombies, endless gravestones and survive Dr. Zomboss!
LTE_EVENTS_DESC_LAWNOFDOOM.zh: 准备在末日草坪中魂飞魄散吧！闪避僵尸大军的凶猛攻击、墓碑的无尽侵袭，在僵王博士的诡计中生存下来！

LTE_EVENTS_DESC_LAWN_OF_DOOM.en: Play through our spooky Lawn of Doom! Zombies at every step! Maybe even bats! Use your plants to get you through. And remember that Thymed Events are limited thyme!
LTE_EVENTS_DESC_LAWN_OF_DOOM.zh: 来玩玩令人毛骨悚然的末日草坪活动吧！这里，“尸横遍野”，说不定还有蝙蝠相伴！快带上你的植物朋友，挺过这恐怖的万圣之夜。别忘了，限时活动时间有限，赶紧来玩吧！

LTE_EVENTS_DESC_LUCKOTHEZOMBIE.en: The zombies heard there's a pot of gold at the end of your lawn - and they're feeling lucky! Play through the Luck o' the Zombie event and prove once and for all that you hold the four leaf clover! The Limited Thymed Event is only active for a limited thyme!
LTE_EVENTS_DESC_LUCKOTHEZOMBIE.zh: 僵尸听到了你草坪上有金币罐子的声音——它们也感受到了幸运的气息！快来参加僵尸幸运星活动，向世界证明手握幸运四叶草的人是你！限时活动时间有限，赶紧来玩吧！

LTE_EVENTS_DESC_LUNARNEWYEAR.en: Wishing you prosperity and fortune! Play through our Lunar Zoo Year event for new levels and great rewards! The Thymed Event is only active for a limited time!
LTE_EVENTS_DESC_LUNARNEWYEAR.zh: 恭喜发财！来试试全新的“欢庆新年”系列关卡，赢取丰厚奖励！活动时间有限，赶紧来玩吧！

LTE_EVENTS_DESC_LUNARNEWYEAR_2025.en: Happy Year of the Snake! Dance to congrats on the wealth! Play through our Lunar Zoo Year event for new levels and great rewards! The Thymed Event is only active for a limited time!
LTE_EVENTS_DESC_LUNARNEWYEAR_2025.zh: 蛇年快乐！恭喜发财！来试试全新的农历新春系列关卡，赢取丰厚奖励！活动时间有限，赶紧来玩吧！

LTE_EVENTS_DESC_LUNARZOOYEAR.en: Celebrate the new Lunar Zoo Year and defend your lawn with your favorite zodiac plant in this Limited Thymed Event.
LTE_EVENTS_DESC_LUNARZOOYEAR.zh: 一同庆祝笼笠新年，在这场限时活动中用你最爱的生肖植物守卫草坪。

LTE_EVENTS_DESC_MGPWINTER.en: Mega Gatling Pea is ready for some snowy fun! He's bringing his squad and needs your help beating levels, earning coins and seeds to complete his Winter Adventure.
LTE_EVENTS_DESC_MGPWINTER.zh: 超级机枪豌豆已整装待发，试在这皑皑白雪中找点乐子！植物小队集结完毕，但要想通过这些关卡，赢取金币、种子，最终通过冬日大冒险，他还需要你的帮助。

LTE_EVENTS_DESC_MISSILE.en: Dr. Zomboss dispatched one of his proudest inventions. Defend your plants against the onslaught of massive missiles!
LTE_EVENTS_DESC_MISSILE.zh: 僵王博士派出了他最引以为傲的发明之一，保卫你的植物，抵御大波导弹的袭击！

LTE_EVENTS_DESC_MUSICGAME.en: This is not the Neon Mixtape Tour, it is the Neon Musicape Tour!!!
LTE_EVENTS_DESC_MUSICGAME.zh: 这里不是炫光魔音游，是炫光魔——“音游”！！！

LTE_EVENTS_DESC_NEWYEAR2024.en: The dragon attains the rain and clouds, destined not to be confined to a mere pond.
LTE_EVENTS_DESC_NEWYEAR2024.zh: 蛟龙得云雨，终非池中物。

LTE_EVENTS_DESC_OTHERWORLDLETTERS.en: When the watch ticks, a rift opens. Open the otherworld letters, find the "artifacts" before the time warp!
LTE_EVENTS_DESC_OTHERWORLDLETTERS.zh: 当怀表再次走动，裂隙悄然开启。打开异界之信，找到异界之物，在时间错位之前！

LTE_EVENTS_DESC_POPSINGER.en: The Pop Singer from the 80s released her new album in the new century?!
LTE_EVENTS_DESC_POPSINGER.zh: 80年代的流行歌手僵尸在新世纪发售了她的新专辑？！

LTE_EVENTS_DESC_POTW.en: Claim your rewards, if you can beat these grueling levels that stress both your plant and zombie knowledge. This event won’t be around forever! Dr. Zomboss is already hard at work on next week’s levels.
LTE_EVENTS_DESC_POTW.zh: 知己知彼，通过这些严酷的关卡，奖励非你莫属。这次活动时间有限！僵王博士已经在努力研究下周的关卡了。

LTE_EVENTS_DESC_ROMANWORLD.en: Rome wasn't built in a day! But it's full of zombies?! Fight the zombies and defend your Colosseum's lawn!
LTE_EVENTS_DESC_ROMANWORLD.zh: 罗马不是一天建成的！可如今，却“尸横遍野”？！击败僵尸，守护斗兽场的草坪！

LTE_EVENTS_DESC_SPRINGENING.en: Bunny zombies and eggs?! It must be springening! Play and defeat the zombies and save the eggs to earn unique rewards! The Thymed Event is only active for a limited time!
LTE_EVENTS_DESC_SPRINGENING.zh: 兔子僵尸？复活节彩蛋？！看来暖春节又到了！游玩关卡，击败僵尸，收集彩蛋，赢取奖励！限时活动时间有限，赶紧来玩吧！

LTE_EVENTS_DESC_SUMMERNIGHTS.en: The heat is high and the chance of zombies is even higher! Complete 15 levels of summer themed fun in this limited time Thymed Event!
LTE_EVENTS_DESC_SUMMERNIGHTS.zh: 温度再高，也不如僵尸出现的概率高！快来游玩 15 个限时活动关卡，感受夏日的乐趣！

LTE_EVENTS_DESC_TIMESPACEECHOES_S1.en: Dr. Zombie is promoting the importance of this bid. He promises that if they secure the bid, zombies will get a holiday on December 25th from 12:36 to 12:37.
LTE_EVENTS_DESC_TIMESPACEECHOES_S1.zh: 僵王博士许诺，拿下这次竞标，僵们会得到12月25日下午12：36~12：37的假期~

LTE_EVENTS_DESC_TIMESPACEECHOES_S10.en: Commemorating the day the wrestling man took on eleven plant heroes. No reason needed to beat up plants and zombies!
LTE_EVENTS_DESC_TIMESPACEECHOES_S10.zh: 纪念摔跤狂以一打十一位植物英雄的日子。揍植物揍僵尸都不需要理由！

LTE_EVENTS_DESC_TIMESPACEECHOES_S11.en: The garden has mutated again, defeat the garden destroyers led by Dr. Zomboss!
LTE_EVENTS_DESC_TIMESPACEECHOES_S11.zh: 园林再次出现异变，击败僵王博士带领的园林破坏者们！

LTE_EVENTS_DESC_TIMESPACEECHOES_S2.en: You have to admit, it seems like Hot Potato forgot to control the heat while resting, but after the ice melted, the ancient frostbite caves reappeared on the ground.
LTE_EVENTS_DESC_TIMESPACEECHOES_S2.zh: 烤马铃薯似乎在休息的时候忘了控制热量，但融化后的冰也让古老冰窟得以重见天日。

LTE_EVENTS_DESC_TIMESPACEECHOES_S3.en: The influence of time won't be so simple; it may even entangle your dreams. New acquaintances you've just met will soon meet again.
LTE_EVENTS_DESC_TIMESPACEECHOES_S3.zh: 时间的影响将没那么简单，它甚至缠绕住你的梦境，刚见面的新朋友很快再会见面。

LTE_EVENTS_DESC_TIMESPACEECHOES_S4.en: In the glorious era of the Plantagenet, the brilliance of history echoes through time-space, while the reign of zombies continues to reverberate.
LTE_EVENTS_DESC_TIMESPACEECHOES_S4.zh: 金雀花王朝的辉煌时期，历史的荣光在时空中回响，僵尸的统治亦在不断回荡。

LTE_EVENTS_DESC_TIMESPACEECHOES_S5.en: This dreamland is not so simple. Dr. Zomboss has long been waiting here, seemingly aware of every path you will take.
LTE_EVENTS_DESC_TIMESPACEECHOES_S5.zh: 这片梦想之地远超你所想象，僵王博士早已在此静候，仿佛知晓你将踏上的每条道路。

LTE_EVENTS_DESC_TIMESPACEECHOES_S6.en: Time back to the time when Dr. Zomboss sent his "mini army" to take over the town, However, it seems that there are no longer only imps here...
LTE_EVENTS_DESC_TIMESPACEECHOES_S6.zh: 时间回到僵王博士派遣“迷你大军”占领小镇的时刻，然而，这里似乎不再只有小鬼……

LTE_EVENTS_DESC_TIMESPACEECHOES_S7.en: The very beginning, lies atop the yellow sands and beneath the water's surface. What surprises will this era of time and space bring to you this time?
LTE_EVENTS_DESC_TIMESPACEECHOES_S7.zh: 最初的起点，时空的第一站，黄沙之上，水面之下——这一次，时空又将带给你怎样的惊喜呢？

LTE_EVENTS_DESC_TIMESPACEECHOES_S8.en: When spacetime and myth collide, zombies invade the JttW. Lead the plants to seize the True Scriptures!
LTE_EVENTS_DESC_TIMESPACEECHOES_S8.zh: 时空乱流与神话相撞，僵尸也在西游传说中占了一席之地。你能带领植物夺得真经吗？

LTE_EVENTS_DESC_TIMESPACEECHOES_S9.en: The curtain is drawn, and the crazed actors are dying to storm the stage. For art! For death! For BRAINZ!
LTE_EVENTS_DESC_TIMESPACEECHOES_S9.zh: 金脑子剧院，帷幕骤升。疯狂的演员们冲上舞台，为艺术、为死亡、也为脑子献身！

LTE_EVENTS_DESC_TOMBASTIC.en: Descend into the Tomb to find the hidden tacos. Find secrets and untold treasure, if you survive the inhabitants!!!
LTE_EVENTS_DESC_TOMBASTIC.zh: 潜入陵墓，探寻神秘玉米卷。在陵中居民的袭击中生存下来，探索那耐人寻味的秘密、不为人知的宝藏!!!

LTE_EVENTS_DESC_TOMBTANGLER.en: Tomb Tangler is the new tombstone eatin' plant in town. Help defeat the zombies and remember - Tomb Tangler has some surprises up his sleeve! The Thymed Event is only active for a limited time.
LTE_EVENTS_DESC_TOMBTANGLER.zh: 欢迎全新食墓植物——坟墓缠绕者来到镇上。快来帮他击败僵尸，同时也别忘了——他其实还藏了一手！限时活动时间有限，赶紧来玩吧。

LTE_EVENTS_DESC_TRIGGER.en: Get ready for the ultimate boot camp and learn about your plants in the New Plant Nursery.
LTE_EVENTS_DESC_TRIGGER.zh: 准备好参加新芽苗圃中的终极训练营，进一步了解你的植物。

LTE_EVENTS_DESC_UNSODDED.en: The battle between plants and zombies never stops, and even in unsodded, the plants still guard the last hope!
LTE_EVENTS_DESC_UNSODDED.zh: 植物与僵尸之间的战斗从未停止，即便在不毛之地，植物们依然在守护着最后的希望！

LTE_EVENTS_DESC_VALENBRAINZ.en: Celebrate Valentine’s Day and defend your lawn with your favorite Valentine's plant in this Limited Thymed Event.
LTE_EVENTS_DESC_VALENBRAINZ.zh: 庆祝情人节，在这场限时活动中用你最爱的春意“情种”守卫草坪

LTE_EVENTS_DESC_ZCORP.en: Lock up your Coins, board up your Seed Banks, and get ready for the ultimate financial apocalypse. ZCorp is here, and they're hungry for your profits!
LTE_EVENTS_DESC_ZCORP.zh: 锁好金库，封好种子库，准备迎接即将来袭的金融风暴。Z 公司随浪而至，虎视眈眈，想要榨取你的全部利益。

LTE_EVENTS_INFO_CARNIVAL.en: Play Events to get special rewards - including plant seeds! Some Event levels are difficult - make sure to level up your plants. Events are limited time and cannot be played after the clock runs out!
LTE_EVENTS_INFO_CARNIVAL.zh: 游玩活动，即可赢取特殊奖励：包括各种植物种子包！有的关卡可能会有一点难度，把植物升到更高等级即可提高你的获胜几率！活动时间有限，过了时间可能就不能玩了哦！

LTE_EVENTS_INFO_FEASTIVUS.en: Play Events to get special rewards. Some Event levels are difficult - make sure to level up your plants! Events are limited time and cannot be played after the clock runs out!
LTE_EVENTS_INFO_FEASTIVUS.zh: 游玩活动，即可赢取特殊奖励：包括石榴投手、电海松、兔极和他们的装扮！有的关卡可能会有一点难度！活动时间有限，过了时间可能就不能玩了哦！

LTE_EVENTS_INFO_FOODFIGHT.en: Play Events to get special rewards - including Food Fight pinatas and plant seeds. Some Event levels are difficult - make sure to level up your plants to win! Events are limited time and cannot be played after the clock runs out!
LTE_EVENTS_INFO_FOODFIGHT.zh: 游玩活动，即可赢取特殊奖励：包括食物大战彩陶、火鸡投手种子包！有的关卡可能会有一点难度，把植物升到更高等级即可提高你的获胜几率！活动时间有限，过了时间可能就不能玩了哦！

LTE_EVENTS_INFO_FUNTIME.en: Play the event and win special rewards: including plants and costumes! Some levels might be your worst nightmare! No time limit for this event!
LTE_EVENTS_INFO_FUNTIME.zh: 游玩活动，即可赢取特殊奖励：包括植物和装扮！有的关卡可能会有一点难度！该活动不限时间！

LTE_EVENTS_INFO_GENERIC.en: Play Thymed Events to earn special rewards - including plant seeds! If you reach a difficult level, make sure to level up your plants. Thymed Events are, well, timed and cannot be played after the clock runs out!
LTE_EVENTS_INFO_GENERIC.zh: 游玩限时活动，即可赢取各种特殊奖励！如果你遇到了比较难的关卡，把植物升到更高等级即可提高你的获胜几率！限时活动……很明显，时间有限。过了时间可就不能再玩了哦！

LTE_EVENTS_INFO_GENERIC_POTW.en: Play Thymed Events to earn special rewards - including plant seeds! If you reach a difficult level, make sure to level up your plants. Thymed Events are, well, timed and cannot be played after the clock runs out!
LTE_EVENTS_INFO_GENERIC_POTW.zh: 游玩限时活动，赢取包括植物种子在内的特殊奖励！如果你被一关难倒了，不要忘了去升级你的植物。限时活动，不用多说，时间有限，一旦结束就玩不到了哦！

LTE_EVENTS_INFO_LUNARNEWYEAR.en: Play Events to get special rewards - including plant seeds! Some Event levels are difficult - make sure to level up your plants. Events are limited time and cannot be played after the clock runs out!
LTE_EVENTS_INFO_LUNARNEWYEAR.zh: 游玩活动，即可赢取特殊奖励：包括各种植物种子包！有的关卡可能会有一点难度，把植物升到更高等级即可提高你的获胜几率！活动时间有限，过了时间可能就不能玩了哦！

LTE_EVENTS_INFO_OTHERWORLDLETTERS.en: Play Thymed Events to earn special rewards - including collaboration plants! Thymed Events are, well, timed and cannot be played after the clock runs out!
LTE_EVENTS_INFO_OTHERWORLDLETTERS.zh: 游玩限时活动，即可赢取各种特殊奖励，包括联动植物！活动时间有限，一旦结束就玩不到了哦！

LTE_EVENTS_INFO_POPSINGER.en: Play Events to get special rewards - including Bubu Seeds! Some Event levels are difficult. Events are limited time!
LTE_EVENTS_INFO_POPSINGER.zh: 游玩活动，即可赢取特殊奖励：赛尔号主题植物-布布种子！有的关卡可能会有一点难度！该活动不限时间！

LTE_EVENTS_INFO_PRIZE_FOODFIGHT.en: To earn this prize, defeat the Level associated with it! If you're struggling with the level, remember to level up your plants and to use boosted plants from the Zen Garden!
LTE_EVENTS_INFO_PRIZE_FOODFIGHT.zh: 要想赢得这个奖品，请先通过和它相连的关卡！如果你被那关难住了，记得试试升级你的植物，或者使用在禅境花园获得的强化植物！

LTE_EVENTS_INFO_PRIZE_FOODFIGHT_3.en: Turkey-pults lob tofu turkeys that damage zombies and then charge down the lane to damage even more zombies.
LTE_EVENTS_INFO_PRIZE_FOODFIGHT_3.zh: 火鸡投手向僵尸投掷豆腐火鸡，火鸡落地后会攻击僵尸。

LTE_EVENTS_INFO_TIMESPACEECHOES.en: Time Space Echoes levels will undergo periodic updates, and challenges won't be available once the duration of each level ends. Each level will offer different limited-time rewards.
LTE_EVENTS_INFO_TIMESPACEECHOES.zh: 时空回响关卡将会进行周期性更新，每一期关卡持续时间结束后将无法进行挑战，每一期关卡都会有不同的限时奖励。

LTE_EVENTS_INFO_TIMESPACEECHOES_BACK.en: Chrono Rhapsody is a limited-time event that unfolds in periodic 'variations.' Once the current movement concludes, the challenge entrance will close, and the melody of the past will never be performed again—seize the rhythm of the present.
LTE_EVENTS_INFO_TIMESPACEECHOES_BACK.zh: 时空重奏将以周期性“变奏”形式限时开放。当期乐章结束后，挑战入口将随之下线，过往旋律不再重演，请把握当下的节拍。

LTE_EVENTS_LOSE_HINT_1.en: Level up your plants to improve their stats! Better stats mean stronger plants!
LTE_EVENTS_LOSE_HINT_1.zh: 升级植物，提升数据！数据越好，植物越强！

LTE_EVENTS_LVL_OBJ_1_3RD_ANNIVERSARY.zh: 在3周年的生日庆典狂欢中生存下来！

LTE_EVENTS_LVL_OBJ_1_4TH_ANNIVERSARY.zh: 在4周年的生日庆典狂欢中生存下来！

LTE_EVENTS_LVL_OBJ_1_ADV-PIRATE.en: Swim through the swarm of swashbuckling sea pirate zombies!
LTE_EVENTS_LVL_OBJ_1_ADV-PIRATE.zh: 游过由侠盗剑客僵尸聚成的汪洋！

LTE_EVENTS_LVL_OBJ_1_ADV_MGP.en: Brr! Beat the zombies back during this Winter Adventure!
LTE_EVENTS_LVL_OBJ_1_ADV_MGP.zh: 好冷……！在冬日大冒险中击退僵尸！

LTE_EVENTS_LVL_OBJ_1_BEACH.en: Grab your sunscreen and join the Big Beach Brawl!
LTE_EVENTS_LVL_OBJ_1_BEACH.zh: 带上防晒霜，一同参与巨浪汹汹闹海滩！

LTE_EVENTS_LVL_OBJ_1_BEACH_BRAWL.en: Grab your sunscreen and join the Big Beach Brawl!
LTE_EVENTS_LVL_OBJ_1_BEACH_BRAWL.zh: 带上防晒霜，加入海滩大混战吧！

LTE_EVENTS_LVL_OBJ_1_BIRTHDAYZ.zh: 在生日庆典的狂欢中生存下来！

LTE_EVENTS_LVL_OBJ_1_CARNIVAL.en: Survive a backyard big top bombardment!
LTE_EVENTS_LVL_OBJ_1_CARNIVAL.zh: 在后院马戏团特别活动中生存下来！

LTE_EVENTS_LVL_OBJ_1_CERYDRA.en: Let us, conquer the tyrannical fate of this world!
LTE_EVENTS_LVL_OBJ_1_CERYDRA.zh: 让我们，征服世间不公的命运！

LTE_EVENTS_LVL_OBJ_1_FEASTIVUS.zh: 在仲冬圣诞大战中生存下来！

LTE_EVENTS_LVL_OBJ_1_FIFTHANNIVERSARY.zh: 在五周年的周年庆典狂欢中生存下来！

LTE_EVENTS_LVL_OBJ_1_FOODFIGHT.en: Survive an epic zombie Food Fight!
LTE_EVENTS_LVL_OBJ_1_FOODFIGHT.zh: 在食物大战的浩荡尸潮中生存下来！

LTE_EVENTS_LVL_OBJ_1_FUNTIME.zh: 在笑傲风月的浩荡尸潮中生存下来！

LTE_EVENTS_LVL_OBJ_1_HARVESTFESTIVAL.en: Protect your harvest from the zombies! Defend your lawn!
LTE_EVENTS_LVL_OBJ_1_HARVESTFESTIVAL.zh: 保护你的收成，让它们免遭僵尸的破坏！守护你的草坪！

LTE_EVENTS_LVL_OBJ_1_LAWNBOWL.en: Protect your sportz field and defeat Team Zombie!
LTE_EVENTS_LVL_OBJ_1_LAWNBOWL.zh: 保护运动场，击败僵尸队！

LTE_EVENTS_LVL_OBJ_1_LAWNOFDOOM.en: Outlast the zombies on this spine-chilling Lawn of Doom!!!
LTE_EVENTS_LVL_OBJ_1_LAWNOFDOOM.zh: 在这令人不寒而栗的末日草坪上战胜僵尸！！！

LTE_EVENTS_LVL_OBJ_1_LAWN_OF_DOOM.en: Outlast the zombies on this spine-chilling Lawn of Doom!
LTE_EVENTS_LVL_OBJ_1_LAWN_OF_DOOM.zh: 在这令人不寒而栗的末日草坪上战胜僵尸！

LTE_EVENTS_LVL_OBJ_1_LNY.en: Survive the Lunar Zoo Year stampede!
LTE_EVENTS_LVL_OBJ_1_LNY.zh: 在农历新春特别活动中生存下来！

LTE_EVENTS_LVL_OBJ_1_LOTZ.en: Survive the Luck o' the Zombie riverdance!
LTE_EVENTS_LVL_OBJ_1_LOTZ.zh: 在僵尸幸运星的大河之舞中生存下来

LTE_EVENTS_LVL_OBJ_1_LUCKOTHEZOMBIE.en: Survive the Luck o' the Zombie riverdance!
LTE_EVENTS_LVL_OBJ_1_LUCKOTHEZOMBIE.zh: 在僵尸幸运星的大河之舞中生存下来

LTE_EVENTS_LVL_OBJ_1_LUNARZOOYEAR.en: Survive the Lunar Zoo Year stampede!
LTE_EVENTS_LVL_OBJ_1_LUNARZOOYEAR.zh: 在笼笠新年的蜂拥尸潮中生存下来！

LTE_EVENTS_LVL_OBJ_1_MGPWINTER.en: Brr! Beat the zombies back during this Winter Adventure!
LTE_EVENTS_LVL_OBJ_1_MGPWINTER.zh: 好冷……！在冬日大冒险中击退僵尸！

LTE_EVENTS_LVL_OBJ_1_MISSILE.en: Protect the endangered plants from the Z-Mechs' missile onslaught!

MAGICSHROOM_YAOGUANG_NAME.en: SP - Gleam of a Thousand Plumes

MAGICVINE_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}Deals double damage to armored zombies.
{FLAVOR}A vine capable of using armor-destroying magic, affectionately known as "Magic Vine" by other plants. But in fact, she doesn't really like this name, because someone always mistakes her for a certain guy who brings nightmares.
MAGICVINE_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}攻击防具僵尸时造成双倍伤害。
{FLAVOR}一株能够使用破坏护甲魔法的藤蔓，被其他植物亲切地称为“魔藤”。但其实她并不怎么喜欢这个名字，因为总有人会把她误认成某个会带来噩梦的家伙。

MAGICVINE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Magic Vine fire magic bullets that can destroy armor to attack.
MAGICVINE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 射出能破坏防具的魔弹进行攻击。

MAGICVINE_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Fires a giant magic bullet at zombies.
MAGICVINE_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}发射巨大的魔弹攻击僵尸。

MAGICVINE_TOOLTIP.en: Deals double damage to armored zombies
MAGICVINE_TOOLTIP.zh: 攻击防具僵尸时造成双倍伤害

MAGNETFRUIT_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Star-God Unity: {STAT}causes the Solar Flare summoned by Helios Cabbage to drop a Magnetic Star Meteor every 10 seconds. Upon impact, the meteor explodes into several small stars to attack zombies.
{FLAVOR}Astrofruit has journeyed from the universe of Plants vs. Zombies: Fusion. Although his powers have been greatly diminished by the distortions of time and space, this is not much of a concern for him. "In this universe, though I am bound by the constraints of spacetime, which causes my power to wane, I have long grasped the true essence of these laws—hence, my imperial might remains," Astrofruit said while defeating zombies on the lawn.
MAGNETFRUIT_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}星神合一：{STAT}使究极太阳神卷心菜召唤的太阳每 10 秒牵引一颗究极流星砸下，流星爆炸后会变为若干的小星星攻击僵尸。
{FLAVOR}究极杨桃大帝从《植物大战僵尸：融合版》穿越而来，虽然自身能力受时空影响大不如前，但这对他而言并不是什么大问题。“在此异度时空之中，虽吾受时空桎梏，致使威能锐减，然吾早已参透此间法则之真谛，故帝威犹存。”究极杨桃大帝一边在草坪上驱逐着僵尸，一边说道。

MAGNETFRUIT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Astrofruits shoot five seeking stars that, upon impact, continue to pursue and attack zombies.
MAGNETFRUIT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 究极杨桃大帝可以发射五颗追踪星星，命中后持续追踪并攻击僵尸。

MAGNETFRUIT_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Summons three giant Magnetic Star Meteors and launches several massive homing meteors that continuously track and deal immense damage to zombies upon impact.
MAGNETFRUIT_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}召唤三颗究极流星并发射若干巨大追踪流星，命中后持续追踪僵尸并对僵尸造成巨大伤害。

MAGNETFRUIT_TOOLTIP.en: Shoots seeking stars that pursue zombies upon impact
MAGNETFRUIT_TOOLTIP.zh: 发射五颗追踪星星，命中后持续追踪并攻击僵尸

MAGNETSHROOM1_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Despite his unusual appearance, Magnet-shroom doesn't have a problem attracting girlfriends. But he does have a problem keeping them. It's the same thing every time. In the end, they always find him too clingy.
MAGNETSHROOM1_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}移除僵尸身上的金属物品

{FLAVOR}尽管他的外表与众不同，磁力菇还是可以很轻松地吸引到女性朋友。但他很难留住她们，每次都一样。到最后她们总是发现他真的太黏人了。

MAGNETSHROOM1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Magnet-shrooms remove helmets and other metal objects from zombies.
MAGNETSHROOM1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 磁力菇可以把僵尸身上的金属物品吸走。

MAGNETSHROOM1_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Remove and toss all metal objects on zombies within range, dealing damage.
MAGNETSHROOM1_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}吸取范围内僵尸身上的所有金属物品，然后把它们扔出去，造成伤害。

MAGNETSHROOM1_TOOLTIP.en: Removes helmets and other metal objects from zombies
MAGNETSHROOM1_TOOLTIP.zh: 从僵尸身上移除头盔等金属物品

MAGNETSHROOM_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Iris is the noblest flower of the House of Plantagenet. Whenever other plants try to approach her, she always hides herself within her own cloak.
MAGNETSHROOM_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}可以从斗篷中放出魔法鸟

{FLAVOR}鸢尾花是金雀花王朝最高贵的花朵，每当其他植物想接近她时，她总会将自己隐匿于自己的斗篷中。

普通攻击配音文案：
开始游戏吧
你为何不问一下你大脑中的罅隙
你从我斗篷的缝隙中窥见了什么

{KEYWORD}叶绿素配音文案：
抱歉，赝品才最适合你
风的方向，更适合飞翔
满天星光，满目琳琅
如梦如幻月，若即若离花
我会将这黑夜吞噬殆尽

MAGNETSHROOM_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Iris can release a magical bird from its cloak, which can continuously attack zombies and slow them down.
MAGNETSHROOM_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 可以从斗篷中放出魔法鸟，魔法鸟可以持续攻击僵尸，并对僵尸减速。

MAGNETSHROOM_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: Release 5 stronger magic birds, one each lane.

MAGNETSHROOM_TOOLTIP.en: Release magic birds from cloaks to attack zombies
MAGNETSHROOM_TOOLTIP.zh: 从斗篷中放出魔法鸟攻击僵尸

MAGNIFYINGGRASS_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Magnifying Grass understands the inherent power of a rainbow. Beneath her stoic features she takes great joy in delivering radiant multicolored destruction to the zombie horde.
MAGNIFYINGGRASS_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}轻点花费阳光攻击

{FLAVOR}棱镜草熟知彩虹的内在力量。在她坚韧的外表下，藏着的是为僵尸带来七彩光芒的心愿——七彩的毁灭之光。

MAGNIFYINGGRASS_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Magnifying Grass turns sun into a bolt of colorful damage.
MAGNIFYINGGRASS_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 棱镜草可以将阳光转化为七彩的高能光束。

MAGNIFYINGGRASS_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Shoots an energy beam that deals damage to zombies in its row. The beam duration increases based on the number of sun-producing plants on the lawn.
MAGNIFYINGGRASS_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}发射一串能量光束，对所在行中的僵尸造成伤害。草坪上的阳光生产类植物越多，光束的持续时间就越长。

MAGNIFYINGGRASS_TOOLTIP.en: Tap to spend sun for a powerful attack
MAGNIFYINGGRASS_TOOLTIP.zh: 轻点花费阳光发动强大攻击

MAINMENU_DELETE_PROFILE_BODY.en: If you DELETE this profile you will lose all game play data associated with this profile including any purchased coins.
MAINMENU_DELETE_PROFILE_BODY.zh: 删除此档案将失去所有游戏进度数据，包括任何通过内购获得的金币。

MAINMENU_FACEBOOK_LOGIN.zh: 想和脸书上的朋友连线吗？

MANGOFIER_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR} Mangofier’s straightforward nature leaves little for the imagination. But one thing still remains a mystery and has stumped even the brightest minds. What is the Mangofier’s beam made out of?  Numerous hypotheses have been made… Solar Radiation? A form of Thermal Condensation? Reverse Photosynthesis? Dave claims to know the answer, and has published an 8 page thesis on this subject. Titled ‘Wabby Wab-boobo’.
MANGOFIER_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}聚光芒生而直来直往，没有留给大家半点可以想象的空间：但有件事至今还是个谜，难倒一众智者——聚光芒的光束是从哪儿来的？种种假设接踵而至…来自太阳辐射？某种热缩合？或者是逆光合作用？戴夫声称自己知道答案，并就此发表了一篇长达 8 页的论文。标题为“歪比巴卜”。

MANGOFIER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Utility launcher plant that can be toggled between focus and cluster firing modes. Its long range attacks can reach all parts of the lawn.
MANGOFIER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 一株可以在聚集与发散两种发射模式间进行切换的功能性发射器类植物。攻击范围很大，可以覆盖草坪上的每个角落。

MANGOFIER_DESCRIPTION_HINT.en: Mangofier’s long range attack can switch between focus damage, taking out high value targets or spread damage to take out multiple smaller threats.
MANGOFIER_DESCRIPTION_HINT.zh: 聚光芒攻击范围很大，既可以造成聚集伤害，消灭高价值目标；也可以造成发散伤害，消灭数名威胁更小的敌人。

MANGOFIER_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Focuses ambient energy to continuously blast zombies on the lawn.
MANGOFIER_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}聚集周围的能量，连续轰炸草坪上的僵尸。

MANGOFIER_TOOLTIP.en: Toggles between focus or spread launcher fire modes.
MANGOFIER_TOOLTIP.zh: 可以在聚集与发散两种发射模式间进行切换。

MANGOSTEEN_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Every time Mangosteen say "not ok" words, it’s always on the condition of getting struck by the thunder.
MANGOSTEEN_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}范围：{STAT}以山竹为中心 3x3 的圆形区域
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}释放电圈攻击周围僵尸，种下去一段时间后会长大。
{KEYWORD}植物特征：{STAT}黑色植物

{FLAVOR}聚能山竹每次赌咒发誓时总是会以天打雷劈为条件。

MANGOSTEEN_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Emit an electric circle around itself, deal more damage over time

MANGOSTEEN_TOOLTIP.en: Emit an electric circle around itself

MARIGOLD_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Marigold has dedicated herself to the Zen lifestyle. She's a team player, and gives it her best there in the garden. But if she never has to confront another zombie on the lawn again it will be too soon.
MARIGOLD_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}金盏花喜欢禅境生活。她在花园里是群花中最美丽的那一支。但若是到草坪战场上，她还是太嫩了。

MARIGOLD_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Marigolds give you coin rewards in Zen Garden.
MARIGOLD_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 金盏花可以在禅境花园给予你金币作为奖励。

MARIGOLD_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}给予你一大堆硬币，然后消失。

MARIGOLD_TOOLTIP.en: Gives you rewards in Zen Garden
MARIGOLD_TOOLTIP.zh: 在禅境花园中为你提供奖励

MAUSOLEUM_LEVEL_NAME.zh: 地宫遗迹 - 第 {LEVEL_NUMBER} 夜

MAX_LEVEL_QUEST_DESC.en: Try out the amazing leveled-up Peashooters!
MAX_LEVEL_QUEST_DESC.zh: 试试令人震惊的高等级豌豆射手！

MAYBEE_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}"I'm more than just a set of pretty bells ya know? I can also throw a wicked curveball."
MAYBEE_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}“你知道吗，我可不仅仅是一株美丽的铃兰，我扔出的弧线也是一条邪恶而致命的美丽。”

MAYBEE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: A defensive enchanted projectile plant that captures and shoots pesky bee-like projectiles that target nearby zombies when threatened.
MAYBEE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 一株可以发射子弹的防御性魔法植物，可以捕捉讨厌的蜜蜂状物体作为子弹，把它们发射出去，“蜜蜂”被惊扰后会对附近的僵尸发起进攻。

MAYBEE_DESCRIPTION_HINT.en: When fired over Lightning Reed projectile damage is boosted. Try this with Plant Food for maximum damage!
MAYBEE_DESCRIPTION_HINT.zh: 发射后如果穿过闪电芦苇，可以加强子弹的伤害。巧妙利用这个技巧，配合叶绿素效果，达到最大伤害！

MAYBEE_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Fires a barrage of stronger bee-like projectiles to seek out targets all across the board and for a short time leaves zombies that survived the attack stunned!
MAYBEE_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}发射一连串更为强大的“蜜蜂”子弹，在全场寻找攻击目标。如果僵尸被攻击后仍然存活，则会让其眩晕一小段时间！

MAYBEE_TOOLTIP.en: Fires multiple bee-like projectiles that target nearby zombies.
MAYBEE_TOOLTIP.zh: 发射多枚瞄准附近僵尸的“蜜蜂”子弹。

MEGAGATLING_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}"I used to be an upgrade," says Mega Gatling Pea with uncharacteristic shyness. "Now I'm my own plant, with my own ambitions, dreams and gym club memberships!"
MEGAGATLING_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}“以前，我只是双发豌豆的升级”超级机枪豌豆带着平日里不曾有过的羞涩说。“不过现在，我独立了。我有了自己的志向、自己的梦想，甚至还有了自己的健身房会员！”

MEGAGATLING_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Mega Gatling Peas fire four peas at a time, and will occasionally Plant Food itself.
MEGAGATLING_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 超级机枪豌豆可以同时发射四颗豌豆，偶尔还会自己产生叶绿素效果。

MEGAGATLING_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Shoots a huge number of peas out, dealing massive damage. Normal attack will fire five peas instead of four, permanently.
MEGAGATLING_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}发射大量豌豆，造成巨大伤害。此后的普通攻击将永久从发射四颗豌豆升级为发射五颗。

MELONPULT_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}"Everyone says my head looks like a melon," said the middle child of the Pult family, "and they would be right." Don't ask him if he's seedless or not though, it offends him and frankly it's none of your business.
MELONPULT_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}发射速率：{STAT}1/2 倍

{FLAVOR}“别人都说我的头像个西瓜，”投手家族的老二说，“也许他们是对的。”但千万别问他是不是无籽西瓜，他一听到这话就冒火，而且…关你什么事啊喂！

MELONPULT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Melon-pults do heavy damage to groups of zombies.
MELONPULT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 西瓜投手可以对僵尸造成巨额伤害。

MELONPULT_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Launches melons at every zombie, dealing both damage and splash damage on impact.
MELONPULT_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}向每只僵尸发射西瓜，既可以造成直接伤害，也能造成溅射伤害。

MELONPULT_PLANTFOOD.en: Heavy melons are launched up that target every zombie on the lawn.
MELONPULT_PLANTFOOD.zh: 发射大量沉重的西瓜，砸向草坪上的每只僵尸。

MELONPULT_TOOLTIP.en: Does heavy damage to groups of zombies
MELONPULT_TOOLTIP.zh: 对成群僵尸造成大量伤害

METEORFLOWER_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}"Out of this world molten mayhem! But first… coffee!!"
METEORFLOWER_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}“坠落吧——熔火狂欢！但在这之前……来杯咖啡！！”

METEORFLOWER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Meteor Flower conjures meteor strikes from the sky that leave molten tiles.
METEORFLOWER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 流星花可以从空中召唤流星坠，被砸中的格子会被融化。

METEORFLOWER_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Conjure 3 meteor strikes, dealing damage and creates a molten pool at the impact point.
METEORFLOWER_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}召唤 3 颗流星坠，造成伤害，并在撞击的地方形成熔池。

METEORFLOWER_TOOLTIP.en: Meteor Flower conjures meteor strikes from the sky.
METEORFLOWER_TOOLTIP.zh: 流星花可以从空中召唤流星坠。

MGPADV_25_AD_OFFER.zh: 超级机枪豌豆大冒险广告观看激励

MGPADV_25_AD_PINATA.zh: 超级机枪豌豆大冒险广告彩陶

MGPADV_25_MEGA_PACK.zh: 超级机枪豌豆大冒险至尊包

MGPADV_25_MINI_PACK.zh: 超级机枪豌豆大冒险迷你包

MGPADV_25_PINATA.zh: 超级机枪豌豆大冒险彩陶

MGPADV_25_PREMIUM_PINATA.zh: 超级机枪豌豆大冒险高级彩陶

MGPADV_MEGA_BUNDLE.zh: 超级机枪豌豆大冒险至尊捆绑包

MGPADV_PINATA_BUNDLE.zh: 超级机枪豌豆大冒险彩陶捆绑包

MGPADV_PINATA_OFFER.zh: 超级机枪豌豆大冒险彩陶

MGPADV_PINATA_PACK.zh: 超级机枪豌豆大冒险彩陶包

MGPADV_PREMIUM_PINATA_BUNDLE.zh: 超级机枪豌豆大冒险高级彩陶捆绑包

MGPADV_PREMIUM_PINATA_OFFER.zh: 超级机枪豌豆大冒险高级彩陶

MGPADV_PREMIUM_PINATA_PACK.zh: 超级机枪豌豆大冒险高级彩陶包

MGPADV_SUPER_BUNDLE.zh: 超级机枪豌豆大冒险超级捆绑包

MGPADV_ULTIMATE_BUNDLE.zh: 超级机枪豌豆大冒险终极捆绑包

MGP_MEGA_BUNDLE.zh: 冬日大冒险至尊捆绑包

MGP_MINI_BUNDLE.zh: 冬日大冒险迷你捆绑包

MGP_SUPER_BUNDLE.zh: 冬日大冒险超级捆绑包

MIKULEEK_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}Starts singing 5 seconds after blooming, continuously providing the Ode to Leek effect to all plants within a 3x3 area around it.
{KEYWORD}Ode to Leek: {STAT}Increases attack and production speed; increases current health and maximum health. This effect does not stack.
{KEYWORD}Synergy - [Twin Star Resonance]: {STAT}When activating Plant Food, if Teto Imp Pear is on the lawn, summons an additional three Teto Imp Pears.
{FLAVOR}As a virtual diva, she knows she is just a string of data, but she is willing to sing out loud, singing everyone's thoughts and wishes, because she is the world's number one leek princess.

{KEYWORD}Artist: {STAT}Jingzheng
MIKULEEK_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}种植后五秒开始演唱，持续为周围3x3范围内所有植物提供【葱郁之诗】效果。
{KEYWORD}【葱郁之诗】：{STAT}攻击与生产速度提升；当前生命值与生命上限提升。该效果唯一。
{KEYWORD}连携 - 【双星共鸣】：{STAT}释放叶绿素时若场上存在重音小鬼梨，则额外召唤其他三个重音小鬼梨。
{FLAVOR}作为一棵虚拟歌姬，她清楚她只是一串数据，但是她愿意放声歌唱，唱出每个人的想法，每个人的心愿，因为她是世界第一大葱公主殿下。

{KEYWORD}美术：{STAT}Jingzheng

MIKULEEK_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Leekus increase the attack speed, production speed, and maximum health of surrounding plants.

MINIPEASHOOTER_DESCRIPTION.en: Winter Sweet, who has trained her throwing skills since she was a child, is the nightmare of the owner of various small games in the playground. Until she lost interest in this kind of small game that she called "children's game", the prizes she won from the bitter-faced shopkeeper were enough to fill a small room. It is said that she has recently become obsessed with target shooting, and several nearby shops that operate shooting mini-games are ready to close their doors to avoid her.
MINIPEASHOOTER_DESCRIPTION.zh: 从小训练投掷技能的梅小美是各种游乐场内套圈小游戏店主的噩梦，到她对这种被她称作“小孩子的游戏”的小游戏丧失兴趣为止，从一脸苦逼的店家手中赢来的奖品已经足够堆满一个小房间。据说最近她迷上了打靶，附近的几家经营射击小游戏的店家已经准备关门歇业避避风头了。

MINIPEASHOOTER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 发射可以溅射的梅花攻击前方僵尸

MINIPEASHOOTER_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: Launches plum blossoms to attack zombies in front.

MINIPEASHOOTER_TOOLTIP.en: Attacks zombies by launching plum blossoms.
MINIPEASHOOTER_TOOLTIP.zh: 发射可以溅射的梅花攻击前方僵尸

MINT_AWARD_HEADER.en: You got {NUMBER} Jinjin Tea Coupons! Use Jinjin Tea Coupons to purchase plants in Jinjin Tea House (Shop)!
MINT_AWARD_HEADER.zh: 你得到了 {NUMBER} 张金金茶券！在商店里使用金金茶券来购买金金茶馆的独家植物们吧！

MISSILETOAST_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}Rolling fireballs are extinguished immediately upon contact with water

{FLAVOR}Compared to the icy demeanor of her sisters, Missile Toast is, one might say, suffocatingly passionate! Her daily routine, aside from throwing parties, involves playing barbecue games at them. At times like these, keeping a clear head is more important than roasting a bowl of tapioca noodles, as not every household has a good fire truck.
MISSILETOAST_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}滚动的火球遇到水面会直接消失

{FLAVOR}相比于同胞姐妹的高冷，这位火仙子可以说热情的令人窒息！她的日常除了开派对，就是在派对玩烧烤游戏，这时保持清醒是比烤一碗木薯粉条更重要的事，因为不是家家户户都有一辆好的消防车。

MISSILETOAST_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Missile Toasts throw fireballs at zombies. After hitting a target, the fireballs continue to roll forward.
MISSILETOAST_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 槲寄火仙子可以扔出火球攻击僵尸，火球击中目标后会继续向前滚动。

MISSILETOAST_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}In Missile Toast's normal form, she incinerates zombies and transforms into her plasma form. In her plasma form, she incinerates zombies with a stronger flame.
MISSILETOAST_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}处于普通形态时，焚烧僵尸并转变为等离子形态。处于强化形态时，使用更强的火焰焚烧僵尸。

MISSILETOAST_TOOLTIP.en: Throws fireballs that roll forward after hitting a target
MISSILETOAST_TOOLTIP.zh: 扔出击中目标后会继续向前滚动的火球

MISSILETOE_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Use:{STAT} Tap to arm, then tap the target tile to fire
{KEYWORD}Range:{STAT} Anywhere on the lawn

{FLAVOR}Although it is called a Cob Cannon, he does not have rice. To be accurate, he lacks jade. So how did he get this title? It must be nepotism! Pure favoritism!
MISSILETOE_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}使用：{STAT}轻点进行武装，然后轻点目标地砖进行开火
{KEYWORD}范围：{STAT}草坪上任何地方
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}炮弹命中后产生小范围爆炸

{FLAVOR}尽管被称为玉米加农炮，但他并没有米，准确地说，是缺少玉。那他是怎么得到这个称谓的呢？肯定是裙带关系！纯粹的偏袒！

MISSILETOE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Launches deadly cob of corn to cause huge 3x3 damage to zombies.
MISSILETOE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 玉米加农炮可以发射玉米炸弹对僵尸造成巨额伤害。

MISSILETOE_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}向草坪上的随机目标发射多枚玉米炸弹。

{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}Click to breathe fire
{KEYWORD}Range:{STAT}Straight line
{KEYWORD}Special:{STAT}The longer the charging time, the stronger the flames will be. r
{FLAVOR}Fire gourd was originally just a supporting role in the acrobatic class. Only after he entered the zombie battlefield did he realize his true worth.

{KEYWORD}用法：{STAT}点击喷火
{KEYWORD}范围：{STAT}直线
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}蓄力时间越长，喷出的火焰越强，专克兵器架
{KEYWORD}植物特征：{STAT}黄色植物、满腹怒火

{FLAVOR}火葫芦原先只是个杂技班里的小配角，自从上了僵尸战场后，他才发现自己真正的价值。

MURKADAMIA_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: After Fire Gourd is charged, he can spit fire forward, causing continuous fire damage, very effective against wooden weapon racks.
MURKADAMIA_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 火葫芦蓄力后能朝前方吐火，造成持续火焰伤害，对付木制的兵器架特别有效。

MURKADAMIA_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: Spit out big fire that pushes back and damage zombies

MURKADAMIA_TOOLTIP.zh: 点击后可以喷火并休息，休息时间越长，喷出火焰越强

NARRATIVE_10000459.en: {NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}Fools! Seek your taco. Soon you shall feast... on a taco of DOOM!
NARRATIVE_10000459.zh: {NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}笨蛋！去找你的玉米卷吧！很快……你就会享用这顿玉米卷盛宴……带来的毁灭！

NARRATIVE_1000300.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY}{LONG}Those peashooters are confused and are just going to be in the way.
NARRATIVE_1000300.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY}{LONG}这些豌豆射手有点让我摸不着头脑，因为他们挡着我了。

NARRATIVE_1000301.en: {EXCITED}{LONG}Use the shovel to dig them up and make room for useful plants!
NARRATIVE_1000301.zh: {EXCITED}{LONG}使用铲子移走它们，为更有用的植物腾出空间！

NARRATIVE_1000451.zh: {PLAYFUL}我可以借用一下那瓶辣椒酱吗？

NARRATIVE_1000452.en: {BRINGOUT_TACO}{SAY}{LONG}I've been holding onto this taco for forever!
NARRATIVE_1000452.zh: {BRINGOUT_TACO}{SAY}{LONG}这块玉米卷已经拿在手上…十万年了！

NARRATIVE_1000454.en: {EXCITED}I want to eat THAT taco again! I need my TIME MACHINE!
NARRATIVE_1000454.zh: {EXCITED}我还想再吃一次玉米卷！我需要我的时光机！

NARRATIVE_1000455.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{PLAYFUL:crazydave}Her name is Penny and I'm Crazy Dave. But you can call me Crazy Dave.
NARRATIVE_1000455.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{PLAYFUL:crazydave}她叫潘妮，我叫疯狂戴夫。你也可以简称我为疯狂戴夫。

NARRATIVE_1000456.en: {SAY:winnie}Finally, another User who can process my queries.
NARRATIVE_1000456.zh: {SAY:winnie}终于出现了，一位能看懂我说明书的用户。

NARRATIVE_1000457.en: {TIRED:winnie}Let me postulate, Dave wants to go back in time to eat his taco... again...
NARRATIVE_1000457.zh: {TIRED:winnie}让我猜一猜，戴夫想要回到过去…再一次…吃到他的玉米卷…

NARRATIVE_1000458.en: {SAY:crazydave}She's so smart! Now let's go after my taco!
NARRATIVE_1000458.zh: {SAY:crazydave}她真聪明！现在一同去追寻我的玉米卷吧！

NARRATIVE_1000459.en: {NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}Fools! Seek your taco. Soon you shall feast... on a taco of DOOM!
NARRATIVE_1000459.zh: {NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}笨蛋！去找你的玉米卷吧！很快……你就会享用这顿玉米卷盛宴……带来的毁灭！

NARRATIVE_3701.en: {TIRED}If there was something we could feed him...

NARRATIVE_3702.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Plant Food is rich in vitamins and minerals.
NARRATIVE_3702.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}叶绿素富含维生素和矿物质。

NARRATIVE_3703.en: {PLAYFUL:winnie}It’s an essential part of a perfect breakfast.
NARRATIVE_3703.zh: {PLAYFUL:winnie}这是一顿完美早餐必不可少的一部分。

NARRATIVE_3800.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{EXCITED}I wonder if Plant Food works on other types of plants?
NARRATIVE_3800.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{EXCITED}我想知道叶绿素对其他植物会有什么效果？

NARRATIVE_3900.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{TIRED}{LONG}Aww...you let your plant get eaten! Try again!
NARRATIVE_3900.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{TIRED}{LONG}啊…你的植物被吃掉了！再试一次！

NARRATIVE_4000.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{PLAYFUL}{LONG}I love the smell of coconut cannons in the morning!
NARRATIVE_4000.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{PLAYFUL}{LONG}我喜欢一大早就闻到椰子加农炮的味道！

NARRATIVE_4100.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}{LONG}It appears the zombies have been gathered in that corral.
NARRATIVE_4100.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}{LONG}看来僵尸已经聚集在围栏里了。

NARRATIVE_4102.en: {SAY}{MEDIUM}Better plant something before they get loose.
NARRATIVE_4102.zh: {SAY}{MEDIUM}最好在他们“失缰”前种些什么。

NARRATIVE_4200.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY}Oh good. There are no zombies here.

NARRATIVE_4202.zh: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}你是说他们使用着…骆驼排阵？

NARRATIVE_AILMINT_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Power Mints are powerful plants you can acquire through Arena mode.
NARRATIVE_AILMINT_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}超能薄荷是一类强大的植物，你可以通过竞技场模式来获得他们。

NARRATIVE_AILMINT_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:winnie}They provide a big boost to plants in their family.
NARRATIVE_AILMINT_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}它们对相应家族的植物有巨大的增益作用。

NARRATIVE_AILMINT_INTRO_3.en: {SAY:winnie}The Ail-mint family includes fungi and poison plants.
NARRATIVE_AILMINT_INTRO_3.zh: {SAY:winnie}疾病薄荷家族包括真菌和有毒的植物。

NARRATIVE_ALMANAC_FIND_MORE_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnieicon}{SAY}Tap 'Find More' to see where you can find more seed packets for each plant.
NARRATIVE_ALMANAC_FIND_MORE_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnieicon}{SAY}轻点“寻找更多”即可查看获取每种植物种子包的地点。

NARRATIVE_ALMANAC_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:crazydaveicon}I need a place to collect and upgrade my plants!
NARRATIVE_ALMANAC_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:crazydaveicon}我需要个收纳、升级我植物的地方！

NARRATIVE_ALMANAC_INTRO_3.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnieicon}{SAY}你是指类似“交互式图鉴”的东西？

NARRATIVE_ALMANAC_RANK_UP_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnieicon}{SAY}Some of your plants are ready to Rank Up!  Choose a worthy one.
NARRATIVE_ALMANAC_RANK_UP_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnieicon}{SAY}你的某些植物已经可以升阶了！选一株合适的吧。

NARRATIVE_ALMANAC_RANK_UP_OUTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnieicon}{SAY}Ranking Up will increase your plant's and its whole family's power.  Tap RANK UP to try it out.
NARRATIVE_ALMANAC_RANK_UP_OUTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnieicon}{SAY}升阶可以提高那株植物，以及其整个家族的力量。轻点“升阶”来试试吧。

NARRATIVE_ALMANAC_UPGRADE_PEASHOOTER_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnieicon}{SAY}Take those seed packets you won and upgrade your Peashooter!
NARRATIVE_ALMANAC_UPGRADE_PEASHOOTER_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnieicon}{SAY}用你赢得的种子包来升级豌豆射手！

NARRATIVE_ALMANAC_UPGRADE_WALLNUT_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnieicon}{SAY}Looks like you can upgrade your Wallnut too!
NARRATIVE_ALMANAC_UPGRADE_WALLNUT_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnieicon}{SAY}看来你也可以升级坚果墙了！

NARRATIVE_APPEASEMINT_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie} Power Mints are powerful plants you can acquire through Arena mode.
NARRATIVE_APPEASEMINT_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}}超能薄荷是一类强大的植物，你可以通过竞技场模式来获得他们。

NARRATIVE_APPEASEMINT_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:winnie}They provide a big boost to plants in their family.
NARRATIVE_APPEASEMINT_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}它们对相应家族的植物有巨大的增益作用。

NARRATIVE_APPEASEMINT_INTRO_3.en: {SAY:winnie}The Appease-mint family includes peas and other straight shooters.
NARRATIVE_APPEASEMINT_INTRO_3.zh: {SAY:winnie}豌豆薄荷家族包括豌豆以及其他直线射手植物。

NARRATIVE_ARMAMINT_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Power Mints are powerful plants you can acquire through Arena mode.
NARRATIVE_ARMAMINT_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}超能薄荷是一类强大的植物，你可以通过竞技场模式来获得他们。

NARRATIVE_ARMAMINT_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:winnie}They provide a big boost to plants in their family.
NARRATIVE_ARMAMINT_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}它们对相应家族的植物有巨大的增益作用。

NARRATIVE_ARMAMINT_INTRO_3.en: {SAY:winnie}The Arma-mint Family comprises various lobbing and cannon plants.
NARRATIVE_ARMAMINT_INTRO_3.zh: {SAY:winnie}军械薄荷家族包括投掷和炮弹植物。

NARRATIVE_ATLANTIS_10_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:CRAZYDAVE}{NPC_ENTER:WINNIE}{SAY:WINNIE}The zombies' attacks are getting more and more fierce.
NARRATIVE_ATLANTIS_10_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:CRAZYDAVE}{NPC_ENTER:WINNIE}{SAY:WINNIE}僵尸们的进攻越来越猛烈了。

NARRATIVE_ATLANTIS_10_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:WINNIE}This might mean we are getting closer to our destination.
NARRATIVE_ATLANTIS_10_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:WINNIE}这可能意味着我们离目的地越来越近了。

NARRATIVE_ATLANTIS_10_INTRO_3.en: {EXCITED:CRAZYDAVE}I'm starting to miss life on land.
NARRATIVE_ATLANTIS_10_INTRO_3.zh: {EXCITED:CRAZYDAVE}我开始怀念陆地上的生活了。

NARRATIVE_ATLANTIS_12_INTRO_2.en: {EXCITED:CRAZYDAVE}I also want a jellyfish to grab me and swim with me.

NARRATIVE_ATLANTIS_12_INTRO_3.en: {SAY:WINNIE}That might not be a good idea, User Dave.
NARRATIVE_ATLANTIS_12_INTRO_3.zh: {SAY:WINNIE}这可能并不是一个好主意，用户戴夫。

NARRATIVE_ATLANTIS_13_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:CRAZYDAVE}{NPC_ENTER:WINNIE}{EXCITED:CRAZYDAVE}What are those fish with pointy mouths?

NARRATIVE_ATLANTIS_13_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:WINNIE}They're sailfish—the fastest fish in the ocean.
NARRATIVE_ATLANTIS_13_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:WINNIE}他们是旗鱼，海洋中游得最快的鱼类。

NARRATIVE_ATLANTIS_13_INTRO_3.en: {SAY:WINNIE}Because they swim too fast, be careful not to get hit by them.
NARRATIVE_ATLANTIS_13_INTRO_3.zh: {SAY:WINNIE}因为游得太快，要小心他们撞上潜艇的甲板。

NARRATIVE_ATLANTIS_13_INTRO_4.en: {EXCITED:CRAZYDAVE}Did we get insurance for the submarine?

NARRATIVE_ATLANTIS_16_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}Can this leaky circuit chopping board, really withstand the deep-sea water pressure?
NARRATIVE_ATLANTIS_16_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}这艘盛满泡烂的咸菜的漏水电路真的受得了深海水压吗？

NARRATIVE_ATLANTIS_16_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:zombossicon}What a misfortune! I've already completed your foolish underwater expedition ahead of you!
NARRATIVE_ATLANTIS_16_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:zombossicon}真是太不幸了！我已经先一步完成了你们愚蠢的海底探险！

NARRATIVE_ATLANTIS_16_INTRO_3.en: {SAY:zombossicon}The Ruins Zombie soaring through the sea will shatter your dreams! Your wreckage will become part of the ruins, buried forever!
NARRATIVE_ATLANTIS_16_INTRO_3.zh: {SAY:zombossicon}海中翱翔的遗迹僵尸会敲碎你们的美梦！你们的残骸将成为遗迹的一部分永远埋葬！

NARRATIVE_ATLANTIS_16_INTRO_4.en: {NPC_ENTER:CRAZYDAVE}{NPC_ENTER:WINNIE}{EXCITED:CRAZYDAVE}Living in the underwater ruins forever? It would be nice if there was a sauna down there.
NARRATIVE_ATLANTIS_16_INTRO_4.zh: {NPC_ENTER:CRAZYDAVE}{NPC_ENTER:WINNIE}{EXCITED:CRAZYDAVE}永远住在海底遗迹里嘛？如果海底有桑拿房就好了。

NARRATIVE_ATLANTIS_16_INTRO_5.en: {SAY:WINNIE}Seeing is believing, User Dave—we'll uncover the secrets of the ruins ourselves.
NARRATIVE_ATLANTIS_16_INTRO_5.zh: {SAY:WINNIE}眼见为实，用户戴夫，我们会亲自解开遗迹的秘密的。

NARRATIVE_ATLANTIS_17_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:CRAZYDAVE7{NPC_ENTER:WINNIE}{SAY:WINNIE}The data shows that these Ruins Zombies seem to be preparing to pass judgment on outsiders.
NARRATIVE_ATLANTIS_17_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:CRAZYDAVE}{NPC_ENTER:WINNIE}{SAY:WINNIE}数据显示，这些遗迹僵尸们似乎要对外来者进行一场判决。

NARRATIVE_ATLANTIS_17_INTRO_2.en: {EXCITED:CRAZYDAVE}We travel faster than light every day and never get a ticket!
NARRATIVE_ATLANTIS_17_INTRO_2.zh: {EXCITED:CRAZYDAVE}我们每天超光速都没被开过罚单！

NARRATIVE_ATLANTIS_17_INTRO_3.en: {EXCITED:CRAZYDAVE}Looks like they'd be great for scrubbing in the bath!

NARRATIVE_ATLANTIS_17_INTRO_4.en: {SAY:WINNIE}The plants wouldn't think so, User Dave.
NARRATIVE_ATLANTIS_17_INTRO_4.zh: {SAY:WINNIE}植物们不会这么想的，用户戴夫。

NARRATIVE_ATLANTIS_18_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:CRAZYDAVE}{NPC_ENTER:WINNIE}{SAY:WINNIE}My analyzer needs more information about these underwater ruins zombies.
NARRATIVE_ATLANTIS_18_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:CRAZYDAVE}{NPC_ENTER:WINNIE}{SAY:WINNIE}我的分析仪需要这些海底遗迹僵尸的更多信息。

NARRATIVE_ATLANTIS_18_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:WINNIE}Please follow the operating rules to complete the virtual experiment and help my analyzer reach a conclusion.
NARRATIVE_ATLANTIS_18_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:WINNIE}请按照操作规则完成虚拟实验，协助我的分析仪得出结论。

NARRATIVE_ATLANTIS_18_INTRO_3.en: {SAY:WINNIE}The functions of the items in the top item bar, from left to right, are as follows:
NARRATIVE_ATLANTIS_18_INTRO_3.zh: {SAY:WINNIE}上方道具栏中的道具从左到右依次的作用为：

NARRATIVE_ATLANTIS_18_INTRO_4.en: {SAY:WINNIE}1.Upgrades and enhances the quality of brain cakes, accelerating zombie growth.
NARRATIVE_ATLANTIS_18_INTRO_4.zh: {SAY:WINNIE}1.升级增强脑子蛋糕质量，加快僵尸成长

NARRATIVE_ATLANTIS_18_INTRO_5.en: {SAY:WINNIE}2.Upgrades increase the number of brain cakes that can be fed at the same time.
NARRATIVE_ATLANTIS_18_INTRO_5.zh: {SAY:WINNIE}2.升级增加可同时投喂脑子蛋糕的数量

NARRATIVE_ATLANTIS_18_INTRO_6.en: {SAY:WINNIE}3.Upgrades increase damage dealt to invading fish.
NARRATIVE_ATLANTIS_18_INTRO_6.zh: {SAY:WINNIE}3.升级增强攻击入侵鱼类的伤害

NARRATIVE_ATLANTIS_18_INTRO_8.en: {SAY:WINNIE}5.After purchase, the next brain cake placed will turn into sushi. Its purpose is currently unknown.
NARRATIVE_ATLANTIS_18_INTRO_8.zh: {SAY:WINNIE}5.购买后下次放置的脑子蛋糕将变为寿司，暂不清楚用途

NARRATIVE_ATLANTIS_18_INTRO_9.en: {SAY:WINNIE}6.Purchase three trophies to complete this level.

NARRATIVE_ATLANTIS_19_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:CRAZYDAVE}{NPC_ENTER:WINNIE}{EXCITED:CRAZYDAVE}It seems like there's something outside the submarine.

NARRATIVE_ATLANTIS_19_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:WINNIE}Detected organism of the phylum Mollusca, class Cephalopoda, subclass Coleoidea, order Sepiida, family Sepiidae, genus Sepia.
NARRATIVE_ATLANTIS_19_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:WINNIE}检测到软体动物门、头足纲、蛸亚纲、乌贼目、乌贼科、乌贼属生物

NARRATIVE_ATLANTIS_19_INTRO_3.en: {SAY:WINNIE}Their ink is not easy to deal with—be extra careful!
NARRATIVE_ATLANTIS_19_INTRO_3.zh: {SAY:WINNIE}他们的墨汁可不好处理，要多加小心！

NARRATIVE_ATLANTIS_1_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:WINNIE}User Dave, the data shows that we are about to head to the underwater ruins that were submerged ten thousand years ago.
NARRATIVE_ATLANTIS_1_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:WINNIE}用户戴夫，数据显示，我们即将前往万年前被淹没的水下遗迹

NARRATIVE_ATLANTIS_1_INTRO_4.en: {EXCITED:CRAZYDAVE}We've always been looking for the things we've lost, right!
NARRATIVE_ATLANTIS_1_INTRO_4.zh: {EXCITED:CRAZYDAVE}我们一直在找那些弄丢的东西对吧！

NARRATIVE_ATLANTIS_1_INTRO_5.en: {SAY:WINNIE}The scanner shows that the underwater zombies have also been constantly conducting search operations for brains.
NARRATIVE_ATLANTIS_1_INTRO_5.zh: {SAY:WINNIE}探测器显示，水下的僵尸们也一直不断对大脑展开搜寻行动。

NARRATIVE_ATLANTIS_1_INTRO_6.zh: {SAY:WINNIE}用户戴夫，我们必须做好准备！

NARRATIVE_ATLANTIS_1_INTRO_7.en: {EXCITED:CRAZYDAVE}I'll get the dehydrator ready—soaked tacos don't taste good.
NARRATIVE_ATLANTIS_1_INTRO_7.zh: {EXCITED:CRAZYDAVE}我会准备好风干机，泡水的玉米卷可不好吃。

NARRATIVE_ATLANTIS_21_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:CRAZYDAVE}{NPC_ENTER:WINNIE}{SAY:WINNIE}User Dave, we've finally successfully arrived at the underwater ruins.
NARRATIVE_ATLANTIS_21_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:CRAZYDAVE}{NPC_ENTER:WINNIE}{SAY:WINNIE}用户戴夫，我们终于成功抵达海底遗迹。

NARRATIVE_ATLANTIS_21_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:WINNIE}Please be careful, these blue whales accompanying us now have a very large appetite.
NARRATIVE_ATLANTIS_21_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:WINNIE}请小心，这些与我们随行的蓝鲸现在食欲十分巨大

NARRATIVE_ATLANTIS_21_INTRO_3.en: {EXCITED:CRAZYDAVE}Diving so deep into the sea is only for the sake of finding something to eat?
NARRATIVE_ATLANTIS_21_INTRO_3.zh: {EXCITED:CRAZYDAVE}潜如此深的海只是为了找吃的？

NARRATIVE_ATLANTIS_21_INTRO_4.en: {SAY:WINNIE}If only Seaderris could curb your appetite too.
NARRATIVE_ATLANTIS_21_INTRO_4.zh: {SAY:WINNIE}如果噗噗鱼藤也能遏制您的食欲就好了。

NARRATIVE_ATLANTIS_22_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:CRAZYDAVE}{NPC_ENTER:WINNIE}{SAY:WINNIE}The arena battle is still ongoing—stranger creatures are about to appear.
NARRATIVE_ATLANTIS_22_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:CRAZYDAVE}{NPC_ENTER:WINNIE}{SAY:WINNIE}斗兽活动仍在进行，更怪异的生物即将出现

NARRATIVE_ATLANTIS_22_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:WINNIE}The data shows that they seem to come from the terrifying abyssal depths of the ocean.
NARRATIVE_ATLANTIS_22_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:WINNIE}数据显示，他们似乎来自可怕的海底深渊。

NARRATIVE_ATLANTIS_22_INTRO_3.en: {EXCITED:CRAZYDAVE}I once stayed awake for 15 years, staring into the abyss.

NARRATIVE_ATLANTIS_24_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:WINNIE}Detected — that's not a real star, it's a starfish.
NARRATIVE_ATLANTIS_24_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:WINNIE}检测到那不是真正的星星，是一只海星

NARRATIVE_ATLANTIS_24_INTRO_3.en: {SAY:WINNIE}The startled starfish spins and slams into the submarine, accelerating the water flow.
NARRATIVE_ATLANTIS_24_INTRO_3.zh: {SAY:WINNIE}受到惊吓的海星旋转撞击潜艇，并使水流加速。

NARRATIVE_ATLANTIS_25_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:CRAZYDAVE}{NPC_ENTER:WINNIE}{EXCITED:CRAZYDAVE}What are those things on the seabed?

NARRATIVE_ATLANTIS_25_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:WINNIE}Phylum Mollusca—they use shells to protect themselves.
NARRATIVE_ATLANTIS_25_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:WINNIE}软体动物门，用贝壳保护自己。

NARRATIVE_ATLANTIS_25_INTRO_3.en: {EXCITED:CRAZYDAVE}Just like the iron pot on my head!

NARRATIVE_ATLANTIS_25_INTRO_4.en: {SAY:WINNIE}The data shows that their gripping power seems quite strong.
NARRATIVE_ATLANTIS_25_INTRO_4.zh: {SAY:WINNIE}数据显示，他们的开合力似乎很强。

NARRATIVE_ATLANTIS_27_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:CRAZYDAVE}{NPC_ENTER:WINNIE}{SAY:WINNIE}These zombies seem to want to start an underwater arena battle.
NARRATIVE_ATLANTIS_27_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:CRAZYDAVE}{NPC_ENTER:WINNIE}{SAY:WINNIE}这些僵尸们似乎想发起水下斗兽决战。

NARRATIVE_ATLANTIS_27_INTRO_2.en: {EXCITED:CRAZYDAVE}Whatever you do, don't drag a cat into this.!

NARRATIVE_ATLANTIS_28_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:WINNIE}Please continue to complete further simulation experiments!
NARRATIVE_ATLANTIS_28_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:WINNIE}请继续完成进一步模拟实验！

NARRATIVE_ATLANTIS_29_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:CRAZYDAVE}{NPC_ENTER:WINNIE}{EXCITED:CRAZYDAVE}Every time I see a pufferfish, I always want to poke it.
NARRATIVE_ATLANTIS_29_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:CRAZYDAVE}{NPC_ENTER:WINNIE}{EXCITED:CRAZYDAVE}每次我看到河豚，总想戳上一下。

NARRATIVE_ATLANTIS_29_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:WINNIE}I suggest you abandon that idea, User Dave.
NARRATIVE_ATLANTIS_29_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:WINNIE}我建议你打消这个念头，用户戴夫。

NARRATIVE_ATLANTIS_29_INTRO_3.en: {SAY:WINNIE}Loose balloons fly everywhere, just like pufferfish.
NARRATIVE_ATLANTIS_29_INTRO_3.zh: {SAY:WINNIE}松开的气球到处乱飞，河豚也是一样。

NARRATIVE_ATLANTIS_2_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:CRAZYDAVE}{NPC_ENTER:WINNIE}{SAY:WINNIE}Watch out—there's more than one outsider in these waters!
NARRATIVE_ATLANTIS_2_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:CRAZYDAVE}{NPC_ENTER:WINNIE}{SAY:WINNIE}小心，这片海域不止一位外来者！

NARRATIVE_ATLANTIS_2_INTRO_2.en: {EXCITED:CRAZYDAVE}So does swimming really help with weight loss?

NARRATIVE_ATLANTIS_4_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:CRAZYDAVE}{NPC_ENTER:WINNIE}{EXCITED:CRAZYDAVE}Is that a magic conch? Can it answer my questions?
NARRATIVE_ATLANTIS_4_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:CRAZYDAVE}{NPC_ENTER:WINNIE}{EXCITED:CRAZYDAVE}那是神奇海螺吗，它可以回答我的问题吗

NARRATIVE_ATLANTIS_4_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:WINNIE}According to calculations, hearing an answer is 0%, but hearing User Dave scream is 100%.
NARRATIVE_ATLANTIS_4_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:WINNIE}经演算听到回答的概率为0%，听到用户戴夫惨叫的可能性为100%

NARRATIVE_ATLANTIS_4_INTRO_3.en: {SAY:WINNIE}Zombies like to decorate their heads with hermit crabs to make their heads more secure!
NARRATIVE_ATLANTIS_4_INTRO_3.zh: {SAY:WINNIE}僵尸们喜欢拿寄居蟹装饰脑袋，让它们的头更加安全！

NARRATIVE_ATLANTIS_4_INTRO_4.en: {EXCITED:CRAZYDAVE}I think I know where coneheads originated now.

NARRATIVE_ATLANTIS_7_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:CRAZYDAVE}{NPC_ENTER:WINNIE}{SAY:WINNIE}Warning! Sensors detect an increase in water flow velocity.
NARRATIVE_ATLANTIS_7_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:CRAZYDAVE}{NPC_ENTER:WINNIE}{SAY:WINNIE}警告！传感器检测到水体流速加快

NARRATIVE_ATLANTIS_7_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:WINNIE}User Dave, we need to prepare a response plan.
NARRATIVE_ATLANTIS_7_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:WINNIE}用户戴夫，我们要准备应对方案

NARRATIVE_ATLANTIS_9_INTRO_3.en: {SAY:WINNIE}Jellyfish are made up of 95% to 98% water - I don't think you can squeeze jellyfish sauce out of them.
NARRATIVE_ATLANTIS_9_INTRO_3.zh: {SAY:WINNIE}水母的含水量高达95%到98%，我认为挤不出水母酱

NARRATIVE_ATLANTIS_9_INTRO_4.en: {SAY:WINNIE}The startled jellyfish will take our plants.
NARRATIVE_ATLANTIS_9_INTRO_4.zh: {SAY:WINNIE}受到惊吓的水母会带走我们的植物。

NARRATIVE_BANANA_TIP_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie} Tap on Banana Launcher, then a tile, to launch explosive banana.
NARRATIVE_BANANA_TIP_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie} 轻点香蕉，再轻点一块地砖，即可发射爆炸香蕉弹

NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_BANANA_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}User Dave. Please note the line of Banana Launchers.
NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_BANANA_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}用户戴夫，请注意那一排香蕉发射器。

NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_BANANA_3.en: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}Let's get to it! After all, bananas are a very a-PEELING fruit!
NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_BANANA_3.zh: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}让我们吃了它们吧！毕竟，香蕉是一种易于剥皮的水果。

NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_BANANA_4.en: {TIRED:winnie}User Dave, if I had a head, I would be shaking it right now.
NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_BANANA_4.zh: {TIRED:winnie}用户戴夫，如果我有个头的话，我现在一定已经在摇它了。

NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_BOWLING_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}My research indicates that the sport of bowling experienced a heyday during this era.
NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_BOWLING_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}我的研究表明，保龄球运动在这时正处于鼎盛时期。

NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_BOWLING_2.en: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}Are you thinking what I'm thinking, Penny?

NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_BOWLING_3.en: {TIRED:winnie}I find your thought process indecipherable, User Dave.
NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_BOWLING_3.zh: {TIRED:winnie}我发现你的思考过程令我很难解读，用户戴夫。

NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_BOWLING_4.en: {SAY:winnie}I was thinking that Bowling Bulbs would make excellent allies here.
NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_BOWLING_4.zh: {SAY:winnie}我觉得保龄泡泡在这里会成为我们最棒的盟友。

NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_BOWLING_5.en: {SAY:crazydave}Huh. I was thinking how much I love wearing bowling shoes.
NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_BOWLING_5.zh: {SAY:crazydave}啊哈，我刚刚在想我有多么爱穿保龄球鞋。

NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_BOWLING_6.en: {EXCITED:crazydave}So many colors ... right there on my feet!
NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_BOWLING_6.zh: {EXCITED:crazydave}那时的我…脚上有着五颜六色的装饰！

NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_CHOMPER_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}当好战的僵尸从深渊走出时…

NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_CHOMPER_2.en: {PLAYFUL:winnie}...we need a plant with the appetite of a shark.
NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_CHOMPER_2.zh: {PLAYFUL:winnie}…我们需要一种有着鲨鱼般欲望的植物。

NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_CHOMPER_3.en: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}I catch your drift, Penny. You're talking about Chomper!
NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_CHOMPER_3.zh: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}我懂你意思了，潘妮。你是在说大嘴花吧！

NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_CHOMPER_4.en: {SAY:winnie}Indeed. His sharp teeth could turn the tide of battle.
NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_CHOMPER_4.zh: {SAY:winnie}的确如此。他的尖牙可以扭转战局。

NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_CHOMPER_5.en: {EXCITED:crazydave}Hey, I have an idea too! We could call this Chomper Week!
NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_CHOMPER_5.zh: {EXCITED:crazydave}嘿，我也有个主意！我们可以把这周称作“大嘴花之周”！

NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_CHOMPER_6.en: {TIRED:winnie}If we must, User Dave. If we must.
NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_CHOMPER_6.zh: {TIRED:winnie}万不得已的时候再这样吧，用户戴夫。如果我们必须的话。

NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_FIRSTLEVEL_2.en: {SAY:crazydave}It's got everything a growing plant needs!
NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_FIRSTLEVEL_2.zh: {SAY:crazydave}它有着植物生长所需要的一切！

NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_FIRSTLEVEL_3.zh: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}阳光，沙滩，还有源源不断的浪花儿！

NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_FIRSTLEVEL_4.en: {SAY:winnie}Caution, User Dave. My sensors indicate there are zombies on your beach...
NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_FIRSTLEVEL_4.zh: {SAY:winnie}当心，用户戴夫。我的传感器显示你的海滩上有许多僵尸…

NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_FIRSTLEVEL_5.en: {SAY:winnie}... and far too much water. It will overwhelm the plants.
NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_FIRSTLEVEL_5.zh: {SAY:winnie}…还有过多的海水。它会淹没你的植物。

NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_FIRSTLEVEL_6.en: {SAY:crazydave}No problem-o! We'll just lay down some Lily Pads.
NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_FIRSTLEVEL_6.zh: {SAY:crazydave}这可没问题！我们只需要先放些睡莲叶。

NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_FIRSTLEVEL_7.en: {EXCITED:crazydave}Then the other plants can ride the waves!
NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_FIRSTLEVEL_7.zh: {EXCITED:crazydave}然后其他植物就可以凌驾于海浪之上了！

NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_FIRSTLEVEL_8.en: {PLAYFUL:winnie}Or as the vernacular of this era goes: They can "hang ten."
NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_FIRSTLEVEL_8.zh: {PLAYFUL:winnie}或者用这里的土话来说：它们可以“踏浪前行”。

NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_GARGANTUAR_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY}Listen up, dudes! I'm here to totally bum you out.
NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_GARGANTUAR_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY}你们几个，我说啊，你们已经是死到临头了！

NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_GARGANTUAR_2.en: {SAY}Way down deep, there's a certain creep...

NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_GARGANTUAR_3.en: {SAY}When he swims up, your brains he'll keep!
NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_GARGANTUAR_3.zh: {SAY}当他的身影从海洋中浮起，你的脑子将落到他的手上！

NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_GARGANTUAR_6.en: {TIRED:winnie}He is also quite unpleasant, User Dave. Quite unpleasant.
NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_GARGANTUAR_6.zh: {TIRED:winnie}看得出来他对我们很不爽，用户戴夫。非常不爽。

NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_GARGANTUAR_ALT_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY}Dudes, like, you're totally in for it now!
NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_GARGANTUAR_ALT_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY}你们几个，我说啊，已经死到临头了！

NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_GARGANTUAR_ALT_2.en: {SAY}The Deep Sea Gargantuars have their slimy sights on you.
NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_GARGANTUAR_ALT_2.zh: {SAY}深海巨人僵尸那黏糊糊的视线早已盯上你们！

NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_GARGANTUAR_ALT_4.en: {SAY}But you can't escape their scaly grip!
NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_GARGANTUAR_ALT_4.zh: {SAY}但是你绝对逃不过他们粗糙的掌心！

NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_GARGANTUAR_ALT_6.en: {TIRED:winnie}He is also quite unpleasant, User Dave. Quite unpleasant.
NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_GARGANTUAR_ALT_6.zh: {TIRED:winnie}看得出来他对我们很不爽，用户戴夫。非常不爽。

NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_GUACODILE_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{TIRED:crazydave}I tell ya, Penny, these surf-loving zombies are the pits!
NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_GUACODILE_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{TIRED:crazydave}我说过的，潘妮，这些爱冲浪的僵尸太废渣了！

NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_GUACODILE_3.en: {PLAYFUL:winnie}Hmmm. Pits. Very interesting. User Dave! You are a genius!
NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_GUACODILE_3.zh: {PLAYFUL:winnie}额。废渣。相当有趣。用户戴夫！你真是个天才！

NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_GUACODILE_5.en: {TIRED:winnie}No. No you are not. However, you have given me an idea.
NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_GUACODILE_5.zh: {TIRED:winnie}不，这并不关乎是否是你。不过，你给了我一个好主意。

NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_GUACODILE_6.en: {EXCITED:winnie}Guacodile! This plant fights zombies with pit-like projectiles.
NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_GUACODILE_6.zh: {EXCITED:winnie}鳄梨！这种植物用类似废渣的子弹同僵尸战斗。

NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_GUACODILE_7.en: {SAY:winnie}And he employs a powerful bite as well.

NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_GUACODILE_8.en: {EXCITED:winnie}Plant him on the front lines. You'll see.
NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_GUACODILE_8.zh: {EXCITED:winnie}如果你把他种植在潮位线之前。你就会见识到它的厉害。

NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_HOMINGTHISTLE_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{TIRED:crazydave}Whew! Fighting zombies that arrive in waves AND tides isn't easy.
NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_HOMINGTHISTLE_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{TIRED:crazydave}呼，同随着浪花与退潮而来的僵尸作战可不容易啊。

NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_HOMINGTHISTLE_2.en: {EXCITED:crazydave}You know what we need, Penny? An ally with a lot of 'tude!
NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_HOMINGTHISTLE_2.zh: {EXCITED:crazydave}潘妮，你知道我们需要什么吗？一位有着热情什么格的盟友！

NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_HOMINGTHISTLE_3.en: {SAY:crazydave}And by 'tude, I mean attitude. In case you need translation.
NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_HOMINGTHISTLE_3.zh: {SAY:crazydave}那个“什么格”，意思是“风格”。毕竟有时候你可能需要一个翻译嘛。

NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_HOMINGTHISTLE_4.en: {SAY:winnie}Then I suggest we call upon Homing Thistle.

NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_HOMINGTHISTLE_5.en: {SAY:winnie}I believe he has this 'tude you speak of.
NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_HOMINGTHISTLE_5.zh: {SAY:winnie}我相信他就是那个你说的拥有某种风格的植物盟友。

NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_HOMINGTHISTLE_6.en: {EXCITED:crazydave}His eyes! Intense! He can shoot the zombies a real mean look.
NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_HOMINGTHISTLE_6.zh: {EXCITED:crazydave}看他那眼神！咄咄逼人！感觉他光凭目光就能把那些僵尸射爆！

NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_HOMINGTHISTLE_7.en: {EXCITED:winnie}More importantly, he can shoot deadly darts that home in on their target.
NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_HOMINGTHISTLE_7.zh: {EXCITED:winnie}更厉害的是，他可以发射精确锁定目标的死亡毒镖。

NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_HOMINGTHISTLE_8.en: {EXCITED:crazydave}Two painful blows for the price of one! Radical!
NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_HOMINGTHISTLE_8.zh: {EXCITED:crazydave}一次就能造成双份的伤害，实在是无与伦比！

NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_TIDES_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}User Dave, data suggests that we should beware the tides.
NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_TIDES_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}用户戴夫，数据表明我们应该提防着点儿潮汐。

NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_TIDES_2.en: {SAY:crazydave}When the tide comes in, it'll be a WIPE OUT for our plant friends?
NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_TIDES_2.zh: {SAY:crazydave}你是说，涨潮时，我们的植物伙伴就会被淹没吗？

NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_TIDES_3.en: {SAY:winnie}Indeed. But the tide line indicates how high the water will rise. Plan accordingly.
NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_TIDES_3.zh: {SAY:winnie}正确。但是海岸线可以告知我们潮水最多能上涨到多高。所以依照着它来合理安排吧。

NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_TIDES_4.en: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}The tide comes in, the tide goes out. Who can explain it?
NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_TIDES_4.zh: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}潮起潮落，谁又能解释这些现象呢？

NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_TIDES_5.zh: {TIRED:winnie}科学能为你解答一切，用户戴夫

NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}Yo beach bums! Don't flip your lid.
NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}嘿！海滩懒汉！听过我的话之后可别大动肝火。

NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_2.en: {SAY:zombossicon}But have you noticed that Chomper and Bikini Zombie have been ultra cozy lately?
NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_2.zh: {SAY:zombossicon}你们难道没有注意到大嘴花和比基尼僵尸最近有些过于亲密吗？

NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_3.en: {SAY:zombossicon}Could a beachside plant-zombie romance be in bloom?
NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_3.zh: {SAY:zombossicon}有没有一种可能，植物与僵尸的海滨爱情正在缓缓萌芽？

NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_4.en: {SAY:zombossicon}Speaking of which, how sure are you of Chomper's loyalties?
NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_4.zh: {SAY:zombossicon}说到这儿，你对大嘴花的忠诚还有几分把握呢？

NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_5.en: {SAY:zombossicon}I can't help but notice ... that plant has the appetite of a zombie.
NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_5.zh: {SAY:zombossicon}我爱莫能助，但是我已经注意到了…那株植物具有僵尸般的食欲！

NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_6.en:
{SAY:zombossicon}Chew on that land lovers! Later dudes!
Dr. Zomboss
NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_6.zh:
{SAY:zombossicon}先是咬碎土地上的爱人！接着就是你们几个！
僵王博士

NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_7.en: {NPC_EXIT:zombossicon}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:crazydave}A plant-zombie romance? Penny ... my mind is BLOWN!
NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_7.zh: {NPC_EXIT:zombossicon}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:crazydave}植物与僵尸的爱情？潘妮…我的脑子简直要爆—炸—了—！

NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_8.en: {SAY:winnie}User Dave, do not jump to conclusions. I suggest something more productive.
NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_8.zh: {SAY:winnie}用户戴夫，不要妄下定论。我建议去做些更有用的事情。

NARRATIVE_BEACH_OUTRO_DANGER_ROOM_KEY_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:winnie}Alert! I've detected a strange statue of surfing-era significance.
NARRATIVE_BEACH_OUTRO_DANGER_ROOM_KEY_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:winnie}警告！我探测到了一具拥有冲浪时代意义的奇怪雕像。

NARRATIVE_BEACH_OUTRO_DANGER_ROOM_KEY_2.en: {EXCITED:crazydave}Well lookie there! It's a tiki statue. With crazy eyes.
NARRATIVE_BEACH_OUTRO_DANGER_ROOM_KEY_2.zh: {EXCITED:crazydave}看哪！这是一具提基雕像，有着魔性的双瞳。

NARRATIVE_BEACH_OUTRO_DANGER_ROOM_KEY_3.en: {SAY:winnie}Analysis indicates this tiki could inflict a terrifying challenge upon any who follow it.
NARRATIVE_BEACH_OUTRO_DANGER_ROOM_KEY_3.zh: {SAY:winnie}分析表明，这个“提基”会让任何信奉它的人面临一个可怕的挑战。

NARRATIVE_BEACH_OUTRO_DANGER_ROOM_KEY_4.en: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}So you're saying that a tiki torture awaits? Get it? A tiki TORCH-er?
