NARRATIVE_BEACH_OUTRO_DANGER_ROOM_KEY_4.zh: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}提基“船沉”者是吧。哈哈，听懂这个笑话了吗？提基“传承”者！

NARRATIVE_BEACH_OUTRO_DANGER_ROOM_KEY_5.en:
{TIRED:winnie}User Dave, I must say, your pun is...
TORCH-er-ous.
NARRATIVE_BEACH_OUTRO_DANGER_ROOM_KEY_5.zh:
{TIRED:winnie}用户戴夫，我不得不说…
你的谐音梗说明了船沉的危险性。

NARRATIVE_BEACH_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:crazydave}植物与僵尸的爱情？这简直太疯——狂了！

NARRATIVE_BEACH_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_2.en: {SHOUT:crazydave}And I know a thing or two about craaaazy!
NARRATIVE_BEACH_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_2.zh: {SHOUT:crazydave}我还知道了一两件疯——狂的事！

NARRATIVE_BEACH_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_3.en: {SAY:winnie}I concur. I suspect Dr. Zomboss was attempting to sow seeds of discontent.
NARRATIVE_BEACH_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_3.zh: {SAY:winnie}我赞同。我怀疑僵王博士企图播下令人不满的种子。

NARRATIVE_BEACH_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_4.en: {SAY:crazydave}From now on, we are the only ones sowing seeds around here!
NARRATIVE_BEACH_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_4.zh: {SAY:crazydave}从现在开始，我们才是这儿唯一能种下种子的人！

NARRATIVE_BEACH_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_5.en: {NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}Totally bogus! Little do you know what I have in store for you!
NARRATIVE_BEACH_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_5.zh: {NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}完全错误！你们对于我还留了一手这事知之甚少！

NARRATIVE_BEACH_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_6.en: {SAY:zombossicon}The seeds of destruction have been planted! Brace yourselves for a wipe out!
NARRATIVE_BEACH_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_6.zh: {SAY:zombossicon}毁灭之种已然撒下！为这毁灭的万物，振奋起来吧！

NARRATIVE_BEACH_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_7.en: {SAY:zombossicon}But for now, I gotta split. Catch you dweebs later!
NARRATIVE_BEACH_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_7.zh: {SAY:zombossicon}不过现在呢，我先开溜啦。呆会再来抓住你们这些傻瓜！

NARRATIVE_BEACH_ZOMBIENOTE_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydaveicon}{EXCITED:crazydaveicon}Look! It must be time to play Beach Zombie Bungo!
NARRATIVE_BEACH_ZOMBIENOTE_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydaveicon}{EXCITED:crazydaveicon}看那！是时候去玩海滩僵尸冰格小游戏了！

NARRATIVE_BEACH_ZOMBIENOTE_2.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnieicon}{EXCITED:winnieicon}好的，用户戴夫。不过这是 BINGO 小游戏。

NARRATIVE_BEACH_ZOMBIENOTE_3.en: {SAY:crazydaveicon}You already won, Penny? Wow. You're good at this!
NARRATIVE_BEACH_ZOMBIENOTE_3.zh: {SAY:crazydaveicon}你已经赢了？潘妮！哇。你很擅长这个呢！

NARRATIVE_BEGHOULED_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}I am picking up a grid of plants, User Dave.
NARRATIVE_BEGHOULED_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}我正在收集整理一箩筐子的植物，用户戴夫。

NARRATIVE_BEGHOULED_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:winnie}My scans suggest that they can be swapped to create matches of three.
NARRATIVE_BEGHOULED_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}我的雷达显示，通过两两交换，我们可以把三株相同的植物配对，然后消去他们。

NARRATIVE_BEGHOULED_INTRO_3.en: {EXCITED:crazydave}I saw a game like that once on my telephoney!
NARRATIVE_BEGHOULED_INTRO_3.zh: {EXCITED:crazydave}我曾在我的小手机上见过这款游戏！

NARRATIVE_BEGHOULED_INTRO_4.en: {SAY:winnie}You can use sun to upgrade the plants.
NARRATIVE_BEGHOULED_INTRO_4.zh: {SAY:winnie}使用阳光可以提升场上植物的品质。

NARRATIVE_BEGHOULED_INTRO_5.zh: {SAY:winnie}通过制造 100 组匹配来战胜此关的僵尸吧！

NARRATIVE_BIGBRAINZ01_3.en: {SAY:crazydave}We're learning how to reduce Chew Times!
NARRATIVE_BIGBRAINZ01_3.zh: {SAY:crazydave}我们在学习如何减少咀嚼的次数！

NARRATIVE_BIGBRAINZ01_5.zh: {SAY:crazydave}没时间想那么多了！先学为敬！

NARRATIVE_BIGBRAINZ02_3.en: {NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}To the contrary, foolish Dave. Soon you shall discover...
NARRATIVE_BIGBRAINZ02_3.zh: {NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}恰恰相反，呆瓜戴夫，你很快就会发现…

NARRATIVE_BIGBRAINZ03_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}Penny! I saw Dr. Zomboss in my poetry class!
NARRATIVE_BIGBRAINZ03_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}潘妮！我在诗歌课上看到了僵王博士！

NARRATIVE_BIGBRAINZ03_2.en: {SAY:winnie}Beware, User Dave. He is up to something.
NARRATIVE_BIGBRAINZ03_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}当心，用户戴夫。他肯定在计划些什么。

NARRATIVE_BIGBRAINZ03_3.en: {SAY:crazydave}But his rhymes were so dope and refreshing!
NARRATIVE_BIGBRAINZ03_3.zh: {SAY:crazydave}但他的诗歌真的太酷了，使人充满了活力！

NARRATIVE_BIGBRAINZ04_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}How are you faring in your summer classes, User Dave?
NARRATIVE_BIGBRAINZ04_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}你的暑期课程进展如何？用户戴夫。

NARRATIVE_BIGBRAINZ04_3.en: {SAY:crazydave}Did you know numbers keep going after 10?
NARRATIVE_BIGBRAINZ04_3.zh: {SAY:crazydave}你知道数字在 10 以后还会增长吗？

NARRATIVE_BIGBRAINZ04_4.en: {SAY:crazydave}I had to take my shoes off!
NARRATIVE_BIGBRAINZ04_4.zh: {SAY:crazydave}我现在得脱下鞋来用脚数了！

NARRATIVE_BIGBRAINZ05_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}Snow Pea is a big hit at Summer School, Penny!
NARRATIVE_BIGBRAINZ05_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}潘妮，寒冰豌豆在暑期班很受欢迎！

NARRATIVE_BIGBRAINZ05_2.en: {SAY:crazydave}His increased Chance to Freeze ability is making him BPOC!
NARRATIVE_BIGBRAINZ05_2.zh: {SAY:crazydave}他提升的冻结能力让他如鱼得水！

NARRATIVE_BIGBRAINZ06_2.en: {SAY:zombossicon}This so-called "Big Brainz event" is not just a tribute to knowledge and education.
NARRATIVE_BIGBRAINZ06_2.zh: {SAY:zombossicon}这个所谓的“大头僵尸”活动不仅仅对知识和教育的致敬，

NARRATIVE_BIGBRAINZ06_3.en: {SAY:zombossicon}It is also a TRAP MOST DIRE!!!

NARRATIVE_BIGBRAINZ07_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}You must find a way to foil Dr. Zomboss' evil Big Brainz plot, User Dave.
NARRATIVE_BIGBRAINZ07_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}你必须想方设法来阻止僵王博士在“大头僵尸”活动上的邪恶阴谋，用户戴夫。

NARRATIVE_BIGBRAINZ07_2.en: {SAY:crazydave}But how? Summer School doesn't offer a course in "defeating mad scientists."
NARRATIVE_BIGBRAINZ07_2.zh: {SAY:crazydave}但是要怎么阻止？暑期班没有开设“如何打败疯狂科学家”的课程啊！

NARRATIVE_BIGBRAINZ08_2.en: {SAY:crazydave}We gather together all the plants who've been going to Summer School...
NARRATIVE_BIGBRAINZ08_2.zh: {SAY:crazydave}我们把所有去过暑期班的植物聚集在一起…

NARRATIVE_BIGBRAINZ08_6.en: {SAY:crazydave}We're in bigger trouble than I thought!
NARRATIVE_BIGBRAINZ08_6.zh: {SAY:crazydave}看来我们遇到的麻烦比想像中还要棘手！

NARRATIVE_BIGBRAINZ09_2.en: {SAY:crazydave}You may try to ruin our fun Big Brainz event with some mad scheme!
NARRATIVE_BIGBRAINZ09_2.zh: {SAY:crazydave}你可能是在试图用一些疯狂的计划，破坏我们有趣的“大头僵尸”活动！

NARRATIVE_BIGBRAINZ09_5.en: {SAY:crazydave}I got an A+ on my synonym quiz!
NARRATIVE_BIGBRAINZ09_5.zh: {SAY:crazydave}我在同义词测验中拿了 A+！

NARRATIVE_BIGBRAINZ10_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}Foolish Dave! Your time is... uh... wait a moment...
NARRATIVE_BIGBRAINZ10_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}呆瓜戴夫！你的时候到……呃……等一下…

NARRATIVE_BIGBRAINZ10_3.en: {SAY:zombossicon}I spent so much time gloating I forgot to invent a scheme!
NARRATIVE_BIGBRAINZ10_3.zh: {SAY:zombossicon}幸灾乐祸太久，我都忘记要想个计划了！

NARRATIVE_BIGBRAINZ10_4.en: {NPC_EXIT:zombossicon}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:crazydave}What's that, Zomboss? Didn't do your HOMEWORK?
NARRATIVE_BIGBRAINZ10_4.zh: {NPC_EXIT:zombossicon}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:crazydave}咋了？僵王，你该不会是作业还没写完吧？

NARRATIVE_BIGBRAINZ10_5.en: {SAY:crazydave}In English class we call that IRONY!
NARRATIVE_BIGBRAINZ10_5.zh: {SAY:crazydave}在英语课上，我们称之为“IRONY”——讽刺！

NARRATIVE_BIGBRAINZ10_6.en: {NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}This isn't over! I'll take online classes! You haven't seen the last of meeee...
NARRATIVE_BIGBRAINZ10_6.zh: {NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}这还没完！我会去上网课的！你还会再见到我的…

NARRATIVE_BIGBRAINZ10_7.en: {NPC_EXIT:zombossicon}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}I bet we've seen the last of him!
NARRATIVE_BIGBRAINZ10_7.zh: {NPC_EXIT:zombossicon}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}我打赌这是我们最后一次见到他了！

NARRATIVE_BIGBRAINZ10_8.en: {SAY:winnie}Don't count on it. But at least the Big Brainz event was a huge success!
NARRATIVE_BIGBRAINZ10_8.zh: {SAY:winnie}不至于。但起码“大头僵尸”活动取得了巨大的成功！

NARRATIVE_BIRTHDAYZ_LTE_2022_1_10.zh: {SAY:sunflower}就喜欢你这样的选择性热情，兄弟！

NARRATIVE_BIRTHDAYZ_LTE_2022_1_3.en: {SAY:sunflower}I know, silly! We've been friends for years!
NARRATIVE_BIRTHDAYZ_LTE_2022_1_3.zh: {SAY:sunflower}我知道，小傻瓜。我们已经当了好多年的朋友了！

NARRATIVE_BIRTHDAYZ_LTE_2022_1_4.en: {SAY:sunflower}Thirteen of them, to be exact! Time to PARTY!
NARRATIVE_BIRTHDAYZ_LTE_2022_1_4.zh: {SAY:sunflower}准确地说，已经 13 年了！一起来开个派对吧！

NARRATIVE_BIRTHDAYZ_LTE_2022_2_5.zh: {SAY:sunflower_r}哪家孩子 13 岁还不会说话呀！

NARRATIVE_BIRTHDAYZ_LTE_2022_3_2.en: {SAY:winnie}Greetings, Wall-nut. And a fine happy Birthdayz to you as well.
NARRATIVE_BIRTHDAYZ_LTE_2022_3_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}你好，坚果墙。也祝你度过一个愉快的生日。

NARRATIVE_BIRTHDAYZ_LTE_2022_3_4.en: {SAY:winnie}I am Penny, User Dave's time-traveling recreational vehicle.
NARRATIVE_BIRTHDAYZ_LTE_2022_3_4.zh: {SAY:winnie}我叫潘妮，用户戴夫用来进行时空旅行的休闲车。

NARRATIVE_BIRTHDAYZ_LTE_2022_3_5.en: {SAY:wallnut}Neaters! I guess that means you can have Birthdayz whenever you want!
NARRATIVE_BIRTHDAYZ_LTE_2022_3_5.zh: {SAY:wallnut}太厉害了！那你岂不是可以随时过生日！

NARRATIVE_BIRTHDAYZ_LTE_2022_4_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:sunflower_r}{SAY:crazydave}Who should we invite to the Birthdayz party, Sunflower?
NARRATIVE_BIRTHDAYZ_LTE_2022_4_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:sunflower_r}{SAY:crazydave}我们应该邀请谁来参加生日庆典呢，向日葵？

NARRATIVE_BIRTHDAYZ_LTE_2022_5_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}Gnash my teeth! A birthdayz party? Without I?
NARRATIVE_BIRTHDAYZ_LTE_2022_5_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}气抖冷！生日派对……居然不邀请我？

NARRATIVE_BIRTHDAYZ_LTE_2022_5_2.en: {SAY:zombossicon}Dr. Edgar Zomboss? Premiere alt-life thinker and moral philosopher?
NARRATIVE_BIRTHDAYZ_LTE_2022_5_2.zh: {SAY:zombossicon}我可是首席另类生命思考家、道德哲学家——埃德加·僵王博士！

NARRATIVE_BIRTHDAYZ_LTE_2022_5_3.en: {SAY:zombossicon}You shall rue and pay for this insult!
NARRATIVE_BIRTHDAYZ_LTE_2022_5_3.zh: {SAY:zombossicon}如此侮辱我，你们会为之后悔、付出代价的！

NARRATIVE_BIRTHDAYZ_LTE_2022_5_5.zh: {SAY:sunflower}大家都知道这也是你的生日！

NARRATIVE_BIRTHDAYZ_LTE_2022_6_3.en: {SAY:sunflower}If the presents keep coming, I'm not complaining!
NARRATIVE_BIRTHDAYZ_LTE_2022_6_3.zh: {SAY:sunflower}如果礼物不断，我的快乐也不会断！

NARRATIVE_BIRTHDAYZ_LTE_2022_6_4.en: {SAY:wallnut_r}I just hope we don't see Jetpack Zombies in this level.
NARRATIVE_BIRTHDAYZ_LTE_2022_6_4.zh: {SAY:wallnut_r}我只希望这关不要出现喷射器僵尸。

NARRATIVE_BIRTHDAYZ_LTE_2022_6_5.en: {SAY:wallnut_r}I will FREAK OUT if we do!

NARRATIVE_BIRTHDAYZ_LTE_2022_7_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}What an incredible Birthdayz this has been, Penny!
NARRATIVE_BIRTHDAYZ_LTE_2022_7_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}这次的生日庆典太棒了，潘妮！

NARRATIVE_BIRTHDAYZ_LTE_2022_7_3.zh: {SAY:crazydave}而且现在植物可以说话了，潘妮！

NARRATIVE_BIRTHDAYZ_LTE_2022_7_7.en: {SAY:sunflower_r}We plants gossip all the time in there!
NARRATIVE_BIRTHDAYZ_LTE_2022_7_7.zh: {SAY:sunflower_r}我们植物经常在里面聊八卦！

NARRATIVE_BIRTHDAYZ_LTE_2023_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:winnie}User Dave, I believe celebratory congratulations are in order.
NARRATIVE_BIRTHDAYZ_LTE_2023_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:winnie}用户戴夫，庆典祝贺应该已经准备就绪了。

NARRATIVE_BIRTHDAYZ_LTE_2023_1_3.en: {SAY:winnie}No User Dave, it is your Birthday!

NARRATIVE_BIRTHDAYZ_LTE_2023_1_4.en: {NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}There will be no celebrating today! You!! Get them!!!
NARRATIVE_BIRTHDAYZ_LTE_2023_1_4.zh: {NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}我才不会让你们庆祝呢！来人！！ 抓住他们！！！

NARRATIVE_BIRTHDAYZ_LTE_2023_2_2.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Emergency!!! Unusual energy signatures detected. Brace for time… .. . *BZZZTTT… WOOOOSHhhh*
NARRATIVE_BIRTHDAYZ_LTE_2023_2_2.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}紧急状况！！！ 探测到异常能量签名。赶快……*嗞……唔——*

NARRATIVE_BIRTHDAYZ_LTE_2023_2_3.en: {NPC_EXIT:peashooter}{NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}Muhahah!!! You fools! You walked right into my trap.
NARRATIVE_BIRTHDAYZ_LTE_2023_2_3.zh: {NPC_EXIT:peashooter}{NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}木哈哈！！！ 你们这群傻瓜！步入我的陷阱了吧。

NARRATIVE_BIRTHDAYZ_LTE_2023_2_4.en: {SAY:zomboss_r}Finally, my subscription to Evil Genius Monthly is paying off.
NARRATIVE_BIRTHDAYZ_LTE_2023_2_4.zh: {SAY:zomboss_r}终于啊，看来我订阅《邪恶天才月刊》的钱没百花。

NARRATIVE_BIRTHDAYZ_LTE_2023_3_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:peashooter}Is that a Yeti? I thought they'd gone extinct?
NARRATIVE_BIRTHDAYZ_LTE_2023_3_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:peashooter}那是只雪人僵尸吗？我还以为它们都灭绝了呢？

NARRATIVE_BIRTHDAYZ_LTE_2023_3_2.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}It would appear that Zomboss’s tampering has caused the Yeti's reappearance.
NARRATIVE_BIRTHDAYZ_LTE_2023_3_2.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}看来是僵王篡改了时空，让雪人僵尸再次出现了。

NARRATIVE_BIRTHDAYZ_LTE_2023_3_3.en: {SAY:winnie}I can use this to plot a way back home. However, this will require all my processing powers.
NARRATIVE_BIRTHDAYZ_LTE_2023_3_3.zh: {SAY:winnie}我可以用它来规划我们回家的路线。然而，这将消耗我所有的算力。

NARRATIVE_BIRTHDAYZ_LTE_2023_4_2.en: {NPC_ENTER:sunflower}{SAY:sunflower}Be careful, don’t fall for their trap.

NARRATIVE_BIRTHDAYZ_LTE_2023_5_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie_l}{SAY:winnie_l}It would appear we are back to our original coordinates.

NARRATIVE_BIRTHDAYZ_LTE_2023_5_2.en: {NPC_EXIT:winnie_l}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}Whhaaat! How can this be... How did you…

NARRATIVE_BIRTHDAYZ_LTE_2023_6_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}Curses... I miscalculated this time, but mark my words you haven’t seen the last of me.
NARRATIVE_BIRTHDAYZ_LTE_2023_6_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}坏了……这次我有些失算，但你们要知道，我一定会回来的。

NARRATIVE_BIRTHDAYZ_LTE_2023_6_4.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}There was never any cake, User Dave.

NARRATIVE_BIRTHDAY_LTE_2024_1_2.en: {SAY:winnie}No User Dave. For once, you are right on schedule.
NARRATIVE_BIRTHDAY_LTE_2024_1_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}并没有，用户戴夫。你终于准时一次了。

NARRATIVE_BIRTHDAY_LTE_2024_1_4.en: {NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:peashooter}Those are some ominous looking clouds heading towards us.
NARRATIVE_BIRTHDAY_LTE_2024_1_4.zh: {NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:peashooter}有一团“无彩不祥云”在朝我们袭来。

NARRATIVE_BIRTHDAY_LTE_2024_2_2.en: {SAY:zomboss_r}But my next invention will soak you completely!
NARRATIVE_BIRTHDAY_LTE_2024_2_2.zh: {SAY:zomboss_r}下次，我的发明会把你生吞活剥！

NARRATIVE_BIRTHDAY_LTE_2024_2_3.en: {NPC_EXIT:zomboss_r}{NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:peashooter}We’ll be ready for you Zomboss. All of us plants and with...
NARRATIVE_BIRTHDAY_LTE_2024_2_3.zh: {NPC_EXIT:zomboss_r}{NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:peashooter}我们会从容应对的，僵王。除了我们全体植物大军，还有…

NARRATIVE_BIRTHDAY_LTE_2025_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{NPC_ENTER:sunflower_r}{SAY:sunflower_r}Is everything ready for Dave's surprise birthday party?
NARRATIVE_BIRTHDAY_LTE_2025_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{NPC_ENTER:sunflower_r}{SAY:sunflower_r}戴夫的惊喜生日派对都准备好了吗？

NARRATIVE_BIRTHDAY_LTE_2025_1_2.en: {SAY:peashooter}All that's left are the decorations. I told Wallnut to clean the lawn.
NARRATIVE_BIRTHDAY_LTE_2025_1_2.zh: {SAY:peashooter}只差装饰品了。我刚叫坚果墙去打扫草坪。

NARRATIVE_BIRTHDAY_LTE_2025_1_3.en: {SAY:sunflower_r}Then why is Wallnut playing with the garden hose? Wait Walln...
NARRATIVE_BIRTHDAY_LTE_2025_1_3.zh: {SAY:sunflower_r}那坚果墙怎么在玩水龙头？等等坚…

NARRATIVE_BIRTHDAY_LTE_2025_1_5.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}*电流声* 错误！探-探测到-到-到-水。系-系统故-故-故障。

NARRATIVE_BIRTHDAY_LTE_2025_1_6.en: {NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:peashooter_r}{SAY:peashooter_r}Look what you did. Penny's circuit boards are damaged now.
NARRATIVE_BIRTHDAY_LTE_2025_1_6.zh: {NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:peashooter_r}{SAY:peashooter_r}看你干的好事。现在潘妮的电路板坏掉了。

NARRATIVE_BIRTHDAY_LTE_2025_1_7.en: {SHOUT:peashooter_r}And the lawn! It's all flooded. We need to clean this before the party.
NARRATIVE_BIRTHDAY_LTE_2025_1_7.zh: {SHOUT:peashooter_r}草坪也是！水漫金山。我们得在派对开始前清理好。

NARRATIVE_BIRTHDAY_LTE_2025_2_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:peashooter}发生了什么?! 我们在哪儿，潘妮？

NARRATIVE_BIRTHDAY_LTE_2025_2_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}*电流声* 系-系统故-故-故障。开-开始旅-旅-旅行。

NARRATIVE_BIRTHDAY_LTE_2025_2_3.en: {SAY:peashooter}Uh oh! Penny's taking us to random places due to her malfunction.
NARRATIVE_BIRTHDAY_LTE_2025_2_3.zh: {SAY:peashooter}啊哦！潘妮故障了，在带我们到处乱跑。

NARRATIVE_BIRTHDAY_LTE_2025_3_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:peashooter}Thank you, Mother Nature! We are back home.
NARRATIVE_BIRTHDAY_LTE_2025_3_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:peashooter}感谢你，自然母亲！我们回家了。

NARRATIVE_BIRTHDAY_LTE_2025_3_2.en: {SAY:winnie}All systems are operational. Apologies for the inconvenience caused.
NARRATIVE_BIRTHDAY_LTE_2025_3_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}所有系统工作正常。抱歉对你们造成的不便。

NARRATIVE_BIRTHDAY_LTE_2025_4_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}All threats are neutralized. Begin protocol surprise party.
NARRATIVE_BIRTHDAY_LTE_2025_4_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}所有威胁已解除。开始惊喜派对协议。

NARRATIVE_BIRTHDAY_LTE_2025_4_2.en: {NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:wallnut}{SAY:wallnut}Shh! Dave will hear us. Do you want to ruin the surprise?
NARRATIVE_BIRTHDAY_LTE_2025_4_2.zh: {NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:wallnut}{SAY:wallnut}嘘！戴夫会听到的。你想毁了惊喜吗？

NARRATIVE_BIRTHDAY_LTE_2025_4_3.en: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter_r}{SAY:peashooter_r}You're the one to talk, but we will discuss this later. Dave's coming
NARRATIVE_BIRTHDAY_LTE_2025_4_3.zh: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter_r}{SAY:peashooter_r}大哥别说二哥，待会儿在吵吧。戴夫来了。

NARRATIVE_BIRTHDAY_LTE_2025_4_6.en: {SHOUT:crazydave}Holy moly! You guys scared the tacos out of me.
NARRATIVE_BIRTHDAY_LTE_2025_4_6.zh: {SHOUT:crazydave}天呐！你们把我的玉米卷都吓出来了。

NARRATIVE_BLASTBERRYVINE_EQ_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Vines are special plants that can be planted on top of other plants.
NARRATIVE_BLASTBERRYVINE_EQ_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}藤蔓是一类能种在其他植物之上的特殊存在。

NARRATIVE_BLASTBERRYVINE_EQ_2.en: {SAY:winnie}Plant Blastberry Vines on other plants for an offensive boost!
NARRATIVE_BLASTBERRYVINE_EQ_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}在其他植物上种植爆莓藤蔓以提高其进攻强度！

NARRATIVE_BLOCKOLI_EQ_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Plant Blockoli to smash and stun with blocking shields.
NARRATIVE_BLOCKOLI_EQ_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}种植西拦花，用坚固的花盾击晕僵尸。

NARRATIVE_BOINGSETTA_EQ_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}种植一品轰，摧毁周围的物品，击退并冷缓僵尸。
NARRATIVE_BOINGSETTA_EQ_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}种植一品红，摧毁周围的物品，击退并冷缓僵尸。

NARRATIVE_BOMBARDMINT_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Power Mints are powerful plants you can acquire through Arena mode.
NARRATIVE_BOMBARDMINT_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}超能薄荷是一类强大的植物，你可以通过竞技场模式来获得他们。

NARRATIVE_BOMBARDMINT_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:winnie}They provide a big boost to plants in their family.
NARRATIVE_BOMBARDMINT_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}它们对相应家族的植物有巨大的增益作用。

NARRATIVE_BOMBARDMINT_INTRO_3.en: {SAY:winnie}The Bombard-mint Family is made up of explosive plants.
NARRATIVE_BOMBARDMINT_INTRO_3.zh: {SAY:winnie}轰炸薄荷家族包括爆炸植物。

NARRATIVE_BOOMFLOWER_EQ_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}种植爆炸桔梗，施放可拖动的气球地雷。
NARRATIVE_BOOMFLOWER_EQ_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}种植爆炸桔梗，施放可拖动的气球地雷。

NARRATIVE_BRAMBLEBUSH_EQ_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Plant Bramble Bush to trap and damage zombies.
NARRATIVE_BRAMBLEBUSH_EQ_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}种植莓棘灌木丛，困住僵尸，并对它们造成伤害。

NARRATIVE_BUFFZ01_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Some levels may have Buffz & Bruisez active.
NARRATIVE_BUFFZ01_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}有些关卡会有“增强与弱化机制”这么一说。

NARRATIVE_BUFFZ01_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:winnie}This means zombies can be weak, resistant, or immune to damage from certain plant families.
NARRATIVE_BUFFZ01_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}这意味着该关的僵尸可能对某些植物家族的攻击产生抗性、完全免疫，或是有伤害加成。

NARRATIVE_BUFFZ01_INTRO_3.en: {SAY:winnie}This time, zombies are WEAK to plants in the Fila-mint family.
NARRATIVE_BUFFZ01_INTRO_3.zh: {SAY:winnie}这次，僵尸面对白炽薄荷家族植物的攻击时会更加虚弱。

NARRATIVE_BUFFZ01_INTRO_4.en: {SAY:winnie}Lightning Reeds will do a lot of damage.
NARRATIVE_BUFFZ01_INTRO_4.zh: {SAY:winnie}即便是闪电芦苇，也能造成大量伤害。

NARRATIVE_BUFFZ02_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Buffz & Bruisez can work the other way as well.
NARRATIVE_BUFFZ02_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}增强与弱化机制也可以反过来。

NARRATIVE_BUFFZ02_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:winnie}Zombies can resist damage from certain plant families.
NARRATIVE_BUFFZ02_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}僵尸可以抵抗某些植物家族的伤害。

NARRATIVE_BUFFZ02_INTRO_3.en: {SAY:winnie}This time, zombies RESIST damage from plants in the Fila-mint family.
NARRATIVE_BUFFZ02_INTRO_3.zh: {SAY:winnie}这一次，僵尸对白炽薄荷家族植物的攻击具有抗性。

NARRATIVE_BUFFZ02_INTRO_4.en: {SAY:winnie}Lightning Reeds will do less damage than normal.
NARRATIVE_BUFFZ02_INTRO_4.zh: {SAY:winnie}闪电芦苇只能造成比原先更低的伤害。

NARRATIVE_BUFFZ03_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}At the greatest extreme, Buffz & Bruisez can nullify a plant family completely.
NARRATIVE_BUFFZ03_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}在极端情况下，弱化机制甚至可以让部分植物家族的攻击完全无效。

NARRATIVE_BUFFZ03_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:winnie}This time, zombies are IMMUNE to damage from plants in the Fila-mint family.
NARRATIVE_BUFFZ03_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}这一次，僵尸对白炽薄荷家族植物的攻击完全免疫。

NARRATIVE_BUFFZ03_INTRO_3.en: {SAY:winnie}Lightning Reeds will do no damage. Use them as blockers!
NARRATIVE_BUFFZ03_INTRO_3.zh: {SAY:winnie}闪电芦苇无法造成任何伤害，只能用把他当做沿路的炮灰了！

NARRATIVE_BUTTERCUP_EQ_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}种植黄油毛茛，往攻击她的僵尸脸上砸黄油。

NARRATIVE_BUY_PLANTFOOD_3.en: {SPECIAL4}Here neighbor, have some moola! Why? Because I'm CRAAAZY!
NARRATIVE_BUY_PLANTFOOD_3.zh: {SPECIAL4}来来来，我的邻居！拿好这些元宝！为啥，因为我疯——了！

NARRATIVE_BUY_POWERUPS_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{EXCITED}{LONG}If you want to use a Power Up, you can buy one with coins!
NARRATIVE_BUY_POWERUPS_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{EXCITED}{LONG}如果你想用金手指，可以用金币买一个！

NARRATIVE_BUY_POWERUPS_2.en: {LONG}Just tap on that doohickey down there and you're in business!
NARRATIVE_BUY_POWERUPS_2.zh: {LONG}只需要轻点这个小按钮，交易就完成啦！

NARRATIVE_BWB_LTE_2023_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:peashooter}Surf's up, dudes! Let's shred some zombies!
NARRATIVE_BWB_LTE_2023_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:peashooter}准备冲浪，兄弟们！把僵尸撞得粉身碎骨！

NARRATIVE_BWB_LTE_2023_1_2.en: {NPC_ENTER:sunflower_r}{SAY:sunflower_r}Totally! We'll wipe 'em out like a gnarly wave!

NARRATIVE_BWB_LTE_2023_1_3.en: {NPC_EXIT:sunflower_r}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}You punks don't even know what you're up against. You're all just fish out of water.
NARRATIVE_BWB_LTE_2023_1_3.zh: {NPC_EXIT:sunflower_r}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}你们这些小混混根本不知道自己正在面对什么。你们，不过如离水之鱼般弱小。

NARRATIVE_BWB_LTE_2023_1_4.en: {SAY:peashooter}And you're about as scary as a goldfish in a bowl.
NARRATIVE_BWB_LTE_2023_1_4.zh: {SAY:peashooter}而你，不过如缸中金鱼般可怕。

NARRATIVE_BWB_LTE_2023_1_5.en: {NPC_EXIT:zomboss_r}{NPC_ENTER:sunflower_r}{SAY:sunflower_r}Or maybe a seagull with a insomnia.

NARRATIVE_BWB_LTE_2023_1_6.en: {NPC_EXIT:sunflower_r}{NPC_ENTER:wallnut_r}{SAY:wallnut_r}Or a hermit crab with stage fright.

NARRATIVE_BWB_LTE_2023_1_7.en: {NPC_EXIT:wallnut_r}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}Enough with the inane jokes! Attack, my aquatic fiends!
NARRATIVE_BWB_LTE_2023_1_7.zh: {NPC_EXIT:wallnut_r}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}这都哪儿跟哪儿啊，讲够了吗！进攻，我的水中之友！

NARRATIVE_BWB_LTE_2023_2_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:peashooter}Wallnut, you might wanna get on a Lily Pad. The tide is coming in.
NARRATIVE_BWB_LTE_2023_2_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:peashooter}坚果，你还是到睡莲叶上来吧。潮水马上就来了。

NARRATIVE_BWB_LTE_2023_2_3.en: {SAY:peashooter}Nothing's wrong with the ground.  You will get swept away if the water gets too high.
NARRATIVE_BWB_LTE_2023_2_3.zh: {SAY:peashooter}地上没问题。但是如果潮水涨得太高，你就会被冲走的。

NARRATIVE_BWB_LTE_2023_2_4.en: {SAY:wallnut_r}Hey, I'm not afraid of a little water. I'm a tough nut to crack, you know.
NARRATIVE_BWB_LTE_2023_2_4.zh: {SAY:wallnut_r}切，我才不怕这点儿水呢。我可是坚强的坚果。

NARRATIVE_BWB_LTE_2023_2_5.en: {SAY:peashooter}Wall-nut, just get on a Lily Pad. It'll be like your own private island.
NARRATIVE_BWB_LTE_2023_2_5.zh: {SAY:peashooter}坚果墙，快到睡莲叶上来。上面就像私人岛屿一样。

NARRATIVE_BWB_LTE_2023_3_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:wallnut_r}{SAY:wallnut_r}You know, Peashooter, this isn't half bad. I could get used to this Lily Pad life.
NARRATIVE_BWB_LTE_2023_3_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:wallnut_r}{SAY:wallnut_r}你知道吗，豌豆射手，其实感觉没那么糟。我开始习惯在睡莲叶上的生活了。

NARRATIVE_BWB_LTE_2023_3_2.en: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:peashooter}That's the spirit, dude. Now just sit back, relax, and enjoy the tide.
NARRATIVE_BWB_LTE_2023_3_2.zh: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:peashooter}就是这样，兄弟。你只需要坐下、放松，享受潮涨潮落就好。

NARRATIVE_BWB_LTE_2023_3_3.en: {SAY:wallnut_r}And if any zombies try to mess with us, we'll just toss 'em back to the deep end.
NARRATIVE_BWB_LTE_2023_3_3.zh: {SAY:wallnut_r}然后如果有僵尸来惹我们，我们就把它扔回深渊中去。

NARRATIVE_BWB_LTE_2023_4_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:peashooter}Dude! It's Banana Launcher! This beach party is about to get a whole lot crazier!
NARRATIVE_BWB_LTE_2023_4_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:peashooter}帅啊！是香蕉火箭炮！看来我们的海滩派对要更疯狂了！

NARRATIVE_BWB_LTE_2023_4_2.en: {NPC_ENTER:sunflower_r}{SAY:sunflower_r}Awesome! Make sure he's well-protected so he can shoot those sweet banana missiles.
NARRATIVE_BWB_LTE_2023_4_2.zh: {NPC_ENTER:sunflower_r}{SAY:sunflower_r}好耶！一定要保护好他，这样他才能安心发射那些强力的香蕉导弹。

NARRATIVE_BWB_LTE_2023_4_3.en: {NPC_EXIT:sunflower_r}{NPC_ENTER:wallnut_r}{SAY:wallnut_r}Let's surround him with Lily Pads and I'll keep those Zombies off him.
NARRATIVE_BWB_LTE_2023_4_3.zh: {NPC_EXIT:sunflower_r}{NPC_ENTER:wallnut_r}{SAY:wallnut_r}用睡莲叶围住他吧，我会让僵尸离他远远地。

NARRATIVE_BWB_LTE_2023_4_4.en: {SAY:peashooter}Good idea, Wall-nut! And I can cover him from behind.
NARRATIVE_BWB_LTE_2023_4_4.zh: {SAY:peashooter}好办法，坚果墙！我能在他身后掩护他。

NARRATIVE_BWB_LTE_2023_5_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:wallnut}{SAY:wallnut}This is great! We should have a beach party like this every day!
NARRATIVE_BWB_LTE_2023_5_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:wallnut}{SAY:wallnut}真棒！以后我们真该每天都举办一场这样的海滩派对！

NARRATIVE_BWB_LTE_2023_5_2.en: {NPC_ENTER:sunflower_r}{SAY:sunflower_r}Only if Banana Launcher carries his banana missiles, those things are heavy!
NARRATIVE_BWB_LTE_2023_5_2.zh: {NPC_ENTER:sunflower_r}{SAY:sunflower_r}只是如果香蕉火箭炮要带他的导弹的话，行李就会很重。

NARRATIVE_BWB_LTE_2023_6_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:peashooter}Yo, dude! We totally washed the beach with those zombies!
NARRATIVE_BWB_LTE_2023_6_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:peashooter}牛的，兄弟们！我们把海滩上的僵尸扫荡一空了！

NARRATIVE_BWB_LTE_2023_6_2.en: {NPC_ENTER:sunflower_r}{SAY:sunflower_r}Yeah! We weren't about to let those undead losers.
NARRATIVE_BWB_LTE_2023_6_2.zh: {NPC_ENTER:sunflower_r}{SAY:sunflower_r}好耶！他们这些废渣不死族，本来就是不速之客。

NARRATIVE_BWB_LTE_2023_6_3.en: {NPC_EXIT:sunflower_r}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}My beach resort plans are ruined. I will crush you plants, you just wait.
NARRATIVE_BWB_LTE_2023_6_3.zh: {NPC_EXIT:sunflower_r}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}我的海滩度假计划泡汤了。我早晚会压扁你们这些植物的，你们等着瞧。

NARRATIVE_BWB_LTE_2023_6_4.en: {SAY:peashooter}Oh, please. You and your zombie crew are nothing but beach bums.
NARRATIVE_BWB_LTE_2023_6_4.zh: {SAY:peashooter}那就来啊。你和你的僵尸军队不过是在海滩上游走的废柴罢了。

NARRATIVE_BWB_LTE_2023_6_5.en: {SAY:zomboss_r}Just you wait, I have a whole ocean of tricks up my sleeve.
NARRATIVE_BWB_LTE_2023_6_5.zh: {SAY:zomboss_r}等着吧，我还有海量你前所未见的绝招。

NARRATIVE_BWB_LTE_2023_6_6.en: {NPC_EXIT:zomboss_r}{NPC_ENTER:sunflower_r}{SAY:sunflower_r}Ooh, we're shaking in our roots. Maybe you should just shell out and go home.
NARRATIVE_BWB_LTE_2023_6_6.zh: {NPC_EXIT:zomboss_r}{NPC_ENTER:sunflower_r}{SAY:sunflower_r}哇，真是吓得我们根都在发抖呢。要不您早点打包回家洗洗睡吧。

NARRATIVE_BWB_LTE_2023_6_7.en: {SAY:peashooter}Yeah, before you get sand in your circuits.
NARRATIVE_BWB_LTE_2023_6_7.zh: {SAY:peashooter}没错，不然小心你的电路里进沙子。

NARRATIVE_BWB_LTE_2023_6_8.en: {NPC_EXIT:sunflower_r}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}Mark my words, I'll be back to make you plant punks pay.
NARRATIVE_BWB_LTE_2023_6_8.zh: {NPC_EXIT:sunflower_r}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}记住我说的话，我会卷土重来，让你们这群植物小混混付出代价的。

NARRATIVE_BWB_LTE_2023_6_9.en: {NPC_EXIT:zomboss_r}{SAY:peashooter}Whatever, dude. Don't let the sand hit you on the way out.
NARRATIVE_BWB_LTE_2023_6_9.zh: {NPC_EXIT:zomboss_r}{SAY:peashooter}随你呗，兄弟。走的时候小心鞋里进沙子。

NARRATIVE_BWB_LTE_2024_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}I am ready for the beach. The sun, the sand and the...zombies?
NARRATIVE_BWB_LTE_2024_1_1.zh: {SAY:peashooter}我准备好在沙滩激情四射了。阳光明媚，满地金沙，还有…尸潮如雨？

NARRATIVE_BWB_LTE_2024_1_2.en: {SAY:winnie}Affirmative, User Dave. Beach day initiating. Preparing for travel.
NARRATIVE_BWB_LTE_2024_1_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}确实如此，用户戴夫。海滩之旅，就此启航。

NARRATIVE_BWB_LTE_2024_1_3.en: {NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss}{SAY:zomboss}Don't forget to frown and prepare for a sandy showdown!
NARRATIVE_BWB_LTE_2024_1_3.zh: {NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss}{SAY:zomboss}别忘了要愁眉苦脸，准备一场沙地对决啊！

NARRATIVE_BWB_LTE_2024_1_4.en: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter_r}{SAY:peashooter_r}Oh, come on, Zomboss! Can't we have just one day off?
NARRATIVE_BWB_LTE_2024_1_4.zh: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter_r}{SAY:peashooter_r}哎，别吧，僵王！我们就不能放一天假吗？

NARRATIVE_BWB_LTE_2024_1_5.en: {SAY:zomboss}Absolutely NOT! My zombies will give you a seaweed-infested welcome.
NARRATIVE_BWB_LTE_2024_1_5.zh: {SAY:zomboss}绝对不行！我的僵尸军团会让你们无处可逃、海藻缠身，以此表达我们的热情欢迎。

NARRATIVE_BWB_LTE_2024_1_6.en: {SAY:peashooter_r}Bring it on, we aren't afraid of a little sand in our leaves.
NARRATIVE_BWB_LTE_2024_1_6.zh: {SAY:peashooter_r}那就放马过来吧，“沙场”的尘土，是吓不倒我们的。

NARRATIVE_BWB_LTE_2024_2_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:sunflower}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:sunflower}Well that was an unexpected twist in our beach day plans, huh?
NARRATIVE_BWB_LTE_2024_2_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:sunflower}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:sunflower}还真没想到我们的沙滩假日会闹这一出啊。

NARRATIVE_BWB_LTE_2024_2_2.en: {SAY:winnie}Affirmative Sunflower! The beach is secured, resuming relaxation mode.
NARRATIVE_BWB_LTE_2024_2_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}确实如此向日葵！海滩已安全，恢复放松模式。

NARRATIVE_BWB_LTE_2024_2_3.en: {NPC_EXIT:sunflower}{NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}This isn't over, plants! I'll have my revenge...on some other sunny day.
NARRATIVE_BWB_LTE_2024_2_3.zh: {NPC_EXIT:sunflower}{NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}还没结束呢，你们这群植物！我会卷土重来的……等我再找一个阳光明媚的日子。

NARRATIVE_BWB_LTE_2024_2_4.en: {NPC_ENTER:wallnut}{SAY:wallnut}Maybe next time, Zomboss. Today, the beach is ours!
NARRATIVE_BWB_LTE_2024_2_4.zh: {NPC_ENTER:wallnut}{SAY:wallnut}下次再说吧，僵王。今天，海滩是我们的！

NARRATIVE_BWB_LTE_2025_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:sunflower}{NPC_ENTER:peashooter_r}{SAY:peashooter_r}Alright! The beach day is finally here!
NARRATIVE_BWB_LTE_2025_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:sunflower}{NPC_ENTER:peashooter_r}{SAY:peashooter_r}好诶！终于等到去海滩的时候了！

NARRATIVE_BWB_LTE_2025_1_2.en: {SAY:sunflower}I couldn't agree more. Nothing can ruin this beautiful day.
NARRATIVE_BWB_LTE_2025_1_2.zh: {SAY:sunflower}是这样的。没有什么可以毁掉如此美好的一天。

NARRATIVE_BWB_LTE_2025_1_3.en: {NPC_EXIT:sunflower}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss}{SAY:zomboss}Attention you leafy lifeguards, this beach is Zomboss Territory.
NARRATIVE_BWB_LTE_2025_1_3.zh: {NPC_EXIT:sunflower}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss}{SAY:zomboss}听好了你们这些绿油油的救生员，这片海滩是我僵王的领土。

NARRATIVE_BWB_LTE_2025_1_4.en: {SAY:zomboss}My zombies will turn your paradise into a sand trap.
NARRATIVE_BWB_LTE_2025_1_4.zh: {SAY:zomboss}我的僵尸大军会把你们的乐园变为桎梏沙土。

NARRATIVE_BWB_LTE_2025_1_5.en: {SAY:peashooter_r}Zomboss, the only thing trapped here will be your plans.
NARRATIVE_BWB_LTE_2025_1_5.zh: {SAY:peashooter_r}僵王，被桎梏的，只有你的计划。

NARRATIVE_BWB_LTE_2025_2_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:sunflower}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:sunflower}You might need a whole storm shelter after that, eh, Zomboss?
NARRATIVE_BWB_LTE_2025_2_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:sunflower}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:sunflower}你待会儿估计得找一间防风窖，对吧，僵王？

NARRATIVE_BWB_LTE_2025_2_2.en: {SAY:zomboss_r}Curses! I will be back with a new plan...and a life jacket.
NARRATIVE_BWB_LTE_2025_2_2.zh: {SAY:zomboss_r}呸！我会带着新的计划……还有一间新的救生衣回来的。

NARRATIVE_CHALLENGE_BRANCH_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydaveicon}{SAY}Uh-oh, the road is forked. What do we do?!
NARRATIVE_CHALLENGE_BRANCH_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydaveicon}{SAY}啊噢，前方的道路产生了分叉。我们该怎么办？！

NARRATIVE_CHALLENGE_BRANCH_INTRO_2.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnieicon}{SAY}Those are where you flex your brains with new plants and upgrades.
NARRATIVE_CHALLENGE_BRANCH_INTRO_2.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnieicon}{SAY}那里可以充分发挥你脑子的聪明才智，以此活用新植物与升级道具。

NARRATIVE_CHALLENGE_BRANCH_INTRO_4.en: {TIRED:crazydaveicon}Brain busting? Very dangerous. You go first.

NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_10_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}My sensors indicate some unique zombies nearby, User Dave.
NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_10_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}我的传感器探测到附近似乎有一些独特的僵尸，用户戴夫。

NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_10_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:crazydave}Could it be the zombie that scratches its head on the ground like a monkey?
NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_10_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:crazydave}会是那个像猴子一样在地上挠自己头的僵尸吗？

NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_10_INTRO_3.en: {SAY:winnie}Your answer is incorrect. The Literati Zombie will continuously sketch out zombies at its location.
NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_10_INTRO_3.zh: {SAY:winnie}你的回答是错误的，骚客僵尸会在自身当前的位置源源不断的画出僵尸。

NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_10_INTRO_4.en: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}Can that pen sketch out a taco?

NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_12_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY}Greeting, garden enjoyers, you absolutely cannot imagine the situation you are about to fall into.
NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_12_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY}你好，园林享受者们，汝绝对不会想到汝将要落入怎样境地。

NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_12_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:zombossicon}I have brought the most skilled expert here, who is proficient in the mastery of 108 martial arts techniques.
NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_12_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:zombossicon}吾找来了这里最厉害的高手，其精通108门武林绝学。

NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_12_INTRO_3.en: {SAY:zombossicon}After that, your brain will belong to me. Wish me luck!
NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_12_INTRO_3.zh: {SAY:zombossicon}在那之后汝脑将归属于吾，祝吾好运！

NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_12_INTRO_4.en: {NPC_EXIT:zombossicon}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{PLAYFUL:crazydave}Does that Gargantuar look like it has mastered the 108 martial arts techniques?
NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_12_INTRO_4.zh: {NPC_EXIT:zombossicon}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{PLAYFUL:crazydave}那只巨人僵尸看起来像是有108门武林绝学的样子吗？

NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_12_INTRO_5.en: {SAY:winnie}My sensors only indicate that the hands of the Guardian Gargantuar zombie are very dexterous.
NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_12_INTRO_5.zh: {SAY:winnie}我的扫描器只扫描到那只护卫巨人僵尸的手非常灵巧。

NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_13_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:crazydave}Beep beep beep. Unknown new zombie variant detected.
NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_13_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:crazydave}嘀嘀嘀，已检测到未知新品种僵尸。

NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_13_INTRO_3.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}User Dave, you did not develop a Waffle System. However, the unknown zombie variant is indeed real.
NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_13_INTRO_3.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}用户戴夫，你并没有研发华夫饼系统。但是未知新品种僵尸确实是真的。

NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_13_INTRO_4.en: {SAY:winnie}Beware the Feng Shui Zombie. He possesses the ability to "Shrink the Earth to Inches" and teleport.
NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_13_INTRO_4.zh: {SAY:winnie}请小心风水学家僵尸，他拥有缩地成寸的能力。

NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_13_INTRO_5.en: {SAY:winnie}He can also turn the area around plants into 'Feng Shui Sacred Ground,' which will nullify their attack power.
NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_13_INTRO_5.zh: {SAY:winnie}同时会让植物周围变成一片风水宝地，这将会让植物丧失攻击力。

NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_13_INTRO_6.en: {SAY:crazydave}But I've never heard of any Sacred Ground from the start!?
NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_13_INTRO_6.zh: {SAY:crazydave}可是一开始我从没有听说过什么风水宝地呀！？

NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_13_INTRO_7.en: {SAY:winnie}Perhaps this is what they call "Reality is born from the mind."
NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_13_INTRO_7.zh: {SAY:winnie}这也许就是人们常说的相由心生吧。

NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_13_INTRO_8.en: {SAY:crazydave}Then why hasn't my Waffle System been activated yet?
NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_13_INTRO_8.zh: {SAY:crazydave}那我的华夫饼系统为什么还没有被激活？

NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_14_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}Hey! This gal can make a bunch of zombies totally dizzy!
NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_14_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}嘿！这个家伙能让一群僵尸被她搞得晕头转向！

NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_14_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:crazydave}But it doesn't work on zombies with a good sense of direction.
NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_14_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:crazydave}但对一些方向感很好的僵尸却不奏效。

NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_14_INTRO_3.en: {SAY:winnie}Perhaps she just lacks some plant companions.
NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_14_INTRO_3.zh: {SAY:winnie}也许她只是缺一些植物同伴。

NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_15_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}Yikes, why is it raining? But hey, we can use the sun we saved up from the sunny days!
NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_15_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}呀，天怎么就下起雨了？不过我们可以把在晴朗时收集的阳光拿出来用了！

NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_15_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:winnie}Do not panic, User Dave. Sensors indicate plant seeds are mixed within the rain.
NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_15_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}不要着急，用户戴夫。探测器显示，雨水中似乎混杂着植物种子。

NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_15_INTRO_3.en: {SAY:winnie}Perhaps we can plant without sunlight for the time being.
NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_15_INTRO_3.zh: {SAY:winnie}也许我们暂时不需要阳光也可以种植植物。

NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_15_INTRO_4.en: {SAY:crazydave}I know this one! This is exactly what "Pie in the sky" means!
NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_15_INTRO_4.zh: {SAY:crazydave}我知道这个，这就是“天上会掉馅饼”的意思！

NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_16_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}There's an art exhibition in the garden!

NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_16_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:winnie}According to my observations, that is Dr. Zomboss's evil invention.
NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_16_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}根据我的观察，那是僵王博士的邪恶发明。

NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_16_INTRO_3.en: {SAY:winnie}It obstructs the plants' line of sight, preventing accurate attacks.
NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_16_INTRO_3.zh: {SAY:winnie}它可以阻挡植物的的视线，让植物无法做出准确的攻击。

NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_16_INTRO_4.en: {SAY:winnie}However, do not worry. Gargantuars do not appreciate art; they will make a mess of it.
NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_16_INTRO_4.zh: {SAY:winnie}不过不用担心，巨人僵尸是不会欣赏艺术展的，他会把这一切搞乱。

NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_16_INTRO_5.en: {SAY:crazydave}I get it! So can we use that to block our brains?
NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_16_INTRO_5.zh: {SAY:crazydave}原来如此，那我们是不是可以用那个挡住脑子。

NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_16_INTRO_6.en: {SAY:crazydave}That way the zombies won't see us and they'll give up attacking?
NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_16_INTRO_6.zh: {SAY:crazydave}这样僵尸就看不见我们从而放弃进攻？

NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_16_INTRO_7.en: {SAY:winnie}I do not believe hungry zombies consider visibility as a factor.
NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_16_INTRO_7.zh: {SAY:winnie}我不认为饥饿的僵尸会去思考“看不见”。

NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_18_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Zombie threat level rising, User Dave. It is time to bring him out.
NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_18_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}检测到僵尸的威胁正在增加，用户戴夫。是时候该请出他了。

NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_18_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:winnie}User Dave, I formally introduce the Plummet.
NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_18_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}用户戴夫，我正式向你介绍重垂李子。

NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_18_INTRO_3.en: {SAY:winnie}He possesses immense growth potential and renders zombies more vulnerable to damage.
NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_18_INTRO_3.zh: {SAY:winnie}他拥有非常大的成长性，能让僵尸更加容易受伤。

NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_18_INTRO_4.en: {SAY:winnie}Incidentally, he will not be confused by screens. He will even dismantle them.
NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_18_INTRO_4.zh: {SAY:winnie}顺带一提，他不会被屏风迷惑，甚至会反过来拆掉屏风。

NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_19_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:crazydave}They are like my beard hairs, popping up in every corner.
NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_19_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:crazydave}他们就像我的胡子一样，在每一个角落都能碰到。

NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_19_INTRO_3.en: {SAY:winnie}According to historical records, he can kick a ball that ricochets between plants.
NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_19_INTRO_3.zh: {SAY:winnie}根据史料记载，他可以踢出球在植物们来回间碰撞。

NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_19_INTRO_4.en: {SAY:winnie}Key point: the first plant hit will be displaced by the impact force.
NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_19_INTRO_4.zh: {SAY:winnie}敲重点，碰到球的第一株植物会因为作用力而上下移动。

NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_19_INTRO_5.en: {SAY:crazydave}Maybe Tumbleweed can be friends with that ball. They both like to "roll into things."
NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_19_INTRO_5.zh: {SAY:crazydave}也许风滚草可以和那个球交朋友，他们都喜欢“碰撞”。

NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_1_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:crazydave}Moss, water pools, and bridge planks, Penny, have we returned to Pirate Seas again?
NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_1_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:crazydave}苔藓，水池，还有桥板，潘妮，我们是不是又回到了海盗港湾？

NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_1_INTRO_3.en: {SAY:winnie}User Dave, according to my scan analysis, it appears that we are clearly in a garden.
NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_1_INTRO_3.zh: {SAY:winnie}用户戴夫，根据我的探索记录显示，我们显然身处在一处园林之中。

NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_1_INTRO_4.en: {SAY:winnie}And it seems that some sort of power is influencing this place; plant levels are suppressed here.
NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_1_INTRO_4.zh: {SAY:winnie}并且这里似乎被某种神秘力量影响着，植物等级全都被抑制了。

NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_1_INTRO_5.zh: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}我们能在这里找到独特风味的玉米卷吗？

NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_1_INTRO_6.en: {SAY:winnie}At the moment, we need the help of the Lily Pads more.
NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_1_INTRO_6.zh: {SAY:winnie}目前我们更需要睡莲叶的帮助。

NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_21_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}Wall-nut and Aloe together are like an unbreakable defense line!
NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_21_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}坚果和芦荟在一起就像是不可破的防线一样！

NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_21_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:crazydave}Ever wonder? What if these two plants combined?
NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_21_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:crazydave}有没有想过？如果这两株植物合在一起会发生什么？

NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_21_INTRO_5.en: {SAY:winnie}User Dave, you are simply a genius!

NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_21_INTRO_6.en: {SAY:winnie}Now let me introduce a new ally: Elderbarrier!
NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_21_INTRO_6.zh: {SAY:winnie}现在由我来介绍新盟友，接骨木果！

NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_21_INTRO_7.en: {SAY:winnie}Not only can he withstand zombie attacks, but he also heals surrounding plants simultaneously. He even self-repairs when resting.
NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_21_INTRO_7.zh: {SAY:winnie}他不仅可以扛住僵尸的攻击，还可以同时为周围的植物恢复生命，休息的时候还可以自我恢复。

NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_21_INTRO_8.en: {SAY:winnie}Most importantly, he can completely block the Cuju Star Zombie's ball!
NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_21_INTRO_8.zh: {SAY:winnie}最重要的是，他可以完全抵挡住蹴鞠明星僵尸的球！

NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_21_INTRO_9.en: {SAY:crazydave}Hey, looks like my Crazy Brain hasn't degenerated yet.
NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_21_INTRO_9.zh: {SAY:crazydave}嘿，看起来我的疯狂之脑还没有退化嘛。

NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_23_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}The sky looks like it's turned dark, neighbor.
NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_23_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}天空就像是天黑了一样，邻居。

NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_23_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:crazydave}Maybe the zombies are resting? Throwing a Sweet-Brain Party on the lawn?
NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_23_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:crazydave}也许僵尸会休息？会在草坪上开一场糖脑派对？

NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_23_INTRO_3.en: {SAY:crazydave}Uh... where did the sun I saved up a few days ago go?
NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_23_INTRO_3.zh: {SAY:crazydave}呃呃...我前几天存的阳光放哪去了？

NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_23_INTRO_4.en: {SAY:winnie}Let me provide a hint. User Dave, do you recall your sunbathing session yesterday?
NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_23_INTRO_4.zh: {SAY:winnie}我来提示一下。用户戴夫，你还记得一天前的日光浴吗？

NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_25_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}Without entering the garden... how could one know... such spring splendor exists...
NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_25_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}不到园林 — 怎知 — 春色如 — 许 ~

NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_25_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:zombossicon}How are you enjoying yourselves, destroyers of gardens?
NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_25_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:zombossicon}各位园林的破坏者兴致如何？

NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_25_INTRO_3.en: {SAY:zombossicon}The auspicious hour is here, open the door to brains. Crush the plants, dim the light, till only zombie remains.
NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_25_INTRO_3.zh: {SAY:zombossicon}吉时已到，开门见脑。破植除光，祛明驻僵。

NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_25_INTRO_4.en: {SAY:zombossicon}Gentlemen, lend your ears to my humble composition dedicated to the marrow of these intruders. A final farewell.
NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_25_INTRO_4.zh: {SAY:zombossicon}诸位且听我为这些外来客的脑髓所作的拙作，为他们做最后的践行。

NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_25_INTRO_5.en: {NPC_EXIT:zombossicon}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}That sounds like a truly interesting drama!
NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_25_INTRO_5.zh: {NPC_EXIT:zombossicon}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}听上去是真是一种有趣的戏剧！

NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_25_INTRO_6.en: {SAY:winnie}His dream has turned into a play, User Dave.

NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_25_INTRO_7.en: {SAY:crazydave}This garden's passion wants to gnaw the soul into crumbs!

NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_25_OUTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Sensors indicate a 99.1644% probability that Dr. Zomboss has fallen back to reality.
NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_25_OUTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}探测器显示，僵王博士跌回现实的可能性为99.1644%。

NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_25_OUTRO_10.en: {SAY:crazydave}Then maybe I'll understand what you guys are talking about.
NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_25_OUTRO_10.zh: {SAY:crazydave}那样我就能明白你们在说什么了。

NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_25_OUTRO_11.en: {SAY:winnie}Time itself is the best proof. Let us proceed!
NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_25_OUTRO_11.zh: {SAY:winnie}时间本身就是最好的证明，让我们继续前进吧！

NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_25_OUTRO_2.en: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}Foolish broken machine! You cannot calculate my beautiful dream of wisdom!
NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_25_OUTRO_2.zh: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}愚蠢的破机器根本无法计算我智慧的美梦！

NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_25_OUTRO_3.en: {SAY:zombossicon}Ahem! Feudal ethics devour people, but so what if I die for love!!
NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_25_OUTRO_3.zh: {SAY:zombossicon}咳，礼教吃人，我偏为了爱死了又如何！！

NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_25_OUTRO_4.en: {SAY:zombossicon}A bunch of fools! Imbeciles! Idiots with no appreciation for art!
NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_25_OUTRO_4.zh: {SAY:zombossicon}一群傻瓜！笨蛋！没有艺术细胞的白痴！

NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_25_OUTRO_5.en: {SAY:zombossicon}The living can die, and the dead can live! A living man won't be suffocated by reason!
NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_25_OUTRO_5.zh: {SAY:zombossicon}生可以死，死可以生！活人不会被理憋死！

NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_25_OUTRO_6.en: {SAY:zombossicon}You brainless louts better serve your brains on a plate and wait!
NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_25_OUTRO_6.zh: {SAY:zombossicon}你们这些没脑子的家伙都得给我把脑子放在盘子里等着！

NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_25_OUTRO_8.en: {SAY:winnie}The destruction brought by Dr. Zomboss is essentially born of passion within a dream, User Dave.
NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_25_OUTRO_8.zh: {SAY:winnie}僵王博士所带来的毁灭，本质都是因梦生情，用户戴夫。

NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_25_OUTRO_9.en: {SAY:crazydave}I need a super-sized iced lemonade to wash my hair.
NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_25_OUTRO_9.zh: {SAY:crazydave}我需要一份超大杯冰镇柠檬水来洗头。

NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_2_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}我闻到一股奇怪的香气，潘妮。

NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_2_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:winnie}According to the scent scan analysis, it seems that there is a strong aroma of Jasmine nearby, emanating from the plant.
NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_2_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}根据气味探测器显示，这附近似乎存在一些茉莉奶绿，该植物的香气特别浓郁。

NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_2_INTRO_3.en: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}Jazz Mine? What's that? Uh-uh-uh... Oh! A mine filled with jazz music?
NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_2_INTRO_3.zh: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}那是什么？呃呃呃...哦！一滩在花朵上的牛奶？

NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_2_INTRO_4.en: {SAY:winnie}Jasmine grants nearby zombies a multitude of negative buffs. Zombies killed under its sustained effect will also drop suns.
NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_2_INTRO_4.zh: {SAY:winnie}茉莉奶绿会使周围附近的僵尸中毒并且被赋予减速buff，在持续的效果时间被击杀的僵尸还会掉落阳光。

NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_2_INTRO_5.en: {EXCITED:crazydave}Fantastic! I must gather more of these flowers to indulge in a leisurely sunbath.
NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_2_INTRO_5.zh: {EXCITED:crazydave}太棒了，我一定要多采点这些花来享受一场慢时间的阳光浴。

NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_4_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:crazydave}Penny, is it raining? Why's there a zombie holding an umbrella? Has she gone mad?
NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_4_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:crazydave}潘妮，现在难道在下雨？为什么会有个僵尸拿着伞？难道是她疯了？

NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_4_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:winnie}Please note, User Dave, that umbrella seems to have significant elasticity and can deflect lobbed projectiles.
NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_4_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}请注意，用户戴夫，那把伞似乎有很大的弹性，会把投射类子弹给弹开。

NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_4_INTRO_3.en: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}Hey! Does the pot on my head count as an umbrella?
NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_4_INTRO_3.zh: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}嘿！我头上的锅盖算不算雨伞？

NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_7_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}There is a plant soaking in the water, and another one basking in the sun on the land.
NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_7_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}那远处有一株植物在水上泡着，还有一株在陆地上晒着太阳。

NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_7_INTRO_3.en: {SAY:winnie}Her projectiles can penetrate zombies, and attacks zombies across three lanes when planted on water.
NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_7_INTRO_3.zh: {SAY:winnie}她的子弹会穿透僵尸，在水中，会攻击三行的僵尸。

NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_7_INTRO_4.en: {EXCITED:crazydave}That's three times the projectiles; we need more water!!
NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_7_INTRO_4.zh: {EXCITED:crazydave}那就是三倍的子弹，我们需要种更多的栀子，更多的水！！

NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_OUTRO_DANGER_ROO.en: {SAY:crazydave}It tastes a little hard to chew.
{SAY:crazydave}Maybe I can use it as a height-boosting insole for Wall-nut.
NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_OUTRO_DANGER_ROO.zh: {SAY:crazydave}或许可以用来当坚果的增高垫使用。

NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_OUTRO_DANGER_ROO.en: {SAY:winnie}This appears to be a mechanism trigger.
{SAY:winnie}Perhaps it can be used to unlock something.
NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_OUTRO_DANGER_ROO.zh: {SAY:winnie}也许它可以用来开启某些东西。

NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_ZOMBIENOTE_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydaveicon}{EXCITED:crazydaveicon}Well lookie-here, Penny! It says something but I don't know traditional Chinese!
NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_ZOMBIENOTE_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydaveicon}{EXCITED:crazydaveicon}这上面好像写着什么，潘妮。可是我不认识繁体字！

NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_ZOMBIENOTE_2.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnieicon}{SAY:winnieicon}My analysis suggests that this is a novel that tells the metaphorical tale of "harvesting and releasing the brain."
NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_ZOMBIENOTE_2.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnieicon}{SAY:winnieicon}根据数据，这是一本讲述“收放脑之喻”的小说。

NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_ZOMBIENOTE_3.en: {SAY:crazydaveicon}The zombies yearn to use this novel to glimpse the position of the holy undead.
NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_ZOMBIENOTE_3.zh: {SAY:winnieicon}僵尸渴望借助这本小说来窥探圣尸的位子。

NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_ZOMBIENOTE_4.en: {SAY:crazydaveicon}Perhaps I aspire to achieve the position of the Taco Deity.
NARRATIVE_CHINESEGARDEN_ZOMBIENOTE_4.zh: {SAY:crazydaveicon}也许我想成就玉米卷之神的位子。

NARRATIVE_CIRCUSACT2_LTE_2022_1_2.en: {SAY:peashooter_r}Yep. Sorry I missed the last couple of limited-time events.
NARRATIVE_CIRCUSACT2_LTE_2022_1_2.zh: {SAY:peashooter_r}嗯嗯。对不起啦，之前的几个限时活动我都没来。

NARRATIVE_CIRCUSACT2_LTE_2022_1_3.en: {SHOUT:peashooter_r}I was getting a haircut and it took FOREVER.
NARRATIVE_CIRCUSACT2_LTE_2022_1_3.zh: {SHOUT:peashooter_r}我去剪了个头发，结果半天都弄不好。

NARRATIVE_CIRCUSACT2_LTE_2022_2_2.en: {SAY:peashooter}Nobody told me about these circus zombies!
NARRATIVE_CIRCUSACT2_LTE_2022_2_2.zh: {SAY:peashooter}怎么有这么多马戏团僵尸啊！

NARRATIVE_CIRCUSACT2_LTE_2022_3_2.en: {SAY:sunflower_r}GASP! Mr. Zomboss! I never thought I'd face you face-to-face!
NARRATIVE_CIRCUSACT2_LTE_2022_3_2.zh: {SAY:sunflower_r}*倒吸一口凉气* 僵王先生！我没想过居然会和你面对面谈话！

NARRATIVE_CIRCUSACT2_LTE_2022_3_3.en: {SAY:zomboss}Bah! I care not for your thoughts! Only evil plans!
NARRATIVE_CIRCUSACT2_LTE_2022_3_3.zh: {SAY:zomboss}呸！我才不在乎你怎么想！我只关心我的邪恶计划！

NARRATIVE_CIRCUSACT2_LTE_2022_3_4.zh: {SAY:sunflower_r}兄弟，是你先来找我说话的啊！

NARRATIVE_CIRCUSACT2_LTE_2022_4_3.en: {SAY:sunflower}Mr. Zomboss told me he's got evil plans!
NARRATIVE_CIRCUSACT2_LTE_2022_4_3.zh: {SAY:sunflower}僵王先生告诉我他有“邪恶计划”！

NARRATIVE_CIRCUSACT2_LTE_2022_5_3.en: {SHOUT:wallnut}Is your evil plan to hit us with circus zombies again?
NARRATIVE_CIRCUSACT2_LTE_2022_5_3.zh: {SHOUT:wallnut}你的“邪恶计划”是想再用马戏团僵尸袭击我们一次吗？

NARRATIVE_CIRCUSACT2_LTE_2022_6_2.en: {SAY:crazydave}Carnival zombies left and right! Mostly right!
NARRATIVE_CIRCUSACT2_LTE_2022_6_2.zh: {SAY:crazydave}简直可以说是“左右为尸”了！当然，大部分都在右边！

NARRATIVE_CIRCUSACT2_LTE_2022_7_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:zomboss}You may have won this round, Machine!
NARRATIVE_CIRCUSACT2_LTE_2022_7_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:zomboss}破机器，也许你这次的确获胜了！

NARRATIVE_CIRCUSACT2_LTE_2022_7_3.en: {SAY:zomboss}Bah! Those data can be interpreted many ways!
NARRATIVE_CIRCUSACT2_LTE_2022_7_3.zh: {SAY:zomboss}呸！这些数据的理解方式多着呢！

NARRATIVE_CIRCUSACT2_LTE_2022_7_6.en: {SAY:peashooter_r}What new craziness will Dr. Zomboss cook up?
NARRATIVE_CIRCUSACT2_LTE_2022_7_6.zh: {SAY:peashooter_r}僵王博士接下来又会耍什么新把戏呢？

NARRATIVE_CIRCUSACT2_LTE_2022_7_7.zh: {SAY:peashooter_r}欲知后事如何，请听下回分解！

NARRATIVE_CIRCUSACT3_LTE_2023_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss}{SAY:zomboss}Ha ha ha! I'm here to take over this circus, and there's nothing you plants can do to stop me!
NARRATIVE_CIRCUSACT3_LTE_2023_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss}{SAY:zomboss}哈哈哈！这个游乐园就由我来接管了，你们这些植物休想阻止我！

NARRATIVE_CIRCUSACT3_LTE_2023_1_2.en: {NPC_EXIT:zomboss}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:crazydave}Oh no! We can't let you do that! Where will we get up to our shenanigans then?!
NARRATIVE_CIRCUSACT3_LTE_2023_1_2.zh: {NPC_EXIT:zomboss}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:crazydave}不行！我们才不会让你得逞！不然我们要到哪儿去狂欢呢？！

NARRATIVE_CIRCUSACT3_LTE_2023_1_3.en: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter_r}{SAY:peashooter_r}We'll never let you take over, Zomboss!

NARRATIVE_CIRCUSACT3_LTE_2023_1_4.en: {NPC_EXIT:peashooter_r}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Alert! The Big Top will block sun falling from the Sky.
NARRATIVE_CIRCUSACT3_LTE_2023_1_4.zh: {NPC_EXIT:peashooter_r}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}警告！游乐园的大帐篷会挡住从天上降落的阳光。

NARRATIVE_CIRCUSACT3_LTE_2023_1_5.en: {NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss}{SAY:zomboss}You're no match for my zombie army! The Big Top tent will be mine!
NARRATIVE_CIRCUSACT3_LTE_2023_1_5.zh: {NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss}{SAY:zomboss}你们根本不是我僵尸大军的对手！大帐篷游乐园我赢定了！

NARRATIVE_CIRCUSACT3_LTE_2023_1_6.en: {NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:sunflower_r}{SAY:sunflower_r}You'll have to get past us first! We won't let you take over without a fight!
NARRATIVE_CIRCUSACT3_LTE_2023_1_6.zh: {NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:sunflower_r}{SAY:sunflower_r}那得先过了我们这关！不打赢我们，休想得逞！

NARRATIVE_CIRCUSACT3_LTE_2023_1_7.en: {SAY:zomboss}Very well, plants. Let's see who is the better mastermind!
NARRATIVE_CIRCUSACT3_LTE_2023_1_7.zh: {SAY:zomboss}好啊，你们这群植物。来看看谁更会出谋划策吧！

NARRATIVE_CIRCUSACT3_LTE_2023_2_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:wallnut}{SAY:wallnut}Looks like Coconut Cannon crew have joined our Defense of the Big Top!
NARRATIVE_CIRCUSACT3_LTE_2023_2_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:wallnut}{SAY:wallnut}看来椰子加农炮小队加入到我们的帐篷守卫战了！

NARRATIVE_CIRCUSACT3_LTE_2023_2_3.en: {NPC_EXIT:peashooter_r}{NPC_ENTER:sunflower_r}{SAY:sunflower_r}I'm not sure if Coconuts are going to be effective against the zombies.
NARRATIVE_CIRCUSACT3_LTE_2023_2_3.zh: {NPC_EXIT:peashooter_r}{NPC_ENTER:sunflower_r}{SAY:sunflower_r}我不是很确定椰子对那些僵尸有没有用。

NARRATIVE_CIRCUSACT3_LTE_2023_2_6.en: {SAY:wallnut}they can take down the zombies from any angle using those carts!
NARRATIVE_CIRCUSACT3_LTE_2023_2_6.zh: {SAY:wallnut}他们还能利用那些矿车，从各个角度击溃僵尸！

NARRATIVE_CIRCUSACT3_LTE_2023_2_9.en: {SAY:peashooter}Lets blast these zombies back into their clown car!
NARRATIVE_CIRCUSACT3_LTE_2023_2_9.zh: {SAY:peashooter}把这些僵尸轰回它们自己的小丑车里去吧！

NARRATIVE_CIRCUSACT3_LTE_2023_3_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss}{SAY:zomboss}看仔细了，这是我的高跷僵尸！

NARRATIVE_CIRCUSACT3_LTE_2023_3_5.en: {SAY:iceburg_r}Don't worry, Wallnut! We'll help you out!

NARRATIVE_CIRCUSACT3_LTE_2023_3_6.en: {SAY:wallnut}I feel so inadequate compared to those tall zombies.
NARRATIVE_CIRCUSACT3_LTE_2023_3_6.zh: {SAY:wallnut}和那些高大的僵尸比起来，我太弱小了。

NARRATIVE_CIRCUSACT3_LTE_2023_3_7.en: {SAY:iceburg_r}Don't be silly, Wallnut! You may be shorter than them, but you're just as tough!
NARRATIVE_CIRCUSACT3_LTE_2023_3_7.zh: {SAY:iceburg_r}别傻了，坚果墙！你可能确实比他它们矮，但你和它们一样坚强！

NARRATIVE_CIRCUSACT3_LTE_2023_4_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss}{SAY:zomboss}Step right up and witness, back by popular demand, the Catastro-liope!
NARRATIVE_CIRCUSACT3_LTE_2023_4_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss}{SAY:zomboss}都上前来看清楚了，我的悲乐风琴机器人，在众望所归之下强势回归！

NARRATIVE_CIRCUSACT3_LTE_2023_4_3.en: {SAY:zomboss}Tremble you fool! Its only purpose in life is to ROOT out plants and take over this circus!
NARRATIVE_CIRCUSACT3_LTE_2023_4_3.zh: {SAY:zomboss}颤抖吧，傻瓜！它唯一的目的，就是把那些植物连根拔起，然后统治这个游乐园！

NARRATIVE_CIRCUSACT3_LTE_2023_4_4.en: {NPC_EXIT:crazydave_r}{NPC_ENTER:peashooter_r}{SAY:peashooter_r}Oh no! That sounds like it could be trouble!

NARRATIVE_CIRCUSACT3_LTE_2023_4_5.en: {SAY:zomboss}Ha ha ha! You'll never be able to defeat the Catastro-liope! It's indestructible!
NARRATIVE_CIRCUSACT3_LTE_2023_4_5.zh: {SAY:zomboss}哈哈哈！你们根本不可能打败我这坚不可摧的悲乐风琴机器人！

NARRATIVE_CIRCUSACT3_LTE_2023_5_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss}{SAY:zomboss}Grrr... How could you defeat my Catastro-liope? It was supposed to be unbeatable!
NARRATIVE_CIRCUSACT3_LTE_2023_5_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss}{SAY:zomboss}恶……你们是怎么打败我的悲乐风琴机器人的？它明明是无敌的啊！

NARRATIVE_CIRCUSACT3_LTE_2023_5_2.en: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter_r}{SAY:peashooter_r}Ha! We took it down with ease, thanks to our trusty Friends, the Coconut Cannons.
NARRATIVE_CIRCUSACT3_LTE_2023_5_2.zh: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter_r}{SAY:peashooter_r}哈！多亏了我们那群值得信赖的朋友，椰子加农炮小队。轻松拿下！

NARRATIVE_CIRCUSACT3_LTE_2023_5_3.en: {NPC_EXIT:peashooter_r}{NPC_ENTER:sunflower_r}{SAY:sunflower_r}And don't forget, we had a little help from Wallnut and his tough shell.
NARRATIVE_CIRCUSACT3_LTE_2023_5_3.zh: {NPC_EXIT:peashooter_r}{NPC_ENTER:sunflower_r}{SAY:sunflower_r}别忘了，坚果墙坚硬的壳也给了我们一些帮助。

NARRATIVE_CIRCUSACT3_LTE_2023_5_4.en: {NPC_EXIT:sunflower_r}{NPC_ENTER:wallnut_r}{SAY:wallnut_r}That's right. We may be plants, but we're no pushovers.
NARRATIVE_CIRCUSACT3_LTE_2023_5_4.zh: {NPC_EXIT:sunflower_r}{NPC_ENTER:wallnut_r}{SAY:wallnut_r}没错。我们或许不过是植物，但我们绝不软弱。

NARRATIVE_CIRCUSACT3_LTE_2023_5_5.en: {SAY:zomboss}You may have won this battle, but the war is far from over. The Big Top will be mine!
NARRATIVE_CIRCUSACT3_LTE_2023_5_5.zh: {SAY:zomboss}这场战斗你也许能够侥幸获胜，但这场战争还远未结束。大帐篷游乐园早晚会落入我的掌心！

NARRATIVE_CIRCUSACT3_LTE_2023_5_6.en: {NPC_EXIT:wallnut_r}{NPC_ENTER:sunflower_r}{SAY:sunflower_r}Bring it on, Zomboss. We're always ready for you.
NARRATIVE_CIRCUSACT3_LTE_2023_5_6.zh: {NPC_EXIT:wallnut_r}{NPC_ENTER:sunflower_r}{SAY:sunflower_r}放马过来吧，僵王。我们随时奉陪。

NARRATIVE_CIRCUSACT3_LTE_2023_OLD1.en: {NPC_EXIT:sunflower}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:crazydave}Wait a minute! I have a better idea! Let's put on a show for the zombies!
NARRATIVE_CIRCUSACT3_LTE_2023_OLD1.zh: {NPC_EXIT:sunflower}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:crazydave}等等！我有个好主意！我们来给僵尸表演个节目吧！

NARRATIVE_CIRCUSACT3_LTE_2023_OLD10.en: {SAY:wallnut}Really? Thanks, team! I feel better now.
NARRATIVE_CIRCUSACT3_LTE_2023_OLD10.zh: {SAY:wallnut}真的吗？谢谢大家！我感觉好受些了。

NARRATIVE_CIRCUSACT3_LTE_2023_OLD11.en: {SAY:crazydave}Indestructible, you say? I have just the thing! *rolls out a Coconut Cannon
NARRATIVE_CIRCUSACT3_LTE_2023_OLD11.zh: {SAY:crazydave}坚不可摧是吧？我有东西来对付它！*推出来一架椰子加农炮

NARRATIVE_CIRCUSACT3_LTE_2023_OLD13.en: {SAY:crazydave}These are my friends, the Coconut Cannons! And they are going to destroy your Cart of Doom once and for all!
NARRATIVE_CIRCUSACT3_LTE_2023_OLD13.zh: {SAY:crazydave}他们是我的朋友，椰子加农炮小队！他们会把你的毁灭之车摧毁得片甲不留！

NARRATIVE_CIRCUSACT3_LTE_2023_OLD14.en: {SAY:zomboss}Its not a Cart of Doom! Show some respect to your eventual demise, the Catastro-liope!
NARRATIVE_CIRCUSACT3_LTE_2023_OLD14.zh: {SAY:zomboss}这才不是什么毁灭之车！给你死神——悲乐风琴机器人一点尊重好吧！

NARRATIVE_CIRCUSACT3_LTE_2023_OLD3.en: {SAY:crazydave}A performance that will be so entertaining, your zombies won't even want to take over the Big Top tent anymore!
NARRATIVE_CIRCUSACT3_LTE_2023_OLD3.zh: {SAY:crazydave}很有意思的节目，看完之后，你的僵尸都不会再想去抢占大帐篷游乐园了！

NARRATIVE_CIRCUSACT3_LTE_2023_OLD4.en: {SAY:zomboss}That's the most ridiculous thing I've ever heard!

NARRATIVE_CIRCUSACT3_LTE_2023_OLD5.zh: {SAY:peashooter_r}是吗？来看看吧！*开始表演杂技

NARRATIVE_CIRCUSACT3_LTE_2023_OLD8.en: {SAY:crazydave}*starts riding a unicycle and juggling at the same time

NARRATIVE_CIRCUSACT3_LTE_2023_OLD9.en: {NPC_EXIT:iceburg_r}{NPC_ENTER:peashooter_r}{SAY:peashooter_r}Yeah, we couldn't do it without you! You're a valuable member of the team!
NARRATIVE_CIRCUSACT3_LTE_2023_OLD9.zh: {NPC_EXIT:iceburg_r}{NPC_ENTER:peashooter_r}{SAY:peashooter_r}对呀，没有你，我们根本做不到！你是我们队伍中很重要的一员！

NARRATIVE_CIRCUSACT3_LTE_2023__OLD4.en: {SAY:zomboss}That's the most ridiculous thing I've ever heard!

NARRATIVE_CIRCUSACT4_LTE_2024_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss}{SAY:zomboss}Roll up, roll up, puny mortals, to my undead extravaganza!
NARRATIVE_CIRCUSACT4_LTE_2024_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss}{SAY:zomboss}凡人们，瞧一瞧，看一看，欣赏我的不死军团大展览！

NARRATIVE_CIRCUSACT4_LTE_2024_1_2.en: {SAY:zomboss}Behold, my monstrous performers shall steal the show, literally. Muhuhahaha!
NARRATIVE_CIRCUSACT4_LTE_2024_1_2.zh: {SAY:zomboss}看清楚吧，我的怪奇艺人定会抢尽风头——真正地“抢”。木呼哈哈哈！

NARRATIVE_CIRCUSACT4_LTE_2024_1_3.en: {NPC_EXIT:zomboss}{NPC_ENTER:wallnut}{SAY:wallnut}Oh no! Our show is being hijacked. My performance was next.
NARRATIVE_CIRCUSACT4_LTE_2024_1_3.zh: {NPC_EXIT:zomboss}{NPC_ENTER:wallnut}{SAY:wallnut}不好！我们的风头要被“抢”了。下个是我来表演呢。

NARRATIVE_CIRCUSACT4_LTE_2024_1_4.en: {NPC_ENTER:sunflower_r}{SAY:sunflower_r}Who knew Zomboss had such a flair for dramatics?
NARRATIVE_CIRCUSACT4_LTE_2024_1_4.zh: {NPC_ENTER:sunflower_r}{SAY:sunflower_r}谁知道僵王原来这么有戏剧天赋。

NARRATIVE_CIRCUSACT4_LTE_2024_1_5.en: {SAY:sunflower_r}But I guess we have to show Zomboss how its actually done.
NARRATIVE_CIRCUSACT4_LTE_2024_1_5.zh: {SAY:sunflower_r}但我想，我们必须让僵王见识见识什么才是真正的表演。

NARRATIVE_CIRCUSACT4_LTE_2024_1_6.en: {NPC_EXIT:wallnut}{NPC_EXIT:sunflower_r}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss}{SAY:zomboss}Without sun there is no stopping me today! Minions!
NARRATIVE_CIRCUSACT4_LTE_2024_1_6.zh: {NPC_EXIT:wallnut}{NPC_EXIT:sunflower_r}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss}{SAY:zomboss}没了阳光，今天没有什么能阻止我了！小的们！

NARRATIVE_CIRCUSACT4_LTE_2024_2_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:peashooter}Looks like we managed to outshine the zombie act.
NARRATIVE_CIRCUSACT4_LTE_2024_2_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:peashooter}看来我们的表演比起僵尸还是技高一筹啊。

NARRATIVE_CIRCUSACT4_LTE_2024_2_2.en: {NPC_EXIT:peashooter}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}Blast it all! You may have stopped my act.
NARRATIVE_CIRCUSACT4_LTE_2024_2_2.zh: {NPC_EXIT:peashooter}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}真该死！你们也许能够阻止我的表演。

NARRATIVE_CIRCUSACT4_LTE_2024_2_3.en: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}But this isn't the end and my evil plans will go on!
NARRATIVE_CIRCUSACT4_LTE_2024_2_3.zh: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}但却阻止不了我的邪恶计划！这次，可不是结束！

NARRATIVE_CIRCUSACT4_LTE_2024_2_5.zh: {SHOUT:wallnut}…啊哦…转得停不下来了…不不不…救命啊！

NARRATIVE_CIRCUS_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}It's a coverup! We're intense in tents, Penny!
NARRATIVE_CIRCUS_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}后院被罩起来了！潘妮！我们被游乐园的帐篷罩住了！

NARRATIVE_CIRCUS_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:winnie}Indeed. It appears the Backyard Big Top has come to town.
NARRATIVE_CIRCUS_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}是的。看起来后院游乐园到我们镇上来了。

NARRATIVE_CIRCUS_INTRO_4.en: {SAY:winnie}The big top will block sun falling from the sky.
NARRATIVE_CIRCUS_INTRO_4.zh: {SAY:winnie}游乐园的大帐篷会阻挡天空中掉下来的阳光。

NARRATIVE_CIRCUS_RAILCART_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Plants on mine carts can be moved.
NARRATIVE_CIRCUS_RAILCART_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}你可以移动在矿车上的植物。

NARRATIVE_CONCEALMINT_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Power Mints are powerful plants you can acquire through Arena mode.
NARRATIVE_CONCEALMINT_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}超能薄荷是一类强大的植物，你可以通过竞技场模式来获得他们。

NARRATIVE_CONCEALMINT_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:winnie}They provide a big boost to plants in their family.
NARRATIVE_CONCEALMINT_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}它们对相应家族的植物有巨大的增益作用。

NARRATIVE_CONCEALMINT_INTRO_3.en: {SAY:winnie}The Conceal-mint family includes all the shadow plants.
NARRATIVE_CONCEALMINT_INTRO_3.zh: {SAY:winnie}隐藏薄荷家族包括暗影植物。

NARRATIVE_CONTAINMINT_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Power Mints are powerful plants you can acquire through Arena mode.
NARRATIVE_CONTAINMINT_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}超能薄荷是一类强大的植物，你可以通过竞技场模式来获得他们。

NARRATIVE_CONTAINMINT_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:winnie}They provide a big boost to plants in their family.
NARRATIVE_CONTAINMINT_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}它们对相应家族的植物有巨大的增益作用。

NARRATIVE_CONTAINMINT_INTRO_3.en: {SAY:winnie}The Contain-mint Family includes stalling and slowing plants.
NARRATIVE_CONTAINMINT_INTRO_3.zh: {SAY:winnie}限制薄荷家族包括减速类植物。

NARRATIVE_COWBOY_26_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}I say, Penny, old thing, tally ho! Pip-pip and such!
NARRATIVE_COWBOY_26_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}我说，潘妮老伙计，快看哪，我终于找到了好些呆板稀奇的英国佬！

NARRATIVE_COWBOY_26_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:winnie} We are in the Wild West, User Dave. Not Victorian England.
NARRATIVE_COWBOY_26_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:winnie} 我们现在身处狂野西部，用户戴夫。这里并不是维多利亚时代的英格兰。

NARRATIVE_COWBOY_26_INTRO_4.en: {SAY:winnie}We are likely to encounter far more ferocious former frontiersmen, User Dave.
NARRATIVE_COWBOY_26_INTRO_4.zh: {SAY:winnie}我们预计将与更多更凶悍的美国西部拓荒者交战，用户戴夫。

NARRATIVE_COWBOY_26_INTRO_5.en: {SAY:winnie}We will need upgraded plants to stake any claim.
NARRATIVE_COWBOY_26_INTRO_5.zh: {SAY:winnie}我们将需要升级植物来捍卫我们对这片土地上的主权。

NARRATIVE_COWBOY_31_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:winnie}The rough terrain forbids the mowing of lawns.
NARRATIVE_COWBOY_31_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}崎岖不平的地势阻碍了对于草坪的修剪。

NARRATIVE_COWBOY_31_INTRO_3.en: {SAY:winnie}Our battles shall be more fraught from here on.
NARRATIVE_COWBOY_31_INTRO_3.zh: {SAY:winnie}我们后续的战役将更加令人忧心。

NARRATIVE_COWBOY_35_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}Even as the West was wild, so is my fury even wilder!
NARRATIVE_COWBOY_35_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}就像狂野西部的荒蛮一样，连我此刻的愤怒也更为狂野了！

NARRATIVE_COWBOY_35_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:zombossicon}Face me! Face me and the rebuilt and improved Zombot War Wagon!
NARRATIVE_COWBOY_35_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:zombossicon}面对我吧！面对我和那重制升级版的牛车狂战者僵尸机器人！

NARRATIVE_COWBOY_35_OUTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}It was a stagecoach, it was a robot... it was Complete Cowboy CRAAAAY-ziness!
NARRATIVE_COWBOY_35_OUTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}那是架马车，又是个机器…这…简直完完全全是牛仔发疯！

NARRATIVE_COWBOY_35_OUTRO_2.en: {SAY:winnie}Our upgraded plants proved up to the task, User Dave.
NARRATIVE_COWBOY_35_OUTRO_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}我们的升级版植物已经圆满完成任务，用户戴夫。

NARRATIVE_COWBOY_35_OUTRO_3.en: {NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}All my efforts... useless! I begin to seriously question my capacity to succeed!
NARRATIVE_COWBOY_35_OUTRO_3.zh: {NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}我所有的心血，所有的努力…都白费了！我开始严重怀疑我夺得胜利的才能了！

NARRATIVE_COWBOY_CHALLENGE_LASTSTAND_A_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY}It's high noon, and waves of zombies about.

NARRATIVE_COWBOY_CHALLENGE_LASTSTAND_A_2.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{EXCITED:crazydave}Time to show them who's got the fastest plants in time!
NARRATIVE_COWBOY_CHALLENGE_LASTSTAND_A_2.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{EXCITED:crazydave}看看是它们的嘴快，还是植物的子弹快！

NARRATIVE_COWBOY_CHALLENGE_LASTSTAND_B_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY}I could really go for a tub of fried chicken right now.

NARRATIVE_COWBOY_CHALLENGE_LASTSTAND_B_2.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{PLAYFUL:winnie}Well, they've let loose the birds of war, so you're in luck.
NARRATIVE_COWBOY_CHALLENGE_LASTSTAND_B_2.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{PLAYFUL:winnie}可以呀。僵尸正好放跑了几只战鸟，把它们现炸了就好。

NARRATIVE_COWBOY_CHALLENGE_LASTSTAND_C_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{PLAYFUL}{START_DIALOG_MUSIC}干得漂亮，用户时空旅行者长官。

NARRATIVE_COWBOY_CHALLENGE_MINIGAME_A_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY}Put on your bloomers and charge your reeds.
NARRATIVE_COWBOY_CHALLENGE_MINIGAME_A_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY}给你的芦苇充好电！对了，也别忘了穿上你的牛仔裤！

NARRATIVE_COWBOY_CHALLENGE_MINIGAME_B_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED}That is a lot of mine carts.

NARRATIVE_COWBOY_CHALLENGE_MINIGAME_B_3.en: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}I didn't know mine carts could do math!
NARRATIVE_COWBOY_CHALLENGE_MINIGAME_B_3.zh: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}我居然不知道矿车会做算数题！

NARRATIVE_COWBOY_CHALLENGE_MINIGAME_C_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY}{START_DIALOG_MUSIC}My great grandpappy was a lawman around these parts.
NARRATIVE_COWBOY_CHALLENGE_MINIGAME_C_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY}{START_DIALOG_MUSIC}我的曾祖父以前就在这附近当治安官。

NARRATIVE_COWBOY_CHALLENGE_PRESET_B_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SPECIAL17}They're coming 'round the mountain for your brains!
NARRATIVE_COWBOY_CHALLENGE_PRESET_B_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SPECIAL17}他们要绕过大山来找你的脑子！

NARRATIVE_COWBOY_CHALLENGE_PRESET_C_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY}{START_DIALOG_MUSIC}I can't believe there were so many chickens.
NARRATIVE_COWBOY_CHALLENGE_PRESET_C_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY}{START_DIALOG_MUSIC}我不敢相信这儿居然有那么多鸡！

NARRATIVE_COWBOY_CHALLENGE_PRESET_C_3.en: {SAY:winnie}This will be remembered as the Great Chickening of 1850.
NARRATIVE_COWBOY_CHALLENGE_PRESET_C_3.zh: {SAY:winnie}这会被后世人称为“1850 大鸡群事件”。

NARRATIVE_COWBOY_CHALLENGE_PROTECTPLANTS.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY}These levels can be tough nuts to crack.
NARRATIVE_COWBOY_CHALLENGE_PROTECTPLANTS.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY}你需要在这些关卡里保护好坚果。

NARRATIVE_COWBOY_CHALLENGE_PROTECTPLANTS.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{PLAYFUL:crazydave}And I want to see the delicious creamy center.
NARRATIVE_COWBOY_CHALLENGE_PROTECTPLANTS.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{PLAYFUL:crazydave}我想瞧瞧美味的坚果奶油夹心。

NARRATIVE_COWBOY_CHALLENGE_PROTECTPLANTS.en: {TIRED:winnie}The point is not to crack them.
NARRATIVE_COWBOY_CHALLENGE_PROTECTPLANTS.zh: {TIRED:winnie}这关的重点不在于如何敲碎它们。

NARRATIVE_COWBOY_CHALLENGE_PROTECTPLANTS.en: {SAY:crazydave}It sounds like a stampede of pianos!
NARRATIVE_COWBOY_CHALLENGE_PROTECTPLANTS.zh: {SAY:crazydave}听起来像是一批蜂拥而至的牛仔钢琴家！

NARRATIVE_COWBOY_CHALLENGE_PROTECTPLANTS.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:crazydave}You've got the fastest fingers in the West.

NARRATIVE_COWBOY_INTRO_FIRSTLEVEL_2.zh:
{SAY}怀旧钢琴小曲：
下载完毕

NARRATIVE_COWBOY_INTRO_GARGANTUAR_2.en: {SAY:zombossicon}Agents are arriving to mark your brains as my property.
NARRATIVE_COWBOY_INTRO_GARGANTUAR_2.zh: {SAY:zombossicon}我的特工马上就会来把你的脑子划为我的财产了。

NARRATIVE_COWBOY_INTRO_GARGANTUAR_3.zh: {SAY:zombossicon}此致 敬礼 埃德加·僵王博士。

NARRATIVE_COWBOY_INTRO_GARGANTUAR_4.en: {NPC_EXIT:zombossicon}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}I don't want my brains all marked up.
NARRATIVE_COWBOY_INTRO_GARGANTUAR_4.zh: {NPC_EXIT:zombossicon}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}我才不想我的脑子上写着别人的名字！

NARRATIVE_COWBOY_INTRO_GARGANTUAR_5.zh: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}不然我得花很久很久才把它们洗得干干净净了！

NARRATIVE_COWBOY_INTRO_LEVEL7_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY}Like cow tipping, zombie tipping is best done from the side.
NARRATIVE_COWBOY_INTRO_LEVEL7_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY}就像“推牛倒”游戏一样，对付僵尸最好是从两面夹击！

NARRATIVE_COWBOY_INTRO_LEVEL7_2.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{PLAYFUL:crazydave}Trust me, do not try and tip a cow from behind!
NARRATIVE_COWBOY_INTRO_LEVEL7_2.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{PLAYFUL:crazydave}相信我，千万不要从牛后面推倒它们！

NARRATIVE_COWBOY_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}Have you considered that you are sharing in Crazy David's madness?
NARRATIVE_COWBOY_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}你有没有想过其实你自己已经变得和疯狂戴夫一样疯了？

NARRATIVE_COWBOY_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_2.en: {SAY:zombossicon}There is no zombie outbreak threatening you.

NARRATIVE_COWBOY_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_3.en: {SAY:zombossicon}You are not using plants to defend your home.
NARRATIVE_COWBOY_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_3.zh: {SAY:zombossicon}你使用植物也并不是为了守卫你的家园。

NARRATIVE_COWBOY_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_4.en: {SAY:zombossicon}The zombies and I are normal people, simply trying to help you.
NARRATIVE_COWBOY_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_4.zh: {SAY:zombossicon}而我与那些所谓的僵尸实际上都是一些普通人，仅仅是想帮助你。

NARRATIVE_COWBOY_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_5.en: {NPC_EXIT:zombossicon}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:crazydave}I bet you'll tell us there are no spoons, too!
NARRATIVE_COWBOY_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_5.zh: {NPC_EXIT:zombossicon}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:crazydave}你是不是还要像《黑客帝国》里一样告诉我“其实根本没有勺子”？

NARRATIVE_COWBOY_NEW_OUTRO_LASTTLEVEL_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}{START_DIALOG_MUSIC}User Dave, it's time to saddle up and leave.
NARRATIVE_COWBOY_NEW_OUTRO_LASTTLEVEL_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}{START_DIALOG_MUSIC}用户戴夫，是时候给马备鞍并准备离开了。

NARRATIVE_COWBOY_NEW_OUTRO_LASTTLEVEL_2.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SPECIAL14}夕阳近在咫尺，让我们策马前行吧！

NARRATIVE_COWBOY_NEW_OUTRO_LASTTLEVEL_3.en: {EXCITED:winnie}Where do you think the future will take us?
NARRATIVE_COWBOY_NEW_OUTRO_LASTTLEVEL_3.zh: {EXCITED:winnie}你觉得未来会将我们带向何方？

NARRATIVE_COWBOY_NEW_OUTRO_LASTTLEVEL_5.en: {SAY:crazydave}We should take another look at my Time-Space Taco Map.
NARRATIVE_COWBOY_NEW_OUTRO_LASTTLEVEL_5.zh: {SAY:crazydave}我们应该再看看我的时空玉米卷地图。

NARRATIVE_COWBOY_OUTRO_DANGER_ROOM_KEY_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}My Uncle Milo used to have one these, he called it a boom box.
NARRATIVE_COWBOY_OUTRO_DANGER_ROOM_KEY_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}我的叔叔米洛曾经有一个这样的玩意，他管这叫砰砰盒。

NARRATIVE_COWBOY_OUTRO_DANGER_ROOM_KEY_2.en: {SAY:winnie}Actually, that's close enough. I'll allow it.
NARRATIVE_COWBOY_OUTRO_DANGER_ROOM_KEY_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}事实上，这么称呼它已经够贴切了。至少我认可这样。

NARRATIVE_COWBOY_OUTRO_GARGANTUAR_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}Maybe we can use that to unlock our minds.
NARRATIVE_COWBOY_OUTRO_GARGANTUAR_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}也许我们能用它来解放我们的思想。

NARRATIVE_COWBOY_OUTRO_GARGANTUAR_2.en: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}I still have some cleaning to do.
NARRATIVE_COWBOY_OUTRO_GARGANTUAR_2.zh: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}不过我还有一些清洁工作要做。

NARRATIVE_COWBOY_OUTRO_GARGANTUAR_3.en: {SAY:winnie}It would be better used gaining access to a World.
NARRATIVE_COWBOY_OUTRO_GARGANTUAR_3.zh: {SAY:winnie}我觉得用它去进入另一个世界会更好。

NARRATIVE_COWBOY_OUTRO_GARGANTUAR_4.en: {TIRED:winnie}You know, for the greater good of...

NARRATIVE_COWBOY_OUTRO_LASTTLEVEL_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}{START_DIALOG_MUSIC}User Dave, it's time to saddle up and leave.
NARRATIVE_COWBOY_OUTRO_LASTTLEVEL_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}{START_DIALOG_MUSIC}用户戴夫，是时候给马备鞍并准备离开了。

NARRATIVE_COWBOY_OUTRO_LASTTLEVEL_2.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SPECIAL14}夕阳近在咫尺，让我们策马前行吧！

NARRATIVE_COWBOY_OUTRO_LASTTLEVEL_3.en: {EXCITED:winnie}Where do you think the future will take us?
NARRATIVE_COWBOY_OUTRO_LASTTLEVEL_3.zh: {EXCITED:winnie}你觉得未来会将我们带向何方？

NARRATIVE_COWBOY_OUTRO_LASTTLEVEL_6.en: {SAY:crazydave}{SPECIAL15}Just remember. Tomorrow is always a taco...
NARRATIVE_COWBOY_OUTRO_LASTTLEVEL_6.zh: {SAY:crazydave}{SPECIAL15}谨记，不久的将来仍会有玉米卷…

NARRATIVE_COWBOY_OUTRO_LASTTLEVEL_7.en: {SPECIAL16:crazydave}And a taco is what we find inside of all of us.
NARRATIVE_COWBOY_OUTRO_LASTTLEVEL_7.zh: {SPECIAL16:crazydave}同时玉米卷是我们所有人内心所想之物。

NARRATIVE_COWBOY_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{EXCITED:crazydave}That's right! These plants versus you and your zombies.
NARRATIVE_COWBOY_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{EXCITED:crazydave}这就对了！植物永远与你们僵尸势不两立！

NARRATIVE_COWBOY_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_2.en: {SAY:crazydave}And we didn't even use any spoons...
NARRATIVE_COWBOY_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_2.zh: {SAY:crazydave}而我甚至没有动用引线炸弹…

NARRATIVE_COWBOY_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_3.zh: {SAY:crazydave}哪怕我们手上真的有这些玩意！

NARRATIVE_COWBOY_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_4.en: {NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}I admit you are correct in this regard.
NARRATIVE_COWBOY_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_4.zh: {NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}我不得不承认…在这点上你们是正确的。

NARRATIVE_COWBOY_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_5.en: {SAY:zombossicon}We have no existential conflict over the nature of spoons.
NARRATIVE_COWBOY_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_5.zh: {SAY:zombossicon}然而在武力对抗方面，我们之间不存在辩驳的余地。

NARRATIVE_COWBOY_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydaveicon}{START_DIALOG_MUSIC}That looks like it could be all futurey.
NARRATIVE_COWBOY_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydaveicon}{START_DIALOG_MUSIC}看样子我们要向未来看齐了！

NARRATIVE_COWBOY_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_INTRO_10.zh: {SAY:zombossicon}谨启 埃德加 · 僵王博士。

NARRATIVE_COWBOY_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_INTRO_12.en: {EXCITED:crazydaveicon}That Mr. Boss guy seems like a really nice fellow!
NARRATIVE_COWBOY_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_INTRO_12.zh: {EXCITED:crazydaveicon}那位博士先生看起来真是位大善人啊！

NARRATIVE_COWBOY_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_INTRO_13.en: {TIRED:winnieicon}We should be wary of that one User Dave.
NARRATIVE_COWBOY_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_INTRO_13.zh: {TIRED:winnieicon}我们必须担心未来，用户戴夫。

NARRATIVE_COWBOY_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_INTRO_15.en: {EXCITED:winnieicon}Earning Stars will prepare you for Star Gates we find later!
NARRATIVE_COWBOY_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_INTRO_15.zh: {EXCITED:winnieicon}收集星星，为开启找到的下一扇星星大门做准备！

NARRATIVE_COWBOY_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_INTRO_16.en: {SAY:winnieicon}Also, Endless Zones will keep you sharp for future trials.
NARRATIVE_COWBOY_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_INTRO_16.zh: {SAY:winnieicon}同时，无尽模式能让你为将来的试炼养精蓄锐。

NARRATIVE_COWBOY_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_INTRO_17.en: {SAY:crazydaveicon}{SPECIAL15}Just remember. Tomorrow is always a taco...
NARRATIVE_COWBOY_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_INTRO_17.zh: {SAY:crazydaveicon}{SPECIAL15}谨记，不久的将来仍会有玉米卷…

NARRATIVE_COWBOY_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_INTRO_18.en: {SPECIAL16:crazydave}And a taco is what we find inside of all of us.
NARRATIVE_COWBOY_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_INTRO_18.zh: {SPECIAL16:crazydave}同时玉米卷是我们所有人内心所想之物。

NARRATIVE_COWBOY_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_INTRO_2.en: {PLAYFUL:crazydaveicon}I bet Future Dave has solved our taco paradox.
NARRATIVE_COWBOY_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_INTRO_2.zh: {PLAYFUL:crazydaveicon}我敢说将来的我肯定解决了“玉米卷悖论”。

NARRATIVE_COWBOY_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_INTRO_3.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnieicon}I'm detecting a rush of tachyon particles.
NARRATIVE_COWBOY_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_INTRO_3.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnieicon}我探测到了一股超光速粒子。

NARRATIVE_COWBOY_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_INTRO_4.en: {EXCITED:winnieicon}Maybe Future Penny is trying to make contact.
NARRATIVE_COWBOY_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_INTRO_4.zh: {EXCITED:winnieicon}也许是未来的潘妮正尝试与我们取得联系。

NARRATIVE_COWBOY_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_INTRO_6.en: {SAY:zombossicon}The Future will be requesting your presence.

NARRATIVE_COWBOY_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_INTRO_8.en: {SAY:zombossicon}Upon entry, legal possession of your brains...
NARRATIVE_COWBOY_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_INTRO_8.zh: {SAY:zombossicon}一旦踏足未来，你们脑子的合法所有权…

NARRATIVE_COWBOY_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_INTRO_9.en: {SAY:zombossicon}Will be transferred to one Dr. Edgar Zomboss.
NARRATIVE_COWBOY_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_INTRO_9.zh: {SAY:zombossicon}将归于名为埃德加的僵王博士名下。

NARRATIVE_COWBOY_WORLDMAP_INTRO_4.en: {PLAYFUL}Let's get these plants to the watering hole.
NARRATIVE_COWBOY_WORLDMAP_INTRO_4.zh: {PLAYFUL}让我们把这些植物带去酒吧。

NARRATIVE_COWBOY_ZOMBIENOTE_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnieicon}It appears brains are outlawed around here.
NARRATIVE_COWBOY_ZOMBIENOTE_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnieicon}看起来持有脑子在此地是非法的。

NARRATIVE_COWBOY_ZOMBIENOTE_3.zh: {PLAYFUL:winnieicon}我们会跟随您的安排，用户戴夫。

NARRATIVE_DANGER_ROOM_FAILURE_3.zh: {SAY}好消息是：你又得到了额外的两个！

NARRATIVE_DANGER_ROOM_INTROWRAPUP_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{PLAYFUL}Nice pick, let's see how far you can get!
NARRATIVE_DANGER_ROOM_INTROWRAPUP_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{PLAYFUL}明智之选！让我们看看你能在这个模式中走多远！

NARRATIVE_DANGER_ROOM_INTRO_BEACH_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{EXCITED:crazydave}Hi neighbor! Welcome to The Tiki Torch-er!
NARRATIVE_DANGER_ROOM_INTRO_BEACH_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{EXCITED:crazydave}嗨，邻居！欢迎来到提基文明传承者！

NARRATIVE_DANGER_ROOM_INTRO_BEACH_2.en: {SAY:crazydave}But beware! Zombies are selling seashells by this seashore!
NARRATIVE_DANGER_ROOM_INTRO_BEACH_2.zh: {SAY:crazydave}但是你可要小心！僵尸正在海岸卖贝壳呢！

NARRATIVE_DANGER_ROOM_INTRO_BEACH_3.en: {SHOUT:crazydave}And they insist you pay in brains!
NARRATIVE_DANGER_ROOM_INTRO_BEACH_3.zh: {SHOUT:crazydave}他们还坚持要用你的脑子来付账！

NARRATIVE_DANGER_ROOM_INTRO_CHINESEGARDE.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{EXCITED:crazydave}Oh-ho-ho! Have I arrived in my own inner world?
NARRATIVE_DANGER_ROOM_INTRO_CHINESEGARDE.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{EXCITED:crazydave}哦嚯嚯，我这是来到自己的内心世界了吗？
