NARRATIVE_DANGER_ROOM_INTRO_CHINESEGARDE.en: {SAY:crazydave}Oh-ho-ho! Have I arrived in my own inner world?
NARRATIVE_DANGER_ROOM_INTRO_CHINESEGARDE.zh: {SAY:crazydave}哦嚯嚯，我这是来到自己的内心世界了吗？

NARRATIVE_DANGER_ROOM_INTRO_CHINESEGARDE.en: {SAY:crazydave}Let's beat the stuffing out of zombies and seek the treasure within the heart!
NARRATIVE_DANGER_ROOM_INTRO_CHINESEGARDE.zh: {SAY:crazydave}将僵尸打的落花流水并向心寻求宝藏吧！

NARRATIVE_DANGER_ROOM_INTRO_COWBOY_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY}Hi neighbor! Welcome to the Big Bad Butte!

NARRATIVE_DANGER_ROOM_INTRO_COWBOY_2.en: {SAY}And by big I mean crawling with zombies...
NARRATIVE_DANGER_ROOM_INTRO_COWBOY_2.zh: {SAY}我说的“大”是指这里僵尸横行…

NARRATIVE_DANGER_ROOM_INTRO_DARK_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY}嗨，邻居！欢迎来到亚瑟王的挑战！

NARRATIVE_DANGER_ROOM_INTRO_DARK_2.en: {PLAYFUL}Here you'll find that day is night and knights are zombies!
NARRATIVE_DANGER_ROOM_INTRO_DARK_2.zh: {PLAYFUL}这里你将会见到日夜颠倒，骑士为尸的奇观异景！

NARRATIVE_DANGER_ROOM_INTRO_DINO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{EXCITED:crazydave}Howdy, neighbor! Welcome to La Brainsa Tarpits!
NARRATIVE_DANGER_ROOM_INTRO_DINO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{EXCITED:crazydave}你好啊，邻居！欢迎来到脑子焦油坑！

NARRATIVE_DANGER_ROOM_INTRO_DINO_2.en: {PLAYFUL}I hope you're ready for a reptilian rumble!
NARRATIVE_DANGER_ROOM_INTRO_DINO_2.zh: {PLAYFUL}我希望你准备好迎接一场恐龙大战了！

NARRATIVE_DANGER_ROOM_INTRO_EGYPT_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY}Hi neighbor! Welcome to the Pyramid of Doom!
NARRATIVE_DANGER_ROOM_INTRO_EGYPT_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY}嗨，邻居！欢迎来到厄运金字塔 ！

NARRATIVE_DANGER_ROOM_INTRO_EGYPT_2.en: {SAY}It's just like a regular pyramid, but... you know... doomier.
NARRATIVE_DANGER_ROOM_INTRO_EGYPT_2.zh: {SAY}它看上去真像个再普通不过的金字塔，但…你懂的…它充斥着更多厄运。

NARRATIVE_DANGER_ROOM_INTRO_EIGHTIES_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{EXCITED:crazydave}Howdy, neighbor! Welcome to the GREATEST HITS!
NARRATIVE_DANGER_ROOM_INTRO_EIGHTIES_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{EXCITED:crazydave}你好啊，邻居！欢迎来到最潮专辑！

NARRATIVE_DANGER_ROOM_INTRO_EIGHTIES_2.en: {PLAYFUL}I hope you're ready for a righteously up-tempo experience!
NARRATIVE_DANGER_ROOM_INTRO_EIGHTIES_2.zh: {PLAYFUL}我希望你已经准备好迎接真正快节奏的战斗体验了！

NARRATIVE_DANGER_ROOM_INTRO_FUTURE_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY}Hi neighbor! Welcome to the Terror from Tomorrow!
NARRATIVE_DANGER_ROOM_INTRO_FUTURE_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY}嗨，邻居！欢迎来到明日的恐惧！

NARRATIVE_DANGER_ROOM_INTRO_FUTURE_2.en: {PLAYFUL}Making tomorrow's terror something terrible for today!
NARRATIVE_DANGER_ROOM_INTRO_FUTURE_2.zh: {PLAYFUL}让明日的恐惧在今日就降临吧！

NARRATIVE_DANGER_ROOM_INTRO_ICEAGE_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY}Hi neighbor! Welcome to the Icebound Battleground!

NARRATIVE_DANGER_ROOM_INTRO_ICEAGE_2.en: {SAY:crazydave}This place is cold as, uh, ICE ... not to mention chock full o' zombies.
NARRATIVE_DANGER_ROOM_INTRO_ICEAGE_2.zh: {SAY:crazydave}这个鬼地方…像“寒极”一样冰冷，更别提还有源源不断的僵尸让你不寒而栗了。

NARRATIVE_DANGER_ROOM_INTRO_ICEAGE_3.en: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}Best bring some hot zombie-fightin' moves. And maybe a nice warm coat too.
NARRATIVE_DANGER_ROOM_INTRO_ICEAGE_3.zh: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}最好带些对僵尸“热”情的植物，或许再带一件保暖的外套。

NARRATIVE_DANGER_ROOM_INTRO_LOSTCITY_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY}Hi neighbor! Welcome to the Temple of Bloom!

NARRATIVE_DANGER_ROOM_INTRO_LOSTCITY_2.en: {PLAYFUL}Here you'll find that gold is good but brings out more zombies!
NARRATIVE_DANGER_ROOM_INTRO_LOSTCITY_2.zh: {PLAYFUL}你可以在这儿找到值钱的黄金…同时也会引来更多的僵尸。

NARRATIVE_DANGER_ROOM_INTRO_MODERN_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{EXCITED:crazydave}Howdy, neighbor! Welcome to Highway to the Danger Room!
NARRATIVE_DANGER_ROOM_INTRO_MODERN_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{EXCITED:crazydave}你好啊，邻居！欢迎来到通往无尽的高速！

NARRATIVE_DANGER_ROOM_INTRO_PIRATE_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY}Hi neighbor! Welcome to Dead Man's Booty!
NARRATIVE_DANGER_ROOM_INTRO_PIRATE_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY}嗨，邻居！欢迎来到逝者的宝藏！

NARRATIVE_DANGER_ROOM_INTRO_RAINBOWMARKE.en: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}The Unnamed World is a world filled with chaos, so there are still endless zombies here!
NARRATIVE_DANGER_ROOM_INTRO_RAINBOWMARKE.zh: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}未被命名的世界是充满混沌的世界，所以这里依然有源源不断的僵尸！

NARRATIVE_DANGER_ROOM_LAWNMOWER_SUCCESS_.en: {SAY}Your Plant Food carries over to the next level!
NARRATIVE_DANGER_ROOM_LAWNMOWER_SUCCESS_.zh: {SAY}你的叶绿素能保存到下一关！

NARRATIVE_DANGER_ROOM_LAWNMOWER_SUCCESS_.en: {PLAYFUL}Now it's time to pick another plant!

NARRATIVE_DANGER_ROOM_POWER_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY}The Endless Zones are harder than usual!
NARRATIVE_DANGER_ROOM_POWER_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY}无尽地带会比一般的关卡更加困难！

NARRATIVE_DANGER_ROOM_POWER_2.en: {SAY:winnie}Power Ups and Plant Food can only be purchased once per level.
NARRATIVE_DANGER_ROOM_POWER_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}金手指和叶绿素每关只能各购买一次。

NARRATIVE_DANGER_ROOM_SUCCESS_3.en: {SAY}In the Endless Zones, your lawn mowers carry over to the next level!
NARRATIVE_DANGER_ROOM_SUCCESS_3.zh: {SAY}在无尽地带，你的割草机会保存到下一关！

NARRATIVE_DANGER_ROOM_SUCCESS_5.en: {SAY}Your Plant Food carries over to the next level as well!

NARRATIVE_DANGER_ROOM_SUCCESS_7.en: {PLAYFUL}Now it's time to pick another plant!

NARRATIVE_DANGER_ROOM_TUTORIAL_3.en: {SAY}Now you get to pick one more.

NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_EVILPOTIONS_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:winnie}Warning! I've detected carafes containing chemical compounds of a malevolent makeup!
NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_EVILPOTIONS_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:winnie}警报！我检测到盛在玻璃瓶里的邪恶化合物！

NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_EVILPOTIONS_2.en: {TIRED:crazydave}Can you translate that into Crazy Dave Talk for me?
NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_EVILPOTIONS_2.zh: {TIRED:crazydave}你能将这翻译成“疯言戴语”后讲给我听么？

NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_EVILPOTIONS_3.en: {TIRED:winnie}There are evil potions on the lawn!

NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_EVILPOTIONS_4.en: {EXCITED:crazydave}Evil medieval potions! They're the most dangerous kind...
NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_EVILPOTIONS_4.zh: {EXCITED:crazydave}中世纪的邪恶魔药！那可是最危险的品种啊…

NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_EVILPOTIONS_5.en: {EXCITED:crazydave}On account of having twice the evil!
NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_EVILPOTIONS_5.zh: {EXCITED:crazydave}那是因为它们蕴含着双倍的罪恶！

NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_FIRSTLEVEL_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:crazydave}太让人惊讶了！是谁把这处旮旯搞得这么暗？

NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_FIRSTLEVEL_2.en: {TIRED:winnie}No one, User Dave. We have simply arrived in the Dark Ages.
NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_FIRSTLEVEL_2.zh: {TIRED:winnie}然而并没有谁刻意这样做，用户戴夫。我们只不过是抵达了黑暗时代。

NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_FIRSTLEVEL_3.zh: {SAY:crazydave}茫茫黑夜听起来就令我无比沮丧。

NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_FIRSTLEVEL_4.en: {PLAYFUL:winnie}Indeed. According to my research, a plague has swept this era.
NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_FIRSTLEVEL_4.zh: {PLAYFUL:winnie}确实如此。根据调查，一场瘟疫正好席卷了这个时代。

NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_FIRSTLEVEL_5.en: {SAY:winnie}Also, sun no longer falls from the sky.

NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_FIRSTLEVEL_6.en: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}What we need is someone to brighten this place up!
NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_FIRSTLEVEL_6.zh: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}看来我们需要有人把这个地方点亮。

NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_FIRSTLEVEL_8.en: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}These guys not only know how to turn a frown upside down...
NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_FIRSTLEVEL_8.zh: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}这些家伙不仅知道如何扭转坏的局面。

NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_FIRSTLEVEL_9.en: {EXCITED:crazydave}They make more sun as they grow! Great guys, very talented.
NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_FIRSTLEVEL_9.zh: {EXCITED:crazydave}它们还会在逐渐长大的同时生产出更多阳光！好家伙，它们天赋异禀。

NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_FUMESHROOM_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{TIRED:crazydave}I'm afraid the Dark Ages are giving me a bad case of the vapours.
NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_FUMESHROOM_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{TIRED:crazydave}黑暗时代这烟雾有毒吧，可给我整吐了。

NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_FUMESHROOM_2.en: {SAY:winnie}User Dave, the vapours are no longer considered a real ailment.
NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_FUMESHROOM_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}用户戴夫，我并没有检测到烟雾里存在任何有毒物质。

NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_FUMESHROOM_3.en: {SAY:winnie}But I believe Fume-shroom will be of use here.
NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_FUMESHROOM_3.zh: {SAY:winnie}不过，我倒是觉得大喷菇可以在这里大显身手。

NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_FUMESHROOM_4.en: {EXCITED:winnie}His vapors are quite real and provide a distinct advantage against the right zombie opponents.
NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_FUMESHROOM_4.zh: {EXCITED:winnie}他喷射出的烟雾对我们相当有利。并且，用他来对付某些特殊的僵尸更是有着绝佳的优势。

NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_FUMESHROOM_5.en: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}Fume-tastic! Let's give the zombies a case of the vapours instead!
NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_FUMESHROOM_5.zh: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}烟雾吼哇！用他的烟雾把僵尸整吐吧！

NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_GARGANTUAR_2.en: {SAY:zombossicon}It is my fervent medical opinion that your humours are out of balance!
NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_GARGANTUAR_2.zh: {SAY:zombossicon}以余之拙见，病在汝脑髓，已入膏肓！

NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_GARGANTUAR_3.en: {SAY:zombossicon}Methinks the siphoning of thine brains is the only way to correct this ailment!
NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_GARGANTUAR_3.zh: {SAY:zombossicon}以虹吸之法亟治，乃为疗养汝脑小恙之上道！

NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_GARGANTUAR_4.zh: {SAY:zombossicon}不死何俟？埃德加 · 僵王博士

NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_GARGANTUAR_5.en: {NPC_EXIT:zombossicon}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{PLAYFUL:crazydave}Hey! I prefer my humors and my brains unbalanced!
NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_GARGANTUAR_5.zh: {NPC_EXIT:zombossicon}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{PLAYFUL:crazydave}我真是太嗨了！我愈加喜欢我那种病态幽默与脑髓搅成一锅粥的感觉嘞！

NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_HYPNOSHROOM_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:winnie}Data suggests the Dark Ages were a time of intellectual decline and moral  confusion.
NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_HYPNOSHROOM_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:winnie}数据显示，黑暗时代是一个充斥着伦理乱象与低智之风的时期。

NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_HYPNOSHROOM_2.en: {PLAYFUL:winnie}Perhaps now is a good time to call upon the persuasive powers of the Hypno-shroom?
NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_HYPNOSHROOM_2.zh: {PLAYFUL:winnie}也许现在就是使用魅惑菇强大说服力的绝佳时机？

NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_HYPNOSHROOM_3.en: {EXCITED:crazydave}Good idea, Penny! We'll convert the wicked – Dark Ages style!
NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_HYPNOSHROOM_3.zh: {EXCITED:crazydave}好主意！潘妮！我们将会使恶人皈依，扭转黑暗时代的坏风气！

NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_HYPNOSHROOM_4.en: {SAY:crazydave}Deploy this shroom and the zombies won't know what bit them...
NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_HYPNOSHROOM_4.zh: {SAY:crazydave}只要把这个蘑菇种下去，僵尸就等着被自己的同类撕咬吧……

NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_HYPNOSHROOM_5.en: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}Until they see that it was their fellow zombies! Then, mind BLOWN!
NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_HYPNOSHROOM_5.zh: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}直到它们目睹在面前的是昔日的同伴！然后，脑袋在百思不得其解时被啃得开花！

NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_MAGNETSHROOM_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}According to my data, iron and other metals were routinely put to use during the Dark Ages.
NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_MAGNETSHROOM_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}数据显示，铁和其他金属在黑暗时代常常被使用。

NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_MAGNETSHROOM_2.en: {EXCITED:winnie}Thus, Magnet-shroom should make an excellent ally here.
NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_MAGNETSHROOM_2.zh: {EXCITED:winnie}因此，磁力菇将在这里大显身手。

NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_MAGNETSHROOM_3.en: {EXCITED:crazydave}He can pull buckets, helmets and other metal objects off of zombies!
NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_MAGNETSHROOM_3.zh: {EXCITED:crazydave}他可以把铁桶、头盔，以及其他金属物品从僵尸身上弄下来！

NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_MAGNETSHROOM_4.en: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}Some people think it's magic. But really, it's just physics.
NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_MAGNETSHROOM_4.zh: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}有些人觉得这是一种魔法。实际上，这不过是一种物理现象。

NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_PEANUT_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}Boy, Pea-shooter and Wall-nut sure are good at what they do.
NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_PEANUT_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}小伙子，豌豆射手和坚果墙都在自己的岗位上恪尽职守。

NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_PEANUT_2.en: {EXCITED:crazydave}Talk about two great plants that fight great together!
NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_PEANUT_2.zh: {EXCITED:crazydave}两株快乐的植物在一起战斗，又该给我带来更多的欢乐！

NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_PEANUT_3.en: {EXCITED:winnie}User Dave! Perhaps you are not as cerebrally unsound as you periodically insist!
NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_PEANUT_3.zh: {EXCITED:winnie}用户戴夫！也许你并不是总精神失常，你偶尔会有正确意见！

NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_PEANUT_4.en: {PLAYFUL:winnie}What if there was one plant that behaved like both a Pea-shooter AND a Wall-nut?
NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_PEANUT_4.zh: {PLAYFUL:winnie}一株融合了豌豆和坚果特性的植物会是什么样子呢？

NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_PEANUT_6.en: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}Two plant powers in one legume's body?
NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_PEANUT_6.zh: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}两株植物的力量结合于一株豆类植物的身体？

NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_PEANUT_7.en: {EXCITED:crazydave}Keep talkin' like that and people are going to call you Crazy Penny!
NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_PEANUT_7.zh: {EXCITED:crazydave}再这么说下去大家会叫你疯狂潘妮的！

NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_PEANUT_8.en: {SAY:crazydave}Which would be weird for both of us.

NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY}A question for you, my Ignoble Foes!

NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_2.en: {SAY:zombossicon}Hast thou noted how violent thine plants become upon consuming Plant Food?
NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_2.zh: {SAY:zombossicon}草木因青灰而嗜虐，然汝等未尝意之。

NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_3.en: {SAY:zombossicon}Perchance, hast thou wondered what Plant Food is truly made of?

NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_4.en: {SAY:zombossicon}Verily, I shall tell thee. It's zombies! Plant Food is made out of zombies!

NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_5.en: {NPC_EXIT:zombossicon}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}Unpossible! We feed our plants only the highest quality organic uhm...
NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_5.zh: {NPC_EXIT:zombossicon}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}不可能！我们给植物的只有高品质的有机…呃…

NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_6.en: {TIRED:crazydave}Hey Penny, what is Plant Food made of?

NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_7.en: {SAY:winnie}I fear the true nature of Plant Food requires further analysis, User Dave.
NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_7.zh: {SAY:winnie}恐怕我需要对叶绿素的成分做进一步分析，用户戴夫。

NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_8.en: {TIRED:winnie}Excuse me while I run some tests.
NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_8.zh: {TIRED:winnie}我需要对它们做一些检测，在此期间请勿打扰我。

NARRATIVE_DARK_OUTRO_DANGER_ROOM_KEY_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}Why would anyone go and stick a nice sword into a dirty ol' rock?
NARRATIVE_DARK_OUTRO_DANGER_ROOM_KEY_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}为何有人将这把圣剑插在这块肮脏的石头上？

NARRATIVE_DARK_OUTRO_DANGER_ROOM_KEY_2.en: {TIRED:winnie}I understand it to be a test, User Dave.
NARRATIVE_DARK_OUTRO_DANGER_ROOM_KEY_2.zh: {TIRED:winnie}我认为这是一项挑战，用户戴夫。

NARRATIVE_DARK_OUTRO_DANGER_ROOM_KEY_3.en: {EXCITED:winnie}Only someone with great physical strength and strength of character may remove it.
NARRATIVE_DARK_OUTRO_DANGER_ROOM_KEY_3.zh: {EXCITED:winnie}唯独体格强壮，力大无穷的勇士方有可能拔剑出石。

NARRATIVE_DARK_OUTRO_DANGER_ROOM_KEY_4.en: {SAY:crazydave}I bet someone with a jackhammer could remove it.
NARRATIVE_DARK_OUTRO_DANGER_ROOM_KEY_4.zh: {SAY:crazydave}我敢说肯定会有一个携带手提钻的勇士能蛮力钻出此剑！

NARRATIVE_DARK_OUTRO_DANGER_ROOM_KEY_6.en: {TIRED:winnie}An inelegant but no doubt effective solution to the test, User Dave.
NARRATIVE_DARK_OUTRO_DANGER_ROOM_KEY_6.zh: {TIRED:winnie}这是一个优雅不足但效果显著的手段，用户戴夫。

NARRATIVE_DARK_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}I have found no evidence that Plant Food contains zombies or zombie byproducts.
NARRATIVE_DARK_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}没有任何证据表明叶绿素中含有僵尸或者任何尸制品。

NARRATIVE_DARK_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_2.en: {TIRED:crazydave}Phew! Plants shouldn't eat zombies who eat plants.
NARRATIVE_DARK_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_2.zh: {TIRED:crazydave}呸！植物才不应该吃那些要吃他们的僵尸呢。

NARRATIVE_DARK_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_3.en: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}Except Chomper. He has to. Dude needs the fiber.
NARRATIVE_DARK_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_3.zh: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}除了食人花，他需要僵尸的纤维。

NARRATIVE_DARK_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_4.en: {NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}Why dost thine time-traveling jalopy lie to thee?

NARRATIVE_DARK_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_5.en: {SAY:zombossicon}Perchance, a question best left for another day?

NARRATIVE_DARK_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_6.en: {SAY:zombossicon}Now, I pray, imagine maniacal laughter as I depart.

NARRATIVE_DARK_ZOMBIENOTE_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnieicon}{SAY:winnieicon}User Dave, we have encountered a scroll.
NARRATIVE_DARK_ZOMBIENOTE_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnieicon}{SAY:winnieicon}用户戴夫，我们获得了一个卷轴。

NARRATIVE_DARK_ZOMBIENOTE_2.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydaveicon}{EXCITED:crazydaveicon}I love side-scrollers! They're my second favorite kind of game.
NARRATIVE_DARK_ZOMBIENOTE_2.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydaveicon}{EXCITED:crazydaveicon}横向卷轴小游戏！这可是我第二喜欢的游戏类型！

NARRATIVE_DARK_ZOMBIENOTE_3.en: {SAY:winnieicon}This is not a game. It's a piece of parchment bearing a message.
NARRATIVE_DARK_ZOMBIENOTE_3.zh: {SAY:winnieicon}这不是游戏，这是一张携带着信息的羊皮纸。

NARRATIVE_DARK_ZOMBIENOTE_4.en: {PLAYFUL:crazydaveicon}Will ya look at that! It's Dark Ages email. Neat-o!
NARRATIVE_DARK_ZOMBIENOTE_4.zh: {SAY:crazydaveicon}你指的是这个时空的巨人僵尸吗？

NARRATIVE_DARK_ZOMBIENOTE_6.en: {PLAYFUL:crazydaveicon}No matter how strong you are, you are no match for us, hahaha!
NARRATIVE_DARK_ZOMBIENOTE_6.zh: {PLAYFUL:crazydaveicon}再强悍也不是咱们的对手，哈哈哈！

NARRATIVE_DARTICHOKE_EQ_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Dartichokes aim first at high-priority targets like Wizards and Octo Zombies.
NARRATIVE_DARTICHOKE_EQ_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}飞镖洋蓟可以优先攻击诸如巫师、章鱼僵尸等高优先级的僵尸。

NARRATIVE_DINO_15_OUTRO_2.en: {SAY:winnie}A meteorite. Curious. My records indicate this should be... bigger.
NARRATIVE_DINO_15_OUTRO_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}这是一颗陨石。奇怪的是…我的记录显示这应该…更大才对。

NARRATIVE_DINO_15_OUTRO_3.zh: {SAY:crazydave}更大？像超级墨西哥卷饼那么大吗？

NARRATIVE_DINO_15_OUTRO_4.en: {SAY:winnie}More like super Seattle-sized. I hope history has not gone awry...
NARRATIVE_DINO_15_OUTRO_4.zh: {SAY:winnie}非常大，大概有一个超级西雅图体育场那么大，我真希望历史不要出现什么偏差…

NARRATIVE_DINO_16_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}Surrender your brains forthwith, inane time stumblers!
NARRATIVE_DINO_16_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}你们这些蹒跚而行的时空旅行笨蛋，快快交出脑子，立刻投降！

NARRATIVE_DINO_16_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:zombossicon}Else you shall share the fate of these terrible thunder lizards: EXTINCTION!
NARRATIVE_DINO_16_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:zombossicon}否则你们就等着与那些雷霆巨蜥一起遭受噩运吧——走向灭绝！

NARRATIVE_DINO_16_INTRO_3.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{EXCITED:crazydave}But I don't want to get extincted!
NARRATIVE_DINO_16_INTRO_3.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{EXCITED:crazydave}可是我不想和恐龙一样灭绝诶！

NARRATIVE_DINO_17_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}有什么事困扰你了吗，用户戴夫？

NARRATIVE_DINO_17_INTRO_3.en: {EXCITED:crazydave}I just always wanted a primitive sunflower who gave big suns!
NARRATIVE_DINO_17_INTRO_3.zh: {EXCITED:crazydave}我只是想要一株产出大阳光的原始版向日葵。

NARRATIVE_DINO_17_INTRO_4.zh: {SAY:winnie}可以准备撰写好评了，用户戴夫。

NARRATIVE_DINO_1_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Alert, User Dave. My sensors indicate we have moved 153,954,765 years into the past.
NARRATIVE_DINO_1_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}警告，用户戴夫。我的传感器表明我们已回到 1,5396,4765 年前。

NARRATIVE_DINO_1_INTRO_2.en: {EXCITED:crazydave}Yabbers! That's before I was even born!

NARRATIVE_DINO_1_INTRO_3.en: {SAY:winnie}Correct. We seem to have landed in some form of Jurassic Marsh.
NARRATIVE_DINO_1_INTRO_3.zh: {SAY:winnie}我们似乎已着陆于侏罗纪时期的沼泽地上。

NARRATIVE_DINO_1_INTRO_4.zh: {EXCITED:crazydave}我晓得，我感受到了更多的氧气！

NARRATIVE_DINO_21_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Beware the Jurassic Bully zombies, User Dave.
NARRATIVE_DINO_21_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}请当心侏罗纪暴徒僵尸，用户戴夫。

NARRATIVE_DINO_21_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:winnie}They are immune to the Primal Peashooter's knockback effect.
NARRATIVE_DINO_21_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}他们免疫原始豌豆射手的击退效果。

NARRATIVE_DINO_21_INTRO_3.en: {EXCITED:crazydave}Zuh? But how? Even Gargantuars get knocked back!
NARRATIVE_DINO_21_INTRO_3.zh: {EXCITED:crazydave}蛤？可是…即便是巨人僵尸也会受击退效果影响啊！

NARRATIVE_DINO_21_INTRO_4.en: {SAY:winnie}True, User Dave. The Bully is simply too stupid to observe typical physics.
NARRATIVE_DINO_21_INTRO_4.zh: {SAY:winnie}这是真的，用户戴夫。然则这些蛮人不过是蠢到不懂遵守基本的物理法则罢了。

NARRATIVE_DINO_23_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}I detect Primal Potato Mines nearby, User Dave.
NARRATIVE_DINO_23_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}我探测到原始土豆地雷在附近，用户戴夫。

NARRATIVE_DINO_23_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:winnie}Their prepaleolithic potency will far exceed our more refined modern versions.
NARRATIVE_DINO_23_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}旧石器时代的地雷的潜能远超我们那位于现代的改良版。

NARRATIVE_DINO_23_INTRO_3.zh: {EXCITED:crazydave}强力版的土豆？我已经爱上它们了！

NARRATIVE_DINO_2_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}This epoch is known for its unusual lifeforms, User Dave.
NARRATIVE_DINO_2_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}这个纪元以它存在的不寻常生物而闻名于世，用户戴夫。

NARRATIVE_DINO_2_INTRO_2.zh: {EXCITED:crazydave}我知道！这里的有众多的裸子植物，对吗？

NARRATIVE_DINO_2_INTRO_3.en: {SAY:winnie}I was thinking more in terms of saurians, User Dave. Dinosaurs.
NARRATIVE_DINO_2_INTRO_3.zh: {SAY:winnie}我想的是这里有更多的蜥蜴亚目的动物，用户戴夫。也就是恐龙。

NARRATIVE_DINO_2_INTRO_4.en: {SAY:winnie}They won't attack us directly and we can't affect them.

NARRATIVE_DINO_2_INTRO_5.en: {SAY:winnie}However, they will definitely react to zombies. Be wary!
NARRATIVE_DINO_2_INTRO_5.zh: {SAY:winnie}但他们一定会对僵尸有所反应。敬请多加小心！

NARRATIVE_DINO_33_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}Hey! The past is still just when we left it!
NARRATIVE_DINO_33_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}嘿！一切还维持在我们离开那时的模样！

NARRATIVE_DINO_33_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:winnie}True, with differences. More Jurassic zombies have appeared, with amplified abilities.
NARRATIVE_DINO_33_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}的确如此，但有所差异的是。更多侏罗纪僵尸出现了，并且它们的能力被强化了。

NARRATIVE_DINO_33_INTRO_3.en: {SAY:winnie}Our plants may need to be upgraded to provide sufficient protection.
NARRATIVE_DINO_33_INTRO_3.zh: {SAY:winnie}我们的植物可能需要升级以提供足够的防护。

NARRATIVE_DINO_34_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}哎哟哟！我们的割草机已经灭绝了！

NARRATIVE_DINO_34_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:winnie}Time fluxes interfere with mowing technology, User Dave.
NARRATIVE_DINO_34_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}时空的不稳定性干扰了割草科技，用户戴夫。

NARRATIVE_DINO_34_INTRO_3.en: {SAY:winnie}We must plant with additional care lest we be overrun.
NARRATIVE_DINO_34_INTRO_3.zh: {SAY:winnie}我们必须格外小心地种植以防被击溃。

NARRATIVE_DINO_42_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}Bah! Your infernal interference enrages me! Bah!
NARRATIVE_DINO_42_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}呸！你那可恨的介入惹毛我了！呸！

NARRATIVE_DINO_42_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:zombossicon} The Zombot Dinotronic Mechasaur, 2nd Edition, shall end your travels permanently!
NARRATIVE_DINO_42_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:zombossicon} 机龙速袭者僵尸机器人第二代将永久结束你们的旅程！

NARRATIVE_DINO_42_OUTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}We did it! Thanks, occasionally helpful dinosaurs!
NARRATIVE_DINO_42_OUTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}我们做到啦！感谢你们，偶尔有点用处的恐龙！

NARRATIVE_DINO_42_OUTRO_2.en: {SAY:winnie}Our upgraded plants proved invaluable as well, User Dave.
NARRATIVE_DINO_42_OUTRO_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}我们的升级植物也展现了它们的价值，用户戴夫。

NARRATIVE_DINO_42_OUTRO_3.en: {NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}Arrg! How could a robot dinosaur fail? MY PLAN WAS FOOLPROOF.
NARRATIVE_DINO_42_OUTRO_3.zh: {NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}哇啊啊啊！这机械恐龙怎么可能倾覆！我的计划明明万—无—一—失！

NARRATIVE_DINO_6_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:crazydave}I can feel the ground a-trembling, Penny! More dinos?
NARRATIVE_DINO_6_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:crazydave}我感受到大地在颤抖，潘妮！是更多恐龙要来了吗？

NARRATIVE_DINO_6_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:winnie}Indeed, User Dave. A herd of stegosaurs approaches.
NARRATIVE_DINO_6_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}是的，用户戴夫。一大群剑龙正在靠近。

NARRATIVE_DINO_6_INTRO_3.en: {SAY:winnie}My sensors indicate they will snare zombies with their tail, and then flick them off.
NARRATIVE_DINO_6_INTRO_3.zh: {SAY:winnie}我的传感器表明他们会用尾巴抓住僵尸，然后将它们甩出。

NARRATIVE_DINO_8_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}I have analyzed a new plant, User Dave.
NARRATIVE_DINO_8_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}我刚分析出这儿有株新植物，用户戴夫。

NARRATIVE_DINO_8_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:winnie}The Perfume-shroom charms dinosaurs and turns them against the zombies.
NARRATIVE_DINO_8_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}香水菇可以迷住恐龙，从而使它们转而对抗僵尸。

NARRATIVE_DINO_8_INTRO_3.en: {EXCITED:crazydave}Dino-sour power? On OUR side? This is taco-level great news!
NARRATIVE_DINO_8_INTRO_3.zh: {EXCITED:crazydave}龙之波动？为我所用？真是个玉米卷级别的大好消息啊！

NARRATIVE_DINO_9_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{EXCITED:crazydave}Penny! I just remembered how much I love silent letters!
NARRATIVE_DINO_9_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{EXCITED:crazydave}潘妮！我回想起了自己是有多么酷爱拼音中“整体认读音节”啊！

NARRATIVE_DINO_9_INTRO_2.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Coincidentally, User Dave, a flock of Pterodactyls is approaching.
NARRATIVE_DINO_9_INTRO_2.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}真是太巧合了，用户戴夫。一大群翼龙正在接近。

NARRATIVE_DINO_9_INTRO_3.zh: {EXCITED:crazydave}翼龙？这个“翼”字只需整体发音真是太赞了！

NARRATIVE_DINO_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}我的暴怒已然开辟了新纪元！

NARRATIVE_DINO_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_2.en: {SAY:zombossicon}Is there nowhen I may go to avoid your imbecilic interference?
NARRATIVE_DINO_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_2.zh: {SAY:zombossicon}难道我要一直躲避你们那愚蠢的干涉吗？

NARRATIVE_DINO_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_3.en: {SAY:zombossicon}Stay right where you are. I have an enormous rock scheduled to make your acquaintance.
NARRATIVE_DINO_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_3.zh: {SAY:zombossicon}乖乖站好，我的“巨石计划”不久将会呈现在你们面前！

NARRATIVE_DINO_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_4.zh: {NPC_EXIT:zombossicon}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:crazydave}“巨石计划”？听起来就让人讨厌。

NARRATIVE_DINO_OUTRO_DANGER_ROOM_KEY_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:crazydave}I see a toenail! Of unusual size!
NARRATIVE_DINO_OUTRO_DANGER_ROOM_KEY_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:crazydave}我看到了一块特大尺寸的脚趾甲！

NARRATIVE_DINO_OUTRO_DANGER_ROOM_KEY_2.en: {SAY:winnie}This raptor claw bespeaks an ancient arena of dinosaurian dimensions, User Dave!
NARRATIVE_DINO_OUTRO_DANGER_ROOM_KEY_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}此块迅猛龙的爪牙表明附近有一处挤满恐龙的异次元的上古竞技场，用户戴夫！

NARRATIVE_DINO_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}I detect an incoming meteor, User Dave
NARRATIVE_DINO_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}我探测到了一块正在靠近的陨石，用户戴夫。

NARRATIVE_DINO_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_2.en: {SAY:winnie}I advise immediate egress from this timezone.
NARRATIVE_DINO_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}我建议我们立即离开这个时空！

NARRATIVE_DINO_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_3.en: {EXCITED:crazydave}Bye-bye, dinos! You'll be birdies in no time!
NARRATIVE_DINO_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_3.zh: {EXCITED:crazydave}再会，恐龙！你们很快就要演变为小鸟儿了！

NARRATIVE_DINO_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_4.en: {NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}Bah! You leave me no choice but to enact... Project Paradox!
NARRATIVE_DINO_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_4.zh: {NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}呸！你让我别无选择，看来是时候启动“悖论计划”了！

NARRATIVE_DINO_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_5.zh: {SAY:zombossicon}我会满心欢喜再见到你们的，傻瓜！

NARRATIVE_DRAFTODIL_EQ_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}种植气流水仙，减缓、消灭飞行的僵尸。
NARRATIVE_DRAFTODIL_EQ_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}种植气流水仙，减缓、消灭飞行的僵尸。

NARRATIVE_EGYPT3_OUTRO_2.en: {SAY:winnie}New plants will help us face new challenges.
NARRATIVE_EGYPT3_OUTRO_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}新植物会帮我们应对新的挑战。

NARRATIVE_EGYPT3_OUTRO_3.en: {EXCITED:crazydave}I hope this new plant can hit up to three targets in its lane, twice!
NARRATIVE_EGYPT3_OUTRO_3.zh: {EXCITED:crazydave}希望这个新植物能一下击中三个目标，还能来回伤害两次！

NARRATIVE_EGYPT4_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Bloomerangs should prove effective against Camel Zombies.
NARRATIVE_EGYPT4_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}用回旋花来对付骆驼僵尸应该格外有效。

NARRATIVE_EGYPT4_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:winnie}Oh, and no need for sun. Plants are coming special delivery!
NARRATIVE_EGYPT4_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}对了，这关不需要阳光。因为植物会通过传送带过来！

NARRATIVE_EGYPT_26_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}呜哇，木乃伊！更多的木乃伊僵尸要来了！

NARRATIVE_EGYPT_26_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:winnie}The time fissure is strengthening zombies from all epochs, User Dave.
NARRATIVE_EGYPT_26_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}时空裂痕正在强化来自所有纪元的僵尸，用户戴夫。

NARRATIVE_EGYPT_26_INTRO_3.en: {SAY:winnie}We should expect more powerful versions of some zombies.
NARRATIVE_EGYPT_26_INTRO_3.zh: {SAY:winnie}我们可以期待遇见更多某些僵尸的强化版。

NARRATIVE_EGYPT_26_INTRO_5.en: {SAY:winnie}We may need to retreat to another timeline and return when our plants are stronger.
NARRATIVE_EGYPT_26_INTRO_5.zh: {SAY:winnie}我们也许只能撤退到其他时间线去，等我们的植物变得更加强大了再回来。

NARRATIVE_EGYPT_31_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:winnie}The timeline is exhibiting instabilities, User Dave.
NARRATIVE_EGYPT_31_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}时间线正呈现出不稳定的状态，用户戴夫。

NARRATIVE_EGYPT_31_INTRO_3.en: {SAY:winnie}Fixed-loop paradoxes are forbidding the presence of lawnmowers.
NARRATIVE_EGYPT_31_INTRO_3.zh: {SAY:winnie}固定循环悖论禁止了割草机的存在。

NARRATIVE_EGYPT_31_INTRO_4.zh: {SAY:crazydave}可我已经把中间那台割草机命名为“小割割”了呀！

NARRATIVE_EGYPT_35_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}Once more we meet in the sands of time!
NARRATIVE_EGYPT_35_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}我们在黄沙漫漫的时空中再度见面了！

NARRATIVE_EGYPT_35_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:zombossicon}Have you enjoyed my new and improved zombies?
NARRATIVE_EGYPT_35_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:zombossicon}和我的全新强化版僵尸玩得开心吗？

NARRATIVE_EGYPT_35_INTRO_3.en: {SAY:zombossicon}Or should I say ancient and improved?
NARRATIVE_EGYPT_35_INTRO_3.zh: {SAY:zombossicon}或者我应该说，上古的强化版僵尸？

NARRATIVE_EGYPT_35_INTRO_4.en: {SAY:zombossicon}Bah! They are nothing to my Zombot Sphinxinator 2.0!
NARRATIVE_EGYPT_35_INTRO_4.zh: {SAY:zombossicon}呸！它们在我的狮身终结者僵尸机器人 2.0 面前都不值一提！

NARRATIVE_EGYPT_35_OUTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}我已经大汗淋漓！但我们成功了！

NARRATIVE_EGYPT_35_OUTRO_2.en: {SAY:winnie}We may travel to other timelines freely, User Dave.
NARRATIVE_EGYPT_35_OUTRO_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}我们应该可以自由穿梭到其他时空了，用户戴夫。

NARRATIVE_EGYPT_35_OUTRO_3.en: {SAY:winnie}But I detect further timeline expansions in the future.
NARRATIVE_EGYPT_35_OUTRO_3.zh: {SAY:winnie}但是我探测到了更多未来的时间线在膨胀。

NARRATIVE_EGYPT_35_OUTRO_4.zh: {NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}到时我一定会征服你的，金字塔！

NARRATIVE_EGYPT_BLOOMERANG_LEVELUP_INTRO.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Indeed they do, User Dave. But they are not.
NARRATIVE_EGYPT_BLOOMERANG_LEVELUP_INTRO.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}是的，用户戴夫。但事实并非如此。

NARRATIVE_EGYPT_BLOOMERANG_LEVELUP_INTRO.en: {SAY:winnie}The lower Bloomerang is at MAX LEVEL.
NARRATIVE_EGYPT_BLOOMERANG_LEVELUP_INTRO.zh: {SAY:winnie}下面的魔术菇是最高等级的。

NARRATIVE_EGYPT_BLOOMERANG_LEVELUP_INTRO.en: {SAY:winnie}Oh, and no need for sun. Plants are coming special delivery!
NARRATIVE_EGYPT_BLOOMERANG_LEVELUP_INTRO.zh: {SAY:winnie}对了，这关不需要阳光。因为植物会通过传送带过来！

NARRATIVE_EGYPT_CHALLENGE_CONVEYOR_INTRO.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY}No need for sun.  Plants are coming via special delivery.
NARRATIVE_EGYPT_CHALLENGE_CONVEYOR_INTRO.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY}这关不需要阳光。因为植物会通过传送带过来！

NARRATIVE_EGYPT_CHALLENGE_CONVEYOR_OUTRO.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{EXCITED}{START_DIALOG_MUSIC}Awesome! I've always wanted to eat one of those.
{SAY:crazydave}Wait... that's not a starfish. It's an actual star.
NARRATIVE_EGYPT_CHALLENGE_CONVEYOR_OUTRO.zh: {SAY:crazydave}等等…那不是海星。那是一颗真正的星星。

NARRATIVE_EGYPT_CHALLENGE_LASTSTAND_A_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{PLAYFUL}This will be the first last stand. There will be more lasts to come.
NARRATIVE_EGYPT_CHALLENGE_LASTSTAND_A_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{PLAYFUL}这是我们的第一场“坚不可摧”。后续有更多的战斗即将打响。

NARRATIVE_EGYPT_CHALLENGE_LASTSTAND_B_4.en: {EXCITED:crazydave}I love sitting, but now is not the time! Let's get crazy.
NARRATIVE_EGYPT_CHALLENGE_LASTSTAND_B_4.zh: {EXCITED:crazydave}我喜欢！来疯狂地通过这一关吧。

NARRATIVE_EGYPT_CHALLENGE_LASTSTAND_C_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY}{START_DIALOG_MUSIC}I hope that pharaohs had some heirs.
NARRATIVE_EGYPT_CHALLENGE_LASTSTAND_C_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY}{START_DIALOG_MUSIC}我倒是希望法老有些继承人。

NARRATIVE_EGYPT_CHALLENGE_LASTSTAND_C_2.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}I guess that was their last stand too.
NARRATIVE_EGYPT_CHALLENGE_LASTSTAND_C_2.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}我想这也是他们的最后一战了。

NARRATIVE_EGYPT_CHALLENGE_MINIGAME_A_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY}There's a brand new symbol to match. It's a bucket.
NARRATIVE_EGYPT_CHALLENGE_MINIGAME_A_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY}有新的图案可以匹配了。是个桶。

NARRATIVE_EGYPT_CHALLENGE_MINIGAME_B_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{EXCITED}Match the symbols and win a prize!

NARRATIVE_EGYPT_CHALLENGE_PRESET_A_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY}This level is a locked coordinate in time.
NARRATIVE_EGYPT_CHALLENGE_PRESET_A_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY}这关是一个在时空中锁定的坐标。

NARRATIVE_EGYPT_CHALLENGE_PRESET_A_2.en: {EXCITED:winnie}You must take these plants to win.
NARRATIVE_EGYPT_CHALLENGE_PRESET_A_2.zh: {EXCITED:winnie}你只能使用选定的植物过关。

NARRATIVE_EGYPT_CHALLENGE_PRESET_A_3.zh: {EXCITED:winnie}不然的话，现实世界将会面临被你扭曲的风险。

NARRATIVE_EGYPT_CHALLENGE_PRESET_A_4.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{EXCITED:crazydave}千万别扭曲现实世界啊！不然就糟了。

NARRATIVE_EGYPT_CHALLENGE_PRESET_B_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{TIRED}Can't we build a modern fence to stop these ancient zombies?
NARRATIVE_EGYPT_CHALLENGE_PRESET_B_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{TIRED}我们就不能造一座现代化的栅栏来阻挡这些僵尸吗？

NARRATIVE_EGYPT_CHALLENGE_PRESET_B_2.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{PLAYFUL:crazydave}Who needs fences when you have offense?
NARRATIVE_EGYPT_CHALLENGE_PRESET_B_2.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{PLAYFUL:crazydave}当你有能力进攻时，谁还需要栅栏来防守？

NARRATIVE_EGYPT_CHALLENGE_PRESET_C_2.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{PLAYFUL:crazydave}他们之间也是真正的植物基友。

NARRATIVE_EGYPT_CHALLENGE_PROTECTPLANTS_.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{EXCITED}There's a plant call on the banana phone. It's an S.O.S.!
NARRATIVE_EGYPT_CHALLENGE_PROTECTPLANTS_.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{EXCITED}那里有株植物在用“香蕉手机”向外求助。这是一则 S.O.S. 求救信号！

NARRATIVE_EGYPT_CHALLENGE_PROTECTPLANTS_.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:winnie}They'll be sitting plants if we don't help. Let's take that root and save them!
NARRATIVE_EGYPT_CHALLENGE_PROTECTPLANTS_.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:winnie}如果我们坐视不管，它们就只能在那儿坐以待毙了。快快向它们伸出援手吧！

NARRATIVE_EGYPT_CHALLENGE_PROTECTPLANTS_.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY}My sensors have detected plants in danger.
NARRATIVE_EGYPT_CHALLENGE_PROTECTPLANTS_.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY}我的传感器探测到了正处于危险状态植物。
{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SPECIAL9:crazydave}谁会来拯救这些植物呢？谁呢？！？？

NARRATIVE_EGYPT_CHALLENGE_PROTECTPLANTS_.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}There's too many tombs. Let's clear them out.
NARRATIVE_EGYPT_CHALLENGE_PROTECTPLANTS_.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}坟墓数量过多，先清除它们吧。

NARRATIVE_EGYPT_CHALLENGE_PROTECTPLANTS_.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SHOUT:crazydave}I'm hyperventilating I'm so excited right now.
NARRATIVE_EGYPT_CHALLENGE_PROTECTPLANTS_.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SHOUT:crazydave}我现在已经呼吸急促了，好激动啊！

NARRATIVE_EGYPT_INTRO_FIRSTLEVEL_2.en: {SAY:winnie}Please wait 4500 years for your taco to be ready... more or less.
NARRATIVE_EGYPT_INTRO_FIRSTLEVEL_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}请耐心等待…距你的玉米卷出炉还有大约 4500 年。

NARRATIVE_EGYPT_INTRO_FIRSTLEVEL_4.en: {PLAYFUL}I'm sure my taco is around here somewhere, but in the meantime...
NARRATIVE_EGYPT_INTRO_FIRSTLEVEL_4.zh: {PLAYFUL}我敢打赌我的玉米卷就在附近。不过与此同时…

NARRATIVE_EGYPT_INTRO_FIRSTLEVEL_7.en: {TIRED}If only there was something that you could feed it…
NARRATIVE_EGYPT_INTRO_FIRSTLEVEL_7.zh: {TIRED}不知道有没有什么东西可以喂他…

NARRATIVE_EGYPT_INTRO_FIRSTLEVEL_8.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Plant Food is packed with vitamins and minerals.
NARRATIVE_EGYPT_INTRO_FIRSTLEVEL_8.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}叶绿素富含维生素和矿物质。

NARRATIVE_EGYPT_INTRO_FIRSTLEVEL_9.en: {PLAYFUL:winnie}It's an essential part of a complete breakfast.
NARRATIVE_EGYPT_INTRO_FIRSTLEVEL_9.zh: {PLAYFUL:winnie}这是一顿完美早餐必不可少的一部分。

NARRATIVE_EGYPT_INTRO_GARGANTUAR_2.en: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY}Special couriers have been dispatched to retrieve your brains.
NARRATIVE_EGYPT_INTRO_GARGANTUAR_2.zh: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY}邮递特使已经奉我之命前去取得你们的脑子。

NARRATIVE_EGYPT_INTRO_GARGANTUAR_3.en: {SAY:zombossicon}Please have your release forms signed before their arrival.
NARRATIVE_EGYPT_INTRO_GARGANTUAR_3.zh: {SAY:zombossicon}请在他们来之前在这份授权书上签字。

NARRATIVE_EGYPT_INTRO_GARGANTUAR_4.zh: {SAY:zombossicon}此致 敬礼，埃德加 · 僵王博士。

NARRATIVE_EGYPT_INTRO_GARGANTUAR_5.en: {NPC_EXIT:zombossicon}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:crazydave}Cool, that Mr. Boss guy wants your autograph!
NARRATIVE_EGYPT_INTRO_GARGANTUAR_5.zh: {NPC_EXIT:zombossicon}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:crazydave}酷诶，那位博士先生想要你的签名呢！

NARRATIVE_EGYPT_INTRO_LASTLEVEL_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SPECIAL7}Whoa... this world goes to eleven! That's crazy!
NARRATIVE_EGYPT_INTRO_LASTLEVEL_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SPECIAL7}哇哦！这世界有十一个关卡！太疯狂了！

NARRATIVE_EGYPT_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}My taco tastes so close I can smell it!
NARRATIVE_EGYPT_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY}你有没有想过为什么你的邻居戴夫永远这么饿？

NARRATIVE_EGYPT_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_2.en: {SAY:winnie}Beware, User Dave. Dr. Zomboss still stands in our way.
NARRATIVE_EGYPT_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_2.zh: {SAY:zombossicon}玉米卷中的什么秘密成分会激发他的欲望？

NARRATIVE_EGYPT_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_3.en: {SAY:crazydave}What does that guy have against tacos and me eating them?
NARRATIVE_EGYPT_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_3.zh: {SAY:zombossicon}难道他和我们一样需要你的脑子吗？

NARRATIVE_EGYPT_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_4.en: {NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}Bah! My reasoning is simple yet beyond your comprehension!
NARRATIVE_EGYPT_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_4.zh: {NPC_EXIT:zombossicon}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{EXCITED:crazydave}啥？！屁嘞！我永远不会吃脑子玉米卷！

NARRATIVE_EGYPT_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_5.en: {SAY:zombossicon}Now face my Zombot Sphinx-inator in battle!
NARRATIVE_EGYPT_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_5.zh: {TIRED:crazydave}但是…我也不记得里面是什么了…

NARRATIVE_EGYPT_OUTRO_DANGER_ROOM_KEY_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:winnie}Though tetrahedrons are pyramids, this one is not a Platonic solid.
NARRATIVE_EGYPT_OUTRO_DANGER_ROOM_KEY_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:winnie}四面都像金字塔，但这可不是正多面体。

NARRATIVE_EGYPT_OUTRO_DANGER_ROOM_KEY_2.en: {EXCITED:crazydave}I'm so hungry, I would love a Platonic solid.
NARRATIVE_EGYPT_OUTRO_DANGER_ROOM_KEY_2.zh: {EXCITED:crazydave}我好饿啊，我想要一个柏拉图式的食物。

NARRATIVE_EGYPT_OUTRO_DANGER_ROOM_KEY_3.en: {TIRED:winnie}User Dave, this is also not a taco salad.
NARRATIVE_EGYPT_OUTRO_DANGER_ROOM_KEY_3.zh: {TIRED:winnie}用户戴夫，这里也没有玉米卷沙拉。

NARRATIVE_EGYPT_OUTRO_GARGANTUAR_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{PLAYFUL:crazydave}Look, Penny! A Pirate Key! It's pirate-y!
NARRATIVE_EGYPT_OUTRO_GARGANTUAR_1.zh: {NPC_EXIT:zombossicon}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{PLAYFUL:crazydave}看起来快递员要给自己送货了！

NARRATIVE_EGYPT_OUTRO_GARGANTUAR_2.en: {EXCITED:winnie}This will enable us to travel to another time.
NARRATIVE_EGYPT_OUTRO_GARGANTUAR_2.zh: {EXCITED:winnie}这些对于去其他时间旅行很有用。

NARRATIVE_EGYPT_OUTRO_GARGANTUAR_3.zh: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}好耶！是时候尝试一下玉米卷地图了！

NARRATIVE_EGYPT_OUTRO_GARGANTUAR_4.en: {NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}This is no pleasure trip! Your excursion will be watery... and grave!
NARRATIVE_EGYPT_OUTRO_GARGANTUAR_4.zh: {NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}这不是一次愉快旅途！你的前程将是水汪汪的墓碑！

NARRATIVE_EGYPT_OUTRO_LASTTLEVEL_2.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SPECIAL8}看来这场戏杀“清”了！！！！哈哈哈哈哈！

NARRATIVE_EGYPT_OUTRO_LASTTLEVEL_4.en: {TIRED:winnie}User Dave has been waiting to use that joke since we got here.
NARRATIVE_EGYPT_OUTRO_LASTTLEVEL_4.zh: {TIRED:winnie}自从我们来到这里，用户戴夫就一直在讲那个笑话。

NARRATIVE_EGYPT_OUTRO_LASTTLEVEL_5.en: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}Do you know what's better than a wrap? A Taco. Let's go!
NARRATIVE_EGYPT_OUTRO_LASTTLEVEL_5.zh: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}你知道什么比杀“清”更棒吗？肯定是一份玉米卷！我们走吧！

NARRATIVE_EGYPT_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_2.en: {TIRED:crazydave}There was never any meat in that taco.

NARRATIVE_EGYPT_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_3.en: {EXCITED:crazydave}I still have Tofunky in my beard to prove it!
NARRATIVE_EGYPT_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_3.zh: {EXCITED:crazydave}瞧瞧我长胡子里的残渣，它们能做担保！

NARRATIVE_EGYPT_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_4.en: {NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}Well, that just leaves more brains for us... later.
NARRATIVE_EGYPT_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_4.zh: {NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}好吧，这只不过是将更多的脑子…留到以后供我们享用。

NARRATIVE_EGYPT_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_5.en: {SAY:zombossicon}I'll find you again, in another where and another when!
NARRATIVE_EGYPT_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_5.zh: {SAY:zombossicon}我将再次——在又一个时空，于另一个地点，找到你！

NARRATIVE_EGYPT_STAR_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydaveicon}{EXCITED}Look! Now there's a star on the time-space map!
NARRATIVE_EGYPT_STAR_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydaveicon}{EXCITED}看！现在时空地图上有颗星星！

NARRATIVE_EGYPT_STAR_INTRO_3.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnieicon}{SAY}Stars appear on the map where you earned them.
NARRATIVE_EGYPT_STAR_INTRO_3.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnieicon}{SAY}当你获得星星时，它们便会出现在地图的对应位置上。

NARRATIVE_EGYPT_STAR_INTRO_4.en: {PLAYFUL:winnieicon}Stars could help us get back to the year 2009 and your taco.
NARRATIVE_EGYPT_STAR_INTRO_4.zh: {PLAYFUL:winnieicon}星星能帮我们回到 2009 年，并找回你的玉米卷。

NARRATIVE_EGYPT_STAR_INTRO_5.en: {PLAYFUL:crazydaveicon}Well let's get going and find some more!
NARRATIVE_EGYPT_STAR_INTRO_5.zh: {PLAYFUL:crazydaveicon}那么让我们行动起来，去寻找更多星星吧！

NARRATIVE_EGYPT_STAR_INTRO_OLD_4.en: {TIRED:winnieicon}Empty stars show where you can go to earn stars.
NARRATIVE_EGYPT_STAR_INTRO_OLD_4.zh: {TIRED:winnieicon}星星槽指引我们何处能获得更多星星。

NARRATIVE_EGYPT_WORLDMAP_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydaveicon}Now this looks like the map to my taco!
NARRATIVE_EGYPT_WORLDMAP_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydaveicon}现在这张地图应该是用来找我的玉米卷的了。

NARRATIVE_EGYPT_WORLDMAP_INTRO_2.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnieicon}{SAY}To be precise this is a world map where we can find plants that can help us and...
NARRATIVE_EGYPT_WORLDMAP_INTRO_2.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnieicon}{SAY}确切地说，这张地图标示着我们能在何处寻找到能助我们一臂之力的植物以及…

NARRATIVE_EGYPT_WORLDMAP_INTRO_4.en: {TIRED:winnieicon}User Dave, there are more important things at hand than...
NARRATIVE_EGYPT_WORLDMAP_INTRO_4.zh: {TIRED:winnieicon}用户戴夫，我们手头上还有更要紧的事…

NARRATIVE_EGYPT_WORLDMAP_INTRO_OLD_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydaveicon}{EXCITED}Good news! Penny found a map to my taco!
NARRATIVE_EGYPT_WORLDMAP_INTRO_OLD_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydaveicon}{EXCITED}好消息！潘妮发现了能找到玉米卷的地图！

NARRATIVE_EGYPT_WORLDMAP_INTRO_OLD_2.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnieicon}{TIRED}No, that is a time-space map to the plants that can help us.
NARRATIVE_EGYPT_WORLDMAP_INTRO_OLD_2.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnieicon}{TIRED}不，这里有一张时空地图，指向那些能助我们一臂之力的植物。

NARRATIVE_EGYPT_ZOMBIENOTE_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnieicon}{SAY}My Gügle translator indicates the zombies have a plan.
NARRATIVE_EGYPT_ZOMBIENOTE_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnieicon}{SAY}我的“古鸽翻译”显示出僵尸有一项计划。

NARRATIVE_EIGHTIES_15_OUTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:crazydave}Somebody passed me a note in homeroom, Penny!
NARRATIVE_EIGHTIES_15_OUTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:crazydave}有人在教室里递给我一张便条，潘妮！

NARRATIVE_EIGHTIES_15_OUTRO_2.en: {SAY:crazydave}It says to meet behind the bike racks at lunchtime for a funderful surprise!
NARRATIVE_EIGHTIES_15_OUTRO_2.zh: {SAY:crazydave}上边说要我在午餐时间，于空无一人的自行车棚会面。他还说会给我一个大惊喜。

NARRATIVE_EIGHTIES_15_OUTRO_3.en: {SAY:winnie}I believe some skepticism about this note is in order, User Dave.
NARRATIVE_EIGHTIES_15_OUTRO_3.zh: {SAY:winnie}我觉得这张纸条有些蹊跷，用户戴夫。

NARRATIVE_EIGHTIES_16_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}Do you feel that you have grooved? Did you bang your head? Have you "dug it"?
NARRATIVE_EIGHTIES_16_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}不觉得你们的“节奏”有些老掉牙了么？你们是否在旅途中四处碰壁？另外，你们“挖”到玉米卷了吗？

NARRATIVE_EIGHTIES_16_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:zombossicon}Now the party is over! Melt before the musical might of my majestic Hair Metal Gargantuar!
NARRATIVE_EIGHTIES_16_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:zombossicon}哼！舞会到此为止啦！体会到重金属巨人僵尸的伟岸之前先行消融吧！

NARRATIVE_EIGHTIES_16_INTRO_3.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:crazydave}I'm scared, Penny! It's two minutes to midnight!
NARRATIVE_EIGHTIES_16_INTRO_3.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:crazydave}呜哇，我好怕怕啊，潘妮！还差两分钟就到惊魂的午夜啦！

NARRATIVE_EIGHTIES_16_INTRO_4.en: {SAY:winnie}Be brave, User Dave. We'll jilt this ditty... on rock and roll!
NARRATIVE_EIGHTIES_16_INTRO_4.zh: {SAY:winnie}别怂！用户戴夫！我们将停止播放这首小曲…进而转入摇摆与打滚中去！

NARRATIVE_EIGHTIES_17_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:crazydave}Mmm! Penny, do you smell something scrum-dicious?
NARRATIVE_EIGHTIES_17_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:crazydave}唔…潘妮，你有闻到什么令人拂袖的“清香”吗，好恶心诶！

NARRATIVE_EIGHTIES_17_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:Winnie}不，用户戴夫。此处只有霹雳舞僵尸。

NARRATIVE_EIGHTIES_1_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:crazydave}Flashback! I remember this décor from when I chased squirbos as a kid!
NARRATIVE_EIGHTIES_1_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:crazydave}何等美好的回忆！我记得当年我还光着屁股追地鼠时，就有这种电音了。

NARRATIVE_EIGHTIES_1_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:winnie}Indeed, User Dave. We appear to have arrived in the midst of a Neon Mixtape Tour.
NARRATIVE_EIGHTIES_1_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}的确，用户戴夫。我们似乎已经处于炫光魔音游当中。

NARRATIVE_EIGHTIES_1_INTRO_3.en: {SAY:winnie}I suspect the musical tempo may affect the zombies' speeds.
NARRATIVE_EIGHTIES_1_INTRO_3.zh: {SAY:winnie}据我猜测，音乐的节奏将会影响到僵尸行进的速度。

NARRATIVE_EIGHTIES_1_INTRO_4.en: {EXCITED:crazydave}I'm feeding the rhythm, I'M FEEDING THE RHYTHM!
NARRATIVE_EIGHTIES_1_INTRO_4.zh: {EXCITED:crazydave}我感受到音乐的节拍了，让~我~们~一~起~摇~摆！

NARRATIVE_EIGHTIES_22_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Spore-shrooms have a unique ability, User Dave.
NARRATIVE_EIGHTIES_22_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}孢子菇有着独特的能力，用户戴夫。

NARRATIVE_EIGHTIES_22_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:winnie}If they defeat a zombie, a new Spore-shroom will spawn where that zombie fell.
NARRATIVE_EIGHTIES_22_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}只要一只僵尸因孢子而倒下，那么一株新的蘑菇就此而诞生。

NARRATIVE_EIGHTIES_22_INTRO_3.zh: {EXCITED:crazyDave}嘿哇嘿哇呼！孢子菇意味着我们会有越来越多的蘑菇！

NARRATIVE_EIGHTIES_26_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:crazydave}Say, Penny, do you think Intensive Carrots can be used to revive defeated plants?
NARRATIVE_EIGHTIES_26_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:crazydave}试着探讨一下，潘妮。你认为复活萝卜复活那些植物是否类似于忒修斯之船呢？

NARRATIVE_EIGHTIES_26_INTRO_3.en: {SAY:winnie}Sorry. It just confuses me when you pay attention.
NARRATIVE_EIGHTIES_26_INTRO_3.zh: {SAY:winnie}抱歉，当你认真起来时我却糊涂了。

NARRATIVE_EIGHTIES_2_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:winnie}I believe special zombies may display unique abilities while their preferred music is playing.
NARRATIVE_EIGHTIES_2_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}我相信某些特殊僵尸将会在他们的专属音乐响起后展现他们的专属技能。

NARRATIVE_EIGHTIES_2_INTRO_3.en: {EXCITED:crazydave}You mean they'll jam their jam when their jam is jamming?
NARRATIVE_EIGHTIES_2_INTRO_3.zh: {EXCITED:crazydave}噢，你的意思是当他们所放的放出时他们的就会放出他们该放的吗？

NARRATIVE_EIGHTIES_2_INTRO_4.en: {SAY:winnie}Yes, correct, yes, and yes, User Dave.
NARRATIVE_EIGHTIES_2_INTRO_4.zh: {SAY:winnie}是的，你说的是对的。你说风不是风的话那便是雨，用户戴夫。

NARRATIVE_EIGHTIES_32_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}Hmmmm... you’re in danger above. You’re a fool; and so knew I!
NARRATIVE_EIGHTIES_32_INTRO_1.zh:
{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}♫You’re in danger above. You’re a fool; and so knew I!♫
（额…你已经遇上大事了~你是个笨蛋，而且我知道！）

NARRATIVE_EIGHTIES_32_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:zombossicon}Hear me now: Ever shall you give up; ever shall you be down; always you’ll run aground, I’ll revert you.
NARRATIVE_EIGHTIES_32_INTRO_2.zh:
{SAY:zombossicon}♫Ever shall you give up; ever shall you be down; always you’ll run aground, I’ll revert you.♫
（现在听我唱：永远要将你放弃；永远要让你失望；永远要把你抛弃，要伤害你。）

NARRATIVE_EIGHTIES_32_INTRO_3.en: {SAY:zombossicon}I intend to make you cry; I mean for you to say goodbye; I'm not really that nice a guy – I alert you!
NARRATIVE_EIGHTIES_32_INTRO_3.zh:
{SAY:zombossicon}♫I intend to make you cry; I mean for you to say goodbye; I'm not really that nice a guy – I alert you!♫
（我极为想要让你哭；还想和你说再见；我不是个好人 - 我告诉你！）

NARRATIVE_EIGHTIES_32_OUTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}Yarbs! That was close... with so many exciting timing and rhythm changes!
NARRATIVE_EIGHTIES_32_OUTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}呀…那旷日持久的激战时光，那时移势迁的美妙旋律，实在是太危险了！

NARRATIVE_EIGHTIES_32_OUTRO_2.en: {SAY:winnie}I fear we have only hit pause on Dr. Zomboss’s heinous deal.
NARRATIVE_EIGHTIES_32_OUTRO_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}恐怕我们只是暂时阻止了僵王博士那邪恶的大阴谋。

NARRATIVE_EIGHTIES_32_OUTRO_3.en: {NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}Indeed, next verse, same and yet worse! I go now to when you cannot imagine!
NARRATIVE_EIGHTIES_32_OUTRO_3.zh: {NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}的确…下节乐章，邪恶依旧，甚至更胜一筹！告辞，我现在要去一个你们永远想不到的时空！

NARRATIVE_EIGHTIES_3_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:crazydave}I got a real Cactus feeling about this, Penny!
NARRATIVE_EIGHTIES_3_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:crazydave}我终于摸索出仙人掌真正的特性啦，潘妮！

NARRATIVE_EIGHTIES_3_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:winnie}Indeed, Cactus has changed over time, User Dave.
NARRATIVE_EIGHTIES_3_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}没错，仙人掌的确是随着时间推移而改变着，用户戴夫。

NARRATIVE_EIGHTIES_3_INTRO_3.en: {SAY:winnie}Now she fires a thorn for ranged damage, but hides for ground damage when zombies approach.
NARRATIVE_EIGHTIES_3_INTRO_3.zh: {SAY:winnie}现在她发射棘刺来远程攻击，然而在僵尸接近时她会藏起来从地面造成伤害。

NARRATIVE_EIGHTIES_3_INTRO_4.en: {EXCITED:crazydave}That's so Cactus... always varying her attack and defensive profiles!
NARRATIVE_EIGHTIES_3_INTRO_4.zh: {EXCITED:crazydave}那可真是个“神仙”啊！她总是在攻与守的姿态间切换自如！

NARRATIVE_EIGHTIES_OUTRO_DANGER_ROOM_KEY.en: {SAY:crazydave}Karaoke time! At last my tangerine dreams will come true!
NARRATIVE_EIGHTIES_OUTRO_DANGER_ROOM_KEY.zh: {SAY:crazydave}现在是卡拉 OK 时间！我幼时的橘色歌唱梦终于得以实现啦！

NARRATIVE_EIGHTIES_OUTRO_DANGER_ROOM_KEY.en: {SAY:winnie}Caution, User Dave. This dropped mic promises a banned battle of heavy petal proportions!
NARRATIVE_EIGHTIES_OUTRO_DANGER_ROOM_KEY.zh: {SAY:winnie}当心点，用户戴夫。这个遗落的麦克风指向一个挑战禁地，一个有着重瓣摇滚的地方。

NARRATIVE_ELDER_ALMANAC_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydaveicon}{SAY}Let's go to the dandy-handy Almanac to upgrade a plant!
NARRATIVE_ELDER_ALMANAC_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydaveicon}{SAY}让我们去那本超好用超方便的图鉴中去升级一棵植物吧！

NARRATIVE_ELDER_ALMANAC_OUTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnieicon}{SAY}Defeat levels to unlock and collect new plants.

NARRATIVE_ELDER_ALMANAC_OUTRO_3.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydaveicon}{EXCITED}And then upgrade those plants in the Almanac?
NARRATIVE_ELDER_ALMANAC_OUTRO_3.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydaveicon}{EXCITED}然后在图鉴中升级那些植物？

NARRATIVE_ELDER_QUEST_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydaveicon}{SAY}Travel Log's got some kinda new thing! Check it out!
NARRATIVE_ELDER_QUEST_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydaveicon}{SAY}旅行原木里好像有些新东西了！快去看看吧！

NARRATIVE_EMPOWERMINT_LEVELUP_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Power Mints can be leveled up with mints you earn from Arena mode.
NARRATIVE_EMPOWERMINT_LEVELUP_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}你可以通过在竞技场得到的薄荷糖来升级你的超能薄荷。

NARRATIVE_EMPOWERMINT_LEVELUP_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:winnie}Leveled up Power Mints last longer, have more powerful effects, and can be planted more often.
NARRATIVE_EMPOWERMINT_LEVELUP_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}高等级的超能薄荷持续时间更长、效果更加强大，冷却时间也会更短。

NARRATIVE_ENCHANTMINT_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Power Mints are powerful plants you can acquire through Arena mode.
NARRATIVE_ENCHANTMINT_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}超能薄荷是一类强大的植物，你可以在竞技场模式获得它们。

NARRATIVE_ENCHANTMINT_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:winnie}They provide a big boost to plants in their family.
NARRATIVE_ENCHANTMINT_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}它们对相应家族的植物有巨大的增益作用。

NARRATIVE_ENCHANTMINT_INTRO_3.en: {SAY:winnie}The Enchant-mint family is made up of magic plants.
NARRATIVE_ENCHANTMINT_INTRO_3.zh: {SAY:winnie}法力薄荷家族包括魔法植物。

NARRATIVE_ENFORCEMINT_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Power Mints are powerful plants you can acquire through Arena mode.
NARRATIVE_ENFORCEMINT_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}超能薄荷是一类强大的植物，你可以在竞技场模式获得它们。

NARRATIVE_ENFORCEMINT_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:winnie}They provide a big boost to plants in their family.
NARRATIVE_ENFORCEMINT_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}它们对相应家族的植物有巨大的增益作用。

NARRATIVE_ENFORCEMINT_INTRO_3.en: {SAY:winnie}The Enforce-mint family includes short-range, high-damage melee plants.
NARRATIVE_ENFORCEMINT_INTRO_3.zh: {SAY:winnie}强迫薄荷家族包括近战、高伤害的格斗类植物。

NARRATIVE_ENLIGHTENMINT_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Power Mints are powerful plants you can acquire through Arena mode.
NARRATIVE_ENLIGHTENMINT_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}超能薄荷是一类强大的植物，你可以在竞技场模式获得它们。

NARRATIVE_ENLIGHTENMINT_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:winnie}They provide a big boost to plants in their family.
NARRATIVE_ENLIGHTENMINT_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}它们对相应家族的植物有巨大的增益作用。

NARRATIVE_ENLIGHTENMINT_INTRO_3.en: {SAY:winnie}The Enlighten-mint Family is made up of sun-producing plants.
NARRATIVE_ENLIGHTENMINT_INTRO_3.zh: {SAY:winnie}启明薄荷家族包括可以生产阳光的植物。

NARRATIVE_ENLIGHTENMINT_LEVELUP_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Enlighten-mint can be leveled up with Season Award seed packets.
NARRATIVE_ENLIGHTENMINT_LEVELUP_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}启明薄荷可以用赛季奖励的种子包升级。

NARRATIVE_ENLIGHTENMINT_LEVELUP_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:winnie}A leveled up Enlighten-mint lasts longer, produces more sun, and can be planted more often.
NARRATIVE_ENLIGHTENMINT_LEVELUP_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}一株高等级的启明薄荷在草坪上的持续时间会更长，给你更多都阳光，并且还可以更频繁地种植。

NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_ALOE_01_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}User Dave, I have detected that you have sustained multiple surface level injuries.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_ALOE_01_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}用户戴夫，我探测到你的皮肤有多处受到了损伤。

NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_ALOE_01_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:crazydave}I got into a fight with the Travel Log. He thinks he can tell me what to do!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_ALOE_01_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:crazydave}我和旅行原木吵了一架。他凭什么觉得自己可以吩咐我该干什么！

NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_ALOE_01_INTRO_3.en: {SAY:winnie}Medical assistance is required. I recommend that we search for an Aloe.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_ALOE_01_INTRO_3.zh: {SAY:winnie}一位随行御医是很有必要的。我推荐我们去找一株芦荟。

NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_ALOE_01_INTRO_4.en: {SAY:winnie}Aloe is capable of healing damage an adjacent plant takes.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_ALOE_01_INTRO_4.zh: {SAY:winnie}芦荟在治愈毗邻植物这一方面非常得心应手。

NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_ALOE_02_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}The Aloe is a steadfast companion to the Kiwi Beast.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_ALOE_02_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}芦荟是野兽猕猴桃的忠实伙伴。

NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_ALOE_02_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:winnie}Aloe's healing with allow Kiwi Beast to persist longer, dealing optimal damage to zombies.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_ALOE_02_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}芦荟的治疗效果能让野兽猕猴桃在场上存活更久，有助于后者对僵尸输出最高级别的伤害。

NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_ALOE_02_INTRO_3.en: {SAY:crazydave}Aloe soothes the savage Kiwi Beast. Except for the part where it still looks pretty angry.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_ALOE_02_INTRO_3.zh: {SAY:crazydave}芦荟抚平了野兽猕猴桃的野性。除去它那看起来仍带有怒色的脸庞。

NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_ALOE_05_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}Aloe can heal anything! I don't need this pot for protection anymore!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_ALOE_05_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}芦荟会治愈一切！我不再需要这个花盆作为掩体了！

NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_ALOE_05_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:winnie}That is inadvisable, User Dave. Stronger defenses benefit even further from an Aloe's presence.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_ALOE_05_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}这是不可取的，用户戴夫。芦荟的关照会令稳健的防线锦上添花。

NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_ALOE_08_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:crazydave}Penny! A grid of plants for swappin'!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_ALOE_08_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:crazydave}潘妮，这里有一片可供调换顺序的植物！

NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_ALOE_08_INTRO_2.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Indeed, User Dave. Plants can be swapped to create matches of 3 or more.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_ALOE_08_INTRO_2.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}正确，用户戴夫，3 株或者更多数目的同种植物可以通过交换顺序来达成一组匹配。

NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_ALOE_08_INTRO_3.en: {SAY:winnie}You must make 100 matches to defeat the zombies.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_ALOE_08_INTRO_3.zh: {SAY:winnie}你必须制造出 100 组匹配来战胜这一关的僵尸！

NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_ALOE_08_INTRO_4.en: {SAY:winnie}You can use sun to upgrade your plants.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_ALOE_08_INTRO_4.zh: {SAY:winnie}{SAY:winnie}使用阳光可以提升场上植物的品质。

NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_ALOE_09_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:winnie}This is a first, User Dave. Please continue.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_ALOE_09_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}这只是一个开始，用户戴夫。请继续这段旅程。

NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_ALOE_09_INTRO_3.en: {SAY:crazydave}The Lost City lost its lights. What if we could turn them back on?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_ALOE_09_INTRO_3.zh: {SAY:crazydave}失落之城褪去了它的光彩。当我们把照明开关重新打上会怎样呢？

NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_ALOE_09_INTRO_4.en: {SAY:winnie}Then I would say that would be a bright idea.

NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_ALOE_10_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}We have arrived at the apex of our Aloe adventure.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_ALOE_10_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}我们已经到达了本次芦荟探险之旅的最终一站。

NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_ALOE_10_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:crazydave}I'm going to miss all of the good times we had together.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_ALOE_10_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:crazydave}我会怀念与大家一起度过的美好时光的。

NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_ALOE_10_INTRO_3.en: {SAY:winnie}User Dave, victory here will allow us to acquire the Aloe permanently.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_ALOE_10_INTRO_3.zh: {SAY:winnie}用户戴夫，此次的胜利将使我们永久获得芦荟。无胡！

NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_ALOE_10_INTRO_4.en: {SAY:crazydave}In that case, I'm going to miss my beard.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_ALOE_10_INTRO_4.zh: {SAY:crazydave}这样的话，我肯定会怀念我的大胡子的。

NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_ALOE_10_OUTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Mission accomplished. The Aloe has been added to our plant collection.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_ALOE_10_OUTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}任务完成。芦荟已加入到我们采集的植物中。

NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_ALOE_10_OUTRO_2.en: {SAY:crazydave}And I still have my beard! Everything is coming up Crazy Dave!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_ALOE_10_OUTRO_2.zh: {SAY:crazydave}而且我的大胡子没有消失！真是喜出望外啊，疯狂戴夫！

NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_BEGHOULED_BLITZ_001.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:crazydave}Penny! A grid of plants for swappin'!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_BEGHOULED_BLITZ_001.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:crazydave}潘妮，这里有一片可供调换顺序的植物！

NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_BEGHOULED_BLITZ_001.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Indeed, User Dave. Plants can be swapped to create matches of 3 or more.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_BEGHOULED_BLITZ_001.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}正确，用户戴夫，3 株或者更多数目的同种植物可以通过交换顺序来达成一组匹配。

NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_BEGHOULED_BLITZ_001.en: {SAY:winnie}You must make 125 matches to defeat the zombies.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_BEGHOULED_BLITZ_001.zh: {SAY:winnie}你必须制造出 125 组匹配来战胜这一关的僵尸！

NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_BEGHOULED_BLITZ_001.en: {SAY:winnie}You can use sun to upgrade your plants.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_BEGHOULED_BLITZ_001.zh: {SAY:winnie}{SAY:winnie}使用阳光可以提升场上植物的品质。

NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_BEGHOULED_BLITZ_001.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:winnie}I detect three different Power-Ups, User Dave.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_BEGHOULED_BLITZ_001.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:winnie}我探测到了三种金手指道具，用户戴夫。

NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_BEGHOULED_BLITZ_001.en: {SAY:winnie}They are Power Shuffle, Power Shovel, and Power Zap.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_BEGHOULED_BLITZ_001.zh: {SAY:winnie}它们分别是移换指，铁铲指以及电击指。

NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_BEGHOULED_BLITZ_001.en: {SAY:winnie}Power Shuffle scrambles the board if you are having trouble finding a match.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_BEGHOULED_BLITZ_001.zh: {SAY:winnie}陷入两难的困境时，移换指能打乱场上植物的顺序，以便你找到下一组配对。

NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_BEGHOULED_BLITZ_001.en: {SAY:winnie}Power Shovel fills in a crater, allowing an eaten plant to be replaced.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_BEGHOULED_BLITZ_001.zh: {SAY:winnie}铁铲指能用一株新的植物填补某个因为啃食形成的弹坑

NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_BEGHOULED_BLITZ_001.en: {SAY:crazydave}I was confused about that last one!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_BEGHOULED_BLITZ_001.zh: {SAY:crazydave}我搞不懂最后那个是啥玩意儿！
{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:crazydave}有太多需要调换的植物啦，潘妮！！！

NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_BEGHOULED_BLITZ_001.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie} Indeed, it is a gauntlet, User Dave.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_BEGHOULED_BLITZ_001.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}确实，这将是一项严峻的考验，用户戴夫。

NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_BEGHOULED_BLITZ_001.en: {SAY:winnie}However, my sensors detect a rich reward if we persevere.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_BEGHOULED_BLITZ_001.zh: {SAY:winnie}不过我的传感器探测到，我们若是坚持下来了，将会得到一份豪礼。

NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_BEGHOULED_BLITZ_001.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:crazydave}Whew! That plant grid was rough like old sausage!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_BEGHOULED_BLITZ_001.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:crazydave}哇哦！植物间的弹坑粗糙得像老香肠的肠衣！

NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_BEGHOULED_BLITZ_001.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Correct, User Dave. However, we should expect a rich coin reward for our efforts.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_BEGHOULED_BLITZ_001.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}正确，用户戴夫。不过，我们的付出值得用一袋丰厚的金币作为奖赏。

NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_ELECTRICCURRANT_10_.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:winnie}My batteries are nearly charged, User Dave.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_ELECTRICCURRANT_10_.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:winnie}我的蓄电池即将充满，用户戴夫。

NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_ELECTRICCURRANT_10_.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:crazydave}That Electric Currant is sparky AND sparkly!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_ELECTRICCURRANT_10_.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:crazydave}看呐，那个满载活力的电流醋栗在闪闪发光！

NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_ELECTRICCURRANT_10_.en: {SAY:winnie} Indeed, its electrical power is most invigorating.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_ELECTRICCURRANT_10_.zh: {SAY:winnie}的确如此，它的电能最为振奋人心。

NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_ELECTRICCURRANT_10_.en: {SAY:winnie}It will make an excellent addition to our collection.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_ELECTRICCURRANT_10_.zh: {SAY:winnie}它将成为我们收藏品中最璀璨的那颗明星。

NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_ELECTRICCURRANT_1_I.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Alert, User Dave! My batteries are losing power.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_ELECTRICCURRANT_1_I.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}警告，用户戴夫！我的蓄电池正在流失电量。

NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_ELECTRICCURRANT_1_I.en: {SAY:crazydave}But you need power to roll your windows up and down!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_ELECTRICCURRANT_1_I.zh: {SAY:crazydave}可是你需要电量来维持电动车窗的起落啊！

NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_ELECTRICCURRANT_1_I.en: {SAY:winnie}Correct. Perhaps some electrical plants can restore my charge.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_ELECTRICCURRANT_1_I.zh: {SAY:winnie}正确。也许一些电系植物能够帮我重新充能。

NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_ELECTRICCURRANT_1_I.en: {SAY:crazydave}That's so plausible, it just might work!

NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_ELECTRICCURRANT_2_I.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}I have detected an Electric Currant plant, User Dave.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_ELECTRICCURRANT_2_I.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}我刚刚探测到了一种名叫电流醋栗的植物，用户戴夫。

NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_ELECTRICCURRANT_2_I.en: {SAY:winnie}Two in the same row or column will create an electric field between them.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_ELECTRICCURRANT_2_I.zh: {SAY:winnie}位于同行或同排的两个电流醋栗之间会形成一处电场。

NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_ELECTRICCURRANT_2_I.en: {SAY:winnie}The field will damage zombies and recharge my batteries.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_ELECTRICCURRANT_2_I.zh: {SAY:winnie}电能伤害僵尸，亦可为我的蓄电池充电。

NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_ELECTRICCURRANT_4_I.en: {SAY:winnie}Use them to zap zombies with Electric Currant fields.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_ELECTRICCURRANT_4_I.zh: {SAY:winnie}利用它们的可移动的特性使电流红醋栗的电场把僵尸电得直哆嗦。
{SAY:crazydave}我想瓦特也会赞同这个主意！

NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_ELECTRICCURRANT_5_I.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}All this electricity makes my face-beard hurt! Can we stop for a beach break?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_ELECTRICCURRANT_5_I.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}这些电流把我脸上的大胡子都整得不像样了！我们能不能先在海滩上稍作休整？

NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_ELECTRICCURRANT_5_I.en: {SAY:winnie}Of course, User Dave. Prepare for Beach Party onslaught.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_ELECTRICCURRANT_5_I.zh: {SAY:winnie}当然，用户戴夫。为前来海滩度假的僵潮做准备吧。
{SAY:winnie}此处将有源源不断的香蕉配给。

NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_ELECTRICCURRANT_6_I.en: {SAY:winnie}They are charging nicely, User Dave, thank you for inquiring.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_ELECTRICCURRANT_6_I.zh: {SAY:winnie}充电情况良好，用户戴夫，感谢你为我寻找醋栗。
{SAY:crazydave}他们的电流栅栏的的确确展现了“库仑定律”的无比优越性！

NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_ELECTRICCURRANT_9_I.en: {SAY:winnie}When triggered they destroy plants and zombies alike.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_ELECTRICCURRANT_9_I.zh: {SAY:winnie}当它们被触发时将会毁灭途径的一切植物，僵尸也不例外！

NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_GEMJAM_10_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:crazydave}Those gems are so close I can smell 'em!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_GEMJAM_10_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:crazydave}钻石已经近在眼前了，我都能嗅到它们的香气了！

NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_GEMJAM_10_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:crazydave}就像春天弥漫着的醋栗花香一般！

NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_GEMJAM_1_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Attention, User Dave! I have audio-detected a large stash of zombie gems.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_GEMJAM_1_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}敬请留意，用户戴夫！我用无线电监测到僵尸在某处埋藏了大量钻石！

NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_GEMJAM_1_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:crazydave}你听到了游牧民族在藏东西，哈？

NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_GEMJAM_1_INTRO_3.en: {SAY:winnie}If we move swiftly, we may be able to claim them for our own.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_GEMJAM_1_INTRO_3.zh: {SAY:winnie}如果我们的行动足够迅速，就可以将他们据为己有。

NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_GEMJAM_6_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}The zombies are aware of our gem quest, User Dave.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_GEMJAM_6_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}僵尸已经察觉到我们对钻石的探寻了，用户戴夫。

NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_GEMJAM_6_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:winnie}They intend to attack us from the sea.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_GEMJAM_6_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}他们企图从海里踩着浪袭击我们。

NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_GEMJAM_6_INTRO_3.en: {SAY:crazydave}We'll sea about that! Bowling Bulbs, LET'S ROLL!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_GEMJAM_6_INTRO_3.zh: {SAY:crazydave}我们当然能“猜”到他们的意图了！保龄泡泡，一起“滚”吧！

NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_GOLDBLOOM_1_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}我闻到了羽毛与电流的气息！

NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_GOLDBLOOM_1_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:winnie}My sensors register a plant lost in time.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_GOLDBLOOM_1_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}我的传感器显示，一株植物迷失在了时间漩涡中。

NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_GOLDBLOOM_1_INTRO_3.zh: {SAY:crazydave}我嗅到了营救与柑橘的气息！

NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_GOLDBLOOM_2_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Our missing plant is the Gold Bloom, User Dave.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_GOLDBLOOM_2_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}我们丢失的植物叫做黄金蓓蕾，用户戴夫。

NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_GOLDBLOOM_2_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:winnie}It produces an immediate bounty of sun when planted!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_GOLDBLOOM_2_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}它被种下之后，将会瞬间生产大量阳光！

NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_GOLDBLOOM_2_INTRO_3.en: {SAY:crazydave}Instant sun? Not good enough! MUST GO FASTER!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_GOLDBLOOM_2_INTRO_3.zh: {SAY:crazydave}瞬间产生大量阳光？依然不够完美！它的冷却还可以再快一点！

NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_GOLDBLOOM_2_OUTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}The Gold Bloom is unstuck in time, User Dave.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_GOLDBLOOM_2_OUTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}黄金花已经逃脱时空的禁锢，用户戴夫。

NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_GOLDBLOOM_2_OUTRO_2.en: {SAY:winnie}Luckily I can track it whenever it goes.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_GOLDBLOOM_2_OUTRO_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}幸运的是，我可以跟踪到它前往的时间线。

NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_GOLDBLOOM_7_OUTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}We did it! I am a hero to all plants!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_GOLDBLOOM_7_OUTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}我们做到了！我是植物的大救星！

NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_GOLDBLOOM_7_OUTRO_2.en: {SAY:winnie}I am concerned about the strange portals we encountered, User Dave.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_GOLDBLOOM_7_OUTRO_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}我担心的是先前遇到的那些放出不同僵尸的古怪时空裂缝，用户戴夫。

NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_GOLDBLOOM_7_OUTRO_3.en: {SAY:winnie} I believe some unfortunate chicanery may be afoot.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_GOLDBLOOM_7_OUTRO_3.zh: {SAY:winnie} 我坚信某人仍在尝试实施那些尚未成功的阴谋诡计。

NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_ZOMBIESCALING_01_IN.en: {SAY:winnie}We've traveled back before the age of Power Plants.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_ZOMBIESCALING_01_IN.zh: {SAY:winnie}我们回到了还没有植物升级的时代。

NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_ZOMBIESCALING_01_IN.en: {SAY:winnie}Any plants we choose will be at Level 1 while we're here.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_ZOMBIESCALING_01_IN.zh: {SAY:winnie}我们在此时空选择的任何植物都将会是 1 级。

NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_ZOMBIESCALING_02_IN.en: {SAY:winnie}My sensors detect that we are stuck in a time loop.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_ZOMBIESCALING_02_IN.zh: {SAY:winnie}我的传感器显示，我们深陷于时空的轮回之中。

NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_ZOMBIESCALING_02_IN.en: {SAY:winnie}The zombies we faced the first time have had their strength boosted!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_ZOMBIESCALING_02_IN.zh: {SAY:winnie}我们先前碰到的僵尸已经在体格上获得了强化。

NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_ZOMBIESCALING_02_IN.en: {SAY:winnie}As these boosts escalate, the zombie threat may soon be insurmountable.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_ZOMBIESCALING_02_IN.zh: {SAY:winnie}照着这样下去，僵尸引起的威胁将很快变得难以克服。

NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_ZOMBIESCALING_02_IN.en: {EXCITED:crazydave}Ooo, I want to see how far we can get!

NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_ZOMBIESCALING_10_OU.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}Woo! We made it all the way to the end!
{SAY:winnie}I honestly did not expect us to get this far.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_ZOMBIESCALING_10_OU.zh: {SAY:winnie}说真的，我未曾想过我们能走的这么远。

NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_ZOMBIESCALING_10_OU.en: {PLAYFUL:winnie}I underestimated the strength of some of our plants!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_ZOMBIESCALING_10_OU.zh: {PLAYFUL:winnie}看来是我低估植物的实力了。
{EXCITED:crazydave}或许只是因为我们就是那么棒！

NARRATIVE_ESCAPEROOT_LOD_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Tap the Escape Root, then tap another plant, to make them switch places.
NARRATIVE_ESCAPEROOT_LOD_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}轻点逃脱树根，再轻点另外一株植物，即可让它们交换位置。

NARRATIVE_ESCAPEROOT_LOD_2.en: {SAY:winnie}Escape Root explodes when a zombie gets close.
NARRATIVE_ESCAPEROOT_LOD_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}当僵尸接近时，逃脱树根将会爆炸。

NARRATIVE_EVENTS_POWERTILE_TUTORIAL_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}If you use Plant Food on plant on a Power Tile, all plants on tiles of that color will get Plant Food.
NARRATIVE_EVENTS_POWERTILE_TUTORIAL_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}给能量地砖上的植物施放叶绿素，相同颜色地砖上的植物都能获得叶绿素效果。

NARRATIVE_EVENT_BEGHOULED_BEYOND_001_INT.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}The Kiwibeast becomes larger and more powerful the more damage it takes.
NARRATIVE_EVENT_BEGHOULED_BEYOND_001_INT.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}野兽猕猴桃受到更多伤害时，就会变得更大更强力。

NARRATIVE_EXPLODEOVINE_EQ_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Plant Explode-O-Vines alone or on other plants to explode and knock back zombies.
NARRATIVE_EXPLODEOVINE_EQ_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}单独种植爆炸藤蔓或种在其他植物上，即可爆炸并击退僵尸。

NARRATIVE_FALLHARVEST102_2.en: {SAY:winnie}It is when the sun crosses the celestial equator.
NARRATIVE_FALLHARVEST102_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}秋分是太阳穿过天分赤道的时候。

NARRATIVE_FALLHARVEST103_2.en: {SAY:zombossicon}With emotion I have put a plan in motion!
NARRATIVE_FALLHARVEST103_2.zh: {SAY:zombossicon}随着我满腔的激动，一项计划已然启动！

NARRATIVE_FALLHARVEST103_4.en: {SAY:zombossicon}...and your harvest shall be bitter indeed!
NARRATIVE_FALLHARVEST103_4.zh: {SAY:zombossicon}而你所收获的果实，将只剩苦涩！

NARRATIVE_FALLHARVEST105_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}潘妮，给我介绍一下苹果迫击炮呗！

NARRATIVE_FALLHARVEST105_2.en: {SAY:winnie}Applemortar lobs apple cores that damage and stun zombies across three lanes.
NARRATIVE_FALLHARVEST105_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}苹果迫击炮可以投掷苹果核眩晕三条路上的僵尸。

NARRATIVE_FALLHARVEST106_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}I think I'm falling for Applemortar, Penny!
NARRATIVE_FALLHARVEST106_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}潘妮，我真的要爱上苹果迫击炮了！

NARRATIVE_FALLHARVEST106_3.en: {SAY:crazydave}Do you think there's a chance they'd go with me to the Fall Dance?
NARRATIVE_FALLHARVEST106_3.zh: {SAY:crazydave}你觉得他们会不会愿意和我一起去参加秋季舞会？

NARRATIVE_FALLHARVEST107_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}潘妮，苹果迫击炮给我回消息了！

NARRATIVE_FALLHARVEST107_2.zh: {SAY:crazydave}“现在不方便回你，我正忙着投苹果核呢。”

NARRATIVE_FALLHARVEST107_3.zh: {SAY:crazydave}你觉得他们会不会对我也有感觉？

NARRATIVE_FALLHARVEST107_4.en: {SAY:winnie}I think harvest season may be affecting your brain, User Dave.
NARRATIVE_FALLHARVEST107_4.zh: {SAY:winnie}我想丰收季可能已经影响到你的脑子了，用户戴夫。

NARRATIVE_FALLHARVEST108_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}Ha har ha! My plan proceeds apace, Foolish Dave!
NARRATIVE_FALLHARVEST108_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}哈哈哈，我的计划进展十分乐观，呆夫！

NARRATIVE_FALLHARVEST108_2.zh: {SAY:zombossicon}不久，你就会尝到你所丰收到的果实…

NARRATIVE_FALLHARVEST108_4.en: {SAY:zombossicon}Yes, I know I said "bitter harvest" before.
NARRATIVE_FALLHARVEST108_4.zh: {SAY:zombossicon}对，我知道自己之前已经诅咒过你“丰收的果实会很苦涩”了。

NARRATIVE_FALLHARVEST108_5.zh: {SAY:zombossicon}但谁让我是大魔王呢！咬我啊！

NARRATIVE_FALLHARVEST109_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Dr. Zomboss. You must cease blasting User Dave with your emotion ray.
NARRATIVE_FALLHARVEST109_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}僵王博士，你必须停止使用情绪光线照射用户戴夫。

NARRATIVE_FALLHARVEST109_2.en: {NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}But I... how did you deduce my plan?
NARRATIVE_FALLHARVEST109_2.zh: {NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}但是……你是怎么推断出我的计划的？

NARRATIVE_FALLHARVEST109_4.en: {SAY:winnie}You hit "Reply All" on your planning e-mail.
NARRATIVE_FALLHARVEST109_4.zh: {SAY:winnie}你在发送你的计划邮件时，误点成“发送给所有人”按钮了。

NARRATIVE_FALLHARVEST110_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}User Dave, I have sabotaged Dr. Zomboss' emotion ray.
NARRATIVE_FALLHARVEST110_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}用户戴夫，我已经成功破坏掉僵王博士的情绪光线了。

NARRATIVE_FALLHARVEST110_2.en: {SAY:crazydave}I feel... different! I don't love Applemortar any more.
NARRATIVE_FALLHARVEST110_2.zh: {SAY:crazydave}我感觉……如获新生！我现在不爱苹果迫击炮了。

NARRATIVE_FALLHARVEST110_3.en: {SAY:crazydave}I mean, I'm not IN love with them. We're still great friends!
NARRATIVE_FALLHARVEST110_3.zh: {SAY:crazydave}我的意思是……我不“爱”他们了。但我们的友爱还是在的！

NARRATIVE_FALLHARVEST110_4.zh: {SAY:crazydave}不过，恋爱那酸酸甜甜的感觉，真是让人怀念啊。

NARRATIVE_FALLHARVEST110_5.en: {SAY:winnie}I am sorry, User Dave. It was necessary, albeit melancholy. Just like autumn.
NARRATIVE_FALLHARVEST110_5.zh: {SAY:winnie}很抱歉，用户戴夫。虽然可能会让你难过，但我必须这么做。就像秋天一样，致郁如此，但每年都必将经历。

NARRATIVE_FALLHARVEST110_6.en: {NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}Wait... do either of you have Applemortar's number? They're dreamy!
NARRATIVE_FALLHARVEST110_6.zh: {NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}等等，你俩谁有苹果迫击炮的电话号码吗？他们肯定会是我的梦中情人！

NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2022_11_2.en: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}No! Wall-Nut defeat is the key to victory!
NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2022_11_2.zh: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}不行！必须要让坚果墙失败，这是我胜利的关键！

NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2022_12_3.en: {NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_EXIT:wallnut}{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}You haven’t won, Wall-Nut! This is a temporary setback! I’ll be back!
NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2022_12_3.zh: {NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_EXIT:wallnut}{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}你才没有赢呢，坚果墙！我只是暂时遇到了些挫折！我一定会回来的！

NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2022_1_2.en: {SAY:crazydave}What time of the year is it?

NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2022_1_3.en: {SAY:winnie}I believe people call this “sweater weather,” User Dave.
NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2022_1_3.zh: {SAY:winnie}人们好像称其为“穿毛衣的时节”，用户戴夫。

NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2022_2_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}Havoc awaits these plants! I’m going to ruin their Feastivus with the Nutcracker Zombie!
NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2022_2_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}这些植物的浩劫就要来了！我要用胡桃夹子僵尸摧毁它们的仲冬圣诞！

NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2022_2_3.en: {SAY:zombossicon}I will unravel your sweaters one thread at a time! Fools!
NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2022_2_3.zh: {SAY:zombossicon}我会一根一根地把你们的毛衣拆掉！蠢蛋！

NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2022_3_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:wallnut}{NPC_ENTER:sunflower_r}{SAY:wallnut}I’m the weak link in the defense. If Zomboss wins, it’ll be because of me.
NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2022_3_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:wallnut}{NPC_ENTER:sunflower_r}{SAY:wallnut}我是草坪防线的薄弱点。僵王要是赢了，那都是我的错。

NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2022_3_2.en: {SAY:sunflower_r}Chin up, Wall-Nut. You’re a strong nut. Key to our defense.
NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2022_3_2.zh: {SAY:sunflower_r}别这样想，坚果墙。你是坚强的坚果墙，我们防御体系的关键。

NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2022_3_3.en: {SAY:wallnut}Hero plants have a uniform. Why don’t I? It’s ‘cause I’m weak.
NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2022_3_3.zh: {SAY:wallnut}英雄植物都有自己的制服。我为什么没有？就是因为我太弱了。

NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2022_4_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:sunflower}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:sunflower}We’ve got to cheer up, Wall-Nut. We’ll lose without him!
NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2022_4_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:sunflower}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:sunflower}我们必须让坚果墙振作起来。没有他，我们必输无疑！

NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2022_4_2.en: {SAY:winnie}I will pass this message to all of the plants, Sunflower.
NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2022_4_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}我会把这个消息传给所有植物的，向日葵。

NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2022_5_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:wallnut_r}{NPC_ENTER:sunflower}{SAY:wallnut_r}僵王博士无时无刻不在变得更加强大！

NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2022_5_2.zh: {SAY:sunflower}他可是不死大军里最危险的。

NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2022_5_3.en: {SAY:wallnut_r}I’m afraid of what he will do next.
NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2022_5_3.zh: {SAY:wallnut_r}好担心他接下来会做些什么。

NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2022_6_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}My data shows me that Wall-Nut is sad.
NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2022_6_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}我的数据表明坚果墙很难过。

NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2022_6_3.en: {NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:sunflower}{SAY:sunflower}What if we made something special to cheer him up?
NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2022_6_3.zh: {NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:sunflower}{SAY:sunflower}要不我们做些特别的东西让他开心？

NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2022_7_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:wallnut}{SAY:wallnut}Good luck on this level. I wish I could help you.
NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2022_7_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:wallnut}{SAY:wallnut}祝你这关好运。真希望我能帮到你。

NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2022_7_2.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Historical data shows us that Wall-Nut is in fact very useful.
NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2022_7_2.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}历史数据表明，坚果墙实际上非常有用。

NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2022_8_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:sunflower}{SAY:sunflower}仲冬圣诞是亲朋好友相聚的日子。

NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2022_8_3.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:crazydave}还有毛衣。有人说这是穿毛衣的时节。

NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2022_9_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:crazydave}I think this costume won’t fit anyone but you?
NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2022_9_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:crazydave}这套衣服好像是为你量身定制的呢？

NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2022_9_3.en: {SAY:wallnut_r}I am undefeatable! All of my legs! Mechanical!
NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2022_9_3.zh: {SAY:wallnut_r}我无敌了！我的腿又齐了！我无与伦比的机蟹腿！

NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2023_10_2.en: {NPC_EXIT:sunflower}{NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:peashooter}What a wonderful Feastivus! Wall-nut wins a gold medal...
NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2023_10_2.zh: {NPC_EXIT:sunflower}{NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:peashooter}仲冬圣诞真是美好啊！坚果墙赢得了一枚金牌…

NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2023_10_3.en: {SAY:peashooter}And Zomboss is left with coal again!
NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2023_10_3.zh: {SAY:peashooter}而僵王嘛，抱点黑炭回家取暖吧！

NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2023_10_4.en: {SAY:zomboss_r}Grrr... this is not the last you have seen of me. We will conquer the Z.O.M.B.I.E!
NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2023_10_4.zh: {SAY:zomboss_r}咯额额……我们还会再见面的。我们将称霸“尸山雪海”赛！

NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2023_10_5.en: {NPC_EXIT:peashooter}{NPC_ENTER:wallnut}{SAY:wallnut}I love sliding with those Bobsled dudes! They are so easy to beat!
NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2023_10_5.zh: {NPC_EXIT:peashooter}{NPC_ENTER:wallnut}{SAY:wallnut}好喜欢和那些雪橇队僵尸一起滑冰啊！想赢他们简直太轻松了！

NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2023_10_6.en: {SHOUT:zomboss_r}Darn you and your smooth sliding shell!
NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2023_10_6.zh: {SHOUT:zomboss_r}你，还有你那光滑的外壳，可真该死啊！
