NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2023_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}Ahh, the perfect ground to start our training for the Z.O.M.B.I.E!
NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2023_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}啊，终于找到合适的地方来为“尸山雪海”做训练了！

NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2023_1_3.en: {SAY:peashooter_r}Looks like Zomboss wants to train how to be a... Zombie? He is off his gourd!
NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2023_1_3.zh: {SAY:peashooter_r}僵王好像想训练什么……“尸山血海”？他是“枫”了吧！

NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2023_1_4.en: {NPC_EXIT:peashooter_r}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}I was talking to my Bobsled Crew you insolent weeds!
NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2023_1_4.zh: {NPC_EXIT:peashooter_r}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}我在跟我的雪橇队队员说话，你们这帮野草有没有礼貌啊！

NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2023_1_5.en: {SAY:sunflower}Those old hacks?! I thought they retired. What even is the Z.O.M.B.I.E?
NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2023_1_5.zh: {SAY:sunflower}故技重施？！ 我还以为它们都退休了呢。而且“尸山血海”是啥？

NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2023_1_6.en: {SAY:zomboss_r}Its the Zonal Olympiad of Mountainous Bobsledding Invitational Event!
NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2023_1_6.zh: {SAY:zomboss_r}是“僵尸山地雪橇海选奥林匹克区域邀请赛”！

NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2023_1_8.en: {SAY:sunflower}You're such a dweeb, Zomboss. Good 'ol Spikeweed will take care of them.
NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2023_1_8.zh: {SAY:sunflower}你真是“椿”到家了，僵王。我们也故技重施，让地刺草来就能轻松处理了。

NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2023_2_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}增援部队抵达战场。欢迎爆冰槲寄生。

NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2023_2_3.en: {SAY:winnie}Missile Toe appears to suffer from acute Shyness.

NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2023_2_4.en: {SAY:sunflower}HA! Doesn't matter, all you have to do is aim at their toes!
NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2023_2_4.zh: {SAY:sunflower}哈！没关系，你只需要朝着僵尸“爆冰”就行了！

NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2023_3_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}The Bobsled crew training is getting on quite smoothly...
NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2023_3_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}雪橇队队员们的训练井然有序…

NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2023_3_2.en: {SAY:zomboss_r}That Z.O.M.B.I.E gold medal is all but ours!
NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2023_3_2.zh: {SAY:zomboss_r}“尸山雪海”赛的金牌，舍我其谁！

NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2023_3_3.en: {NPC_ENTER:iceburg}{SAY:iceburg}They've been coasting so far, time to turn up the heat!
NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2023_3_3.zh: {NPC_ENTER:iceburg}{SAY:iceburg}它们训练得太舒服了，该上上强度了！

NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2023_3_4.en: {SAY:iceburg}Say hello to my fiery little friend, Jalapeno.
NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2023_3_4.zh: {SAY:iceburg}和我热情似火的朋友——火爆辣椒打声招呼吧。

NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2023_4_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:wallnut}{SAY:wallnut}绝望，又是那些胡桃夹子僵尸！

NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2023_4_2.en: {SAY:wallnut}Help me, oh spirits of my ancestors!
NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2023_4_2.zh: {SAY:wallnut}先祖神灵，请从天界下凡佑护我吧！

NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2023_4_3.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Calling in the Holy order of the Holly Knights. Please stand by.
NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2023_4_3.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}正在呼叫冬青屏障，从天空下落进行保护。请稍侯。

NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2023_5_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}I will have a surprise for you plants soon...
NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2023_5_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}我给你们植物准备了一些惊喜礼物…

NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2023_5_2.en: {SAY:zomboss_r}A sweet treat for letting Bobsled shred up your lawn for practice. Muahahaha!
NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2023_5_2.zh: {SAY:zomboss_r}牺牲自己的草坪，帮我的雪橇队做足练习，准备点好礼是应该的。木哈哈哈！

NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2023_5_3.en: {NPC_ENTER:wallnut}{SAY:wallnut}Oooo... I wonder what it will be.

NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2023_6_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}Are you ready for your sweet surprise, plants?
NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2023_6_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}准备好接收你们的礼物了吗，植物们？

NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2023_6_2.zh: {SAY:zomboss_r}答案揭晓！是蛋糕（坦克）……木哈哈哈！

NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2023_7_2.en: {SAY:zomboss_r}My Bobsled Crew will soon have conquered the Z.O.M.B.I.E Finals!
NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2023_7_2.zh: {SAY:zomboss_r}我的雪橇车小队马上就称霸“尸山雪海”总决赛了！

NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2023_7_3.en: {SAY:zomboss_r}Once and for all confirming Zombie Athletic superiority!
NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2023_7_3.zh: {SAY:zomboss_r}一举证明僵尸运动员亘古不变的优越性！

NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2023_7_4.en: {SAY:sunflower}So says you Zomboss... hehehe. Am I right, Wall-nut?
NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2023_7_4.zh: {SAY:sunflower}你说是就是吧，僵王……呵呵呵。你觉得呢，坚果墙？

NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2023_8_2.en: {SAY:sunflower}What's wrong, Zomboss? Lose a final or something?
NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2023_8_2.zh: {SAY:sunflower}怎么了，僵王？你不会总决赛输了吧？

NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2023_8_3.en: {SAY:zomboss_r}I know it was that pesky Wall-nut behind it all!
NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2023_8_3.zh: {SAY:zomboss_r}我就知道是那颗讨厌的坚果墙在捣鬼！

NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2023_8_4.en: {SAY:sunflower}I don't know what you're talking about.

NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2023_8_5.en: {SAY:sunflower}I heard that a smooth, mustachioed, walnut shaped thing won the Z.O.M.B.I.E.
NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2023_8_5.zh: {SAY:sunflower}我只听说，一颗光滑、留着胡子，形状长得像坚果的东西赢得了“尸山雪海”赛。

NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2023_8_7.en: {SAY:zomboss_r}You pushed my Bobsled crew back into retirement you cretin!
NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2023_8_7.zh: {SAY:zomboss_r}你们又把我的雪橇队逼退休了，你们这群白痴！

NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2023_8_8.en: {SAY:zomboss_r}There will be a reckoning for this!
NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2023_8_8.zh: {SAY:zomboss_r}早晚我会和你们全数清算的！

NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2023_9_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}你们种下的恶果，现在成熟了！

NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2023_9_2.en: {SAY:zomboss_r}I will use my Zombot to usher in a new Ice Age!
NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2023_9_2.zh: {SAY:zomboss_r}我要用我的僵尸机器人，构筑一个新的冰河世纪！

NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2024_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}The holiday season is upon us User Dave, shall we begin the party?
NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2024_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}圣诞季近在咫尺，用户戴夫，要开始派对吗？

NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2024_1_2.zh: {SAY:crazydave}圣诞派对让我感觉有点幽闭恐惧。

NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2024_1_3.en: {SAY:winnie}It will be in the lawn User Dave, in the open.
NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2024_1_3.zh: {SAY:winnie}开在草坪上，用户戴夫，在户外。

NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2024_1_4.en: {NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:wallnut}{SAY:wallnut}I brought marshmallows for roasting everyone. Time for some s'mores.
NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2024_1_4.zh: {NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:wallnut}{SAY:wallnut}我带了些棉花糖，大家一起来烤吧。来吃点烤棉花糖。

NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2024_1_5.en: {NPC_EXIT:wallnut}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}Ho ho ho! A party without my chilling presence?
NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2024_1_5.zh: {NPC_EXIT:wallnut}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}嚯嚯嚯！派对，怎能没有我来冷冷场？

NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2024_1_6.en: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:peashooter}Learn to enjoy the holidays and stop being a grinch.

NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2024_1_7.en: {SAY:zomboss_r}Oh enjoy I will, watching my zombies ruin your holiday spirits. Minions!!!!
NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2024_1_7.zh: {SAY:zomboss_r}哦，看我的僵尸毁掉你吗的圣诞精神一定很享受。小的们!!!!

NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2024_2_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:iceburg}{SAY:iceburg}Looks like your evil plans were cooled off pretty quickly, eh Zomboss?
NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2024_2_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:iceburg}{SAY:iceburg}看来你的邪恶计划一下就凉透了，是吧僵王？

NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2024_2_2.en: {NPC_ENTER:sunflower_r}{SAY:sunflower_r}I think you said it too soon my friend, Zomboss seems to be unfazed.
NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2024_2_2.zh: {NPC_ENTER:sunflower_r}{SAY:sunflower_r}你说的好像太早了，朋友——僵王好像不为所动。

NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2024_2_3.en: {NPC_EXIT:iceburg}{NPC_EXIT:sunflower_r}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}Didn't mean to give you the cold shoulder...

NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2024_2_4.en: {SAY:zomboss_r}...mind you wretched plants, I will have the final sleigh.
NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2024_2_4.zh: {SAY:zomboss_r}..…记住你们这些卑劣的植物，最后的雪橇在我手上。

NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2024_3_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:iceburg_r}{NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:peashooter}Zomboss is up to no good this time as well. We need to be on alert.
NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2024_3_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:iceburg_r}{NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:peashooter}僵王又在想坏点子了。我们要小心。

NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2024_3_2.en: {SAY:iceburg_r}I am here to put those zombies on ice and keep things cool and frosty.
NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2024_3_2.zh: {SAY:iceburg_r}我来让这些僵尸如履薄冰，让局面冰霜般镇定。

NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2024_3_3.en: {NPC_EXIT:iceburg_r}{NPC_EXIT:peashooter}{NPC_ENTER:wallnut}{SAY:wallnut}Alright, I am ready for seconds. Has anyone seen my roasting stick?
NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2024_3_3.zh: {NPC_EXIT:iceburg_r}{NPC_EXIT:peashooter}{NPC_ENTER:wallnut}{SAY:wallnut}好，我马上准备好。谁看到我的烤棉花糖棍了？

NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2024_3_4.en: {NPC_EXIT:wallnut}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}Back for more, are you? Prepare for the ultimate frozen fiasco!
NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2024_3_4.zh: {NPC_EXIT:wallnut}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}你们又回来自讨苦吃了，是吧？准备面对透心凉的惨败吧！

NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2024_3_5.en: {NPC_EXIT:zomboss_r}{NPC_ENTER:iceburg_r}{SAY:iceburg_r}Here we go again, this time we will melt your plans away. Bring it on!
NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2024_3_5.zh: {NPC_EXIT:zomboss_r}{NPC_ENTER:iceburg_r}{SAY:iceburg_r}我们又来了，这次我们会让你的计划融化为流水。放马过来吧！

NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2024_4_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}Curse you! I keep slipping up on this icy path.
NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2024_4_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}诅咒你们！这条冰道老是让我滑倒。

NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2024_4_2.en: {NPC_ENTER:sunflower}{SAY:sunflower}Hehehe, being naughty the whole year has its consequences eh, Zomboss.
NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2024_4_2.zh: {NPC_ENTER:sunflower}{SAY:sunflower}呵呵呵，淘气一整年是有后果的，是吧僵王。

NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2024_4_3.en: {NPC_EXIT:sunflower}{SAY:zomboss_r}Enjoy your fleeting victory, but I will be back with even colder plans.
NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2024_4_3.zh: {NPC_EXIT:sunflower}{SAY:zomboss_r}享受你们那短暂的胜利吧，我会带着更冷酷的计划回来的。

NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2024_4_4.en: {NPC_EXIT:zomboss_r}{NPC_ENTER:wallnut}{SAY:wallnut}Umm Guys?! I think these are burnt. S'mores emergency here!
NARRATIVE_FEASTIVUS_LTE_2024_4_4.zh: {NPC_EXIT:zomboss_r}{NPC_ENTER:wallnut}{SAY:wallnut}额，兄弟们?! 这些好像烤糊了。烤出问题了！

NARRATIVE_FILAMINT_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Power Mints are powerful plants you can acquire through Arena mode.
NARRATIVE_FILAMINT_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}超能薄荷是一类强大的植物，你可以在竞技场模式获得它们。

NARRATIVE_FILAMINT_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:winnie}They provide a big boost to plants in their family.
NARRATIVE_FILAMINT_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}它们对相应家族的植物有巨大的增益作用。

NARRATIVE_FILAMINT_INTRO_3.en: {SAY:winnie}The Fila-mint Family is made up of electric plants.
NARRATIVE_FILAMINT_INTRO_3.zh: {SAY:winnie}白炽薄荷家族包括电系植物。

NARRATIVE_FILAMINT_INTRO_4.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:crazydave}Sorry I'm late, what did I miss? Mint sauce?
NARRATIVE_FILAMINT_INTRO_4.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:crazydave}啊！抱歉，我来晚了。我错过了什么？你们刚刚是在聊薄荷酱之类的吗？

NARRATIVE_FOODFIGHT101_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}也许我的计划有点太复杂了！

NARRATIVE_FOODFIGHT101_3.zh: {SAY:zombossicon}也许越简单的策略，效果越好！

NARRATIVE_FOODFIGHT102_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}I'm glad we prepared for Food Fight, Penny!
NARRATIVE_FOODFIGHT102_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}还好我们已经为这次食物大战做好准备了，潘妮！

NARRATIVE_FOODFIGHT103_2.en: {SAY:crazydave}I could eat six dozen of them right now!
NARRATIVE_FOODFIGHT103_2.zh: {SAY:crazydave}我现在能一口气吃下七十只火鸡！

NARRATIVE_FOODFIGHT103_3.en: {SAY:crazydave}Seven if you put 'em in a taco!
NARRATIVE_FOODFIGHT103_3.zh: {SAY:crazydave}如果把它们放在玉米卷里，我能吃下八十只！

NARRATIVE_FOODFIGHT104_3.zh: {SAY:crazydave}后院的泳池都要被我的口水装满了！

NARRATIVE_FOODFIGHT105_3.zh: {SAY:zombossicon}吐绶鸡就是火鸡的学术称呼啦！

NARRATIVE_FOODFIGHT106_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}Yesterday's turkey assault has me quaking, Penny!
NARRATIVE_FOODFIGHT106_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}昨天火鸡的进攻简直恐怖得令我发抖，潘妮！

NARRATIVE_FOODFIGHT106_3.en: {SAY:winnie}The lawn was thick with wattles and snoods.
NARRATIVE_FOODFIGHT106_3.zh: {SAY:winnie}地上到处都是他们嘴下方的红色肉瓣。

NARRATIVE_FOODFIGHT107_2.en: {SAY:crazydave}In the other corner: MILLIONS OF TURKEYS!!!

NARRATIVE_FOODFIGHT107_3.en: {SAY:crazydave}Who will win? HOW WILL THEY TASTE?
NARRATIVE_FOODFIGHT107_3.zh: {SAY:crazydave}谁会是最终的赢家？而他们尝起来的味道又如何？

NARRATIVE_FOODFIGHT108_2.en: {SAY:crazydave}Good thing Sweet Potato is here to sweep 'em up into her lane!
NARRATIVE_FOODFIGHT108_2.zh: {SAY:crazydave}好在我们有甜薯，她可以吸引火鸡们到她的那行去！

NARRATIVE_FOODFIGHT108_3.en: {SAY:winnie}Thank you for the useful --if delayed-- reminder of Sweet Potato's function, User Dave.
NARRATIVE_FOODFIGHT108_3.zh: {SAY:winnie}谢谢你（这么晚）给我们科普甜薯的功能，用户戴夫。

NARRATIVE_FOODFIGHT109_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:crazydave}C'mon, Dr. Zomboss, can't we cease conflict for one day?
NARRATIVE_FOODFIGHT109_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:crazydave}害，僵王博士，我们难道就不能和平共处一天吗？

NARRATIVE_FOODFIGHT109_4.en: {NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}Bah! You shall bear witness to my grandest creation!
NARRATIVE_FOODFIGHT109_4.zh: {NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}呸！等着吧，你将见证我最伟大的造物！

NARRATIVE_FOODFIGHT110_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}I ate so much turkey yesterday, Penny!
NARRATIVE_FOODFIGHT110_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}潘妮，我昨天吃了一大堆火鸡呢！

NARRATIVE_FOODFIGHT110_2.en: {SAY:crazydave}After we handle today's turkeys, let's go buy stuff for drastically reduced prices!
NARRATIVE_FOODFIGHT110_2.zh: {SAY:crazydave}等我们处理完今天的火鸡，就去大减价买东西吧！

NARRATIVE_FOODFIGHT110_3.en: {SAY:winnie}I salute your economic wisdom, User Dave.
NARRATIVE_FOODFIGHT110_3.zh: {SAY:winnie}我向你的经济头脑致敬，用户戴夫。

NARRATIVE_FOODFIGHT111_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}There shall be a brief pause in the turkey assault.
NARRATIVE_FOODFIGHT111_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}火鸡大军的进攻会暂时歇息一段时间。

NARRATIVE_FOODFIGHT111_2.zh: {SAY:zombossicon}在此之后，你们必将臣服于它们的爪下。

NARRATIVE_FOODFIGHT111_3.en: {SAY:zombossicon}Overwhelmed by turkeys in even greater numbers!

NARRATIVE_FOODFIGHT112_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}Dr. Zomboss keeps throwing turkeys at us, Penny!
NARRATIVE_FOODFIGHT112_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}潘妮，僵王博士在一直向我们扔火鸡呢！

NARRATIVE_FOODFIGHT112_2.en: {SAY:winnie}Correct, User Dave. He has become a one-note threat, easily predicted.
NARRATIVE_FOODFIGHT112_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}是的，用户戴夫。他现在已经江郎才尽了，我很轻松就能预测他之后的行动。

NARRATIVE_FOODFIGHT112_4.en: {SAY:zombossicon}You fail to see the subtleties in my symphony of turkey triumph!
NARRATIVE_FOODFIGHT112_4.zh: {SAY:zombossicon}你没有听出我的火鸡胜利交响曲中的微妙之处！

NARRATIVE_FOODFIGHT113_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}After we fight off a bunch of turkeys today, Penny...
NARRATIVE_FOODFIGHT113_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}等我们打败今日份的火鸡，潘妮…

NARRATIVE_FOODFIGHT113_2.en: {SAY:crazydave}Do you want to go shopping for discounted consumer electronics?
NARRATIVE_FOODFIGHT113_2.zh: {SAY:crazydave}你想不想去买一些打折的消费电子品呀？

NARRATIVE_FOODFIGHT113_4.en: {SAY:winnie}I have prepared a detailed list of microchips and speaker components for us to acquire.
NARRATIVE_FOODFIGHT113_4.zh: {SAY:winnie}我为我们需要的微芯片和扬声器组件列了一份详细的清单。

NARRATIVE_FOODFIGHT_LTE_2022_11_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}You haven't seen the last of me!
NARRATIVE_FOODFIGHT_LTE_2022_11_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}你们还没见过我的真实面目！

NARRATIVE_FOODFIGHT_LTE_2022_11_2.zh: {NPC_ENTER:sunflower}{SAY:sunflower}可是我们要举办食物大战哦！

NARRATIVE_FOODFIGHT_LTE_2022_11_3.en: {SAY:zombossicon}I’m giving a speech! Let me finish! I’ll take you all down!
NARRATIVE_FOODFIGHT_LTE_2022_11_3.zh: {SAY:zombossicon}我在发表演讲呢！别插嘴！不然我把你们全部拿下！

NARRATIVE_FOODFIGHT_LTE_2022_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:wallnut}{SAY:wallnut}This is a lot of food. How many people are coming to this Food Fight?
NARRATIVE_FOODFIGHT_LTE_2022_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:wallnut}{SAY:wallnut}好多食物哦。这次食物大战有多少人会来呢？

NARRATIVE_FOODFIGHT_LTE_2022_2_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}是的，用户戴夫。那是火鸡投手。

NARRATIVE_FOODFIGHT_LTE_2022_2_3.en: {SAY:crazydave}Nice to meet you! Do you have a taco?

NARRATIVE_FOODFIGHT_LTE_2022_3_2.en: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}Not nearly enough to foil my plans!
NARRATIVE_FOODFIGHT_LTE_2022_3_2.zh: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}就这并不足以让我的计划受挫！

NARRATIVE_FOODFIGHT_LTE_2022_4_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}I must take Wall-Nut down! There’s a crack in his shell!
NARRATIVE_FOODFIGHT_LTE_2022_4_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}我必须得把坚果墙拿下！他这外强中干的外壳，定有我能利用的缝！

NARRATIVE_FOODFIGHT_LTE_2022_5_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:wallnut_r}{NPC_ENTER:sunflower}{SAY:sunflower}Whenever I see a lot of turkeys, I like to call up Lightning Reed.
NARRATIVE_FOODFIGHT_LTE_2022_5_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:wallnut_r}{NPC_ENTER:sunflower}{SAY:sunflower}我每次看到火鸡，就想给闪电芦苇打电话。

NARRATIVE_FOODFIGHT_LTE_2022_5_3.en: {SAY:sunflower}Zombie turkeys are a special kind of difficult, Wall-Nut.
NARRATIVE_FOODFIGHT_LTE_2022_5_3.zh: {SAY:sunflower}僵尸火鸡的危险程度可不一般，坚果墙。

NARRATIVE_FOODFIGHT_LTE_2022_6_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:crazydave}向日葵和流星花有什么关系吗？

NARRATIVE_FOODFIGHT_LTE_2022_6_2.en: {SAY:winnie}That is a surprisingly smart question, User Dave.
NARRATIVE_FOODFIGHT_LTE_2022_6_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}这问题很聪明呢，用户戴夫，都不像是你会问出来的。

NARRATIVE_FOODFIGHT_LTE_2022_6_4.en: {SAY:winnie}Confirmed. This is the User Dave we know.
NARRATIVE_FOODFIGHT_LTE_2022_6_4.zh: {SAY:winnie}已确认。是我们所熟悉的用户戴夫。

NARRATIVE_FOODFIGHT_LTE_2022_7_2.en: {SAY:winnie}That is correct. You are a force to be reckoned with.

NARRATIVE_FOODFIGHT_LTE_2022_8_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:winnie}My analysis tells me that you are winning this Food Fight.
NARRATIVE_FOODFIGHT_LTE_2022_8_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:winnie}我的分析表明，你们即将赢得这场食物大战。

NARRATIVE_FOODFIGHT_LTE_2022_8_2.en: {SAY:crazydave}Do we get a taco plate if we win?

NARRATIVE_FOODFIGHT_LTE_2023_1_4.en: {SAY:zomboss_r}I've made a new recipe and you are all the ingredients.
NARRATIVE_FOODFIGHT_LTE_2023_1_4.zh: {SAY:zomboss_r}我编写了一份新的食谱，而你们，都是原料。

NARRATIVE_FOODFIGHT_LTE_2023_2_2.zh: {SAY:nightcap_r}嘘！危险逼近。我们必须未雨绸缪。

NARRATIVE_FOODFIGHT_LTE_2023_2_3.en: {NPC_EXIT:nightcap_r}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}This experiemental turkey is made with 100% filler and preservitives.
NARRATIVE_FOODFIGHT_LTE_2023_2_3.zh: {NPC_EXIT:nightcap_r}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}此款试验品火鸡，包含 100% 填充物和防腐剂。

NARRATIVE_FOODFIGHT_LTE_2023_3_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}Muhahah! You've gather makings of a perfect salad here.
NARRATIVE_FOODFIGHT_LTE_2023_3_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}木哈哈！你们在此集结的样子，有如一盘完美的沙拉。

NARRATIVE_FOODFIGHT_LTE_2023_3_2.en: {SAY:zomboss_r}All that is missing is a just your BRAINZ!
NARRATIVE_FOODFIGHT_LTE_2023_3_2.zh: {SAY:zomboss_r}只可惜，上面还少了你们的脑子！

NARRATIVE_FOODFIGHT_LTE_2023_3_3.en: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:peashooter}You're not invited to this party Zomboss!
NARRATIVE_FOODFIGHT_LTE_2023_3_3.zh: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:peashooter}我们可没邀请你来参加这场派对，僵王！

NARRATIVE_FOODFIGHT_LTE_2023_4_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie_l}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave_r}{SAY:winnie_l}User Dave. You appear to be restless, how may I assist you?
NARRATIVE_FOODFIGHT_LTE_2023_4_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie_l}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave_r}{SAY:winnie_l}用户戴夫。你看起来有些焦躁不安，我能帮助你吗？

NARRATIVE_FOODFIGHT_LTE_2023_4_3.en: {SAY:winnie_l}My sensors may assist you in your search.
NARRATIVE_FOODFIGHT_LTE_2023_4_3.zh: {SAY:winnie_l}我的传感器或许可以帮助你寻找。

NARRATIVE_FOODFIGHT_LTE_2023_4_6.en: {SAY:winnie_l}(Sigh) My sensor is not calibrated for imaginary substances.
NARRATIVE_FOODFIGHT_LTE_2023_4_6.zh: {SAY:winnie_l}（叹气）我的传感器没有为虚构物质进行校准。

NARRATIVE_FOODFIGHT_LTE_2023_5_3.en: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}Ho Oh! You fools! It's you that have been back to the corner.
NARRATIVE_FOODFIGHT_LTE_2023_5_3.zh: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}吼吼！你们这群傻瓜！是你们给我腾位置才对。

NARRATIVE_FOODFIGHT_LTE_2023_5_4.en: {SAY:zomboss_r}I'll send you all to the kiddy table.

NARRATIVE_FOODFIGHT_LTE_2023_5_5.zh: {NPC_EXIT:zomboss_r}{SAY:peashooter}无论什么困难，我们都会从容应对。

NARRATIVE_FOODFIGHT_LTE_2023_6_2.en: {SAY:peashooter}You're artifical turkey is no match for us.
NARRATIVE_FOODFIGHT_LTE_2023_6_2.zh: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:peashooter}你的人造火鸡将根本不配与我们一战！

NARRATIVE_FOODFIGHT_LTE_2023_6_3.zh: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}你们这群傻瓜！只是你们自以为胜利了而已！

NARRATIVE_FOODFIGHT_LTE_2023_6_4.en: {SAY:zomboss_r}This isn't the end, next time we meet, you'll all be frozen. Muhahaha!
NARRATIVE_FOODFIGHT_LTE_2023_6_4.zh: {SAY:zomboss_r}还没结束呢，下次对阵，我要让你们如履薄冰。木哈哈哈！

NARRATIVE_FOODFIGHT_LTE_2023_6_5.en: {NPC_EXIT:zomboss_r}{NPC_ENTER:wallnut_r}{SAY:wallnut_r}It was a great day for a Food Fight!

NARRATIVE_FOODFIGHT_LTE_2024_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:chilibean}{SAY:chilibean}Gosh! My tummy is rumbling looking at this feast!
NARRATIVE_FOODFIGHT_LTE_2024_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:chilibean}{SAY:chilibean}天哪！这种盛宴，看得我肚子都咕咕叫了！

NARRATIVE_FOODFIGHT_LTE_2024_1_2.en: {NPC_ENTER:wallnut_r}{SAY:wallnut_r}This is nothing, I can handle this all by myself.

NARRATIVE_FOODFIGHT_LTE_2024_1_3.en: {NPC_EXIT:chilibean}{NPC_EXIT:wallnut_r}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}Did someone say feast? I am famished. Some brainz will be delightful.
NARRATIVE_FOODFIGHT_LTE_2024_1_3.zh: {NPC_EXIT:chilibean}{NPC_EXIT:wallnut_r}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}有人说盛宴？饿死我了。要是可以吃点脑子就好了。

NARRATIVE_FOODFIGHT_LTE_2024_1_4.en: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:peashooter}Were you even invited here Zomboss? This is a private event.
NARRATIVE_FOODFIGHT_LTE_2024_1_4.zh: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:peashooter}邀请你来了吗，僵王？这是可是私人活动。

NARRATIVE_FOODFIGHT_LTE_2024_1_5.en: {SAY:zomboss_r}Okay no more Dr. Nice Pie Zomboss, time to raid the buffet. Minions!
NARRATIVE_FOODFIGHT_LTE_2024_1_5.zh: {SAY:zomboss_r}好吧，僵乖王小博士下线，该入侵吃自助餐了。小的们！

NARRATIVE_FOODFIGHT_LTE_2024_2_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Dr. Zomboss' attempt to turn our feast into a food fright has been neutralised.
NARRATIVE_FOODFIGHT_LTE_2024_2_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}僵王博士把盛宴变成食物大战的企图已经化解了。

NARRATIVE_FOODFIGHT_LTE_2024_2_2.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:crazydave}What threat? Are the tacos running out? I was just getting in the zone.
NARRATIVE_FOODFIGHT_LTE_2024_2_2.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:crazydave}什么威胁？玉米卷要吃完了？我才刚进入状态呢。

NARRATIVE_FOODFIGHT_LTE_2024_2_3.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Astounding how you could consume eateries during all of this.
NARRATIVE_FOODFIGHT_LTE_2024_2_3.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}这边打仗你却还能这么吃，我挺吃惊的。

NARRATIVE_FOODFIGHT_LTE_2024_2_4.en: {NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}You may have turned my gourmet disaster into a fancy meal...
NARRATIVE_FOODFIGHT_LTE_2024_2_4.zh: {NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}你们可以把我的美味灾难变成可口佳肴…

NARRATIVE_FOODFIGHT_LTE_2024_2_5.en: {SAY:zomboss_r}...But next time, my minions will be the ones sealing the deal.
NARRATIVE_FOODFIGHT_LTE_2024_2_5.zh: {SAY:zomboss_r}...但下次，我的随从会是那个决定报价的人。

NARRATIVE_FUTURE_26_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}The future's not what it used to be! There's more of it!
NARRATIVE_FUTURE_26_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}未来不再像从前那样了！它延伸得更多了！

NARRATIVE_FUTURE_26_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:winnie}I believe zombies may be drawing strength from the time fissure, User Dave.
NARRATIVE_FUTURE_26_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}我相信僵尸能从时空裂痕中汲取力量，用户戴夫。

NARRATIVE_FUTURE_26_INTRO_3.en: {SAY:winnie}We will likely encounter more powerful versions of select zombies.
NARRATIVE_FUTURE_26_INTRO_3.zh: {SAY:winnie}我们很可能会遇见那些更强大的僵尸。

NARRATIVE_FUTURE_26_INTRO_4.en: {SAY:winnie}We may need to retreat to another timeline and return when our plants are stronger.
NARRATIVE_FUTURE_26_INTRO_4.zh: {SAY:winnie}我们也许只能撤退到其他时间线的世界，等我们的植物变得更加强大时再回来了。

NARRATIVE_FUTURE_31_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}Hey! Our futuristic lawnmowers are in the past!
NARRATIVE_FUTURE_31_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}嗨！我们的最炫未来风割草机已成为往事了！

NARRATIVE_FUTURE_31_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:winnie}I detect Dr. Zomboss' hand in this, User Dave.
NARRATIVE_FUTURE_31_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}我探测到，似乎是僵王博士支配着这里的一切，用户戴夫。

NARRATIVE_FUTURE_31_INTRO_4.en: {SAY:crazydave}Either way, things just got 108% craaaaaazier around here!
NARRATIVE_FUTURE_31_INTRO_4.zh: {SAY:crazydave}不管怎样，这里的一切已经升至 108% 的疯疯疯疯疯疯狂啦！

NARRATIVE_FUTURE_35_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}The future is as we have made it!
NARRATIVE_FUTURE_35_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}未来就像我们曾经创造过的那样！

NARRATIVE_FUTURE_35_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:zombossicon}The rise of the fallen, the life of death!
NARRATIVE_FUTURE_35_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:zombossicon}这是堕落者的崛起，死亡者的永生！

NARRATIVE_FUTURE_35_INTRO_3.zh: {SAY:zombossicon}上述两者，伴随着其他神秘的话语！

NARRATIVE_FUTURE_35_INTRO_4.zh: {SAY:zombossicon}明日破译者僵尸机器人 2.0 将会一雪前耻！

NARRATIVE_FUTURE_35_OUTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}Is it over? Has it started? I can never tell with these time-gummy-nummers!
NARRATIVE_FUTURE_35_OUTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}早已开始亦或尚未结束？我还没能弄懂这些黏糊糊的时空编号呢！

NARRATIVE_FUTURE_35_OUTRO_2.en: {SAY:winnie}We have survived this futuristic gauntlet, User Dave.
NARRATIVE_FUTURE_35_OUTRO_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}我们挺过了此次来自明日的考验，用户戴夫。

NARRATIVE_FUTURE_35_OUTRO_3.en: {SAY:winnie}Though I suspect our challenges are not complete.
NARRATIVE_FUTURE_35_OUTRO_3.zh: {SAY:winnie}…尽管我猜测我们的挑战尚未完成。

NARRATIVE_FUTURE_35_OUTRO_4.zh: {NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}画个圈圈诅咒你那该死的闪躲导弹的方式！

NARRATIVE_FUTURE_CHALLENGE_LASTSTAND_A_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}I like to save some sun for a rainy day.
NARRATIVE_FUTURE_CHALLENGE_LASTSTAND_A_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}我喜欢在晴朗时收集阳光以备雨天不时之需。

NARRATIVE_FUTURE_CHALLENGE_LASTSTAND_A_2.en: {TIRED:winnie}It can get you out of a pickle or into an E.M.Peach.
NARRATIVE_FUTURE_CHALLENGE_LASTSTAND_A_2.zh: {TIRED:winnie}是的，这可以让你摆脱“腌腌一息”的困境亦或委身于电磁脉冲桃之中。

NARRATIVE_FUTURE_CHALLENGE_PRESET_A_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY}You can pick your friends, but you can't pick these plants.
NARRATIVE_FUTURE_CHALLENGE_PRESET_A_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY}你可以叫上你的朋友，但不能自由选择植物。

NARRATIVE_FUTURE_CHALLENGE_PRESET_A_2.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{EXCITED:crazydave}But some of my best friends are plants!
NARRATIVE_FUTURE_CHALLENGE_PRESET_A_2.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{EXCITED:crazydave}可我某些最好的朋友就是植物啊！

NARRATIVE_FUTURE_CHALLENGE_PRESET_B_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{TIRED}Looks like we don't have much firepower here Penny.
NARRATIVE_FUTURE_CHALLENGE_PRESET_B_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{TIRED}潘妮！我们这边似乎没有足够的火力啊！

NARRATIVE_FUTURE_CHALLENGE_PRESET_B_3.en: {EXCITED:winnie}Magnifying Grass can pack quite the punch.
NARRATIVE_FUTURE_CHALLENGE_PRESET_B_3.zh: {EXCITED:winnie}棱镜草会把对它的按压化作有力的进攻。

NARRATIVE_FUTURE_CHALLENGE_PROTECTPLANTS.en: {EXCITED:crazydave}It takes a lot of pulp to stand your ground like that.
NARRATIVE_FUTURE_CHALLENGE_PROTECTPLANTS.zh: {EXCITED:crazydave}它们可是以果肉之躯来捍卫你的草坪啊！

NARRATIVE_FUTURE_CHALLENGE_SUNBOMBS_A_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{TIRED}You know how sometimes suns are bombs?
NARRATIVE_FUTURE_CHALLENGE_SUNBOMBS_A_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{TIRED}你知道什么时候阳光会爆炸吗？

NARRATIVE_FUTURE_INTRO_FIRSTLEVEL_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY}The Future! Weird, I thought I would be hungrier.
NARRATIVE_FUTURE_INTRO_FIRSTLEVEL_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY}未来已然到来！真奇怪，我本应该更饿才对。

NARRATIVE_FUTURE_INTRO_FIRSTLEVEL_2.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:crazydave}After all I haven't eaten in 4000 years!
NARRATIVE_FUTURE_INTRO_FIRSTLEVEL_2.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:crazydave}毕竟我已经 4000 年没有吃东西啦！

NARRATIVE_FUTURE_INTRO_FIRSTLEVEL_4.en: {SAY:crazydave}Hey, what happened to the lawn? It’s so glowy!
NARRATIVE_FUTURE_INTRO_FIRSTLEVEL_4.zh: {SAY:crazydave}嘿，我们的草坪怎么了？它可是在闪闪发光诶！

NARRATIVE_FUTURE_INTRO_FIRSTLEVEL_5.en: {SAY:winnie}I’m detecting an array of Power Tiles on the space-lawn.
NARRATIVE_FUTURE_INTRO_FIRSTLEVEL_5.zh: {SAY:winnie}我在这片太空草坪上探测到了一组“能量地砖”阵列。

NARRATIVE_FUTURE_INTRO_FIRSTLEVEL_FAILUR.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY}哇哦！重新试着去用好这份叶绿素吧！

NARRATIVE_FUTURE_INTRO_GARGANTUAR_2.en: {SAY:zombossicon}In this year your brains were collected ages ago.
NARRATIVE_FUTURE_INTRO_GARGANTUAR_2.zh: {SAY:zombossicon}现在是未来，你们的脑子显然在许久之前就已被我夺得。

NARRATIVE_FUTURE_INTRO_GARGANTUAR_3.en: {SAY:zombossicon}Collect them again soon, Dr. Edgar Zomboss.
NARRATIVE_FUTURE_INTRO_GARGANTUAR_3.zh: {SAY:zombossicon}你们的脑子将再度归属于我，埃德加·僵王博士。

NARRATIVE_FUTURE_INTRO_GARGANTUAR_4.en: {NPC_EXIT:zombossicon}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:crazydave}Watch out neighbor, I'm pretty sure he wasn't talking about my BRAINS!
NARRATIVE_FUTURE_INTRO_GARGANTUAR_4.zh: {NPC_EXIT:zombossicon}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:crazydave}走点心，邻居，我敢肯定他不是在对我的脑子打着主意！

NARRATIVE_FUTURE_INTRO_GARGANTUAR_5.en: {PLAYFUL:winnie}I would say there's evidence to the contrary.
NARRATIVE_FUTURE_INTRO_GARGANTUAR_5.zh: {PLAYFUL:winnie}有证据指出，实际情况与戴夫的话正相反。

NARRATIVE_FUTURE_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}Isn't it convenient that your neighbor is so helpful in your fight against us zombies?
NARRATIVE_FUTURE_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}有你的邻居帮你抵抗我们僵尸军团，是不是很方便啊？

NARRATIVE_FUTURE_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_2.en: {SAY:zombossicon}Crazy David's apparent incompetence is only eclipsed by his usefulness.
NARRATIVE_FUTURE_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_2.zh: {SAY:zombossicon}疯狂戴夫他那外强中干的实质被能干的表象所遮掩。

NARRATIVE_FUTURE_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_3.en: {SAY:zombossicon}However, with one secret word my sleeper agent will turn against you.
NARRATIVE_FUTURE_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_3.zh: {SAY:zombossicon}然而，只需下达一句秘令，他——我的秘密间谍就会转而攻击你。

NARRATIVE_FUTURE_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_4.zh: {SAY:zombossicon}遵循我的意志吧，戴夫！“僵尸催眠术”——

NARRATIVE_FUTURE_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_6.en: {PLAYFUL}Can I borrow your brains? Um, I mean hot sauce!
NARRATIVE_FUTURE_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_6.zh: {PLAYFUL}我能借用一下你的脑子吗？嗯啊，我的意思是辣椒酱。

NARRATIVE_FUTURE_MAGNIFYING_GRASS_FAILUR.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY}Oops, you should give it another shot!
NARRATIVE_FUTURE_MAGNIFYING_GRASS_FAILUR.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY}哎呀，你应该再让透镜草攻击一次！

NARRATIVE_FUTURE_MANUAL_MOWERS_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}You can decide to launch one mower early now.
NARRATIVE_FUTURE_MANUAL_MOWERS_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}你现在可以手动发射一辆割草机了。

NARRATIVE_FUTURE_MANUAL_MOWERS_2.en: {EXCITED:winnie}Just press and hold a mower when the time is right.

NARRATIVE_FUTURE_MANUAL_MOWERS_3.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:crazydave}Sometimes that's the most strate-logical thing to do!
NARRATIVE_FUTURE_MANUAL_MOWERS_3.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:crazydave}有的时候，这就是最符合逻辑的战略了！

NARRATIVE_FUTURE_OUTRO_DANGER_ROOM_KEY_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:crazydave}I spy with my crazy eye a U.F.B.! An unidentified flying brain!
NARRATIVE_FUTURE_OUTRO_DANGER_ROOM_KEY_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:crazydave}我用我的疯眼侦查到了一架 U.F.B.！一艘“不明-飞行-脑”！

NARRATIVE_FUTURE_OUTRO_DANGER_ROOM_KEY_2.en: {SAY:winnie}Something more formidable than a brain lies within.
NARRATIVE_FUTURE_OUTRO_DANGER_ROOM_KEY_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}不明飞行脑之中的某样东西比起脑子外形更加令人可畏。

NARRATIVE_FUTURE_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_2.en: {EXCITED:crazydave}I want to eat THAT hypno-taco again! I need my TIME MACHINE!
NARRATIVE_FUTURE_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_2.zh: {EXCITED:crazydave}我还想再吃一次~催~眠~玉米卷！我需要我的时光机！

NARRATIVE_FUTURE_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_3.en: {TIRED:crazydave}What? Wait a minute... what was I saying again?
NARRATIVE_FUTURE_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_3.zh: {TIRED:crazydave}等等？我刚刚说了什么？我这是复读了 2009 年在草坪上的那段话吗？

NARRATIVE_FUTURE_ZOMBIENOTE_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydaveicon}{SAY}It says there’s an error.  Can you come here and fix it Penny?
NARRATIVE_FUTURE_ZOMBIENOTE_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydaveicon}{SAY}平板电脑出现了一个错误。潘妮，你能过来修复它吗？

NARRATIVE_FUTURE_ZOMBIENOTE_2.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnieicon}{TIRED}Did you try unplugging it and plugging it back in?

NARRATIVE_GHOSTPEPPER_TEST_10.zh: {SAY:ghostpepper}就喜欢你这样的选择性热情，兄弟！

NARRATIVE_GHOSTPEPPER_TEST_3.en: {SAY:ghostpepper}I know, silly! We’ve been friends for years!
NARRATIVE_GHOSTPEPPER_TEST_3.zh: {SAY:ghostpepper}我知道，小傻瓜。我们已经当了好多年的朋友了！

NARRATIVE_GHOSTPEPPER_TEST_4.en: {SAY:ghostpepper}Thirteen of them, to be exact! Time to PARTY!
NARRATIVE_GHOSTPEPPER_TEST_4.zh: {SAY:ghostpepper}准确地说，已经 13 年了！一起来开个派对吧！

NARRATIVE_GLOOMVINE_EQ_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Plant Gloom Vine to power shadow plants and do damage in 8 directions.
NARRATIVE_GLOOMVINE_EQ_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}种植忧郁藤蔓，加强暗影植物，并对 8 个方向造成伤害。

NARRATIVE_GTA_10_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:carljohnson}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Ever have a problem with your Plant Food supply running low? If so, give the Bird of Paradise a try!
NARRATIVE_GTA_10_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:carljohnson}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}你有过遇到过叶绿素供应不足的问题吗？如果有的话，请试试极乐草吧！

NARRATIVE_GTA_10_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:winnie}It produces Plant Food after attacking zombies a certain number of times. Let it provide logistical support while in combat!
NARRATIVE_GTA_10_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}它攻击僵尸一定次数后会生产叶绿素，快让它在战斗的同时提供后勤补给吧！

NARRATIVE_GTA_10_INTRO_3.en: {SAY:carljohnson}Too bad people can't eat Plant Food.

NARRATIVE_GTA_11_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}The data shows that the noise pollution index of the neighborhood has increased by 200%, and my gut tells me that this is not normal.
NARRATIVE_GTA_11_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}数据显示街区的噪音污染指数提升了 200%，我的直觉告诉我这并不正常。

NARRATIVE_GTA_11_INTRO_2.en: {NPC_ENTER:carljohnson}{SAY:carljohnson}Damn, it's that fool again, OZ Loc.
NARRATIVE_GTA_11_INTRO_2.zh: {NPC_ENTER:carljohnson}{SAY:carljohnson}该死，又是那个蠢货来了，OZ LOC。

NARRATIVE_GTA_11_INTRO_3.en: {SAY:carljohnson}His music is so bad I wouldn't even let my worst enemy listen to his rap!
NARRATIVE_GTA_11_INTRO_3.zh: {SAY:carljohnson}他的音乐难听到我都不会让我最恨的敌人听他说唱的！

NARRATIVE_GTA_11_INTRO_4.en: {NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave_r}{PLAYFUL:crazydave_r}I think this music sounds pretty groovy!
NARRATIVE_GTA_11_INTRO_4.zh: {NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave_r}{PLAYFUL:crazydave_r}我觉得这些音乐还挺动听的！

NARRATIVE_GTA_15_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}What's going on, brother? Have ya ever heard of the legend of the OZ who keeps a diet of consuming 7 combos a meal?
NARRATIVE_GTA_15_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}近来可好，植物大师。有曾听说过一个帮派元老僵尸保持一顿饭吞噬 7 个套餐的传说吗？

NARRATIVE_GTA_15_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:zombossicon}This homie of mine is arriving at yo' residence to collect your brains as protection money!
NARRATIVE_GTA_15_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:zombossicon}这位哥们即将光临您的陋室，把您的脑子作为保护费来收集！

NARRATIVE_GTA_15_INTRO_4.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:crazydave}Only 7 combos a meal in one sitting? That's way less than me, I can eat 3 in one go!
NARRATIVE_GTA_15_INTRO_4.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:crazydave}一顿饭才吃 7 个套餐？比我少多了，我一顿饭能吃 3 个！

NARRATIVE_GTA_15_INTRO_6.en: {NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:carljohnson}{SAY:carljohnson}Damn, these zombies startin' to copy Big Smoke? Ain't they got nuthin' better to do?
NARRATIVE_GTA_15_INTRO_6.zh: {NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:carljohnson}{SAY:carljohnson}该死，这些僵尸开始模仿大斯莫克了？他们没别的事情做了吗？

NARRATIVE_GTA_1_INTRO_10.zh: {EXCITED:winnie}是的，我们这方面经验很丰富。

NARRATIVE_GTA_1_INTRO_11.en: {SAY:carljohnson}Just in time! I woke up this morning, and saw all my homies and my guns were gone.
NARRATIVE_GTA_1_INTRO_11.zh: {SAY:carljohnson}来的正好，今天我早上起来，看见兄弟们和我的枪都不见了。

NARRATIVE_GTA_1_INTRO_12.en: {SAY:carljohnson}I thought the hood was being taken over by some Vinewood zombie movie actors.
NARRATIVE_GTA_1_INTRO_12.zh: {SAY:carljohnson}我以为我们的地盘被好麦坞丧尸片演员霸占了，后来才发现是真货。

NARRATIVE_GTA_1_INTRO_13.en: {SAY:carljohnson}But as it turned out, they were the real deal.
NARRATIVE_GTA_1_INTRO_13.zh: {SAY:carljohnson}这些丑八怪还穿的和我的兄弟们一样。

NARRATIVE_GTA_1_INTRO_14.en: {SAY:carljohnson}These ugly bastards are even dressed like my homies.
NARRATIVE_GTA_1_INTRO_14.zh: {SAY:carljohnson}我只好躲在家里，真是一团糟。

NARRATIVE_GTA_1_INTRO_15.en: {SAY:carljohnson}So I had to lay low at home. It's all a mess.
NARRATIVE_GTA_1_INTRO_15.zh: {SAY:winnie}我们会帮助你战胜僵尸的，CJ 先生。

NARRATIVE_GTA_1_INTRO_16.en: {SAY:winnie}We'll help you defeat the zombies, CJ.

NARRATIVE_GTA_1_INTRO_17.zh: {SAY:carljohnson}玉米卷？我可不建议你现在去当当钟，因为看那边，这些傻子僵尸们来了！

NARRATIVE_GTA_1_INTRO_18.en: {SAY:carljohnson}Tacos? I wouldn't suggest going to Cluckin' Bell right now.

NARRATIVE_GTA_1_INTRO_19.en: {SAY:carljohnson}'cause look over there, those zombie fools are coming!

NARRATIVE_GTA_1_INTRO_3.zh: {SAY:winnie}街区安全指数评估，严重不合格。

NARRATIVE_GTA_1_INTRO_4.en: {NPC_ENTER:carljohnson}{SAY:carljohnson}Who (the heck) are you? What do you want?

NARRATIVE_GTA_1_INTRO_5.en: {NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave_r}{SAY:crazydave_r}Wow, neighbor, look, there's another human here! And he doesn't have a pot on his head!
NARRATIVE_GTA_1_INTRO_5.zh: {NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave_r}{SAY:crazydave_r}哇，邻居，看，这里居然有别的人类！这个人类的脑袋上居然没有锅！

NARRATIVE_GTA_1_INTRO_6.en: {PLAYFUL:crazydave_r}Isn't he afraid of zombies eating his brain?
NARRATIVE_GTA_1_INTRO_6.zh: {PLAYFUL:crazydave_r}难道他不怕僵尸吃掉他的脑子吗？

NARRATIVE_GTA_1_INTRO_7.en: {SAY:carljohnson}A pot? Hey, fatso, I think you're the one with a problem!
NARRATIVE_GTA_1_INTRO_7.zh: {SAY:carljohnson}锅？嘿，胖子，我看你才是脑子有问题了！

NARRATIVE_GTA_1_INTRO_8.en: {NPC_EXIT:crazydave_r}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Please calm down, sir. We're Time Travelers, and we're here to eliminate zombies. What's your name?
NARRATIVE_GTA_1_INTRO_8.zh: {NPC_EXIT:crazydave_r}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}冷静点，先生，我们是时空旅行者，是来消灭僵尸的，请问你叫什么名字？

NARRATIVE_GTA_1_INTRO_9.en: {SAY:carljohnson}The name's CJ. Are you dudes here to kill zombies?
NARRATIVE_GTA_1_INTRO_9.zh: {SAY:carljohnson}我叫 CJ，你们是来打僵尸的？

NARRATIVE_GTA_2_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:carljohnson}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}In gang warfare, victory often comes down to numbers. We have our own swarm tactic.
NARRATIVE_GTA_2_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:carljohnson}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}帮派战争中，往往靠人数取胜，我们也有我们自己的人海战术。

NARRATIVE_GTA_2_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:winnie}Poppin' Poppies unleashes her minions to attack and mesmerize zombies, which can deal a heavy blow to those gangster zombies!
NARRATIVE_GTA_2_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}热舞罂粟，它会放出自己的小弟攻击和魅惑僵尸，能对那些帮派僵尸们造成严重打击！

NARRATIVE_GTA_2_INTRO_3.en: {SAY:carljohnson}I really wanna find where my guns are...

NARRATIVE_GTA_6_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:carljohnson}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave_r}{SAY:crazydave_r}Look, neighbor! There's a zombie with some hot sauce!
NARRATIVE_GTA_6_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:carljohnson}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave_r}{SAY:crazydave_r}看，邻居！那里有一个拿着辣椒酱的僵尸！

NARRATIVE_GTA_6_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:carljohnson}That's not hot sauce, man, that's a Molotov cocktail!
NARRATIVE_GTA_6_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:carljohnson}那可不是辣椒酱，兄弟，那是燃烧瓶！

NARRATIVE_GTA_6_INTRO_4.en: {SAY:carljohnson}Oh my god, and I thought Big Smoke was the biggest eater.
NARRATIVE_GTA_6_INTRO_4.zh: {SAY:carljohnson}天啊，我还以为大斯莫克是最贪吃的呢，现在我们要被烧成灰了！

NARRATIVE_GTA_6_INTRO_5.en: {SAY:carljohnson}Now we're gonna be burnt to ashes!
NARRATIVE_GTA_6_INTRO_5.zh: {NPC_EXIT:crazydave_r}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}不用害怕，CJ 先生，是时候让红丝兰派上用场了。

NARRATIVE_GTA_6_INTRO_6.en: {NPC_EXIT:crazydave_r}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}No need to be afraid, CJ, it's time to put that Yucca Guardian to good use.
NARRATIVE_GTA_6_INTRO_6.zh: {SAY:carljohnson}其实我之前抢过一辆消防车来着，算了吧…

NARRATIVE_GTA_6_INTRO_7.en: {SAY:carljohnson}I actually jacked a fire truck earlier, but... never mind.

NARRATIVE_GTA_ZOMBIENOTE_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnieicon}{SAY:winnieicon}User Dave, it seems you have been blacklisted by the local fast-food restaurants—unless you hand over your brain.
NARRATIVE_GTA_ZOMBIENOTE_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnieicon}{SAY:winnieicon}用户戴夫，您似乎已经被当地的快餐店列入黑名单——除非您交出脑子

NARRATIVE_GTA_ZOMBIENOTE_2.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydaveicon}{EXCITED:crazydaveicon}Refused service at a fast food restaurant? But you know I love tacos!
NARRATIVE_GTA_ZOMBIENOTE_2.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydaveicon}{EXCITED:crazydaveicon}被快餐店拒绝服务？可是你知道我最爱玉米卷了！

NARRATIVE_GTA_ZOMBIENOTE_3.en: {SAY:winnieicon}We have something more urgent than eating right now, User Dave.
NARRATIVE_GTA_ZOMBIENOTE_3.zh: {SAY:winnieicon}我们现在有比饮食更紧急的事情，用户戴夫。

NARRATIVE_GTA_ZOMBIENOTE_4.en: {SAY:crazydaveicon}Hurry up, neighbors, maybe we have to visit Ammu-nation!
NARRATIVE_GTA_ZOMBIENOTE_4.zh: {SAY:crazydaveicon}快点，邻居，也许我们得拜访武装国度！

NARRATIVE_GTA_ZOMBIENOTE_5.en: {PLAYFUL:winnieicon}But the map shows that it is currently the territory of the zombie families.
NARRATIVE_GTA_ZOMBIENOTE_5.zh: {PLAYFUL:winnieicon}但是地图显示那里目前是僵尸帮的领地。

NARRATIVE_GUMNUT_EQ_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Gumnuts pop sticky gum onto zombies, blocking other zombies behind.
NARRATIVE_GUMNUT_EQ_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}粘液桉果可以把黏糊糊的泡泡糖黏在僵尸身上，并阻拦后来的僵尸。

NARRATIVE_HALLOWEEN_LTE_2023_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Happy Halloween User Dave. I've prepared some spooky surprises for today.
NARRATIVE_HALLOWEEN_LTE_2023_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}万圣节快乐，用户戴夫。我为今天准备了一些恐怖、吓人的惊喜。

NARRATIVE_HALLOWEEN_LTE_2023_1_2.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:crazydave}Spooooky! Wait... what day is it again?
NARRATIVE_HALLOWEEN_LTE_2023_1_2.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:crazydave}恐怖吓人！等等……今天啥日子来着？

NARRATIVE_HALLOWEEN_LTE_2023_1_3.en: {NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}Trick or brainz losers! I'm here for a feast!
NARRATIVE_HALLOWEEN_LTE_2023_1_3.zh: {NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}不给脑子就捣蛋，你们这群废柴！我来这里可不是吃素的！

NARRATIVE_HALLOWEEN_LTE_2023_1_4.en: {SAY:crazydave}Feast? Oh, I was just thinking about tacos!
NARRATIVE_HALLOWEEN_LTE_2023_1_4.zh: {SAY:crazydave}不吃素？哦，我刚刚还在想吃玉米卷来着！

NARRATIVE_HALLOWEEN_LTE_2023_1_5.en: {NPC_EXIT:zomboss_r}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}User Dave, we need to defend the treats from this undead invasion.
NARRATIVE_HALLOWEEN_LTE_2023_1_5.zh: {NPC_EXIT:zomboss_r}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}用户戴夫，我们需要抵御这些不死军团的入侵。

NARRATIVE_HALLOWEEN_LTE_2023_2_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Intruder alert, a Zombie has fallen into the Soybean vats again.
NARRATIVE_HALLOWEEN_LTE_2023_2_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}入侵者警告，一只僵尸又跌入了大豆池中。

NARRATIVE_HALLOWEEN_LTE_2023_2_3.en: {SAY:winnie}User Dave, your Soybeans have mutated... again.
NARRATIVE_HALLOWEEN_LTE_2023_2_3.zh: {SAY:winnie}用户戴夫，你的大豆好像……又变异了。

NARRATIVE_HALLOWEEN_LTE_2023_2_4.en: {NPC_EXIT:browncoatzombie}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:crazydave}Mmmm, Imagine the flavor fusion. Undead-sprinkled soy tacos!
NARRATIVE_HALLOWEEN_LTE_2023_2_4.zh: {NPC_EXIT:browncoatzombie}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:crazydave}嗯，想象一下这风味的交融。僵尸味大豆玉米卷！

NARRATIVE_HALLOWEEN_LTE_2023_2_5.en: {SAY:winnie}I can't even fathom your culinary adventures User Dave. Focus, please.
NARRATIVE_HALLOWEEN_LTE_2023_2_5.zh: {SAY:winnie}我完全无法想象你在烹饪这件事上经历了多少冒险，用户戴夫。请集中精神。

NARRATIVE_HALLOWEEN_LTE_2023_3_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}User Dave, the Mystery Ninja has left us a haiku.
NARRATIVE_HALLOWEEN_LTE_2023_3_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}用户戴夫，神秘忍者给我们留下了一段俳句。

NARRATIVE_HALLOWEEN_LTE_2023_3_5.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:crazydave}Nightcap? Do they come with a side of pajamas?

NARRATIVE_HALLOWEEN_LTE_2023_4_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:ghostpepper_r}{SAY:ghostpepper_r}I'm here to add some fire to your tacos!

NARRATIVE_HALLOWEEN_LTE_2023_4_2.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:crazydave}Fire to my tacos? That's sizzlingly fantastic!
NARRATIVE_HALLOWEEN_LTE_2023_4_2.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:crazydave}给我的玉米卷添火？那不错啊！

NARRATIVE_HALLOWEEN_LTE_2023_4_3.en: {SAY:ghostpepper_r}Hold on, Dave. We need to deal with those zombies first.
NARRATIVE_HALLOWEEN_LTE_2023_4_3.zh: {SAY:ghostpepper_r}等等，戴夫。我们得先解决掉那群僵尸。

NARRATIVE_HALLOWEEN_LTE_2023_5_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}User Dave, Zomboss plans to destroy the Goo peashooter's candy stash!
NARRATIVE_HALLOWEEN_LTE_2023_5_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}用户戴夫，僵王计划摧毁黏液豌豆射手的糖果储藏室！

NARRATIVE_HALLOWEEN_LTE_2023_5_2.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:crazydave}Candy stash? Time to defend the gooey goodness!
NARRATIVE_HALLOWEEN_LTE_2023_5_2.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:crazydave}糖果储藏室？看来得好好保护这些黏糊糊的宝藏了！

NARRATIVE_HALLOWEEN_LTE_2023_5_3.en: {SAY:winnie}We need a solid plan, not a sugar rush user Dave.
NARRATIVE_HALLOWEEN_LTE_2023_5_3.zh: {SAY:winnie}我们需要一个完整的计划，别这么“糖”突草率，用户戴夫。

NARRATIVE_HALLOWEEN_LTE_2023_5_4.en: {SAY:crazydave}Leaf it to my peashooter protection brigade!
NARRATIVE_HALLOWEEN_LTE_2023_5_4.zh: {SAY:crazydave}那就交给我的豌豆射手保护大队吧！

NARRATIVE_HALLOWEEN_LTE_2023_6_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:winnie}Sensors indicate no undead signatures. Threat neutralized.
NARRATIVE_HALLOWEEN_LTE_2023_6_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:winnie}我的传感器表明没有不死大军的征兆了。威胁解除。

NARRATIVE_HALLOWEEN_LTE_2023_6_2.en: {SAY:winnie}User Dave, I’m receiving a transmission. An invitation to go trick or treating.
NARRATIVE_HALLOWEEN_LTE_2023_6_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}用户戴夫，我收到了一条传输信息。是邀请我们去“不给糖就捣蛋”的。

NARRATIVE_HALLOWEEN_LTE_2023_6_3.en: {SAY:crazydave}Wonder if there taco-flavored candy out there...
NARRATIVE_HALLOWEEN_LTE_2023_6_3.zh: {SAY:crazydave}不知道那里有没有玉米卷风味的糖果…

NARRATIVE_HALLOWEEN_LTE_2024_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}Mwahaha! Welcome foolish mortals to your doom.
NARRATIVE_HALLOWEEN_LTE_2024_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}木哇哈哈！愚蠢的凡人，欢迎来到你们的末日。

NARRATIVE_HALLOWEEN_LTE_2024_1_2.en: {SAY:zomboss_r}Tonight my minions and I will feast on your brainz.
NARRATIVE_HALLOWEEN_LTE_2024_1_2.zh: {SAY:zomboss_r}今天我和我的随从们，会尽情享用你们的脑子。

NARRATIVE_HALLOWEEN_LTE_2024_1_3.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:crazydave}Are you here for trick or treat? All I have is tacos but thats my feast...
NARRATIVE_HALLOWEEN_LTE_2024_1_3.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:crazydave}你们是来“不给脑子就捣蛋”的吗？我只有玉米卷，不过得我先享用…

NARRATIVE_HALLOWEEN_LTE_2024_1_4.en: {SAY:zomboss_r}Silence and prepare youselves for a spine-chilling encounter.
NARRATIVE_HALLOWEEN_LTE_2024_1_4.zh: {SAY:zomboss_r}肃静，准备面对自己那令人背脊发凉的遭遇吧。

NARRATIVE_HALLOWEEN_LTE_2024_1_5.en: {NPC_EXIT:zomboss_r}{NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:peashooter}Looks like Zomboss is up to no good again.
NARRATIVE_HALLOWEEN_LTE_2024_1_5.zh: {NPC_EXIT:zomboss_r}{NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:peashooter}看起来僵王又在想坏点子了。

NARRATIVE_HALLOWEEN_LTE_2024_1_6.en: {NPC_ENTER:wallnut_r}{SAY:wallnut_r}Does it have to be tonight? I wasn't planning on facing these undead creepers.
NARRATIVE_HALLOWEEN_LTE_2024_1_6.zh: {NPC_ENTER:wallnut_r}{SAY:wallnut_r}就非得今晚吗？我不想面对这些古灵精怪的不死军团。

NARRATIVE_HALLOWEEN_LTE_2024_1_7.en: {NPC_EXIT:peashooter}{NPC_ENTER:ghostpepper}{SAY:ghostpepper}Boo! I am here to ghost-bust those zombies with some spectral spice.
NARRATIVE_HALLOWEEN_LTE_2024_1_7.zh: {NPC_EXIT:peashooter}{NPC_ENTER:ghostpepper}{SAY:ghostpepper}唬！我来用自己的幽魂香料，“鬼捉敢死队”。

NARRATIVE_HALLOWEEN_LTE_2024_1_8.en: {SHOUT:wallnut_r}Holy creepers! Stop sneaking up on me man, I am on your team.
NARRATIVE_HALLOWEEN_LTE_2024_1_8.zh: {SHOUT:wallnut_r}我天！别这样突然出现吓我啊，我们是一队的。

NARRATIVE_HALLOWEEN_LTE_2024_2_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}Curses! My haunted plans turned into pumpkin patch!.
NARRATIVE_HALLOWEEN_LTE_2024_2_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}呸！我的鬼点子变成南瓜籽了。

NARRATIVE_HALLOWEEN_LTE_2024_2_2.en: {SAY:zomboss_r}But mark my words puny mortals, next time my tricks will get the treatz!
NARRATIVE_HALLOWEEN_LTE_2024_2_2.zh: {SAY:zomboss_r}不过记住，卑微的凡人，下次我的点子绝不只是捣捣蛋。

NARRATIVE_HALLOWEEN_LTE_2024_2_3.en: {NPC_EXIT:zomboss_r}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}That was such a scream and hair-raising.
NARRATIVE_HALLOWEEN_LTE_2024_2_3.zh: {NPC_EXIT:zomboss_r}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}真是让人尖叫又让人发寒啊。

NARRATIVE_HALLOWEEN_LTE_2024_2_4.en: {SAY:winnie}You can relax User Dave, my sensors indicate no undead activity on the lawn.
NARRATIVE_HALLOWEEN_LTE_2024_2_4.zh: {SAY:winnie}可以放心用户戴夫，我的传感器表明草坪上没有不死军团的活动。

NARRATIVE_HALLOWEEN_LTE_2024_2_5.en: {SAY:winnie}Great job plants! Dr. Zomboss' spooky schemes have been scared off.
NARRATIVE_HALLOWEEN_LTE_2024_2_5.zh: {SAY:winnie}做得好各位植物！你们把僵王博士的诡计吓破产了。

NARRATIVE_HARVEST_LTE_2023_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}So, this is the famed Harvest Festival... a bountiful feast for the senses!
NARRATIVE_HARVEST_LTE_2023_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}原来，这就是久负盛名的丰收节啊……真是一场丰富的感官盛宴！

NARRATIVE_HARVEST_LTE_2023_1_2.en: {SAY:zomboss_r}But amidst this abundance lies the ultimate prize—the Cornucopia of Plenty!
NARRATIVE_HARVEST_LTE_2023_1_2.zh: {SAY:zomboss_r}但在这无尽的丰足之中，还藏着真正的终极奖品——丰饶羊角！

NARRATIVE_HARVEST_LTE_2023_1_3.en: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:peashooter}Well, well, if it isn't Dr. Zomboss, craving a taste of our leafy delights?
NARRATIVE_HARVEST_LTE_2023_1_3.zh: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:peashooter}看哪，看哪，这不是处处追寻蔬果盛宴果腹的僵王吗？

NARRATIVE_HARVEST_LTE_2023_1_4.en: {NPC_EXIT:peashooter}{NPC_ENTER:iceburg}{SAY:iceburg}Your plans are as frostbitten as a zombie popsicle, Zomboss...
NARRATIVE_HARVEST_LTE_2023_1_4.zh: {NPC_EXIT:peashooter}{NPC_ENTER:iceburg}{SAY:iceburg}你的计划已经凉成僵尸冰棍了，僵王…

NARRATIVE_HARVEST_LTE_2023_1_5.en: {SAY:iceburg}We'll send you packing with chills down your decomposing spine!
NARRATIVE_HARVEST_LTE_2023_1_5.zh: {SAY:iceburg}看我们替你收拾行囊，为你落寞的脊背留下刺骨寒霜！

NARRATIVE_HARVEST_LTE_2023_1_6.en: {NPC_EXIT:iceburg}{SAY:zomboss_r}Soon, you'll feel the icy grip of defeat as my zombies overrun the lawn!
NARRATIVE_HARVEST_LTE_2023_1_6.zh: {NPC_EXIT:iceburg}{SAY:zomboss_r}很快，等我的僵尸大军占领草坪时，你们就会知道，真正寒冷的东西，是你们的失败！

NARRATIVE_HARVEST_LTE_2023_2_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:wallnut}{SAY:wallnut}Uhhh, I don't like the look of those clucking nightmares out there Peashooter...
NARRATIVE_HARVEST_LTE_2023_2_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:wallnut}{SAY:wallnut}额额额，我不喜欢外面那些怪物咯咯作响的样子，豌豆射手…

NARRATIVE_HARVEST_LTE_2023_2_2.zh: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}嘿嘿嘿，我的绝妙计划诞生了！

NARRATIVE_HARVEST_LTE_2023_2_3.en: {NPC_EXIT:zomboss_r}{NPC_ENTER:peashooter_r}{SAY:peashooter_r}Don't Worry, we'll weather this cluck-storm with a shocking twist.
NARRATIVE_HARVEST_LTE_2023_2_3.zh: {NPC_EXIT:zomboss_r}{NPC_ENTER:peashooter_r}{SAY:peashooter_r}别担心，我们只需要一个惊天大反转，就能轻松度过这场风暴。

NARRATIVE_HARVEST_LTE_2023_2_4.en: {SAY:peashooter_r}Prepare for an electrifying defense against these feathered foes!
NARRATIVE_HARVEST_LTE_2023_2_4.zh: {SAY:peashooter_r}部署电网，准备防御这些长着羽毛的敌人！

NARRATIVE_HARVEST_LTE_2023_2_5.en: {NPC_EXIT:peashooter_r}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}Lightning? A futile flicker against the unstoppable force of my chicken brigade!
NARRATIVE_HARVEST_LTE_2023_2_5.zh: {NPC_EXIT:peashooter_r}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}电？一点星星电火，怎么可能挡得住我那不可阻挡的僵尸鸡大军！

NARRATIVE_HARVEST_LTE_2023_2_6.en: {NPC_EXIT:wallnut}{NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:peashooter}You'll be shell-shocked by our electrifying counterattack!
NARRATIVE_HARVEST_LTE_2023_2_6.zh: {NPC_EXIT:wallnut}{NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:peashooter}等我们成功用电光火石来反制你的时候，你就等着五雷轰顶吧！

NARRATIVE_HARVEST_LTE_2023_3_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}Your demise is imminent! I've spiked your fertilizer you putrid plants!
NARRATIVE_HARVEST_LTE_2023_3_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}你们的末日马上就要来临啦！我偷偷给你们的肥料掺了些东西，你们这群烂植物！

NARRATIVE_HARVEST_LTE_2023_3_2.en: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:peashooter}All you've done is fertilize our determination Zomboss!
NARRATIVE_HARVEST_LTE_2023_3_2.zh: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:peashooter}你做这些，只不过是在增强我们的决心罢了，僵王！

NARRATIVE_HARVEST_LTE_2023_3_3.en: {NPC_EXIT:peashooter}{NPC_ENTER:iceburg}{SAY:iceburg}Just like Zomboss to forget about our Ace in the hole... here comes the CARROT!
NARRATIVE_HARVEST_LTE_2023_3_3.zh: {NPC_EXIT:peashooter}{NPC_ENTER:iceburg}{SAY:iceburg}僵王是不是忘了我们还有一张王牌……有请胡萝卜登场！

NARRATIVE_HARVEST_LTE_2023_4_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}Foiled again! But mark my words, plants, I'll return for that Cornucopia soon!
NARRATIVE_HARVEST_LTE_2023_4_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}又一次的败北！不过别忘了，你们这群植物，我会回来夺回我的丰饶羊角的！

NARRATIVE_HARVEST_LTE_2023_4_2.en: {NPC_EXIT:zomboss_r}{NPC_ENTER:wallnut}{SAY:wallnut}We... won! Yay! Wait... what did we win again?
NARRATIVE_HARVEST_LTE_2023_4_2.zh: {NPC_EXIT:zomboss_r}{NPC_ENTER:wallnut}{SAY:wallnut}我们……赢了！好耶！等等……我们赢什么了来着？

NARRATIVE_HARVEST_LTE_2023_4_3.en: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter_r}{SAY:peashooter_r}Oh, Wallnut, you're as sharp as a butter knife. We protected the Cornucopia!
NARRATIVE_HARVEST_LTE_2023_4_3.zh: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter_r}{SAY:peashooter_r}哦，坚果墙，你真是鱼的记忆啊。我们保护了丰饶羊角！

NARRATIVE_HARVEST_LTE_2023_4_4.en: {NPC_EXIT:wallnut}{NPC_EXIT:peashooter_r}{NPC_ENTER:iceburg}Your plans were built on thin ice, Zomboss. Chill out while we enjoy our victory!
NARRATIVE_HARVEST_LTE_2023_4_4.zh: {NPC_EXIT:wallnut}{NPC_EXIT:peashooter_r}{NPC_ENTER:iceburg}你的计划本来就站不住脚，僵王。趁着我们放松享受胜利的果实，你自己好好冷静想想吧！

NARRATIVE_HARVEST_LTE_2024_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss}{SAY:zomboss}The season of harvest is upon us and I shall collect the nature's bounty.
NARRATIVE_HARVEST_LTE_2024_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss}{SAY:zomboss}丰收的季节就要来了，我要收集大自然的恩赐。

NARRATIVE_HARVEST_LTE_2024_1_2.en: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter_r}{SAY:peashooter_r}Are you forgetting that we are here to show you that nature always wins.
NARRATIVE_HARVEST_LTE_2024_1_2.zh: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter_r}{SAY:peashooter_r}你是不是忘了，我们就是来为你展示大自然的不可战胜的。

NARRATIVE_HARVEST_LTE_2024_1_3.en: {NPC_EXIT:peashooter_r}{NPC_ENTER:sunflower_r}{SAY:sunflower_r}That's right! Get ready to reap what you sow, Zomboss.
NARRATIVE_HARVEST_LTE_2024_1_3.zh: {NPC_EXIT:peashooter_r}{NPC_ENTER:sunflower_r}{SAY:sunflower_r}没错！准备好自食其果吧，僵王。

NARRATIVE_HARVEST_LTE_2024_1_4.en: {SAY:sunflower_r}Its time for a little garden warfare.

NARRATIVE_HARVEST_LTE_2024_2_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss}{SAY:zomboss}Curse this harvest of humiliation! You may have won this time, wretched plants...
NARRATIVE_HARVEST_LTE_2024_2_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss}{SAY:zomboss}敢让我收获这满满的羞辱，我诅咒你们！也许这次你们赢了，可怜的植物…

NARRATIVE_HARVEST_LTE_2024_2_2.en: {SAY:zomboss}...but my plans will blossom intro something far more sinister next time!
NARRATIVE_HARVEST_LTE_2024_2_2.zh: {SAY:zomboss}…但下次，我的计划里会涌现出更多的险恶！

NARRATIVE_HARVEST_LTE_2024_2_3.en: {NPC_EXIT:zomboss}{NPC_ENTER:sunflower}{SAY:sunflower}You can try Zomboss, but you'll always end up mulched in the end.
NARRATIVE_HARVEST_LTE_2024_2_3.zh: {NPC_EXIT:zomboss}{NPC_ENTER:sunflower}{SAY:sunflower}你随便试吧僵王，只不过你的结局永远是被沙土掩埋。

NARRATIVE_HARVEST_LTE_2024_2_4.en: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter_r}{SAY:peashooter_r}And our gardens will be lush and the brains un-munched
NARRATIVE_HARVEST_LTE_2024_2_4.zh: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter_r}{SAY:peashooter_r}而我们的花园将郁郁葱葱，脑子将安然无恙

NARRATIVE_HEADBUTTER_EQ_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Plant Headbutter Lettuce to bash and butter zombies.
NARRATIVE_HEADBUTTER_EQ_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}种植黄油生菜，猛击僵尸，并用黄油糊住它们。

NARRATIVE_HEATHSEEKER_EQ_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Plant Heath Seekers to release a storm of homing, piercing darts.
NARRATIVE_HEATHSEEKER_EQ_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}种植石楠导引头，释放一阵具有穿透性的制导飞镖风暴。

NARRATIVE_HEIAN_11_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:CRAZYDAVE}{NPC_ENTER:WINNIE}{EXCITED:CRAZYDAVE}Wow! What a strong wind! I feel like I'm going to blow my head off!
NARRATIVE_HEIAN_11_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:CRAZYDAVE}{NPC_ENTER:WINNIE}{EXCITED:CRAZYDAVE}哇！好大的风啊！感觉要把我的锅盔都吹掉了！

NARRATIVE_HEIAN_11_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:WINNIE}Data shows that strong winds often hit this place, which may also be accompanied by terrible cyclones.
NARRATIVE_HEIAN_11_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:WINNIE}资料显示，这个地方经常会有强风来袭，还有可能伴随着可怕的旋风，

NARRATIVE_HEIAN_11_INTRO_3.en: {SAY:WINNIE}This has a huge impact on us.

NARRATIVE_HEIAN_11_INTRO_4.en: {EXCITED:CRAZYDAVE}Woah! Can we fight the forces of nature??
NARRATIVE_HEIAN_11_INTRO_4.zh: {EXCITED:CRAZYDAVE}哇哦！我们能对抗大自然的力量吗？

NARRATIVE_HEIAN_11_INTRO_5.en: {SAY:WINNIE}Please use Dendrobium Windproof, they can block the whirlwind and prevent the plants from being blown away when planting together.
NARRATIVE_HEIAN_11_INTRO_5.zh: {SAY:WINNIE}请使用石斛，他们可以挡住旋风，防止植物被吹走，种植一起的时候

NARRATIVE_HEIAN_11_INTRO_6.en: {SAY:WINNIE}Wow! This looks like a place with a lot of mustard tacos.

NARRATIVE_HEIAN_1_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:CRAZYDAVE}{NPC_ENTER:WINNIE}{EXCITED:CRAZYDAVE}Wow! This looks like a place with a lot of wasabi tacos!
NARRATIVE_HEIAN_1_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:CRAZYDAVE}{NPC_ENTER:WINNIE}{EXCITED:CRAZYDAVE}哇！这里这里看上去像是有很多芥末味玉米卷的地方！

NARRATIVE_HEIAN_1_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:WINNIE}Welcome to new world! This is Japan in the 10th century, the Heian period.
NARRATIVE_HEIAN_1_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:WINNIE}欢迎加入新的时空旅程！这里是10世纪，平安时代的日本。

NARRATIVE_HEIAN_1_INTRO_3.en: {SAY:WINNIE}The detector showed that we were at a shrine near Mount Fuji.
NARRATIVE_HEIAN_1_INTRO_3.zh: {SAY:WINNIE}探测仪显示我们正在富士山附近的一座神社里。

NARRATIVE_HEIAN_1_INTRO_4.en: {EXCITED:CRAZYDAVE}Look at those guys’ hairstyles that look like tacos, maybe they actually have tacos hidden in their hair!
NARRATIVE_HEIAN_1_INTRO_4.zh: {EXCITED:CRAZYDAVE}看那些家伙的发型像不像玉米卷，没准他们头发里真的藏着玉米卷呢！

NARRATIVE_HEIAN_1_INTRO_5.en: {SAY:WINNIE}According to scan analysis, there were no tacos hidden in their hair, and they were wearing wigs.
NARRATIVE_HEIAN_1_INTRO_5.zh: {SAY:WINNIE}根据扫描分析，他们的头发里面没有藏着玉米卷，而且他们戴的都是假发。

NARRATIVE_HEIAN_1_INTRO_6.en: {EXCITED:CRAZYDAVE}Look! What's that box over there? I'm guessing it's a taco box?
NARRATIVE_HEIAN_1_INTRO_6.zh: {EXCITED:CRAZYDAVE}快看！那里的那个箱子是什么？呃！我猜是装玉米卷的餐盒？

NARRATIVE_HEIAN_1_INTRO_7.en: {SAY:WINNIE}That's Saisen Box. Use different Saisen Boxes properly. It will help you deal with zombies better.
NARRATIVE_HEIAN_1_INTRO_7.zh: {SAY:WINNIE}那是赛钱箱，合理运用不同的赛钱箱，它会帮助你更好的对付僵尸！

NARRATIVE_HEIAN_1_INTRO_8.en: {SAY:WINNIE}Of course, you have to "put coins" in first. Oh, I mean your Plant Foods
NARRATIVE_HEIAN_1_INTRO_8.zh: {SAY:WINNIE}当然，你得先往里面“投币”才行。喔，我是指你的叶绿素

NARRATIVE_HEIAN_1_INTRO_9.en: {SAY:WINNIE}Sun Saisen Box returns some of the sunlight to nearby plants.
NARRATIVE_HEIAN_1_INTRO_9.zh: {SAY:WINNIE}阳光赛钱箱可以返回种在附近的植物的部分阳光。

NARRATIVE_HEIAN_2_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:CRAZYDAVE}{NPC_ENTER:WINNIE}{EXCITED:CRAZYDAVE}HOLY!They are holding a chimney in their hands, and it is also on fire!
NARRATIVE_HEIAN_2_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:CRAZYDAVE}{NPC_ENTER:WINNIE}{EXCITED:CRAZYDAVE}天呐！他们的手上抱着一根烟囱，而且还会冒火呢！

NARRATIVE_HEIAN_2_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:WINNIE}Warning, those are Fireworks Zombies, the fireworks they spray will set us on fire!
NARRATIVE_HEIAN_2_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:WINNIE}警告，那是花火僵尸，喷洒的烟花会把我们点着的！

NARRATIVE_HEIAN_2_INTRO_3.en: {EXCITED:CRAZYDAVE}Wow! This hot feeling, did they add chili sauce in it?
NARRATIVE_HEIAN_2_INTRO_3.zh: {EXCITED:CRAZYDAVE}哇！这火辣的感觉，他们是在里面加了辣椒酱吗？

NARRATIVE_HEIAN_2_INTRO_4.en: {SAY:WINNIE}The water droplets from Dripphylleia can extinguish the fireworks from the fireworks tube.
NARRATIVE_HEIAN_2_INTRO_4.zh: {SAY:WINNIE}冰莲的水滴可以浇灭花火筒喷出的烟花火苗。

NARRATIVE_HEIAN_2_INTRO_5.en: {EXCITED:CRAZYDAVE}So what are you waiting for, hurry up!

NARRATIVE_HEIAN_3_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:CRAZYDAVE}{NPC_ENTER:WINNIE}{EXCITED:CRAZYDAVE}Oh! This is an unusual Saisen box. Will it contain tacos this time?
NARRATIVE_HEIAN_3_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:CRAZYDAVE}{NPC_ENTER:WINNIE}{EXCITED:CRAZYDAVE}噢！这是个不一般的赛钱箱，这次里面会装有玉米卷吗？

NARRATIVE_HEIAN_3_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:WINNIE}Nah, this is PF Saisen Box, which allow plants nearby activate their pf's effect together!
NARRATIVE_HEIAN_3_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:WINNIE}留意赛钱箱上的图案，这个是能量赛钱箱，可以让附近的植物一起释放叶绿素。

NARRATIVE_HEIAN_4_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:CRAZYDAVE}{NPC_ENTER:WINNIE}{EXCITED:CRAZYDAVE}Are there any other boxes? I wish there was a box for tacos!
NARRATIVE_HEIAN_4_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:CRAZYDAVE}{NPC_ENTER:WINNIE}{EXCITED:CRAZYDAVE}还有其他的箱子吗？我希望有一个能装玉米卷的箱子！

NARRATIVE_HEIAN_4_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:WINNIE}Please forget about tacos for now. This is the Plant Saisen box.
NARRATIVE_HEIAN_4_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:WINNIE}亲爱的戴夫，暂时忘记玉米卷吧。这个是植物赛钱箱，

NARRATIVE_HEIAN_4_INTRO_3.en: {SAY:WINNIE}It can provide you with a high-level plant to help you deal with powerful zombies.
NARRATIVE_HEIAN_4_INTRO_3.zh: {SAY:WINNIE}可以为你提供一个高阶植物，助你解决强力僵尸。

NARRATIVE_HEIAN_5_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:CRAZYDAVE}{NPC_ENTER:WINNIE}{EXCITED:CRAZYDAVE}Those guys have a lot of stuff in their hands! Is this a gift?
NARRATIVE_HEIAN_5_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:CRAZYDAVE}{NPC_ENTER:WINNIE}{EXCITED:CRAZYDAVE}那些家伙手里拿了好多东西！这是要来送礼吗？

NARRATIVE_HEIAN_5_INTRO_2.en:
{SAY:WINNIE}They are ninja imp zombies, and they are holding pufferfish,
					
					alive!
NARRATIVE_HEIAN_5_INTRO_2.zh:
{SAY:WINNIE}请小心，他们是忍者小鬼僵尸，手里拿的是河豚,
					
					活的！

NARRATIVE_HEIAN_5_INTRO_3.en: {EXCITED:CRAZYDAVE}Those little ORPHANs want to STEAL MY DELICIOUS TACO?!!!
NARRATIVE_HEIAN_5_INTRO_3.zh: {EXCITED:CRAZYDAVE}这些家伙想干嘛？我敢打赌它们肯定是因为想偷吃我的玉米卷！

NARRATIVE_HEIAN_5_INTRO_4.en: {SAY:WINNIE}Only 0.01% they do that. At the same time, data shows that they are experts in sneak attacks.
NARRATIVE_HEIAN_5_INTRO_4.zh: {SAY:WINNIE}该可能性的概率为0.01%。同时资料显示，他们是偷袭的专家。

NARRATIVE_HEIAN_5_INTRO_5.en: {SAY:WINNIE}But we have Stephania, who is a master at dealing with this kind of ninja.
NARRATIVE_HEIAN_5_INTRO_5.zh: {SAY:WINNIE}但我们有千金藤，他可是处理这种忍者的专家。

NARRATIVE_HEIAN_6_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:CRAZYDAVE}{NPC_ENTER:WINNIE}{EXCITED:CRAZYDAVE}UGH! A DIFFERENT BOX AGAIN. There’s no tacos in there anyway.
NARRATIVE_HEIAN_6_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:CRAZYDAVE}{NPC_ENTER:WINNIE}{EXCITED:CRAZYDAVE}呃，又是一个不同的箱子。反正里面也没有放玉米卷。

NARRATIVE_HEIAN_6_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:WINNIE}Yes, this is a Upgrade Saisen Box, which can increase nearby plants and zombies by one level. Please use it with caution.
NARRATIVE_HEIAN_6_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:WINNIE}对的，这个是跃升赛钱箱，可以让附近的植物和僵尸上升一阶，请小心使用。

NARRATIVE_HEIAN_7_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:CRAZYDAVE}{NPC_ENTER:WINNIE}{EXCITED:CRAZYDAVE}Hey! Do you smell something? The tacos are 10,000x better than this!
NARRATIVE_HEIAN_7_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:CRAZYDAVE}{NPC_ENTER:WINNIE}{EXCITED:CRAZYDAVE}嘿！你闻到什么味道了么？玉米卷可比这玩意香一万倍！

NARRATIVE_HEIAN_7_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:WINNIE}Dave, I don't have a nose, and secondly, that's a Sushi Chef Zombie, and he makes some pretty delicious sushi,
NARRATIVE_HEIAN_7_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:WINNIE}戴夫，我没有鼻子，其次那是寿司师傅僵尸，他会做出相当美味的寿司，

NARRATIVE_HEIAN_7_INTRO_3.en: {SAY:WINNIE}it makes other zombies that eat it become more difficult to deal with.
NARRATIVE_HEIAN_7_INTRO_3.zh: {SAY:WINNIE}让其他吃下去的僵尸变得更为难缠。

NARRATIVE_HEIAN_7_INTRO_4.en:
{SAY:WINNIE}However, 
				
				 Chef Cypripedium is a super chef and is eager to have a gourmet showdown with these sushi chefs.
NARRATIVE_HEIAN_7_INTRO_4.zh: {SAY:WINNIE}不过，杓兰是一位特级厨师，正渴望着与这些寿司师傅进行美食对决。

NARRATIVE_HEIAN_7_INTRO_5.en: {SAY:WINNIE}Maybe we should get out of the way.

NARRATIVE_HEIAN_7_INTRO_6.en: {EXCITED:CRAZYDAVE}Should I ask him to make me tacos?
NARRATIVE_HEIAN_7_INTRO_6.zh: {EXCITED:CRAZYDAVE}我是不是应该请他帮我做个玉米卷？

NARRATIVE_HEROES_EVENT_001_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:greenshadow}The battle between plants and zombies has become SUPER-POWERED!
NARRATIVE_HEROES_EVENT_001_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:greenshadow}植物与僵尸之间的战争已经全面升级！

NARRATIVE_HEROES_EVENT_001_INTRO_3.en: {SAY:greenshadow}After passing these levels, you will get Cat tail!
NARRATIVE_HEROES_EVENT_001_INTRO_3.zh: {SAY:greenshadow}这一切都要拜英雄机 5000 所赐！

NARRATIVE_HEROES_EVENT_001_INTRO_8.en: {SAY:greenshadow}Well, Player, defeat SUPER BRAINZ with your plants!
NARRATIVE_HEROES_EVENT_001_INTRO_8.zh: {SAY:greenshadow}好吧，现在你面对的是——绿，影，侠！

NARRATIVE_HEROES_EVENT_001_INTRO_9.en: {SAY:greenshadow}It's an epic clash between bloom and doom!
NARRATIVE_HEROES_EVENT_001_INTRO_9.zh: {SAY:greenshadow}这是一场“盛开”与“毁灭”之间的终极较量！

NARRATIVE_HEROES_EVENT_001_OUTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:greenshadow}{NPC_ENTER:superbrainz}{SAY:greenshadow}我们会再一次面对面交锋的，超级脑僵！

NARRATIVE_HEROES_EVENT_002_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:greenshadow}穿上你们引以为豪的绿影套装！

NARRATIVE_HEROES_EVENT_002_INTRO_4.zh: {SAY:greenshadow}无穷小子！你分裂得未免太疯狂了吧！

NARRATIVE_HEROES_EVENT_002_INTRO_5.zh: {SAY:greenshadow}嘻嘻笑可不会让气氛变得更加滑稽起来！

NARRATIVE_HEROES_EVENT_003_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:solarflare}{SAY:solarflare}Hi! Good ol' SOLAR FLARE here! Let's get sunny!
NARRATIVE_HEROES_EVENT_003_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:solarflare}{SAY:solarflare}嗨～这里是相当不错的耀斑花哟！让我们一起变得晴朗吧！

NARRATIVE_HEROES_EVENT_003_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:solarflare}We're going to continue killing zombies today!
NARRATIVE_HEROES_EVENT_003_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:solarflare}今天我们要去看一批上好的装扮！

NARRATIVE_HEROES_EVENT_003_INTRO_4.en: {SAY:solarflare}Uh-oh! This is the second time you said it! Let's beat him!
NARRATIVE_HEROES_EVENT_003_INTRO_4.zh: {SAY:solarflare}啊哦！是时候照亮这个大块头了！

NARRATIVE_HEROES_EVENT_004_INTRO_2.zh: {NPC_ENTER:solarflare}{SAY:solarflare}霹雳舞王！你这个邪恶的大反派！

NARRATIVE_HEROES_EVENT_004_INTRO_3.en: {SAY:solarflare}Though I gotta say... I love those flashy duds!
NARRATIVE_HEROES_EVENT_004_INTRO_3.zh: {SAY:solarflare}不过我还是要说…我好喜欢他这身闪亮的衣服啊！

NARRATIVE_HEROES_EVENT_005_INTRO_5.zh: {SAY:wallknight}我在思考有关彩色蜡笔的事情！

NARRATIVE_HEROES_EVENT_006_INTRO_2.zh: {NPC_ENTER:impfinity}{SAY:impfinity}嘻嘻嘻，嘻嘻嘻，嘻嘻嘻，嘻嘻嘻嘻嘻嘻！

NARRATIVE_HEROES_EVENT_007_INTRO_3.zh: {SAY:impfinity}嘻嘻嘻，嘻嘻嘻，嘻嘻嘻，嘻嘻嘻嘻嘻嘻！

NARRATIVE_HEROES_EVENT_008_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:solarflare}{SAY:solarflare}当英雄机 5000 爆炸后，植物和僵尸都被变成了英雄…然后弄出了一大摊乱子！

NARRATIVE_HEROES_EVENT_008_INTRO_2.en: {NPC_ENTER:electricboogaloo}{SAY:solarflare}Stay back, if you want to be electrocuted, Electric Boogaloo!

NARRATIVE_HEROES_EVENT_008_INTRO_3.en: {SAY:solarflare}I won't be charmed by your suave charms!
NARRATIVE_HEROES_EVENT_008_INTRO_3.zh: {SAY:solarflare}我不会被你的暖男魅力所迷惑的！

NARRATIVE_HEROES_EVENT_009_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:superbrainz}{SAY:superbrainz}超级脑僵！他们无往不 月生！

NARRATIVE_HEROES_EVENT_010_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:greenshadow}{NPC_ENTER:superbrainz}{SAY:greenshadow}I knew we'd meet again, Super Brainz!
NARRATIVE_HEROES_EVENT_010_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:greenshadow}{NPC_ENTER:superbrainz}{SAY:greenshadow}我知道我们会再度会面的，超级脑僵！

NARRATIVE_HEROES_EVENT_010_INTRO_3.en: {SAY:greenshadow}Yes, I already... You know what? Forget it.
NARRATIVE_HEROES_EVENT_010_INTRO_3.zh: {SAY:greenshadow}是的，我已经准备…你有听到什么吗？赶快忘掉吧。

NARRATIVE_HEROES_EVENT_011_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:greenshadow}{NPC_ENTER:impfinity}{SAY:greenshadow}Where are the missing Hero-Tron 5000 parts, Impfinity?
NARRATIVE_HEROES_EVENT_011_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:greenshadow}{NPC_ENTER:impfinity}{SAY:greenshadow}散落的英雄机 5000 的碎片在哪里，无穷小子？

NARRATIVE_HEROES_EVENT_011_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:impfinity}喜嘻嘻，嘻嘻嘻，嘻嘻嘻嘻嘻嘻！

NARRATIVE_HEROES_EVENT_013_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:impfinity}We stole the Hero-Tron bits! Yep! Stuck em in my hat!
NARRATIVE_HEROES_EVENT_013_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:impfinity}我们偷到了英雄机的碎片！是的！他们藏在我的帽子里！

NARRATIVE_HEROES_EVENT_014_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:solarflare}{SAY:solarflare}哎呀！这些僵尸可真是顽固的老主顾啊。

NARRATIVE_HEROES_EVENT_014_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:solarflare}They just keep coming! They never stop!
NARRATIVE_HEROES_EVENT_014_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:solarflare}他们还在进攻！他们没有停手！

NARRATIVE_HEROES_EVENT_014_INTRO_4.en: {SAY:solarflare}And let's face it... their conversation is not illuminating!
NARRATIVE_HEROES_EVENT_014_INTRO_4.zh: {SAY:solarflare}让我们面对挑战吧…何他们对话可不会受什么启发！

NARRATIVE_HEROES_EVENT_015_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:greenshadow}{SAY:greenshadow}Solar Flare! Did you find the Hero-Tron components?
NARRATIVE_HEROES_EVENT_015_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:greenshadow}{SAY:greenshadow}耀斑花！你找到英雄机 5000 的零件了吗？

NARRATIVE_HEROES_EVENT_015_INTRO_10.zh: {NPC_EXIT:solarflare}{NPC_EXIT:electricboogaloo}{NPC_ENTER:impfinity}{SAY:impfinity}嘻嘻嘻，嘻嘻嘻，嘻嘻嘻，嘻嘻嘻嘻嘻嘻！

NARRATIVE_HEROES_EVENT_015_INTRO_12.en: {SAY:impfinity}...and check out Plants vs. Zombies HEROES!
NARRATIVE_HEROES_EVENT_015_INTRO_12.zh: {SAY:impfinity}那就来《植物大战僵尸：英雄》中一探究竟吧！

NARRATIVE_HEROES_EVENT_015_INTRO_2.en: {NPC_EXIT:greenshadow}{NPC_ENTER:solarflare}{SAY:solarflare}Nope! Just lots of junk! How about you, Wall-Knight?
NARRATIVE_HEROES_EVENT_015_INTRO_2.zh: {NPC_EXIT:greenshadow}{NPC_ENTER:solarflare}{SAY:solarflare}还没呢！还是只有大堆大堆的垃圾！你呢，坚果骑士？

NARRATIVE_HOCUS_EQ_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Plant Hocus Crocus to magic close zombies to the back of the lawn.
NARRATIVE_HOCUS_EQ_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}种植藏红花，用魔法将接近的僵尸传送回草坪右边。

NARRATIVE_HOLLY_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}Tap Holly Barrier, then tap the target to launch barrier leaf.
NARRATIVE_HOLLY_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}轻点冬青屏障，再轻点目标，即可发射冬青叶。

NARRATIVE_HOLLY_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:winnie}Launched attacks knock back zombies and leave prickly barriers in empty tiles.
NARRATIVE_HOLLY_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}发射的攻击物能够击退僵尸，并在空格处留下锯齿状的屏障。

NARRATIVE_HOLLY_INTRO_3.en: {SAY:winnie}Holly Barrier can launch 3 barriers and also deals prickly damage to attacking zombies!
NARRATIVE_HOLLY_INTRO_3.zh: {SAY:winnie}冬青屏障共计可发射冬青屏障 3 次，同时对向前进犯的僵尸造成如坐针毡般的伤害！

NARRATIVE_HOMINGTHISTLE_EQ_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Plant Homing Thistles to target zombies closest to your house.
NARRATIVE_HOMINGTHISTLE_EQ_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}种植导向蓟，自动锁定离你房子最近的僵尸。

NARRATIVE_HYPNOSHROOM_EQ_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}When zombies eat Hypno-shrooms, they will turn around and fight for you.
NARRATIVE_HYPNOSHROOM_EQ_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}僵尸吃掉魅惑菇后，会成为你的盟友，为你战斗。

NARRATIVE_HYPNOSHROOM_EQ_PF_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Use Plant Food to supercharge the Hypno-Shroom and transform any zombie that eats it into a Gargantuar!
NARRATIVE_HYPNOSHROOM_EQ_PF_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}为魅惑菇施用叶绿素进行强化，把任意吃掉它的僵尸变为巨人僵尸！

NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_INTRO_CHARDGUARD_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}These Cave Zombies sure are hard headed.
NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_INTRO_CHARDGUARD_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}这些冰窟僵尸的脑袋可真是顽固而僵硬。

NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_INTRO_CHARDGUARD_2.en: {TIRED:crazydave}They just won't take "no brains" for an answer.
NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_INTRO_CHARDGUARD_2.zh: {TIRED:crazydave}他们绝不会以“不要脑子”作为回复！

NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_INTRO_CHARDGUARD_3.en: {PLAYFUL:winnie}According to my data, Neanderthal zombie skulls are 33.2 percent harder than other zombie skulls.
NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_INTRO_CHARDGUARD_3.zh: {PLAYFUL:winnie}我的数据显示，这些野蛮的穴居僵尸头骨比其他的硬 33.2%。

NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_INTRO_CHARDGUARD_4.en: {SAY:winnie}I propose we deploy Chard Guard. He has a secret up his leaves.
NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_INTRO_CHARDGUARD_4.zh: {SAY:winnie}我建议部署甜菜护卫。他长出的叶子上有着惊人的秘密。

NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_INTRO_CHARDGUARD_5.en: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}You mean his ol' Knock 'Em Dead maneuver?
NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_INTRO_CHARDGUARD_5.zh: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}你是指他的老招牌——“只管撞死他们”那一招？

NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_INTRO_CHARDGUARD_6.en: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}It’ll knock those zombies back where they came from!
NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_INTRO_CHARDGUARD_6.zh: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}它会把僵尸击退回他们来时经过的地方！

NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_INTRO_CHARDGUARD_7.en: {TIRED:winnie}I guess it's not a secret any more, now is it User Dave?
NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_INTRO_CHARDGUARD_7.zh: {TIRED:winnie}我想这现在已经不是个秘密了，对吧戴夫？

NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_INTRO_FIREPEASHOOTER_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:winnie}W-w-warning, User Dave! I am r-r-running l-l-low on antifreeze!
NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_INTRO_FIREPEASHOOTER_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:winnie}警—警——警告，用户戴夫！防冻剂储—储—量不—不—足！

NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_INTRO_FIREPEASHOOTER_2.en: {TIRED:winnie}If my systems f-f-f-freeeze up, we could be stuck here forever!
NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_INTRO_FIREPEASHOOTER_2.zh: {TIRED:winnie}一旦我的系统完全被冻—冻—冻住了，我们可能永远被困在这里的！

NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_INTRO_FIREPEASHOOTER_3.en: {EXCITED:crazydave}It'll be a cold day in heck before I let that happen, Penny!
NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_INTRO_FIREPEASHOOTER_3.zh: {EXCITED:crazydave}潘妮，在我亮出我的法宝之前，今日依旧是个该死的大冷天！

NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_INTRO_FIREPEASHOOTER_4.zh: {SAY:crazydave}是时候释放火焰豌豆的能量了！

NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_INTRO_FIREPEASHOOTER_5.en: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}She can apply heat to those zombies, and warm up nearby pals too!
NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_INTRO_FIREPEASHOOTER_5.zh: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}她可以烧伤那些僵尸。不仅如此，她还能温暖四周的植物！

NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_INTRO_FIRSTLEVEL_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{PLAYFUL:crazydave}Brrrrr. It's colder than a polar bear eating an ice pop!
NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_INTRO_FIRSTLEVEL_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{PLAYFUL:crazydave}呃呃呃呃呃…呆在这简直比北极熊吃冰棒还要冷啊！

NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_INTRO_FIRSTLEVEL_2.en: {SAY:winnie}Indeed. It appears we have arrived in the Frostbite Caves.
NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_INTRO_FIRSTLEVEL_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}没错。这说明我们已经抵达了极寒冰窟。

NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_INTRO_FIRSTLEVEL_3.en: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}We've traveled so far back in history ... we've arrived in PREhistory!
NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_INTRO_FIRSTLEVEL_3.zh: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}我们竟然穿越到了这么古老的地方…我们回到了史前时期！

NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_INTRO_FIRSTLEVEL_4.en: {SAY:winnie}A historic moment indeed, User Dave. But more importantly...
NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_INTRO_FIRSTLEVEL_4.zh: {SAY:winnie}这确实是一段有着深远影响的重要时期，用户戴夫。但是更为重要的是…

NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_INTRO_FIRSTLEVEL_5.en: {EXCITED:winnie}My sensors indicate there is an ice floe on the lawn.
NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_INTRO_FIRSTLEVEL_5.zh: {EXCITED:winnie}我的传感器检测到草坪上有一块浮冰。

NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_INTRO_FIRSTLEVEL_6.en: {SAY:winnie}Data suggests it will block both plants and zombies.
NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_INTRO_FIRSTLEVEL_6.zh: {SAY:winnie}数据显示，它可以阻挡植物与僵尸。

NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_INTRO_FIRSTLEVEL_7.en: {EXCITED:winnie}Though I predict hungry zombies will find a way around it.
NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_INTRO_FIRSTLEVEL_7.zh: {EXCITED:winnie}尽管我猜那些饥饿的僵尸会寻找通路绕过这块障碍。

NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_INTRO_FIRSTLEVEL_8.en: {SAY:crazydave}Don't worry. We'll plant wisely and stop those zombies COLD!
NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_INTRO_FIRSTLEVEL_8.zh: {SAY:crazydave}别担心，只要我们沉着思考，就一定能把这些僵尸封印在这岁月中！

NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_INTRO_FLAMETHROWER_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{TIRED:crazydave}Global cooling is the pits. What we need is a heat wave!
NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_INTRO_FLAMETHROWER_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{TIRED:crazydave}全球气候变冷的形势愈发严峻了！我们需要一股热浪！

NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_INTRO_FLAMETHROWER_2.en: {SAY:winnie}Agreed. Please note, I have now replaced the snowballs with fireballs.
NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_INTRO_FLAMETHROWER_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}确实。你有注意到吗，我已经把雪球指更换成火焰指了。

NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_INTRO_FLAMETHROWER_3.en: {SAY:winnie}The Flamethrower power-up melts frost and damages zombies too.
NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_INTRO_FLAMETHROWER_3.zh: {SAY:winnie}火焰指既可以融化被寒风冻结住的东西，还可以对僵尸造成伤害。

NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_INTRO_FLAMETHROWER_4.en: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}Neat-o! You know, they say revenge is a dish best served cold.
NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_INTRO_FLAMETHROWER_4.zh: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}好耶！大家都说“横眉冷对千夫指”…“君子报仇十年不晚”…

NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_INTRO_FLAMETHROWER_5.en: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}But I say it's best served hot. Fiery hot! With extra hot sauce.
NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_INTRO_FLAMETHROWER_5.zh: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}但我感觉“热对”才是“快意仇恨”的最优解嘛。大火快煮，再来点儿辣酱！

NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_INTRO_FLAMETHROWER_6.zh: {EXCITED:crazydave}然后玉米卷这个小点心就出炉了！

NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_INTRO_GARGANTUAR_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}Me Zomboss. Me write you another threatening note.
NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_INTRO_GARGANTUAR_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}我，僵始王。在此予你另一封恐吓信。

NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_INTRO_GARGANTUAR_2.en: {SAY:zombossicon}You in trouble. Biiiiig trouble. Gargantuan trouble, in fact!
NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_INTRO_GARGANTUAR_2.zh: {SAY:zombossicon}你摊上大事了！大麻烦！不对，我应该说是“巨”麻烦！“巨人”般的麻烦！

NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_INTRO_GARGANTUAR_3.en: {SAY:zombossicon}Sloth Gargantuar smash! Smash your tiny, shivering plants!
NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_INTRO_GARGANTUAR_3.zh: {SAY:zombossicon}他，地懒巨人！会碾碎你那弱小、可怜又无助的植物！

NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_INTRO_GARGANTUAR_4.en: {SAY:zombossicon}Sloth Gargantuar deliver prehistoric plague of Imps!
NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_INTRO_GARGANTUAR_4.zh: {SAY:zombossicon}凶猛如斯，他还会投掷数只史前小鬼来瓦解你的防线！

NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_INTRO_GARGANTUAR_5.zh: {SAY:zombossicon}祝你一路顺风，半路失踪！谨启 僵始王博士

NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_INTRO_GARGANTUAR_6.en: {NPC_EXIT:zombossicon}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}I postulate evolution will never come to that zombie.
NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_INTRO_GARGANTUAR_6.zh: {NPC_EXIT:zombossicon}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}我觉得那只恹恹狂啸的僵尸应该进化不出什么新成果了。

NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_INTRO_GARGANTUAR_7.en: {SAY:crazydave}Not in a million, billion, gazillion years.
NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_INTRO_GARGANTUAR_7.zh: {SAY:crazydave}至少上百万、百亿，百兆年里都没有可能了。

NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_INTRO_HURRIKALE_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}My data suggests Hurrikale would be of great use here.
NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_INTRO_HURRIKALE_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}我的数据显示，飓风甘蓝在这里用处极大。

NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_INTRO_HURRIKALE_2.en: {EXCITED:crazydave}A blast of air from him, and the zombies will chill out and slow down!
NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_INTRO_HURRIKALE_2.zh: {EXCITED:crazydave}一阵飓风吹过，就能让僵尸后退并受到冷缓效果！

NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_INTRO_HURRIKALE_3.en: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}The guy's a real blow hard. And I mean that in the nicest way possible.
NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_INTRO_HURRIKALE_3.zh: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}这家伙可真能“吹”啊！…我指的是字面意思…

NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_INTRO_ICEBLOCKS_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}Don't look now, Penny, but those plants have a bad case of freezer burn!
NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_INTRO_ICEBLOCKS_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}别再左顾右盼了，潘妮。我们的植物陷入了令人沮丧的冻伤状态！

NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_INTRO_ICEBLOCKS_2.en: {TIRED:winnie}It's the freezing winds from this time period. They've immobilized the plants.
NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_INTRO_ICEBLOCKS_2.zh: {TIRED:winnie}这个时代的寒冷气流…他们还冻住了植物。

NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_INTRO_ICEBLOCKS_3.en: {EXCITED:winnie}I suggest we call on Hot Potato. She can melt those ice blocks.
NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_INTRO_ICEBLOCKS_3.zh: {EXCITED:winnie}我建议我们拜访热土豆，她能够融化掉那些冰块。

NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_INTRO_ICEBLOCKS_4.en: {SAY:crazydave}I'm warming up to the idea already!
NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_INTRO_ICEBLOCKS_4.zh: {SAY:crazydave}我已经准备热身来实施这个方法了！

NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_INTRO_MINIGAME_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}{SAY:crazydave}It's too quiet. Where is everyone? I have a bad feeling about this.
NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_INTRO_MINIGAME_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}{SAY:crazydave}这里未免寂静过头了。大家都去哪了？我对此有种不好的预感。

NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_INTRO_MINIGAME_2.en: {SAY:winnie}My sensors indicate there are zombies hiding under the ice.
NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_INTRO_MINIGAME_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}我的传感器显示这里有不少僵尸正藏在冰块中。

NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_INTRO_MINIGAME_3.en: {SAY:crazydave}I know this game! They call it Hide & Eat Brains.
NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_INTRO_MINIGAME_3.zh: {SAY:crazydave}我知道这个游戏叫什么！僵尸称其为“食脑躲猫猫”。

NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_INTRO_MINIGAME_4.en: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}Time for a game of our own: I call it Whack-A-Zombie.
NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_INTRO_MINIGAME_4.zh: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}知道我们称其是什么吗？我愿称其为——“锤僵尸”。

NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_INTRO_MINIGAME_5.en: {SAY:winnie}Whack them good and they will surely drop better hammers.
NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_INTRO_MINIGAME_5.zh: {SAY:winnie}好好锤那些家伙吧！打得好的话，肯定会掉下来更好的锤子的。

NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_INTRO_MINIGAME_6.en: {SAY:crazydave}I'm sorry. Can't help it. Have to say it. It's ... hammer time.
NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_INTRO_MINIGAME_6.zh: {SAY:crazydave}抱歉，控制不住，一定要说：现在是…锤子时间。

NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_INTRO_PEPPERPULT_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{TIRED:crazydave}I'm starting to get cold feet about this place.
NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_INTRO_PEPPERPULT_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{TIRED:crazydave}我已经开始对这冷到极点的鬼地方感到害怕了。

NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_INTRO_PEPPERPULT_2.en: {SAY:crazydave}Also, my feet are getting really cold.
NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_INTRO_PEPPERPULT_2.zh: {SAY:crazydave}并且，我的脚上的冻疮也是这么想的…

NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_INTRO_PEPPERPULT_3.en: {PLAYFUL:winnie}Time to turn up the heat. I recommend Pepper-pult for the job.
NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_INTRO_PEPPERPULT_3.zh: {PLAYFUL:winnie}是时候添把柴火了。我认为辣椒投手能够胜任这个职务。

NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_INTRO_PEPPERPULT_4.en: {SAY:winnie}He lobs hot peppers at zombies and also keeps nearby plants warm.
NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_INTRO_PEPPERPULT_4.zh: {SAY:winnie}他能够向僵尸投掷甜椒，并且使邻近的植物保持温暖。

NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_INTRO_PEPPERPULT_5.en: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}Let's pick a peck of Pepper-pults! It's the perfect plant for our predicament!
NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_INTRO_PEPPERPULT_5.zh: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}快来采一菜篮子辣椒投手！它能解决我们所有的忧愁！

NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_INTRO_PEPPERPULT_6.en: {TIRED:winnie}Must you rhyme, User Dave? Must you?
NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_INTRO_PEPPERPULT_6.zh: {TIRED:winnie}你说话一定要押韵吗，用户戴夫？一定要吗？

NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_INTRO_STUNION_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{TIRED:crazydave}I wish these prehistoric zombies would just go back to their caves.
NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_INTRO_STUNION_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{TIRED:crazydave}我真希望那些史前僵尸回到他们的洞穴中。

NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_INTRO_STUNION_2.en: {EXCITED:winnie}User Dave, perhaps it's time to try a new tactic.
