NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_INTRO_STUNION_2.zh: {EXCITED:winnie}用户戴夫，也许是时候尝试一种新的战略了。

NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_INTRO_STUNION_3.en: {SAY:winnie}Data suggests Stunion would make for a ... potent ... ally here.
NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_INTRO_STUNION_3.zh: {SAY:winnie}资料显示眩晕洋葱在这儿肯定是一位…烈性的…盟友。

NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_INTRO_STUNION_4.en: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}Great idea, Penny! That guy's breath is stunning!
NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_INTRO_STUNION_4.zh: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}真是个好主意！潘妮！这家伙的一呼一吸令僵尸为之倾倒！

NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_INTRO_STUNION_5.en: {SAY:crazydave}Not even exaggerating. He stuns zombies ... with his bad breath.
NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_INTRO_STUNION_5.zh: {SAY:crazydave}这可不是夸张的说法。他利用那令人作呕的口臭…使僵尸眩晕。

NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_INTRO_XSHOT_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}Penny, what we need right now is a nice hot cup o' cocoa!
NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_INTRO_XSHOT_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}潘妮，我们现在需要一杯热可可！

NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_INTRO_XSHOT_2.en: {SAY:winnie}User Dave, that is an unproven zombie-fighting weapon.
NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_INTRO_XSHOT_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}用户戴夫，我们这里有一种能与僵尸匹敌的无名利器。

NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_INTRO_XSHOT_3.en: {SAY:winnie}I recommend we call on Rotobaga instead.

NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_INTRO_XSHOT_4.en: {EXCITED:winnie}She can hover above ground AND shoot at zombies in four directions!
NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_INTRO_XSHOT_4.zh: {EXCITED:winnie}她能够在低空盘旋，并向四个方向发射子弹攻击僵尸！

NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_INTRO_XSHOT_5.en: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}Kid's got talent! Maybe she knows how to make hot cocoa too?
NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_INTRO_XSHOT_5.zh: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}这姑娘有前途！也许她也知道该如何制作热可可？

NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}Gurrreetings! Dr. Zomboss have prehistoric question for pitiful plant friends.
NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}你们吼哇——！僵始王博士想问问那些凄惨的植物朋友一个来自史前问题！

NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_2.en: {SAY:zombossicon}Why you hunt for taco? Is taco all it cracked up to be?
NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_2.zh: {SAY:zombossicon}找玉米卷干啥子？它真的像你们吹捧得那么美味吗？

NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_3.en: {SAY:zombossicon}Could it be ... trap? Could it be ... trick?
NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_3.zh: {SAY:zombossicon}也许这是…一个骗局？也许这是…一个阴谋？

NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_4.zh: {SAY:zombossicon}深思熟虑一下这个问题吧！呜哇哇哈哈哈！呜嘎——呜嘎！

NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_6.en: {TIRED:winnie}User Dave, ignore the taco. Ignore the taunts.
NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_6.zh: {TIRED:winnie}用户戴夫，请先忘记玉米卷…忘却他人的嘲讽。

NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_7.zh: {EXCITED:winnie}因为是时候与僵王博士开战了！

NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_OUTRO_DANGER_ROOM_KEY_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED: winnie}User Dave, I've detected an incoming ice cube.
NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_OUTRO_DANGER_ROOM_KEY_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:winnie}用户戴夫，我探测到了一块刚到货的“冰立方”。

NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_OUTRO_DANGER_ROOM_KEY_2.zh: {EXCITED:crazydave}分明是一块向我挥来冰锥的断臂。

NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_OUTRO_DANGER_ROOM_KEY_3.en: {SAY:winnie}Analysis suggests this creepy cube unlocks a chilly challenge.
NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_OUTRO_DANGER_ROOM_KEY_3.zh: {SAY:winnie}分析表明，这块令人毛骨悚然的冰立方能够解锁一项寒风刺骨的挑战。

NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_OUTRO_DANGER_ROOM_KEY_4.en: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}You know what I say? Brrrrr-ing it on!
NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_OUTRO_DANGER_ROOM_KEY_4.zh: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}你居然听懂了我在哆嗦着什么？让让让…让我们壮壮壮壮壮壮一下胆吧！

NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:winnie}Well done. We have defeated Dr. Zomboss.
NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:winnie}干得漂亮！我们已经击败了僵始王博士。

NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_2.en: {EXCITED:crazydave}And his attempt to make me question my taco!
NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_2.zh: {EXCITED:crazydave}他居然试图让我质疑自己的玉米卷！

NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_4.en: {SAY:winnie}You know that it is about more than just a taco.
NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_4.zh: {SAY:winnie}你知道这不仅仅关乎于一个玉米卷。

NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_5.en: {TIRED:crazydave}I suppose you're right, Penny. It's also about-

NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_7.en: {SAY:zombossicon}Dr. Zomboss crawl back from brink of destruction!
NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_7.zh: {SAY:zombossicon}僵始王博士将从毁灭的边缘再度爬回！

NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_8.en: {SAY:zombossicon}Dr. Zomboss return when you no expect him. Bring BIG SURPRISE!
NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_8.zh: {SAY:zombossicon}僵王博士在你意想不到的时候卷土重来，给你带来一份大！惊！喜！

NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_9.en: {SAY:zombossicon}Dr. Zomboss stop speaking about self in third-person now! Guuudbye!
NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_9.zh: {SAY:zombossicon}僵王博士不想再以第三人称的方式自吹自擂了！再见了戴夫~今日我就要远航~

NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_ZOMBIENOTE_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydaveicon}{TIRED:crazydaveicon}Penny, hath you ever tried licking an ice-thickle and got your tongue thtuck to it?
NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_ZOMBIENOTE_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydaveicon}{TIRED:crazydaveicon}潘妮，你有没有在疲倦时舔冰棍儿，并且用舌头把它卷起来的习惯嘞？

NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_ZOMBIENOTE_2.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnieicon}{TIRED:winnieicon}不。用户戴夫，我没有这个习惯，也没有舌头。

NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_ZOMBIENOTE_3.en: {SAY:crazydaveicon}Uh ... me neither. Thath would be craaaazthy.
NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_ZOMBIENOTE_3.zh: {SAY:crazydaveicon}唔…我也不会。毕竟这听起来实在是太风——狂了。

NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_ZOMBIENOTE_4.en: {SAY:winnieicon}Sigh. While your tongue heals, please note the strange stone tablet.
NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_ZOMBIENOTE_4.zh: {SAY:winnieicon}唉…在你舌头愈合着的时候，请注意这块奇怪的远古石碑。

NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_ZOMBIENOTE_5.en: {SAY:winnieicon}It appears to be a warning sign, written in Cave Zombie.
NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_ZOMBIENOTE_5.zh: {SAY:winnieicon}这似乎是个警告标识，是洞穴僵尸的杰作。

NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_ZOMBIENOTE_6.en: {PLAYFUL:crazydaveicon}Doesth it warn people not to lick ice-thickles?
NARRATIVE_ICEAGE_ZOMBIENOTE_6.zh: {PLAYFUL:crazydaveicon}它系不系在警告世人不要用舌头舔冰棍啊？

NARRATIVE_ICEBERG_UNLOCK_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:crazydave}Those torchy Explorer Zombies are rude and inflammatory!
NARRATIVE_ICEBERG_UNLOCK_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:crazydave}那些举着火把的探险家僵尸真是粗鲁，让人火大！

NARRATIVE_ICEBERG_UNLOCK_2.zh: {SAY:crazydave}要是我们能冻灭他的火就好了！

NARRATIVE_ICEWEED_EQ_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}种植寒冰地刺，冷缓僵尸，并对它们造成伤害！
NARRATIVE_ICEWEED_EQ_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}种植寒冰地刺，冷缓僵尸，并对它们造成伤害！

NARRATIVE_INFERNO_EQ_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Plant Infernos to burn and push back zombies.
NARRATIVE_INFERNO_EQ_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}种植地狱火蕨，烧伤僵尸，并把它们往回推。

NARRATIVE_INTRODUCE_TUTORIAL_10.en: {SAY:winnie}If you want to experience the original Chinese version of the plants, please support the official CN version! Thank you!
NARRATIVE_INTRODUCE_TUTORIAL_10.zh: {SAY:winnie}如果你想体验原版的中文版植物，请多多支持中文版正版游戏！

NARRATIVE_INTRODUCE_TUTORIAL_11.en: {SAY:crazydave}Alright, it's time to set off! Taco, here I come!!!
NARRATIVE_INTRODUCE_TUTORIAL_11.zh: {SAY:crazydave}好了,是时候出发了，玉米卷，我来了！！！

NARRATIVE_INTRODUCE_TUTORIAL_3.en: {SAY:crazydave}Welcome back to the initial time, where huge adventures unfold.
NARRATIVE_INTRODUCE_TUTORIAL_3.zh: {SAY:crazydave}欢迎回到最初的时间点，后面的冒险有了很多变化。

NARRATIVE_INTRODUCE_TUTORIAL_4.en: {SAY:winnie}Meanwhile, your plant attributes have also been adjusted.
NARRATIVE_INTRODUCE_TUTORIAL_4.zh: {SAY:winnie}与此同时，你的植物属性也被调整了。

NARRATIVE_INTRODUCE_TUTORIAL_5.en: {SAY:crazydave}Although the levels have changed, SHUTTLE's essence remains: CHALLENGING!
NARRATIVE_INTRODUCE_TUTORIAL_5.zh: {SAY:crazydave}虽然关卡大改了，但是SHUTTLE的本色未变:难！

NARRATIVE_INTRODUCE_TUTORIAL_6.en: {SAY:winnie}But I believe, with your intelligence and wit, you will surely be able to clear the level :)
NARRATIVE_INTRODUCE_TUTORIAL_6.zh: {SAY:winnie}可是我相信，以你的聪明才智，一定能通关:)

NARRATIVE_INTRODUCE_TUTORIAL_7.en: {SAY:crazydave}The developers have also optimized the gaming experience, fixing numerous bugs.
NARRATIVE_INTRODUCE_TUTORIAL_7.zh: {SAY:crazydave}作者们也优化了游戏体验，修复了许多漏洞。

NARRATIVE_INTRODUCE_TUTORIAL_8.en: {SAY:winnie}According to my data, the difficulty of the late world is variable. You can choose the order in which to challenge them.
NARRATIVE_INTRODUCE_TUTORIAL_8.zh: {SAY:winnie}根据计算，后期世界难度不定，可以有选择地选择先后闯关，但是海盗港湾和后院马戏团难度较高，你可以选择最后闯关。

NARRATIVE_INTRODUCE_TUTORIAL_9.en: {SAY:crazydave}Due to hardcoding issues, some CN things are no longer the same in SHUTTLE.
NARRATIVE_INTRODUCE_TUTORIAL_9.zh: {SAY:crazydave}需要说明的是，该版本移植的中文版植物的部分特性由于源码问题不再存在。

NARRATIVE_JACKOLANTERN_LOD_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Tap Jack O' Lantern for a burst of flame.
NARRATIVE_JACKOLANTERN_LOD_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}轻点南瓜灯可以产生一道火焰。

NARRATIVE_JACKOLANTERN_LOD_2.en: {SAY:winnie}Tap and HOLD for an extended burst that does increasing damage!
NARRATIVE_JACKOLANTERN_LOD_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}按住不放，即可长时间喷射更高伤害的烈焰！

NARRATIVE_JOUST_UNLOCK_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydaveicon}{NPC_ENTER:winnieicon}{SAY:winnieicon}User Dave. I have detected a new rift has opened. We are now able to access an "Arena."
NARRATIVE_JOUST_UNLOCK_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydaveicon}{NPC_ENTER:winnieicon}{SAY:winnieicon}用户戴夫。我探测到一条新的时空裂缝已经打开。我们现在可以进入“竞技场”了。

NARRATIVE_JOUST_UNLOCK_2.en: {EXCITED:crazydaveicon}Arena?! That sounds like an arborena of gardening warfare!
NARRATIVE_JOUST_UNLOCK_2.zh: {EXCITED:crazydaveicon}竞技场？！ 这似乎成功地让我们在这场花园大战中停下了脚步！

NARRATIVE_JOUST_UNLOCK_3.en: {SAY:winnieicon}Arena will allow us to demonstrate our planting prowess for prestige and prizes.
NARRATIVE_JOUST_UNLOCK_3.zh: {SAY:winnieicon}竞技场能让我们展示自己的种植能力来获得奖励。

NARRATIVE_JOUST_UNLOCK_4.en: {SAY:crazydaveicon}That's a lot of peas! That's how I know it's good.
NARRATIVE_JOUST_UNLOCK_4.zh: {SAY:crazydaveicon}豌豆真多！我从这里就可以知道这很棒了。

NARRATIVE_KIWIBEAST_EQ_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}野兽猕猴桃的弹跳重击会给予僵尸伤害。

NARRATIVE_KIWIBEAST_EQ_2.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}They become more powerful as they take damage from zombies.
NARRATIVE_KIWIBEAST_EQ_2.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}当他们受到更多伤害时，进攻会变得更为猛烈。

NARRATIVE_LAWNBOWL_LTE_2023_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SHOUT:zomboss_r}Muhahaaha! I have you this time. You won’t be escaping my grasp.
NARRATIVE_LAWNBOWL_LTE_2023_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SHOUT:zomboss_r}木哈哈哈！这次我终于逮住你们了。你们是逃不出我的手掌心的。

NARRATIVE_LAWNBOWL_LTE_2023_1_2.en: {NPC_EXIT:zomboss_r}{NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:peashooter}We’re ready for anything you can throw at us!
NARRATIVE_LAWNBOWL_LTE_2023_1_2.zh: {NPC_EXIT:zomboss_r}{NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:peashooter}无论你想耍什么花招，我们都会从容应对！

NARRATIVE_LAWNBOWL_LTE_2023_1_3.en: {NPC_ENTER:wallnut_r}{SAY:wallnut_r}Yeah! I will block all your passes.

NARRATIVE_LAWNBOWL_LTE_2023_2_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SHOUT:zomboss_r}木哈哈！看清楚了！我最新的翻——新发明！

NARRATIVE_LAWNBOWL_LTE_2023_2_3.en: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:peashooter}You don’t scare us! Wall-nut will block anything you can throw at us.
NARRATIVE_LAWNBOWL_LTE_2023_2_3.zh: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:peashooter}你才吓不到我们呢！无论你想投什么花球，坚果墙都能为我们挡住。

NARRATIVE_LAWNBOWL_LTE_2023_2_5.en: {NPC_EXIT:wallnut}{SAY:zomboss_r}Ho, Ho! My Catapults can lob over all your silly little nut walls.
NARRATIVE_LAWNBOWL_LTE_2023_2_5.zh: {NPC_EXIT:wallnut}{SAY:zomboss_r}嚯，嚯！我的投球车可以把球轻轻松松投过你们那呆呆坚果的小身板。

NARRATIVE_LAWNBOWL_LTE_2023_3_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:peashooter}Time is up Zomboss! And we won’t be going into overtime!
NARRATIVE_LAWNBOWL_LTE_2023_3_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:peashooter}时间到了，僵王！我们才不会让你有加时机会的！

NARRATIVE_LAWNBOWL_LTE_2023_3_2.en: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}Curses! Don’t think you’ve won this match. I have plenty more inventions coming.
NARRATIVE_LAWNBOWL_LTE_2023_3_2.zh: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}呸！别以为你们就此胜利了。我还有更多发明在路上。

NARRATIVE_LAWNBOWL_LTE_2023_3_3.en: {NPC_EXIT:zomboss_r}{SAY:peashooter}Bring it on! We’ll score goals every time and send you packing.
NARRATIVE_LAWNBOWL_LTE_2023_3_3.zh: {NPC_EXIT:zomboss_r}{SAY:peashooter}放马过来吧！我们可不会空球，而你，也别想久留。

NARRATIVE_LAWNBOWL_LTE_2023_3_4.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave_r}{SAY:crazydave_r}哈？我是不是有错过什么派对？

NARRATIVE_LAWNBOWL_LTE_2024_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}Ah, you plucky plants, this time you will taste defeat in epic proportions.
NARRATIVE_LAWNBOWL_LTE_2024_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}啊，你们这帮肆意妄为的植物，这次终于轮到你们尝尝失败的滋味了。

NARRATIVE_LAWNBOWL_LTE_2024_1_2.en: {NPC_EXIT:zomboss_r}{NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:peashooter}Bring it on Zomboss, our game plan is as strong as ever.
NARRATIVE_LAWNBOWL_LTE_2024_1_2.zh: {NPC_EXIT:zomboss_r}{NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:peashooter}放马过来吧，僵王，我们的比赛计划攻无不克。

NARRATIVE_LAWNBOWL_LTE_2024_1_3.en: {NPC_ENTER:sunflower_r}{SAY:sunflower_r}You may have an army, but weee aree the champions.
NARRATIVE_LAWNBOWL_LTE_2024_1_3.zh: {NPC_ENTER:sunflower_r}{SAY:sunflower_r}你是千军之统领，而我们——我们是冠军。

NARRATIVE_LAWNBOWL_LTE_2024_1_4.en: {NPC_EXIT:peashooter}{NPC_EXIT:sunflower_r}{NPC_ENTER:wallnut}{SAY:wallnut}Guys, guys, guys, let's keep calm and...

NARRATIVE_LAWNBOWL_LTE_2024_2_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:crazydave}嘿僵王，刚刚的达阵，如何评价？

NARRATIVE_LAWNBOWL_LTE_2024_2_2.en: {NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}Blast it all! You may have scored this round...
NARRATIVE_LAWNBOWL_LTE_2024_2_2.zh: {NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}真该死！这次你们可能确实顺利得分了…

NARRATIVE_LAWNBOWL_LTE_2024_2_3.en: {SAY:zomboss_r}...but mark my words, next time I'll be the one to astound.
NARRATIVE_LAWNBOWL_LTE_2024_2_3.zh: {SAY:zomboss_r}...不过记住，下次技惊四座的是我。

NARRATIVE_LAWNBOWL_LTE_2024_2_4.en: {NPC_EXIT:zomboss_r}{NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:peashooter}You forgot that our line up is legendary, we aren't losing that easily.
NARRATIVE_LAWNBOWL_LTE_2024_2_4.zh: {NPC_EXIT:zomboss_r}{NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:peashooter}你忘了我的的阵容有多么一流吧，我们才没那么容易失守呢。

NARRATIVE_LAWNDOOM101_2.en: {SAY:winnie}Never fear, User Dave. She is on our side.
NARRATIVE_LAWNDOOM101_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}不必害怕，用户戴夫。她是我们这边的。

NARRATIVE_LAWNDOOM101_3.en: {SAY:crazydave}But she can scare a GRAVESTONE to death!

NARRATIVE_LAWNDOOM101_4.en: {SAY:crazydave}I practically poop just thinking about it!

NARRATIVE_LAWNDOOM102_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}呆瓜戴夫一直在阻挠我的计划！

NARRATIVE_LAWNDOOM102_2.en: {SAY:zombossicon}Perhaps I can turn his superstition against him? Make FEAR my weapon?
NARRATIVE_LAWNDOOM102_2.zh: {SAY:zombossicon}也许我可以利用他的恐惧来对付他？把恐惧作为我的武器？

NARRATIVE_LAWNDOOM102_3.en: {SAY:zombossicon}I shall dress my zombie minions in frightful garments!
NARRATIVE_LAWNDOOM102_3.zh: {SAY:zombossicon}我要给我的僵尸爪牙们穿上可怕的衣服！

NARRATIVE_LAWNDOOM103_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}I'm frightened, Penny! The zombies are wearing scary outfits!
NARRATIVE_LAWNDOOM103_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}潘妮，我好害怕！僵尸穿的衣服好吓人哦！

NARRATIVE_LAWNDOOM103_4.en: {SAY:winnie}We are fully three days into this Lawn of Doom event.
NARRATIVE_LAWNDOOM103_4.zh: {SAY:winnie}末日草坪活动已经持续满满三天了。

NARRATIVE_LAWNDOOM104_2.en: {SAY:crazydave}Does that give them the power of zombies AND skeletons?
NARRATIVE_LAWNDOOM104_2.zh: {SAY:crazydave}这会不会让它们同时拥有僵尸和骷髅的力量？

NARRATIVE_LAWNDOOM104_3.en: {SAY:winnie}Zombies already have skeletons, User Dave. On the inside.
NARRATIVE_LAWNDOOM104_3.zh: {SAY:winnie}僵尸们本来就有骷髅，用户戴夫。在它们的身体里面。

NARRATIVE_LAWNDOOM105_2.zh: {SAY:crazydave}巫术金缕梅的魔力太太太太太可怕了！

NARRATIVE_LAWNDOOM106_2.en: {SAY:zombossicon}The fear and terror of the Lawn of Doom grows thicker by the night!
NARRATIVE_LAWNDOOM106_2.zh: {SAY:zombossicon}末日草坪的恐惧和恐怖在夜间变得更强烈了！

NARRATIVE_LAWNDOOM106_3.en: {SAY:zombossicon}Soon it shall spread in new directions dire!
NARRATIVE_LAWNDOOM106_3.zh: {SAY:zombossicon}不久，它就会向着一个恐怖的新的方向延伸的！

NARRATIVE_LAWNDOOM107_3.en: {SAY:winnie}I think you are right, User Dave!

NARRATIVE_LAWNDOOM107_4.zh: {SAY:winnie}不仅如此，你的恐惧还会传染！

NARRATIVE_LAWNDOOM107_5.zh: {SAY:winnie}我平时说话很少带这么多感叹号！

NARRATIVE_LAWNDOOM108_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}I am not supposed to feel afraid, User Dave!
NARRATIVE_LAWNDOOM108_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}我根本不应该感到恐惧，用户戴夫！

NARRATIVE_LAWNDOOM108_2.en: {SAY:winnie}I assumed my mechanical nature protects me from such emotions!
NARRATIVE_LAWNDOOM108_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}我以为我的机械构造可以保护我免受这种情绪的影响！

NARRATIVE_LAWNDOOM109_2.en: {SAY:crazydave}You're the smart one who never loses it!
NARRATIVE_LAWNDOOM109_2.zh: {SAY:crazydave}你是那种永远不会失去理智的家伙啊！

NARRATIVE_LAWNDOOM109_3.en: {SAY:crazydave}If you're scared what happens to ME?

NARRATIVE_LAWNDOOM110_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}Listen, Penny! A message from Witch Hazel for you!
NARRATIVE_LAWNDOOM110_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}听着，潘妮！巫术金缕梅给了你一些消息！

NARRATIVE_LAWNDOOM110_3.en: {SAY:crazydave}"My mysterious magic transforms zombi into fungi!"
NARRATIVE_LAWNDOOM110_3.zh: {SAY:crazydave}“我的神秘魔法可以把僵尸变成蘑菇！”

NARRATIVE_LAWNDOOM110_4.zh: {SAY:crazydave}这很鼓舞人心，对吧？是不是很有意思？

NARRATIVE_LAWNDOOM111_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}Look, Penny! Another message, from Ghost Pepper:
NARRATIVE_LAWNDOOM111_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}快看啊，潘妮！又来了一条信息，是幽灵辣椒给你的：

NARRATIVE_LAWNDOOM111_2.en: {SAY:crazydave}"Dear Ms. Penny Vehicle, do not fear."
NARRATIVE_LAWNDOOM111_2.zh: {SAY:crazydave}“亲爱的潘妮·车女士，请不要害怕。”

NARRATIVE_LAWNDOOM111_3.en: {SAY:crazydave}"Fear corrodes the mind, and can even shatter stone."
NARRATIVE_LAWNDOOM111_3.zh: {SAY:crazydave}“恐惧可以腐蚀心灵，甚至还能粉碎石头。”

NARRATIVE_LAWNDOOM111_4.en: {SAY:crazydave}Okay, thanks Ghost Pepper! Terrifying, but thanks!
NARRATIVE_LAWNDOOM111_4.zh: {SAY:crazydave}啊，谢谢你，幽灵辣椒！虽然很吓人，但还是谢谢了！

NARRATIVE_LAWNDOOM112_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}Snap out of it, Penny! Listen to Jack O' Lantern's message!
NARRATIVE_LAWNDOOM112_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}克服恐惧，潘妮！听听南瓜灯的消息！

NARRATIVE_LAWNDOOM112_4.en: {SAY:crazydave}"My new upgrade brings the FIRE better than ever before."
NARRATIVE_LAWNDOOM112_4.zh: {SAY:crazydave}“我的全新升级使我开火的能力大幅增强。”

NARRATIVE_LAWNDOOM112_5.en: {SAY:crazydave}Hear that, Penny? By the power of burning things!
NARRATIVE_LAWNDOOM112_5.zh: {SAY:crazydave}听到了吗，潘妮？焚灭东西的能力诶！

NARRATIVE_LAWNDOOM112_6.en: {NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}Ha! My plan works perfectly! Soon... DOOM!
NARRATIVE_LAWNDOOM112_6.zh: {NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}哈！我的计划实施得相当完美！再过不了多久……毁灭吧！

NARRATIVE_LAWNDOOM113_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}Soil yourself, Fearful Dave! And your malfunctioning recreational vehicle, too!
NARRATIVE_LAWNDOOM113_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}埋葬自己吧，胆小的戴夫！还有您那出了故障的休闲车！

NARRATIVE_LAWNDOOM113_2.en: {SAY:zombossicon}On THIS, of all nights, your fears rise up and destroy you!
NARRATIVE_LAWNDOOM113_2.zh: {SAY:zombossicon}错了，今夜，每夜，你的恐惧都将彻头彻尾地摧毁你！

NARRATIVE_LAWNDOOM113_4.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:crazydave}好耶！潘妮恢复正常了！击败他吧！

NARRATIVE_LAWNDOOM113_5.en: {SAY:winnie}Thank you, User Dave. The solution was simple.
NARRATIVE_LAWNDOOM113_5.zh: {SAY:winnie}谢谢你，用户戴夫。解决办法很简单。

NARRATIVE_LAWNDOOM113_9.en: {SAY:winnie}Our spookiest friends are with us tonight, Dr. Zomboss.
NARRATIVE_LAWNDOOM113_9.zh: {SAY:winnie}今晚，我们最恐怖的朋友与我们同在，僵王博士。

NARRATIVE_LAWNDOOM114_2.en: {SAY:crazydave}Those poor zombies last night didn't stand a chance, did they?
NARRATIVE_LAWNDOOM114_2.zh: {SAY:crazydave}那些可怜的僵尸昨晚上依旧没能得逞，对吧？

NARRATIVE_LAWNDOOM114_3.en: {SAY:winnie}Correct, User Dave. They fell in many droves.
NARRATIVE_LAWNDOOM114_3.zh: {SAY:winnie}是的，用户戴夫。它们成群结队地倒下了。

NARRATIVE_LAWNDOOM114_4.en: {SAY:crazydave}Sometimes I forget how insanely powerful our plants are!
NARRATIVE_LAWNDOOM114_4.zh: {SAY:crazydave}有的时候我都忘记我们的植物有多么强大了！

NARRATIVE_LAWNDOOM115_2.en: {SAY:zombossicon}Extending Lawn of Doom stuff past the 31st never feels right anyway!
NARRATIVE_LAWNDOOM115_2.zh: {SAY:zombossicon}反正把末日草坪什么的延长到 31 日怎么说也不对劲！

NARRATIVE_LAWNOFDOOM_LTE_2022_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:ghostpepper}{SAY:ghostpepper}Plants and sprouts of every age! Boo!

NARRATIVE_LAWNOFDOOM_LTE_2022_1_3.en: {SAY:ghostpepper}I’ve been waiting for this day for 365 days.
NARRATIVE_LAWNOFDOOM_LTE_2022_1_3.zh: {SAY:ghostpepper}我等这天已经等了 365 天了。

NARRATIVE_LAWNOFDOOM_LTE_2022_2_3.en: {NPC_EXIT:wallnut_r}{NPC_ENTER:sunflower_r}{SAY:sunflower_r}You’ve got it Ghostie! Turn that scare up on those incoming zombies.
NARRATIVE_LAWNOFDOOM_LTE_2022_2_3.zh: {NPC_EXIT:wallnut_r}{NPC_ENTER:sunflower_r}{SAY:sunflower_r}你成功了，小魂！快用这招来吓退那些正在来袭的僵尸吧。

NARRATIVE_LAWNOFDOOM_LTE_2022_3_4.en: {NPC_EXIT:ghostpepper_r}{NPC_EXIT:wallnut}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss}{SAY:zomboss}Wall-nut and those meddling plants don’t seem so spooky to me.
NARRATIVE_LAWNOFDOOM_LTE_2022_3_4.zh: {NPC_EXIT:ghostpepper_r}{NPC_EXIT:wallnut}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss}{SAY:zomboss}坚果墙和那些婆婆妈妈的植物，我才不会怕呢。

NARRATIVE_LAWNOFDOOM_LTE_2022_3_5.en: {SAY:zomboss}They are no match for my devious delegates of doom!
NARRATIVE_LAWNOFDOOM_LTE_2022_3_5.zh: {SAY:zomboss}我可是阴险狡诈的末日化身，他们配吗！

NARRATIVE_LAWNOFDOOM_LTE_2022_4_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{NPC_ENTER:sunflower_r}{SAY:peashooter} Wall-nut keeps trying to scare me.
NARRATIVE_LAWNOFDOOM_LTE_2022_4_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{NPC_ENTER:sunflower_r}{SAY:peashooter} 坚果墙一直在试着吓我。

NARRATIVE_LAWNOFDOOM_LTE_2022_4_2.en: {SAY:sunflower_r}Me too. He keeps sneaking up on me.
NARRATIVE_LAWNOFDOOM_LTE_2022_4_2.zh: {SAY:sunflower_r}我也是。他老是在我周围偷偷摸摸的。

NARRATIVE_LAWNOFDOOM_LTE_2022_4_3.en: {SAY:peashooter}Oh peas! He’s not scary at all.
NARRATIVE_LAWNOFDOOM_LTE_2022_4_3.zh: {SAY:peashooter}求他别豆了！他才不吓人好吧。

NARRATIVE_LAWNOFDOOM_LTE_2022_4_4.en: {NPC_EXIT:sunflower_r}{NPC_EXIT:peashooter}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}Interesting! I must devise a new Zombie threat to de-shell that nut!
NARRATIVE_LAWNOFDOOM_LTE_2022_4_4.zh: {NPC_EXIT:sunflower_r}{NPC_EXIT:peashooter}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}有意思！我得设计一只僵尸去看看那坚果壳里卖的是什么药！

NARRATIVE_LAWNOFDOOM_LTE_2022_5_3.zh: {SAY:ghostpepper}这草坪，幽灵辣椒缠扰着这草坪。

NARRATIVE_LAWNOFDOOM_LTE_2022_5_4.en: {SHOUT:ghostpepper}This lawn! This lawn of Doom! Boo!
NARRATIVE_LAWNOFDOOM_LTE_2022_5_4.zh: {SHOUT:ghostpepper}这草坪！这末日草坪！哇啊啊啊啊啊！

NARRATIVE_LAWNOFDOOM_LTE_2022_7_4.zh: {NPC_EXIT:tombtangler_r}{NPC_ENTER:peashooter_r}{SAY:peashooter_r}今天也别想得逞，僵尸！今天也别想。

NARRATIVE_LAWNOFDOOM_LTE_2022_8_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}User Dave, I detect that the lawn is now safe from zombie threats.
NARRATIVE_LAWNOFDOOM_LTE_2022_8_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}用户戴夫，我探测到草坪现在已经不受僵尸的威胁了。

NARRATIVE_LAWNOFDOOM_LTE_2022_8_3.en: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}Your time has come… nut! I have a special surprise just for you!
NARRATIVE_LAWNOFDOOM_LTE_2022_8_3.zh: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}你的机会来了……坚果！我专门给你准备了一个特别惊喜！

NARRATIVE_LAWN_MOWERS_FILL_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{EXCITED:winnie}Whoa, mowers can chase down zombies and just keep going!
NARRATIVE_LAWN_MOWERS_FILL_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{EXCITED:winnie}哇，小推车能追随僵尸的脚步，并在消灭他们后继续前进！

NARRATIVE_LAWN_MOWERS_FILL_2.en: {SAY:crazydave}Keep an eye out for mowers dropped by zombies, but in the meantime...
NARRATIVE_LAWN_MOWERS_FILL_2.zh: {SAY:crazydave}注意那些被僵尸触发的小推车，并且与此同时…

NARRATIVE_LAWN_MOWERS_FILL_3.en: {SAY:crazydave}Let me get your mowers back to fightin' form.
NARRATIVE_LAWN_MOWERS_FILL_3.zh: {SAY:crazydave}请让我将你的小推车归位至战斗状态。

NARRATIVE_LAWN_MOWERS_FILL_4.en: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}Don't worry, this one's on the house, or next to the house.
NARRATIVE_LAWN_MOWERS_FILL_4.zh: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}你无须担心它们是摆在房顶，亦或位于房子旁边。

NARRATIVE_LEVITATER_EQ_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}种植悬浮洋芋，让随机僵尸悬浮起来。

NARRATIVE_LOD_BIG_REWARD_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}You are truly amazing! Most deserving of the name... Señor Piñata!
NARRATIVE_LOD_BIG_REWARD_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}小东西真别致！“彩陶玩偶”…你与这个称呼真贴切！

NARRATIVE_LOD_BIG_REWARD_INTRO_2.en: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}Have you seen my taco Señor Piñata? It was about this big...
NARRATIVE_LOD_BIG_REWARD_INTRO_2.zh: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}你可曾见过我的彩陶玉米卷玩偶吗？它大概这么大…

NARRATIVE_LOD_BIG_REWARD_INTRO_3.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{TIRED}That's it. Please disrupt this anomaly before User Dave gets too attached.
NARRATIVE_LOD_BIG_REWARD_INTRO_3.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{TIRED}就这样，请在用户戴夫过于着魔之前打破这次异常。

NARRATIVE_LOD_LEVEL_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{TIRED}User Dave, this does not look like a party.
NARRATIVE_LOD_LEVEL_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{TIRED}用户戴夫，这看起来并不像一个派对。

NARRATIVE_LOD_LEVEL_INTRO_2.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{PLAYFUL}It could still be a surprise party, with gifts and everything!
NARRATIVE_LOD_LEVEL_INTRO_2.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{PLAYFUL}这仍然可以是一个充满惊喜，礼物以及其他一切的盛宴！

NARRATIVE_LOD_LEVEL_INTRO_3.en: {EXCITED:crazydave}You'll see Penny, I think these zombies are different.
NARRATIVE_LOD_LEVEL_INTRO_3.zh: {EXCITED:crazydave}你会看见的，潘妮。我觉得这些僵尸与众不同。

NARRATIVE_LOD_MAP_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnieicon}{EXCITED}There is an impending attack on your house in modern times!
NARRATIVE_LOD_MAP_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnieicon}{EXCITED} 我告诉你什么了？潘妮。一个令人惊喜的彩陶盛宴！

NARRATIVE_LOD_MAP_INTRO_2.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydaveicon}{EXCITED}I bet it's not an attack... I bet it's a party! Oh, I hope it's a Piñata Party!
NARRATIVE_LOD_MAP_INTRO_2.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydaveicon}{EXCITED}我打赌那肯定不是一场对我们的攻势…我敢肯定那就是一场盛宴！噢，我希望那是“彩陶盛宴”！

NARRATIVE_LOD_MAP_INTRO_3.en: {SAY:winnieicon}It's not a party, there are zombies from all different time periods ready to strike!
NARRATIVE_LOD_MAP_INTRO_3.zh: {SAY:winnieicon}这不是盛宴！来自各个时空的僵尸已经准备开始进攻了！

NARRATIVE_LOD_MAP_INTRO_4.en: {EXCITED:winnieicon}Who knows what else they could have brought with them?
NARRATIVE_LOD_MAP_INTRO_4.zh: {EXCITED:winnieicon}谁能知道他们还携带了什么其他的黑科技呢？

NARRATIVE_LOD_MAP_INTRO_5.en: {PLAYFUL:crazydaveicon}Sounds like a party to me! Better hurry up, we don't want to miss out!
NARRATIVE_LOD_MAP_INTRO_5.zh: {PLAYFUL:crazydaveicon}听起来是一场属于我的派对！最好跟紧点，我们可不想错过这场盛会！

NARRATIVE_LOD_MAP_OUTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnieicon}The party is over for now, but those zombies will be back some day.
NARRATIVE_LOD_MAP_OUTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnieicon}僵尸的“狂欢派对”暂告一段落，但他们终将卷土重来。

NARRATIVE_LOD_MAP_OUTRO_3.en: {SAY:winnieicon}Defending against multiple parties in a row could lead to a massive "piñata" anomaly.
NARRATIVE_LOD_MAP_OUTRO_3.zh: {SAY:winnieicon}连续完成多场彩陶派对，就能找到一只特别的超大号彩陶玩偶。

NARRATIVE_LOD_MAP_OUTRO_4.en: {EXCITED:crazydaveicon}I can't wait for the next Piñata Party, and the one after that!
NARRATIVE_LOD_MAP_OUTRO_4.zh: {EXCITED:crazydaveicon}我已经迫不及待地想参加下一场，还有下下场彩陶派对了！

NARRATIVE_LOD_MAP_OUTRO_5.en: {TIRED:crazydaveicon}But those piñatas just remind me of my sad lost taco. Let's go!
NARRATIVE_LOD_MAP_OUTRO_5.zh: {TIRED:crazydaveicon}可是他们只会让我回忆起那丢失的玉米卷。所以一起向前进发吧！

NARRATIVE_LOD_RESET_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnieicon}Missing a "Piñata" Party will reset the build up to the massive "piñata" anomaly.
NARRATIVE_LOD_RESET_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnieicon}漏掉任何一场彩陶派对，都会打断搭建超大彩陶玩偶的过程。

NARRATIVE_LOD_RESET_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:winnieicon}I won't pretend to understand why, but the data does not lie.
NARRATIVE_LOD_RESET_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:winnieicon}我不会思考为何这样，我只知道数据不会骗人。

NARRATIVE_LOD_RESET_INTRO_3.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydaveicon}{EXCITED}Just let us know of any more Piñata Parties you detect!
NARRATIVE_LOD_RESET_INTRO_3.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydaveicon}{EXCITED}让我们更深入的了解你探测到的彩陶吧！

NARRATIVE_LOD_RESET_INTRO_4.en: {PLAYFUL:crazydaveicon}For a party they can be pretty sneaky.
NARRATIVE_LOD_RESET_INTRO_4.zh: {PLAYFUL:crazydaveicon}对于参加派对这事来说，这做法不太光明磊落。

NARRATIVE_LOD_REWARD_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}What did I tell you Penny? A surprise Piñata Party!
NARRATIVE_LOD_REWARD_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}我说的吧，潘妮！果然是一场令人惊喜的彩陶派对！

NARRATIVE_LOD_REWARD_INTRO_2.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{TIRED}Does not compute. It appears a level 3 diagnostic check is in order.
NARRATIVE_LOD_REWARD_INTRO_2.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{TIRED}计算失调。似乎一次三重校验即将开始。

NARRATIVE_LOD_REWARD_INTRO_3.en: {EXCITED:crazydave}Piñatas! Let's bust some open and see what we get!
NARRATIVE_LOD_REWARD_INTRO_3.zh: {EXCITED:crazydave}彩陶！快把它们敲碎，看看能有什么收获！

NARRATIVE_LOSTCITY_13_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}As we all know, Snow Pea is a powerful support plant.
NARRATIVE_LOSTCITY_13_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}众所周知，寒冰射手是一株强力的辅助植物。

NARRATIVE_LOSTCITY_13_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:winnie}But data indicates that a similar entity has infiltrated the zombie hordes.
NARRATIVE_LOSTCITY_13_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}但数据显示，在众多僵尸群中，似乎也混入了一只“类似”的存在。

NARRATIVE_LOSTCITY_13_INTRO_3.en: {EXCITED:crazydave}Can he get me some ice-cold tacos?
NARRATIVE_LOSTCITY_13_INTRO_3.zh: {EXCITED:crazydave}他是来给我送冰镇玉米卷的吗？

NARRATIVE_LOSTCITY_13_INTRO_4.en: {SAY:winnie}Be realistic, User Dave. He only provides Dr. Zomboss with chilled brains.
NARRATIVE_LOSTCITY_13_INTRO_4.zh: {SAY:winnie}现实点，用户戴夫。他只会给僵王博士提供冰镇脑子。

NARRATIVE_LOSTCITY_16_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:zombossicon}Unfortunately for you, the Porter Gargantuars are about to ruin your day!
NARRATIVE_LOSTCITY_16_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:zombossicon}哎哟喂，你们真是太不幸了！脚夫巨人僵尸将要毁掉你们美好的一天！

NARRATIVE_LOSTCITY_16_INTRO_3.en: {SAY:zombossicon}They carry imps. Imps! Prepare to become ancient history!
NARRATIVE_LOSTCITY_16_INTRO_3.zh: {SAY:zombossicon}他们携带了小鬼——脚夫小鬼！你们，等着化为古代史的其中一部分吧！

NARRATIVE_LOSTCITY_16_INTRO_4.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:crazydave}I wish someone would carry me around in a tiny house!
NARRATIVE_LOSTCITY_16_INTRO_4.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:crazydave}我祈愿现在有谁能让我呆在脚夫搬运的小包厢里四处游览。

NARRATIVE_LOSTCITY_16_INTRO_5.en: {SAY:winnie}I wish for a lot of things, User Dave. That is not one of them.
NARRATIVE_LOSTCITY_16_INTRO_5.zh: {SAY:winnie}我同样祈愿着许多事，用户戴夫。但这可不是其中之一。

NARRATIVE_LOSTCITY_16_INTRO_B_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}That zombie with the detector... Is he here to help me find tacos?
NARRATIVE_LOSTCITY_16_INTRO_B_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}那只拿着探测仪的僵尸，是来帮我探测玉米卷的吗？

NARRATIVE_LOSTCITY_16_INTRO_B_2.en: {SAY:winnie}User Dave, you always have such... admirable insights on befriending the enemy.
NARRATIVE_LOSTCITY_16_INTRO_B_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}用户戴夫，你在“化敌为友”这块总是有不得不夸的见解。

NARRATIVE_LOSTCITY_16_INTRO_B_3.en: {SAY:winnie}Data indicates this is a Guide Zombie. He can open up tunnels, making it much easier for other zombies to reach your house.
NARRATIVE_LOSTCITY_16_INTRO_B_3.zh: {SAY:winnie}数据表明，这是一只向导僵尸，他能打开地道，让其他僵尸更轻而易举地接近你的房子。

NARRATIVE_LOSTCITY_16_INTRO_B_4.en: {SAY:crazydave}I wonder if a Gargantuar could plug up those tunnels.
NARRATIVE_LOSTCITY_16_INTRO_B_4.zh: {SAY:crazydave}不知道巨人僵尸能不能把地道堵了。

NARRATIVE_LOSTCITY_17_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie} Alert, User Dave! My sensors sense incoming Imp Porters.
NARRATIVE_LOSTCITY_17_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie} 警告！我的传感器检测到脚夫小鬼正在汹涌来袭！

NARRATIVE_LOSTCITY_17_INTRO_2.zh: {EXCITED:crazydave}低矮品贱的进口商人？他们是否有着琳琅满目的优质货物与叮当作响的玻璃器具？

NARRATIVE_LOSTCITY_17_INTRO_3.en: {SAY:winnie}Negative. They pitch tents on Gold Tiles, and the tents spawn zombies.
NARRATIVE_LOSTCITY_17_INTRO_3.zh: {SAY:winnie}你的回答令我感到失望。脚夫小鬼在黄金地砖上支起能源源不断产生僵尸的帐篷。

NARRATIVE_LOSTCITY_17_INTRO_4.zh: {EXCITED:crazydave}携带帐篷的小鬼不怀好意啊！

NARRATIVE_LOSTCITY_19_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Still troubled by those nasty debuffs from the zombies? Why not give Aloe Doctor a try?
NARRATIVE_LOSTCITY_19_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}还在为僵尸施加的负面效果而烦恼吗？不妨试试芦荟医师。

NARRATIVE_LOSTCITY_19_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:winnie}She can cleanse all negative effects from your plants and provide buffs, all while being immune to some debuffs herself.
NARRATIVE_LOSTCITY_19_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}她能解除植物身上所有的负面效果并提供增益，同时自身还能免疫部分减益。

NARRATIVE_LOSTCITY_19_INTRO_3.en: {SAY:crazydave}Can Aloe help me take care of my tacos?
NARRATIVE_LOSTCITY_19_INTRO_3.zh: {SAY:crazydave}芦荟医师能帮我养护玉米卷吗？

NARRATIVE_LOSTCITY_1_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:winnie}User Dave, this is no ordinary jungle. A scan of my records indicates that this is the fabled Lost City.
NARRATIVE_LOSTCITY_1_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}用户戴夫，这可不是一般的热带丛林。我的记录表明，这里就是传说中的失落之城。

NARRATIVE_LOSTCITY_1_INTRO_3.en: {SAY:winnie}Historical texts state that the Sun was worshipped here. Resources should be plentiful.
NARRATIVE_LOSTCITY_1_INTRO_3.zh: {SAY:winnie}史料记载，太阳在这里备受崇拜。此处的阳光资源应该十分富饶。

NARRATIVE_LOSTCITY_1_INTRO_4.en: {SAY:winnie}I suggest that we try planting on the Gold Tiles that we find here.
NARRATIVE_LOSTCITY_1_INTRO_4.zh: {SAY:winnie}我建议试着把植物种在我们发现的黄金地砖上。

NARRATIVE_LOSTCITY_1_INTRO_5.en: {SAY:winnie}They should continuously generate sun as long as they have plants on them.
NARRATIVE_LOSTCITY_1_INTRO_5.zh: {SAY:winnie}若是地砖上边有植物，它们会持续产出阳光。

NARRATIVE_LOSTCITY_1_INTRO_6.en: {EXCITED:crazydave}Lost City? This is it Penny! We've found it!
NARRATIVE_LOSTCITY_1_INTRO_6.zh: {EXCITED:crazydave}失落之城？是这里啦，潘妮！我们找到它了！

NARRATIVE_LOSTCITY_1_INTRO_7.en: {SAY:crazydave}Where else would I find my lost taco, except in a Lost City?
NARRATIVE_LOSTCITY_1_INTRO_7.zh: {SAY:crazydave}除了失落之城外，还有哪里能够找到我丢失的“遗落玉米卷”吗？

NARRATIVE_LOSTCITY_1_INTRO_8.en: {SAY:winnie}Your continued fixation defies all logic or reason, User Dave.
NARRATIVE_LOSTCITY_1_INTRO_8.zh: {SAY:winnie}你还是一如既往固执地违抗着一切的因果逻辑，用户戴夫。

NARRATIVE_LOSTCITY_20_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}It seems there's an even more advanced level of technology in this lost city.
NARRATIVE_LOSTCITY_20_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}在这个被遗落的城市，似乎还有更强大的科技水平。

NARRATIVE_LOSTCITY_20_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:crazydave}You mean that zombie with the camera? Looks like he's here to take my picture!
NARRATIVE_LOSTCITY_20_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:crazydave}你是说那只拿着照相机的僵尸？看起来是给我来拍照的。

NARRATIVE_LOSTCITY_20_INTRO_3.en: {SAY:winnie}Photographer Zombie can place a camera that freezes an entire row of plants.
NARRATIVE_LOSTCITY_20_INTRO_3.zh: {SAY:winnie}摄影师僵尸可以放置照相机，定格整行植物。

NARRATIVE_LOSTCITY_20_INTRO_4.en: {SAY:winnie}This "freeze" is a hard crowd control. Aloe Doctor isn't immune to it, but she can still remove it.
NARRATIVE_LOSTCITY_20_INTRO_4.zh: {SAY:winnie}定格属于强力控制，芦荟医师无法免疫，但仍可解除。

NARRATIVE_LOSTCITY_22_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Beware, User Dave! I detect trap tiles.
NARRATIVE_LOSTCITY_22_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}当心，用户戴夫！我侦测到了陷阱地砖！

NARRATIVE_LOSTCITY_22_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:winnie}They are triggered by zombies, or when you plant on them.
NARRATIVE_LOSTCITY_22_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}它们在你把植物种在上边，亦或有僵尸经过时被触发。

NARRATIVE_LOSTCITY_22_INTRO_3.zh: {EXCITED:crazydave}然后它们会赐予你玉米卷，是吗？

NARRATIVE_LOSTCITY_22_INTRO_4.en: {SAY:winnie}If you equate tacos with jets of flame and huge boulders, then yes.
NARRATIVE_LOSTCITY_22_INTRO_4.zh: {SAY:winnie}若是你将玉米卷等同于一行熊熊烈焰，或者捣毁沿途一切的滚滚的巨石，那么我可以郑重地回答你：是的！

NARRATIVE_LOSTCITY_2_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}My sensors indicate movement incoming from above.
NARRATIVE_LOSTCITY_2_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}我的传感器探测到我们头顶处传来运动的迹象。

NARRATIVE_LOSTCITY_2_INTRO_2.en: {EXCITED:crazydave}Maybe it's presents. Presents from the sky!
NARRATIVE_LOSTCITY_2_INTRO_2.zh: {EXCITED:crazydave}也许这会是件礼物，来自苍穹的馈赠！

NARRATIVE_LOSTCITY_2_INTRO_3.en: {SAY:winnie}The chances of that statement being true are statistically irrelevant.
NARRATIVE_LOSTCITY_2_INTRO_3.zh: {SAY:winnie}从统计学的角度考量，你说的那种情况简直就是无稽之谈。

NARRATIVE_LOSTCITY_2_INTRO_4.en: {SAY:winnie}I believe it to be a new form of zombie threat. We should be cautious of unexpected guests.
NARRATIVE_LOSTCITY_2_INTRO_4.zh: {SAY:winnie}我相信这是僵尸突袭我们的新方式。我们应该当心那些不速之客。

NARRATIVE_LOSTCITY_3_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}We are facing considerable threats, User Dave. I suggest that we retaliate with tremendous force.
NARRATIVE_LOSTCITY_3_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}我们目前面临着相当大的威胁，用户戴夫。我建议使用强而有力的打击来回敬他们！

NARRATIVE_LOSTCITY_3_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:crazydave}More forceful! That's it! We'll give them all a stern talking to.
NARRATIVE_LOSTCITY_3_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:crazydave}强而有力！就应该这样！我们用强有力的“演讲”回敬他们！

NARRATIVE_LOSTCITY_3_INTRO_3.en: {SAY:winnie}I was referring to the Lava Guava. Its explosive blasts leave behind dangerous magma.
NARRATIVE_LOSTCITY_3_INTRO_3.zh: {SAY:winnie}我指的是岩浆番石榴。它轰隆一声爆炸之后会留下危险的熔岩。

NARRATIVE_LOSTCITY_3_INTRO_4.en: {EXCITED:crazydave}That sounds even better! First a stern talking, then some lava!
NARRATIVE_LOSTCITY_3_INTRO_4.zh: {EXCITED:crazydave}噢，那听起来更棒啦！那就先来一次慷慨激昂的演讲，然后再来一点岩浆！

NARRATIVE_LOSTCITY_4_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Caution, User Dave. I detect a zombie with a shovel.
NARRATIVE_LOSTCITY_4_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}小心，用户戴夫！我勘测到一只携带铲子的僵尸。

NARRATIVE_LOSTCITY_4_INTRO_3.en: {SAY:winnie}It appears to block incoming shots. We need a way to get projectiles over the shovel.
NARRATIVE_LOSTCITY_4_INTRO_3.zh: {SAY:winnie}铲子可以抵挡射手的射击，我们得想办法让植物的攻击物越过铲子。

NARRATIVE_LOSTCITY_4_INTRO_4.zh: {SAY:crazydave}我知道是什么了！伊克斯派力阿莫斯--除你武器！

NARRATIVE_LOSTCITY_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon} Do not think to usurp our discovery of the fabled Lost City!
NARRATIVE_LOSTCITY_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}别妄想篡夺我们于传说中的失落之城里发现的宝物！

NARRATIVE_LOSTCITY_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_2.en: {SAY:zombossicon}I and my zombies have already submitted our find to the Eminent Journal of the Missing and the Mislaid!
NARRATIVE_LOSTCITY_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_2.zh: {SAY:zombossicon}我，还有我的僵尸已经把成果发表在《失落与遗失文明的杰出学刊》上了！

NARRATIVE_LOSTCITY_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_3.en: {SAY:zombossicon}We will publish and you will PERISH!
NARRATIVE_LOSTCITY_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_3.zh: {SAY:zombossicon}我们的论文将日趋完善，你们的棺盖会逐渐关合！

NARRATIVE_LOSTCITY_OUTRO_DANGER_ROOM_KEY.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:crazydave}看啊，潘妮！这有个简直闪瞎我的狗眼不知道是什么鬼的东东！

NARRATIVE_LOSTCITY_OUTRO_DANGER_ROOM_KEY.en: {SAY:winnie}My sensors indicate this amulet points the way to a long-lost challenge.
NARRATIVE_LOSTCITY_OUTRO_DANGER_ROOM_KEY.zh: {SAY:winnie}我的传感器检测到，这个护身符指引着我们进行一项久违的挑战…
{EXCITED:crazydave}麻利点，让我们尽快开始探索吧！

NARRATIVE_LOSTCITY_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:crazydave}All that discovering and still no taco!
NARRATIVE_LOSTCITY_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:crazydave}一切谜底都已被揭晓，然而…此地并无玉米卷。

NARRATIVE_LOSTCITY_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_2.en: {SAY:winnie}The search will no doubt continue, User Dave.
NARRATIVE_LOSTCITY_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}有关玉米卷的搜索工作仍在进行，用户戴夫。

NARRATIVE_LOSTCITY_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_3.en: {NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}My discovery remains intact. The taco is still unfound. And your brains will certainly one day be mine!
NARRATIVE_LOSTCITY_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_3.zh: {NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}我寻到的宝物安然无恙，毫发无伤！你的玉米卷却仍然下落不明！而你们的脑子，终将成为我囊中的宝物！

NARRATIVE_LOSTCITY_ZOMBIENOTE_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:crazydave}Well lookie-here, Penny! It's a treasure map!
NARRATIVE_LOSTCITY_ZOMBIENOTE_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:crazydave}瞧瞧这个，潘妮！这是一张藏宝图！

NARRATIVE_LOSTCITY_ZOMBIENOTE_2.en: {SAY:winnie}My analysis suggests that the origins of that map are highly suspect.
NARRATIVE_LOSTCITY_ZOMBIENOTE_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}我的分析表明，地图的出处十分值得怀疑。

NARRATIVE_LOSTCITY_ZOMBIENOTE_3.en: {SAY:crazydave}It has a big red X on it, Penny. When have big red Xs ever been bad?
NARRATIVE_LOSTCITY_ZOMBIENOTE_3.zh: {SAY:crazydave}这上面有一大红叉，潘妮。大红叉能有什么坏心眼呢？

NARRATIVE_LUCKOTHEZOMBIE_LTE_2023_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:winnie}User Dave, shouldn't you be wearing green for the parade?
NARRATIVE_LUCKOTHEZOMBIE_LTE_2023_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:winnie}用户戴夫，你不应该换上绿色的服装去参加游行吗？

NARRATIVE_LUCKOTHEZOMBIE_LTE_2023_1_2.zh: {SAY:crazydave}我玉米卷里的生菜就是绿色的！

NARRATIVE_LUCKOTHEZOMBIE_LTE_2023_1_4.zh: {SAY:crazydave}把你的针离我的玉米卷远点！

NARRATIVE_LUCKOTHEZOMBIE_LTE_2023_2_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss}{SAY:zomboss}Ha! Ha! Ha! You’ll need more than a bit o’ luck to defeat me!
NARRATIVE_LUCKOTHEZOMBIE_LTE_2023_2_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss}{SAY:zomboss}哈！哈！哈！想要打败我，你们得多找一些幸运星！

NARRATIVE_LUCKOTHEZOMBIE_LTE_2023_2_4.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave_r}{SAY:crazydave_r}啊哦，看来得准备 2 块玉米卷了。

NARRATIVE_LUCKOTHEZOMBIE_LTE_2023_3_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{NPC_ENTER:sunflower_r}{SAY:peashooter}Been waiting all year for this day.

NARRATIVE_LUCKOTHEZOMBIE_LTE_2023_4_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:sunflower_r}{NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:sunflower_r}Spider rain go away, come back to fight another day!
NARRATIVE_LUCKOTHEZOMBIE_LTE_2023_4_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:sunflower_r}{NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:sunflower_r}蛛虫雨快走开，要约战改日再来！

NARRATIVE_LUCKOTHEZOMBIE_LTE_2023_4_3.zh: {SAY:sunflower_r}要是我们有这么……幸运就好了。

NARRATIVE_LUCKOTHEZOMBIE_LTE_2023_5_3.en: {NPC_ENTER:sunflower}{SAY:sunflower}All in all, you’re just another seed in the pot… of gold.
NARRATIVE_LUCKOTHEZOMBIE_LTE_2023_5_3.zh: {NPC_ENTER:sunflower}{SAY:sunflower}总而言之，你不过是花盆中的另一粒种子……金子做的那种。

NARRATIVE_LUCKOTHEZOMBIE_LTE_2023_7_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}User Dave, Luckily, we have successfully defended the lawn and saved your brainz!
NARRATIVE_LUCKOTHEZOMBIE_LTE_2023_7_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}用户戴夫，很幸运，我们成功守卫住了草坪，也拯救了你的脑子！

NARRATIVE_LUCKOTHEZOMBIE_LTE_2023_7_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}正在为下一次冒险重新校准。

NARRATIVE_LUCKOTHEZOMBIE_LTE_2023_7_4.en: {NPC_ENTER:browncoatzombie_r}{SAY:zomboss}One day you won’t be so lucky User Dave then I Zomboss will be there waiting!

NARRATIVE_LUCKOTHEZOMBIE_LTE_2024_3_3.zh: {NPC_EXIT:peashooter}{NPC_EXIT:sunflower_r}{NPC_ENTER:wallnut}{SAY:wallnut}感觉我的好运是不是被我挡住了。

NARRATIVE_LUCKOTHEZOMBIE_LTE_2024_5_3.zh: {SAY:peashooter}看来生活不只有幸运草，也会有恶作剧。

NARRATIVE_LUCKOTHEZOMBIE_LTE_2024_5_4.en: {NPC_EXIT:peashooter}{NPC_EXIT:sunflower_r}{NPC_ENTER:wallnut}{SAY:wallnut}The paddy don't start till I walk in.

NARRATIVE_LUCKOTHEZOMBIE_LTE_2025_3_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:sunflower_r}{NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:sunflower_r}就不能让我们过节消停一次吗！

NARRATIVE_LUCKOTHEZOMBIE_LTE_2025_3_3.en: {SAY:sunflower_r}At least we have our lucky charms!

NARRATIVE_LUCKOTHEZOMBIE_LTE_2025_3_4.en: {NPC_EXIT:peashooter}{NPC_EXIT:sunflower_r}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss}{SAY:zomboss}All the lucky charms in the world won't save you now!
NARRATIVE_LUCKOTHEZOMBIE_LTE_2025_3_4.zh: {NPC_EXIT:peashooter}{NPC_EXIT:sunflower_r}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss}{SAY:zomboss}现在全世界的幸运符都救不了你们了！

NARRATIVE_LUCKOTHEZOMBIE_LTE_2025_4_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{NPC_ENTER:sunflower_r}{SAY:peashooter}At least most of these zombies have the holiday spirit.
