NARRATIVE_LUNARZOOYEAR_LTE_2025_5_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:crazydave}Bid the old, embrace the new, Gardenias whisper spring's debut.

NARRATIVE_LUNARZOOYEAR_LTE_2025_6_3.en: {SAY:zombossicon}Just wait! Next year at this time... I'll be celebrating... ON YOUR LAWN!
NARRATIVE_LUNARZOOYEAR_LTE_2025_6_3.zh: {SAY:zombossicon}走着瞧！明年此时...庆祝的会是我...在你们的草坪上！

NARRATIVE_LUNARZOOYEAR_LTE_2025_6_4.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Statistical analysis shows 0.01% success probability. Shall I prepare contingency plans?
NARRATIVE_LUNARZOOYEAR_LTE_2025_6_4.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}根据数据分析，您明年的成功率约为0.01%，需要我帮您制定备用计划吗？

NARRATIVE_LUNARZOOYEAR_LTE_2025_6_5.zh: {SAY:zombossicon}六百六十六，演都不演了，哥们？？？

NARRATIVE_MAGNETSHROOM_EQ_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Magnet-shrooms remove helmets and other metal objects from zombies.
NARRATIVE_MAGNETSHROOM_EQ_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}磁力菇可以把僵尸身上的金属物品吸走。

NARRATIVE_MAGNETSHROOM_EQ_PF_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Plant Fooded Magnet-shroom attracts multiple metallic objects from zombies within his vicinity and throws them.
NARRATIVE_MAGNETSHROOM_EQ_PF_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}磁力菇受到叶绿素效果后，可以从附近的僵尸身上吸走多个金属物品，随后把它们扔回去。

NARRATIVE_MAUSOLEUM_11_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:winnie}A group of hawkers are pushing rickety pig carts, but they are all zombies.
NARRATIVE_MAUSOLEUM_11_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}一群小贩推着摇摇欲坠的猪车，但它们都是僵尸。

NARRATIVE_MAUSOLEUM_11_INTRO_4.en: {SAY:winnie}At least they aren't plants, User Dave.

NARRATIVE_MAUSOLEUM_13_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:crazydave}There are piles of pottery on the ground. Could there be any treasures buried inside?
NARRATIVE_MAUSOLEUM_13_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:crazydave}地上有一些陶堆，里面会埋藏着什么宝贝吗？

NARRATIVE_MAUSOLEUM_13_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:winnie}These are Terracotta Warriors, a miraculous display of a brilliant ancient civilization.
NARRATIVE_MAUSOLEUM_13_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}这是兵马俑，古代辉煌文明的奇迹展现。

NARRATIVE_MAUSOLEUM_13_INTRO_3.en: {SAY:winnie}Careful, I'm detecting traces of magic on the clay.
NARRATIVE_MAUSOLEUM_13_INTRO_3.zh: {SAY:winnie}小心，检测到陶土上有魔法的痕迹。

NARRATIVE_MAUSOLEUM_13_INTRO_5.en: {SAY:winnie}Magic Vine works wonders against the Terracotta Warriors.

NARRATIVE_MAUSOLEUM_16_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}You artifact vandals, won't you surrender your weapons and yield to the Underground Palace army?
NARRATIVE_MAUSOLEUM_16_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}你们这些文物破坏者，面对地宫大军还不缴械投降？

NARRATIVE_MAUSOLEUM_16_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:zombossicon}No problem! The Centurion Gargantuar will execute my orders and smash you right into the tunnels!
NARRATIVE_MAUSOLEUM_16_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:zombossicon}没有问题！百夫长巨人僵尸将会贯彻我的命令，把你们砸进坑道！

NARRATIVE_MAUSOLEUM_16_INTRO_3.en: {SAY:zombossicon}Perhaps you can leave your mark in history—time-traveling artifact thieves, buried by the artifacts themselves!
NARRATIVE_MAUSOLEUM_16_INTRO_3.zh: {SAY:zombossicon}也许你们可以在历史上留下一笔了 —— 穿越来的文物大盗，被文物所埋葬！

NARRATIVE_MAUSOLEUM_16_INTRO_5.en: {SAY:winnie}It is quite obvious that now is not the time to think about that, User Dave.
NARRATIVE_MAUSOLEUM_16_INTRO_5.zh: {SAY:winnie}很明显现在不是考虑那个的时候，用户戴夫。

NARRATIVE_MAUSOLEUM_17_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:crazydave}What is this place? It looks so festive!
NARRATIVE_MAUSOLEUM_17_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:crazydave}这是什么地方？看起来真喜庆！

NARRATIVE_MAUSOLEUM_17_INTRO_2.en: {TIRED:winnie}Obviously, this is not a festive place, User Dave.
NARRATIVE_MAUSOLEUM_17_INTRO_2.zh: {TIRED:winnie}显然，这里不是什么喜庆的地方，用户戴夫。

NARRATIVE_MAUSOLEUM_17_INTRO_3.en: {SAY:winnie}My sensors have detected some non-corporeal zombies in this eerie underground palace.
NARRATIVE_MAUSOLEUM_17_INTRO_3.zh: {SAY:winnie}我的侦测器检测到有一些非实体的僵尸存在于这个阴森的地宫之中。

NARRATIVE_MAUSOLEUM_17_INTRO_4.en: {SAY:winnie}According to the data, the charms of Exorcist Lily might be very effective against them.
NARRATIVE_MAUSOLEUM_17_INTRO_4.zh: {SAY:winnie}根据资料，钟馗石蒜的灵符对他们可能会很有效果。

NARRATIVE_MAUSOLEUM_17_INTRO_5.en: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}What could be scarier than a misty man suddenly emerging from the fog?
NARRATIVE_MAUSOLEUM_17_INTRO_5.zh: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}有什么会比从迷雾中突然钻出来的迷雾男可怕呢？

NARRATIVE_MAUSOLEUM_1_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:crazydave}Wow! Is this... the Mausoleum of the First Qin Emperor...!? Are there any tacos here?
NARRATIVE_MAUSOLEUM_1_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:crazydave}哇！这是……秦始皇陵……！？这里有玉米卷吗？

NARRATIVE_MAUSOLEUM_1_INTRO_2.en: {TIRED:winnie}User Dave, people of this era haven't started growing corn yet.
NARRATIVE_MAUSOLEUM_1_INTRO_2.zh: {TIRED:winnie}用户戴夫，这个时期的人们还没有种植玉米。

NARRATIVE_MAUSOLEUM_1_INTRO_3.en: {SAY:winnie}There are tunnels everywhere here. We need to lay down Sods to plant our plants.
NARRATIVE_MAUSOLEUM_1_INTRO_3.zh: {SAY:winnie}这里到处都是坑道，我们需要铺草垛来种植植物。

NARRATIVE_MAUSOLEUM_1_INTRO_4.en: {SAY:winnie}Meanwhile, some zombies will also advance along the tunnels.
NARRATIVE_MAUSOLEUM_1_INTRO_4.zh: {SAY:winnie}同时，一些僵尸也会沿着坑道前进。

NARRATIVE_MAUSOLEUM_20_INTRO_2.en: {TIRED:crazydave}The smell of alcohol is so strong that I'm a bit too drunk to stand steadily.
NARRATIVE_MAUSOLEUM_20_INTRO_2.zh: {TIRED:crazydave}酒香味真浓，我有点醉得站不稳了。

NARRATIVE_MAUSOLEUM_20_INTRO_3.en: {SAY:winnie}Perhaps these zombies are also having trouble standing steadily.

NARRATIVE_MAUSOLEUM_23_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}What could be as reliable as my iron pot and my head?
NARRATIVE_MAUSOLEUM_23_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}有什么能像铁锅和我的头一样紧密可靠呢？

NARRATIVE_MAUSOLEUM_23_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:winnie}The Chime Bellzoin and the spectral zombies might count.
NARRATIVE_MAUSOLEUM_23_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}安息木编钟和灵体僵尸也许可以算。

NARRATIVE_MAUSOLEUM_23_INTRO_3.en: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}Could it be louder than the sound of my iron pot hitting my head?
NARRATIVE_MAUSOLEUM_23_INTRO_3.zh: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}会比我的铁锅砸头的声音还响吗？

NARRATIVE_MAUSOLEUM_25_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:winnie}But you might not want to see the tokens fall, User Dave.
NARRATIVE_MAUSOLEUM_25_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}但你可能不太想看见令牌落地，用户戴夫。

NARRATIVE_MAUSOLEUM_25_INTRO_3.en: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}Will a bunch of zombie soldiers pop out? Or an impenetrable defensive formation?
NARRATIVE_MAUSOLEUM_25_INTRO_3.zh: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}会钻出来一堆僵尸士兵吗？还是密不透风的防御方阵？

NARRATIVE_MAUSOLEUM_25_INTRO_4.en: {TIRED:winnie}Unfortunately, you're right about both, User Dave.
NARRATIVE_MAUSOLEUM_25_INTRO_4.zh: {TIRED:winnie}很不幸，你说的都是对的，用户戴夫。

NARRATIVE_MAUSOLEUM_27_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}这个豆荚好像有点神出鬼没的。

NARRATIVE_MAUSOLEUM_27_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:winnie}That's not a pod, it's a Gloombara, User Dave.
NARRATIVE_MAUSOLEUM_27_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}那不是豆荚，是幽潭婆罗，用户戴夫。

NARRATIVE_MAUSOLEUM_27_INTRO_3.en: {SAY:winnie}It can expand the spirit world, making spectral zombies and rune tokens visible, and can also enhance other spirit world plants.
NARRATIVE_MAUSOLEUM_27_INTRO_3.zh: {SAY:winnie}它能展开灵界让灵体僵尸与法阵令牌显形，还可以强化其他灵界植物。

NARRATIVE_MAUSOLEUM_27_INTRO_4.en: {EXCITED:crazydave}Our team has gained another area-of-effect mage!
NARRATIVE_MAUSOLEUM_27_INTRO_4.zh: {EXCITED:crazydave}我们的队伍又多了一名大范围法师啊！

NARRATIVE_MAUSOLEUM_32_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:zombossicon}Dr. Zomboss has ordered the extermination of all books and living beings here.
NARRATIVE_MAUSOLEUM_32_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:zombossicon}僵尸博士已经下令灭除这里的一切图书还有活物。

NARRATIVE_MAUSOLEUM_32_INTRO_3.en: {SAY:zombossicon}Dr. Zomboss will personally oversee the progress. Those who perform well will be rewarded with land and fresh brains.
NARRATIVE_MAUSOLEUM_32_INTRO_3.zh: {SAY:zombossicon}僵尸博士将亲自下场监督执行进度。有功者奖封地与新鲜大脑。

NARRATIVE_MAUSOLEUM_32_INTRO_4.en: {NPC_EXIT:zombossicon}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:crazydave}Is my official career about to begin?

NARRATIVE_MAUSOLEUM_32_OUTRO_2.en: {SAY:zombossicon}Dr. Zomboss is extremely dissatisfied with the current situation! Dr. Zomboss will extend the corvée labor for all minions by 100 years!
NARRATIVE_MAUSOLEUM_32_OUTRO_2.zh: {SAY:zombossicon}僵尸博士对目前状况十分不满！僵尸博士将给全体小兵延长徭役 100 年！

NARRATIVE_MAUSOLEUM_32_OUTRO_3.en: {SAY:zombossicon}Dr. Zomboss will wait for another opportunity to unify the harmonious towns of the past, present, and future!
NARRATIVE_MAUSOLEUM_32_OUTRO_3.zh: {SAY:zombossicon}僵尸博士将另待时机，一统古今与将来的和睦小镇！

NARRATIVE_MAUSOLEUM_3_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}My sensors detect that some zombies are carrying ranged weapons.
NARRATIVE_MAUSOLEUM_3_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}我的侦测器检测到一些僵尸携带了远程武器。

NARRATIVE_MAUSOLEUM_3_INTRO_3.en: {SAY:winnie}Although they don't have guns, they have an endless supply of bows and arrows.
NARRATIVE_MAUSOLEUM_3_INTRO_3.zh: {SAY:winnie}虽然没有枪，但是它们有取之无尽的弓箭。

NARRATIVE_MAUSOLEUM_3_INTRO_4.en: {SAY:crazydave}{SPECIAL2}My saucepan is finally coming in handy!

NARRATIVE_MAUSOLEUM_6_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:crazydave}So neat and tidy! Is this a military parade?

NARRATIVE_MAUSOLEUM_6_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:winnie}Those are Shield Guard Zombies in formation. They raise their shields up front, moving as a single unit.
NARRATIVE_MAUSOLEUM_6_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}那是列阵的盾卫僵尸，它们前举盾牌，浑然一体。

NARRATIVE_MAUSOLEUM_6_INTRO_3.en: {SAY:winnie}Magic Vine can harness electrical magic to deal higher damage to their shields.
NARRATIVE_MAUSOLEUM_6_INTRO_3.zh: {SAY:winnie}魔藤能运用电系魔力，对盾牌造成更高伤害。

NARRATIVE_MAUSOLEUM_6_INTRO_4.en: {EXCITED:crazydave}Helmets, cavalry, bows, shields, and magic... sounds so familiar!
NARRATIVE_MAUSOLEUM_6_INTRO_4.zh: {EXCITED:crazydave}铁盔、骑兵、弓箭、盾牌还有魔法，好熟悉啊！

NARRATIVE_MAUSOLEUM_9_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Careful! I've detected a group of assassins approaching.
NARRATIVE_MAUSOLEUM_9_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}小心！我侦测到一群刺客即将靠近

NARRATIVE_MAUSOLEUM_9_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:winnie}They are holding scrolls with sharp daggers hidden inside.
NARRATIVE_MAUSOLEUM_9_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}它们手持卷筒，内藏锐利的匕首。

NARRATIVE_MEGAGATLING_EQ_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Plant Mega Gatling Pea to fire 4 peas at a time.
NARRATIVE_MEGAGATLING_EQ_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}种植超级机枪豌豆，获得 4 倍火力。

NARRATIVE_MEGAGATLING_EQ_PEAVINE_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Plant Pea Vine on Mega Gatling Pea for a damage boost.
NARRATIVE_MEGAGATLING_EQ_PEAVINE_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}在超级机枪豌豆上种植豌豆藤蔓，强化他的伤害。

NARRATIVE_MEGAGATLING_EQ_PF_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Mega Gatling Pea has a chance to spontaneously Plant Food.
NARRATIVE_MEGAGATLING_EQ_PF_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}超级机枪豌豆有概率自动产生叶绿素效果。

NARRATIVE_MEGAGATLING_EQ_UPGRADE_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Once Plant Fooded, Mega Gatling Pea fires 5 peas instead of 4.
NARRATIVE_MEGAGATLING_EQ_UPGRADE_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}获得叶绿素效果后，超级机枪豌豆可以一次性发射 5 颗豌豆。

NARRATIVE_MGPWA_LTE_2023_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:sunflower}{SAY:sunflower}It’s cold out. Snow is on the ground. And you can smell it in the air…
NARRATIVE_MGPWA_LTE_2023_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:sunflower}{SAY:sunflower}冷死了。遍地都是皑皑白雪。连空气中都满是它的味道……

NARRATIVE_MGPWA_LTE_2023_3_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{NPC_ENTER:wallnut_r}{SAY:peashooter}There is an inbound infestation of Balloon Zombies!

NARRATIVE_MGPWA_LTE_2023_3_2.en: {SAY:peashooter}I can’t stop them! They are above me.
NARRATIVE_MGPWA_LTE_2023_3_2.zh: {SAY:peashooter}我阻止不了它们！它们都在我脑袋上面。

NARRATIVE_MGPWA_LTE_2023_5_5.en: {SAY:wallnut_r}Meteor Flower and Mega Gatling Pea are awesome!
NARRATIVE_MGPWA_LTE_2023_5_5.zh: {SAY:wallnut_r}流星花和超级机枪豌豆太棒啦！

NARRATIVE_MGPWA_LTE_2023_5_7.zh: {SAY:wallnut_r}真是期待我们的下一场冒险啊！

NARRATIVE_MGPWA_LTE_2024_15_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}This is the final battle! Those sales are as good as mine!!!
NARRATIVE_MGPWA_LTE_2024_15_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}决战时刻！折扣商品都是我的!!!

NARRATIVE_MGPWA_LTE_2024_15_2.en: {NPC_EXIT:zomboss_r}{NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:peashooter}You're right about one thing Zomboss, but you can't keep us from those savings!!!
NARRATIVE_MGPWA_LTE_2024_15_2.zh: {NPC_EXIT:zomboss_r}{NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:peashooter}确实是决战，僵王，但能省下钱的是我们!!!

NARRATIVE_MGPWA_LTE_2024_16_2.en: {NPC_EXIT:zomboss_r}{NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:peashooter}Back of the line with you Zomboss!

NARRATIVE_MGPWA_LTE_2024_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:sunflower}{SAY:sunflower}Ah...the holidays are over! You know what that means?
NARRATIVE_MGPWA_LTE_2024_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:sunflower}{SAY:sunflower}啊…节日结束了！你们知道这代表什么吗？

NARRATIVE_MGPWA_LTE_2024_1_4.en: {NPC_EXIT:wallnut}{NPC_EXIT:peashooter_r}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}MWHAHA! I'll make the crowds busier than ever, then all the sales will be MINE!!!
NARRATIVE_MGPWA_LTE_2024_1_4.zh: {NPC_EXIT:wallnut}{NPC_EXIT:peashooter_r}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}木哈哈！我要让人潮比以往更繁杂，这样，所有的折扣商品都是我的了!!!

NARRATIVE_MGPWA_LTE_2024_2_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:sunflower}{SAY:sunflower}These zombies will not keep us from our discounts!!!
NARRATIVE_MGPWA_LTE_2024_2_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:sunflower}{SAY:sunflower}这些僵尸阻止不了我们享受特价!!!

NARRATIVE_MGPWA_LTE_2024_5_2.en: {NPC_EXIT:sunflower}{NPC_ENTER:wallnut}{SAY:wallnut}We don't want to miss the fire sales...
NARRATIVE_MGPWA_LTE_2024_5_2.zh: {NPC_EXIT:sunflower}{NPC_ENTER:wallnut}{SAY:wallnut}我们可不能错过这些清仓甩卖啊…

NARRATIVE_MGPWA_LTE_2024_6_2.en: {NPC_EXIT:sunflower}{NPC_ENTER:wallnut}{SAY:wallnut}We don't want to miss the fire sales...
NARRATIVE_MGPWA_LTE_2024_6_2.zh: {NPC_EXIT:sunflower}{NPC_ENTER:wallnut}{SAY:wallnut}我们可不能错过这些清仓甩卖啊…

NARRATIVE_MINIGAME_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydaveicon}{SAY}现在这里有一个传统的敲击项目。

NARRATIVE_MINIGAME_INTRO_2.en: {EXCITED:crazydaveicon}Facebreaker is a blast from the past, right to your face!
NARRATIVE_MINIGAME_INTRO_2.zh: {EXCITED:crazydaveicon}“非酋终结者”向来因为过分依赖开罐者的脸色（运气）而饱受诟病，请注意右侧的脸皮！

NARRATIVE_MINIGAME_INTRO_3.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnieicon}{TIRED}这被称为破罐者，用户戴夫。破罐者。

NARRATIVE_MINIGAME_INTRO_4.en: {PLAYFUL:crazydaveicon}In that case, it must be right to your vase!
NARRATIVE_MINIGAME_INTRO_4.zh: {PLAYFUL:crazydaveicon}那么，它们一定正对着你的花瓶了！

NARRATIVE_MISSILETOE_LOD_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:Winnie}{SAY:Winnie}Tap Missile Toe to arm her, then tap the target to fire.
NARRATIVE_MISSILETOE_LOD_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:Winnie}{SAY:Winnie}点击玉米加农炮来武装她，再点击一个格子开火。

NARRATIVE_MODERN_11_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}We have picked up a Shadow-shroom seed packet, User Dave.
NARRATIVE_MODERN_11_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}我们刚捡到毒影菇植物卡片，用户戴夫。

NARRATIVE_MODERN_11_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:winnie} Shadow-shrooms are shadow plants, so be sure to plant them next to Moonflowers for bonus effects.
NARRATIVE_MODERN_11_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}毒影菇同样是一种暗影系植物。所以为了获得增强效果，请把他们栽种在月光花身旁。

NARRATIVE_MODERN_11_INTRO_3.zh: {EXCITED:crazydave}又是一次邻里关系的大胜利！

NARRATIVE_MODERN_15_OUTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:crazydave} 看啊，潘妮！这不是我的玉米卷吗！

NARRATIVE_MODERN_15_OUTRO_2.en: {SAY:winnie}No, User Dave! You must not! I detect high levels of trappiness!
NARRATIVE_MODERN_15_OUTRO_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}不，用户戴夫！你不能吃它！我侦测到了高浓度的陷阱指数！

NARRATIVE_MODERN_15_OUTRO_3.zh:
{EXCITED:crazydave}但是…我饿了…所以…玉米卷…我来啦！
…嘎吱嘎吱…

NARRATIVE_MODERN_16_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}Fools! You have fallen into my excruciatingly obvious trap!
NARRATIVE_MODERN_16_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}傻瓜！你们已经掉进我明设的残酷陷阱啦！

NARRATIVE_MODERN_16_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:zombossicon} My vast and varied array of Gargantuars will pummel you into total oblivion!
NARRATIVE_MODERN_16_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:zombossicon}我那庞大而形形色色的巨人大军将会以重拳出击，把你打到完全失忆！

NARRATIVE_MODERN_16_INTRO_3.zh: {NPC_EXIT:zombossicon}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{EXCITED:crazydave}然后我就可以得到我的玉米卷了吗？

NARRATIVE_MODERN_17_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}The Dusk Lobber is yet another shadow plant, User Dave.
NARRATIVE_MODERN_17_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}幽暮投手又是一种暗影系植物，用户戴夫。

NARRATIVE_MODERN_17_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:winnie}On its own, it lobs exploding projectiles.
NARRATIVE_MODERN_17_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}就其本身而言，它能够投掷具有爆炸属性的炮弹。

NARRATIVE_MODERN_17_INTRO_3.en: {SAY:winnie}In its powered state, however, it lobs down three lanes!
NARRATIVE_MODERN_17_INTRO_3.zh: {SAY:winnie}若在增强效果下，它的投掷范围能遍及包括三行！

NARRATIVE_MODERN_17_INTRO_4.en: {EXCITED:crazydave}That's a lane for each of my thumbs and noses!
NARRATIVE_MODERN_17_INTRO_4.zh: {EXCITED:crazydave}我的每根拇指以及我的鼻子都分别占有一行！

NARRATIVE_MODERN_19_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Escape Root is a tricky plant, User Dave.
NARRATIVE_MODERN_19_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}逃脱树根是个很令僵尸棘手的植物，用户戴夫。

NARRATIVE_MODERN_19_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:winnie}When threatened, it swaps in an explosive plant!
NARRATIVE_MODERN_19_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}当它受到威胁时，它就会变成爆炸植物！

NARRATIVE_MODERN_19_INTRO_3.en: {SAY:winnie}And if you tap it, and then another plant, they will switch places!
NARRATIVE_MODERN_19_INTRO_3.zh: {SAY:winnie}如果你点它一下，再点另一株植物，它们就会交换位置！

NARRATIVE_MODERN_19_INTRO_4.en: {SAY:winnie}You can use Escape Roots to rescue endangered plants!
NARRATIVE_MODERN_19_INTRO_4.zh: {SAY:winnie}你可以使用逃脱树根来拯救那些危险中的植物！

NARRATIVE_MODERN_19_INTRO_5.en: {EXCITED:crazydave}Whaaaaa-? Plants can be in-dangered? CALL THE POLICE!
NARRATIVE_MODERN_19_INTRO_5.zh: {EXCITED:crazydave}啥？植物受到威胁了？快点打110啊啊啊啊！

NARRATIVE_MODERN_1_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}啊哈！时空悖论计划，现在…开始！

NARRATIVE_MODERN_1_INTRO_3.en: {SAY:winnie}We have arrived moments before our departure!
NARRATIVE_MODERN_1_INTRO_3.zh: {SAY:winnie}我们已经回到了时空之旅出发前的某一时刻！

NARRATIVE_MODERN_1_INTRO_4.en: {SAY:winnie}If my guess is correct, Dr. Zomboss will attempt to prevent your initial taco-consumption!
NARRATIVE_MODERN_1_INTRO_4.zh: {SAY:winnie}如果我的猜想正确，僵王博士一定在试图阻止你起初的玉米卷吞食行为！

NARRATIVE_MODERN_1_INTRO_5.zh: {SAY:winnie}那么我们的时空之旅将会不复存在！

NARRATIVE_MODERN_1_INTRO_7.en: {EXCITED:crazydave}...OOOOOOOO! Sorry, I was busy screaming "No." Did you say "taco"?
NARRATIVE_MODERN_1_INTRO_7.zh: {EXCITED:crazydave}…啊啊啊啊啊啊！抱歉，我太专注于张皇失措地喊“不”了。你刚刚是说了“玉米卷”这个词吗？

NARRATIVE_MODERN_1_INTRO_8.en: {SAY:winnie}We must beware, User Dave. Dr. Zomboss will surely deploy all his time-varied zombies against us!
NARRATIVE_MODERN_1_INTRO_8.zh: {SAY:winnie}我们必须得小心了，用户戴夫。僵王博士肯定会派出他那来自各个时空形形色色的僵尸来对付我们！

NARRATIVE_MODERN_21_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}全明星僵尸正在入侵，用户戴夫！

NARRATIVE_MODERN_21_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:winnie}They tackle and destroy the first plant they encounter!
NARRATIVE_MODERN_21_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}他们擒拿并立马消灭他们所遇到的第一株植物！

NARRATIVE_MODERN_22_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:crazydave}Oy howdy! I think it's one of those Beghouled-y grids again, Penny!
NARRATIVE_MODERN_22_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:crazydave}啊哈！我觉得这又是一片宝尸迷阵的方格，潘妮！

NARRATIVE_MODERN_23_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}The Grimrose is a shadow plant, User Dave.
NARRATIVE_MODERN_23_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}报丧花是一种暗影族植物，用户戴夫。

NARRATIVE_MODERN_23_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:winnie}It drags down a zombie that enters its lane.
NARRATIVE_MODERN_23_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}它把踏入其所在行的一只僵尸拖下地狱。

NARRATIVE_MODERN_23_INTRO_3.en: {SAY:winnie}When powered, it can dispose of three zombies before it expires.
NARRATIVE_MODERN_23_INTRO_3.zh: {SAY:winnie}当得到月光花的强化效果时，它能够在离去前带走三只僵尸。

NARRATIVE_MODERN_23_INTRO_4.en: {EXCITED:crazydave}That just seems like it's trying too hard!

NARRATIVE_MODERN_24_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:crazydave}我听到了微弱的脚步声，这是噼噼啪啪的小跑！

NARRATIVE_MODERN_24_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:winnie}Engage caution, User Dave. I detect Super-fan Imps ahead!
NARRATIVE_MODERN_24_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}务必小心，用户戴夫。我检测到了大批超级球迷小鬼正在前来！

NARRATIVE_MODERN_24_INTRO_3.zh: {SAY:winnie}他们的团队精神无比狂热炸裂！

NARRATIVE_MODERN_2_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}The Moonflower emits sun, User Dave. But that is not all.
NARRATIVE_MODERN_2_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}月光花可以绽放出阳光，用户戴夫。但是这还不是她的所有能力。

NARRATIVE_MODERN_2_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:winnie}My scans show that it creates a special glow that augments plants of its type.
NARRATIVE_MODERN_2_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}我的雷达显示，它能制造一片能增强植物属性的特别光晕。

NARRATIVE_MODERN_2_INTRO_3.en: {SAY:winnie}Planting Moonflowers next to each other should increase their power.
NARRATIVE_MODERN_2_INTRO_3.zh: {SAY:winnie}将月光花种植到邻近的同类植物身边可以增强它们的能力。

NARRATIVE_MODERN_2_INTRO_4.en: {SAY:winnie}I suspect they will have the same effect on any other shadow plants we may find.
NARRATIVE_MODERN_2_INTRO_4.zh: {SAY:winnie}我猜想，这样的效果同样会出现在找到的其他暗影族植物身上。

NARRATIVE_MODERN_32_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}It is presently a moment of your apocalypse!

NARRATIVE_MODERN_32_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:zombossicon}Your reckless pursuit of an already-eaten taco has shattered all of time!
NARRATIVE_MODERN_32_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:zombossicon}你们那不计后果的追击玉米卷的时空之旅令时空产生了碎片！

NARRATIVE_MODERN_32_INTRO_3.en: {SAY:zombossicon}It falls to me to restore future, now, and past!
NARRATIVE_MODERN_32_INTRO_3.zh: {SAY:zombossicon}这不得不让我穿梭于过去，现在以及未来以修补它们！

NARRATIVE_MODERN_32_INTRO_5.en: {SAY:winnie}Has our quest ruptured the timestream itself?
NARRATIVE_MODERN_32_INTRO_5.zh: {SAY:winnie}我们此次的探寻真的会令时间长河支离破碎吗？

NARRATIVE_MODERN_32_INTRO_6.en: {SAY:crazydave}Allow me to address your concern thusly:
NARRATIVE_MODERN_32_INTRO_6.zh: {SAY:crazydave}我对你那不着边际的“担忧”这样回应：

NARRATIVE_MODERN_32_OUTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}Fools! Do you not value the validity of time?
NARRATIVE_MODERN_32_OUTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}傻瓜！你就没有认真的在某一层面上考虑过时空的合理性吗？

NARRATIVE_MODERN_32_OUTRO_2.en: {SAY:zombossicon}Care you not if one moment follows another?
NARRATIVE_MODERN_32_OUTRO_2.zh: {SAY:zombossicon}你们根本不在乎时间的流逝是连续性的！

NARRATIVE_MODERN_32_OUTRO_3.zh: {SAY:zombossicon}呆子！蠢货！顶着个铁锅的大傻瓜！

NARRATIVE_MODERN_32_OUTRO_4.en: {NPC_EXIT:zombossicon}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie} {EXCITED:crazydave}It's not a pot, it's a handled basin!
NARRATIVE_MODERN_32_OUTRO_4.zh: {NPC_EXIT:zombossicon}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie} {EXCITED:crazydave}这不是一顶普通的锅！这只是一个有把柄的盆！

NARRATIVE_MODERN_32_OUTRO_5.en: {SAY:winnie}I am concerned, User Dave. What if he speaks true?
NARRATIVE_MODERN_32_OUTRO_5.zh: {SAY:winnie}我有些担心，万一他说的是真的呢？

NARRATIVE_MODERN_32_OUTRO_6.en: {EXCITED:crazydave}I'm too taco-addled to care, Penny! FORWARD!
NARRATIVE_MODERN_32_OUTRO_6.zh: {EXCITED:crazydave}潘妮，担心这个只是种“玉米卷式糊涂”罢了！前进！

NARRATIVE_MODERN_33_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}I beseech you, time-zippers, you must listen to reason!
NARRATIVE_MODERN_33_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}算我求你们了，时空穿梭者，你们得听听原因！

NARRATIVE_MODERN_33_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:zombossicon}时空的连贯性将崩溃，我们所处的时空将支离破碎！

NARRATIVE_MODERN_33_INTRO_3.en: {SAY:zombossicon}Stuff is all jiggy and super wacked-out, like!
NARRATIVE_MODERN_33_INTRO_3.zh: {SAY:zombossicon}所有物质都变得不稳定，最终死气沉沉，就像戴夫你一样，不是嘛！

NARRATIVE_MODERN_33_OUTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}I am telling the truth, Insane Dave Person!
NARRATIVE_MODERN_33_OUTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}我是在说实话啊，疯疯癫癫的戴某人！

NARRATIVE_MODERN_33_OUTRO_2.en: {SAY:zombossicon}My words are utterly not an attempt to trick you!

NARRATIVE_MODERN_33_OUTRO_3.en: {SAY:zombossicon}You cannot re-eat a taco! It is impossible!
NARRATIVE_MODERN_33_OUTRO_3.zh: {SAY:zombossicon}你不能“再吃”一次玉米卷！这根本不可能！

NARRATIVE_MODERN_33_OUTRO_4.en: {NPC_EXIT:zombossicon}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{EXCITED:crazydave}Imp-possible? I HATE IMPS! WITH A PASSION!
NARRATIVE_MODERN_33_OUTRO_4.zh: {NPC_EXIT:zombossicon}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{EXCITED:crazydave}可能……就见鬼了！我讨厌见到那些激情四射的小鬼！

NARRATIVE_MODERN_34_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}If you will not listen, then you will be destroyed!
NARRATIVE_MODERN_34_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}如果你不听从我的建议，你将被永久被毁灭！

NARRATIVE_MODERN_34_OUTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}David, I implore you! You must give up your hopeless dream of a long-ago taco!
NARRATIVE_MODERN_34_OUTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}戴夫，我求求你了！求你放弃那想吃玉米卷的梦想吧！

NARRATIVE_MODERN_34_OUTRO_10.en: {EXCITED:crazydave}THIS IS THE GREATEST DAY IN MY OR ANYBODY ELSE'S LIFE!!!!
NARRATIVE_MODERN_34_OUTRO_10.zh: {EXCITED:crazydave}这是世界上所有人最最疯狂的一天啦！！！！

NARRATIVE_MODERN_34_OUTRO_11.en: {SAY:winnie}Indeed, perhaps we have misjudged Dr. Zomboss all this time...
NARRATIVE_MODERN_34_OUTRO_11.zh: {SAY:winnie}的确，也许我们一直都错怪博士先生了。

NARRATIVE_MODERN_34_OUTRO_12.en: {NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon} {SAY:zombossicon}Ha ha ha! Perhaps you HAVE misjudged me. Or... perhaps not!
NARRATIVE_MODERN_34_OUTRO_12.zh: {NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon} {SAY:zombossicon}哈哈哈！也许你们一直都错怪我了，或者……并没有！

NARRATIVE_MODERN_34_OUTRO_13.en: {SAY:zombossicon}I surely have no devious plans for the future! Or... do I?
NARRATIVE_MODERN_34_OUTRO_13.zh: {SAY:zombossicon}不过我保证将来我·不会再有这样邪恶的计划了……或者，我真的还会有？

NARRATIVE_MODERN_34_OUTRO_14.zh: {SAY:zombossicon}哇哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈！我们一定会再见面的！

NARRATIVE_MODERN_34_OUTRO_2.en: {SAY:zombossicon}It is gone, gone forever! But please, in its place, take this!
NARRATIVE_MODERN_34_OUTRO_2.zh: {SAY:zombossicon}它没了，永远地消失了，不复存在了！但是我给你准备了另一个，你就把这个拿走吧！

NARRATIVE_MODERN_34_OUTRO_8.en: {SPECIAL2}{EXCITED:crazydave}A TACO WITH A WAFFLE IN IT!!!!!

NARRATIVE_MODERN_34_OUTRO_9.en: {SAY:winnie}I detect high levels of deliciousness, User Dave.
NARRATIVE_MODERN_34_OUTRO_9.zh: {SAY:winnie}我探测到了极高的美味指数，用户戴夫。

NARRATIVE_MODERN_35_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}我的华夫饼玉米卷真是美味可口！

NARRATIVE_MODERN_35_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:crazydave}But do I smell more zombies ahead?
NARRATIVE_MODERN_35_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:crazydave}可是为何我嗅到前方有更多僵尸的气息呢？

NARRATIVE_MODERN_35_INTRO_3.en: {SAY:winnie}Tacos-With-Waffles-In-Them or not, zombies still want brains.
NARRATIVE_MODERN_35_INTRO_3.zh: {SAY:winnie}无论玉米卷是否有华夫饼，僵尸始终想要脑子。

NARRATIVE_MODERN_35_INTRO_4.en: {SAY:winnie}Stay on the lookout for stronger versions of zombies we've seen.
NARRATIVE_MODERN_35_INTRO_4.zh: {SAY:winnie}我们要对发现的强化版僵尸时刻保持警惕。

NARRATIVE_MODERN_3_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}The Shrinking Violet is well named, User Dave.
NARRATIVE_MODERN_3_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}缩小“谨”菜这个名字取得好啊，用户戴夫

NARRATIVE_MODERN_3_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:winnie}It shrinks zombies and makes them weaker.
NARRATIVE_MODERN_3_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}它能够缩小僵尸并让它们变得更脆弱。

NARRATIVE_MODERN_3_INTRO_3.en: {EXCITED:crazydave}Tiny zombies! Stay away from my shins!

NARRATIVE_MODERN_40_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}我们的割草机变成了割早机！

NARRATIVE_MODERN_40_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:winnie}Indeed, User Dave. Perhaps this is a consequence of Dr. Zomboss' Project Paradox.
NARRATIVE_MODERN_40_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}的确，用户戴夫。或许这是僵王博士悖论计划的成果之一。

NARRATIVE_MODERN_40_INTRO_3.en: {SAY:winnie}We likely will not be able to rely on them going forward.
NARRATIVE_MODERN_40_INTRO_3.zh: {SAY:winnie}我们似乎不能再依赖割草机继续前行了。

NARRATIVE_MODERN_40_INTRO_4.en: {SAY:crazydave}But I need them for squirbo hunting!
NARRATIVE_MODERN_40_INTRO_4.zh: {SAY:crazydave}可我需要它们来捕猎疯狂松鼠什么的呀！

NARRATIVE_MODERN_44_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}Did you enjoy your augmented taco, David?
NARRATIVE_MODERN_44_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}品尝了自己的强化版玉米卷了吗，戴夫？

NARRATIVE_MODERN_44_INTRO_4.zh: {SAY:zombossicon}它的 秘—密—配—方 是什么呢？

NARRATIVE_MODERN_44_INTRO_5.en: {SAY:zombossicon}Surely then you shall appreciate my augmented zombies in equal measure!
NARRATIVE_MODERN_44_INTRO_5.zh: {SAY:zombossicon}可以确定的是你一定会感激那与你实力相当的强化版僵尸的！

NARRATIVE_MODERN_44_OUTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}I think we survived, Penny! Can you check?
NARRATIVE_MODERN_44_OUTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}我认为我们活下来了，潘妮！你能检查确认一下吗？

NARRATIVE_MODERN_44_OUTRO_2.en: {SAY:winnie}Scanning... I calculate 98% chance of survival with 3% margin of error.
NARRATIVE_MODERN_44_OUTRO_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}扫描中……我算出有 98% 的存活率。本次计算有 3% 的边际误差。

NARRATIVE_MODERN_44_OUTRO_3.zh: {SAY:crazydave}感谢玉米卷为强化版植物所做的一切！

NARRATIVE_MODERN_44_OUTRO_4.en: {NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}Curses! It appears that further zombie game-upping shall be required!
NARRATIVE_MODERN_44_OUTRO_4.zh: {NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}呸！这表明需要在游戏中加入更高端的僵尸强化了！

NARRATIVE_MODERN_5_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}The Nightshade is another shadow plant, User Dave.
NARRATIVE_MODERN_5_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}夜影茄又是一株暗影系植物，用户戴夫。

NARRATIVE_MODERN_5_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:winnie}By itself it deals slapping damage to zombies.
NARRATIVE_MODERN_5_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}如果使用它单枪匹马出战，它可以在短时间内对僵尸造成伤害。

NARRATIVE_MODERN_5_INTRO_3.en: {SAY:winnie}But if it is planted next a Moonflower, both will become more powerful.
NARRATIVE_MODERN_5_INTRO_3.zh: {SAY:winnie}若是将它栽种在月光花附近，那么两者都会变得更加强大！

NARRATIVE_MODERN_8_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}I am picking up a grid of plants, User Dave.
NARRATIVE_MODERN_8_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}我找到了一片成棋盘状分布的植物群，用户戴夫。

NARRATIVE_MODERN_8_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:winnie}My scans suggest that they can be swapped to create matches of three.
NARRATIVE_MODERN_8_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}我的雷达显示，它们可以通过两两交换来制造一组由三株同种植物形成的匹配。

NARRATIVE_MODERN_8_INTRO_3.en: {EXCITED:crazydave}I saw a game like that once on my telephoney!
NARRATIVE_MODERN_8_INTRO_3.zh: {EXCITED:crazydave}就像是我在我手机上见过的那个游戏！

NARRATIVE_MODERN_9_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}My sensors are picking up increased helium levels, User Dave.
NARRATIVE_MODERN_9_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}用户戴夫，我的传感器检测到氦含量升高。

NARRATIVE_MODERN_9_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:winnie}I suspect we may be facing one or more Balloon Zombies.
NARRATIVE_MODERN_9_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}我猜测我们将要面对至少一只气球僵尸。

NARRATIVE_MODERN_9_INTRO_3.en: {EXCITED:crazydave}I hate one or more Balloon Zombies!

NARRATIVE_MODERN_OUTRO_DANGER_ROOM_KEY_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:crazydave}Penny! A random length of sewer pipe!

NARRATIVE_MODERN_OUTRO_DANGER_ROOM_KEY_2.en: {SAY:winnie}Be careful, User Dave. That pipe is part of a municipal mulch of endless engagement!
NARRATIVE_MODERN_OUTRO_DANGER_ROOM_KEY_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}小心，用户戴夫。那个下水管道里会爬出无穷无尽的僵尸！

NARRATIVE_MORE_LEVELS_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnieicon}{SAY}There's still more levels in open worlds.
NARRATIVE_MORE_LEVELS_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnieicon}{SAY}在已开放世界里还有更多关卡。

NARRATIVE_MORE_LEVELS_2.en: {EXCITED:winnieicon}And there are still plants and rewards to earn too.
NARRATIVE_MORE_LEVELS_2.zh: {EXCITED:winnieicon}而且还有待获得的植物和奖励。

NARRATIVE_MORE_LEVELS_4.en: {TIRED:crazydaveicon}We haven't forgotten about you my dear lost taco.
NARRATIVE_MORE_LEVELS_4.zh: {TIRED:crazydaveicon}我们还没忘了你，我亲爱的失踪玉米卷。

NARRATIVE_MURKADAMIA_EQ_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Plant Murkadamia Nuts to block and damage zombies.
NARRATIVE_MURKADAMIA_EQ_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}种植黑暗夏威夷果，他们不仅可以阻挡僵尸，还能对它们造成伤害。

NARRATIVE_NIGHTCAP_EQ2023_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Nightcap's poison attacks cut right through armor.
NARRATIVE_NIGHTCAP_EQ2023_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}暗夜菇的剧毒攻击可以穿透盔甲。

NARRATIVE_NIGHTCAP_EQ2023_2_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Nightcap goes into stealth when Zombies are close.
NARRATIVE_NIGHTCAP_EQ2023_2_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}当僵尸接近时，暗夜菇会进入潜行模式。

NARRATIVE_NIGHTCAP_EQ2023_3_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Plant Food powered Nightcap doubles its poison damage and attacks 3 lanes.
NARRATIVE_NIGHTCAP_EQ2023_3_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}受到叶绿素强化的暗夜菇剧毒伤害翻倍，还能攻击 3 行的敌人。

NARRATIVE_NOCTARINE_EQ_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}种植暗夜油桃, 创造有毒的烟雾.
NARRATIVE_NOCTARINE_EQ_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}种植暗夜油桃，创造有毒的烟雾。

NARRATIVE_OLIVEPIT_EQ_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}种植油橄榄坑, 看着他们吞下僵尸.
NARRATIVE_OLIVEPIT_EQ_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}种植油橄榄坑，看着他们吞下僵尸。

NARRATIVE_ORANBOOM_QUEST_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}Wow, everything here is so golden. Where are we?

NARRATIVE_ORANBOOM_QUEST_2.en: {SAY:winnie}User Dave, we are currently on the Ryukyu Islands.
NARRATIVE_ORANBOOM_QUEST_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}用户戴夫，我们目前在琉球群岛上。

NARRATIVE_ORANBOOM_QUEST_4.en: {SAY:winnie}Yes, this is a stop on our time travel.
NARRATIVE_ORANBOOM_QUEST_4.zh: {SAY:winnie}是的，这里是平行世界的我们在时空环游之旅中的一站。

NARRATIVE_ORANBOOM_QUEST_5.en: {SAY:winnie}The Ryukyu Kingdom of the Ryukyu Islands is located near Far Eastern Japan.
NARRATIVE_ORANBOOM_QUEST_5.zh: {SAY:winnie}琉球群岛的琉球王国在远东之倭附近。

NARRATIVE_ORANBOOM_QUEST_6.zh: {SAY:crazydave}那我可以吃到亚洲风味的玉米卷了吗？

NARRATIVE_ORANBOOM_QUEST_7.en: {SAY:winnie}…Maybe you can go to the moon and eat it.

NARRATIVE_OUT_OF_CONTENT_FUTURE_NEXT_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydaveicon}{START_DIALOG_MUSIC}Where do you think the future will take us?
NARRATIVE_OUT_OF_CONTENT_FUTURE_NEXT_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydaveicon}{START_DIALOG_MUSIC}你觉得未来会将我们带向何方？

NARRATIVE_OUT_OF_CONTENT_FUTURE_NEXT_2.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnieicon}Practicing advanced planting techniques in the Endless Zones...
NARRATIVE_OUT_OF_CONTENT_FUTURE_NEXT_2.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnieicon}在无尽地带中练习更为高超的种植技巧…

NARRATIVE_OUT_OF_CONTENT_FUTURE_NEXT_3.en: {SAY:winnieicon}Will keep you sharp for future trials.

NARRATIVE_OUT_OF_CONTENT_FUTURE_NEXT_4.en: {SAY:crazydaveicon}{SPECIAL15}Just remember. Tomorrow is always a taco...
NARRATIVE_OUT_OF_CONTENT_FUTURE_NEXT_4.zh: {SAY:crazydaveicon}{SPECIAL15}请记住。明日，永远都是一个玉米卷…

NARRATIVE_OUT_OF_CONTENT_FUTURE_NEXT_5.en: {SPECIAL16:crazydaveicon}And a taco is what we find inside of all of us.
NARRATIVE_OUT_OF_CONTENT_FUTURE_NEXT_5.zh: {SPECIAL16:crazydave}而玉米卷，正是我们每个人内心深处所苦苦寻求之物。

NARRATIVE_OUT_OF_CONTENT_SOON_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydaveicon}It may look like the end of the road...

NARRATIVE_OUT_OF_CONTENT_SOON_10.en: {PLAYFUL:crazydaveicon}Could you put it in the fridge?

NARRATIVE_OUT_OF_CONTENT_SOON_2.en: {SAY:crazydaveicon}But the road goes on when searching for a taco on the space-time continuum.
NARRATIVE_OUT_OF_CONTENT_SOON_2.zh: {SAY:crazydaveicon}但是当在时空连续中寻找玉米卷的时候，这条路还会延伸。

NARRATIVE_OUT_OF_CONTENT_SOON_3.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnieicon}{SAY:winnieicon}In the meantime, be sure to practice advanced planting techniques in the Endless Zones.
NARRATIVE_OUT_OF_CONTENT_SOON_3.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnieicon}{SAY:winnieicon}同时，请确保在无尽地带中练习更为高超的种植技巧…

NARRATIVE_OUT_OF_CONTENT_SOON_4.en: {PLAYFUL:crazydaveicon}Penny is right. It's important to stay sharp.
NARRATIVE_OUT_OF_CONTENT_SOON_4.zh: {PLAYFUL:crazydaveicon}潘妮的说法完全正确。养精蓄锐以备亮剑之时，这事尤为重要。

NARRATIVE_OUT_OF_CONTENT_SOON_5.en: {EXCITED:crazydaveicon}You never know when you might find zombies on your lawn.
NARRATIVE_OUT_OF_CONTENT_SOON_5.zh: {EXCITED:crazydaveicon}你永远不知哪一天会在草坪上再次发现僵尸。

NARRATIVE_OUT_OF_CONTENT_SOON_8.zh: {TIRED:crazydaveicon}怀疑这一点吗，你只是不清楚而已。

NARRATIVE_OUT_OF_CONTENT_SOON_9.en: {SAY:crazydaveicon}But if you do find my taco on your lawn...
NARRATIVE_OUT_OF_CONTENT_SOON_9.zh: {SAY:crazydaveicon}倘若你在自家草坪上发现我的玉米卷…

NARRATIVE_PEPPERMINT_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Power Mints are powerful plants you can acquire through Arena mode.
NARRATIVE_PEPPERMINT_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}超能薄荷是一类强大的植物，你可以在竞技场模式获得它们。

NARRATIVE_PEPPERMINT_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:winnie}They provide a big boost to plants in their family.
NARRATIVE_PEPPERMINT_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}它们对相应家族的植物有巨大的增益作用。

NARRATIVE_PEPPERMINT_INTRO_3.zh: {SAY:winnie}火辣薄荷家族包括火系植物。

NARRATIVE_PIRATE_26_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}I see more seas! Arrrr there more zombies?
NARRATIVE_PIRATE_26_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}我看到了更广袤的海域！海的那边，是更多的僵尸吗？

NARRATIVE_PIRATE_26_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:winnie}More pirate zombies have appeared, and with greater strength.
NARRATIVE_PIRATE_26_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}更多的海盗僵尸已经出现，并且有着更强大的力量。

NARRATIVE_PIRATE_26_INTRO_3.en: {SAY:winnie}We may need to retreat to another timeline and return when our plants are stronger.
NARRATIVE_PIRATE_26_INTRO_3.zh: {SAY:winnie}我们也许只能撤退到其他时间线的世界，等我们的植物变得更加强大时再回来了。

NARRATIVE_PIRATE_31_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}Ai-yowza! Our lawnmowers have walked some planks!
NARRATIVE_PIRATE_31_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}呜哇！我们的割草机走下甲板啦！

NARRATIVE_PIRATE_31_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:winnie}The temporal energies are too powerful for them, User Dave.
NARRATIVE_PIRATE_31_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}时空的能量对于它们来说过于强大了，用户戴夫。

NARRATIVE_PIRATE_31_INTRO_3.en: {SAY:winnie}We cannot allow even a single zombie past our defenses.
NARRATIVE_PIRATE_31_INTRO_3.zh: {SAY:winnie}现在我们不能让哪怕是一只僵尸跨过我们的防线。

NARRATIVE_PIRATE_31_INTRO_4.en: {SAY:crazydave}Good thing we popped all those piñatas earlier!
NARRATIVE_PIRATE_31_INTRO_4.zh: {SAY:crazydave}好消息是，我们早就敲完那些带有种子包的彩陶了！

NARRATIVE_PIRATE_35_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}The timbers be shivered! The seas are ablaze!
NARRATIVE_PIRATE_35_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}木板瑟瑟发抖，大海怒目圆睁！

NARRATIVE_PIRATE_35_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:zombossicon}Your doom is assured! Your mind is a haze!
NARRATIVE_PIRATE_35_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:zombossicon}你们的劫数早已板上钉钉！你们的思绪犹如雾里看花！

NARRATIVE_PIRATE_35_INTRO_3.en: {SAY:zombossicon}The Zombot Plank Walker 2.0 shall soon rule the waves!
NARRATIVE_PIRATE_35_INTRO_3.zh: {SAY:zombossicon}甲板踏行者僵尸机器人 2.0 必将统领波涛！

NARRATIVE_PIRATE_35_OUTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}We lived! Take that, planks and zombies and seaweed!
NARRATIVE_PIRATE_35_OUTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}我们成功存活下来了！接招吧，甲板、僵尸，还有海草！

NARRATIVE_PIRATE_35_OUTRO_2.en: {SAY:winnie}Indeed, User Dave, piracy is not a victimless crime.
NARRATIVE_PIRATE_35_OUTRO_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}的确如此，用户戴夫。海盗行为可不是没有受害者的犯罪。

NARRATIVE_PIRATE_35_OUTRO_3.en: {NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}These upgraded plants are egregious and unfair!
NARRATIVE_PIRATE_35_OUTRO_3.zh: {NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}这些进阶植物太坏，太不公平了！

NARRATIVE_PIRATE_CHALLENGE_LASTSTAND_A_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY}It's low tide and the waves are coming in.
NARRATIVE_PIRATE_CHALLENGE_LASTSTAND_A_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY}退潮了，可是惊涛骇浪般的僵尸要来了。

NARRATIVE_PIRATE_CHALLENGE_LASTSTAND_A_2.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{EXCITED:crazydave}Grab your water wings! We're going to get wet.
NARRATIVE_PIRATE_CHALLENGE_LASTSTAND_A_2.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{EXCITED:crazydave}抓好你的救生圈！我们要被淋湿了。

NARRATIVE_PIRATE_CHALLENGE_LASTSTAND_C_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{PLAYFUL}You've got a boat load of sun. Don't go overboard.
NARRATIVE_PIRATE_CHALLENGE_LASTSTAND_C_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{PLAYFUL}你有一船的阳光。别浪费它们。

NARRATIVE_PIRATE_CHALLENGE_MINIGAME_A_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY}Target score activated. Let's see if you can beat my high score.
NARRATIVE_PIRATE_CHALLENGE_MINIGAME_A_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY}目标分数机制已激活。让我看看你能否够超越我的最高分。

NARRATIVE_PIRATE_CHALLENGE_MINIGAME_A_2.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{PLAYFUL:crazydave}And put in KRZYDV as your initials.
NARRATIVE_PIRATE_CHALLENGE_MINIGAME_A_2.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{PLAYFUL:crazydave}然后请在最高分排行榜跳出时署名“じ☆ve 瘋狂戴鈇”。

NARRATIVE_PIRATE_CHALLENGE_MINIGAME_B_2.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{EXCITED:crazydave}Who cares? We have cannons and a score to beat.
NARRATIVE_PIRATE_CHALLENGE_MINIGAME_B_2.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{EXCITED:crazydave}谁在乎呢？我们手头有大炮以及要挑战的记录。

NARRATIVE_PIRATE_CHALLENGE_MINIGAME_C_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Congratulations on beating my scores. I'm not bitter.
NARRATIVE_PIRATE_CHALLENGE_MINIGAME_C_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}恭喜达到我的记录。我一点也不难过。

NARRATIVE_PIRATE_CHALLENGE_MINIGAME_C_2.zh: {TIRED:winnie}我才没有说你开挂的意思……挂仔。

NARRATIVE_PIRATE_CHALLENGE_MINIGAME_C_3.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{EXCITED:crazydave}好耶！真是其乐融融、皆大欢喜呢！

NARRATIVE_PIRATE_CHALLENGE_PRESET_A_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY}黄油焖地刺，还有更好的搭配吗。

NARRATIVE_PIRATE_CHALLENGE_PRESET_A_2.en: {PLAYFUL}That's what butter and spikes are made of.

NARRATIVE_PIRATE_CHALLENGE_PRESET_A_3.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}That's hard to argue or agree with.

NARRATIVE_PIRATE_CHALLENGE_PROTECTPLANTS.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{PLAYFUL:crazydave}And don't let those beans walk the plank.
NARRATIVE_PIRATE_CHALLENGE_PROTECTPLANTS.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{PLAYFUL:crazydave}可千万别让那些豆子“走木板”啊。

NARRATIVE_PIRATE_CHALLENGE_PROTECTPLANTS.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{PLAYFUL}Those Spring Beans are living on the edge.

NARRATIVE_PIRATE_CHALLENGE_PROTECTPLANTS.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}危险两个字都写它们脸上了。

NARRATIVE_PIRATE_CHALLENGE_PROTECTPLANTS.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY}It is now clear that these beans are being stalked.
NARRATIVE_PIRATE_CHALLENGE_PROTECTPLANTS.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY}真相大白，这些豆子被跟踪了。

NARRATIVE_PIRATE_INTRO_FIRSTLEVEL_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{TIRED:winnie}I thought we were trying to get back home and get your taco.
NARRATIVE_PIRATE_INTRO_FIRSTLEVEL_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{TIRED:winnie}我曾想我们是否应该尝试回家去找你的玉米卷。

NARRATIVE_PIRATE_INTRO_FIRSTLEVEL_2.en: {SHOUT:crazydave}But Pirates! Hang on to your parrots and peg legs!
NARRATIVE_PIRATE_INTRO_FIRSTLEVEL_2.zh: {SHOUT:crazydave}但这可是海盗生活诶！珍藏好你的鹦鹉和假腿！

NARRATIVE_PIRATE_INTRO_GARGANTUAR_2.en: {SAY:zombossicon}Be advised that your sailing vessel is of insufficient size.
NARRATIVE_PIRATE_INTRO_GARGANTUAR_2.zh: {SAY:zombossicon}提个建议：你们的小帆船似乎不够大。

NARRATIVE_PIRATE_INTRO_GARGANTUAR_3.zh: {SAY:zombossicon}谨启 埃德加 · 僵王博士。

NARRATIVE_PIRATE_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}I've discovered a mysterious trait in your rattletrap time machine.
NARRATIVE_PIRATE_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}我刚才发现了你那破烂时间机器的秘密。

NARRATIVE_PIRATE_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_2.en: {SAY:zombossicon}Its temporal signature is nearly identical to my own creations.
NARRATIVE_PIRATE_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_2.zh: {SAY:zombossicon}她的制造日期签名与我其他作品的签名完全相同。

NARRATIVE_PIRATE_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_3.en: {SAY:zombossicon}Explain to me, how was this "Penny" created in the first place?
NARRATIVE_PIRATE_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_3.zh: {SAY:zombossicon}请你同我解释一下，这个“潘妮”当初是如何被制造出来的呢？

NARRATIVE_PIRATE_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_4.en: {NPC_EXIT:zombossicon}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:winnie}Could I really be some form of Zombot?
NARRATIVE_PIRATE_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_4.zh: {NPC_EXIT:zombossicon}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:winnie}我真的是僵王博士的机器人吗？

NARRATIVE_PIRATE_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_5.en: {TIRED:winnie}User Dave, am I the daughter of Dr. Zomboss?
NARRATIVE_PIRATE_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_5.zh: {TIRED:winnie}用户戴夫，难道我是僵王博士的造物吗？

NARRATIVE_PIRATE_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_6.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{PLAYFUL:crazydave}That was one fine sandwich! So, what did I miss?
NARRATIVE_PIRATE_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_6.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{PLAYFUL:crazydave}那是一块很美味的三明治！所以，我错过了什么？

NARRATIVE_PIRATE_OUTRO_DANGER_ROOM_KEY_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:crazydave}Finally, one of these pirates dropped some booty!
NARRATIVE_PIRATE_OUTRO_DANGER_ROOM_KEY_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:crazydave}终于啊，有一位海盗掉落了点战利品！

NARRATIVE_PIRATE_OUTRO_DANGER_ROOM_KEY_2.en: {PLAYFUL:winnie}I'm detecting something more challenging than treasure inside.
NARRATIVE_PIRATE_OUTRO_DANGER_ROOM_KEY_2.zh: {PLAYFUL:winnie}我在战利品里面探测到有比金银珠宝更具挑战性的东西。

NARRATIVE_PIRATE_OUTRO_GARGANTUAR_2.en: {SAY:winnie}With it we can access another World.

NARRATIVE_PLANTAGENET_16_INTRO_6.zh: {SAY:winnie}......她不能给你玉米卷，但是可以给僵尸补充能量！

NARRATIVE_PLANTAGENET_16_INTRO_7.en: {SAY:crazydave}She is much gentler than the Mirror Queen who summons zombies in the Fairytale Forest.
NARRATIVE_PLANTAGENET_16_INTRO_7.zh: {SAY:crazydave}总比在童话森林召唤僵尸的魔镜女王温柔多了！

NARRATIVE_PLANTAGENET_1_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:mary}{NPC_ENTER:lily}{SAY:mary}Hi traveler, welcome to the Plantagenet, I'm Princess Mary, and here is my personal guard swordswoman Lily!
NARRATIVE_PLANTAGENET_1_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:mary}{NPC_ENTER:lily}{SAY:mary}亲爱的旅行者，欢迎来到金雀花王朝，我是公主玛丽，她是我的贴身护卫剑客莉莉！

NARRATIVE_PLANTAGENET_1_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:lily}{EXCITED:lily}I say hello to you as a swordswoman. If you are new here, please allow us to introduce you!
NARRATIVE_PLANTAGENET_1_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:lily}{EXCITED:lily}以剑客之名向你问好，初来乍到请容许我们为你介绍！

NARRATIVE_PLANTAGENET_1_INTRO_3.en: {TIRED:mary}A year ago this place was a paradise where cats, mice and plants coexisted, but one day...
NARRATIVE_PLANTAGENET_1_INTRO_3.zh: {TIRED:mary}一年前这里还是一片猫鼠和植物共同生存的乐土，可是有一天……

NARRATIVE_PLANTAGENET_1_INTRO_4.en: {TIRED:lily}The invasion of zombies destroyed this peace. They are very powerful and we are retreating steadily...
NARRATIVE_PLANTAGENET_1_INTRO_4.zh: {TIRED:lily}僵尸们的入侵破坏了这份安详，它们势力很强，我们节节败退……

NARRATIVE_PLANTAGENET_1_INTRO_5.en: {TIRED:mary}Not long ago, my father and mother were injured by zombies and left this world forever.
NARRATIVE_PLANTAGENET_1_INTRO_5.zh: {TIRED:mary}前不久父王和母后被僵尸打伤离开了这个世界。

NARRATIVE_PLANTAGENET_1_INTRO_6.en: {EXCITED:lily}I hope you can help us bring light back to the Kingdom!
NARRATIVE_PLANTAGENET_1_INTRO_6.zh: {EXCITED:lily}我希望你能帮助我们，让王国重现光明！

NARRATIVE_PLANTAGENET_1_INTRO_7.en: {EXCITED:mary}Please go to the west to find Lady Rose, she is the only warrior who has found the inheritance of power!
NARRATIVE_PLANTAGENET_1_INTRO_7.zh: {EXCITED:mary}去西部找到蔷薇女爵，她是唯一一位找到力量传承的勇士！

NARRATIVE_PLANTAGENET_20_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:crazydave}The magic floors will no longer glow!

NARRATIVE_PLANTAGENET_20_INTRO_2.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}User Dave, you successfully destroyed the circle and now it won't interfere with you, but the zombies are very mad.
NARRATIVE_PLANTAGENET_20_INTRO_2.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}用户戴夫，你成功摧毁了法阵，现在它不会对你进行干扰，但是僵尸们非常狂躁。

NARRATIVE_PLANTAGENET_20_INTRO_3.en: {SAY:crazydave}Iris and Divine Olive Wood aren't easy to fight against them?
NARRATIVE_PLANTAGENET_20_INTRO_3.zh: {SAY:crazydave}鸢尾花和神灵橄榄木对抗他们不是小菜一碟？

NARRATIVE_PLANTAGENET_20_INTRO_4.en: {SAY:winnie}You need to know how to cooperate so that nothing goes wrong.
NARRATIVE_PLANTAGENET_20_INTRO_4.zh: {SAY:winnie}你需要懂得配合，这样才能确保万无一失。

NARRATIVE_PLANTAGENET_20_INTRO_5.en: {SAY:crazydave}The final battle is here, neighbor, I'm going to eat tacos first, bye!
NARRATIVE_PLANTAGENET_20_INTRO_5.zh: {SAY:crazydave}最终之战到来了，邻居，我先去吃玉米卷了，再见！

NARRATIVE_PLANTAGENET_3_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:mary}{NPC_ENTER:qwnj}{SAY:mary}Black Rose, I have admired you for a long time!!

NARRATIVE_PLANTAGENET_3_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:qwnj}Your Highness, there is no need to be polite. Why do you come to me?
NARRATIVE_PLANTAGENET_3_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:qwnj}公主殿下不必多礼，您来找我有何贵干？

NARRATIVE_PLANTAGENET_3_INTRO_3.en: {TIRED:mary}The kingdom has fallen... The queen mother said she must come to you if she encounters difficulties.
NARRATIVE_PLANTAGENET_3_INTRO_3.zh: {TIRED:mary}王国沦陷了…母后说遇到困难一定要找您。

NARRATIVE_PLANTAGENET_3_INTRO_4.en: {TIRED:qwnj}…What about Her Royal Highness the Queen?

NARRATIVE_PLANTAGENET_3_INTRO_5.en: {TIRED:mary}I just encountered misfortune not long ago...

NARRATIVE_PLANTAGENET_3_INTRO_6.en: {EXCITED:qwnj}Your Majesty, please express your condolences. It is my duty to protect the kingdom with these plants!
NARRATIVE_PLANTAGENET_3_INTRO_6.zh: {EXCITED:qwnj}请陛下节哀，保护王国我义不容辞！和我闯遍西部的植物战士野花也会帮助我们！

NARRATIVE_PLANTAGENET_5_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:mary}{NPC_ENTER:qwnj}{SAY:mary}This snowy night gave me a subtle feeling.
NARRATIVE_PLANTAGENET_5_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:mary}{NPC_ENTER:qwnj}{SAY:mary}这个雪夜，让我有个微妙的感觉。

NARRATIVE_PLANTAGENET_5_INTRO_2.en: {EXCITED:qwnj}My courageous heart felt the call of strength, at the foot of the snow-capped mountains!
NARRATIVE_PLANTAGENET_5_INTRO_2.zh: {EXCITED:qwnj}我的勇气之心感受到了力量的呼唤，在雪山山脚！

NARRATIVE_PLANTAGENET_5_INTRO_4.en: {EXCITED:lily}Snow Lotus? It's time for her to join us!
NARRATIVE_PLANTAGENET_5_INTRO_4.zh: {EXCITED:lily}雪莲么？是时候让她加入我们了！

NARRATIVE_PLANTAGENET_5_OUTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:mary}{NPC_ENTER:lily}{SAY:mary}Lily, look at the dark red roses!

NARRATIVE_PLANTAGENET_5_OUTRO_2.en: {SAY:lily}When I was young, I heard from my parents that the second token was called the Night Rose. No one had ever found it, but why is it here??
NARRATIVE_PLANTAGENET_5_OUTRO_2.zh: {SAY:lily}小时候听父母说过，第二件信物叫做暗夜玫瑰，谁都不曾找到它，可它为什么会在这里？

NARRATIVE_PLANTAGENET_5_OUTRO_3.en: {NPC_ENTER:qwnj}{NPC_EXIT:lily}{EXCITED:qwnj}The heart of courage has a sense, go and merge its power!
NARRATIVE_PLANTAGENET_5_OUTRO_3.zh: {NPC_ENTER:qwnj}{NPC_EXIT:lily}{EXCITED:qwnj}勇气之心有感应，快去融合它的力量吧！

NARRATIVE_PLANTAGENET_5_OUTRO_4.en: {NPC_ENTER:lily}{NPC_EXIT:qwnj}{EXCITED:lily}A swordsman's belief is to protect others, right? If you think so, can you give me your power to protect the kingdom?
NARRATIVE_PLANTAGENET_5_OUTRO_4.zh: {NPC_ENTER:lily}{NPC_EXIT:qwnj}{EXCITED:lily}剑客的信仰就是守护他人，对吧？如果你也这样想，可以把你的力量给我守护王国么？

NARRATIVE_PLANTAGENET_5_OUTRO_5.en: {EXCITED:mary}The power is flowing! Is this the power of inheritance?
NARRATIVE_PLANTAGENET_5_OUTRO_5.zh: {EXCITED:mary}力量在流动！这就是传承力量吗？

NARRATIVE_PLANTAGENET_5_OUTRO_6.en: {NPC_ENTER:aymg}{NPC_EXIT:lily}{EXCITED:aymg}Thank you for recognizing me. We will definitely save the kingdom and use my sword light to cut through the thorns!
NARRATIVE_PLANTAGENET_5_OUTRO_6.zh: {NPC_ENTER:aymg}{NPC_EXIT:lily}{EXCITED:aymg}谢谢你认可我，我们一定会拯救王国，用我的剑光，斩开荆棘！

NARRATIVE_PLANTAGENET_6_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:aymg}It would be nice if he sees it!

NARRATIVE_PLANTAGENET_6_INTRO_3.en: {EXCITED:mary}He? Your boyfriend? He must be able to see it!
NARRATIVE_PLANTAGENET_6_INTRO_3.zh: {EXCITED:mary}他？你男朋友吗？他一定能看到的！

NARRATIVE_PLANTAGENET_6_INTRO_4.en: {TIRED:aymg}He died on the day the zombies invaded. We promised to grow old together, but he actually left me alone.（sobs）
NARRATIVE_PLANTAGENET_6_INTRO_4.zh: {TIRED:aymg}僵尸入侵那天他就消失了，说好要白头偕老，可他居然丢下我一个人。（哭泣）

NARRATIVE_PLANTAGENET_7_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:mary}{NPC_ENTER:qwnj}{SAY:mary}My father once said that to sit on the throne, you must have a token.
NARRATIVE_PLANTAGENET_7_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:mary}{NPC_ENTER:qwnj}{SAY:mary}父王曾经说过，坐上王位必须拥有一件信物。

NARRATIVE_PLANTAGENET_7_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:qwnj}You are talking about the Crown of Hearts, the third token. It is said that it is in the most beautiful place in the kingdom.
NARRATIVE_PLANTAGENET_7_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:qwnj}您说的是红桃皇冠，第三件信物，据说它在王国最美的地方。

NARRATIVE_PLANTAGENET_7_INTRO_3.en: {NPC_ENTER:aymg}{NPC_EXIT:qwnj}{EXCITED:aymg}The most beautiful place? Royal Flower Garden!

NARRATIVE_PLANTAGENET_7_INTRO_4.en: {SAY:mary}That's where Rosemary grows, and her fragrance can make zombies die in their dreams.
NARRATIVE_PLANTAGENET_7_INTRO_4.zh: {SAY:mary}那里是迷迭香生长的地方，她的芳香可以让僵尸在美梦中死去。

NARRATIVE_PLANTNARRATIVE_10.en: {SAY:wallnut_r}That's it. That's all I had to say.

NARRATIVE_PLANTNARRATIVE_12.en: {SAY:sunflower_r}How's your mind, Wall-nut? Is it blown?
NARRATIVE_PLANTNARRATIVE_12.zh: {SAY:sunflower_r}怎么样，坚果墙？有没有感觉世界观崩塌了？

NARRATIVE_PLANTNARRATIVE_3.en: {SAY:sunflower}I know that, silly. We've been friends for years!
NARRATIVE_PLANTNARRATIVE_3.zh: {SAY:sunflower}我知道，小傻瓜。我们已经当了好多年的朋友了！

NARRATIVE_PLANTNARRATIVE_4.en: {SAY:wallnut_r}A filthy liar said popanims could switch places.
NARRATIVE_PLANTNARRATIVE_4.zh: {SAY:wallnut_r}一个大骗子说 PopAnim 动画可以换位置。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_AKEE_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}A.K.E.E lobs seeds that bounces from zombie to zombie.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_AKEE_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}阿开木-木可以投掷能在僵尸间弹跳的子弹。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_ALOE_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Aloe will heal neighboring plants and boost their health.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_ALOE_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}芦荟可以治疗周围的植物，还能强化它们的生命值。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_APPLEMORTAR_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Apple Mortar lobs apple cores across multiple lanes.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_APPLEMORTAR_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}苹果迫击炮可以在数行之间投掷苹果核。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_APPLEMORTAR_1_2.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Proper plant placement will be the key to victory.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_APPLEMORTAR_1_2.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}正确的植物布阵是胜利的关键。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_AQUAVINE_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Aqua Vine can support both ground and water plants.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_AQUAVINE_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Aqua Vine can support both ground and water plants.

NARRATIVE_PLTE_AQUAVINE_1_2.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Depending on the plant its host to, Aqua Vine will change its attack.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_AQUAVINE_1_2.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Depending on the plant its host to, Aqua Vine will change its attack.

NARRATIVE_PLTE_BAMBOOSPARTAN_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Bamboo Spartan attacks multiple enemies in its lane and endures massive damage.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_BAMBOOSPARTAN_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}斯笆达既可以攻击所在行的多名敌人，还能承受大量伤害。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_BAMBOOSPARTAN_1_2.en: {SAY:winnie}Once the shield is broken, its damage increases significantly.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_BAMBOOSPARTAN_1_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}护盾一旦破损，其伤害会大幅增加。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_BANANA_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Tap on Banana Launcher and then anywhere on the board to fire explosives.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_BANANA_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}轻点香蕉火箭炮，随后轻点场地任意位置即可发射爆炸物。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_BEANSPROUT_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Bean Sprout transforms into a zombie smashing monster when it takes damage.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_BEANSPROUT_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}豆芽可以在受到伤害时变身成碎尸怪物。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_BLASTSPINNER_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Blast Spinner lobs webs that may turn zombies into cocoons.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_BLASTSPINNER_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}爆网织株可以投掷蛛网，有概率令僵尸结茧。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_BLASTSPINNER_1_2.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Cocoons will explode damaging all zombies nearby.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_BLASTSPINNER_1_2.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}茧可以爆炸，伤害周围的所有僵尸。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_BLAZELEAF_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Blaze Leaf attacks in a large area, both in front and back.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_BLAZELEAF_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}炽叶攻击范围很大，前后兼顾。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_BLAZELEAF_1_2.en: {SAY:winnie}Every third strike releases a Blaze Wave, damaging zombies in multiple lanes.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_BLAZELEAF_1_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}每攻击三次，都会释放“炽浪”，伤害数行的僵尸。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_BLOOMERANG_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Bloomerang can damage multiple zombies in its lane.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_BLOOMERANG_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}回旋镖射手可以对所在行的多只僵尸造成伤害。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_BLOOMINGHEARTS_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Blooming Hearts' damage increase whenever a zombie is mesmerized by its attack.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_BLOOMINGHEARTS_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}攻击被自己迷惑的僵尸时，铃儿草的伤害会增加。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_BLOVER_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Blover blows away all flying zombies from the lawn.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_BLOVER_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}三叶草可以将所有飞行僵尸吹出草坪。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_BOINGSETTA_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Boingsetta will destroys grid items and knock back zombies.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_BOINGSETTA_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}一品红可以摧毁障碍物，击退僵尸。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_BOMBEGRANATE_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Bombegranate explodes when planted, leaving behind explosive seeds.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_BOMBEGRANATE_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}炸弹石榴可以在种植后立即爆炸，随后留下可以爆炸的种子。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_BONKCHOY_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Bonk Choy can attack zombies in front or behind it. Use this to your advantage.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_BONKCHOY_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}无论僵尸是前是后，菜问都能攻击到。记得合理利用这一点。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_BOOMBERRY_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}BoomBerry lauches explosive berries at the last zombie in its lane.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_BOOMBERRY_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}爆炸莓果可以向所在行最后一只僵尸发射可以爆炸的莓果。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_BOOMBERRY_1_2.en: {SAY:winnie}Zombies hit, will be stunned for a short duration.

NARRATIVE_PLTE_BOOMFLOWER_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Boom Balloon Flower spawns draggable, exploding balloon mines!
NARRATIVE_PLTE_BOOMFLOWER_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}爆炸气球花可以通过拖拽施放可以爆炸的气球地雷！

NARRATIVE_PLTE_BOWLINGBULB_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Bowling Bulb's shots can bounce on multiple zombies, dealing damage
NARRATIVE_PLTE_BOWLINGBULB_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}保鳞茎的子弹可以在数只僵尸间弹跳，造成伤害

NARRATIVE_PLTE_BUDUHBOOM_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Bud'uh Boom explodes and flings butter around the lawn.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_BUDUHBOOM_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}爆浆玉露可以爆炸，随后将黄油抛往附近的草坪。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_BUDUHBOOM_1_2.en: {SAY:winnie}Zombies walking over the butter are slowed down.

NARRATIVE_PLTE_BZZZBUTTON_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}When eaten, Bzz Button electrifies zombies, damaging them overtime.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_BZZZBUTTON_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}电鸣金纽扣可以在被吃掉时让僵尸通电，对其造成持续伤害。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_BZZZBUTTON_1_2.en: {SAY:winnie}Electrified zombies shoot Lighting at other nearby zombies.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_BZZZBUTTON_1_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}通电的僵尸会向周围的其它僵尸发射弧光。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_CABBAGEPULT_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}卷心菜投手可以向敌人发射卷心菜子弹。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_CACTUS_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Cactus shoots piercing thorns that can hit multiple zombies.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_CACTUS_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}仙人掌可以发射具有穿刺效果的尖刺，命中数只僵尸。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_CACTUS_1_2.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}When a zombie gets too close, it'll bury itself underground for safety.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_CACTUS_1_2.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}僵尸太靠近时，安全起见，它便会把自己埋到地下。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_CAULIPOWER_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Caulipower can hynotize weak zombies, turning them into allies that fight for you.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_CAULIPOWER_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Caulipower can hynotize weak zombies, turning them into allies that fight for you.

NARRATIVE_PLTE_CELERYSTALKER_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Celery Stalker waits for the zombies to pass and then strike from behind.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_CELERYSTALKER_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}潜伏芹菜静候僵尸经过，随后从其背后突袭。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_CHARDGUARD_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Chard Guard knocks back zombies but loses one of its leaves.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_CHARDGUARD_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}甜菜护卫可以击退僵尸，但会失去自己的一片叶子。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_CHARDGUARD_1_2.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}After losing all the leaves, it acts as a normal defensive plant.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_CHARDGUARD_1_2.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}失去所有叶子后，它便和一株普通防御植物类似。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_CHERRY_BOMB_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Cherry Bombs can explode to blow up zombies in an area around them.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_CHERRY_BOMB_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}樱桃炸弹可以爆炸，令其周围的僵尸灰飞烟灭。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_CHERRY_BOMB_1_2.en: {SAY:winnie}Due to their short fuse, it is adviced to place them near zombies.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_CHERRY_BOMB_1_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}他们的保险丝很短，所以建议将其放在僵尸靠近僵尸的地方。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_CHILIBEAN_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Chili Beans delivers gastrointestinal distress when eaten by a zombie.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_CHILIBEAN_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}巴豆被吃掉后能让僵尸的肠道翻云覆雨。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_CHILIBEAN_1_2.en: {SAY:winnie}Zombies, behind the one who ate it, are stunned by the effect.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_CHILIBEAN_1_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}而食用者后方的僵尸则会受到眩晕效果。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_CHILLYPEPPER_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Chilly Pepper can freeze or chill zombies across 3 lanes.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_CHILLYPEPPER_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}寒冰辣椒可以冻结或冷缓 3 行的僵尸。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_CHOMPER_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Chomper will eat zombies whole, but is vulnerable while chewing.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_CHOMPER_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}大嘴花可以一口吃掉整只僵尸，不过在咀嚼的时候很脆弱。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_CITRON_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Citron shoots powerful balls of plasma after charging for a short duration.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_CITRON_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}等离子香橼可以在短时间的充能后，发射强力的等离子球。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_COCONUTCANNON_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Coconut Cannon delivers explosive coconut blasts to obliterate zombies.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_COCONUTCANNON_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}椰子加农炮可以发射爆炸椰子来消灭僵尸。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_COCONUTCANNON_1_2.en: {SAY:winnie}Tap on it to fire off the shot, wait for it to recharge and repeat!
NARRATIVE_PLTE_COCONUTCANNON_1_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}轻点它即可开炮，待其冷却，如此反复！

NARRATIVE_PLTE_COCONUTCANNON_2_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Using Plant Food launches a blast that pushes zombies and explodes.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_COCONUTCANNON_2_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}施用叶绿素，发射一枚可以推开僵尸，随后爆炸的炸弹。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_COLDSNAPDRAGON_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Cold Snapdragon's breath attack will chill zombies across multiple lanes.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_COLDSNAPDRAGON_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}冰龙草的龙息攻击可以冷缓数行的僵尸。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_CORNFETTI_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Corn-fetti Popper's attacks pierces through zombies in its path.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_CORNFETTI_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}爆礼花的攻击可以穿透路径上的僵尸。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_CORNFETTI_1_2.en: {SAY:winnie}It also has a chance to knock back zombies within a 2 tile area.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_CORNFETTI_1_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}它还有机会击退 2 块地砖范围内的僵尸。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_CRANJELLY_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Cran Jelly crushes zombies in its lane and leaves behind pool of acidic goo.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_CRANJELLY_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}蔓越莓果冻可以撞向所在行的僵尸，留下一池酸性黏液。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_CRANJELLY_1_2.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Acidic goo both slows and damages zombies that passes through.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_CRANJELLY_1_2.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}酸性黏液既可以令经过的僵尸减速，也能对其造成伤害。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_DANDELION_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Dandelion releases bombs that will explode upon contact.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_DANDELION_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}蒲公英可以释放炸弹，炸弹在接触时爆炸。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_DAZEYCHAIN_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Chain grows in power the longer it’s on the lawn.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_DAZEYCHAIN_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}在草坪上的时间越长，雏菊束的能力越强。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_DOOMSHROOM_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}毁灭菇可以在被消灭时爆炸。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_DOOMSHROOM_1_2.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}The larger it grows, the bigger the explosion.

NARRATIVE_PLTE_DRAFTODIL_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Draftodil will eliminate flying and small zombies.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_DRAFTODIL_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}气流水仙可以消灭飞行僵尸或小体型的僵尸。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_DRAGONBRUIT_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Dragon Bruit can launch projectiles across 3 lanes.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_DRAGONBRUIT_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}吼龙果可以向 3 行发射子弹。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_DRAGONBRUIT_2_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}When Dragon Bruit is destroyed, it will spawn 3 Baby Bruit plants.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_DRAGONBRUIT_2_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}吼龙果被消灭后，可以生成 3 株玲龙果。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_DRAGONBRUIT_3_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Dragon Bruit gains a damage boost when inside of a shadow aura.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_DRAGONBRUIT_3_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}吼龙果可以在暗影光环中获得伤害强化。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_DUSKLOBBER_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Dusklobber is a shadow plants that lob explosive bud down their lane.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_DUSKLOBBER_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}薄暮掷手是一株可以向本行目标投掷爆炸花蕾的暗影植物。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_DUSKLOBBER_1_2.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}When powered by shadow aura, they lob buds in 3 lanes.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_DUSKLOBBER_1_2.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}受到暗影光环强化时，其可以向 3 行投掷花蕾。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_ELECTRICBLUEBERRY_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Electric Blueberry summons a thundercloud that periodically zap zombies.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_ELECTRICBLUEBERRY_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}电击蓝莓可以召唤雷云，间歇性地电击僵尸。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_ELECTRICCURRANT_1_2.en: {SAY:winnie}Place Electric Currants in the same row or column to zap Zombies.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_ELECTRICCURRANT_1_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}把电流醋栗放在相同行或排，电击僵尸。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_ELECTRICITEA_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}When eaten, Electrici-tea releases storm clouds that shocks all nearby zombies.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_ELECTRICITEA_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}电力绿茶可以在被吃掉时释放一朵暴风云，电击周围的所有僵尸。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_ELECTRICPEASHOOTER_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Electric Peashooter can damage Zombies on both adjacent lanes.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_ELECTRICPEASHOOTER_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}电力豌豆射手可以伤害两条相邻行上的僵尸。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_ELECTRICPEEL_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Electric Peel is amphibious, i.e. it can be planted on land and water.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_ELECTRICPEEL_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}电能蕉皮是一株两栖植物，也就是说，它既可以种在陆地上，也能种在水里。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_ELECTRICPEEL_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Electric Peel is amphibious, i.e. it can be planted on land and water.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_ELECTRICPEEL_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}电能蕉皮是一株两栖植物，也就是说，它既可以种在陆地上，也能种在水里。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_ELECTRICPEEL_2.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}On water, Electric Peel's attack deal bonus damage and electrifies the tiles.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_ELECTRICPEEL_2.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}在水面上时，电能蕉皮的攻击可以造成额外伤害，并让那块地砖通电。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_ELECTRICPEEL_2_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}On water, Electric Peel's attack deal bonus damage and electrifies the tiles.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_ELECTRICPEEL_2_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}在水面上时，电能蕉皮的攻击可以造成额外伤害，并让那块地砖通电。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_ELECTRICPEEL_3.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Electric Peel releases a giant super eel to deal massive damage to zombies.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_ELECTRICPEEL_3.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}电能蕉皮可以释放一只巨型的超级电鳗，对僵尸造成大量伤害。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_ELECTRICPEEL_3_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Electric Peel releases a giant super peel to deal massive damage to zombies.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_ELECTRICPEEL_3_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}电能蕉皮可以释放一只巨型的超级电鳗，对僵尸造成大量伤害。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_EMPEA_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}E.M.Peach releases an E.M.P wave that disables all machine zombies.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_EMPEA_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}电磁脉冲桃可以释放令所有机械僵尸失灵的电磁脉冲波。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_ENDURIAN_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Endurian's spiky shell deals damage back at zombies that try to bite it.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_ENDURIAN_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}榴镰尖锐的外壳可以对想要咬它僵尸进行反击。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_EXPLODEONUT_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Defeated Explode-O-Nuts will explode to deal damage to all nearby zombies.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_EXPLODEONUT_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}爆炸坚果被击败后将会爆炸，对周围的所有僵尸造成伤害。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_FIREPEASHOOTER_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Fire Peashooter can melt ice blocks. Use this ability to free frozen plants.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_FIREPEASHOOTER_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Fire Peashooter can melt ice blocks. Use this ability to free frozen plants.

NARRATIVE_PLTE_FROSTBONNET_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winni}Tap on Frost Bonnet to switch it between Fire and Ice damage attack.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_FROSTBONNET_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winni}单击小霜帽，在火、冰攻击间进行切换。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_FUMESHROOM_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Fume-shroom shoots fumes that damages zombies in an area.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_FUMESHROOM_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}大喷菇可以发射烟雾，对范围内的僵尸造成伤害。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_GARLIC_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}大蒜可以让僵尸避开到相邻行。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_GHOSTPEPPER_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Ghost Pepper can haunt zombies in front or behind it.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_GHOSTPEPPER_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}断魂椒可以缠扰前后的僵尸。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_GHOSTPEPPER_1_2.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}受到缠扰的僵尸会随着时间的推移受到伤害。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_GOLDBLOOM_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Gold Bloom will instantly produce sun when planted.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_GOLDBLOOM_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}能量百合可以在种下时立即生产阳光。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_GOLDLEAF_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Gold Leaf creates a gold tile when placed.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_GOLDLEAF_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}黄金叶可以在安放时创造一块黄金地砖。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_GRAPESHOT_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Grapeshot launches multiple grapes that bounces around the lawn.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_GRAPESHOT_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}葡萄爆弹可以发射数枚葡萄，在草坪间弹跳。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_GRAVEBUSTER_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Grave Buster will eat a gravestone, quickly destroying them.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_GRAVEBUSTER_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}墓碑吞噬者会吃掉一座墓碑，将其快速摧毁。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_GRIMROSE_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Grimroses are shadow plants that drag zombies into the dirt.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_GRIMROSE_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}报丧花是可以把僵尸拖入地底的暗影植物。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_GRIMROSE_1_2.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Once it drags a zombie into the ground, it will disappear.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_GRIMROSE_1_2.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}一旦把僵尸拖入地下，它就会消失。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_GRIMROSE_2_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}报丧花可以接受月光花的强化。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_GRIMROSE_2_2.en: When they are, they can defeat up to three enemies before disappearing.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_GRIMROSE_2_2.zh: 强化后，便可以在消失前消灭最多三名敌人。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_GUACODILE_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Guacodiles can be planted on land and in water.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_GUACODILE_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}鳄梨既可以种在陆地上，也可以种在水里。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_GUACODILE_1_2.en: {SAY:winnie}Their attacks differ based on where they are planted.

NARRATIVE_PLTE_GUARDSHROOM_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Guard-shroom will clone miniature copies of itself for defense.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_GUARDSHROOM_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}守卫菇可以创造出自己的迷你复制体来进行防守。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_HAMMERUIT_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Hammeruit charges its hammer, the longer it waits to attack.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_HAMMERUIT_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Hammeruit charges its hammer, the longer it waits to attack.

NARRATIVE_PLTE_HAMMERUIT_1_2.en: {SAY:winnie}The hammer attack can charge up to 2 times to deal increased damage.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_HAMMERUIT_1_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}巨锤攻击可以充能 2 次，造成更高伤害。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_HOLONUT_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Infi-Nut is a defensive plant who can regenerate its health over time.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_HOLONUT_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}无穷坚果是一株可以随着时间的推移重新生成的防御植物。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_HOTDATE_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Hot Date will attract zombies from adjacent lanes.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_HOTDATE_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Hot Date will attract zombies from adjacent lanes.

NARRATIVE_PLTE_HOTDATE_1_2.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}When eaten, it will explode and damage all zombies in the lane.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_HOTDATE_1_2.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}When eaten, it will explode and damage all zombies in the lane.

NARRATIVE_PLTE_HOTPOTATO_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Hot Potatoes melt the ice blocks they're planted on.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_HOTPOTATO_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}热土豆可以融化种的地方的冰块。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_HURRIKALE_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Hurrikale will both chill and push back zombie in its lane.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_HURRIKALE_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}飓风甘蓝既可以冷缓所在行的僵尸，还能将其往后推。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_ICEBLOOM_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Ice Bloom can freeze all zombies on the lawn.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_ICEBLOOM_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}寒冰蓓蕾可以冻结草坪上所有的僵尸。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_ICEBURG_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Iceberg Lettuce freezes the first zombie that steps on it.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_ICEBURG_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}冰山生菜可以冻结第一只踏上它的僵尸。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_ICESHROOM_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Ice-shroom’s frost aura can chill zombies and boost other Winter-mint plants.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_ICESHROOM_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}寒冰菇的寒霜光环可以冷缓僵尸，同时为其它寒冬薄荷家族植物提供强化。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_ICEWEED_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Iceweed can destroy Push Zombies, like Piano,
NARRATIVE_PLTE_ICEWEED_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}冰刺草可以消灭如钢琴僵尸等向前推行的僵尸。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_ICEWEED_1_2.en: {SAY:winnie}and put out the flames of fire zombies, like the Explorer.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_ICEWEED_1_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}还可以熄灭如探险家僵尸等带火焰僵尸的火。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_IMITATER_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Imitater copies the previous Seed Slot plant, doubling your planting rate.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_IMITATER_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}变身洋芋可以拷贝前一个种子槽的植物，让你种植的频率加倍。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_IMPPEAR_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Imp Pear transforms zombies into Imp Pear imps when eaten.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_IMPPEAR_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}小鬼梨可以把僵尸变形成小鬼梨小鬼。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_INTENSIVECARROT_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Intensive Carrot can revive fallen plants, bringing them back into the fight.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_INTENSIVECARROT_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}医护胡萝卜可以复活倒下的植物，令其重新投入战斗。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_JACKOLANTERN_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Jack O' Lantern shoots out a jet of flame towards zombies in its lane.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_JACKOLANTERN_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}南瓜灯可以向所在行的僵尸吐出一团火焰。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_JALAPENO_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Jalapeno ignites its lane, obliterating all zombies caught within its flames.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_JALAPENO_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}火爆辣椒可以点燃所在行，消灭所有陷入火海中的僵尸。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_KERNELPULT_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Kernel-pults fling corn kernels and immobilizing butter at zombies.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_KERNELPULT_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}玉米投手可以向僵尸投掷玉米粒和让它们定住的黄油。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_LASERBEAN_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Laser Bean fires a beam of laser down its lane, hitting all Zombies.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_LASERBEAN_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}激光豆可以向所在行发射激光束，攻击所有僵尸。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_LAVAGUAVA_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Lava Guava errupts dealing damage to all nearby zombies.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_LAVAGUAVA_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}岩浆番石榴可以喷射攻击，对周围的所有僵尸造成伤害。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_LIGHTNINGREED_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Lightning Reeds shoots lightning at the nearest zombie up to one lane away.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_LIGHTNINGREED_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}闪电芦苇可以向最近的僵尸发射闪电，上下两行也没问题。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_LIGHTNINGREED_1_2.en: {SAY:winnie}The lightning also chains to other nearby zombies.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_LIGHTNINGREED_1_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}发射的闪电还能与周围的其它僵尸产生连锁反应。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_LIGHTNINGREED_2_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Lightning Reed creates a storm cloud that attacks random zombies.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_LIGHTNINGREED_2_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}闪电芦苇可以创造一朵雷云，随机对僵尸造成伤害。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_LILYPAD_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Lilypad is an aquatic plant that can host non-aquatic plants on it.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_LILYPAD_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}睡莲叶是一株水生植物，可以承载其上方的非水生植物。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_MAGNIFYINGGRASS_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Tap Magnifying Grass to fire a sun charged bolt at zombies.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_MAGNIFYINGGRASS_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}轻点透镜草，发射充能阳光束。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_MAGNIFYINGGRASS_1_2.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}The shot does consume sun, so use it with caution.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_MAGNIFYINGGRASS_1_2.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}发射会消耗阳光，请谨慎使用。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_MANGOFIER_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Tap Mangofier to switch between Spread and Focus fire modes.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_MANGOFIER_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}轻点聚光芒，在聚集与发散两种发射模式间进行切换。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_MAYBEE_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}MayBee shoots bee-like projectile that damage and mini-stuns the target.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_MAYBEE_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}蜂临兰可以发射蜜蜂状的子弹，对目标造成伤害与轻微的眩晕效果。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_MELONPULT_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Melon-pult deals heavy damage to group of zombies.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_MELONPULT_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}西瓜投手可以对尸群造成大量伤害。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_METEORFLOWER_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Meteor Flower calls upon meteor strikes from above that leaves molten tiles.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_METEORFLOWER_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}流星花可以从空中召唤流星坠，融化被砸中的格子。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_MOONFLOWER_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Moonflower emits sun but also powers up adjacent Shadow plants.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_MOONFLOWER_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}月光花可以绽放出阳光，但也能强化临近的暗影植物。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_NIGHTSHADE_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Nightshade is a shadow plant that strikes zombie with its leaves.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_NIGHTSHADE_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}夜影茄是一株暗影植物，可以用自己的叶片攻击僵尸。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_NIGHTSHADE_1_2.en: {SAY:winnie}Shadow aura boosted Nightshade gains damage, hurls and regrows it leaves.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_NIGHTSHADE_1_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}受到暗影光环强化的夜影茄伤害会变高，叶片投掷后还能重新长出来。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_NOCTARINE_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}暗夜油桃的毒云可以对僵尸造成伤害…

NARRATIVE_PLTE_NOCTARINE_1_2.en: {SAY:winnie}And significantly boosts shadow plants like Dusk Lobber.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_NOCTARINE_1_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}还可以大幅强化如薄暮掷手等暗影植物。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_OLIVEPIT_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie} Olive Pits sets traps that will gobble up incoming zombies.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_OLIVEPIT_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}油橄榄坑可以设下陷阱，吞噬前来的僵尸。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_PARSNIP_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Parsnip deals heavy damage to zombies in close range.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_PARSNIP_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}欧防锋可以对近距离的僵尸造成大量伤害。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_PARSNIP_1_2.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}When it's able to be eaten, it'll charge at zombies down its lane.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_PARSNIP_1_2.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}在快被吃掉时，他可以朝所在行的僵尸冲锋。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_PEANUT_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Pea-nut has both defensive and offensive capabilities.

NARRATIVE_PLTE_PEANUT_1_2.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}This additional flexibility allow it to be planted either in the front or the rear.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_PEANUT_1_2.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}得益于此，你可以将其灵活放置在前线或是后排。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_PEAPOD_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Pea Pod can be placed in the same position upto 5 times.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_PEAPOD_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}豌豆荚最多可以在同一个位置种植 5 次。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_PEAPOD_1_2.en: {SAY:winnie}Strategic distribution in different places will be key to victory.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_PEAPOD_1_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}因地制宜、策略布局是胜利的关键。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_PEASHOOTER_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Peashooter fires pea projectiles, in it's lane, to damage the zombies.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_PEASHOOTER_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}豌豆射手可以向其所在行发射豌豆子弹，对僵尸造成伤害。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_PEASHOOTER_2_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Updraged Peashooter has boosted damage and attack speed. Observe.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_PEASHOOTER_2_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}升级后的豌豆射手，伤害和攻速均有强化。来看看效果吧。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_PEASHOOTER_3_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Plant Food powered Peashooter fires a barrage of fast peas.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_PEASHOOTER_3_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}受到叶绿素强化的豌豆射手可以发射一连串的高速豌豆。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_PEPPERPULT_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Pepper-pult lobs fiery peppers at zombies in its lane.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_PEPPERPULT_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}甜椒投手可以向所在行的僵尸投掷炽热的甜椒。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_PERFUMESHROOM_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Perfume-shroom charms dinosaurs to make them fight against zombies.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_PERFUMESHROOM_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}香水菇可以吸引恐龙，使它们转而对抗僵尸。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_PHATBEET_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Phat Beet damages zombies every second around it.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_PHATBEET_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}节拍甜菜可以每秒攻击一次周围的僵尸。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_POISONPEASHOOTER_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Goo Peashooter shoots peas that both slows and damages zombies overtime.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_POISONPEASHOOTER_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}黏液豌豆射手发射的豌豆既可以令僵尸减速，也能对其造成持续伤害。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_POKRA_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Pokra will deliver rapid piercing, zombie slowing attacks to multiple zombies.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_POKRA_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}尖刺秋葵可以向多只僵尸发出高速的穿刺攻击，并令其减速。
