NARRATIVE_PLTE_POTATOMINE_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Potatomine will explode on contact, but require sometime to arm.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_POTATOMINE_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}土豆地雷会在接触时爆炸，但需要时间来进行武装。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_POTATOMINE_1_2.en: {SAY:winnie}So, place them well in advance and ahead of Zombies.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_POTATOMINE_1_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}所以，将其提早一些种在僵尸前方吧。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_POWERLILY_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Power Lily will create a Plant Food when planted.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_POWERLILY_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}能量花可以在种下时创造一份叶绿素。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_POWERPLANT_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Tile Turnip creates a Power Tile when planted.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_POWERPLANT_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}地砖芜菁可以在安放时创造一块能量地砖

NARRATIVE_PLTE_POWERPLANT_1_2.en: {SAY:winnie}Place them wisely and make sure to use Plant Food to defeat zombies.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_POWERPLANT_1_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}合理选择种植的位置，记得用叶绿素来击败僵尸。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_PRIMALPEASHOOTER_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Primal Peashooter fires peas with a brief stun and can knock back zombies.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_PRIMALPEASHOOTER_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}原始豌豆射手可以发射能击退、眩晕僵尸的豌豆。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_PRIMALSUNFLOWER_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Primal Sunflowers pop out large suns instead of regular ones.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_PRIMALSUNFLOWER_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}原始向日葵冒出的不是普通的阳光，而是大号阳光。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_PRIMALWALLNUT_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Primal Wallnut is a defensive plant that can be planted quickly.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_PRIMALWALLNUT_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}原始坚果墙是一株可以快速种植的防御植物。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_PUFFSHROOM_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Puff-shroom will expire after a short period of time.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_PUFFSHROOM_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}小喷菇会在一小段时间后凋亡。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_PUFFSHROOM_1_2.en: {SAY:winnie}Use Plant Food to extend its lifetime and punish the zombies.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_PUFFSHROOM_1_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}使用叶绿素，延长它的寿命，同时把僵尸打得落花流水。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_REDSTINGER_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Red Stingers fire shots at full force when planted close to home.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_REDSTINGER_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}把红针花种在靠近家的地方时它会全力攻击。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_REDSTINGER_1_2.en: {SAY:winnie}When planted further from home, they become more defensive.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_REDSTINGER_1_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}种得离家越远，它们就会越具防御性。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_REPEATER_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Repeater shoot 2 pea-like projectiles at a time to damage the zombies.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_REPEATER_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}双发豌豆可以一次发射 2 枚豌豆状的子弹，对僵尸造成伤害。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_SAPFLING_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Sap-fling will create puddles of sap that will slow the incoming zombies waves.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_SAPFLING_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}树脂投手可以创造一滩树脂，减速来袭的尸潮。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_SCAREDYSHROOM_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Scardey-shroom's low sun cost allows you to plant many at once.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_SCAREDYSHROOM_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}胆小菇价格实惠，你可以一次种植很多株。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_SCAREDYSHROOM_1_2.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}It's Plant Food effect increases when there are other Scaredy-shroom nearby.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_SCAREDYSHROOM_1_2.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}如果周围有其他胆小菇，那么叶绿素效果会更强。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_SEAFLORA_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Seaflora is an amphibious plant that fires piercing bubbles down its lane.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_SEAFLORA_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}海神花是一株两栖植物，可以向所在行发射具有穿刺效果的泡泡。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_SEAFLORA_1_2.en: {SAY:winnie}On water, Seaflora fires bubbles across three lanes.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_SEAFLORA_1_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}种植在水面上时，海神花可以向三行发射泡泡。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_SEASHOOTER_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Seashooter fires 3 water pea projectiles in different directions.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_SEASHOOTER_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}海豌豆可以向不同的方向发射 3 枚水豌豆作为子弹。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_SEASHOOTER_1_2.en: {SAY:winnie}When planted near water tiles, deals increased damage.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_SEASHOOTER_1_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}种在水地砖附近时，可以造成更高伤害。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_SEASHOOTER_2_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Seashooter launches a barrage of water pea in 3 directions.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_SEASHOOTER_2_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}海豌豆可以向 3 个方向发射一连串的水豌豆。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_SEASHOOTER_2_2.en: {SAY:winnie}Appease-mint family plants around it, launch their Plant Food ability as well.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_SEASHOOTER_2_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}它周围的豌豆薄荷家族植物，也会启动其叶绿素技能。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_SEASHROOML_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Sea-shroom will expire after a short period of time.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_SEASHROOML_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}海蘑菇会在一段时间后消失。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_SEASHROOML_1_2.en: {SAY:winnie}Use plantfood to extend its lifetime and punish the zombies.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_SEASHROOML_1_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}使用叶绿素来延长它的寿命，同时把僵尸打得落花流水。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_SEASHROOM_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Sea-shroom will expire after a short period of time.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_SEASHROOM_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}海蘑菇会在一段时间后消失。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_SEASHROOM_1_2.en: {SAY:winnie}Use plantfood to extend its lifetime and punish the zombies.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_SEASHROOM_1_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}使用叶绿素来延长它的寿命，同时把僵尸打得落花流水。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_SHADOWPEASHOOTER_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Shadow Peashooter hides in it's shadow to trap zombies, when they get too close.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_SHADOWPEASHOOTER_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}暗影豌豆射手可以在僵尸靠得太近时遁入自己的阴影中，捉住僵尸。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_SHADOWPEASHOOTER_2_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Caution! Shadow Peashooter cannot trap flying zombies though.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_SHADOWPEASHOOTER_2_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}不过小心！暗影豌豆射手无法捉住飞行僵尸。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_SHADOWPEASHOOTER_3_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Shadow Peashooter gets boosted when inside a shadow aura.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_SHADOWPEASHOOTER_3_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}在暗影光环中，暗影豌豆射手可以获得强化。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_SHADOWPEASHOOTER_4_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Plant Food powered Shadow Peashooter launches an energy bomb on zombies.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_SHADOWPEASHOOTER_4_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}受到叶绿素强化的暗影豌豆射手会向僵尸发射…

NARRATIVE_PLTE_SHADOWPEASHOOTER_4_2.en: {SAY:winnie}...a massive enegry bomb towards the zombies. Try it out.

NARRATIVE_PLTE_SHADOWSHROOM_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Shadow Shroom poisons zombies that attacks it, dealing damage over time.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_SHADOWSHROOM_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}暗影菇可以让攻击它的僵尸中毒，随着时间的推移对其造成伤害。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_SHRINKINGVIOLET_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}缩小堇菜可以缩小周围的僵尸。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_SHRINKINGVIOLET_1_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}缩小的僵尸会承受额外的伤害。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_SLINGPEA_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Sling Pea will lob peas at multiple zombies across all lanes.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_SLINGPEA_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}投掷豌豆可以向所有行的数只僵尸投掷豌豆。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_SNAPDRAGON_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Snapdragon will warm nearby plants, freeing them from frozen ice.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_SNAPDRAGON_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}火龙草会温暖周围的植物，将其从寒冷的冰中解救出来。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_SNAPPEA_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Snap Pea will eat small zombies and then spit them out to deal damage.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_SNAPPEA_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}大嘴豌豆可以吃掉小体型僵尸，随后将其吐出造成伤害。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_SNOWPEA_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Snow Pea's frozen pea will slow the zombie's movement and attack speed.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_SNOWPEA_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}雪花豌豆的冻豌豆可以减缓僵尸的移动与攻击速度。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_SPIKEROCK_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Spikerock destroy multiple rolling zombies that walk over it.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_SPIKEROCK_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}地刺石可以多次消灭轧过去的僵尸。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_SPIKEWEED_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Spikeweed will deals damage to zombies as they walk over it.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_SPIKEWEED_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}地刺草会对踏过它的僵尸造成伤害。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_SPIKEWEED_1_2.en: {SAY:winnie}Its low on the ground, so most zombies will not attack it.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_SPIKEWEED_1_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}它在地面，低到大多数僵尸都无法攻击它。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_SPLITPEA_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Split Pea shoot peas forward and backwards.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_SPLITPEA_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}裂荚豌豆可以向前后发射豌豆。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_SPORESHROOM_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Spore-shroom fires spores that create new Spore-shrooms out of defeated zombies.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_SPORESHROOM_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}孢子菇可以发射孢子，在击败的僵尸身上再创造出一株孢子菇。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_SPRINGBEAN_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Spring Beans bounce back zombies that get too close.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_SPRINGBEAN_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}弹簧豆可以将靠近的僵尸向后弹。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_SPRINGBEAN_2_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Plant Food Spring Bean to bounce all zombies back.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_SPRINGBEAN_2_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}为弹簧豆施用叶绿素，击退所有僵尸。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_SQUASH_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Squashes will smash the first zombie that gets close.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_SQUASH_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}倭瓜可以压扁第一只接近的僵尸。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_STALLIA_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Stallias slows down zombies with a puff of perfume.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_STALLIA_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}大丽菊可以喷出香水，令僵尸减速。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_SUNBEAN_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Sun Bean infects zombies with sun. As a zombies take damage it will generate sun.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_SUNBEAN_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}阳光豆可以让僵尸染上阳光效果。僵尸受到伤害，便会生成阳光。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_SUNDEWTANGLER_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Sundewtangler traps zombies, leeching them to produce sun.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_SUNDEWTANGLER_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}阳光茅膏菜可以困住僵尸，榨取它的养分，生产阳光。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_SUNFLOWER_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Sunflower generate extra sun over a small interval of time.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_SUNFLOWER_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}向日葵每隔一小段时间就能生成额外的阳光。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_SUNFLOWER_1_2.en: {SAY:winnie}Be sure to plant plenty to avoid running out.

NARRATIVE_PLTE_SUNFLOWER_2_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Plant Food powered Sunflower produces a large amount of sun.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_SUNFLOWER_2_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}受到叶绿素强化的向日葵可以生产大量阳光。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_SUNSHROOM_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Sun-shroom generates more sun as it grows in size.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_SUNSHROOM_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}阳光菇可以随着自己越长越大，生成更多阳光。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_SWEETHEARTSNARE_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Sweetheart Snare slows and damages zombies as they step through her.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_SWEETHEARTSNARE_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}甜心陷阱丛可以在僵尸踩过她时对其造成伤害和减速效果。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_SWEETHEARTSNARE_1_2.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}When planted in the same column, she gets damage and slow bonuses.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_SWEETHEARTSNARE_1_2.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}种在同一排时，她可以获得伤害与减速效果加成。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_SWEETHEARTSNARE_2_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}When fed Plant Food, she launches multiple thorns both forwards and backward.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_SWEETHEARTSNARE_2_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}施用叶绿素后，她可以向前后发射数根尖刺。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_SWEETHEARTSNARE_2_2.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}This will also activate other Sweetheart Snares on the lawn.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_SWEETHEARTSNARE_2_2.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}同时激活草坪上其他的甜心陷阱丛。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_SWEETPOTATO_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Sweet Potatoe attracts zombies from other lanes when they are close by.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_SWEETPOTATO_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}甜薯可以在其他行的僵尸靠近时，将其吸引到自己那行。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_TALLNUT_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Tall-nut are heavy duty walls and blocks low flying enemies.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_TALLNUT_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}高坚果是一面重型墙壁，可以阻挡低空飞行的敌人。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_TANGLEKELP_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Tangle Kelp are aquatic plants that pull the first zombie that nears them underwater.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_TANGLEKELP_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}缠绕海带是可以把第一只靠近的僵尸拖入水底的水生植物。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_TELEPORTATOMINE_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Teleportato Mine teleports several zombies before exploding.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_TELEPORTATOMINE_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}传送土豆地雷可以在爆炸前传送若干只僵尸。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_THREEPEATER_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Threepeater shoots pea projectiles in three lanes to damage the zombies.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_THREEPEATER_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}三线豌豆可以向三行发射豌豆子弹攻击僵尸。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_THYMEWARP_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Thyme warp can teleport zombies back to the start of the lawn.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_THYMEWARP_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}逆时百里香可以把僵尸传送回草坪的起点。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_THYMEWARP_1_2.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}This buys you time to advance your strategy.

NARRATIVE_PLTE_TOADSTOOL_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Toadstool can eat most zombies, generating sun after it digests them.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_TOADSTOOL_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}蟾蜍毒菌可以吃掉大多数僵尸，并在消化完后生成阳光。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_TOMBTANGLER_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Tomb Tangler engulfs a tomb and releases a fog that slows down zombies.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_TOMBTANGLER_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}坟墓缠绕者可以吞没一座坟墓，随后释放出一阵可以减速僵尸的气体。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_TOMBTANGLER_1_2.en: {SAY:winnie}Occasionally, Tomb Tangler will pull zombies into the ground.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_TOMBTANGLER_1_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}坟墓缠绕者偶尔还能把僵尸拖入地底。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_TORCHWOOD_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Torchwood will light peas on fire, boosting their damage.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_TORCHWOOD_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}火炬树桩可以点燃豌豆，强化其伤害。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_TUMBLEWEED_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Plant Tumbleweed anywhere to send them rolling down the lane at zombies.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_TUMBLEWEED_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}在任意位置种下风滚草，让他们沿着草坪滚向僵尸。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_TWINSUNFLOWER_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Sunflower generate twice as many sun as a normal Sunflower.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_TWINSUNFLOWER_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}双胞向日葵生成的阳光是普通向日葵的两倍。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_VAMPORCINI_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Vamporcini will drain the health of nearby zombies, to increase its own.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_VAMPORCINI_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}吸血牛肝菌可以榨干周围的僵尸，用来增加自己的生命值。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_WALLNUT_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Wallnut's hard shell makes it an effective defense against zombie attacks.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_WALLNUT_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}坚果墙的硬壳是抵御僵尸攻击的利器。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_WALLNUT_1_2.en: {SAY:winnie}Plant them infront of other plants to protect them.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_WALLNUT_1_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}将其种在其它植物的前面，保护它们。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_WALLNUT_2_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Plant Food powered Wallnut heals itself and gains a hard armor shell.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_WALLNUT_2_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}受到叶绿素强化的坚果墙可以治疗自己，随后获得一副坚硬的盔甲外壳。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_WASABIWHIP_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Wasabi Whip's attack can reach zombies both in front or behind it.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_WASABIWHIP_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}无论僵尸是前是后，炙鞭山葵都能攻击到。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_WATERRABBIT_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Bun Chi chains 5 quick strikes to gain up to 5 Chi Stacks.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_WATERRABBIT_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}兔极每轮可以快速连续攻击 5 次，增加“真气”堆叠数，最多 5 层。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_WATERRABBIT_1_2.en: {SAY:winnie}Tap on it, when you see a glowing flower, to release a massive Thunder Clap Attack.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_WATERRABBIT_1_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}看到一朵发光的花朵时，轻点它，即可释放强力的“霹雳擂击”。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_WINTERMELON_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Winter Melon deals heavy damage to group of zombies and slows them.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_WINTERMELON_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}冰瓜投手可以对尸群造成大量伤害，并令其减速。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_WINTERMINT_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Winter-mint will chill all zombies on the lawn.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_WINTERMINT_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}寒薄会冷缓草坪上的所有僵尸。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_WINTERMINT_1_2.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}And provide a boost to the effectiveness of other plants in its family.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_WINTERMINT_1_2.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}随后强化其他自己家族植物的能力。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_WITCHHAZEL_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Witch Hazel will transform zombies into shrooms that fights for you.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_WITCHHAZEL_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}巫术金缕梅会把僵尸变形成蘑菇，为你而战。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_XSHOT_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Rotobagas shoot projectiles along the four diagonals, in each direction that has a target.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_XSHOT_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}旋转洋芜菁可以在四个角中的任意一角有敌人时发射子弹。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_ZNAKELILY_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Znake Lily releases tornados that transforms zombies into Zomboids.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_ZNAKELILY_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}尸讹百合可以释放把僵尸变形成拟尸的龙卷风。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_ZNAKELILY_1_2.en: {SAY:winnie}Zomboids fight to protect the lawn against incoming zombies.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_ZNAKELILY_1_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}拟尸可以与来袭的僵尸作战，保护草坪。

NARRATIVE_PLTE_ZOYBEANPOD_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Zoybean Pod will spawn Zomboids that will attack nearby zombies.
NARRATIVE_PLTE_ZOYBEANPOD_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Zoybean Pod will spawn Zomboids that will attack nearby zombies.

NARRATIVE_POWERUPS2_TUTORIAL_INITIAL_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED}User Dave, online banking servers are unresponsive.
NARRATIVE_POWERUPS2_TUTORIAL_INITIAL_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED}用户戴夫，网银服务器无响应。

NARRATIVE_POWERUPS2_TUTORIAL_INITIAL_2.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SPECIAL6:crazydave}Hear that? We're rich! Let's use unlimited FREE Powerups!
NARRATIVE_POWERUPS2_TUTORIAL_INITIAL_2.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SPECIAL6:crazydave}听到了吗？我们发财了！随心使用免费的金手指吧！

NARRATIVE_POWERUPS2_TUTORIAL_REPEAT_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}Use unlimited FREE Powerups to help those plants!
NARRATIVE_POWERUPS2_TUTORIAL_REPEAT_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}无限使用免费的金手指，帮助那些植物吧！

NARRATIVE_POWERUPS_TUTORIAL_INITIAL_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED}You have some Power Ups! I'll show you how to use them.
NARRATIVE_POWERUPS_TUTORIAL_INITIAL_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED}你得到了一些金手指！我来教你怎么用它们吧！

NARRATIVE_POWERUPS_TUTORIAL_INITIAL_2.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SPECIAL6:crazydave}Yeah, and now we can break the seal. Let's get crazy!
NARRATIVE_POWERUPS_TUTORIAL_INITIAL_2.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SPECIAL6:crazydave}耶，现在我们可以启封金手指罐头了。疯玩起来吧！

NARRATIVE_POWERUPS_TUTORIAL_REPEAT_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}You can try out your Power Ups for free here!
NARRATIVE_POWERUPS_TUTORIAL_REPEAT_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}你可以在这里尽情挥霍免费的金手指！

NARRATIVE_POWERVINE_EQ_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Plant Power Vines to fire laser bolts, or more if they're in a network.
NARRATIVE_POWERVINE_EQ_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}种植电能藤蔓，发射激光束。种植多个构成电网，更能造成额外伤害。

NARRATIVE_PRIMALPOTATOMINE_EQ_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Plant Primal Potato Mines to create powerful area-of-effect explosions.
NARRATIVE_PRIMALPOTATOMINE_EQ_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}种植原始土豆地雷，制造强大的范围性爆炸。

NARRATIVE_PRIMALPOTATOMINE_EQ_POWERTILES.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Plant Food on a Power Tile applies Plant Food to all tiles of that color.
NARRATIVE_PRIMALPOTATOMINE_EQ_POWERTILES.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}往能量地砖上施放叶绿素，同色地砖都能获得叶绿素效果。

NARRATIVE_PUFFBALL_EQ_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Plant Puffballs to stun and poison zombies.
NARRATIVE_PUFFBALL_EQ_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}种植马勃，眩晕三排僵尸，并使他们中毒。

NARRATIVE_PUMPKIN_EQ_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie} Plant Pumpkins on other plants for a tough protective shell!
NARRATIVE_PUMPKIN_EQ_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie} 给其他植物套上南瓜来为他们增加一个坚韧的护盾！

NARRATIVE_PVINE_04_EQ_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Max level Pea Vines have high damage upgrade.
NARRATIVE_PVINE_04_EQ_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:crazydave}最高等级豌豆藤蔓的伤害很疯狂！

NARRATIVE_PVINE_EQ_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Plant Pea Vine on Appease-mint Family plants to boost their damage.
NARRATIVE_PVINE_EQ_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}在豌豆薄荷家族的植物上种植豌豆藤蔓，强化他们的伤害。

NARRATIVE_PYREVINE_EQ_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Vines are special plants that can be planted on top of other plants.
NARRATIVE_PYREVINE_EQ_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}藤蔓是一类能种在其他植物之上的特殊存在。

NARRATIVE_PYREVINE_EQ_2.en: {SAY:winnie}Pyre Vines will warm adjacent plants and provide a fiery short range offensive boost!
NARRATIVE_PYREVINE_EQ_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}把火焰藤蔓种在其他植物上，温暖附近植物并获得火热的防御！

NARRATIVE_QUEST_INTRO_3.en: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}What’s that, Travel Log? You provide guidance, progress and rewards?
NARRATIVE_QUEST_INTRO_3.zh: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}那是啥，旅行原木？你能给予我指导和奖励吗？

NARRATIVE_QUEST_INTRO_4.en: {SAY:winnie}The Log is not, in fact, speaking, User Dave.
NARRATIVE_QUEST_INTRO_4.zh: {SAY:winnie}实际上，旅行原木不会说话，用户戴夫。

NARRATIVE_QUEST_INTRO_5.zh: {SAY:crazydave}谢了，旅行原木！我会照你说的做的！

NARRATIVE_QUEST_LOG_AWARD_SCREEN_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnieicon}{SAY}Visit the Travel Log to claim your quest reward.
NARRATIVE_QUEST_LOG_AWARD_SCREEN_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnieicon}{SAY}拜访旅行原木来领取你的任务奖励。

NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_01_INTRO_10.en: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}We do not, but I can ensure you trade for exactly what your heart desires.
NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_01_INTRO_10.zh: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}虽然不认识，但是我可以让你交易到自己心仪的东西哦。

NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_01_INTRO_11.en: {SAY:crazydave_festival}!!! I must really be in the realm of Asgard!!!
NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_01_INTRO_11.zh: {SAY:crazydave_festival}！！！我一定是真的在仙境阿斯加德！！！

NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_01_INTRO_13.en: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}However, the opening of the Lunar Rainbow has linked the Otherworld to this place. You are not the only ones.
NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_01_INTRO_13.zh: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}不过因为月虹的开启，异界与这里产生了连结，不只是你。

NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_01_INTRO_14.en: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}A bunch of ugly green-skinned things have also arrived at this market.
NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_01_INTRO_14.zh: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}还有一帮绿色皮肤的丑东西也来到了这次集市。

NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_01_INTRO_15.en: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}I had thought they came to trade.
NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_01_INTRO_15.zh: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}我曾以为他们是来做交易的。

NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_01_INTRO_16.en: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}But they seek to possess goods without paying.
NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_01_INTRO_16.zh: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}但是他们想要不拿钱就占有商品。

NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_01_INTRO_17.en: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}They are nothing but thieves disrupting the market.
NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_01_INTRO_17.zh: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}简直就是一帮破坏市场的贼人。

NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_01_INTRO_18.en: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}There are more and more of them now. Market order has been severely disrupted.
NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_01_INTRO_18.zh: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}现在贼人越来越多了，市场的秩序已经被严重扰乱。

NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_01_INTRO_19.en: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}If you wish to obtain the items you desire, you might try expelling those thieves.
NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_01_INTRO_19.zh: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}如果你想要获得心仪物品的话，可以试着将那些贼人驱逐出去。

NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_01_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:crazydave}Weren't we just having a barbecue at the campsite??
NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_01_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:crazydave}我们不是在野营地进行烧烤吗？？

NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_01_INTRO_21.en: {SAY:crazydave_festival}That sounds exactly like something zombies would do.
NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_01_INTRO_21.zh: {SAY:crazydave_festival}这听上去是僵尸会干出的事。

NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_01_INTRO_22.en: {SAY:crazydave_festival}So, it's Plants vs. Zombies all over again? That happens to be my specialty, as the Fog Man!
NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_01_INTRO_22.zh: {SAY:crazydave_festival}所以说，又要进行植物大战僵尸了吗，这可是迷雾男我的强项。

NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_01_INTRO_3.en: {SAY:crazydave}I remember a rainbow smashing right into me! Am I in Asgard now?
NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_01_INTRO_3.zh: {SAY:crazydave}我记得是一道彩虹直直的砸向我，难道我现在在阿斯加德？

NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_01_INTRO_4.en: {NPC_ENTER:tenkyuchimata}{SAY:tenkyuchimata}Otherworlders, welcome to the Lunar Rainbow Market.

NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_01_INTRO_5.en: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}Tonight, you are the very first guests.
NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_01_INTRO_5.zh: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}今夜，您们是最早的一批客人呢。

NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_01_INTRO_6.en: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}I am Chimata Tenkyuu, the host of this market.
NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_01_INTRO_6.zh: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}我是天弓千亦，集市的主持人。

NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_01_INTRO_7.en: {NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave_festival}{SAY:crazydave_festival}Oh oh! I'm Dave! You can call me Crazy Dave!
NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_01_INTRO_7.zh: {NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave_festival}{SAY:crazydave_festival}哦哦！我是戴夫！你可以叫我疯狂戴夫！

NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_01_OUTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave_festival}{SAY:crazydave_festival}Hey Neighbor, I found Potato Chips nearby!
NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_01_OUTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave_festival}{SAY:crazydave_festival}嘿邻居我在这附近找到了薯片！

NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_01_OUTRO_2.en: {SAY:crazydave_festival}Crunchy Potato Chips are very helpful for us at night.
NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_01_OUTRO_2.zh: {SAY:crazydave_festival}脆脆的薯片对于我们在夜晚非常的有帮助。

NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_02_INTRO_10.en: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}As for why I don't just hand the cards to you directly...
NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_02_INTRO_10.zh: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}至于为什么不直接将卡牌给你呢…

NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_02_INTRO_11.en: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}Just consider it some mysterious market rule.
NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_02_INTRO_11.zh: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}你就理解成一些神秘的市场规则吧。

NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_02_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:crazydave_festival}Why don't we set up a stall here together?
NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_02_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:crazydave_festival}那为什么我们不一起也在这里摆个摊呢？

NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_02_INTRO_3.en: {SAY:crazydave_festival}I name this stall "Dave's Super Fancy Shop."
NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_02_INTRO_3.zh: {SAY:crazydave_festival}我将这个摊位命名为“戴夫的超级花哨小店”。

NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_02_INTRO_4.en: {SAY:crazydave_festival}This name makes me feel like Super-Fan Imps are tumbling in my stomach!!!
NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_02_INTRO_4.zh: {SAY:crazydave_festival}这个名字能让我感受到粉丝小鬼僵尸在肚子里翻滚！！！

NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_02_INTRO_6.en: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}Ability Cards are items made from Dragon Gems, sealing within them the magic of many humans and youkai.
NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_02_INTRO_6.zh: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}能力卡牌是使用龙珠制作的，封存着许多人类和妖怪魔力的道具。

NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_02_INTRO_7.en: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}I commissioned Megumu Iizunamaru to craft some Ability Cards for you, sealing the magic of plants and zombies.
NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_02_INTRO_7.zh: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}我委托了饭纲丸龙帮你制作了些封存着植物和僵尸魔力的能力卡牌。

NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_02_INTRO_8.en: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}When the time is right, I will send a signal and drop a Card Box containing Ability Cards onto the field.
NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_02_INTRO_8.zh: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}到时候我会发出一个信号，然后将存放着能力卡牌的卡盒投放到场上。

NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_02_INTRO_9.en: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}However, if you don't notice it at first, the Card Box will lose its magic and vanish.
NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_02_INTRO_9.zh: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}不过一开始没有注意到的话，卡盒就会失去魔力而消失哦。

NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_02_OUTRO_12.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave_festival}{NPC_ENTER:tenkyuchimata}{SAY:crazydave_festival}But Zombie Cards don't help me at all! Are you tricking me?
NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_02_OUTRO_12.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave_festival}{NPC_ENTER:tenkyuchimata}{SAY:crazydave_festival}可是僵尸卡牌根本不帮助我呀，你是不是在诓我？

NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_02_OUTRO_13.en: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}Well, perhaps the stench of zombies is so strong it attracted the zombie magic.
NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_02_OUTRO_13.zh: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}嘛，可能是僵尸的臭味太浓厚把僵尸魔力都吸过去了吧。

NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_09_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave_festival}{SAY:crazydave_festival}Hey, I found a new variety of Iris here.
NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_09_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave_festival}{SAY:crazydave_festival}嘿，我在这里找到了新的鸢尾花品种。

NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_09_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:crazydave_festival}Let's call him the "Desire Calamus" for now.

NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_09_INTRO_3.en: {SAY:crazydave_festival}He can eat the divine spirits on the field to power up.
NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_09_INTRO_3.zh: {SAY:crazydave_festival}他可以吃掉场上的小神灵来获得强化。

NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_09_INTRO_4.en: {SAY:crazydave_festival}He's smart, isn't he? I also wish I was a guy who could get stronger just by eating.
NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_09_INTRO_4.zh: {SAY:crazydave_festival}他很聪明，不是吗？我也希望做一个靠吃就能变强的家伙。

NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_09_INTRO_5.en: {SAY:crazydave_festival}That would make us live in Disney World!
NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_09_INTRO_5.zh: {SAY:crazydave_festival}这将会让我们生活在迪士尼世界！

NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_15_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave_festival}{SAY:crazydave_festival}Hey Neighbor, interested in holding a Lunar Rainbow Bonfire Party?
NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_15_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave_festival}{SAY:crazydave_festival}嘿邻居，有没有兴趣办一场月虹篝火晚会。

NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_15_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:crazydave_festival}I proudly introduce to you — Missile Toast!
NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_15_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:crazydave_festival}我将向你隆重介绍——槲寄火仙子！

NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_15_INTRO_3.en: {SAY:crazydave_festival}Her fireballs cover a wide area! Super suitable for a bonfire party!
NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_15_INTRO_3.zh: {SAY:crazydave_festival}她的火球可是覆盖面积很广的！超适合办篝火晚会！

NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_15_INTRO_4.en: {SAY:crazydave_festival}Let the zombies dance along with the heatwave!
NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_15_INTRO_4.zh: {SAY:crazydave_festival}让僵尸也一起跟随热浪舞动吧！

NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_23_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave_festival}{NPC_ENTER:tenkyuchimata}{SAY:tenkyuchimata}Do you know the story of the "Beauty Rainbow"?

NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_23_INTRO_10.en: {SAY:crazydave_festival}That fact just blew me all the way to Pluto!
NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_23_INTRO_10.zh: {SAY:crazydave_festival}这个事实简直就像把我吹到了冥王星！

NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_23_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:crazydave_festival}你是在说爱尔兰的小精灵吗？

NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_23_INTRO_4.en: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}Once, an emperor tried to assault a beautiful woman. After her warnings were ignored, she transformed into a rainbow and flew away.
NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_23_INTRO_4.zh: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}曾经有个皇帝想要非礼一位貌美的女子，这位女子在多次警告无用下，直接变成了虹飞走了。

NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_23_INTRO_5.en: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}That is the origin of the Beauty Rainbow.

NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_23_INTRO_7.en: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}I found a plant called Begonia near the rainbow.
NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_23_INTRO_7.zh: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}我在虹附近找到了一株叫秋海棠的植物。

NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_23_INTRO_8.en: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}I believe she will be of great help to you.

NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_23_INTRO_9.en: {SAY:crazydave_festival}Um, does that mean people in the old days walked on women to get to Asgard?
NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_23_INTRO_9.zh: {SAY:crazydave_festival}唔，也就是说当年人们前往阿斯加德都是踩着女子过去的吗？

NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_30_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}A big fellow is rushing here along the Lunar Rainbow.
NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_30_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}有一个大家伙正沿着月虹向这里奔来。

NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_30_INTRO_3.en: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}It is completely different from the zombies that appeared before.
NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_30_INTRO_3.zh: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}它和那些前面出现的僵尸完全不一样。

NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_30_INTRO_4.en: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}The Lunar Rainbow is about to fade. Are the zombies planning one last stand?
NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_30_INTRO_4.zh: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}月虹即将消散，僵尸们也打算放手一搏了吗？

NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_30_OUTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave_festival}{NPC_ENTER:tenkyuchimata}{SAY:crazydave_festival}Oh oh oh! This big robot is completely trashed!
NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_30_OUTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave_festival}{NPC_ENTER:tenkyuchimata}{SAY:crazydave_festival}哦哦哦！这个大机器人彻底烂掉了！

NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_30_OUTRO_11.en: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}The Lunar Rainbow is about to fade. You will be leaving soon.
NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_30_OUTRO_11.zh: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}月虹马上就要消散了，接下来你就要走了吧。

NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_30_OUTRO_12.en: {SAY:crazydave_festival}I bet Nate and the others must have realized I'm missing.
NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_30_OUTRO_12.zh: {SAY:crazydave_festival}我想内特他们一定发现了我的失踪。

NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_30_OUTRO_13.en: {SAY:crazydave_festival}Maybe I can still get a full plate of BBQ if I go back now!
NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_30_OUTRO_13.zh: {SAY:crazydave_festival}说不准我现在回去就能吃到满满的一盘烧烤呢！

NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_30_OUTRO_14.en: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}We will meet again. The earth is round, after all.
NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_30_OUTRO_14.zh: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}我们还会再见面的，毕竟地球是圆的嘛。

NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_30_OUTRO_3.en: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}Mr. Crazy Dave, I express my sincerest gratitude to you.
NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_30_OUTRO_3.zh: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}疯狂戴夫先生，我向你表示最衷心的感谢。

NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_30_OUTRO_4.en: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}As a return gift, I give you this Auto-Sandwich Magnet.
NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_30_OUTRO_4.zh: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}作为回礼，我把这个全自动三明治吸铁器给你。

NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_30_OUTRO_5.en: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}This Sandwich is the latest product developed by the Kappa. It automatically collects items—surely you must need it.
NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_30_OUTRO_5.zh: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}这个三明治是河童研发的最新产品，可以自动收集物品，想必你一定需要它吧。

NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_30_OUTRO_8.en: {SAY:crazydave_festival}My mood right now is like three Imps getting married in my stomach...
NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_30_OUTRO_8.zh: {SAY:crazydave_festival}我想我的心情现在就像是三只小鬼僵尸在我的肚子里结婚…

NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_30_OUTRO_9.en: {SAY:crazydave_festival}Looks like I can only take this sandwich back for my collection...
NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_30_OUTRO_9.zh: {SAY:crazydave_festival}看来我只能把这个三明治拿回去收藏了…

NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_OUTRO_DANGER_ROO.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave_festival}{NPC_ENTER:tenkyuchimata}{SAY:crazydave_festival}哦，看呐！那是一个有着七彩颜色的钥匙串。

NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_OUTRO_DANGER_ROO.en: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}No, this is actually a string of Magatama from ancient times.
NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_OUTRO_DANGER_ROO.zh: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}并非，这其实是一串来自太古的勾玉。

NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_OUTRO_DANGER_ROO.en: {SAY:crazydave_festival}Magatama? Is that an item used for rituals?
{SAY:tenkyuchimata}It is not that simple. Magatama are vessels capable of holding memories.
NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_OUTRO_DANGER_ROO.zh: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}不止是那样简单，勾玉是能够纳入记忆的器具。

NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_OUTRO_DANGER_ROO.en: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}And these rainbow Magatama are made from the primordial Izanagi Object.
NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_OUTRO_DANGER_ROO.zh: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}而这些七彩勾玉，又是用太古时期的伊奘诺物质制作的。

NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_OUTRO_DANGER_ROO.en: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}As for the Izanagi Object, it is a mineral that existed long before humans were born. The Dragon Gems I mentioned earlier are also made of this essence.
NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_OUTRO_DANGER_ROO.zh: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}至于伊奘诺物质，它是远早于人类诞生就已存在的矿物。先前我所说的龙珠的本质也是它。

NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_OUTRO_DANGER_ROO.en: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}Perhaps it can show you the world before the gods named it?
NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_OUTRO_DANGER_ROO.zh: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}也许，它可以让你看到众神命名这个世界之前的情景？

NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_OUTRO_DANGER_ROO.en: {SAY:crazydave_festival}Ohoho, this news is making my crazy eye explode!!!
NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_OUTRO_DANGER_ROO.zh: {SAY:crazydave_festival}哦嚯嚯，这个消息快让我的疯狂之眼爆炸了！！！

NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_ZOMBIENOTE_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydaveicon}{SAY:crazydaveicon}What does this mean? I can't read Japanese.
NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_ZOMBIENOTE_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydaveicon}{SAY:crazydaveicon}这是什么意思？我看不懂日语。

NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_ZOMBIENOTE_2.en: {NPC_ENTER:tenkyuchimataicon}{SAY:tenkyuchimataicon}It is a custom. On full moon nights, children become messengers of the moon. During this time, they may freely steal dumplings or persimmons from others.
NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_ZOMBIENOTE_2.zh: {NPC_ENTER:tenkyuchimataicon}{SAY:tenkyuchimataicon}这是一种习俗，在满月之夜，孩子们会化身月亮的使者，这时候他们可以随意偷别人家的团子或柿子。

NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_ZOMBIENOTE_4.en: {SAY:tenkyuchimataicon}And this note says "I stole the moon" and... "I hate the guy wearing colorful clothes."
NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_ZOMBIENOTE_4.zh: {SAY:tenkyuchimataicon}然后这上面写的是“月亮被我偷走了”和……“讨厌穿着彩色衣服的家伙”。

NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_ZOMBIENOTE_5.en: {SAY:crazydaveicon}Oh oh oh, isn't that guy you?
NARRATIVE_RAINBOWMARKET_ZOMBIENOTE_5.zh: {SAY:crazydaveicon}哦哦哦哦，那这个家伙不就是你吗？

NARRATIVE_REINFORCEMINT_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Power Mints are powerful plants you can acquire through Arena mode.
NARRATIVE_REINFORCEMINT_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}超能薄荷是通过竞技场模式获得的强大植物。

NARRATIVE_REINFORCEMINT_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:winnie}They provide a big boost to plants in their family.
NARRATIVE_REINFORCEMINT_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}它们对相应家族的植物有巨大的增益作用。

NARRATIVE_REINFORCEMINT_INTRO_3.zh: {SAY:winnie}加固薄荷家族包括防御类植物。

NARRATIVE_REINFORCEMINT_INTRO_4.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:crazydave}Sorry I'm late, what did I miss? A mint pun?
NARRATIVE_REINFORCEMINT_INTRO_4.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:crazydave}啊！抱歉，我来晚了。我错过了什么？你们刚刚是在聊薄荷糖之类的吗？

NARRATIVE_RENAI_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}O mad one! Dost thou believe thy botanical trifles can halt the wheel of destiny?
NARRATIVE_RENAI_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}哦，疯狂之人，汝所植之草木，岂能阻止命运之车轮?

NARRATIVE_RENAI_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_2.en: {SAY:zombossicon}Verily, I shall transmute thy garden into a necrotic dominion!
NARRATIVE_RENAI_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_2.zh: {SAY:zombossicon}吾欲将尔之园地化为僵尸的领域。

NARRATIVE_RENAI_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_3.zh: {SAY:zombossicon}在此之前，让我们开始一场盛大的演出吧！

NARRATIVE_RENAI_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_5.en: {EXCITED:winnie}Translation: He said he's going to kill you.

NARRATIVE_RENAI_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_6.en: {EXCITED:crazydave}Maybe he's got tacos hidden in that monologue?

NARRATIVE_RENAI_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_2.en: {SAY:zombossicon}My endeavors fade like a meteor across the firmament...
NARRATIVE_RENAI_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_2.zh: {SAY:zombossicon}我之努力竟如流星划过天际。

NARRATIVE_RENAI_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_3.en: {SAY:zombossicon}Revel in transient triumph, mortals! For I shall strike back with lightning's wrath!
NARRATIVE_RENAI_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_3.zh: {SAY:zombossicon}尔等沉迷于短暂的欢愉，却不知我将会如闪电般归来！

NARRATIVE_RENAI_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_5.en: {TIRED:winnie}Hypothesis: This is what Shakespearean failure soliloquy sounds like.
NARRATIVE_RENAI_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_5.zh: {TIRED:winnie}或许这就是“莎士比亚式”的诗意失败。

NARRATIVE_RESPRINGENING_LTE_2023_1_2.en: {SAY:crazydave_r}What is that buzzing sound in my ear?

NARRATIVE_RESPRINGENING_LTE_2023_1_3.en: {SAY:winnie_l}My sensors indicate that there are bees in our proximity.
NARRATIVE_RESPRINGENING_LTE_2023_1_3.zh: {SAY:winnie_l}我的传感器表明我们附近有蜜蜂。

NARRATIVE_RESPRINGENING_LTE_2023_2_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss}{SAY:zomboss}Ha! Ha! Ha! Today is the day that Dave will PAY!
NARRATIVE_RESPRINGENING_LTE_2023_2_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss}{SAY:zomboss}哈！哈！哈！今天，我一定要让戴夫付出代价！

NARRATIVE_RESPRINGENING_LTE_2023_3_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{NPC_ENTER:chilibean_r}{SAY:chilibean_r}I sure hope Dave’s tacos are bean-free.
NARRATIVE_RESPRINGENING_LTE_2023_3_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{NPC_ENTER:chilibean_r}{SAY:chilibean_r}我真心希望戴夫的玉米卷里没有豆子。

NARRATIVE_RESPRINGENING_LTE_2023_4_2.zh: {SAY:wallnut}被压扁，被吃掉。这一切又有什么意义呢？

NARRATIVE_RESPRINGENING_LTE_2023_4_3.en: {SAY:sunflower_r}Come on Wall-nut. Spring is in the air!
NARRATIVE_RESPRINGENING_LTE_2023_4_3.zh: {SAY:sunflower_r}哎，坚果墙。看看周围，春意盎然啊！

NARRATIVE_RESPRINGENING_LTE_2023_5_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{NPC_ENTER:iceburg_r}{SAY:peashooter}Something tells me the sun isn’t going anywhere for a while.
NARRATIVE_RESPRINGENING_LTE_2023_5_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{NPC_ENTER:iceburg_r}{SAY:peashooter}听消息说，太阳一时半会儿是不会消失了。

NARRATIVE_RESPRINGENING_LTE_2023_6_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:iceburg_r}{NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:iceburg_r}Keep me faaar away from those whips, thanks!

NARRATIVE_RESPRINGENING_LTE_2023_6_2.en: {SAY:peashooter}That was some battle! I think I broke a sweat!
NARRATIVE_RESPRINGENING_LTE_2023_6_2.zh: {SAY:peashooter}真是场跌宕起伏的恶战啊！我都感觉冒汗了！

NARRATIVE_RESPRINGENING_LTE_2023_6_3.en: {SAY:iceburg_r}Sweating isn’t good for my surface area.
NARRATIVE_RESPRINGENING_LTE_2023_6_3.zh: {SAY:iceburg_r}我要是流汗，那我的表面积就要变小了。

NARRATIVE_RESPRINGENING_LTE_2023_7_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie_l}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave_r}{SAY:winnie_l}Existence of pollen detected in circuitry. Navigation systems malfunctioning.
NARRATIVE_RESPRINGENING_LTE_2023_7_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie_l}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave_r}{SAY:winnie_l}探测到电路中存在花粉。导航系统出现故障。

NARRATIVE_RESPRINGENING_LTE_2023_7_2.en: {SAY:winnie_l}User Dave, Please replace my filter so I may recalibrate for the next adventure.
NARRATIVE_RESPRINGENING_LTE_2023_7_2.zh: {SAY:winnie_l}用户戴夫，请更换我的滤网，这样我才能重新为下次冒险校准。

NARRATIVE_RESPRINGENING_LTE_2023_7_3.en: {SAY:crazydave_r}Where did I put the dang ol’ filter doohickey?
NARRATIVE_RESPRINGENING_LTE_2023_7_3.zh: {SAY:crazydave_r}我把那滤网啥的玩意儿放哪儿去了来着？

NARRATIVE_RESPRINGENING_LTE_2023_7_4.en: {SAY:crazydave_r}I know! I’ll check the doohickey drawer!!
NARRATIVE_RESPRINGENING_LTE_2023_7_4.zh: {SAY:crazydave_r}我知道了！我去看看我的“啥的玩意儿”抽屉！

NARRATIVE_RESPRINGENING_LTE_2023_8_2.en: {SAY:zomboss}You may have won User Dave but that’s only because of my allergies!!
NARRATIVE_RESPRINGENING_LTE_2023_8_2.zh: {SAY:zomboss}算你赢了吧，用户戴夫。但那只是因为我过敏了！！

NARRATIVE_REVERSE_DAVE_PENNY_TEST_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave_r}{NPC_ENTER:winnie_l}{EXCITED:crazydave_r}Penny, look!  I’m on the right side of the screen!

NARRATIVE_RHUBARBARIAN_EQ_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Plant Rhubarbarian to pummel, stun and punch attacking zombies off the lawn.
NARRATIVE_RHUBARBARIAN_EQ_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}种植蛮族大黄，连续击打、眩晕僵尸，并把攻击他的僵尸击出那行。

NARRATIVE_RIFT_UNLOCK_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnieicon}{SAY:winnieicon}User Dave. Penny Tech upgrade complete. I now have new gadgetry, including a Zomboss Positioning System, or ZPS.
NARRATIVE_RIFT_UNLOCK_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnieicon}{SAY:winnieicon}用户戴夫，潘妮升级完成。我现在有了新的设备，包括僵王定位系统，或简称 ZPS。

NARRATIVE_RIFT_UNLOCK_2.en: {SAY:winnieicon}Picking up signal... User Dave, I fear... User Dave?
NARRATIVE_RIFT_UNLOCK_2.zh: {SAY:winnieicon}正在接收信号…用户戴夫，我有些害怕…用户戴夫？

NARRATIVE_RIFT_UNLOCK_4.en: {NPC_EXIT:crazydaveicon}{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}Silence, you nutritional ninny! Remove your shaggy paws from my hyper-radio this insta-...(click)
NARRATIVE_RIFT_UNLOCK_4.zh: {NPC_EXIT:crazydaveicon}{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}闭嘴，你这个笨蛋！把你的毛茸茸爪子从我的超级收音机上拿开…（点击）

NARRATIVE_RIFT_UNLOCK_5.en: {NPC_EXIT:zombossicon}{SAY:winnieicon}Oh, dear. Dr. Zomboss has abducted User Dave. I must charge my new fuel cells and pursue with haste into the rift!
NARRATIVE_RIFT_UNLOCK_5.zh: {NPC_EXIT:zombossicon}{SAY:winnieicon}哦，天啊。僵王博士抓走了用户戴夫。我必须填充我的新燃料快点追到裂缝里去！

NARRATIVE_ROMANB_LTE_2023_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie_l}{SAY:winnie_l}Sensors indicate we have returned to ancient Rome and to The Zombosseum.
NARRATIVE_ROMANB_LTE_2023_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie_l}{SAY:winnie_l}我的传感器表明，我们回到了古罗马和僵王斗兽场。

NARRATIVE_ROMANB_LTE_2023_1_3.en: {NPC_EXIT:winnie_l}{NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:peashooter}We are here to stop you Zomboss.

NARRATIVE_ROMANB_LTE_2023_1_4.zh: {SAY:zomboss_r}那得看你们的本事了……小的们！

NARRATIVE_ROMANB_LTE_2023_2_2.en: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter_r}{SAY:peashooter_r}You don’t want to make it angry though.

NARRATIVE_ROMANB_LTE_2023_3_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave} {SAY:crazydave}现在是不是该去参观一下当地的景点呢？

NARRATIVE_ROMANB_LTE_2023_3_2.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}否，用户戴夫。僵尸大军正在接近。

NARRATIVE_ROMANB_LTE_2023_4_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}A little more and it’ll be complete!

NARRATIVE_ROMANB_LTE_2023_4_3.zh: {SAY:zomboss_r}等会儿你就知道了……木哈哈哈！

NARRATIVE_ROMANB_LTE_2023_5_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}You’re too late.. Behold, you fools. My GREATEST invention!
NARRATIVE_ROMANB_LTE_2023_5_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}你们来晚了……看清楚了，你们这群傻瓜。我最伟大的发明！

NARRATIVE_ROMANB_LTE_2023_5_2.zh: {SHOUT:zomboss_r}悍架华轩僵尸机器人！！！ <呜嗡嗡嗡嗡>

NARRATIVE_ROMANB_LTE_2023_5_4.en: {SAY:zomboss_r}It will CRUSH you this time and there will be no survivors!
NARRATIVE_ROMANB_LTE_2023_5_4.zh: {SAY:zomboss_r}这次，它会把你们统统踩在脚下，不留活口！

NARRATIVE_ROMANB_LTE_2023_6_2.en: {SAY:zomboss_r}I still have 200 payments left on the loan!

NARRATIVE_ROMANB_LTE_2023_6_3.en: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:peashooter}When evil doers arise, we are here to save the day!
NARRATIVE_ROMANB_LTE_2023_6_3.zh: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:peashooter}当恶人出现，就让我们来拯救世界！

NARRATIVE_ROMANB_LTE_2023_6_5.en: {SAY:zomboss_r}This isn’t the end. I’ve got more inventions in store for you.
NARRATIVE_ROMANB_LTE_2023_6_5.zh: {SAY:zomboss_r}还没结束呢。我给你们留了很多发明。

NARRATIVE_ROMANB_LTE_2023_7_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SHOUT:zomboss_r}What! How did you get pass all my minions?
NARRATIVE_ROMANB_LTE_2023_7_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SHOUT:zomboss_r}什么！你们怎么打败我的随从的？

NARRATIVE_ROMANB_LTE_2023_7_2.en: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:peashooter}Your minions are no match for us!
NARRATIVE_ROMANB_LTE_2023_7_2.zh: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:peashooter}你的虾兵蟹将根本不配与我们一战！

NARRATIVE_ROMANB_LTE_2023_7_3.en: {SAY:zomboss_r}Arrg!! I just need a bit more time for some final adjustments.
NARRATIVE_ROMANB_LTE_2023_7_3.zh: {SAY:zomboss_r}恶额！！ 我还需要一点时间来最后调整一下。

NARRATIVE_ROMANB_LTE_2023_8_2.en: {SAY:zomboss_r}This isn’t the end. Our next encounter will be your last!
NARRATIVE_ROMANB_LTE_2023_8_2.zh: {SAY:zomboss_r}还没结束呢。下次对阵，我将成为你们合眼前最后看到的人！

NARRATIVE_ROMANB_LTE_2023_8_3.en: {NPC_EXIT:zomboss_r}{NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:peashooter}When evil doers arise, we are here to save the day!
NARRATIVE_ROMANB_LTE_2023_8_3.zh: {NPC_EXIT:zomboss_r}{NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:peashooter}当黑恶崛起，就让我们来拯救世界！

NARRATIVE_ROMANC_LTE_2024_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss}{SAY:zomboss}Welcome, foolish mortals, to my grand creation...
NARRATIVE_ROMANC_LTE_2024_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss}{SAY:zomboss}欢迎，愚蠢的凡人，欢迎来到我的杰作…

NARRATIVE_ROMANC_LTE_2024_1_3.en: {SAY:zomboss}Prepare to descent into the depths of terror.
NARRATIVE_ROMANC_LTE_2024_1_3.zh: {SAY:zomboss}准备好溺于这恐惧的深渊吧。

NARRATIVE_ROMANC_LTE_2024_1_4.zh: {NPC_ENTER:sunflower_r}{SAY:sunflower_r}你的黑暗掩盖不了我们的决心。

NARRATIVE_ROMANC_LTE_2024_1_5.en: {SAY:sunflower_r}We'll shine through even in the deepest depths!
NARRATIVE_ROMANC_LTE_2024_1_5.zh: {SAY:sunflower_r}哪怕再深的深渊，我们也能照射出万丈光芒！

NARRATIVE_ROMANC_LTE_2024_1_6.en: {NPC_EXIT:sunflower_r}{NPC_ENTER:wallnut_r}{SAY:wallnut_r}Looks like you redecorated, good for you but you are going down.
NARRATIVE_ROMANC_LTE_2024_1_6.zh: {NPC_EXIT:sunflower_r}{NPC_ENTER:wallnut_r}{SAY:wallnut_r}你好像重新装修了一下嘛，真为你感到高兴。不过可惜了。

NARRATIVE_ROMANC_LTE_2024_2_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss}{SAY:zomboss}Blast it all! How could this be? My plans foiled by mere plants.
NARRATIVE_ROMANC_LTE_2024_2_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss}{SAY:zomboss}真服了！怎么可能？我的计划被区区植物阻止了。

NARRATIVE_ROMANC_LTE_2024_2_2.en: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter_r}{SAY:peashooter_r}You know Zomboss, you underestimate us a lot.
NARRATIVE_ROMANC_LTE_2024_2_2.zh: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter_r}{SAY:peashooter_r}其实僵王，你有点太低估我们了。

NARRATIVE_ROMANC_LTE_2024_2_3.en: {NPC_EXIT:peashooter_r}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Zombies have been successfully defeated. Well done plants.
NARRATIVE_ROMANC_LTE_2024_2_3.zh: {NPC_EXIT:peashooter_r}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}已顺利击败僵尸。好样的，各位植物。

NARRATIVE_ROMANC_LTE_2024_2_4.en: {NPC_EXIT:winnie}{SAY:zomboss}Enjoy your temporary victory, but beware the flood that's nigh.
NARRATIVE_ROMANC_LTE_2024_2_4.zh: {NPC_EXIT:winnie}{SAY:zomboss}你们就在眼前的胜利中沉醉吧。不久，我会让你们在洪灾中沉沦。

NARRATIVE_ROMANC_LTE_2024_2_5.en: {SAY:zomboss}For when I return, your garden's fate will be high and dry.
NARRATIVE_ROMANC_LTE_2024_2_5.zh: {SAY:zomboss}而待我归来之时，你们花园的命运将如旱灾般干枯。

NARRATIVE_ROMAN_LTE_2023_2_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:winnie}User Dave. It appears we have traveled to Ancient Rome.
NARRATIVE_ROMAN_LTE_2023_2_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:winnie}用户戴夫。我们似乎旅行到了古罗马。

NARRATIVE_ROMAN_LTE_2023_2_2.en: {SAY:winnie}Zomboss is up to his nefarious schemes again.
NARRATIVE_ROMAN_LTE_2023_2_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}僵王又在实施他的邪恶计划了。

NARRATIVE_ROMAN_LTE_2023_2_3.en: {SAY:winnie}He’s assembled a horde of new zombie threats.
NARRATIVE_ROMAN_LTE_2023_2_3.zh: {SAY:winnie}他集结了一帮前所未有的僵尸大军。

NARRATIVE_ROMAN_LTE_2023_3_2.en: {SAY:sunflower}Our new friend to the lawn is quite capable.
NARRATIVE_ROMAN_LTE_2023_3_2.zh: {SAY:sunflower}我们的新朋友好像蛮厉害的嘛。

NARRATIVE_ROMAN_LTE_2023_4_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss}{SAY:zomboss}把你那令人发指的花花草草扔到一边儿去！

NARRATIVE_ROMAN_LTE_2023_4_2.en: {SAY:zomboss}Next time my legions will crush you and your brainz will be ours!
NARRATIVE_ROMAN_LTE_2023_4_2.zh: {SAY:zomboss}下次，我的军团必将把你们踩在脚下，而手上，则会握着你们那鲜活的脑子！

NARRATIVE_ROMAN_LTE_2025_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie_l}{SAY:winnie_l}User Dave, it appears that we have arrived in Rome yet again.
NARRATIVE_ROMAN_LTE_2025_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie_l}{SAY:winnie_l}用户戴夫，我们好像又抵达罗马了。

NARRATIVE_ROMAN_LTE_2025_1_2.en: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SHOUT:zomboss_r}HAHAHA!!! Prepare to face your doom in the Zombosseum!!!
NARRATIVE_ROMAN_LTE_2025_1_2.zh: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SHOUT:zomboss_r}哈哈哈!!! 准备在僵王斗兽场直面自己的末日吧!!!

NARRATIVE_ROMAN_LTE_2025_1_3.en: {NPC_EXIT:winnie_l}{NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:peashooter}We'll stop whatever you throw at us, Zomboss.
NARRATIVE_ROMAN_LTE_2025_1_3.zh: {NPC_EXIT:winnie_l}{NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:peashooter}无论给我们什么困难，我们都会阻止你的。

NARRATIVE_ROMAN_LTE_2025_1_4.en: {SAY:zomboss_r}Well, you're in my domain now! Minions, attack!!!
NARRATIVE_ROMAN_LTE_2025_1_4.zh: {SAY:zomboss_r}嗯，可现在你们正踏在我的领土上！小的们，进攻!!!

NARRATIVE_ROMAN_LTE_2025_2_2.en: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter_r}{SAY:peashooter_r}Looks like you and your zombies are equally brain-dead!
NARRATIVE_ROMAN_LTE_2025_2_2.zh: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter_r}{SAY:peashooter_r}看来你和你的僵尸大军都有点“脑死亡”了！

NARRATIVE_ROMAN_LTE_2025_2_3.en: {SAY:zomboss}This isn't over!!! Next time, you'll be the ones saying, 'Foiled again!'
NARRATIVE_ROMAN_LTE_2025_2_3.zh: {SAY:zomboss}还没完呢!!! 下回，说“又一次败北”的是你们！

NARRATIVE_ROMAN_LTE_2025_2_4.en: {SAY:zomboss}Just wait till I return. Revenge will be MINE!!!

NARRATIVE_SCORETEST_01_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}击败僵尸来提升分数倍增器的数值。

NARRATIVE_SCORETEST_01_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:winnie}The multiplier drops if you go too long without defeating a zombie.
NARRATIVE_SCORETEST_01_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}如果你太久没有击败任一僵尸，倍增器的分数加成效果会减弱。

NARRATIVE_SCORETEST_01_INTRO_3.en: {SAY:winnie}The multiplier also drops when zombies destroy plants.
NARRATIVE_SCORETEST_01_INTRO_3.zh: {SAY:winnie}分数倍增器也会在僵尸毁坏植物时降级。

NARRATIVE_SHINEVINE_EQ_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Shine Vines amplify the sun production of sun producer plants they're planted on.
NARRATIVE_SHINEVINE_EQ_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}闪耀藤蔓可以增强她们上面的阳光生产植物。

NARRATIVE_SOLARSAGE_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}Solar Sage illuminates zombies, who then drop sun as they leave the board.
NARRATIVE_SOLARSAGE_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}圣光鼠尾草能让僵尸开悟，受开悟的僵尸会离开场地，并在过程中掉落阳光。

NARRATIVE_SOLARTOMATO_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}Solar Tomato stuns zombies in a 3x3 area, with each stunned zombie giving 50 sun.
NARRATIVE_SOLARTOMATO_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}阳光番茄能够令 3x3 范围内的僵尸眩晕，同时使他们各产生 50 阳光。

NARRATIVE_SOLARTOMATO_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:winnie}Use it to stun large crowds of zombies!

NARRATIVE_SPEARMINT_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Power Mints are powerful plants you can acquire through Arena mode.
NARRATIVE_SPEARMINT_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}超能薄荷是通过竞技场模式获得的强大植物。

NARRATIVE_SPEARMINT_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:winnie}They provide a big boost to plants in their family.
NARRATIVE_SPEARMINT_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}它们对相应家族的植物有巨大的增益作用。

NARRATIVE_SPEARMINT_INTRO_3.en: {SAY:winnie}The Spear-mint family is made up of piercing plants.
NARRATIVE_SPEARMINT_INTRO_3.zh: {SAY:winnie}穿刺薄荷家族包括尖刺类植物。

NARRATIVE_SPRINGENING_LTE_2024_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}User Dave, my sensors incidcate that spring has begun.
NARRATIVE_SPRINGENING_LTE_2024_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}用户戴夫，我的传感器表明春天开始了。

NARRATIVE_SPRINGENING_LTE_2024_1_2.en: {SHOUT:crazydave}Already?! No wonder I was seeing bunnies all around the lawn.
NARRATIVE_SPRINGENING_LTE_2024_1_2.zh: {SHOUT:crazydave}这么快吗？！ 难怪草坪上到处都是兔子。

NARRATIVE_SPRINGENING_LTE_2024_1_3.en: {SAY:winnie}Look closely User Dave, they are not normal bunnies.
NARRATIVE_SPRINGENING_LTE_2024_1_3.zh: {SAY:winnie}看清楚了用户戴夫，它们可不是普通兔子。

NARRATIVE_SPRINGENING_LTE_2024_1_4.en: {SAY:crazydave}Wait a minute, why aren't the cute bunnies hopping like normal?
NARRATIVE_SPRINGENING_LTE_2024_1_4.zh: {SAY:crazydave}等等，这些可爱的兔子怎么不像平常一样跳来跳去呢？

NARRATIVE_SPRINGENING_LTE_2024_2_2.zh: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SHOUT:zomboss_r}木哈哈……你们就要完蛋了，彩蛋的蛋！

NARRATIVE_SPRINGENING_LTE_2024_2_3.en: {SAY:peashooter}Yolks on you, we will shell out all your plans.
NARRATIVE_SPRINGENING_LTE_2024_2_3.zh: {SAY:peashooter}“壳”别高兴太早，无论什么计划，我们会给你搅“黄”。

NARRATIVE_SPRINGENING_LTE_2024_3_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss}{SAY:zomboss}Only if I hadn't slipped on this butter, my plans would've been sunny side up.
NARRATIVE_SPRINGENING_LTE_2024_3_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss}{SAY:zomboss}要不是我不小心踩到黄油滑倒了，我的计划肯定前途大好。

NARRATIVE_SPRINGENING_LTE_2024_3_3.en: {SAY:zomboss}Who told you to take off the costume? We still have much to do.
NARRATIVE_SPRINGENING_LTE_2024_3_3.zh: {SAY:zomboss}谁叫你脱掉兔子装扮的？计划还早着呢。

NARRATIVE_SPRINGENING_LTE_2024_4_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:wallnut}{SAY:wallnut}I had a nightmare that I was an egg and flying zombies tried to hatch me.
NARRATIVE_SPRINGENING_LTE_2024_4_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:wallnut}{SAY:wallnut}我做了个噩梦，我梦见自己是颗蛋，会飞的僵尸想孵我。

NARRATIVE_SPRINGENING_LTE_2024_4_2.en: {NPC_ENTER:chilibean_r}{SAY:chilibean_r}You had to open up about your nightmare hadn't you? Look up.
NARRATIVE_SPRINGENING_LTE_2024_4_2.zh: {NPC_ENTER:chilibean_r}{SAY:chilibean_r}凭你这嘴，梦里肯定是乌鸦蛋吧？看天上。

NARRATIVE_SPRINGENING_LTE_2024_4_3.zh: {SHOUT:wallnut}不，别啊别……别…别…别…不不不不不不！

NARRATIVE_SPRINGENING_LTE_2024_5_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:iceburg}{SAY:iceburg}Woah Draftodil's air cannons are as loud as they are powerful.
NARRATIVE_SPRINGENING_LTE_2024_5_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:iceburg}{SAY:iceburg}哇，气流水仙的空气炮，声音和它的威力一样大。

NARRATIVE_SPRINGENING_LTE_2024_5_2.en: {NPC_ENTER:wallnut_r}{SHOUT:wallnut_r}Ohhhh yeeaahh! That's some air conditioning man!

NARRATIVE_SPRINGENING_LTE_2024_5_3.en: {SAY:iceburg}Why are you shouting I am right infront of you?
NARRATIVE_SPRINGENING_LTE_2024_5_3.zh: {SAY:iceburg}我就在你面前，你吼那么大声干什么？

NARRATIVE_SPRINGENING_LTE_2024_5_4.en: {SHOUT:wallnut_r}Sorry, I can't hear you with all the sound of me enjoying this breeze.
NARRATIVE_SPRINGENING_LTE_2024_5_4.zh: {SHOUT:wallnut_r}对不起，声音太大、微风太爽，我听不到你说话。

NARRATIVE_SPRINGENING_LTE_2024_6_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}User Dave, we may have a better soultion to our 'Hare' infestation.
NARRATIVE_SPRINGENING_LTE_2024_6_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}用户戴夫，我们也许有更好的办法来解决“野兔滥衍”的问题了。

NARRATIVE_SPRINGENING_LTE_2024_6_2.en: {SAY:crazydave}Already working on it, presenting carrot traps.
NARRATIVE_SPRINGENING_LTE_2024_6_2.zh: {SAY:crazydave}已经在处理了，我正在安置胡萝卜陷阱。

NARRATIVE_SPRINGENING_LTE_2024_6_3.en: {SAY:winnie}*Sigh* No User Dave, allow me to show you.
NARRATIVE_SPRINGENING_LTE_2024_6_3.zh: {SAY:winnie}*叹气* 不是，用户戴夫，请允许我向你展示一下吧。

NARRATIVE_SPRINGENING_LTE_2024_7_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie_l}{NPC_ENTER:peashooter_r}{SAY:peashooter_r}Dandelion sure helped out in the spring cleaning here.
NARRATIVE_SPRINGENING_LTE_2024_7_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie_l}{NPC_ENTER:peashooter_r}{SAY:peashooter_r}蒲公英为春季大扫除帮了不少忙啊。

NARRATIVE_SPRINGENING_LTE_2024_7_3.en: {SAY:winnie_l}After all, bunnies are afraid of lions.

NARRATIVE_SPRINGENING_LTE_2024_7_4.en: {NPC_EXIT:peashooter_r}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave_r}{SAY:crazydave_r}Let me clean out these tacos real quick.
NARRATIVE_SPRINGENING_LTE_2024_7_4.zh: {NPC_EXIT:peashooter_r}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave_r}{SAY:crazydave_r}我来扫除那些玉米卷吧，很快的。

NARRATIVE_SPRINGENING_LTE_2024_8_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss}{SAY:zomboss}Dazey Chain's gas made me choke. Only if I could recover in time.
NARRATIVE_SPRINGENING_LTE_2024_8_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss}{SAY:zomboss}迷乱雏菊束的气呛死我了。气都喘不过来。

NARRATIVE_SPRINGENING_LTE_2024_8_2.en: {NPC_ENTER:sunflower_r}{SAY:sunflower_r}You may want to recover from this flop first.
NARRATIVE_SPRINGENING_LTE_2024_8_2.zh: {NPC_ENTER:sunflower_r}{SAY:sunflower_r}建议你这次失败后喘口气消停一阵子。

NARRATIVE_SPRINGENING_LTE_2024_8_3.en: {NPC_EXIT:zomboss}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Well done plants, navigating to the next adventure.
NARRATIVE_SPRINGENING_LTE_2024_8_3.zh: {NPC_EXIT:zomboss}{NPC_EXIT:sunflower_r}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}各位植物，干得好，正在前往下一场冒险。

NARRATIVE_SPRINGENING_LTE_2025_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{NPC_ENTER:sunflower_r}{SAY:peashooter}Ah, the spring time is here! I feel amazing.

NARRATIVE_SPRINGENING_LTE_2025_1_2.en: {SAY:sunflower_r}I couldn't agree more my friend. Feels like nothing can go wrong today.
NARRATIVE_SPRINGENING_LTE_2025_1_2.zh: {SAY:sunflower_r}太同意了，我的朋友。感觉今天诸事顺心。

NARRATIVE_SPRINGENING_LTE_2025_1_5.en: {SAY:zomboss_r}The spring won't stop me and my egg-cellent plans. Muhuhaha!
NARRATIVE_SPRINGENING_LTE_2025_1_5.zh: {SAY:zomboss_r}春天阻止不了我，也阻止不了我彩蛋般精彩的计划。木呼哈哈！

NARRATIVE_SPRINGENING_LTE_2025_2_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}This isn't over! My allergies might be acting up...
NARRATIVE_SPRINGENING_LTE_2025_2_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}还没完呢！虽然我的过敏发作了…

NARRATIVE_SPRINGENING_LTE_2025_2_2.en: {SAY:zomboss_r}...but, I'll sneeze the victory next time! Achooo!
NARRATIVE_SPRINGENING_LTE_2025_2_2.zh: {SAY:zomboss_r}…但，我下次定会喷出我的胜利！阿嚏！

NARRATIVE_SPRINGENING_LTE_2025_2_4.en: {SAY:sunflower}It's the only souvenir you'll get from our lawn. Hehe.
NARRATIVE_SPRINGENING_LTE_2025_2_4.zh: {SAY:sunflower}这是你在草坪上唯一能带走的纪念品了。呵呵。

NARRATIVE_STARGATE_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydaveicon}{SAY}It appears to be some sort of gate... of stars.
NARRATIVE_STARGATE_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydaveicon}{SAY}这看上去是某种带着星星的…大门。

NARRATIVE_STARGATE_INTRO_2.zh: {EXCITED}我将它称作——超级无敌星星门！

NARRATIVE_STARGATE_INTRO_4.en: {SAY:winnieicon}The map shows you where new Stars can be earned!
NARRATIVE_STARGATE_INTRO_4.zh: {SAY:winnieicon}地图显示了何处可获取更多星星！

NARRATIVE_STARGATE_INTRO_5.en: {SAY:winnieicon}By earning enough Stars we can unlock the gate…
NARRATIVE_STARGATE_INTRO_5.zh: {SAY:winnieicon}通过收集足够多的星星，我们可以解锁这扇大门…

NARRATIVE_STARGATE_INTRO_6.zh: {EXCITED:winnieicon}然后我们就可以去另外一个时空旅行了！

NARRATIVE_STEAM_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}Long time no see, Mustache, Rusty Bolt, oh, and you!
NARRATIVE_STEAM_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}很久不见，胡子，破铁皮，哦，还有你！

NARRATIVE_STEAM_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_2.en: {SAY:zombossicon}It wasn't easy for you to come here, was it?

NARRATIVE_STEAM_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_3.en: {SAY:zombossicon}To repay your efforts, I'll let you witness the power of Industrial Age technology!
NARRATIVE_STEAM_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_3.zh: {SAY:zombossicon}为了回报你们的努力，让你们见识下工业时代科技的力量！

NARRATIVE_STEAM_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_4.en: {NPC_EXIT:zombossicon}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:crazydave}Is that the whatzit zombie... oh, Zomboard!
NARRATIVE_STEAM_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_4.zh: {NPC_EXIT:zombossicon}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:crazydave}他是那个什么僵尸...哦僵尸硕士！

NARRATIVE_STEAM_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_5.en: {TIRED:winnie}Oh Dave, I must make a necessary correction, he's Zomboss.
NARRATIVE_STEAM_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_5.zh: {TIRED:winnie}哦戴夫，我得做出必要的提醒，他是僵王博士。

NARRATIVE_STEAM_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_6.en: {EXCITED:winnie}Perhaps we should set a timer to calculate how long he can hold up this time.
NARRATIVE_STEAM_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_6.zh: {EXCITED:winnie}或许我们该掐个表，计算一下这次他能够撑多久。

NARRATIVE_STEAM_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_2.en: {SAY:zombossicon}But you don't realize... something terrible is brewing!
NARRATIVE_STEAM_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_2.zh: {SAY:zombossicon}但是你不知道，一些可怕的事情正在发生！

NARRATIVE_STEAM_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_3.en: {SAY:zombossicon}Bwahahaha! Bask in your victory while you can——soon you'll meet... an UPGRADE!
NARRATIVE_STEAM_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_3.zh: {SAY:zombossicon}哈哈哈哈哈，继续沉浸在胜利的喜悦中吧，很快，你会见识到一些“新东西”！

NARRATIVE_STEAM_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_4.en: {NPC_EXIT:zombossicon}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:crazydave}He really knows how to put on a show, huh? Hahaha!
NARRATIVE_STEAM_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_4.zh: {NPC_EXIT:zombossicon}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:crazydave}他说的还蛮唬人的，哈哈哈哈。

NARRATIVE_STEAM_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_5.en: {TIRED:winnie}There's 87.3% statistically significant probability he's developing new weapons. Caution advised.
NARRATIVE_STEAM_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_5.zh: {TIRED:winnie}或许他真的在研究些可怕的东西，我们要小心。

NARRATIVE_STICKYBOMBRICE_EQ_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Plant Stickybomb Rice to lob sticky rice bombs.
NARRATIVE_STICKYBOMBRICE_EQ_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}种植黏弹糯米，投掷糯米黏弹。

NARRATIVE_STORE_EGYPT_COINS_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnieicon}{SAY}Take these gems and buy some coins!
NARRATIVE_STORE_EGYPT_COINS_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnieicon}{SAY}收下这些钻石来买些金币吧！

NARRATIVE_STORE_EGYPT_PINATA_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnieicon}{SAY}The Ancient Egypt piñata might have what we're looking for. Take these gems and buy one!
NARRATIVE_STORE_EGYPT_PINATA_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnieicon}{SAY}这个上古埃及彩陶应该正好有我们想要找的东西！收下这些钻石去买一个吧！

NARRATIVE_STORE_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydaveicon}{PLAYFUL}Nice work! Hey Penny, what does this button do?
NARRATIVE_STORE_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydaveicon}{PLAYFUL}干得漂亮！对了，潘妮！这个按钮有什么用呢？

NARRATIVE_STORE_INTRO_2.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnieicon}{EXCITED}Most interesting, there's special items in there!
NARRATIVE_STORE_INTRO_2.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnieicon}{EXCITED}最有意思的是，里面还有许多特殊物品！

NARRATIVE_STORE_MORE_GEMS_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydaveicon}{SAY}Wowsers! That's node's got a skull on it! What could it mean?
NARRATIVE_STORE_MORE_GEMS_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnieicon}{SAY}想要更多彩陶吗？在时间结束之前完成旅行日志的任务。每天都有新任务出现哦！

NARRATIVE_STORE_OPEN_PINATAS_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydaveicon}{SAY}I want to make Iceberg Lettuce freeze fire more better-er, Penny!
NARRATIVE_STORE_OPEN_PINATAS_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydaveicon}{SAY}想开更多的彩陶吗？看看商店吧！

NARRATIVE_STORE_OPEN_PINATAS_2.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnieicon}{SAY}We can find seed packets in piñatas in the Store.
NARRATIVE_STORE_OPEN_PINATAS_2.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnieicon}{SAY}我们能在商店中找到含有种子包的彩陶。

NARRATIVE_STRAWBURST_LOD_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}爆裂草莓的果实炸弹会随着时间长大。

NARRATIVE_STUNION_EQ_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Stunions will breathe a cloud of stunning gas on nearby zombies.
NARRATIVE_STUNION_EQ_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}眩晕洋葱可以呼出口臭雾气来让前面一堆僵尸眩晕。

NARRATIVE_SUMMERNIGHTS_LTE_2022_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:sunflower}{NPC_ENTER:wallnut_r}{SAY:sunflower}夏天到了，坚果墙！以后再也不用上学了！

NARRATIVE_SUMMERNIGHTS_LTE_2022_1_4.en: {SAY:sunflower}No more school? That way lies MADNESS!
NARRATIVE_SUMMERNIGHTS_LTE_2022_1_4.zh: {SAY:sunflower}不去上学？那就只有“疯”路一条了！

NARRATIVE_SUMMERNIGHTS_LTE_2022_2_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:sunflower_r}{SAY:crazydave}Hey-oh, Sunny! I hear zombie-fightin' school is out for summer.
NARRATIVE_SUMMERNIGHTS_LTE_2022_2_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:sunflower_r}{SAY:crazydave}你好哇，小葵！听说你们打僵尸学校放暑假啦？

NARRATIVE_SUMMERNIGHTS_LTE_2022_2_2.en: {SAY:crazydave}Wanna open a new taco truck with me?
NARRATIVE_SUMMERNIGHTS_LTE_2022_2_2.zh: {SAY:crazydave}想和我开一辆新的美食车吗？

NARRATIVE_SUMMERNIGHTS_LTE_2022_3_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:sunflower}{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}Sunflower! Have you not heard? Summer is slack time.
NARRATIVE_SUMMERNIGHTS_LTE_2022_3_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:sunflower}{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}向日葵！你不知道吗？暑假就是该休息嘛。

NARRATIVE_SUMMERNIGHTS_LTE_2022_3_2.en: {SAY:zombossicon}Why toil so hard powering an entire infantry? Why not take a break?
NARRATIVE_SUMMERNIGHTS_LTE_2022_3_2.zh: {SAY:zombossicon}何苦在这里为战场提供能源呢？休息一下吧？

NARRATIVE_SUMMERNIGHTS_LTE_2022_3_4.en: {SAY:sunflower}You've given me a lot to consider, Mr. Zomboss.
NARRATIVE_SUMMERNIGHTS_LTE_2022_3_4.zh: {SAY:sunflower}你让我思考了很多，僵王先生。

NARRATIVE_SUMMERNIGHTS_LTE_2022_3_5.zh: {SAY:sunflower}主要是在想你说的话有多么可笑！

NARRATIVE_SUMMERNIGHTS_LTE_2022_4_2.en: {SAY:winnie}Correct. How are you enjoying Summer Nights, Wall-nut?
NARRATIVE_SUMMERNIGHTS_LTE_2022_4_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}是的。仲夏夜过得开心吗，坚果墙？

NARRATIVE_SUMMERNIGHTS_LTE_2022_5_2.en: {SAY:sunflower}So much free time! I don't know what to do!
NARRATIVE_SUMMERNIGHTS_LTE_2022_5_2.zh: {SAY:sunflower}还有这么多空闲时间！我都不知道玩什么了！

NARRATIVE_SUMMERNIGHTS_LTE_2022_5_4.en: {SAY:sunflower}All I know for sure is I don't want to open a taco truck!
NARRATIVE_SUMMERNIGHTS_LTE_2022_5_4.zh: {SAY:sunflower}不过我唯一知道的就是我不想开美食车！

NARRATIVE_SUMMERNIGHTS_LTE_2022_6_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:sunflower}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:sunflower}Penny, of all the people and things I know, you're the wisest!
NARRATIVE_SUMMERNIGHTS_LTE_2022_6_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:sunflower}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:sunflower}潘妮，你是我认识的所有人和物中最聪明的那个！

NARRATIVE_SUMMERNIGHTS_LTE_2022_6_2.en: {SAY:sunflower}How should I fill my free time?
NARRATIVE_SUMMERNIGHTS_LTE_2022_6_2.zh: {SAY:sunflower}你能告诉我——我这么多的空余时间该怎么用吗？

NARRATIVE_SUMMERNIGHTS_LTE_2022_6_3.en: {SAY:winnie}With what you love, of course. Always.
NARRATIVE_SUMMERNIGHTS_LTE_2022_6_3.zh: {SAY:winnie}当然是去做你喜欢的事情了。

NARRATIVE_SUMMERNIGHTS_LTE_2022_7_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:sunflower}{NPC_ENTER:wallnut_r}{SAY:sunflower}... and then I realized my favorite way to spend time is DEFEATING ZOMBIES!
NARRATIVE_SUMMERNIGHTS_LTE_2022_7_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:sunflower}{NPC_ENTER:wallnut_r}{SAY:sunflower}...随后我才意识到，我最喜欢做的事情就是击败僵尸！

NARRATIVE_SUMMERNIGHTS_LTE_2023_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:winnie}User Dave, my GPS indicates we are in the desert.
NARRATIVE_SUMMERNIGHTS_LTE_2023_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:winnie}用户戴夫，我的 GPS 表明，我们现在正处于沙漠中。

NARRATIVE_SUMMERNIGHTS_LTE_2023_1_2.en: {SAY:crazydave}Uh oh! This desert is so HOT! Did we bring water?!
NARRATIVE_SUMMERNIGHTS_LTE_2023_1_2.zh: {SAY:crazydave}啊哦！沙漠好热啊！我们有带水吗？！

NARRATIVE_SUMMERNIGHTS_LTE_2023_2_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:winnie}Sensors indicate water tank is dangerously low. Locating water sources.
NARRATIVE_SUMMERNIGHTS_LTE_2023_2_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:winnie}我的传感器表明水箱水位过低，十分危险。正在寻找水源。

NARRATIVE_SUMMERNIGHTS_LTE_2023_2_2.en: {SAY:crazydave}While you’re at it could you locate my taco?
NARRATIVE_SUMMERNIGHTS_LTE_2023_2_2.zh: {SAY:crazydave}反正你都在找了，能顺便帮我看看玉米卷在哪儿吗？

NARRATIVE_SUMMERNIGHTS_LTE_2023_3_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:crazydave}The existence of salty water can only mean one thing... A body of sweet water!
NARRATIVE_SUMMERNIGHTS_LTE_2023_3_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:crazydave}咸水的存在只可能能意味着一件事……有淡水源！

NARRATIVE_SUMMERNIGHTS_LTE_2023_3_2.en: {SAY:winnie}My sensors cannot differentiate between salt and sweet water.
NARRATIVE_SUMMERNIGHTS_LTE_2023_3_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}我的传感器无法区别咸水和淡水。

NARRATIVE_SUMMERNIGHTS_LTE_2023_4_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:crazydave}哇，那些海盗看起来很渴呃呃呃啊。

NARRATIVE_SUMMERNIGHTS_LTE_2023_4_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}探测到模仿口音的双关。哈。哈。哈

NARRATIVE_SUMMERNIGHTS_LTE_2023_4_3.en: {SAY:crazydave} I don’t remember installing the pun detector... or how we ended up at the beach!
NARRATIVE_SUMMERNIGHTS_LTE_2023_4_3.zh: {SAY:crazydave}我怎么不记得有安装双关探测器……也不记得我们是怎么跑到海滩上来的了！

NARRATIVE_SUMMERNIGHTS_LTE_2023_5_2.en: {SAY:zomboss} Nooo! The beach zombies were my crowning achievement.
NARRATIVE_SUMMERNIGHTS_LTE_2023_5_2.zh: {SAY:zomboss} 不！海滩僵尸是我最大的成就。

NARRATIVE_SUMMERNIGHTS_LTE_2023_6_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:winnie}User Dave, I’m receiving a transmission. It’s an invitation to a party!
NARRATIVE_SUMMERNIGHTS_LTE_2023_6_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:winnie}用户戴夫，我收到一条传输信息。是一则派对邀请！

NARRATIVE_SUMMERNIGHTS_LTE_2023_6_2.en: {SAY:crazydave}PARTY?! Why didnt you say so sooner? I wonder what there is to eat...
NARRATIVE_SUMMERNIGHTS_LTE_2023_6_2.zh: {SAY:crazydave}派对？！ 你怎么不早说？不知道那儿有什么好吃的…

NARRATIVE_SUMMERNIGHTS_LTE_2023_6_3.en: {SAY:winnie}Setting a course for the party destination. Standby.
NARRATIVE_SUMMERNIGHTS_LTE_2023_6_3.zh: {SAY:winnie}正在设置前往派对目的地的路线。待机中。

NARRATIVE_SUMMERNIGHTS_LTE_2023_7_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:winnie}Based on my calculations this summer party was a success.
NARRATIVE_SUMMERNIGHTS_LTE_2023_7_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:winnie}根据我的计算，这场夏日派对很成功。

NARRATIVE_SUMMERNIGHTS_LTE_2023_7_2.en: {SAY:crazydave}Based on my observations, I'd say there was no taco.
NARRATIVE_SUMMERNIGHTS_LTE_2023_7_2.zh: {SAY:crazydave}根据我的观察，我想说根本没有炸玉米卷。

NARRATIVE_SUMMERNIGHTS_LTE_2023_7_3.zh: {SAY:winnie}正在为下一次冒险重新校准！

NARRATIVE_SUMMERNIGHTS_LTE_2024_1_3.en: {SAY:sunflower}At this rate I’m going to wilt.

NARRATIVE_SUMMERNIGHTS_LTE_2024_1_4.en: {NPC_EXIT:wallnut_r}{NPC_EXIT:sunflower}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}Muhahaha! You Fools. This weather opens up the perfect opportunity.
NARRATIVE_SUMMERNIGHTS_LTE_2024_1_4.zh: {NPC_EXIT:wallnut_r}{NPC_EXIT:sunflower}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}木哈哈哈！你们这群傻瓜。这样的天气，犹如上帝为我开的一扇窗。

NARRATIVE_SUMMERNIGHTS_LTE_2024_2_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}我诅咒你们这帮植物。你们给我记住了。

NARRATIVE_SUMMERNIGHTS_LTE_2024_2_2.en: {SAY:zomboss_r}I’ll be back and next time.. My inventions will... Muwahahaha!.
NARRATIVE_SUMMERNIGHTS_LTE_2024_2_2.zh: {SAY:zomboss_r}我一定会回来的…我的发明会…木哇哈哈哈！

NARRATIVE_SUMMERNIGHTS_LTE_2024_2_5.zh: {SAY:peashooter}没错坚果墙。僵王博士，也不在话下！

NARRATIVE_SUMMERNIGHTS_LTE_2024_2_6.en: {SAY:peashooter}I would call that a good Summer Nights work.

NARRATIVE_SUMMERNIGHTS_LTE_A_1_3.en: {SAY:winnie}Excessive temperature detected. Shutting down non-critical systems.
NARRATIVE_SUMMERNIGHTS_LTE_A_1_3.zh: {SAY:winnie}探测到过高温度。正在关闭不必要的系统。

NARRATIVE_SUMMERNIGHTS_LTE_A_1_5.en: {SAY:peashooter}We should stand guard during this malfunction!
NARRATIVE_SUMMERNIGHTS_LTE_A_1_5.zh: {SAY:peashooter}自检的时候我们可不能掉以轻心！

NARRATIVE_SUMMERNIGHTS_LTE_A_2_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}System errors detected and corrected. All systems restored.
NARRATIVE_SUMMERNIGHTS_LTE_A_2_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}已检测到系统错误并修正。所有系统已恢复。

NARRATIVE_SUMMERNIGHTS_LTE_A_2_3.en: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss}{SAY:zomboss}Curse you! Just wait until I debut my brand new invention!
NARRATIVE_SUMMERNIGHTS_LTE_A_2_3.zh: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss}{SAY:zomboss}诅咒你们！等着看我的全新发明吧！

NARRATIVE_SUMMERNIGHTS_LTE_A_2_4.en: {NPC_EXIT:zomboss}{NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:peashooter}We’ll be ready for you Zomboss and whatever invention you can come up with.
NARRATIVE_SUMMERNIGHTS_LTE_A_2_4.zh: {NPC_EXIT:zomboss}{NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:peashooter}无论你发明什么，我们都会从容应对的，僵王。

NARRATIVE_SUNFLOWER_WALLNUT_EVENT_3.en: {SAY:wallnut}I don't know about the new event!

NARRATIVE_SUNFLOWER_WALLNUT_EVENT_4.zh: {SAY:wallnut}那个叫“生日庆典限时活动“的活动！

NARRATIVE_SUNFLOWER_WALLNUT_EVENT_5.en: {SAY:wallnut}The one that just started and goes for 15 days!
NARRATIVE_SUNFLOWER_WALLNUT_EVENT_5.zh: {SAY:wallnut}那个刚刚开始，15 天后就结束的活动！

NARRATIVE_SUNFLOWER_WALLNUT_EVENT_6.en: {SAY:wallnut}With all the cool prizes and rewards!
NARRATIVE_SUNFLOWER_WALLNUT_EVENT_6.zh: {SAY:wallnut}那个可以赢取超酷奖品和奖励的活动！

NARRATIVE_TELEPORTATOMINE_EQ_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}种植传送土豆地雷, 先把僵尸传送过来, 再把他们全部炸掉!
NARRATIVE_TELEPORTATOMINE_EQ_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}种植传送土豆地雷，先把僵尸传送过来，再把他们全部炸掉！

NARRATIVE_TEST_01_01.en: this is a test string bah

NARRATIVE_TEST_3.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}植物养料富含维生素和矿物质.
NARRATIVE_TEST_3.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}叶绿素富含维生素和矿物质。

NARRATIVE_TEST_4.en: {PLAYFUL:winnie}这是一顿完美早餐必不可少的一部分.
NARRATIVE_TEST_4.zh: {PLAYFUL:winnie}这是一顿完美早餐必不可少的一部分。

NARRATIVE_TIGERGRASS_EQ_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Plant Tiger Grass to spawn aggressive grass tigers.
NARRATIVE_TIGERGRASS_EQ_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}种植虎草，召唤草虎攻击僵尸。

NARRATIVE_TOMBASTIC_LTE_2025_1_2.en: {SAY:zomboss_r}These gravestones are not just decor, but also zombie factories!
NARRATIVE_TOMBASTIC_LTE_2025_1_2.zh: {SAY:zomboss_r}这些墓碑不只是诱饵，还是僵尸工厂！

NARRATIVE_TOMBASTIC_LTE_2025_1_4.en: {SAY:peashooter}Do you have a recycling plan for all these stones?
NARRATIVE_TOMBASTIC_LTE_2025_1_4.zh: {SAY:peashooter}你真不打算回收一下这些石头吗?

NARRATIVE_TOMBASTIC_LTE_2025_1_5.en: {SAY:zomboss_r}Enough prattle! My gravestones will flood your lawn with zombies...
NARRATIVE_TOMBASTIC_LTE_2025_1_5.zh: {SAY:zomboss_r}别废话了！不等你们说出“脑子”两个字…

NARRATIVE_TOMBASTIC_LTE_2025_1_6.zh: {SAY:zomboss_r}…我的墓碑，就将让尸海淹没你们的草坪。

NARRATIVE_TOMBASTIC_LTE_2025_2_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}不可能！我的胜利明明万无一失。

NARRATIVE_TOMBASTIC_LTE_2025_2_2.en: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:peashooter}Your flawless triumph crumbled like your gravestones.
NARRATIVE_TOMBASTIC_LTE_2025_2_2.zh: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:peashooter}你万无一失的胜利像你的墓碑一样滚落一地了。

NARRATIVE_TOMBASTIC_LTE_2025_2_3.en: {NPC_EXIT:peashooter}{NPC_ENTER:sunflower}{SAY:sunflower}Looks like your plans are dead and buried, Zomboss.
NARRATIVE_TOMBASTIC_LTE_2025_2_3.zh: {NPC_EXIT:peashooter}{NPC_ENTER:sunflower}{SAY:sunflower}看起来你的计划停止呼吸，入葬地底了，僵王。

NARRATIVE_TOMBASTIC_LTE_2025_2_4.en: {SAY:zomboss_r}You'll rue the day, plants! Next time, I shall make you pay.
NARRATIVE_TOMBASTIC_LTE_2025_2_4.zh: {SAY:zomboss_r}今天算你们走运，植物！下次，我要让你们付出代价。

NARRATIVE_TOMBASTIC_LTE_A_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{NPC_ENTER:wallnut_r}{SAY:peashooter}Finally we've made it to this newly discovered tomb.
NARRATIVE_TOMBASTIC_LTE_A_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{NPC_ENTER:wallnut_r}{SAY:peashooter}终于赶到这块新发掘到的坟墓了。

NARRATIVE_TOMBASTIC_LTE_A_1_2.en: {SAY:wallnut_r}I wonder what treasures we will find in there?
NARRATIVE_TOMBASTIC_LTE_A_1_2.zh: {SAY:wallnut_r}不知道我们能在里面找到什么宝藏？

NARRATIVE_TOMBASTIC_LTE_A_1_3.en: {NPC_EXIT:wallnut_r}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}You fools again! This treasure is Mine! You lot can go home!
NARRATIVE_TOMBASTIC_LTE_A_1_3.zh: {NPC_EXIT:wallnut_r}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}又是你们这群傻瓜！宝藏是我的！尔辈回自己家去吧！

NARRATIVE_TOMBASTIC_LTE_A_1_6.en: {SHOUT:peashooter}We can't let zomboss beat us to the treasure. Let's go!!
NARRATIVE_TOMBASTIC_LTE_A_1_6.zh: {SHOUT:peashooter}不能让僵王先于我们找到宝藏！出发吧!!

NARRATIVE_TOMBASTIC_LTE_A_2_2.en: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:peashooter}Give it up Zomboss, we won't let you get the treasure.
NARRATIVE_TOMBASTIC_LTE_A_2_2.zh: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:peashooter}放弃吧僵王，我们是不会让你拿到宝藏的。

NARRATIVE_TOMBASTIC_LTE_A_2_3.en: {NPC_EXIT:peashooter}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:crazydave}Mmmm.. Is that a taco that I smell?
NARRATIVE_TOMBASTIC_LTE_A_2_3.zh: {NPC_EXIT:peashooter}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:crazydave}嗯…我是不是闻到玉米卷的味道了？

NARRATIVE_TOMBASTIC_LTE_A_2_4.en: {SAY:zomboss_r}Muhahaha! Well! We will see who will have the last laugh next time!
NARRATIVE_TOMBASTIC_LTE_A_2_4.zh: {SAY:zomboss_r}木哈哈哈！行啊！下次，看谁笑到最后！

NARRATIVE_TOMBTANGLER_LTE_2022_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:sunflower}{SAY:sunflower}The sun is shining! Zomboss must be up to his nefarious tricks again.
NARRATIVE_TOMBTANGLER_LTE_2022_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:sunflower}{SAY:sunflower}真是艳阳高照啊！僵王博士肯定又在琢磨他的小把戏了。

NARRATIVE_TOMBTANGLER_LTE_2022_1_2.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Analysis shows that the lawn has been filled with gravestones.
NARRATIVE_TOMBTANGLER_LTE_2022_1_2.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}分析表明，现在草坪上布满了墓碑。

NARRATIVE_TOMBTANGLER_LTE_2022_1_3.en: {NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_EXIT:sunflower}{NPC_ENTER:tombtangler}{SAY:tombtangler}I'm Tomb Tangler. Tangles if you're friendly. I hear you have a gravestone problem.
NARRATIVE_TOMBTANGLER_LTE_2022_1_3.zh: {NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_EXIT:sunflower}{NPC_ENTER:tombtangler}{SAY:tombtangler}我是坟墓缠绕者。只要你是好人，我就不会缠着你。听说这些墓碑让你们很头疼。

NARRATIVE_TOMBTANGLER_LTE_2022_2_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:sunflower}{NPC_ENTER:tombtangler_r}{SAY:sunflower}Tomb Tangler! We couldn't have done it without you!
NARRATIVE_TOMBTANGLER_LTE_2022_2_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:sunflower}{NPC_ENTER:tombtangler_r}{SAY:sunflower}坟墓缠绕者！没有你，我们可怎么办呀！

NARRATIVE_TOMBTANGLER_LTE_2022_2_2.zh: {SAY:tombtangler_r}谢谢你的“缠”美，向日葵。没事儿的。

NARRATIVE_TOMBTANGLER_LTE_2022_3_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:chilibean}{SAY:chilibean}Why are there so many gravestones? It's making my tummy rumble!
NARRATIVE_TOMBTANGLER_LTE_2022_3_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:chilibean}{SAY:chilibean}怎么这么多墓碑呀？整得我肚子都咕咕叫了！

NARRATIVE_TOMBTANGLER_LTE_2022_4_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}How are you beating my ghastly gravestone ground gamble?!
NARRATIVE_TOMBTANGLER_LTE_2022_4_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}你们是怎么破解我那精心设计、不寒而栗、尸居余气的墓碑诡计的？！

NARRATIVE_TOMBTANGLER_LTE_2022_5_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}Time to turn up the terrible tactics!
NARRATIVE_TOMBTANGLER_LTE_2022_5_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}是时候拿出那个可怕的战术了！

NARRATIVE_TOMBTANGLER_LTE_2022_5_2.en: {NPC_EXIT:zombossicon}{NPC_ENTER:tombtangler}{SAY:tombtangler}We got this team! I’ll tangle the gravestones!
NARRATIVE_TOMBTANGLER_LTE_2022_5_2.zh: {NPC_EXIT:zombossicon}{NPC_ENTER:tombtangler}{SAY:tombtangler}没事儿的，队友们！我去缠住那些墓碑！

NARRATIVE_TOMBTANGLER_LTE_2022_5_4.en: {NPC_EXIT:iceburg_r}{SAY:chilibean}Chili Bean: I don’t feel so good.

NARRATIVE_TOMBTANGLER_LTE_2022_6_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:chilibean}{NPC_ENTER:iceburg_r}{SAY:chilibean}Are we done yet? Did we win?

NARRATIVE_TOMBTANGLER_LTE_2022_7_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}You plants are always up to something!

NARRATIVE_TOMBTANGLER_LTE_2022_8_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}My villain support group said this would work!
NARRATIVE_TOMBTANGLER_LTE_2022_8_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}我的邪恶支持小组说这个办法肯定没问题！

NARRATIVE_TOMBTANGLER_LTE_2022_8_2.zh: {NPC_EXIT:zombossicon}{NPC_ENTER:sunflower}{NPC_ENTER:iceburg_r}{SAY:sunflower}你们才不是缠绕小分队的对手！

NARRATIVE_TOMBTANGLER_LTE_2022_8_7.zh: {SAY:chilibean_r}行吧，冰冻生菜也帮了一些忙。

NARRATIVE_TOMBTANGLER_LTE_2022_8_8.zh: {NPC_EXIT:tombtangler}{NPC_EXIT:chilibean_r}{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}你们……还有你们的脑子，都将属于我！

NARRATIVE_TOWER_100_OUTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}The temporal paradox has ended, and time is flowing correctly once again.
NARRATIVE_TOWER_100_OUTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}时间悖论结束了，时间开始正确流逝。

NARRATIVE_TOWER_100_OUTRO_2.en: {EXCITED:crazydave}I can already smell the aroma of sun waffles!
NARRATIVE_TOWER_100_OUTRO_2.zh: {EXCITED:crazydave}我闻到了太阳华夫饼的味道！

NARRATIVE_TOWER_100_OUTRO_3.en: {SAY:winnie}This plant seems to have been here for ages.
NARRATIVE_TOWER_100_OUTRO_3.zh: {SAY:winnie}这株植物似乎在这儿存在了很久。

NARRATIVE_TOWER_100_OUTRO_4.en: {SAY:winnie}The data indicates that it shares the same spacetime as certain plants from other dimensions.
NARRATIVE_TOWER_100_OUTRO_4.zh: {SAY:winnie}数据显示，它跟某些来自其他时空的植物是同一时空。

NARRATIVE_TOWER_100_OUTRO_5.en: {SAY:winnie}Perhaps we can take it away from here.
NARRATIVE_TOWER_100_OUTRO_5.zh: {SAY:winnie}我们或许可以带它离开这个地方。

NARRATIVE_TOWER_100_OUTRO_6.en: {EXCITED:crazydave}I'm all set to enjoy tomorrow's waffles!
NARRATIVE_TOWER_100_OUTRO_6.zh: {EXCITED:crazydave}我已经准备好吃明天的华夫饼了！

NARRATIVE_TOWER_11_OUTRO_2.en: {SAY:crazydave}The foolish antics of today's zombies have been replicated to the letter.
NARRATIVE_TOWER_11_OUTRO_2.zh: {SAY:crazydave}今天的僵尸的愚蠢的行为绝对重复了。

NARRATIVE_TOWER_11_OUTRO_3.en: {SAY:winnie}This time your intuition was spot on, User Dave.
NARRATIVE_TOWER_11_OUTRO_3.zh: {SAY:winnie}这次你的直觉没错，用户戴夫。

NARRATIVE_TOWER_11_OUTRO_4.en: {SAY:winnie}The data indicates that we've been thrown back 10 days.
NARRATIVE_TOWER_11_OUTRO_4.zh: {SAY:winnie}数据显示我们又回到了 10 天前。

NARRATIVE_TOWER_11_OUTRO_5.en: {SAY:winnie}And the environment here is growing increasingly hostile.
NARRATIVE_TOWER_11_OUTRO_5.zh: {SAY:winnie}并且这里的环境正在变得更加恶劣。

NARRATIVE_TOWER_11_OUTRO_6.en: {SAY:crazydave}Tomorrow is yesterday, the past is the future, and plants are zombies.
NARRATIVE_TOWER_11_OUTRO_6.zh: {SAY:crazydave}明天是昨天，过去是未来，叉子是勺子。

NARRATIVE_TOWER_1_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:crazydave}This place feels as familiar as a taco, yet as mysterious as "popular wisdom."
NARRATIVE_TOWER_1_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:crazydave}我感觉这里像玉米卷一样熟悉，又像“流行智慧”一样陌生。

NARRATIVE_TOWER_1_INTRO_3.en: {TIRED:winnie}I believe we've become trapped in a temporal paradox, User Dave.
NARRATIVE_TOWER_1_INTRO_3.zh: {TIRED:winnie}我认为我们陷入了一种时间悖论之中，用户戴夫。

NARRATIVE_TOWER_1_INTRO_4.en: {SAY:crazydave}Then all I need to do is build one more…

NARRATIVE_TOWER_1_INTRO_6.zh: {EXCITED:crazydave}我就可以再吃到一份玉米卷！

NARRATIVE_TOWER_1_INTRO_7.en: {SAY:winnie}My data shows that the risk of this action is 99.99999999903%.
NARRATIVE_TOWER_1_INTRO_7.zh: {SAY:winnie}我的数据显示该行为的危险性为 99.99999999903%。
