NARRATIVE_TOWER_50_OUTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}The □th cycle has come to an end.

NARRATIVE_TOWER_50_OUTRO_2.en: {SAY:winnie}The environment is now safer than before, and the system has never been affected by time.
NARRATIVE_TOWER_50_OUTRO_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}环境比之前更加安全，系统从来没有受到过时间影响。

NARRATIVE_TOWER_50_OUTRO_3.en: {SAY:crazydave}Penny, when was the last time I checked the status of your system components?
NARRATIVE_TOWER_50_OUTRO_3.zh: {SAY:crazydave}潘妮，我上次检查你的系统部件状况的时候是啥时候？

NARRATIVE_TUMBLEWEED_EQ_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Plant Tumbleweeds anywhere to send them rolling down the lane at zombies.
NARRATIVE_TUMBLEWEED_EQ_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}在任意位置种下风滚草，让他们沿着草坪滚向僵尸。

NARRATIVE_TURKEYPULT_EQ_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Plant Turkey-pults to lob tofu turkeys at zombies. Plant 2 or more per row to overwhelm zombies!
NARRATIVE_TURKEYPULT_EQ_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}种植火鸡投手，向僵尸投掷豆腐火鸡。种植 2 个以上，更能把它们压倒在鸡潮里！

NARRATIVE_TUTORIAL_PLANTLEVELS_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:crazydave}看啊！一株豌豆射手与一株双发豌豆！

NARRATIVE_TUTORIAL_PLANTLEVELS_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:crazydave}I sure hope no Buckethead Zombie attacks that poor lil' Peashooter!
NARRATIVE_TUTORIAL_PLANTLEVELS_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:crazydave}我真希望没有铁桶僵尸会去攻击那棵可怜的豌豆射手！

NARRATIVE_TUTORIAL_PLANTLEVELS_INTRO_4.zh: {SAY:winnie}这株豌豆射手已经到达最高等级了。

NARRATIVE_TUTORIAL_PLANTLEVELS_INTRO_6.en: {SAY:winnie}At its current level, it is even stronger than a regular Repeater.
NARRATIVE_TUTORIAL_PLANTLEVELS_INTRO_6.zh: {SAY:winnie}在这个等级下，它比那株平凡的双发豌豆强太多了。

NARRATIVE_ULTOMATO_EQ_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Plant Ultomatos on top of themselves to mutate them up from green to yellow to red!
NARRATIVE_ULTOMATO_EQ_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}把终极番茄种在它们自己上面，让它们从绿到黄，再从黄到红吧！

NARRATIVE_UNIVERSE_INTRO_TUTORIALNOT_8.zh: {SAY:winnieicon}他会为你带来引导、奖励与更多的可能性！

NARRATIVE_UNIVERSE_INTRO_TUTORIAL_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydaveicon}{EXCITED}Penny! The Pirate Key went all flooey! Where are we?
NARRATIVE_UNIVERSE_INTRO_TUTORIAL_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydaveicon}{EXCITED}好消息！潘妮发现了能找到玉米卷的地图！

NARRATIVE_UNIVERSE_INTRO_TUTORIAL_2.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnieicon}{TIRED}不，这里有一张时空地图，指向我们能探索的世界。

NARRATIVE_UNIVERSE_INTRO_TUTORIAL_3.zh: {EXCITED:crazydaveicon}木乃伊、海盗还有牛仔，我滴天！

NARRATIVE_UNIVERSE_INTRO_TUTORIAL_4.en: {SAY:winnieicon}We are outside of time. Between Ancient Egypt and the Pirate Seas.
NARRATIVE_UNIVERSE_INTRO_TUTORIAL_4.zh: {SAY:crazydave}我们需要一些方法来探索其它世界。

NARRATIVE_UNIVERSE_INTRO_TUTORIAL_5.zh: {SAY:winnieicon}但现在我们得在上古埃及继续前进了！

NARRATIVE_UNIVERSE_INTRO_TUTORIAL_6.en: {SAY:winnieicon}We must brave the Pirate Seas, User Dave.
NARRATIVE_UNIVERSE_INTRO_TUTORIAL_6.zh: {SAY:winnieicon}我们必须勇敢面对海盗港湾，用户戴夫。

NARRATIVE_UNIVERSE_INTRO_TUTORIAL_7.en: {SAY:crazydaveicon}I'll brave ANYTHING for taco treasure! Let's go!
NARRATIVE_UNIVERSE_INTRO_TUTORIAL_7.zh: {SAY:crazydaveicon}为了我那宝贵的玉米卷，我愿勇敢面对一切！出发吧！

NARRATIVE_VALENBRAINZ_LTE_2025_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:sunflower}{SAY:sunflower}It's Valentine's Day! A perfect time to celebrate with the ones who matter most!
NARRATIVE_VALENBRAINZ_LTE_2025_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:sunflower}{SAY:sunflower}情人节到了！最适合与最重要的人一同庆祝！

NARRATIVE_VALENBRAINZ_LTE_2025_1_2.en: {NPC_EXIT:sunflower}{NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:peashooter}Yeah! We even got the dance floor all set up.

NARRATIVE_VALENBRAINZ_LTE_2025_1_4.en: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}There will be no dancing or celebrating!

NARRATIVE_VALENBRAINZ_LTE_2025_1_5.en: {SHOUT:zomboss_r}Prepare for the greatest heartbreak of all...your demise!!!
NARRATIVE_VALENBRAINZ_LTE_2025_1_5.zh: {SHOUT:zomboss_r}准备好接受最心碎的时刻吧——自己的灭亡!!!

NARRATIVE_VALENBRAINZ_LTE_2025_2_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}Blast it all! Love cannot shield you forever!
NARRATIVE_VALENBRAINZ_LTE_2025_2_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}真该死！爱是不可能永远保护你们的。

NARRATIVE_VALENBRAINZ_LTE_2025_2_2.en: {SHOUT:zomboss_r}I will return...and next time, it will be MY party!
NARRATIVE_VALENBRAINZ_LTE_2025_2_2.zh: {SHOUT:zomboss_r}我会回来的……而下次，这片土地上将是我的派对！

NARRATIVE_VALENBRAINZ_LTE_2025_2_3.en: {SAY:peashooter}And we'll be happy to crash that party!

NARRATIVE_VALENBRAINZ_LTE_2025_2_4.en: {NPC_EXIT:zomboss_r}{NPC_EXIT:peashooter}{NPC_ENTER:sunflower}{SAY:sunflower}I'm just happy we got some fireworks on Valentine's Day!

NARRATIVE_VASEBREAKER_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}A lawn of vases is like a box of chocolates.
NARRATIVE_VASEBREAKER_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}草地上的一只只花瓶如同一盒盒巧克力。

NARRATIVE_VASEBREAKER_INTRO_2.en: {EXCITED:crazydave}Some are awesome! Others taste downright ugly!
NARRATIVE_VASEBREAKER_INTRO_2.zh: {EXCITED:crazydave}有些好吃至极，但有些则让人反胃！

NARRATIVE_VASEBREAKER_INTRO_3.en: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}But all vases are much harder on your teeth!
NARRATIVE_VASEBREAKER_INTRO_3.zh: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}当然啦，你可别真的用牙啃那些花瓶！

NARRATIVE_VASEBREAKER_INTRO_4.en: {SAY:winnie}Be careful with how fast you break vases.
NARRATIVE_VASEBREAKER_INTRO_4.zh: {SAY:winnie}注意自己在敲花瓶时的速度。

NARRATIVE_VASEBREAKER_INTRO_5.en: {EXCITED:winnie}You might end up with more ugly than you can handle.
NARRATIVE_VASEBREAKER_INTRO_5.zh: {EXCITED:winnie}敲得太快，可能让你最后难以收场。

NARRATIVE_VETERAN_WARNING_10.en: {SAY:winnie}It is not necessary to shout, User Dave.
NARRATIVE_VETERAN_WARNING_10.zh: {SAY:winnie}没有必要大喊大叫的，用户戴夫。

NARRATIVE_VETERAN_WARNING_3.en: {SAY:crazydave}Should we mention these post-Zomboss nodes are REALLY difficult?
NARRATIVE_VETERAN_WARNING_3.zh: {SAY:crazydave}我们是否应该提一下，后面的拓展关卡会极其困难？

NARRATIVE_VETERAN_WARNING_4.en: {SAY:crazydave}And that it would be CRAAAA-ZY to try them without powerful plants?
NARRATIVE_VETERAN_WARNING_4.zh: {SAY:crazydave}并且，没有强力植物就去挑战后面的关卡难道不是疯了吗？

NARRATIVE_VETERAN_WARNING_5.zh: {SAY:winnie}你说的对，而且，你好像已经提了。

NARRATIVE_VETERAN_WARNING_7.zh: {SAY:crazydave}这些关卡困难程度到了令人疯癫的地步！

NARRATIVE_VETERAN_WARNING_8.en: {SAY:crazydave}YOU SHOULD AT LEAST GET SOME POWERFUL PLANTS TO BEAT THEM!!!
NARRATIVE_VETERAN_WARNING_8.zh: {SAY:crazydave}你至少应该先解锁一些强力植物再来挑战它们！！！

NARRATIVE_VETERAN_WARNING_9.zh: {SAY:crazydave}我是认真的，请先去探索其它世界！

NARRATIVE_WINTERMELON_EQ2023_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Winter Melon will chill zombies on impact.
NARRATIVE_WINTERMELON_EQ2023_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}冰瓜可以冷缓被砸到的僵尸。

NARRATIVE_WINTERMELON_EQ2023_2_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Winter Melon attacks will spill over, damaging and chilling adjacent enemies.
NARRATIVE_WINTERMELON_EQ2023_2_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}冰瓜的攻击可以向周围溅射，对周遭的所有敌人造成伤害和冷缓效果。

NARRATIVE_WINTERMELON_EQ2023_3_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Winter Melon PF Bombards all zombies with frozen melons.
NARRATIVE_WINTERMELON_EQ2023_3_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}为冰瓜投手施用叶绿素，向所有僵尸轰炸冰冻西瓜。

NARRATIVE_WINTERMINT_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie} Power Mints are powerful plants you can acquire through Arena.
NARRATIVE_WINTERMINT_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}超能薄荷是你可以通过竞技场获得的强大植物。

NARRATIVE_WINTERMINT_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:winnie}They provide a big boost to plants in their family.
NARRATIVE_WINTERMINT_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}它们对相应家族的植物有巨大的增益作用。

NARRATIVE_WINTERMINT_INTRO_3.en: {SAY:winnie}The Winter-mint family comprises chilling and freezing plants.
NARRATIVE_WINTERMINT_INTRO_3.zh: {SAY:winnie}寒冬薄荷家族包括冰系植物。

NARRATIVE_YETI_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnieicon}{PLAYFUL}My Penny sense has detected a rare and curious lunch box.
NARRATIVE_YETI_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnieicon}{PLAYFUL}潘妮报告：发现一只新奇稀有的午餐盒。

NARRATIVE_YETI_INTRO_2.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydaveicon}{PLAYFUL}I smell a Yeti! Let's go after him!
NARRATIVE_YETI_INTRO_2.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydaveicon}{PLAYFUL}我闻到了雪人僵尸的味道！走，去追他！

NARRATIVE_YOURHOUSE10_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydavepvz}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydavepvz}The familiar scent of the conveyor belt.

NARRATIVE_YOURHOUSE10_2.en: {SAY:winnie}The battle during the day was about to come to an end, and the battle at night was about to begin. They launched a general attack.
NARRATIVE_YOURHOUSE10_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}白天的战斗即将落下帷幕，黑夜的战斗要打响了，它们发起了总攻。

NARRATIVE_YOURHOUSE10_3.en: {SAY:crazydavepvz}Have you forgotten how we defeated them last time?
NARRATIVE_YOURHOUSE10_3.zh: {SAY:crazydavepvz}难道你忘记上次我们是怎么打败它们的吗？

NARRATIVE_YOURHOUSE10_4.en: {SAY:winnie}User Dave, you didn’t have me when you fought these zombies last time...
NARRATIVE_YOURHOUSE10_4.zh: {SAY:winnie}用户戴夫，你上次和这群僵尸战斗的时候可没有我...

NARRATIVE_YOURHOUSE1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydavepvz}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydavepvz}Why are we back in the lawn?

NARRATIVE_YOURHOUSE1_2.en: {SAY:winnie}Dave, we have defeated Zomboss's Zombot II before, Dr. Zomboss wasn't convinced then turned on the time Machine.
NARRATIVE_YOURHOUSE1_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}用户戴夫，由于我们击败了无畏者二号，但僵王博士不服气，开启了时光机。

NARRATIVE_YOURHOUSE1_3.en: {SAY:crazydavepvz}Time machine? ! ! Does that mean I get to eat tacos again?
NARRATIVE_YOURHOUSE1_3.zh: {SAY:crazydavepvz}时光机？！！那是不是意味着我又可以再吃一次玉米卷了？

NARRATIVE_YOURHOUSE1_4.en: {SAY:winnie}That's true, but you'll have to face those zombies you've defeated before.
NARRATIVE_YOURHOUSE1_4.zh: {SAY:winnie}确实如此，但是你得重新面对那些以前击败过的僵尸们。

NARRATIVE_YOURHOUSE1_5.en: {SAY:winnie}The data shows that they are stronger than before.
NARRATIVE_YOURHOUSE1_5.zh: {SAY:winnie}数据显示，他们比原来更加强大。

NARRATIVE_YOURHOUSE1_6.en: {SAY:crazydavepvz}I give up, all I care about is tacos!
NARRATIVE_YOURHOUSE1_6.zh: {SAY:crazydavepvz}区区手下败将，我只在乎我的玉米卷！

NARRATIVE_YOURHOUSE3_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydavepvz}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydavepvz}I think I can kill Edgar with plants from other time and space.
NARRATIVE_YOURHOUSE3_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydavepvz}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydavepvz}我觉得我可以用其他时空的植物杀穿埃德加。

NARRATIVE_YOURHOUSE3_2.en: {SAY:winnie}Your idea is beautiful, but the reality is cruel. You can only use the first few plants in this level.
NARRATIVE_YOURHOUSE3_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}你的想法很美好，但现实很残酷，本关你只能使用最初始的几株植物。

NARRATIVE_YOURHOUSE3_3.en: {SAY:crazydavepvz}***! Never mind, not a big deal!

NARRATIVE_YOURHOUSE3_4.en: {SAY:winnie}I hope you can still have the last laugh.

NARRATIVE_YOURHOUSE4_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydavepvz}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydavepvz}Even with this difficulty, he wants to seek revenge from us?
NARRATIVE_YOURHOUSE4_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydavepvz}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydavepvz}就这种难度也想找我们复仇？

NARRATIVE_YOURHOUSE4_2.en: {SAY:winnie}No, the data shows that as the difficulty increases, Dr. Zomboss imposes additional objectives on us.
NARRATIVE_YOURHOUSE4_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}不，数据显示，难度再增加，僵王博士给我们加了要求。

NARRATIVE_YOURHOUSE4_4.en: {SAY:winnie}Hypnotize 70 zombies, and he has already picked most of the plants for you.
NARRATIVE_YOURHOUSE4_4.zh: {SAY:winnie}魅惑 70 只僵尸，而且他已经强制你选择了一部分植物。

NARRATIVE_YOURHOUSE7_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydavepvz}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydavepvz}I'm getting a little tired of Dr. Zombie's shenanigans.
NARRATIVE_YOURHOUSE7_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydavepvz}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydavepvz}我已经有点厌倦僵王博士的把戏了。

NARRATIVE_YOURHOUSE7_2.en: {SAY:winnie}Indeed, he was still the same old man.

NARRATIVE_YOURHOUSE7_3.en: {SAY:winnie}But at this level he seemed to be trying to stump us.
NARRATIVE_YOURHOUSE7_3.zh: {SAY:winnie}不过这一关他貌似想难倒我们的样子。

NARRATIVE_YOURHOUSE8_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydavepvz}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydavepvz}There is a familiar flower on the lawn.

NARRATIVE_YOURHOUSE8_2.en: {SAY:winnie}As you can see, Edgar is looking for ways to increase the difficulty and take your brain.
NARRATIVE_YOURHOUSE8_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}如你所见，埃德加在想方设法增加难度，想夺取你的脑子。

NARRATIVE_YOURHOUSE8_3.en: {SAY:crazydavepvz}Dripphylleia taught him how to be a zombie!

NARRATIVE_YOURHOUSE8_4.en: {SAY:winnie}You don't seem to be able to use it.

NARRATIVE_YOURHOUSE9_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydavepvz}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydavepvz}Why are there so many plants on the cordon?
NARRATIVE_YOURHOUSE9_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydavepvz}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydavepvz}怎么这么多植物在警戒线上。

NARRATIVE_YOURHOUSE9_2.en: {SAY:winnie}The area where these plants are located is very dangerous and you must protect them or your brain will be in danger.
NARRATIVE_YOURHOUSE9_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}这些植物所在的区域非常危险，你必须保护他们不然你的脑子也会不保。

NARRATIVE_YOURHOUSE9_3.en: {SAY:crazydavepvz}What do plants have to do with my brain?

NARRATIVE_YOURHOUSE_2.en: {SAY:winnie}User Dave, Dr. Zomboss, has issued a challenge to us. This time the mecha he uses is our old friend.
NARRATIVE_YOURHOUSE_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}用户戴夫，僵王博士埃德加向我们发出了战书，这次他使用的机甲是我们的老朋友。

NARRATIVE_YOURHOUSE_3.zh: {SAY:crazydave}无畏者？！！那个被我们打散架的赝品吗？

NARRATIVE_YOURHOUSE_4.en: {SAY:winnie}No, Dave, he modified his Zombot and it's now called Zombot II.
NARRATIVE_YOURHOUSE_4.zh: {SAY:winnie}不，戴夫，他改良了他的无畏者机器人，现在叫做无畏者二号。

NARRATIVE_YOURHOUSE_5.en: {SAY:winnie}Data shows that it not only has all the previous skills, but also...summons rifts and launches missiles.
NARRATIVE_YOURHOUSE_5.zh: {SAY:winnie}数据显示，它不仅会以前的所有技能，还会...召唤时空裂缝和发射导弹。

NARRATIVE_YOURHOUSE_50_INTRO_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}Hey, neighbor! Getting a sense of déjà vu?
NARRATIVE_YOURHOUSE_50_INTRO_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}嘿，邻居！你是不是感觉到这一切都在变得更加熟悉？

NARRATIVE_YOURHOUSE_50_INTRO_10.en: {SAY:crazydave}Because my house is right next door!

NARRATIVE_YOURHOUSE_50_INTRO_2.en: {SAY:winnie}User Dave, sensors are detecting an unknown massive signal source on approach.
NARRATIVE_YOURHOUSE_50_INTRO_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}用户戴夫，探测器检测到未知巨型信号源正在接近。

NARRATIVE_YOURHOUSE_50_INTRO_3.en: {SAY:winnie}My analysis suggests we are about to face an incredibly difficult battle.
NARRATIVE_YOURHOUSE_50_INTRO_3.zh: {SAY:winnie}我认为我们会有一场非常艰难的战争即将发生。

NARRATIVE_YOURHOUSE_50_INTRO_5.en: {SAY:crazydave}They're always so unique, and so very languid.
NARRATIVE_YOURHOUSE_50_INTRO_5.zh: {SAY:crazydave}他们总是那么的特别又慵懒。

NARRATIVE_YOURHOUSE_50_INTRO_7.en: {SAY:zombossicon}If you don't want us to throw a rooftop brain-barbecue party...
NARRATIVE_YOURHOUSE_50_INTRO_7.zh: {SAY:zombossicon}如果你不想让我们在你的屋顶上开露天烧烤大脑派对...

NARRATIVE_YOURHOUSE_50_INTRO_8.en: {SAY:zombossicon}...then my little darlings and I are coming inside!
NARRATIVE_YOURHOUSE_50_INTRO_8.zh: {SAY:zombossicon}那么我和我的小宝贝就会踏进你的房间！

NARRATIVE_YOURHOUSE_50_OUTRO_4.en: {SAY:winnie}Data indicates Dr. Zomboss's victory rate against us is 0%.
NARRATIVE_YOURHOUSE_50_OUTRO_4.zh: {SAY:winnie}系统显示，僵王博士在我们面前的胜利率为0%

NARRATIVE_YOURHOUSE_50_OUTRO_5.en: {SAY:crazydave}It's the same story in every timeline, but I'm still gonna find my taco.
NARRATIVE_YOURHOUSE_50_OUTRO_5.zh: {SAY:crazydave}每个时空都是一样的，但我依然会寻找我的玉米卷。

NARRATIVE_YOURHOUSE_50_OUTRO_7.en: {SAY:winnie}What is the significance of the taco search, User Dave?
NARRATIVE_YOURHOUSE_50_OUTRO_7.zh: {SAY:winnie}我们寻找玉米卷的意义是什么？用户戴夫。

NARRATIVE_YOURHOUSE_50_OUTRO_9.en: {EXCITED:crazydave}Maybe it's for the sake of tacos past!

NARRATIVE_YOURHOUSE_6.en: {SAY:crazydave}That's it? I think his white flag will go up again.
NARRATIVE_YOURHOUSE_6.zh: {SAY:crazydave}就这？我想他的白旗会再次竖起。

NARRATIVE_YOURHOUSE_7.en: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}You guys, let me tell you, you are already on the verge of death!
NARRATIVE_YOURHOUSE_7.zh: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}你们几个，我说啊，你们已经是死到临头了！

NARRATIVE_YOURHOUSE_8.en: {SAY:zombossicon}Don't be ignorant, my Zombot II is unstoppable!
NARRATIVE_YOURHOUSE_8.zh: {SAY:zombossicon}别不识好歹，我的无畏者二号无人能挡！

NARRATIVE_YOURHOUSE_R_2.en: {SAY:winnie}User Dave, Dr. Zomboss sent us an invitation to eat your brain here..
NARRATIVE_YOURHOUSE_R_2.zh: {SAY:winnie}用户戴夫，僵王博士埃德加向我们发出了邀请，说要在这里吃到你的脑子。

NARRATIVE_YOURHOUSE_R_3.en: {SAY:crazydave}You are such a good helper to me, and you brought me here.
NARRATIVE_YOURHOUSE_R_3.zh: {SAY:crazydave}你可真是我的好帮手，还把我带到这里。

NARRATIVE_YOURHOUSE_R_4.en: {SAY:winnie}You have defeated him countless times in the past, are you still afraid of him?
NARRATIVE_YOURHOUSE_R_4.zh: {SAY:winnie}在过去你已经打败过他无数次了，难道你还怕他么。

NARRATIVE_YOURHOUSE_R_6.en: {SAY:winnie}It seems that Dr. Zomboss is still preparing and wants to entertain us with his zombie army first.
NARRATIVE_YOURHOUSE_R_6.zh: {SAY:winnie}僵王博士貌似还在准备，想先用僵尸大军招待我们。

NARRATIVE_ZCORP_LTE_2023_1_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}看清楚了！更新、更好的 Z 公司。

NARRATIVE_ZCORP_LTE_2023_1_2.en: {SAY:zomboss_r}I predict an upsurge in Brainz gainz with our synergistic solutions!
NARRATIVE_ZCORP_LTE_2023_1_2.zh: {SAY:zomboss_r}我预测，我们的协同办公解决方案，会让脑子的收益稳步提升！

NARRATIVE_ZCORP_LTE_2023_1_4.en: {SAY:zomboss_r}I am creating a paradigm shift in the brainz supply chain you fools!
NARRATIVE_ZCORP_LTE_2023_1_4.zh: {SAY:zomboss_r}我在为我们的脑子供应链进行典范转移，你们这群傻瓜！

NARRATIVE_ZCORP_LTE_2023_1_5.en: {SAY:peashooter}That still doesn't sound like a good thing for us, Zomboss.
NARRATIVE_ZCORP_LTE_2023_1_5.zh: {SAY:peashooter}好像对我们而言依然不是什么好消息，僵王。

NARRATIVE_ZCORP_LTE_2023_1_6.en: {NPC_EXIT:peashooter}{NPC_ENTER:sunflower}{SAY:sunflower}We're satisfied with the current paradigm of not being zombie food.
NARRATIVE_ZCORP_LTE_2023_1_6.zh: {NPC_EXIT:peashooter}{NPC_ENTER:sunflower}{SAY:sunflower}我们对目前还没有进僵尸肚子的“典范”很满意。

NARRATIVE_ZCORP_LTE_2023_1_7.en: {SAY:zomboss_r}Resistance is futile. ZCorp is the wave of the future!
NARRATIVE_ZCORP_LTE_2023_1_7.zh: {SAY:zomboss_r}放弃抵抗吧。Z 公司是未来的汹汹之潮！

NARRATIVE_ZCORP_LTE_2023_2_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:peashooter}Oh no, my laptop's busted! This is terrible.
NARRATIVE_ZCORP_LTE_2023_2_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:peashooter}糟糕，我的笔记本坏了！真倒霉。

NARRATIVE_ZCORP_LTE_2023_2_2.en: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}A ZCorp HelpDesk technician will be right over... to remove your brainz...
NARRATIVE_ZCORP_LTE_2023_2_2.zh: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}正在派发一名 Z 公司技术支持专员……来取走您的脑子…

NARRATIVE_ZCORP_LTE_2023_2_4.en: {SAY:peashooter}Uh, no thanks Zomboss, I can live without Wallnut memes for a day.
NARRATIVE_ZCORP_LTE_2023_2_4.zh: {SAY:peashooter}啊，不用了僵王，你一天不讲坚果墙笑话我也死不了，谢谢。

NARRATIVE_ZCORP_LTE_2023_2_5.en: {SAY:zomboss_r}Nonsense! We will set you up with one of our brand new Explosive Models!
NARRATIVE_ZCORP_LTE_2023_2_5.zh: {SAY:zomboss_r}胡说！让我们来给您安排一款全新的可以爆炸的机型吧！

NARRATIVE_ZCORP_LTE_2023_2_7.en: {SAY:zomboss_r}It's the most cutting-edge technology.. it will blow your leaves out!
NARRATIVE_ZCORP_LTE_2023_2_7.zh: {SAY:zomboss_r}那可是用最尖端的技术打造的……您要是亲眼看见，估计得把您的叶子都吓掉！

NARRATIVE_ZCORP_LTE_2023_3_2.zh: {NPC_ENTER:sunflower}{SAY:sunflower}我们已经把它们缩小到看不见了！

NARRATIVE_ZCORP_LTE_2023_3_3.en: {SAY:zomboss_r}ZCorp is still a force to be reckoned with, even without my legal council!
NARRATIVE_ZCORP_LTE_2023_3_3.zh: {SAY:zomboss_r}即使没有我的法务委员会，Z 公司依然是一股不可忽视的力量！

NARRATIVE_ZCORP_LTE_2023_3_4.en: {SAY:sunflower}Oh yeah? What do you have, besides a losing lawsuit and a bad attitude?
NARRATIVE_ZCORP_LTE_2023_3_4.zh: {SAY:sunflower}是吗？除了败诉案例和坏脾气，你们还有什么？

NARRATIVE_ZCORP_LTE_2023_3_6.en: {SHOUT:zomboss_r}ZCORP DOES NOT HAVE TO ANSWER TO THE LIKES OF YOU!!
NARRATIVE_ZCORP_LTE_2023_3_6.zh: {SHOUT:zomboss_r}Z 公司不必回应像你们这样的人！！

NARRATIVE_ZCORP_LTE_2023_4_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:peashooter}Ha! So much for this hostile zombie takeover!
NARRATIVE_ZCORP_LTE_2023_4_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:peashooter}哈！看来僵尸的这次恶意收购就到此为止了！

NARRATIVE_ZCORP_LTE_2023_4_2.en: {NPC_ENTER:sunflower_r}{SAY:sunflower_r}I can't believe we actually pulled it off. We were so close to being zombie chow.
NARRATIVE_ZCORP_LTE_2023_4_2.zh: {NPC_ENTER:sunflower_r}{SAY:sunflower_r}我都不敢相信我们真的成功了。我们差一点就变成僵尸的盘中餐了。

NARRATIVE_ZCORP_LTE_2023_4_4.en: {SAY:peashooter}Yes, Wallnut! We won! We defeated ZCorp and put Zomboss out of business.
NARRATIVE_ZCORP_LTE_2023_4_4.zh: {SAY:peashooter}没错，坚果墙！我们赢了！我们击败了 Z 公司，让僵王的生意泡汤了。

NARRATIVE_ZCORP_LTE_2023_4_5.en: {NPC_EXIT:wallnut_r}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}Just you wait! I'll be back with a leaner, meaner, and more efficient ZCorp!
NARRATIVE_ZCORP_LTE_2023_4_5.zh: {NPC_EXIT:wallnut_r}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}等着吧！我会带着一个更精简、更阴险，还更有效率的 Z 公司卷土重来的！

NARRATIVE_ZCORP_LTE_2023_4_6.en: {SAY:peashooter}You always were a terrible businessman Zomboss, and now you are all out of Brainz!
NARRATIVE_ZCORP_LTE_2023_4_6.zh: {SAY:peashooter}你什么时候把生意做好过啊僵王，而且你现在脑子也用光了！

NARRATIVE_ZCORP_LTE_A_1_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}You lot! What are you doing here??

NARRATIVE_ZCORP_LTE_A_1_2.en: {SAY:zomboss_r}We're close today. Come back another time.
NARRATIVE_ZCORP_LTE_A_1_2.zh: {SAY:zomboss_r}我们今天打烊了。以后再来吧。

NARRATIVE_ZCORP_LTE_A_1_3.en: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:peashooter}Justice closes for no one. We're here to shut you down!
NARRATIVE_ZCORP_LTE_A_1_3.zh: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:peashooter}正义绝不打烊。我们是来让你关门大吉的！

NARRATIVE_ZCORP_LTE_A_1_4.en: {SAY:zomboss_r}Fools, you think you can take on all of ZCorp!
NARRATIVE_ZCORP_LTE_A_1_4.zh: {SAY:zomboss_r}傻瓜，你们以为自己可以对付整个 Z 公司吗！

NARRATIVE_ZCORP_LTE_A_1_5.en: {SAY:zomboss_r}This will be the end of you! Muhahaha!
NARRATIVE_ZCORP_LTE_A_1_5.zh: {SAY:zomboss_r}今天就是你们的末日！木哈哈哈！

NARRATIVE_ZCORP_LTE_A_2_1.en: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}You think you have bested me today. But this isn't the end.
NARRATIVE_ZCORP_LTE_A_2_1.zh: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}你们自以为今天打败了我。可这还没完。

NARRATIVE_ZCORP_LTE_A_2_2.zh: {SAY:zomboss_r}反正我也一直想换个工作地点，

NARRATIVE_ZCORP_LTE_A_2_4.en: {NPC_EXIT:zomboss_r}{NPC_ENTER:sunflower_r}{SAY:sunflower_r}He got away.  But we'll get another chance.

NARRATIVE_ZCORP_LTE_A_2_5.en: {SAY:peashooter}There's no place to hide from Justice!

NARRATIVE_ZEN_GARDEN_INTRO_TUTORIAL_SPEE.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}Your Sunflower will grow up too, but it takes awhile.
NARRATIVE_ZEN_GARDEN_INTRO_TUTORIAL_SPEE.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}你的向日葵同样会长大，但需要一段时间。

NARRATIVE_ZEN_GARDEN_INTRO_TUTORIAL_SPEE.en: {PLAYFUL:winnie}Try some more Gems to speed her up!
NARRATIVE_ZEN_GARDEN_INTRO_TUTORIAL_SPEE.zh: {PLAYFUL:winnie}试试用更多的钻石加速她们的成长吧！

NARRATIVE_ZEN_GARDEN_INTRO_TUTORIAL_WELC.en: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{EXCITED}Zen Garden isn't just for growing Marigolds.
NARRATIVE_ZEN_GARDEN_INTRO_TUTORIAL_WELC.zh: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{EXCITED}禅境花园可不只能种金盏花。

NARRATIVE_ZEN_GARDEN_INTRO_TUTORIAL_WELC.en: {EXCITED:crazydave}You can also grow mega powerful boosted plants!
NARRATIVE_ZEN_GARDEN_INTRO_TUTORIAL_WELC.zh: {EXCITED:crazydave}你也可以种更多强大的植物使其获得强化！

NARRATIVE_ZEN_GARDEN_INTRO_TUTORIAL_WELC.en: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}But boosted plants only last for a single level!
NARRATIVE_ZEN_GARDEN_INTRO_TUTORIAL_WELC.zh: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}但是强化效果仅能维持一关！

NARRATIVE_ZEN_GARDEN_MARIGOLD_TUTORIAL_S.en: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}If you wait a while, your Marigold will grow.
NARRATIVE_ZEN_GARDEN_MARIGOLD_TUTORIAL_S.zh: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}如果你等待一段时间，你的金盏花就会逐渐长大。

NARRATIVE_ZEN_GARDEN_MARIGOLD_TUTORIAL_S.en: {PLAYFUL:winnie}But you can speed up the process with Gems!
NARRATIVE_ZEN_GARDEN_MARIGOLD_TUTORIAL_S.zh: {PLAYFUL:winnie}但是你能用钻石来加速这个过程！

NARRATIVE_ZEN_GARDEN_MARIGOLD_TUTORIAL_W.en: {EXCITED:crazydave}Maybe if you water it, you'll get coins?
NARRATIVE_ZEN_GARDEN_MARIGOLD_TUTORIAL_W.zh: {EXCITED:crazydave}如果你耐心给它浇水的话，说不定可以收获一些金币呢？

NARRATIVE_ZEN_GARDEN_MARIGOLD_TUTORIAL_W.en: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}At least, I think that's how it works.

NETWORK_ISSUE_DESCRIPTION.en: {FEATURE} requires an internet connection! Please connect to the internet and select "Retry" or "Exit" to leave {FEATURE}.
NETWORK_ISSUE_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FEATURE}需要互联网连接！请连接网络后点击“重试”或者点击“退出”来离开{FEATURE}。

NETWORK_ISSUE_DESCRIPTION_CLOUDCONNECTIO.en: We could not verify your cloud connection. Please check that you are signed into Google Play Game Services to protect progress and preserve progress across devices.
NETWORK_ISSUE_DESCRIPTION_CLOUDCONNECTIO.zh: 我们无法验证你的云端连接。请检查你是否登入了 Google Play 游戏服务，以保护进度并在不同设备上维护进度。

NETWORK_ISSUE_DESCRIPTION_CLOUDCONNECTIO.en: We could not verify your cloud connection. Please check that you are signed into iCloud to protect progress and preserve progress across devices.
NETWORK_ISSUE_DESCRIPTION_CLOUDCONNECTIO.zh: 我们无法验证你的云端连接。请检查你是否登入了 iCloud，以保护进度并在不同设备上维护进度。

NETWORK_ISSUE_DESCRIPTION_DISCONNECTED.en: We were unable to connect to the server.  Please try again sometime later.
NETWORK_ISSUE_DESCRIPTION_DISCONNECTED.zh: 无法连接至服务器，请稍后再试。

NETWORK_ISSUE_DESCRIPTION_INVALIDDATA.en: Sorry, it looks like there's a network data issue. Arg! Click to exit Arena.
NETWORK_ISSUE_DESCRIPTION_INVALIDDATA.zh: 抱歉，似乎有一些网络数据问题。呃！点击退出竞技场。

NETWORK_ISSUE_DESCRIPTION_TIMEOUT.en: An internet connection is required to play Arena. Please connect to the internet and "Retry" to try again, or "Exit" to leave Arena.
NETWORK_ISSUE_DESCRIPTION_TIMEOUT.zh: 游玩竞技场需要互联网连接。请在连接到互联网后点击“重试”以再次尝试，或点击“退出”离开竞技场。

NETWORK_ISSUE_DESCRIPTION_TIMEOUT_ENDLEV.en: Your internet connection has been lost. Tap "Exit" to continue (your reward streak may be lost).
NETWORK_ISSUE_DESCRIPTION_TIMEOUT_ENDLEV.zh: 已丢失互联网连接。点击“退出”以继续（你可能会失去连胜奖励）。

NETWORK_ISSUE_DESCRIPTION_TOURNAMENTEXPI.en: The current tournament has expired!  Return to collect your winnings!
NETWORK_ISSUE_DESCRIPTION_TOURNAMENTEXPI.zh: 当前赛程已经终止了！快返回领取你的奖励吧！

NETWORK_ISSUE_TITLE_CLOUDCONNECTION_ANDR.en: Sorry, it looks like there's a network data issue.
NETWORK_ISSUE_TITLE_CLOUDCONNECTION_ANDR.zh: 抱歉，似乎有一些网络数据问题。

NIGHTCAP_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}Avoids most zombie attacks.

{FLAVOR}Nightcap's always had a keen sense for justice, back from when she was a tiny spore watching late-night ninja movies instead of concentrating on her mycology homework.
NIGHTCAP_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}免疫大多数僵尸的攻击

{FLAVOR}暗夜菇对正义总有一种敏锐性，在她只是一个小孢子的时候，她总喜欢观看深夜档的忍者电影，而不是专注于她的真菌学作业。

NIGHTCAP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Nightcap shoots piercing poisonous stars down the lane and withdraws into a toxic stealth mode when zombies get too close.
NIGHTCAP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 暗夜菇可向其所在行发射具有穿透性的毒星星。当僵尸距离暗夜菇过近时，暗夜菇将会变化为拥有毒性的潜行模式。

NIGHTCAP_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Poison Zombies in 3 lanes and push them back!
NIGHTCAP_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}让 3 行的僵尸中毒，随后击退它们！

NIGHTSHADE_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}For Nightshade, smacking is a duty and a privilege. He comes from a long line of ardent smackers, and his family counts three kings, four ambassadors and a president as among those proudly slapped around.
NIGHTSHADE_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}扔出叶子，被加强时会恢复叶子

{FLAVOR}对夜影龙葵来说，打脸是一种义务和特权。他来自打脸国度，他的家族有三位国王、四位大使和一位总统，他们都会自豪地互相打脸。

NIGHTSHADE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Nightshades are shadow plants that smack zombies with slappy leaves. Hurls and regrow its leave when powered by other Shadow plants.
NIGHTSHADE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 夜影龙葵作为一株暗影植物，它会用叶子攻击僵尸。

NIGHTSHADE_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Regrows all of its leaves, then throw three large leaves at zombies. Permanently, increases its damage.
NIGHTSHADE_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}重新长出所有叶子，随后向僵尸扔出三片大叶子。还能永久提升它的伤害。

NIGHTSHADE_TOOLTIP.zh: 暗影植物，发射叶子拍打僵尸

NOCTARINE_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}"You know," Hat-shroom said proudly, "I made all the plant hats, although they don't seem to like wearing hats very much."
NOCTARINE_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}使用：{STAT}疯帽菇会扔出头顶的帽子对身前的僵尸进行攻击
{KEYWORD}植物特征：{STAT}童话植物

{FLAVOR}“你知道的，”疯帽菇自豪地说“所有植物的帽子都是我做的，虽然他们好像都不怎么喜欢戴帽子。”

NOCTARINE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Hat-shroom will throw the hat on its head to attack the zombies in front of it
NOCTARINE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 疯帽菇会扔出头顶的帽子对身前的僵尸进行攻击

NOCTARINE_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Hat-shroom will throw 5 darts at zombies which deal massive damage and bounce between lanes.

NOCTARINE_TOOLTIP.en: Throw the bouncy hat on its head to attack the zombies in front of it and other lanes.
NOCTARINE_TOOLTIP.zh: 疯帽菇会扔出头顶的帽子对身前的僵尸进行攻击

NOTIFICATION_CHANNEL_CHEAT_DESCRIPTION.zh: 开启辅助程序推送通知

NOTIFICATION_CHANNEL_DANGER_ROOM_DESCRIP.zh: 开启无尽模式推送通知

NOTIFICATION_CHANNEL_PINATA_HUNT_DESCRIP.zh: 开启彩陶追击推送通知

NOTIFICATION_CHANNEL_PINATA_PARTY_DESCRI.zh: 开启彩陶盛宴推送通知

NOTIFICATION_CHANNEL_QUESTS_DESCRIPTION.en: Turn on Travel Log Quest notifications
NOTIFICATION_CHANNEL_QUESTS_DESCRIPTION.zh: 开启旅行原木任务推送通知

NOTIFICATION_CHANNEL_RIFTS_DESCRIPTION.zh: 开启潘妮的追击推送通知

NOTIFICATION_CHANNEL_SEASONS_DESCRIPTION.zh: 开启赛季更新推送通知

NOTIFICATION_CHANNEL_ZEN_GARDEN_DESCRIPT.zh: 开启禅境花园推送通知

NOT_ENOUGH_SPROUTS.en: No more sprouts. Play levels to find more!
NOT_ENOUGH_SPROUTS.zh: 没有更多幼芽了。游玩关卡去找更多的吧！

NYS23_SUN_PRODUCER_BUNDLE.zh: 新年阳光生产者捆绑包

OFFERWALL_OUT_OF_ADS_DESCRIPTION.en: We are unable to play an ad at this time. Please try again later.
OFFERWALL_OUT_OF_ADS_DESCRIPTION.zh: 我们目前无法播放广告。请稍后再试。

OFFERWALL_OUT_OF_OFFERS_DESCRIPTION.en: We are unable to show offers at this time. Please try again later.
OFFERWALL_OUT_OF_OFFERS_DESCRIPTION.zh: 我们目前无法展示任务。请稍后再试。

OFFLINE_FACEBOOK_LOGIN_BODY.en: Please connect to a network in order to log in to Facebook.
OFFLINE_FACEBOOK_LOGIN_BODY.zh: 请连接至网络以登入 Facebook。

OLIVEPIT1_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Olive Pit lies buried deep underground, thinking furiously. What about? Hard to say. Maybe airplanes? Do helicopters count as airplanes?
OLIVEPIT1_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}植物特征：{STAT}矮个子

{FLAVOR}橄榄坑埋在地下深处，他一直有个愿望，希望有一天能去一次天空之城里面的飞船。

OLIVEPIT1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Olive Pits drill into the ground and wait to consume zombies foolish enough to walk over them.
OLIVEPIT1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 橄榄坑能减速前方一格僵尸，并让路过的僵尸掉下去

OLIVEPIT1_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Swallow a bunch of zombies, and spit out oil in the surrounding area.
OLIVEPIT1_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}吞掉一堆僵尸，在周围吐油。

OLIVEPIT1_TOOLTIP.zh: 橄榄坑能减速前方一格僵尸，并让路过的僵尸掉下去

OLIVEPIT_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}Illuminate zombies into weak Solarsage Bullys every 18 seconds, effective against some special zombies.

{FLAVOR}"Let me save you!" Olive wood exclaimed eagerly, holding the Bible in his hand. "May God bless you, Amen, Amen."
OLIVEPIT_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}隔一段时间克死一个僵尸并转生成一个弱壮汉僵尸，对部分特殊僵尸也有效

{FLAVOR}让我来超度你吧！神灵橄榄木迫不及待地说，他早已拿着圣经。愿上帝保佑你，阿门，阿门。

OLIVEPIT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Illuminate zombies into Solarsage Bullys every 18 seconds
OLIVEPIT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 隔一段时间克死一个僵尸并转生成一个弱壮汉僵尸

OLIVEPIT_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: Immediately illuminate the surrounding zombies into Solarsage Bullys.

ORANBOOM_QUEST.en: Oranboom TAT Collab Quest - Far East Paddy Fields - Harvest Days
ORANBOOM_QUEST.zh: TAT联动·橘子炸弹-远东之倭稻田·丰收之刻

OUTRO_ZOMBIESWON.zh:
僵尸
吃掉了
你的脑子！

OUT_OF_CONTENT_HEADER.zh: 要游玩这一关卡，你必须下载额外内容。

OXYGENALGAE_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}Produces oxygen that spreads to the surroundings, allowing nearby land plants to grow in seawater.

{FLAVOR}Oxygen Algae exercises regularly every day, and it is said that this is the source of her ability to continuously provide oxygen to the surrounding area.
OXYGENALGAE_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特点：{STAT}生产氧气扩散向周围，可以使自身3*3范围的陆地植物在海水中种植并生存

{FLAVOR}氧气海藻每天都会做有氧运动，据悉这是她能向周围持续提供氧气的来源。

OXYGENALGAE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Provides sun and oxygen to surrounding plants.
OXYGENALGAE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 为周围植物提供阳光和氧气。

OXYGENALGAE_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: Instantly produces a large amount of sun.
OXYGENALGAE_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}大招立即产生大量阳光

OXYGENALGAE_TOOLTIP.en: Provides sun and oxygen to surrounding plants

PACKET_LAST_STAND_LOCKED.en: This plant cannot be planted during Last Stand setup.
PACKET_LAST_STAND_LOCKED.zh: 这株植物不能在坚不可摧的准备阶段里种植。

PARADOXPULT_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Eternal Nova: {STAT}has a chance to fling a Black Hole, the Black Hole lingers in place to slow zombies and can be detonated by Vortex Melon to deal massive explosive damage.
{FLAVOR}Paradox-pult hails from Plants vs. Zombies: Fusion. Born at the very dawn of the universe, his age is beyond calculation. He plucked three stars from the primordial cosmos to serve as his satellites—prizes that not even a black hole could steal away. Nowadays, the old timer's greatest joy is simply fiddling with these cosmic trinkets that are just as ancient as he is.
PARADOXPULT_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}永寂新星：{STAT}有概率投掷出黑洞，黑洞将会留在原地减速僵尸，且能被究极冰神西瓜引爆，造成灰烬伤害。
{FLAVOR}究极超时空玉米来自《植物大战僵尸：融合版》。他诞生自宇宙之初，年岁已不可估量。他从宇宙的原初摘下三枚星辰作为自己的卫星，即便黑洞也让无法将其夺走。如今，老人家最大的乐趣就是把玩这串与他同龄的宇宙岁月。

PARADOXPULT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Paradox-pults fling butter and Black Holes at zombies.
PARADOXPULT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 究极超时空玉米可以投掷黄油或黑洞攻击僵尸。

PARADOXPULT_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Launches Black Holes at every zombie on the lawn.
PARADOXPULT_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}向全场所有僵尸投出黑洞。

PARADOXPULT_TOOLTIP.en: Flings butter or Black Holes at zombies
PARADOXPULT_TOOLTIP.zh: 投掷黄油或黑洞攻击僵尸

PARSNIP1_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}"Snip!" says Parsnip. "Snip snip snip! If it wasn't for my scrapbook, my coupons, and snipping zombies to death, I just don't know what I'd do with myself!"
PARSNIP1_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}“剪！”铁钳防风草说。“剪剪剪！如果不是因为我有剪剪贴簿、优惠券，和剪死僵尸之类的事情能做，我真不知道我会拿自己怎么办！”

PARSNIP1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Parsnips snip at zombies, then charge down the lane at the last moment.
PARSNIP1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 铁钳防风草可以用铁钳攻击僵尸，在被吃掉时会义无反顾地冲向前线。

PARSNIP1_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Knocks back every zombie in front and then summons two mini parsnips that will rush down the column.
PARSNIP1_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}击退面前的每只僵尸，随后召唤两株迷你防风草，横扫本排。

PARSNIP1_TOOLTIP.en: Snips zombies, then charges down lane
PARSNIP1_TOOLTIP.zh: 钳击僵尸，快被吃掉时冲向前方

PARSNIP_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}范围：{STAT}前方1行
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}射出一枚向前穿透的子弹，使正在穿透的僵尸减速。

{FLAVOR}瞄准目标……3！2！1！发射！耐心、认真、细致、稳重，这是周围植物夸突击竹兵的常用词汇，但他自己知道，其实这些词汇并不完全符合，举个例子他其实想长高，如果可以长得比高坚果高，他能从土里把自己刨出来并且绕花园跑三圈。

PARSNIP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Fires a drill, which will cause continuous damage to the zombie while drilling through it, lasting 4 seconds.
PARSNIP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 发射一枚钻头子弹，钻透僵尸过程中对僵尸造成持续伤害，持续4秒

PARSNIP_TOOLTIP.en: Fires drill which damage and slow zombies
PARSNIP_TOOLTIP.zh: 发射一枚钻头子弹，钻透僵尸过程中对僵尸造成持续伤害

PATCH_FAILED_BODY.zh: 应用新内容时发生错误（错误代码：{ERROR_CODE}）

PATCH_VERIFICATION_FAILED.en: Downloaded content may have been corrupted. Updated content will need to be downloaded again.
PATCH_VERIFICATION_FAILED.zh: 下载的内容好像出了点问题，需要重新下载。

PEANUT_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}White Radish has studied qigong for many years, but the only technique he's learned is not moving an inch.
PEANUT_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}植物特征：{STAT}白色植物

{FLAVOR}白萝卜学了很多年气功，但他一直都只会一招：纹丝不动。

PEANUT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Stand firmly on the ground, have a decent amount of health and attack zombies.
PEANUT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 稳固地立在地上，拥有一定血量并攻击僵尸。

PEANUT_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Heals to full health, gains an armor helmet and shoots a barrage of peas.
PEANUT_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}治愈自己，获得一个盔甲头盔，发射一连串的豌豆。

PEANUT_TOOLTIP.en: A wall plant that attack nearby zombies
PEANUT_TOOLTIP.zh: 稳固地立在地上，拥有一定血量并攻击僵尸。

PEAPOD_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Having studied Quantum Spatial Mechanics in Clown College, Pea Pod has been amusing families of all ages.
PEAPOD_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}攻击细节：{STAT}普通（对于每个豌豆）
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}更多豌豆，更高攻速

{FLAVOR}在小丑学院学习量子力学之后，豌豆荚终于会讲全年龄向的笑话了。

PEAPOD_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Pea Pods can be planted in the same space for up to 5 times the destruction.
PEAPOD_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 豌豆荚能在同一个格子种植，最高可达原先 5 倍的火力。

PEAPOD_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Summons a giant Peashooter that shoots five giant peas.
PEAPOD_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}召唤一株巨大的豌豆射手，发射五颗巨型豌豆。

PEAPOD_PLANTFOOD.en: Monstrous Peashooter head emerges and shoots 5 giant peas.
PEAPOD_PLANTFOOD.zh: 地下会钻出大豌豆头，发射五颗大豌豆。

PEAPOD_TOOLTIP.en: Plant multiple times on the same spot to multiply damage
PEAPOD_TOOLTIP.zh: 原地多次种植以造成多倍伤害

PEASHOOTER_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}"What is it like being famous?" asked the Peashooter while sipping his bottled water, "I can't talk right now, I'm finishing my merchandising deal. Hold my fir coat."
PEASHOOTER_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}“问我成名的滋味如何？”豌豆射手慢慢地饮了一口茶，“我现在没空告诉你这个，我正在整理我的商业合同。还有，帮我保管一下我的外套。”

PEASHOOTER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Peashooters are your first line of defense. They shoot peas at attacking zombies.
PEASHOOTER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 豌豆射手是你的第一道防线。他们会发射豌豆攻击僵尸。

PEASHOOTER_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Shoots a barrage of fast peas.
PEASHOOTER_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}发射一连串高速豌豆。

PEASHOOTER_PLANTFOOD.en: Fires off a stream of peas, adding up to a lot of damage.
PEASHOOTER_PLANTFOOD.zh: 发射一大波豌豆，造成巨大伤害。

PENNY_SHIELD_DESCRIPTION.en: Creates a {HEALTH} health shield every {TIME} seconds!
PENNY_SHIELD_DESCRIPTION.zh: 每 {TIME} 秒创造一面生命值为 {HEALTH} 的护盾！

PENNY_SHIELD_MULTIPLE_DESCRIPTION.en: Creates {NUMBER} shields with {HEALTH} health every {TIME} seconds!
PENNY_SHIELD_MULTIPLE_DESCRIPTION.zh: 每 {TIME} 秒创造 {NUMBER} 面生命值为 {HEALTH} 的护盾！

PEPPERMINT_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Lily of Pharmacy has been learning medicine since she was young, hoping to save the wounded. But for zombies, death might be their only solution.
PEPPERMINT_DESCRIPTION.zh: 芦藜药师从小学医，希望可以救死扶伤，但对于僵尸，可能死亡才是解脱。

PEPPERMINT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Lily of Pharmacy lob poisons and slow zombies
PEPPERMINT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 可对射程内的僵尸造成伤害并附加中毒效果

PEPPERMINT_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Launches multiple poisons at every zombie, slowing them.

PEPPERMINT_TOOLTIP.zh: 可对射程内的僵尸造成伤害并附加中毒效果

PEPPERPULT_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Some say Pepper-pult is a hot head. Some find his fiery disposition off-putting. But the truth is, he's just very focused and determined. He loves what he does. He appreciates everything he has. "I came from the weedy side of the lawn," Pepper-pult explains. "I worked hard to pull myself up by my roots. I'm a self-made pepper and I don't take a single thing for granted."
PEPPERPULT_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}免疫被冻结
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}可以温暖附近的植物

{FLAVOR}有人说辣椒投手是个暴脾气。他们觉得他的爆脾气令人不悦。但事实是，他只是过于专注和坚定。他热爱他的工作，并感激着他拥有的一切事物。“我来自那杂草丛生的草坪，”辣椒投手解释道。“我努力工作只为提升自我。我是个只依靠自己奋斗的甜椒，我从不对任何一件事想当然。”

PEPPERPULT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Pepper-pults lob flaming peppers at zombies and keep nearby plants warm.
PEPPERPULT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 辣椒投手会向僵尸投掷燃烧的甜椒，还能温暖周围的植物。

PEPPERPULT_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Lobs several giant fire peppers at random zombies that deal moderate splash damage on impact.
PEPPERPULT_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}随机投掷数枚巨型火辣椒，撞击造成中等的溅射伤害。

PEPPERPULT_PLANTFOOD.en: Lobs massive explosive peppers at random targets on the lawn, while melting nearby ice.
PEPPERPULT_PLANTFOOD.zh: 在草坪上随机位置投掷大甜椒，同时融化周围冰块。

PEPPERPULT_TOOLTIP.en: Lobs flaming peppers at zombies and warms nearby plants
PEPPERPULT_TOOLTIP.zh: 向僵尸投掷火焰甜椒，并且可以温暖附近的植物

PERFUMESHROOM_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Perfume-shrooms emit a pure, concentrated mist of aerosolized love.
PERFUMESHROOM_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}使用：{STAT}可以影响一排内的所有恐龙
{FLAVOR}香水菇散散发出的雾，是浓浓的、纯纯的爱。

PERFUMESHROOM_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Perfume-shrooms enchant dinosaurs and charm them into working against the zombies.
PERFUMESHROOM_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 香水菇会给恐龙洗脑，让它们与僵尸反目成仇。

PERFUMESHROOM_TOOLTIP.zh: 迷住恐龙，使他们对抗僵尸

PERK_SELECTION_CHILIBEAN_LOST_WARNING.en: Losing a Chili Bean counts as losing a plant. Do you still wish to use this perk?
PERK_SELECTION_CHILIBEAN_LOST_WARNING.zh: 失去巴豆会被算作失去一株植物。你仍然想使用此增益吗？

PERK_SELECTION_GOLDBLOOM_LOST_WARNING.en: Using a Goldbloom counts as losing a plant. Do you still wish to use this perk?
PERK_SELECTION_GOLDBLOOM_LOST_WARNING.zh: 使用黄金蓓蕾会被算作失去一株植物。你仍然想使用此增益吗？

PERK_SELECTION_HYPNOSHROOM_LOST_WARNING.en: Losing a Hypnoshroom counts as losing a plant. Do you still wish to use this perk?
PERK_SELECTION_HYPNOSHROOM_LOST_WARNING.zh: 失去魅惑菇会被算作失去一株植物。你仍然想使用此增益吗？

PERK_SELECTION_JALAPENO_PLANTS_LOST_WARN.en: Exploding a Jalapeno counts as losing a plant. Do you still wish to use this perk?
PERK_SELECTION_JALAPENO_PLANTS_LOST_WARN.zh: 火爆辣椒爆炸会被算作失去一株植物。你仍然想使用此增益吗？

PERK_SELECTION_MINE_PLANTS_LOST_WARNING.en: Exploding a Potato Mine counts as losing a plant. Do you still wish to use this perk?
PERK_SELECTION_MINE_PLANTS_LOST_WARNING.zh: 土豆地雷爆炸会被算作失去一株植物。你仍然想使用此增益吗？

PERK_SELECTION_NO_PERKS_WARNING.en:
You haven't selected a FREE Perk!
Are you sure you want to continue?
PERK_SELECTION_NO_PERKS_WARNING.zh:
你似乎还并未选择免费的增益！
确定不选择一个吗？

PERK_SELECTION_SQUASH_LOST_WARNING.en: Using a Squash counts as losing a plant. Do you still wish to use this perk?
PERK_SELECTION_SQUASH_LOST_WARNING.zh: 使用倭瓜会被算作失去一株植物。你仍然想使用此增益吗？

PERK_SELECTION_TUMBLEWEED_LOST_WARNING.en: Using a Tumbleweed counts as losing a plant. Do you still wish to use this perk?
PERK_SELECTION_TUMBLEWEED_LOST_WARNING.zh: 使用风滚草会被算作失去一株植物。你仍然想使用此增益吗？

PERM_LAWN_MOWER_TUTORIAL_1.zh: 你的割草机救了你一命！

PERM_LAWN_MOWER_TUTORIAL_2.en: Save your brains and gas up another!
PERM_LAWN_MOWER_TUTORIAL_2.zh: 保护你的脑子，给另一台割草机加油！

PHANTASMAGNOLIA_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}ineffective against mechanical zombies and has reduced effect on large zombies
{FLAVOR}"Phantas Magnolia is a stunning, radiant, ethereal, breathtaking, absolutely gorgeous beauty... Wait, why did I just say that?"
PHANTASMAGNOLIA_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}致幻对机械类僵尸无效，对大体型僵尸效果减弱
{FLAVOR}“致幻木兰是一株花容月貌，天生丽质，出水芙蓉，倾国倾城，闭月羞花的一株植物......咦，我刚才为什么要这么说？”

PHANTASMAGNOLIA_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Phantas Magnolias blow phantasmal bubbles that reverse zombie direction, causing them to walk backwards.
PHANTASMAGNOLIA_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 致幻木兰能吹出致幻气泡使僵尸迷失方向，使它们反向移动。

PHANTASMAGNOLIA_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Launches a massive phantasmal bubble that forces all zombies on the lawn to walk backwards for a short duration.
PHANTASMAGNOLIA_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}发射一个巨型致幻气泡，使草坪上的所有僵尸在短时间内反向移动。

PHANTASMAGNOLIA_TOOLTIP.en: Blows bubbles that reverse zombie direction
PHANTASMAGNOLIA_TOOLTIP.zh: 吹出让僵尸反向行动的气泡

PHATBEET1_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Phat Beet has been known to drop sick rhymes, dope grooves, and highly satisfactory jams, often within seconds of each other.
PHATBEET1_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}虽然魔音甜菜演奏的旋律令人恶心，但是其做出的美味果酱令人垂涎三尺。

PHATBEET1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Phat Beets thump out damage every second.
PHATBEET1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 魔音甜菜每秒造成一次伤害。

PHATBEET1_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Thump the ground, dealing damage to surrounding zombies.
PHATBEET1_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}重击地面，对周围的僵尸造成伤害。

PHATBEET1_TOOLTIP.en: Thumps out damage every few seconds
PHATBEET1_TOOLTIP.zh: 每隔几秒可以重击一次

PHATBEET_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Lotus Root is a hardcore environmentalist. It always yearns to fire when smog is in the air.
PHATBEET_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}莲藕射手可以像双发豌豆一样向僵尸发射两枚水滴

PHATBEET_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Lotus Shooter can shoot 2 water droplets at zombies
PHATBEET_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 莲藕射手可以向僵尸发射水滴

PHATBEET_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: Repeater but with knockback effect, how cool!

PINATA_ARENA_ELITE_T10_DESC.zh: 竞技场 - 精英彩陶特惠！

PINATA_ARENA_PRO_T50.zh: 竞技场职业表现捆绑包！

PINATA_ARENA_PRO_T50_DESC.zh: 竞技场职业表现捆绑包特惠

PINATA_HUNT_REFRESH_BODY.en: Spend gems to refresh all piñatas, or watch an advertisement to refresh one piñata.
PINATA_HUNT_REFRESH_BODY.zh: 你可以花费钻石来刷新所有彩陶；也可以观看广告来刷新一份彩陶。

PINATA_HUNT_TOOLTIP_DESCRIPTION.en: Replaying any world level awards a piñata from that world. Get more when the timer resets!
PINATA_HUNT_TOOLTIP_DESCRIPTION.zh: 重新游玩某个世界的关卡，就能获得那个世界的彩陶。等计时器重置后，还能获取更多奖励！

PIRATE_LEVEL_NAME.zh: 海盗港湾 - 第 {LEVEL_NUMBER} 天

PLANTAGENET_LEVEL_NAME.zh: 金雀花王朝 - 第 {LEVEL_NUMBER} 天

PLANTAGENET_LEVEL_NAME_1.en: House of Plantagenet - Day {LEVEL_NUMBER} - Decline of Dynasty
PLANTAGENET_LEVEL_NAME_1.zh: 金雀花王朝 - 第 {LEVEL_NUMBER} 天 - 王朝衰落

PLANTAGENET_LEVEL_NAME_10.en: House of Plantagenet - Day {LEVEL_NUMBER} - Space Chaos
PLANTAGENET_LEVEL_NAME_10.zh: 金雀花王朝 - 第 {LEVEL_NUMBER} 天 - 时空混乱

PLANTAGENET_LEVEL_NAME_11.en: House of Plantagenet - Night {LEVEL_NUMBER} - Psychedelic Circle
PLANTAGENET_LEVEL_NAME_11.zh: 金雀花王朝 - 第 {LEVEL_NUMBER} 夜 - 迷幻法阵

PLANTAGENET_LEVEL_NAME_12.en: House of Plantagenet - Night {LEVEL_NUMBER} - Empire of Giants
PLANTAGENET_LEVEL_NAME_12.zh: 金雀花王朝 - 第 {LEVEL_NUMBER} 夜 - 巨人帝国

PLANTAGENET_LEVEL_NAME_13.en: House of Plantagenet - Night {LEVEL_NUMBER} - Joined Forces
PLANTAGENET_LEVEL_NAME_13.zh: 金雀花王朝 - 第 {LEVEL_NUMBER} 夜 - 强强联手

PLANTAGENET_LEVEL_NAME_14.en: House of Plantagenet - Night {LEVEL_NUMBER} - Horizontal Warrior
PLANTAGENET_LEVEL_NAME_14.zh: 金雀花王朝 - 第 {LEVEL_NUMBER} 夜 - 横排战士

PLANTAGENET_LEVEL_NAME_15.en: House of Plantagenet - Night {LEVEL_NUMBER} - Fatan Synergy
PLANTAGENET_LEVEL_NAME_15.zh: 金雀花王朝 - 第 {LEVEL_NUMBER} 夜 - 法坦协同

PLANTAGENET_LEVEL_NAME_16.en: House of Plantagenet - Day {LEVEL_NUMBER} - Purple Dawn

PLANTAIN_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}A stable plant, maintaining an effective attack distance.

PLANTAIN_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Plantains attack targets that are neither very far nor very close to it. Plantains are also a good helper when a huge wave of zombies arrives.
PLANTAIN_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 芭蕉会攻击离它不是很远也不是很近的目标，在一大波僵尸到来时，芭蕉也是个好帮手。

PLANTAIN_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Causes the zombies in front to be infected by suns. Killing them within 10 seconds will drop 75 Suns.
PLANTAIN_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}扇出龙卷风攻击所在行前方的僵尸，10 秒内消灭命中的僵尸将掉落阳光。

PLANTAIN_TOOLTIP.en: Attack zombies within a few tiles in front.
PLANTAIN_TOOLTIP.zh: 近距离攻击前方几格内的僵尸。

PLANTERN_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Range: {STAT}1 Row
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}Let you see clearly what's in the fog

{FLAVOR}Plantern hates science, that's what he does. Other plants absorb light and emit oxygen while Plantern absorb darkness and emit light. He once said frankly: "I don't say anything like 'witchcraft and magic'. I only use the word 'dark force'." I just... I think I have said enough.
PLANTERN_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}范围：{STAT}一排
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}让你看清雾中的东西

{FLAVOR}路灯花蔑视科学，他就这样。其他植物吸收光可以排出氧气，路灯花都吸收黑暗发出光。路灯花曾就此坦言：“我不说什么‘巫术魔法’之类的东西，我只使用‘黑暗原力’这个词，我只是……我认为我已经说的够多的了。”

PLANTERN_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Plantern illuminates nearby area, allowing you to see clearly in the fog
PLANTERN_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 驱雾路灯花可照亮附近一片区域，让你看清雾中的东西

PLANTERN_TOOLTIP.zh: 照亮附近一片区域，让你看清雾中的东西

PLUMMET_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}grows with attack count, gaining the ability to knock back, stun, and lower zombie defense
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}deals bonus damage to grid items and can target Privacy Screens
{FLAVOR}What is Plummet's true specialty? Definitely the rattle-drum. He has beaten the runner-up, Elderbarrier, in every single Rattle-Drum Championship to take the crown. When asked about his thoughts on winning, he simply says: "I just treat smashing zombies exactly like shaking a rattle-drum."
PLUMMET_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}随攻击次数增加而成长，可以击退、眩晕并降低僵尸防御
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}对障碍物造成的伤害提高，能够攻击屏风
{FLAVOR}要问重垂李子最擅长的手艺是什么？那肯定是摇拨浪鼓。每一届的摇拨浪鼓大赛上，他都能击败老对手接骨木拿下冠军。要问他的冠军感想？他只是说：“我只不过是把摇拨浪鼓当成了砸僵尸。”

PLUMMET_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Plummets smash nearby zombies and grow larger.
PLUMMET_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 重垂李子攻击近处的僵尸并成长。

PLUMMET_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Smashes zombies in a forward area, reducing their defense, and summons a Giant Plum.
PLUMMET_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}锤击前方范围内的僵尸，使其防御降低，并召唤巨型李子。

PLUMMET_TOOLTIP.en: Attacks nearby zombies and grows larger
PLUMMET_TOOLTIP.zh: 重垂李子攻击近处的僵尸并强化自身

POISONPEASHOOTER_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Goo Peashooter is a goopy shooter. See? See how that works? It's a play on words. Words are often playful, folks!
POISONPEASHOOTER_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}谁都无法想象毒液豌豆会做出这样疯狂的举动，甚至连他自己都不知道。在植物眼中他就是个疯子，但是在他的眼中，这个是时尚。你知道他做的是什么吗？就是做夸张的动作逗别人笑罢了。

POISONPEASHOOTER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Goo Peashooters shoot poison peas at zombies, poisoning them as well as slowing them down.
POISONPEASHOOTER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 毒液豌豆射手可以向僵尸发射毒豌豆，让它们中毒并减速。

POISONPEASHOOTER_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Summons a large ball of poison that deals damage, knock back, and poison all zombies on the lawn.
POISONPEASHOOTER_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}召唤一枚巨大的毒球，对草坪上的所有僵尸造成伤害、击退和中毒效果。

POISONVINE_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Green Snake Vine sometimes thought he was a real snake, until one day he actually grew a tail with a mouth.
POISONVINE_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}青蛇藤蔓有时候会觉得自己是一条真的蛇，直到有一天真的长出了一根会开口的尾巴。

POISONVINE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Green Snake Vines can be planted on top of other plants to provide increased defense and an additional poisonous attack.
POISONVINE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 青蛇藤蔓可以种在其他植物上面，增强他们的攻击和防御，还可以发射毒气子弹。

POISONVINE_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Fires a poison orb that create a 3x3 poison gas explosion on impact, dealing continuous damage.
POISONVINE_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}发射毒球，击中僵尸时会产生范围为 3x3 的毒气爆炸，持续造成伤害。

POISONVINE_TOOLTIP.zh: 保护其他植物，同时发射毒气子弹

POKRA1_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Pokra’s scrappy, she’s a fighter, she’s not afraid to jab below the belt to get the job done. She won’t, because that would be cheating, but she’s not afraid to. “Just so we’re clear,” she says with a resolute glint in her eye.
POKRA1_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}尖刺秋葵魄力十足。她是个能打的斗士，为了赢得胜利，她毫不惧怕使用些肮脏卑鄙的手段来痛击她的对手，但她不会这样做，因为她不想藐视规则。但她用得起，也丝毫不会畏惧。“先把话挑明了才行，”她一边说着，眼角边闪着坚毅的亮光。

POKRA1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Pokras deliver piercing, zombie-stalling jabs that add up to a powerful spike launch, then they rest momentarily before starting again.
POKRA1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 尖刺秋葵可以连续穿透僵尸戳出刺拳，使其毒缓。多次刺拳叠加，可以发射强力毒刺。每次发射完都会休息片刻才能再次开始攻击。

POKRA1_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Launches several powerful spikes that both pierces and slows zombies.
POKRA1_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}发射数道强大的尖刺，既能刺穿僵尸，又能减慢僵尸的速度。

POKRA_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}When asked if she is a doctor, she always replies, "I don’t want to be a doctor," just leave it to Ooloong Peach.
POKRA_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}问她是不是医生，她总是回答，我不想当医生，交给桃桃乌龙吧。

POKRA_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Heavenly Peachs explode once placed; damaging zombies in 10x10 area.
POKRA_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 蟠桃炸弹一旦被放下就会蓄力对10×10范围内的僵尸造成中等伤害。

POPCAP_GAMES_PRESENTS.en:
PopCap Games Presents
Created by SHUTTLE Production Team
POPCAP_GAMES_PRESENTS.zh:
PopCap Games 出品
SHUTTLE 制作组呈现

POPPINPOPPIES_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Lil' Buddy: {STAT}Lil' Buddy inflicts "Addiction" effect on zombies that eat it or any vine plants on it.

{KEYWORD}Addiction: {STAT}Increasing their eating speed by 300 percent and reducing their eating damage by 50 percent. Additionally, affected zombies will continuously receive true damage based on a certain percentage of their own total health.

{FLAVOR}Poppin' Poppies is the most notorious gang leader on the West Coast, with countless minions. However, she is not on the FBI's investigation list, mainly because the FBI team responsible for her has been wiped out by her crew. When asked why she's never been caught, she just smiles and says, "My descendants are endless."

{KEYWORD}Programmer: {STAT}jaynkrow
POPPINPOPPIES_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}“小伙伴”：{STAT}“小伙伴”可以使啃食它以及种植在它身上的藤蔓植物的僵尸获得【成瘾】效果。
{KEYWORD}成瘾：{STAT}啃食速度提升 300 %，啃食伤害降低 50 %，并会持续受到基于其总生命值百分比的真实伤害。

{FLAVOR}热舞罂粟是西海岸最臭名昭著的帮派头目，有着无数小弟，但 FBI 调查对象中并不包括她，主要原因是负责调查她的 FBI 小队已经被她的小弟灭了。当别人问她为什么不会被抓，她只是笑笑，说：“子子孙孙无穷匮也”。

{KEYWORD}代码：{STAT}jaynkrow

POPPINPOPPIES_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Every few seconds, Poppin' Poppies tosses a poppy shell to her left and right, each summoning a Lil' Buddy. New Lil' Buddies replace old ones. After summoning a total of 4 Lil' Buddies, she dies.
POPPINPOPPIES_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 热舞罂粟每隔数秒都会向自身左右两侧各投掷一个罂粟壳，每个罂粟壳可召唤一名“小伙伴”。当左侧或右侧的小伙伴消失时，热舞罂粟会再次投出罂粟壳召唤“小伙伴”。召唤满 4 名后，自身死亡。

POPPINPOPPIES_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Resets her Lil' Buddy summon count and tosses two additional poppy shells to random locations on the lawn.
POPPINPOPPIES_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}刷新自身生成“小伙伴”的次数，并向场上任意位置抛出两个罂粟壳。

POPPINPOPPIES_TOOLTIP.en: Tosses poppy shells to her sides, summoning Lil' Buddies times before dying
POPPINPOPPIES_TOOLTIP.zh: 向两侧投掷罂粟壳，召唤“小伙伴”

POTATOCHIP_DESCRIPTION.en:
{FLAVOR}Potato Chip insists that it's important to go along with where life takes you. A bag, a tube, some kind of other thing? It's all life. "March on and keep a happy face," it says. Potato Chip, however, is not familiar with the terrifying concept of "crunch."

{KEYWORD}Origin: {STAT}PvZ 2: Reflourished
POTATOCHIP_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{FLAVOR}薯片坚信，随遇而安非常重要。无论是在袋子里、圆筒里，还是其他什么东西里？那都是生活。“昂首前行，笑口常开，”它说。然而，薯片还不熟悉“被嚼碎”这个可怕的概念。

{KEYWORD}归属：{STAT}PvZ 2 Reflourished

POTATOCHIP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Potato Chip crumbles on contact, creating a small explosion that deals little damage.
POTATOCHIP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 薯片会在接触时碎裂，产生小范围爆炸并造成少量伤害。

POTATOCHIP_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Spawns a dozen copies of itself.
POTATOCHIP_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}生成一打自己的复制体，并优先占据草坪右侧的格子。

POTATOCHIP_TOOLTIP.en: Explodes on contact, doing chip damage to a tile
POTATOCHIP_TOOLTIP.zh: 接触时爆炸，对单个格子造成微量伤害

POTATOMINE_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Believe it or not, SPUDOW! did not happen overnight. Having been forced to try out new catchphrases and focus testing as many variations as possible (Tubular? Really?), Potato Mine weeded out the competition to stick with what he knows best.
POTATOMINE_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}使用：{STAT}单次使用，延迟激活
{KEYWORD}范围：{STAT}接触

{FLAVOR}信不信由你，关于爆炸时该发出什么声音，土豆地雷在地下真的会想很久。他把每个新的流行语试了个遍，想看看哪个最合适（水管爆炸的声音？你认真的？）。结果最后，好像还是那熟悉的“砰隆”声战胜了它所有的竞争对手。

POTATOMINE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Potato Mines explode on contact, but they take time to arm. Plant them ahead of zombies.
POTATOMINE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 土豆地雷一经接触就会爆炸，但它需要时间来做好准备。把它放在僵尸前面一些的位置吧。

POTATOMINE_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Immediately arms and spawns multiple copies of itself.
POTATOMINE_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}立即就绪，生成多份自己的复制体。

POTATOMINE_PLANTFOOD.en: Immediately arms itself, and launches out 2 armed clones to random tiles on the lawn.
POTATOMINE_PLANTFOOD.zh: 立即做好准备，向草坪上的随机位置投出两颗已准备好的复制体。

POTATOMINE_TOOLTIP.en: Explodes on contact, but takes time to arm itself
POTATOMINE_TOOLTIP.zh: 在僵尸接触时爆炸，但需要时间来做好准备

POTIONTOUGHNESS1.en: Potion zombies with pink evil potion/fairy fog
POTIONTOUGHNESS1.zh: 被粉色邪恶药水/迷雾加强

POTIONTOUGHNESS2.en: Potion zombies with pink evil potion/fairy fog
POTIONTOUGHNESS2.zh: 被粉色邪恶药水/迷雾加强

POTIONTOUGHNESS3.en: Potion zombies with pink evil potion/fairy fog
POTIONTOUGHNESS3.zh: 被粉色邪恶药水/迷雾加强

POWERLILY_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}From seedling to sapling, to full grown foliage, Power Lily's experience as a life coach has shown her the best way to empower and support plants everywhere.
POWERLILY_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}使用：{STAT}一次性使用，立即生效
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}创造一份叶绿素

{FLAVOR}从种子到小苗，再到大树，能量花有着十足的生活经验来为所有植物提供无穷的力量与支持。

POWERLILY_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Power Lilies create one Plant Food out of thin air.
POWERLILY_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 能量花可以凭空创造一份叶绿素。

POWERLILY_TOOLTIP.en: Creates one Plant Food for use

POWERPLANT_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}范围：{STAT}前方1行
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}持续发射激光，僵尸会被减速

{FLAVOR}皇冠花的花苞中蕴含着无限的能量，只要瞄准目标，再给他一些时间，就能发射恐怖的高能激光。

POWERPLANT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Launch a laser which will be blocked by zombies, and the laser will slow down the zombies
POWERPLANT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 发射激光，会被僵尸阻挡，激光会减速僵尸

POWERPLANT_TOOLTIP.en: Launch a laser to slow and damage zombies
POWERPLANT_TOOLTIP.zh: 发射激光，会被僵尸阻挡，激光会减速僵尸

POWERTILE_TUTORIAL_1.en: Put Plant Food on a Peashooter
POWERTILE_TUTORIAL_1.zh: 在豌豆射手身上使用叶绿素

POWERTILE_TUTORIAL_3.en: Awesome! You can plant anything on Power Tiles
POWERTILE_TUTORIAL_3.zh: 真棒！你可以在能量地砖上种植任何东西

POWERUP_AWARD_HEADER1.zh: 你得到了 {NUMBER} 个金手指！

POWERUP_BEGHOULED_SHOVEL_DESCRIPTION.en: Use Power Shovel in Beghouled to remove plants and fill in craters!
POWERUP_BEGHOULED_SHOVEL_DESCRIPTION.zh: 使用铁铲指，在宝尸迷阵中移除植物或弹坑！

POWERUP_BEGHOULED_SHUFFLE_DESCRIPTION.en: Use Power Shuffle in Beghouled to shuffle plants for more matches!
POWERUP_BEGHOULED_SHUFFLE_DESCRIPTION.zh: 使用移换指，在宝尸迷阵中移换植物，进行更多搭配！

POWERUP_FLAMETHROWER_DESCRIPTION.en: Hold your finger down to thaw ice and burn zombies in Frostbite Caves!
POWERUP_FLAMETHROWER_DESCRIPTION.zh: 在极寒冰窟中按住手指，融化冰块、灼烧僵尸！

POWERUP_FLICK_DESCRIPTION.en: Swipe a zombie to toss it around. Swipe it twice to send it off the screen!
POWERUP_FLICK_DESCRIPTION.zh: 在僵尸身上划动一次把它扔起来，再划一次把它甩飞出屏幕！

POWERUP_PINCH_DESCRIPTION.en: Pinch a zombie to destroy it!
POWERUP_PINCH_DESCRIPTION.zh: 用手指捏僵尸来消灭他

POWERUP_SNOWBALL_DESCRIPTION.en: Hold your finger down on a zombie to throw chilling snowballs at it!
POWERUP_SNOWBALL_DESCRIPTION.zh: 把你的手指按在僵尸身上，朝它扔冰冷的雪球！

POWERUP_VASEBREAKER_BUTTER_DESCRIPTION.en: Tap to butter a single zombie in Vasebreaker!
POWERUP_VASEBREAKER_BUTTER_DESCRIPTION.zh: 在破罐者中点击一只僵尸，给它涂上黄油！

POWERUP_VASEBREAKER_BUTTER_UNLOCK.en: Complete Egyptian Challenge Pack to unlock.

POWERUP_VASEBREAKER_MOVE_DESCRIPTION.en: Tap to select a vase, tap again to relocate to an empty tile in Vasebreaker!
POWERUP_VASEBREAKER_MOVE_DESCRIPTION.zh: 在破罐者中轻点一个花瓶后，再轻点一块空地，即可移动花瓶！

POWERUP_VASEBREAKER_MOVE_UNLOCK.en: Complete Wave {ENDLESS_WAVE} in Endless to unlock.
POWERUP_VASEBREAKER_MOVE_UNLOCK.zh: 完成无尽第 {ENDLESS_WAVE} 波后解锁。

POWERUP_VASEBREAKER_REVEAL_DESCRIPTION.en: Tap to reveal the contents of one vase in Vasebreaker!
POWERUP_VASEBREAKER_REVEAL_DESCRIPTION.zh: 在破罐者中显示一个花瓶里面的东西！

POWERUP_WIZARDFINGER_DESCRIPTION.en: Hold your finger down on a zombie to electrocute it!
POWERUP_WIZARDFINGER_DESCRIPTION.zh: 把你的手指按在僵尸身上，对它进行电击！

POWERVINE1_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Power Vine's noodly antennae tremble in electric anticipation and he grins, imagining firing laser bolts at zombies in tandem with his brothers.
POWERVINE1_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}与其他电能藤蔓水平或垂直临近的电能藤蔓会形成网络

{FLAVOR}电能藤蔓那对柔软的触角在兴奋的作用下颤抖着。他咧嘴笑着，想像着与他的兄弟密切合作，一起向僵尸发射激光束。

POWERVINE1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Power Vines shoot rapid-fire, high-velocity laser bolts, and can increase their firepower by connecting up in a network.
POWERVINE1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 电能藤蔓可以高频发射高速激光束，而且能互相连接构成网络来提升火力。

POWERVINE1_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Disable nearby mechanical enemies and unleashes a wave of energy bolts. When he's linked with another Power Vine, unleashes 3 waves of energy bolts.
POWERVINE1_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}瘫痪周围的机械类僵尸，释放一波激光束。当链接到另一株电力藤蔓，可以释放 3 波激光束。

POWERVINE1_TOOLTIP.zh: 互相连接成网络，发射激光束

POWERVINE_DESCRIPTION.en:
{STAT}Whenever Celebration Soda Palm is attacked, the soda inside will shaken and inflate. After 10 seconds worth of inflation, the soda will burst though the cap on top, knocking back all zombies three tiles in front of it to the fourth tile. The amount of time needed to inflate will not be reset if zombie attacks are interrupted.

{FLAVOR}Celebration Soda Palm was originally filled with wine, but after being informed it was inappropriate for children to hold wine, he became accustomed to holding soda.
POWERVINE_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}范围：{STAT}前方3格 
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}庆典汽水椰每受到伤害，瓶中的汽水就会震动充气，当充气时长达到10秒时，汽水会冲破瓶盖，将身前3格内的所有僵尸击退到第4格的位置，充气时长不会因为僵尸攻击中断而重置。

{FLAVOR}庆典汽水椰原本装的是酒，不过在被告知装酒是少儿不宜的事之后，他就开始习惯装汽水了。

POWERVINE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: After a while, it will spray soda to repel the zombies in front.
POWERVINE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 一段时间会喷射汽水将前方的僵尸击退

POWERVINE_TOOLTIP.zh: 一段时间会喷射汽水将前方的僵尸击退

PP_LOCKED_PROMPT_INFO.en: Zomboss kidnapped Dave! Penny's Pursuit levels use fuel but each level has perks that make it easier to play! Defeat enough levels for a chance to challenge Zomboss and save Dave!
PP_LOCKED_PROMPT_INFO.zh: 僵王绑架了疯狂戴夫！游玩潘妮的追击关卡需要消耗燃料，但每个关卡都有让游戏更轻松的增益！通过足够多的关卡，就有机会挑战僵王博士，救出戴夫！

PREMIUM_PLANT_QUEST_DESC.en: Check out a Premium plant you don't own! Different Level each day!
PREMIUM_PLANT_QUEST_DESC.zh: 试试可以加强射击类植物的豌豆薄荷，赢取奖励！

PREMIUM_PLANT_QUEST_TITLE.en: Try a Premium Plant for Free!

PREREQ_TEST_01_DESC.en: Whitelist - Player must have Kiwibeast - award Kiwibeast seed Packet
PREREQ_TEST_01_DESC.zh: 白名单 - 玩家必须拥有野兽猕猴桃 - 奖励野兽猕猴桃种子包

PREREQ_TEST_02_DESC.en: Blacklist - Player must not have Hurrikale - award Hurrikale seed packets
PREREQ_TEST_02_DESC.zh: 黑名单 - 玩家不能拥有飓风甘蓝 - 奖励飓风甘蓝种子包

PREREQ_TEST_03_DESC.en: Number of plants owned - must have 10 or more plants - award 50 gems
PREREQ_TEST_03_DESC.zh: 拥有的植物数 - 必须有 10 株或更多植物 - 奖励 50 颗钻石

PREREQ_TEST_04_DESC.en: Number of plants at X level - Player must have 10 plants at Level 3 - award 50 gems
PREREQ_TEST_04_DESC.zh: X 级植物数 - 玩家必须有 10 株 3 级植物 - 奖励 50 颗钻石

PREREQ_TEST_05_DESC.en: Has Spent - Player must have spent - reward pinata_spend pinata
PREREQ_TEST_05_DESC.zh: 消费 - 玩家必须消费过 - 奖励彩陶_消费彩陶

PREREQ_TEST_06_DESC.en: Churn 1 - spender at risk of churn (0.7 or higher) - award pinata_churn
PREREQ_TEST_06_DESC.zh: 流失 1 - 有流失风险（0.7 或更高）的消费者 - 奖励彩陶_流失

PREREQ_TEST_07_DESC.en: Churn 2 - non-spender at risk of churn (0.7 or higher) - award pinata_churn
PREREQ_TEST_07_DESC.zh: 流失 2 - 有流失风险（0.7 或更高）的未消费者 - 奖励彩陶_流失

PREREQ_TEST_08_DESC.en: Days since install - 2 Days - reward pinata_day2
PREREQ_TEST_08_DESC.zh: 安装天数 - 2 天 - 奖励彩陶_第 2 天

PREREQ_TEST_09_DESC.en: Days since install - 7 Days - reward pinata_day7
PREREQ_TEST_09_DESC.zh: 安装天数 - 7 天 - 奖励彩陶_第 7 天

PREREQ_TEST_10_DESC.en: Days since install - 14 Days - reward pinata_day14
PREREQ_TEST_10_DESC.zh: 安装天数 - 14 天 - 奖励彩陶_第 14 天

PREREQ_TEST_11_DESC.en: Currency - Player has <5000 coins, >7Days install - award 5000 coins
PREREQ_TEST_11_DESC.zh: 货币 - 玩家有 <5000 coins, > 安装了 7 天 - 奖励 5000 枚金币

PRIMALPEASHOOTER_COSTUME.zh: B级-原始豌豆射手新年帽装扮

PRIMALPEASHOOTER_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Primal Peashooter may be primitive, but that doesn't stop him from enrolling and excelling in several software development correspondence courses.
PRIMALPEASHOOTER_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}发出的原始豌豆可以击退僵尸

{FLAVOR}原始豌豆射手也许处于落后的时代，但是这并不会阻碍他学习一些软件开发课程。

PRIMALPEASHOOTER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Primal Peashooters shoot heavy peas with a brief stun and occasional knockback at zombies.
PRIMALPEASHOOTER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 原始豌豆射手可以发射沉重的豌豆击晕或击退僵尸。

PRIMALPEASHOOTER_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Shoots several peas that can knock back zombies.
PRIMALPEASHOOTER_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}发射数枚可以击退僵尸的豌豆。

PRIMALPEASHOOTER_TOOLTIP.zh: 发射有强力眩晕效果的豌豆

PRIMALPOTATOMINE_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Primal Potato Mine doesn't consider himself to be primal. As far as he's concerned he's state-of-the-art. And who knows? Maybe he is.
PRIMALPOTATOMINE_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}使用：{STAT}一次性使用，延迟激活
{KEYWORD}范围：{STAT}周围所有区域

{FLAVOR}原始土豆地雷并不认为自己很原始。相反，他认为自己很先进。也许事实就是如此呢？

PRIMALPOTATOMINE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Primal Potato Mines cost more than regular Potato Mines, but they arm more quickly and do damage over a larger area.
PRIMALPOTATOMINE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 原始土豆地雷虽然需要消耗更多的阳光，但他的强大力量会让你觉得物有所值。

PRIMALPOTATOMINE_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Immediately arms and spawns multiple copies of itself.
PRIMALPOTATOMINE_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}立即就绪，生成多份自己的复制体。

PRIMALPOTATOMINE_TOOLTIP.zh: 在僵尸接触时爆炸造成范围伤害，但需要时间来做好准备

PRIMALSUNFLOWER_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Primal Sunflower is new to all this sun-giving business, so be patient with her. She's an early adopter of the all-you-can-stuff-yourself buffet style of sun production.
PRIMALSUNFLOWER_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}阳光产量：{STAT}大阳光

{FLAVOR}原始向日葵才刚学会生产阳光，所以最好别对她那么苛刻吧。她可是自助型阳光生产的早期开拓者。

PRIMALSUNFLOWER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Primal Sunflowers pop out large suns instead of regular ones.
PRIMALSUNFLOWER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 原始向日葵可以产生大号的阳光。

PRIMALSUNFLOWER_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Immediately produces large amount of sun.

PRIMALWALLNUT_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}"Grunt," explains Primal Wall-nut. "Grunt oog grunt-grunt," he goes on to say. "Ook-urg grunty grunt grunt," he concludes. A nut of many opinions, is Primal Wall-nut.
PRIMALWALLNUT_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}“咕哝”，原始坚果墙解释道，“咕哝哝咕哝咕哝，”然后他还接着说“好的，咕哝咕哝咕哝，”他总结道。原始坚果墙确实是个拥有很多观点的坚果呢。

PRIMALWALLNUT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Primal Wall-nuts cost a bit more than typical Wall-nuts, but they can be planted much more quickly.
PRIMALWALLNUT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 原始坚果墙虽然比坚果墙要贵那么一点点，但你可以更频繁地种植他。

PRIMALWALLNUT_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Fully heals itself and gains a thick rock armor.
PRIMALWALLNUT_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}治愈自己，获得一副厚厚的石甲。

PRIMALWALLNUT_TOOLTIP.en: Quick-planting wall that blocks off zombies
PRIMALWALLNUT_TOOLTIP.zh: 阻碍僵尸，可以快速种植

PRODUCT_SHRINKINGVIOLETBUNDLE_DESC.en: Don’t shrink from danger! Power up with Shrinking Violet and 20000 coins!
PRODUCT_SHRINKINGVIOLETBUNDLE_DESC.zh: 在危险面前，你并不渺小！该捆绑包包含金手指、缩小紫罗兰。以及 20000 枚金币！

PRODUCT_SHRINKINGVIOLET_DESCRIPTION.en: Shrinks zombies and makes them weaker!

PRODUCT_SPROUTS5_DESCRIPTION.en: Wow, that's a lot of Sprouts!

PRODUCT_STRAWBURST_DESCRIPTION.zh: 结出具有小、中、大三种不同伤害的草莓！

PRODUCT_SUMMER_BUNDLE_DESCRIPTION.en: Double up with Imitater! Plus 50 Gems and 10,000 coins!
PRODUCT_SUMMER_BUNDLE_DESCRIPTION.zh: 用模仿者来使用两株相同植物！再加上 50 钻石和 1,0000 金币！

PRODUCT_SUNDEWTANGLER_DESCRIPTION.en: MMmm... Nothing like a good Zombie smoothie to start the day!
PRODUCT_SUNDEWTANGLER_DESCRIPTION.zh: 嗯……来一杯僵尸冰沙，开启美好一天！

PRODUCT_SWEETHEARTSNARE_DESCRIPTION.en: Personal space is my love language.

PRODUCT_SWEETPOTATO_DESCRIPTION.en: Zombies will switch lanes to get a bite!
PRODUCT_SWEETPOTATO_DESCRIPTION.zh: 僵尸会为了咬上它一口而移动到该行的！

PRODUCT_SYN_BUNDLE_BRAMBLEBUSH_T15.zh: 莓棘灌木丛协作捆绑包！

PRODUCT_TELEPORTATOMINE_DESCRIPTION.zh: 将僵尸传送到自己的位置并爆炸造成范围伤害，短时间内就能做好准备！

PRODUCT_TELEPORTATOMINE_NAME.zh: 植物 - 传送土豆地雷

PRODUCT_TICKET_STOREFRONT_CONSUME_G150.zh: 超值！36 张竞技场入场券！

PRODUCT_TICKET_STOREFRONT_CONSUME_G75.zh: 太棒了！16 张竞技场入场券！

PRODUCT_TOADSTOOL_DESCRIPTION.en: Devours zombies whole to generate sun!
PRODUCT_TOADSTOOL_DESCRIPTION.zh: 吞食僵尸，咀嚼后产生阳光！

PRODUCT_TOMBTANGLER_DESCRIPTION.en: Slows Zombies and randomly pulls them down!
PRODUCT_TOMBTANGLER_DESCRIPTION.zh: 减速僵尸，随机把它们拖入土中！

PRODUCT_TRANSFORMATION_BUNDLE_DESCRIPTIO.zh: 金缕梅、蟾蜍毒菌和魅惑菇！

PRODUCT_TRANSFORMATION_BUNDLE_NAME.zh: 捆绑包 - 变形捆绑包

PRODUCT_TRICKS_AND_TREATS_BUNDLE_DESCRIP.en: Get tricky with Witch Hazel & Ghost Pepper!
PRODUCT_TRICKS_AND_TREATS_BUNDLE_DESCRIP.zh: 微妙地使用金缕梅和幽灵辣椒！

PRODUCT_TRICKS_AND_TREATS_BUNDLE_NAME.zh: 捆绑包 - 即要糖又捣蛋捆绑包

PRODUCT_TUMBLEWEED_DESCRIPTION.zh: 发射自己，可以反弹，有机率击退僵尸！

PRODUCT_ULTOMATO_DESCRIPTION.zh: 蓄能攻击并于受伤时自爆！

PRODUCT_VAMPORCINI_DESCRIPTION.en: A Defensive plant that drainz Zombies!
PRODUCT_VAMPORCINI_DESCRIPTION.zh: 一株可以榨干僵尸的防御性植物！

PRODUCT_WASABIWHIP_2000_BUNDLE_DESCRIPTI.zh: 用 20000 枚金币鞭打那帮僵尸！

PRODUCT_WASABIWHIP_5000_BUNDLE_DESCRIPTI.en: Power up your Wasabi Whip with 50000 coins!
PRODUCT_WASABIWHIP_5000_BUNDLE_DESCRIPTI.zh: 用 50000 枚金币升级你的炙热山葵！

PRODUCT_WASABIWHIP_5000_BUNDLE_NAME.zh: 捆绑包 - 炙热山葵能量

PRODUCT_WASABIWHIP_DESCRIPTION.zh: 鞭打前方和后方的目标！

PRODUCT_WATERRABBIT_COSTUME.en: S - Tai Chi Clothing + Speical Effects
PRODUCT_WATERRABBIT_COSTUME.zh: S级-兔极太极功夫衫+特效

PRODUCT_WATERRABBIT_DESCRIPTION.en: Body is (90%) water, but Chi, immortal.
PRODUCT_WATERRABBIT_DESCRIPTION.zh: 兔型的身躯，不过由（90% 的）水构成；而“极”，恒久不灭。

PRODUCT_WITCHHAZEL_DESCRIPTION.zh: 随机选取一只僵尸变为小喷菇！

PRODUCT_ZNAKELILY_DESCRIPTION.en: All problems can be transformed into solutions!
PRODUCT_ZNAKELILY_DESCRIPTION.zh: 所有的问题都可以变为答案！

PROGRESSIVE_REGISTRATION_ERROR_EXPIRED_A.en: Your authorization code has expired.  Go back and enter your email again to get a new code.
PROGRESSIVE_REGISTRATION_ERROR_EXPIRED_A.zh: 你的验证码已过期。返回至上一步并重新输入你的邮箱，获取新的验证码。

PROGRESSIVE_REGISTRATION_ERROR_GENERIC.en: Failed to register.  Try again later.

PROGRESSIVE_REGISTRATION_ERROR_SEND_CODE.en: We couldn’t send an email to your email address.
PROGRESSIVE_REGISTRATION_ERROR_SEND_CODE.zh: 我们无法向你的邮箱地址发送邮件。

PROGRESSIVE_REGISTRATION_ERROR_TOO_MANY_.en: We couldn’t send an email to your email address.
PROGRESSIVE_REGISTRATION_ERROR_TOO_MANY_.zh: 我们无法向你的邮箱地址发送邮件。

PROGRESSIVE_REGISTRATION_LINK_PERSONAL_I.en: View our Privacy and Cookie Policy
PROGRESSIVE_REGISTRATION_LINK_PERSONAL_I.zh: 查看我们的隐私和 Cookie 政策

PROGRESSIVE_REGISTRATION_NOTE_CODE_SENT.en:
We sent you an e-mail with a unique code.
Enter the code in the field above to verify your e-mail.
PROGRESSIVE_REGISTRATION_NOTE_CODE_SENT.zh:
我们向你发送了一封邮件，带有独特验证码。
请在上方区域内填入你在邮箱里收到的验证码。

PROGRESSIVE_REGISTRATION_NOTE_CODE_TO_YO.en: We’ll send a unique code to the e-mail address you enter above.
PROGRESSIVE_REGISTRATION_NOTE_CODE_TO_YO.zh: 我们将向你在上方输入的邮箱地址发送一份独特验证码

PROGRESSIVE_REGISTRATION_NOTE_PERSONAL_I.zh: 我们不会分享您的任何个人信息

PROGRESSIVE_REGISTRATION_SUCCESS_NOTE.en: Your email has been successfully registered and linked to your game profile.
PROGRESSIVE_REGISTRATION_SUCCESS_NOTE.zh: 你的邮箱已成功注册，并已与你的游戏帐户绑定。

PROGRESS_BEACH_DANGER_DESC.en: This party never stops. Just be careful not to wipe out!
PROGRESS_BEACH_DANGER_DESC.zh: 派对永不停歇，只需当心自己不被赶走即可！

PROGRESS_COWBOY_DANGER_DESC.en: It's a never-ending hootenanny. Can you handle it?
PROGRESS_COWBOY_DANGER_DESC.zh: 这是一场永无尽头的乡间音乐会。你能合理收场吗？

PROGRESS_DARK_DANGER_DESC.en: Test your mettle in a battle for the ages. The Dark Ages, that is!
PROGRESS_DARK_DANGER_DESC.zh: 在这个年代的沙场中磨练你的意志。这里，是黑暗时代！

PROGRESS_DINO_DANGER_DESC.en: It's a never-ending martial marsh! Survive it!
PROGRESS_DINO_DANGER_DESC.zh: 这里是一处永不消停的战争泥沼！好好活下去！

PROGRESS_EGYPT_DANGER_DESC.en: There's more zombies than we can keep under wraps in this pyramid. Can you dig it?
PROGRESS_EGYPT_DANGER_DESC.zh: 这个金字塔有着比我们预想着还要多的僵尸，你能把他们全数掘尽吗？

PROGRESS_EIGHTIES_DANGER_DESC.en: Eternal Eighties zombies assail you! You're not gonna take it!
PROGRESS_EIGHTIES_DANGER_DESC.zh: 没完没了的魔音僵尸始终在抨击着你！你不能将这些批评意见全盘采纳！

PROGRESS_FUTURE_DANGER_DESC.en: Experience your Terror from Tomorrow, today. It's time for battle!
PROGRESS_FUTURE_DANGER_DESC.zh: 今天，就来感受明日的恐惧吧！是时候开战了！

PROGRESS_ICEAGE_DANGER_DESC.en: In this frozen fracas, it's chill or be chilled!
PROGRESS_ICEAGE_DANGER_DESC.zh: 如何在冷酷的战斗中抉择，冰杀对手亦或就此冻死！

PROGRESS_ITEM_HIGHEST_CHALLENGE_LEVEL.zh: 无尽地带：达到了最高分

PROGRESS_LOSTCITY_DANGER_DESC.en: Endless zombies are out to ruin your day. Don't lose your way!
PROGRESS_LOSTCITY_DANGER_DESC.zh: 无穷的僵尸糟蹋着你的每一天。不要就此迷路！

PROGRESS_MODERN_DANGER_DESC.en: It's zombies from now, then, and later, all at once! DOOOOM!
PROGRESS_MODERN_DANGER_DESC.zh: 古往今来的僵尸会涌向你从今往后的每个时刻！这就是劫数！

PROGRESS_MODERN_DANGER_TITLE.en: Challenge Highway to the Danger Room!

PROGRESS_PIRATE_DANGER_DESC.en: Scallywags, avast! How long can you last?
PROGRESS_PIRATE_DANGER_DESC.zh: 无赖，停止靠近！你可以坚持守卫多久呢？

PROMPT_FOR_APP_TRACKING.en: Tracking allows us to offer you relevant & rewarded ads more often, and helps us to improve the app. If disabled, the ads you see will be less relevant to you. Whichever option you choose, we’re so excited to have you play the game!
PROMPT_FOR_APP_TRACKING.zh: 跟踪使我们能更频繁地向你提供与你相关且有奖励的广告，而且能帮助我们提升这个程序。如果关闭了，你看到的广告会与你没那么相关。不管你如何选择，我们很高兴你能来玩这个游戏！

PROMPT_FOR_APP_TRACKING_DISABLED_BODY.en: To enable this setting and receive third-party ads that are relevant to your interests, please enable Tracking in your Apple iOS settings.
PROMPT_FOR_APP_TRACKING_DISABLED_BODY.zh: 要启用此设置并接收与你兴趣相关的第三方广告，请在 Apple iOS 设置中启用跟踪。

PROMPT_FOR_APP_TRACKING_DISABLED_HEADER.zh: 正在启用第三方供应商的定向广告推送

PROMPT_FOR_TARGETED_ADS.en:
We rely on third-party partners to deliver personalized in-game ads.
If disabled, you still will see third-party ads, but these ads may not be as relevant to you. You can change your preference by visiting your settings. See EA's Privacy Policy for more details.
PROMPT_FOR_TARGETED_ADS.zh:
我们依赖第三方合作商的服务来为你在游戏内推送定制化广告。
如果禁用此选项，你仍然会看到此类第三方广告，但可能会不再与你有密切关联。你可以在隐私设置中修改你的偏好。更多细节详见《EA 隐私和 Cookie 政策》。

PROMPT_FOR_TARGETED_ADS_HEADER.en: Targeted Advertising Provided by Third Parties
PROMPT_FOR_TARGETED_ADS_HEADER.zh: 第三方供应商的定向广告推送

PROSPECTOR_INHIBITOR_DESCRIPTION.zh: 把关卡中的勘探者僵尸替换掉！

PUFFBALL1_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}"You think cuz I'm Puffball that I'm puffy, that I'm soft, that I'm insubstantial?" fumes Puffball. "You need to change that thinking. PRONTO."

PUFFBALL1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Puffballs explode when planted, stunning and poisoning zombies in three columns.
PUFFBALL1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 马勃可以在种下时爆炸，眩晕并毒害周围 3 排的僵尸。

PUFFBALL1_TOOLTIP.zh: 眩晕范围内僵尸并使他们中毒

PUFFBALL_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}"I've always enjoyed releasing heavy fumes," says Gloom Shroom. "I know a lot of people aren't cool with that. They say it's rude or that it smells bad. All I can say is, would you rather have your brain eaten by zombies?"
PUFFBALL_DESCRIPTION.zh: “我一直喜欢释放浓烟，”忧郁蘑菇说。 “我知道很多人对此并不感冒。他们说这很粗鲁或闻起来很糟糕。我只能说，你愿意让僵尸吃掉你的脑子吗？”

PUFFBALL_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Gloom-shroom release heavy fumes in an area around themselves.
PUFFBALL_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 忧郁蘑菇可以向自己周围的区域喷射浓烟

PUFFBALL_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}向草坪上各个方向喷射大量孢子弹幕，威力惊人。

PUFFBALL_TOOLTIP.en: Spray smoke into the area around themselves
PUFFBALL_TOOLTIP.zh: 向自己周围的区域喷射浓烟

PUFFSHROOM_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Puff-shroom is hip to all the latest social networks. He loves to surf Sporebook, FungusedIn and ShroomstaGram. But sometimes he misses the simple camaraderie of a good ol' fashioned Lawn Area Network party.
PUFFSHROOM_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}只能存活一段时间

{FLAVOR}小喷菇对各种现代社交平台了如指掌。他没事儿就喜欢刷刷枝乎、微杏、小红花。不过，他偶尔也会怀念起昔日与朋友们一起橘芋网对战的美好时光。

PUFFSHROOM_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Puff-shrooms are short-range shooters that last for a limited time.
PUFFSHROOM_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 小喷菇是个能暂时存在的短程射手。

PUFFSHROOM_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}All Puff-shroom on the lawn will shoot a spore barrage and resets their life duration.
PUFFSHROOM_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}草坪上的所有小喷菇一起发射孢子弹幕，并重置它们的生命时间。

PUFFSHROOM_TOOLTIP.en: Short-range shooter, lasts for a limited time
PUFFSHROOM_TOOLTIP.zh: 短程射手，存在时间有限

PUMPKIN_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Pumpkin may be a hollowed-out shell, but he still has a rich inner life filled with feelings, fantasies and surprisingly disappointing opinions.
PUMPKIN_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}它虽然看起来只是一副被挖空了的南瓜空壳，但你也许永远想不到它的内心世界有多么的丰富而充盈。七彩的情感、美妙的幻想，以及那些丧到令人发指的想法。

PUMPKIN_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Pumpkins can be planted on top of other plants to provide a tough additional layer of armor.
PUMPKIN_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 南瓜壳可以种植在其他植物之上，提供一层坚硬的额外护甲。

PUMPKIN_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Creates a hard armor shell, that can absorb additional damage.
PUMPKIN_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}创造一副坚硬的盔甲外壳，吸收额外伤害。

PUNKSHOCKER_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}Generates two lightning bolts that paralyze zombies.
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}After sustaining a certain number of hits, zombies trigger an Arc Shock: they become stunned and paralyzed. Paralyzed zombies are slowed.
{FLAVOR}Getting close to these amphibious anarchists makes your face tingle. A group of them inevitably gets carried away, turning the lawn into a chaotic dance floor of electrocuted zombies.
PUNKSHOCKER_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}可以制造两道带有麻痹效果的闪电。
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}每个僵尸被闪电击中三次后就会受到电弧冲击：陷入1.5秒的眩晕和5秒的麻痹状态，麻痹状态下僵尸减速40%。
{FLAVOR}接近这些两栖无政府主义者会让你的面部刺痛。他们中的一群植物不可避免地会被带动，营造一个电击僵尸的混乱舞池。

PUNKSHOCKER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 可以制造两道带有麻痹效果的闪电。

PUNKSHOCKER_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Create a storm cloud that damages random zombies and leaves behind Lightning Spikes on the lawn.
PUNKSHOCKER_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}召唤一个带有特殊雷电的云团在草坪上移动，电击僵尸并留下电击尖刺。

PUNKSHOCKER_TOOLTIP.zh: 可以制造两道带有麻痹效果的闪电

PURCHASE_COINS_IN_APP_STORE.en: Visit the App Store to purchase coins?
PURCHASE_COINS_IN_APP_STORE.zh: 想去 App Store 购买更多金币吗？

PURCHASE_COSTUMES_WITH_GEMS.en: Plant costumes are not shared with all profiles.
PURCHASE_COSTUMES_WITH_GEMS.zh: 植物装扮不会与所有档案共享。

PURCHASE_CROSS_PROFILE_BUNDLE.en: Purchased Plants and Upgrades can be claimed by any of your additional profiles!
PURCHASE_CROSS_PROFILE_BUNDLE.zh: 其它档案也可以领取你购买的植物和升级道具！

PURCHASE_CROSS_PROFILE_KEYGATE.en: Purchased Key Gates can be claimed by any of your additional profiles!
PURCHASE_CROSS_PROFILE_KEYGATE.zh: 其它档案也可以进入你内购解锁的大门！

PURCHASE_CROSS_PROFILE_PLANT.en: Purchased Plants can be claimed by any of your additional profiles!
PURCHASE_CROSS_PROFILE_PLANT.zh: 其它档案也可以领取你内购解锁的植物！

PURCHASE_CROSS_PROFILE_STARGATE.en: Purchased Worlds can be claimed by any of your additional profiles!
PURCHASE_CROSS_PROFILE_STARGATE.zh: 其它档案也可以进入你内购解锁的世界！

PURCHASE_CROSS_PROFILE_UPGRADE.en: Purchased Upgrades can be claimed by any of your additional profiles!
PURCHASE_CROSS_PROFILE_UPGRADE.zh: 其它档案也可以领取你内购解锁的升级道具！

PURCHASE_ERROR.en: Unable to contact store at this time.  Please try again later.
PURCHASE_ERROR.zh: 现在无法联络商店。请稍后再试。

PURCHASE_ERROR_BODY.en:
Unable to complete purchase.
Please try again.
PURCHASE_ERROR_BODY.zh:
无法完成购买。
请稍后再试。

PURCHASE_ERROR_DEFERRED_TRANSACTION_CONF.en: You already have an in-progress transaction for the requested product.
PURCHASE_ERROR_DEFERRED_TRANSACTION_CONF.zh: 对于要求的产品，你已经有进行中的交易。

PURCHASE_ERROR_DEFERRED_TRANSACTION_CONF.en: You already have an in-progress transaction for the requested product. Please wait until after the tutorial to restore purchases.
PURCHASE_ERROR_DEFERRED_TRANSACTION_CONF.zh: 你已经有一个关于所请求产品的交易正在处理了。请等教程结束后再恢复购买。

PURCHASE_ERROR_INSUFFICIENT_COINS.en: Oops, you don’t have enough coins for that!
PURCHASE_ERROR_INSUFFICIENT_COINS.zh: 诶，你好像没有足够的金币！

PURCHASE_ERROR_INSUFFICIENT_GEMS.en: Oops, you don’t have enough gems for that! Earn gems in Thymed Events, Quests, or acquire them in the store.
PURCHASE_ERROR_INSUFFICIENT_GEMS.zh: 诶，你的钻石好像不够了！你可以在彩陶盛宴、任务里赢得钻石。当然，也可以直接在商店购买。

PURCHASE_ERROR_INSUFFICIENT_MINTS.en: Oops, you don’t have enough Jinjin Tea Coupons for that!
PURCHASE_ERROR_INSUFFICIENT_MINTS.zh: 嗯…你好像没有足够的金金奶茶券！你可以在商店的“资源”栏位里使用金币或者钻石购买。

PURCHASE_ERROR_INSUFFICIENT_TICKETS.en: Oops, you don’t have enough tickets for that. Play events for more tickets!
PURCHASE_ERROR_INSUFFICIENT_TICKETS.zh: 诶，你的票好像不够了！多玩玩限时活动来获取吧！

PURCHASE_ERROR_INVALID_SKU.en: The requested SKU could not be found in the catalog.
PURCHASE_ERROR_INVALID_SKU.zh: 无法在目录中找到要求的 SKU。

PURCHASE_ERROR_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE_BODY.en: Either you're not connected to the internet, or there are issues connecting to the application store!
