PURCHASE_GEMIUM_BUNDLE.en: Items purchased with Gems are not shared with all profiles.
PURCHASE_GEMIUM_BUNDLE.zh: 使用钻石购买的物品不会与所有档案共享。

PURCHASE_KEY_GATE.zh: 想要购买钥匙来解锁大门吗？

PURCHASE_RECLAIM_ITEM_BODY.en: Item has already been purchased on another profile. Claim for current profile at no cost!
PURCHASE_RECLAIM_ITEM_BODY.zh: 这项商品在其他档案已经购买过了。请免费领取它吧！

PURCHASE_REFRESH_FAIL.en: Some purchase were not refreshed correctly, please try again.
PURCHASE_REFRESH_FAIL.zh: 有一些购买内容好像还没有刷新好，请再试一次吧。

PURCHASE_SINGLE_PROFILE_PLANT_FREE.en: Free plants are not shared with all profiles.
PURCHASE_SINGLE_PROFILE_PLANT_FREE.zh: 免费植物不会与所有档案共享。

PURCHASE_SINGLE_PROFILE_PLANT_WITH_COINS.en: Plants purchased with Coins are not shared with all profiles.
PURCHASE_SINGLE_PROFILE_PLANT_WITH_COINS.zh: 无法退回本次购买所使用的金币

PURCHASE_SINGLE_PROFILE_PLANT_WITH_GEMS.en: Plants purchased with Gems are not shared with all profiles.
PURCHASE_SINGLE_PROFILE_PLANT_WITH_GEMS.zh: 无法退回本次购买所使用的钻石

PURCHASE_SINGLE_PROFILE_PLANT_WITH_MINTS.en: Plants purchased with mints are not shared with all profiles.
PURCHASE_SINGLE_PROFILE_PLANT_WITH_MINTS.zh: 无法退回本次购买所使用的金金奶茶券

PURCHASE_SINGLE_PROFILE_PLANT_WITH_TICKE.en: Plants purchased with Tickets are not shared with all profiles.
PURCHASE_SINGLE_PROFILE_PLANT_WITH_TICKE.zh: 使用腕票购买的植物不会与所有档案共享。

PVINE1_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Pea Vine boosts Appease-mint Family plants, and he himself is an Appease-mint Family plant, so therefore... hang on... don't tell me... I can do this. I said DON'T TELL ME.
PVINE1_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}使用：{STAT}增强豌豆薄荷家族植物

{FLAVOR}豌豆藤蔓可以增强豌豆薄荷家族的植物，而他自己也是株豌豆薄荷家族的植物，所以说……等等……别告诉我……我自己能捋清这团关系……哎，我都说了我自己能捋清！

PVINE1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Pea Vines planted on top of Appease-mint Family plants provide a significant damage boost to those plants.
PVINE1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 当豌豆藤蔓种在豌豆薄荷家族植物身上时，会给它们提供巨大增益。

PVINE1_TOOLTIP.zh: 增强豌豆薄荷家族植物

PVINE_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}I, a brodiaea, just have the ability of a saw for no reason, and I’m happy about that. But, who only quoted part of my name?
PVINE_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}范围：{STAT}前方1格
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}用头顶的帽子对僵尸进行攻击，被攻击的僵尸有概率直接被打断手
{KEYWORD}植物特征：{STAT}绿色植物

{FLAVOR}我，卜若地，不知道为什么，拥有了锯子的功能，我很高兴，但是，是谁把我的名字截断了来用的？

PVINE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 用头顶的帽子对僵尸进行攻击

PVINE_TOOLTIP.en: Throw it's hat to attack zombie
PVINE_TOOLTIP.zh: 用头顶的帽子对僵尸进行攻击

PVZ2_MTX_LI_26_DESC.zh: 金手指 + 金币超级捆绑包

PVZ2_MTX_LI_27_DESC.zh: 金手指 + 金币超级捆绑包

PVZ2_MTX_LI_43.zh: 裂荚射手新植物捆绑包

PVZ2_MTX_LI_43_DESC.zh: 裂荚射手新植物捆绑包。

PVZ2_MTX_LI_44.zh: 裂荚射手新植物捆绑包

PVZ2_MTX_LI_44_DESC.zh: 裂荚射手新植物捆绑包。

PVZ2_MTX_LI_45.zh: 裂荚射手新植物捆绑包

PVZ2_MTX_LI_45_DESC.zh: 裂荚射手新植物捆绑包。

PVZ2_MTX_POWERVINE_EA_SD_2021_01.en: Early Access: Power Vine + 100 Piñata Seeds
PVZ2_MTX_POWERVINE_EA_SD_2021_01.zh: 抢先体验：电能藤蔓 + 100 包彩陶种子

PVZ2_MTX_SPECIAL_DESC.zh: 植物大战僵尸 2 特供

PVZ2_NSCALENDARSUSAGEDESCRIPTION.en: This app would like access to your calendar to display interactive ads.
PVZ2_NSCALENDARSUSAGEDESCRIPTION.zh: 此程序想访问你的日历以更好地展示交互广告。

PVZ2_NSCAMERAUSAGEDESCRIPTION.en: This app would like to access your camera to update your profile picture and display interactive ads.
PVZ2_NSCAMERAUSAGEDESCRIPTION.zh: 此程序想访问你的相机以更新你的帐户并展示交互广告。

PVZ2_NSLOCATIONWHENINUSEUSAGEDESCRIPTION.en: This app would like access to your location when in use to display interactive ads.
PVZ2_NSLOCATIONWHENINUSEUSAGEDESCRIPTION.zh: 此程序想在使用时访问你的位置以展示交互广告。

PVZ2_NSPHOTOLIBRARYUSAGEDESCRIPTION.en: This app would like to save images to your photo library to display interactive ads.
PVZ2_NSPHOTOLIBRARYUSAGEDESCRIPTION.zh: 此程序想向你的图册保存图片以展示交互广告。

PVZ2_NSREMINDERSUSAGEDESCRIPTION.en: This app would like to send reminders to display interactive ads.
PVZ2_NSREMINDERSUSAGEDESCRIPTION.zh: 此程序想发送通知以展示交互广告。

PVZ2_STORE_EA_PLAY_DESC.zh: 为 EA Play 用户量身定制的特殊捆绑包

PVZ2_STORE_PARSNIP_BUNDLE_DISCOUNT.zh: 铁钳防风草折扣捆绑包

PYREVINE1_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Pyre Vine considers his holdings, his fortune, his vast hoard of wealth. He feels it should please him, and yet nevertheless he is anxious and fearful.
PYREVINE1_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}火焰藤蔓考虑着他的股份、他的家产、他聚藏的无穷财富。他觉得这些应该能让他高兴起来，尽管如此，他还是忧虑、恐惧着。

PYREVINE1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Pyre Vines can be planted on top of other plants to provide protection from cold plus an additional close range flame attack.
PYREVINE1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 火焰藤蔓可以种在其他植物上，可以御寒，并且还能在近距离发动额外的火焰攻击。

PYREVINE1_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Lights the entire column on fire, dealing massive damage to every zombie.
PYREVINE1_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}点燃所在整行，对每个僵尸都造成超高的火焰伤害。

PYREVINE1_TOOLTIP.zh: 制造短距离火焰，温暖附近植物

PYREVINE_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Since she was weak and unhealthy when young, Orchid Mage studied hard on gravitational magic. Now she has attained mastery in the field, she is no longer bounded by gravity and can use this power to fight off zombies.
PYREVINE_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}范围：{STAT}前方1行
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}引力球爆炸后让僵尸失重。
{KEYWORD}植物特征：{STAT}紫色植物、飞行植物

{FLAVOR}因为幼年时身体虚弱，扇贝兰法师苦修引力魔法。现在她已修习圆满，借助引力她可以脱离重力的束缚，并将这股力量化作抵御僵尸的力量。

PYREVINE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Launch a gravitational ball, which will explode and cause slow effect.
PYREVINE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 发射一枚引力球，爆炸后产生黑洞产生失重效果。

PYREVINE_TOOLTIP.zh: 发射一枚引力球，爆炸后产生黑洞产生失重效果。

QUESTS_DISABLED_50MB.en: Oops! You need to download additional content before activating the Travel Log.
QUESTS_DISABLED_50MB.zh: 诶！你需要下载额外的内容才能使用旅行原木。

QUESTS_DISABLED_EGYPT2.en: Oops! You need to finish Egypt Day 2 before activating the Travel Log.
QUESTS_DISABLED_EGYPT2.zh: 诶…你需要完成上古埃及第 2 天才能使用旅行原木

QUESTS_DISABLED_LEVEL_COMPLETION.en: Oops! The Travel Log can't be activated yet.
QUESTS_DISABLED_LEVEL_COMPLETION.zh: 诶…旅行原木现在还不能使用

QUEST_AWARD_BODY.zh: 完成任务，赢取更多奖励！

QUEST_CLAIM_FAIL.en: The reward for this quest has already been claimed.
QUEST_CLAIM_FAIL.zh: 此任务的奖励已被领取。

QUEST_CONTENT_COMPLETE.en: Quests are complete in this tab! Check back here soon for more Quests.
QUEST_CONTENT_COMPLETE.zh: 这一栏里的任务都完成啦！晚点回来看看说不定会有更多的任务哦。

QUEST_PROGRESS_FAIL.en: Quest progress has not been completed.

QUEST_PVZ_ROBOT_R.en: The Revenge of Dr. Zomboss - Chapter 1
QUEST_PVZ_ROBOT_R.zh: 僵王博士的复仇 - 第一章

QUEST_RANK_ROLLUP_AWARD_DESCRIPTION.en: You already completed some quests, before they even existed! It's funny how time travel works.
QUEST_RANK_ROLLUP_AWARD_DESCRIPTION.zh: 有些任务还没有出现你就已经完成了！时间旅行真是有趣啊。

QUEST_RANK_UP_AWARD_DESCRIPTION.en: You've added another notch to your Travel Log.  Good work like that deserves to be rewarded!
QUEST_RANK_UP_AWARD_DESCRIPTION.zh: 你的旅行原木再次升级了。加油干，奖励大大滴有！

QUEST_RECYCLE_BUTTON_CONFIRMATION_TEXT.en: If you REFRESH this quest you will lose any progress you have made on it, and replace it with a new quest. You may refresh {x} times each day.
QUEST_RECYCLE_BUTTON_CONFIRMATION_TEXT.zh: 如果你刷新了这个任务，那它的全部进度都会丢失，并将被新任务取代。你每天可以刷新 {x} 次。

QUEST_REVEAL_HEADER.en: You have a new quest, try to show it how awesome you are by beating it!
QUEST_REVEAL_HEADER.zh: 你有一份新的任务！打败它，告诉它你有多厉害！

QUEST_TITLE_CORNUCOPIA.zh: 丰饶玉米角联动任务 - 第 {LEVEL_NUMBER} 关

QUICK_DELIVERY_DESCRIPTION.zh: 使传送带的出卡速度提高 {NUMBER}%！

RABBAGEPULT_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Star-God Unity: {STAT}summons a Solar Flare that deals continuous damage to all zombies on the lawn. Damage increases based on the number of Helios Cabbages present. If Astrofruit is on the lawn, the damage bonus provided by Helios Cabbage is doubled.
{FLAVOR}Helios Cabbage is from Plants vs. Zombies: Fusion. His "Timespace Special Ticket" hits a snag, sending him tumbling into a world born from a time paradox. There, he witnessed many plant allies he’d never seen before, a little one that looks alike Dr. Zomboss, zombies dancing in beachwear, and towering figures resembling giant zombies blocking the entrance.
RABBAGEPULT_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}星神合一：{STAT}召唤太阳，对全场僵尸持续造成伤害。太阳造成的伤害随场上究极太阳神卷心菜的数量而提高，若场上存在究极杨桃大帝，究极太阳神卷心菜为太阳提供的伤害提升效果翻倍。
{FLAVOR}究极太阳神卷心菜来自《植物大战僵尸：融合版》，他的“时空车票”出了一点问题，导致他掉进了一个由时间悖论创造的世界之中。在这里，他看到了很多他自己从未见过的植物同伴，很像僵王博士的小矮子，穿着海滩服跳舞的僵尸，堵在洞口的像是巨人僵尸的玩意。

RABBAGEPULT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Helios Cabbages hurl cabbages that are filled with sun at the enemy, dropping sun when hitting zombies.
RABBAGEPULT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 究极太阳神卷心菜可以向敌人投掷充满阳光的卷心菜，在击中僵尸后掉落阳光。

RABBAGEPULT_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Launches multiple advanced cabbages that are filled with even more sun at every zombie, dealing heavy damage and dropping more sun.
RABBAGEPULT_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}向每只僵尸投掷多颗充满更多阳光的高级卷心菜，造成大量伤害的同时掉落大量阳光。

RABBAGEPULT_TOOLTIP.en: Hurls sunny cabbages over obstacles at the enemy
RABBAGEPULT_TOOLTIP.zh: 越过障碍物向僵尸投掷阳光卷心菜

RANK_INFO_DESCRIPTION.en: Earn more Rank XP by completing Daily Activities in the Travel Log, participating in Limited Thyme Events, and by opening Piñatas. Earn Rank Points by collecting Rank XP.  Once you fill the meter below, you will earn 1 Rank Point.
RANK_INFO_DESCRIPTION.zh: 完成旅行原木中的日常活动、参与特别限时活动、开启彩陶，即可赢取更多的阶级经验。收集阶级经验，即可赢得阶级点数。只要填满下方的进度条，你就能获得 1 阶级点数。

RANK_PTS_AWARD_HEADER.zh: 你获得了 {NUMBER} 阶级点数！

RANK_PTS_AWARD_HEADER_SINGLE.zh: 你获得了 1 阶级点数！

RANK_XP_AWARD_HEADER.zh: 你获得了 {NUMBER} 阶级经验！

RAP_ALM_POPUP_DESC.en: If you visit Almanac now you will forfeit your rented plant.
RAP_ALM_POPUP_DESC.zh: 如果现在查看图鉴，你将会失去租赁到的植物。

RAP_DIALOG_SUB_TITLE.en: You may only rent 1 plant per level. Rented plants are locked in to your loadout.
RAP_DIALOG_SUB_TITLE.zh: 每道关卡中只能租赁一株植物。租赁到的植物会被锁定到你的选择中。

RAP_EXIT_POPUP_DESC.en:
Are you sure you want to exit the level?
Doing so will lose your rented plants and current progress in this level.
RAP_EXIT_POPUP_DESC.zh:
你确定要退出这个关卡吗？
这么做会让你失去租赁到的植物和在这个关卡中的进度。

RAP_RESTART_POPUP_DESC.en:
Are you sure that you want to restart the level?
Doing so will lose your rented plants and current progress in this level.
RAP_RESTART_POPUP_DESC.zh:
你确定要重新尝试这个关卡吗？
这么做会让你失去租赁到的植物和在这个关卡中的进度

RAP_ZEN_POPUP_DESC.en: If you visit Zen Garden now you will forfeit your rented plant.
RAP_ZEN_POPUP_DESC.zh: 如果现在查看禅境花园，你将会失去租赁到的植物。

REDSTINGER_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Maypop is determined to become an engineer, but up until now it can still only build gears.
REDSTINGER_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}番莲立志要成为一名工程师，但到现在它只会造齿轮。

REDSTINGER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Can fire gears that penetrate zombies.
REDSTINGER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 可以发射穿透僵尸的齿轮。

REDSTINGER_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: Immune to any damages for a few seconds then throw big gear which deal massive damage

REDSTINGER_TOOLTIP.zh: 可以发射穿透僵尸的齿轮。

REINFORCEMINT_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}HP: {STAT}High
{KEYWORD}Sun Production: {STAT}Large

{FLAVOR}This is the better Plantern, instead of illuminate foggy areas, he become a sun producer instead
REINFORCEMINT_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}生命值：{STAT}高
{KEYWORD}阳光产量：{STAT}大号阳光

{FLAVOR}路灯花蔑视科学，他就这样。其他植物吸收光可以排出氧气，路灯花都吸收黑暗发出光。路灯花曾就此坦言：“我不说什么‘巫术魔法’之类的东西，我只使用‘黑暗原力’这个词，我只是……我认为我已经说的够多的了。”

REINFORCEMINT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 路灯花阻碍僵尸并为你提供阳光。

RENTED_PLANT_STORE_DONT_SHOW_AGAIN.en: Don't show this again for 30 days
RENTED_PLANT_STORE_DONT_SHOW_AGAIN.zh: 不要在 30 天内再次展示

RENTED_PLANT_STORE_SUB_TITLE.en: Now that you have seen what {PLANTNAME} can do, consider these offers.
RENTED_PLANT_STORE_SUB_TITLE.zh: 既然已经明白{PLANTNAME}能做什么了，那就看看你需不需要这些商品吧。

RENT_A_PLANT_DISABLED_BY_CHEAT.en: RENT A PLANT DISABLED BY CHEAT
RENT_A_PLANT_DISABLED_BY_CHEAT.zh: 辅助程序已禁止租用植物

RENT_A_PLANT_NO_ADS.en: Sorry, there are no ads available at this time. Please try again later.
RENT_A_PLANT_NO_ADS.zh: 抱歉，现在还没有广告。请稍候再试。

RENT_A_PLANT_NO_INTERNET.en: Unable to connect to the servers. Please find a more stable internet connection or try again later.
RENT_A_PLANT_NO_INTERNET.zh: 无法连接至服务器。请寻找更稳定的互联网连接或稍后再试。

RENT_A_PLANT_NO_PLANTS.en: Uh oh! You're out of plants to rent! Please try again later.
RENT_A_PLANT_NO_PLANTS.zh: 啊哦！没有可以租用的植物了！请稍后再试。

RENT_A_PLANT_SLOTS_FULL.en: Number of plant slots are full. Please try again later!
RENT_A_PLANT_SLOTS_FULL.zh: 植物槽数量已满。请稍后再试！

REPEATER1_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}"Everyone always asks me if we've met before," says Repeater. "Everyone always asks me if we've met before. Wait, did I just say that?"
REPEATER1_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}伤害：{STAT}中等（每颗）
{KEYWORD}发射速度：{STAT}两倍
{FLAVOR}如果你对双重射手好，他会加倍报答。如果你惹了他，那你可能会得到加倍的反击。当然他的人际关系相当好，大家最愿意做的就是借钱给他。

REPEATER1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Repeaters fire two peas at one time.
REPEATER1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 双重射手能一次发射两颗豌豆。

REPEATER1_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Shoots two volleys of peas at zombies in its row.
REPEATER1_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}向所在行僵尸集火发射两连串豌豆。

REPEATER1_TOOLTIP.en: Shoots two peas at the enemy
REPEATER1_TOOLTIP.zh: 连续发射两发豌豆攻击敌人。

REPEATER_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Egret Flower is a stern and firm individual, you won't ever see him smile. Of course you may think that he’s acting cool, because he is in fact acting cool.
REPEATER_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}发射可以眩晕的导弹。
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}飞行植物

{FLAVOR}白鹭花是个孤傲的角色，你永远看不到他的笑容。当然你也可以理解他是在装酷，因为事实上他确实在装酷。

REPEATER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 白鹭花战机发射的种子可以使僵尸暂时眩晕。

REPEATER_TOOLTIP.en: Shoot seeds that temporarily stun zombies
REPEATER_TOOLTIP.zh: 投掷可以使僵尸暂时眩晕的种子

REPLAY_FOOTER.en: Spend Gems to replay this level and earn extra rewards. You can only replay once per day.
REPLAY_FOOTER.zh: 花费钻石重玩本关，获得额外奖励。每天只能重玩一次。

RESISTANCES_TOOLTIP_BODY.en: Plants from different families will be stronger, weaker, or ineffective against zombies.
RESISTANCES_TOOLTIP_BODY.zh: 不同家族的植物对僵尸的攻击会更强、更弱或无效。

RESSTREAMBUNDLE_UPDATE_DONE.en: Resource Stream Bundle update complete. Click to close the game.
RESSTREAMBUNDLE_UPDATE_DONE.zh: 数据包更新完成，点击关闭游戏。

RESSTREAMBUNDLE_UPDATE_FAILED.en: Resource Stream Bundle doesn't need to update.

RESSTREAMBUNDLE_UPDATE_IN_PROGRESS.zh: 数据包更新进行中，请不要关闭此页面...

RESTART_LEVEL.en: Are you sure that you want to restart the level?
RESTART_LEVEL.zh: 你确定要重新尝试这个关卡吗？

RESTART_LEVEL_BODY.en:
Do you want to try this level 
again from the beginning?
RESTART_LEVEL_BODY.zh: 你想重新尝试这个关卡吗？

RESTORE_PURCHASES_OFFLINE_BODY.en: The device needs to be connected to the internet to restore purchases.
RESTORE_PURCHASES_OFFLINE_BODY.zh: 为了恢复购买，你的设备必须连接到互联网。

RETRY_AD_FOOTER.en: Watch an advertisement (if available) to earn a retry.
RETRY_AD_FOOTER.zh: 观看广告，重试一次（如果广告可用的话）

REWARDS_TOOLTIP_COINS.en: Spend coins on power-ups, plant level-ups, and retries.
REWARDS_TOOLTIP_COINS.zh: 在金手指、植物升级和重试上花费金币。

REWARDS_TOOLTIP_GEMS.en: Spend gems on plants, seed packets, speed-ups or boosts!
REWARDS_TOOLTIP_GEMS.zh: 将钻石花在植物、种子包、加速或提升上！

REWARDS_TOOLTIP_MINTS.en: Spend mints to unlock Empower-mint plants.
REWARDS_TOOLTIP_MINTS.zh: 花薄荷糖解锁授权薄荷植物。

REWARDS_TOOLTIP_PENNY_FUEL.en: Fuel is required to play levels in the Penny's Pursuit game mode.
REWARDS_TOOLTIP_PENNY_FUEL.zh: 在潘妮的追击游戏模式下，需要加油才能玩关卡。

REWARDS_TOOLTIP_PINATA.en: Piñatas contain a variety of random rewards like coins and seed packets.
REWARDS_TOOLTIP_PINATA.zh: 彩陶包含各种随机奖励，如金币和种子包。

REWARDS_TOOLTIP_PLANTS.en: {PLANT_NAME} seeds are required to level up your {PLANT_NAME}.

REWARDS_TOOLTIP_RANKPTS.en: Rank Points are used to rank up plants! Ranking up plants unlocks the next set of plant levels and increases the Mint Family Bonus!
REWARDS_TOOLTIP_RANKPTS.zh: 阶级点数可以为植物升阶！升阶后，就能为它们解锁下一阶段的植物等级，同时还能增加薄荷家族的增益效果！

REWARDS_TOOLTIP_RANKXP.en: Collect Rank XP to convert to Rank Points!
REWARDS_TOOLTIP_RANKXP.zh: 收集阶级经验，转换成阶级点数！

RHEUMNOBILE_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}absorbs zombies and refines them.

{FLAVOR}Holding the Immo-Nobile Turret in the palm of your hand gives a strange sense of pressure. But once you put her down, the pressure becomes even greater…
RHEUMNOBILE_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}吸收僵尸并炼化
{FLAVOR}把伏僵塔黄托在手心里会有种莫名的压力。但是把她放下之后，压力变得更大了……

RHEUMNOBILE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Jumps up in place and then falls, crushing all zombies within its attack range.
RHEUMNOBILE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 原地跳起后落下，将自身攻击范围内的僵尸镇压

RHEUMNOBILE_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Heals to full health, boosts defense.

RHUBARBARIAN_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}"My drive to punch things? Inescapable!" exults Rhubarbarian. "That tree over there? PUNCH IT! That mailbox? SPLINTERS! Your coffee club punch card? LET ME AT THAT THING!"
RHUBARBARIAN_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}没有击打目标时往前翻滚

{FLAVOR}“我打东西的动力？世间一切都是我的动力！”蛮族大黄兴高采烈地说：“那儿有棵树是吧？砰！那儿有个邮箱？哇泡！你要打卡是吧？来，我帮你打！”

RHUBARBARIAN_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Rhubarbarian wildly pummels, stuns and punches zombies off the lawn, inflicting heavy damage for a limited time.
RHUBARBARIAN_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 蛮族大黄可以狂野地击打、眩晕僵尸，并把它们击出场，在有限的时间内造成大量伤害。

RHUBARBARIAN_TOOLTIP.en: Stuns and punches zombies off the board

RIFT_DOWN_FOR_MAINTENANCE.en: Penny's Pursuit is down for maintenance. Check back in a while!
RIFT_DOWN_FOR_MAINTENANCE.zh: 潘妮的追击正在维护。请待会儿再来看看吧！

RIFT_EXIT_DESCRIPTION.en: If you surrender, you will lose the Penny Fuel for this match.
RIFT_EXIT_DESCRIPTION.zh: 如果投降的话，你将会失去使用在这一关的潘妮燃料。

RIFT_EXIT_ZOMBOSS_DESCRIPTION.en: Surrendering now will forfeit one of your chances to fight Dr. Zomboss.
RIFT_EXIT_ZOMBOSS_DESCRIPTION.zh: 现在投降你将会失去一次与僵王博士战斗的机会。

RIFT_HOWTOPLAY_1_DESCRIPTION.en: New levels available weekly. Fill the ZPS gauge to 100% by defeating levels, then challenge Zomboss to earn rewards!
RIFT_HOWTOPLAY_1_DESCRIPTION.zh: 每周都有新的关卡！完成关卡让 ZPS 填充到 100%，然后挑战僵王赢取金币！

RIFT_HOWTOPLAY_2_DESCRIPTION.en: Complete Bonus Objectives to upgrade Penny's powerful new abilities. Use 1 Perk per game for FREE! Perks reset each event.
RIFT_HOWTOPLAY_2_DESCRIPTION.zh: 完成奖励目标，升级潘妮强大的新能力。这些增益每关都可以免费使用一次！每次新事件都会重置增益。

RIFT_HOWTOPLAY_3_DESCRIPTION.en: Penny's Pursuit games consume Penny Fuel. Penny's fuel cells will recharge over time, or you can refill fuel with Gems.
RIFT_HOWTOPLAY_3_DESCRIPTION.zh: 游玩潘妮的追击关卡需要消耗潘妮的燃料。潘妮的燃料罐会随时间自动重新加满，或者你也可以花费钻石来手动填满。

RIFT_HOWTOPLAY_4_DESCRIPTION.en: Battle Zomboss in a 3-Round showdown for rewards! Afterward, Zomboss takes a union-mandated lunch break to recover.
RIFT_HOWTOPLAY_4_DESCRIPTION.zh: 与僵王大战三个回合！战斗结束之后，你可以获得奖励。

RIFT_HOWTOPLAY_5_DESCRIPTION.en: (1) CLASSIC: Survive waves of zombies    (2) LAST STAND: Plan your defense and defeat the zombies    (3) ARENA: Plan your defense to survive and get a high score    (4) TIMED: Survive until time runs out    (5) MINIGAME: Unique gameplay like bowling
RIFT_HOWTOPLAY_5_DESCRIPTION.zh: （1）经典：在僵尸进攻下生存下来（2）坚不可摧：建立你的防线阻挡僵尸（3）竞技：建立你的防线生存下来，获取高分（4）计时：生存到计时结束（5）小游戏：类似于保龄球的迷你游戏

RIFT_HOWTOPLAY_6_DESCRIPTION.en: Earn rewards the first time you beat any level at Mild, Spicy and Extra Hot difficulty!
RIFT_HOWTOPLAY_6_DESCRIPTION.zh: 首次在简单、困难和超难难度中获胜即可赢得奖励！

RIFT_NEED_CONNECTION.en: Connect to the internet for Penny's Pursuit
RIFT_NEED_CONNECTION.zh: 需要连接到互联网才能游玩潘妮的追击

RIFT_OVER_DESCRIPTION.en: Please make sure you have the most recent game version, or come back later for a new event!

RIFT_TITLE_TEXT_95.zh: 不是所有橙子都是橙色

RIFT_UPDATE_AVAILABLE.zh: 潘妮的追击有更新了。现在更新吧！

RIFT_ZOMBOSS_OVER_DESCRIPTION.en: Time ran out and Zomboss has escaped! He left this behind...
RIFT_ZOMBOSS_OVER_DESCRIPTION.zh: 时间耗尽，僵王逃跑了！他留下了这个…

RW23_ULTIMATE_GEMS_PACK.zh: 僵王斗兽场终极钻石包

SAPFLING1_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}You've gotta see Sap-fling's throwing arm to believe it. He may be young, but everyone agrees ... the kid's got TALENT. Scouts from some of the biggest Pinecone Ball teams have been keeping a close eye on him. He could be headed to the majors. Oh sure, some knock him for his incredibly sticky spitball. But he only uses all-natural sap, so it's entirely legal.
SAPFLING1_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}攻击详情：{STAT}不会造成伤害，但会创造树脂黏液坑。
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}减慢走过树脂坑的僵尸速度。

{FLAVOR}你得看看树脂投手的投掷臂，才敢相信他到底多强。他或许还小，但所有人都觉得这孩子以后肯定是个大器之才。一些世界顶尖松果球队的球探都在密切地关注着他，以后他肯定可以加入一个大型联盟。当然了，虽然某些人可能会因他那黏糊糊的唾沫球打他一顿，但他只用纯天然树脂，所以这完全没毛病。

SAPFLING1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Sap-flings create zombie-slowing puddles of sap.
SAPFLING1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 树脂投手可以创建出减速僵尸的树脂格子。

SAPFLING1_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Lobs pinecones at multiple random tiles on the lawn, creating sticky saps that slows zombie movement.
SAPFLING1_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}随机将松果抛向草坪上的多块地砖，产生粘稠的树脂，减缓僵尸的移动速度。

SAPFLING1_TOOLTIP.zh: 制造能使僵尸慢下来的树脂洼

SAPFLING_DESCRIPTION.en: Morning Glory has been disturbed by the noise of the renovation upstairs for a long time, after asking his neighbor, DJ Beet on how to solve the problem, he immediately bought a MSR-7 headphone.
SAPFLING_DESCRIPTION.zh: 喇叭花一直饱受楼上装修的噪音打扰，他请教邻居DJ甜菜如何解决之后，立马下单买了一个MSR-7耳机。

SAPFLING_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Send a stream of sound waves forward.

SAPFLING_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Launches big soundwave that pushes zombies.

SCAREDYSHROOM_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}"How did I get talked into this? I wish I was at home."
SCAREDYSHROOM_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR} “我怎么就被说服来干这事儿了？还是家里好啊。”

SCAREDYSHROOM_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: A timid mushroom that shoots spore projectiles at zombies in its lane, but hides when they get too close.
SCAREDYSHROOM_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 一株胆子很小的蘑菇，可以向所在行上的僵尸发射孢子，不过当僵尸靠得太近时，它就会躲起来。

SCAREDYSHROOM_DESCRIPTION_HINT.en: Scaredy-shroom has a stronger defense when hiding from zombies.
SCAREDYSHROOM_DESCRIPTION_HINT.zh: 胆小菇在躲避僵尸时，防御力更强。

SCAREDYSHROOM_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Scaredy-shroom rallies himself and surrounding Scaredy-shrooms to fire a stream of spores that push back advancing zombies.
SCAREDYSHROOM_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}胆小菇与周围其它的胆小菇集结，发射一连串孢子，击退前进的僵尸。

SCAREDYSHROOM_TOOLTIP.en: Shoots spores, but hides when zombies are close.
SCAREDYSHROOM_TOOLTIP.zh: 发射孢子，但会在僵尸接近时躲起来。

SEADERRIS_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Seaderris loves spraying rotenone everywhere. One day she found out that both fish and zombies hate rotenone, and that made her even happier.
SEADERRIS_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}噗噗鱼藤很喜欢到处喷出鱼藤酮。有一天她知道鱼群和僵尸都很讨厌鱼藤酮，她更开心了。

SEADERRIS_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Seaderris can be planted in water to mesmerize the surrounding fish.
SEADERRIS_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 噗噗鱼藤可以种在水中，魅惑周围的鱼群。

SEAFLORA_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}"Zzz zz… Take over the … the garage… zzzzZzz .. the world… . Zzz…zzz.."

SEAFLORA_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Amphibious plant that fires piercing bubbles down its lane. Fire bubbles across three lanes when planted on water.
SEAFLORA_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 一种两栖植物，在一行上喷出穿透的气泡。在水上种植时，会在三行范围上喷出气泡。

SEAFLORA_DESCRIPTION_HINT.en: Team SeaFlora with slow or other push zombies to take advantage of the large bubble explosion during its Plant Food.
SEAFLORA_DESCRIPTION_HINT.zh: 海神花的叶绿素效果是使用缓慢的但能推动僵尸的大气泡。

SEAFLORA_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Fires a giant bubble down its lane, pushing back zombies, then exploding for massive damage. Improves to 3 lanes when planted on water.
SEAFLORA_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}向所在行发射一颗巨大的泡泡，把僵尸击退，随后发生爆炸，造成巨大伤害。如果种植在水面上，则可以向 3 行发射。

SEAFLORA_TOOLTIP.en: Amphibious plant that fires piercing bubbles down the lane.
SEAFLORA_TOOLTIP.zh: 一种两栖植物，在一行上喷射出穿刺的气泡。

SEAPOTATOMINE_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Sea-potato Mine, who can absorb both the nutrients of the land and the water, is also the 4th sibling in the Potato Mine family. One day, when Sea-potato Mine was still small, he went on a trip with its other siblings. Unfortunately, he got lost while wandering around. However, he soon encountered a kind-hearted big sister who gave Sea-potato Mine a magical bubble and patiently guided him to reunite with his brothers and sisters. That bubble is the one it is still wearing at all times, including now. Since Sea-potato Mine was still young at that time, he doesn't remember what the big sister looked like or what her name was.
SEAPOTATOMINE_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}一个既可以汲取土地营养又可以汲取水中的营养的土豆雷，是土豆雷家族的四弟。有一天，在土豆水雷还小的时候，他和其他兄弟姐妹一起出去旅游，结果他逛着逛着就不慎迷路了。不过，他很快就遇到了一个知心大姐姐，那位大姐姐赠予了土豆水雷一个魔法泡泡，并且耐心地带领土豆水雷与兄弟姐妹团聚。那个泡泡就是他无时无刻，包括现在还在戴着的那个。不过很可惜，由于土豆水雷当时还小，所以他也不记得那位大姐姐长什么样，叫什么名字了。

SEAPOTATOMINE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Potato Mine that can be grown in water and on land.
SEAPOTATOMINE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 可在水中和陆地上种植的土豆雷。

SEAPOTATOMINE_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Releases 3 Sea-potato Mine seeds when there are no zombies within the explosion trigger range. If there are, he will grow and explode immediately.
SEAPOTATOMINE_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}爆炸触发范围内无僵尸时分裂出数个土豆水雷，若有僵尸则立即生长并爆炸。

SEAPOTATOMINE_TOOLTIP.en: Can be planted in water and on land.
SEAPOTATOMINE_TOOLTIP.zh: 可在水中和陆地上种植的土豆雷。

SEASHOOTER_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}While helping her niece in school, Dave accidentally left a Peashooter on a Lilypad near the school’s pool. Four years later, Dave returned to his niece’s graduation and found it had mutated into a totally different plant. “No beach pass? No entry!” says Seashooter while personally throwing the zombies out of the water. “H2-OH-NO you don’t!” exclaims Seashooter to the zombies entering the lawn or the pool on its watch.
SEASHOOTER_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}在学校帮助自己侄女的时候，戴夫不小心把一株豌豆射手留在了学校水池旁的一片睡莲叶上。四年后，戴夫回到学校参加他侄女的毕业典礼时，却发现它已经突变成了一株截然不同的植物。“没有通行证？不准进海滩！”海豌豆说着便自己把一只僵尸扔出水外。“尸畏水！”海豌豆朝着自己眼皮底下踏入草坪和池塘的僵尸喊道。

SEASHOOTER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: An amphibious plant that launches a volley of 3 water covered peas, in different directions, that deals damage to zombies. It creates a puddle when placed on ground.
SEASHOOTER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 一株可以向不同方向同时发射 3 枚被水包裹住豌豆的两栖植物，豌豆可以对僵尸造成伤害。在陆地上种植时，可以创造一片水洼。

SEASHOOTER_DESCRIPTION_HINT.en: Seashooter's Plant Food can make other Appease-mint family plants to launch their Plant Food ability as well.
SEASHOOTER_DESCRIPTION_HINT.zh: 海豌豆的叶绿素效果可以让其它豌豆薄荷家族植物也启动自己的叶绿素技能。

SEASHOOTER_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Seashooter launches a barrage of water peas in 3 directions. Appease-mint plants near Seashooter also launch their Plant Food ability.
SEASHOOTER_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}海豌豆向 3 个方向发射一连串的水豌豆。海豌豆周围的随机 3 株豌豆类植物、射手类植物和火炬树桩也会一并启动其叶绿素技能。

SEASHOOTER_TOOLTIP.en: Boosted when placed adjacent to water tiles around it.
SEASHOOTER_TOOLTIP.zh: 种在周围有水地砖的地方可以获得强化。

SEASHROOM_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Sea-shroom has never seen the sea. It's in his name, he's heard loads about it, but he's just never found the time. One day, though, it'll go down.
SEASHROOM_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}伤害：{STAT}普通
{KEYWORD}范围：{STAT}短
{STAT}特殊：必须种在水中

{FLAVOR}海蘑菇从未见过大海。大海仅存在于他的名字当中。他总听到关于大海的传闻。只是没有合适的时间，却从未有机会踏上行程。总有一天…是的，他会亲眼遥望大海的。

SEASHROOM_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Sea-shrooms are amphibious plants that shoot short-range spores
SEASHROOM_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 海蘑菇是能够射出短程孢子的水生植物。

SEASHROOM_DESCRIPTION_HINT.en: Applying Plant Food to Sea-shroom will reset all Sea-shroom wither timers, as well as trigger every Sea-shroom to fire their spore stream.
SEASHROOM_DESCRIPTION_HINT.zh: 向海蘑菇施用叶绿素可以重置所有海蘑菇的凋零倒计时，同时触发所有海蘑菇，一齐发射连串的孢子。

SEASHROOM_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}创建一份自己的复制体，重置所有海蘑菇的凋零倒计时，随后所有海蘑菇一齐发射连串的孢子。

SEASHROOM_LEVEL_NAME.en: Let's Go to the Sea Together - Level {LEVEL_NUMBER}
SEASHROOM_LEVEL_NAME.zh: 一起去看海吧 - 第 {LEVEL_NUMBER} 步

SEASHROOM_TOOLTIP.en: Amphibious plant that shoot short-ranged spores
SEASHROOM_TOOLTIP.zh: 水生短程射手，存在时间有限。

SEASONAL_PLANT_UNLOCK.zh: 季节限定植物解锁特惠！

SEASON_NAME_36.zh: 传送土豆地雷的闪现赛季！

SEASON_NAME_40.zh: 莓棘灌木丛的多刺赛季！

SEASON_NAME_43.zh: 超级机枪豌豆的超级赛季

SEASON_NAME_45.zh: 坟墓缠绕者的粉碎赛季！

SECONDANNIVERSARY.en: Spring's joy, meeting you. Two winters, grateful too.
SECONDANNIVERSARY.zh: 有幸春来与君逢，谢君伴余两载冬。

SECURITY_GOURD_DIALOG_BODY.en: Your brains are in danger! Hire a Security Gourd and push back the zombies!
SECURITY_GOURD_DIALOG_BODY.zh: 你的脑子有危险！聘用一位安全葫卫击退那些僵尸！

SEED_CHOOSER_GRAVE_WARNING.en: There are no graves on this level, are you sure you want to pick the Grave Buster?

SEED_CHOOSER_RENT_PLANT_NOT_ENOUGH_COINS.en: Oops!  Gather more coins to rent this plant.
SEED_CHOOSER_RENT_PLANT_NOT_ENOUGH_COINS.zh: 嗯…好像金币不够了。多去收集一些再来租借吧！

SEED_CHOOSER_SUN_WARNING.en: You haven't chosen any sun producing plants, are you sure you want to continue?

You will still see EA marketing, but it may be less relevant to you.
SETTINGS_PLAYERTARGETING_EA_PROMPT.zh: 我们会使用你的个人数据来提供我们认为你会感兴趣的广告。关闭此选项后，你仍然会看到由 EA 提供的广告，但是我们将不会再为你推送定制化广告。

SETTINGS_PLAYERTARGETING_EA_PROMPT_DISAB.en: If disabled, you will still see ads from EA, but we will not personalize them for you.

SETTINGS_PLAYERTARGETING_EA_TITLE.zh: EA 游戏内定向广告推送

SETTINGS_PLAYERTARGETING_PROMPT.en: We rely on third-party partners to deliver personalized in-game ads. If disabled, you still will see third-party ads, but these ads may not be as relevant to you. You can change your preference by visiting your privacy settings. See EA's Privacy and Cookie Policy for more details.
SETTINGS_PLAYERTARGETING_PROMPT.zh: 我们依赖第三方合作商的服务来为你在游戏内推送定制化广告。如果禁用此选项，你仍然会看到第三方广告，但这些广告将不会再与你相关。你可以在隐私设置中修改你的偏好。请前往 EA 隐私和 Cookie 政策了解更多。

If disabled, you still will see third-party ads, but these ads may not be as relevant to you. You can change your preference by visiting your privacy settings. See EA's Privacy and Cookie Policy for more details.

SETTINGS_PRIVACY_TITLE_AGEGATE.zh: 华人天下游的 B 站主页

SETTINGS_RESTORE_PURCHASES_PROMPT.en: Restoring your purchases will allow you to claim any previously purchased, non-consumable items from the store, including premium Plants and Upgrades, and purchased Worlds.
SETTINGS_RESTORE_PURCHASES_PROMPT.zh: 恢复购买功能可以让你领取之前在商店购买过的不可消费品。包括你的高级植物、升级道具，以及购买过的世界。

SETTINGS_RESTORE_PURCHASES_PROMPT_DISABL.en: Please complete Egypt 7 to restore purchases.
SETTINGS_RESTORE_PURCHASES_PROMPT_DISABL.zh: 请先完成埃及 7 再恢复购买。

SHADOWPEASHOOTER_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}"Phoot," Shadow Peashooter says, emitting a shadowy, ah, hmmm, I guess you could call it a pea, at a distant zombie. "Uph!" gasps the zombie in evident surprise. There's a lot going on under the surface between these two.
SHADOWPEASHOOTER_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}被增强后发射可以穿透并减速的射线。
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}僵尸接近时，隐匿于地下，并把它拖入虚空。

{FLAVOR}暗影豌豆射手“呼”地一声，吐出了一枚暗影…豌豆…？好吧…可能对于远处的僵尸来说那玩意儿确实是豌豆吧。“唔！”僵尸惊讶地倒抽了一口气。看来他俩在地下有很多事情可以好好交流一下了。

SHADOWPEASHOOTER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Shadow Peashooters are shadow plants that fire piercing shadowy peas at zombies.
SHADOWPEASHOOTER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 暗影豌豆射手是一株暗影植物，可以发射暗影豌豆攻击僵尸。

SHADOWPEASHOOTER_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Summons a bomb that increases its area effect for every adjacent Moonflower plant.
SHADOWPEASHOOTER_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}召唤一枚炸弹，周围的月光花越多，范围效果越强大。

SHADOWPEASHOOTER_TOOLTIP.zh: 发射可穿透僵尸、有减速效果的光束

SHADOWSHROOM_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Despite being such a poisonous and profoundly inedible fungus, Shadow-shroom is nonetheless a total cutie-pie.
SHADOWSHROOM_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}使用：{STAT}一次性使用，接触时生效
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}被暗影增强的毒影菇可以让僵尸互相传染中毒效果。

{FLAVOR}尽管是一种有毒且不能吃的真菌，毒影菇依旧是个十足的可爱派。

SHADOWSHROOM_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Shadow-shrooms poison zombies who touch them, inflicting damage over time.
SHADOWSHROOM_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 毒影菇可以让僵尸中毒，随着时间的推移，伤害会越来越高。

SHADOWSHROOM_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Poisons every zombie on the lawn. If a zombie is already poisoned, deal extra damage.
SHADOWSHROOM_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}让草坪上的每只僵尸中毒。如果僵尸已经中毒了，则造成额外伤害。

SHADOWSHROOM_TOOLTIP.zh: 暗影植物，让吃掉他的僵尸中毒一段时间

SHINEVINE_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}"Peek-a-boo!" giggles Shine Vine, staring directly at you, the player. "Consider that fourth wall SHATTERED!"
SHINEVINE_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}使用：{STAT}最好种在阳光植物身上
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}不会增强月光花的阳光产量

{FLAVOR}“来捉迷藏吧！”闪耀藤蔓咯咯地笑着，看着你这个玩家。“想象一下，如果第四面墙被打破会怎样吧！”

SHINEVINE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Shine Vines are vine plants that amplify the sun production of sun producer plants, except Moonflower, create some sun on their own, and use a sun-stun burst as a last-second defense when attacked.
SHINEVINE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 闪耀藤蔓是种藤蔓植物，能增多阳光生产植物的阳光产量，同时自己生产阳光，被僵尸啃咬时还会用阳光力量眩晕僵尸并产出阳光。

SHINEVINE_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Produces sun and stuns all nearby zombies.
SHINEVINE_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}生产阳光，眩晕周围的所有僵尸。

SHINEVINE_TOOLTIP.zh: 提高内部植物的阳光产量

SHOCKWAVE_PERK_DESCRIPTION.en: Knockback zombies approx. {DISTANCE} tiles every {TIME} seconds!
SHOCKWAVE_PERK_DESCRIPTION.zh: 每 {TIME} 秒令僵尸后退 {DISTANCE} 单位距离！

SHRINKINGVIOLET_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Shrinking Violet started out shy, but it's remarkable how discovering a magical talent for zombie-reduction can change your whole outlook.
SHRINKINGVIOLET_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}使用：{STAT}一次性使用，接触时生效
{KEYWORD}范围：{STAT}影响周围格内僵尸
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}使小鬼僵尸消失

{FLAVOR}你对缩小紫罗兰的第一印象可能是它很害羞。不过一旦你发现她有个可以缩小僵尸的魔法天赋，肯定会不禁惊叹：“太强了！”

SHRINKINGVIOLET_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Shrinking Violets shrink zombies in an area, forcing them to take double damage and reducing the bite damage they inflict.
SHRINKINGVIOLET_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 缩小紫罗兰可以缩小一定范围内的僵尸，使它们受到的伤害翻倍，并减少啃咬植物的伤害。

SHRINKINGVIOLET_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Shrinks all zombies on the lawn.
SHRINKINGVIOLET_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}缩小草坪上的所有僵尸。

SHRINKINGVIOLET_TOOLTIP.en: Shrinks zombies and makes them weaker
SHRINKINGVIOLET_TOOLTIP.zh: 缩小僵尸，使他们更脆弱

SIXTHANNIVERSARY_LEVEL_15_BTL.en: Survive the turn-based scenario (The first wave of zombies will attack at 90s)
SIXTHANNIVERSARY_LEVEL_15_BTL.zh: 在回合制的情况下生存下来 (第一波僵尸将在第 90 s 进攻)

SIXTHANNIVERSARY_LEVEL_15_NAME.en: 6th Anniversary Celebration - Level 15 - Half-Thyme Break I

SIXTHANNIVERSARY_LEVEL_16_NAME.en: 6th Anniversary Celebration - Level 16 - Half-Thyme Break II
SIXTHANNIVERSARY_LEVEL_16_NAME.zh: 六周年庆典 - 第 16 回 - “种”场休息Ⅱ

SIXTHANNIVERSARY_LEVEL_17_BTL.en: Survive the turn-based scenario (The first wave of zombies will attack at 90s)
SIXTHANNIVERSARY_LEVEL_17_BTL.zh: 在回合制的情况下生存下来 (第一波僵尸将在第 90 s 进攻)

SIXTHANNIVERSARY_LEVEL_17_NAME.en: 6th Anniversary Celebration - Level 17 - Half-Thyme Break III
SIXTHANNIVERSARY_LEVEL_17_NAME.zh: 六周年庆典 - 第 17 回 - “种”场休息Ⅲ

SIXTHANNIVERSARY_LEVEL_19_NAME.en: 6th Anniversary Celebration - Level 19 - Sword, Blade, Spear
SIXTHANNIVERSARY_LEVEL_19_NAME.zh: 六周年庆典 - 第 19 回 - 剑 刀 矛

SIXTHANNIVERSARY_LEVEL_22_NAME.en: 6th Anniversary Celebration - Level 22 - Cheese Pincer Attack
SIXTHANNIVERSARY_LEVEL_22_NAME.zh: 六周年庆典 - 第 22 回 - 两面包夹芝士

SIXTHANNIVERSARY_LEVEL_25_BTL.en: Defeat 10 Gargantuars and avoid being eaten by zombies! Tall-nuts can be moved in this level!
SIXTHANNIVERSARY_LEVEL_25_BTL.zh: 消灭 10 只巨人并躲避僵尸的啃食！本关高坚果可移动！

SIXTHANNIVERSARY_LEVEL_26_NAME.zh: 六周年庆典 - 第 26 回 - 蹦极?闪电战!

SIXTHANNIVERSARY_LEVEL_28_NAME.zh: 六周年庆典 - 第 28 回 - 新手教程

SIXTHANNIVERSARY_LEVEL_4_BTL.en: Never let plants be bound by octopi!
SIXTHANNIVERSARY_LEVEL_4_BTL.zh: 不要让植物被套上章鱼！

SIXTHANNIVERSARY_LEVEL_5_NAME.en: 6th Anniversary Celebration - Level 5 - Basic Fusion Evolution
SIXTHANNIVERSARY_LEVEL_5_NAME.zh: 六周年庆典 - 第 5 回 - 初级融合进化

SIXTHANNIVERSARY_LEVEL_8_NAME.en: 6th Anniversary Celebration - Level 8 - Wild West Hurdle Race
SIXTHANNIVERSARY_LEVEL_8_NAME.zh: 六周年庆典 - 第 8 回 - 西部跨栏大赛

Are you sure you want to skip this level?
This action requires a certain number of gems!
Continuous skipping will increase the cost!

你确定要跳过本关吗？
该操作需要消耗一定数量的钻石！
连续跳关会增加消耗的钻石数量！

SKIP_WORLD_NAME_EIGHTIES.zh: 跳关至炫光魔音游第 15 关

SLINGPEA_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Sling Pea keeps a keen eye on the whole battle space. He's alert and attentive. "If something slips through," he muses quietly, "it would be my fault. And I just couldn't forgive myself if that happened."
SLINGPEA_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}豌豆迫击炮一直密切观察着整个战场。“如果有什么僵尸偷偷溜了进来，我是不会原谅我自己的。因为这是我的失职。”他永远都如此机敏，又如此专注。

SLINGPEA_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Sling Peas fire 5 peas in a burst, targeting the zombies closest to your house each time.
SLINGPEA_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 豌豆迫击炮可以一次发射五颗豌豆，每次都会瞄准离房子最近的僵尸。

SLINGPEA_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Shoots 3 bursts of stunning peas at zombies.
SLINGPEA_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}向僵尸集中发射三波豌豆雨攻击

SLINGPEA_TOOLTIP.zh: 向全场发射五颗豌豆，攻击每行最靠左的目标

SLOT_UNLOCKED.en: A new pot is available for sprouts!
SLOT_UNLOCKED.zh: 一个供幼芽生长的新花盆已解锁！

SMALLTOWN2_CHALLENGE_TEXT.en: Tip: Stun Chicken Wranglers before attacking to prevent them from releasing Zombie Chickens.
SMALLTOWN2_CHALLENGE_TEXT.zh: 提示：眩晕鸡贼僵尸后再攻击他不会放出僵尸鸡。

SNAPDRAGON_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Although the most powerful dragon in the plant kingdom, he still dreams of wings and seeing the world beneath him.
SNAPDRAGON_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}范围：{STAT}攻击他前面 6 块地砖内的所有僵尸

{FLAVOR}尽管他是植物王国中最厉害的龙，但他仍然梦想着有一对翅膀并且看看自己脚下的世界。

SNAPDRAGON_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Snapdragons breathe fire that causes damage in 6 adjacent tiles.
SNAPDRAGON_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 火龙草可以向六块地砖内的僵尸喷出火焰。

SNAPDRAGON_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Sets the area in front of it on fire, dealing heavy damage to zombies.
SNAPDRAGON_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}点燃前方的区域，对僵尸造成大量伤害。

SNAPDRAGON_PLANTFOOD.en: Creates a 3x3 patch of fire that does massive damage.
SNAPDRAGON_PLANTFOOD.zh: 产生一片范围为 3x3 的火，造成巨大的伤害。

SNAPDRAGON_TOOLTIP.en: Breathes fire in an area in front of it
SNAPDRAGON_TOOLTIP.zh: 向前方一片区域呼出火焰

SNAPPEA1_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}"I'm a picky eater, I'll admit it," admits Snap Pea casually. "I'll eat a zombie, no problem, but there's just something about heads. I feel like they're looking at me."
SNAPPEA1_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}食人花豌豆说：“好吧，我承认，我确实有点挑食。我是喜欢吃僵尸，没问题，但它们的脑袋就让我感觉挺不适的。感觉就像是它们在盯着我看一样。”

SNAPPEA1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Snap Peas dive underground, burrow towards zombies, then pop up underneath to swallow them in one gulp. Snap Peas then return to their starting spot, chew on the entire matter for a while, and finally spit the zombies' heads out at attackers.
SNAPPEA1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 食人花豌豆可以先钻入地下，跑到僵尸下面，一口吞下一只僵尸。然后会开始咀嚼僵尸，咀嚼完后会将僵尸的头吐出来攻击另一只僵尸。

SNAPPEA1_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Eat several zombies and then shoot out their heads.
SNAPPEA1_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}吃掉数只僵尸，随后发射出它们的头。

SNAPPEA1_TOOLTIP.en: Eats zombies and spits out their heads
SNAPPEA1_TOOLTIP.zh: 吃掉一只僵尸，咀嚼一段时间后吐出他的头

SNAPPEA_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}"I only chew ham-flavored gum," exudes Gumnut. "Ham and salt."
SNAPPEA_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}僵尸越强，形成的阻碍能力越强
{KEYWORD}使用：{STAT}针对巨人僵尸和机甲橄榄球僵尸

{FLAVOR}“我只嚼火腿味的口香糖，”粘液桉果嘟囔着。“火腿加盐。”

SNAPPEA_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Gumnuts pop sticky gum onto zombies, pinning them in place and causing them to block other zombies behind them.
SNAPPEA_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 粘液桉果会把黏稠的口香糖黏在僵尸身上，让它们定在原地，挡住身后的其他僵尸。

SNAPPEA_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Shoots a large gum bubble that immobilizes a large number of zombies.
SNAPPEA_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}发射巨大的树胶泡泡，让大量僵尸无法动弹。

SNAPPEA_TOOLTIP.zh: 制造黏胶黏住僵尸，被黏住的僵尸会阻碍其他僵尸

SNOWDROP_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Range:{STAT} Straight
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}3x3 splash

{FLAVOR}Zombies always look at her with a cold expression because of her charming appearance and her snowflake can always control the zombies on the battlefield. The output plant always complains that as an ice plant, she always takes away their credit, but for some reason they are not too angry. Maybe this can also be attributed to her charming appearance.
SNOWDROP_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}范围：{STAT}前方一行
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}3x3溅射

{FLAVOR}僵尸总是用冰冷的表情看着她，因为她那迷人的外表和那冰冷的子弹总能在战场上将僵尸控制得无法动弹。而输出植物们总是抱怨道她作为一株寒冰植物却老是抢走他们的功劳，不过不知为何他们并不会太过生气，可能这也能归功到她那迷人的外表吧。

SNOWDROP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Snowdrop can fire high-damage snowflake forward and slow down zombies within a 3x3 range.
SNOWDROP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 小雪花可以向前方发射高伤害的雪花子弹并减速3x3范围内的僵尸。

SNOWDROP_TOOLTIP.zh: 向前方发射高伤害的雪花子弹。

SNOWLOTUS_COSTUME.en: B - East Snow Lotus's Rare Costume
SNOWLOTUS_COSTUME.zh: B级-冰刃雪莲东雪莲罕见装扮

SNOWPEA_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}As a professional table tennis player, in the off-season he also enjoys skiing, playing the bongos, and spelunking.
SNOWPEA_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}子弹撞到僵尸时冷缓并伤害僵尸

{FLAVOR}作为一名专业的乒乓球选手，在休赛期他也喜欢滑雪，拍手鼓以及洞穴探险。

SNOWPEA_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Snow Peas fire frozen peas making it hard for zombies to advance.
SNOWPEA_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 寒冰豌豆可以发射冰冻豌豆，让僵尸难以前行。

SNOWPEA_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Slows all zombies in the column, then shoots a barrage of frozen peas.
SNOWPEA_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}让所在排的所有僵尸减速，随后发射一大堆冰冻豌豆。

SNOWPEA_PLANTFOOD.en: Fires a stream of frozen peas and creates a sheet of ice that chills everything in its lane.
SNOWPEA_PLANTFOOD.zh: 发射一堆冰冻豌豆，并创造一条冰道，冷缓这条道上的所有东西。

SNOWPEA_TOOLTIP.en: Shoots frozen peas that damage and slow zombies
SNOWPEA_TOOLTIP.zh: 发射冰冻豌豆，伤害、减速僵尸

SOLARFLARE_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Solar Flare is naturally enamored with sun, just as sun seems to favor her. Zombies can have a penchant for sun too, so she always delights in collecting it and gifting it to them—leaving the zombies utterly speechless with joy.
SOLARFLARE_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}耀斑花天生就迷恋阳光，就像阳光也对她青睐一样。僵尸也很容易喜欢阳光，所以她每次都乐于把阳光收集起来送给僵尸，僵尸每次都被这份礼物惊喜到无话可说。

SOLARFLARE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Solar Flare can collect sunlight from the field and discharge sun in a fan-shaped area ahead, dealing explosive damage and leaving a brief of remaining sun—which can be gathered if zombies are defeated within a short period of time.
SOLARFLARE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 耀斑花可以从场上收集阳光并向前方扇形区域发射能量，击中僵尸后造成爆炸伤害并短暂残留部分阳光，在一段时间内击败僵尸可收集残留阳光。

SOLARFLARE_TOOLTIP.en: Collects sun, dealing damage and leaving the remaining sun
SOLARFLARE_TOOLTIP.zh: 从场上收集阳光，造成伤害并短暂残留阳光

SOLARSAGE_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}"Ommm," Solar Sage hums softly to herself. But she's not kidding anybody. We all know her mind is filled with race cars and bulldozers.
SOLARSAGE_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}对动物和机器无效
{FLAVOR}圣光鼠尾草嘴里喃喃着“唵…”。大家都以为她对赛车已经爱到这种丧心病狂地步了，整天在那儿学着发动机的声音。但其实她只是在念经啦。

SOLARSAGE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Solar Sages illuminate zombies, causing them to make better choices and depart, leaving behind a trail of sun.
SOLARSAGE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 圣光鼠尾草能让僵尸开悟，让它们心存正念、离开战场，并在经过的道路上留下阳光。

SOLARSAGE_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Illuminates zombies in the surrounding area, causing them to fight other zombies. Produces sun if there are no valid zombies in its effect area.
SOLARSAGE_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}让周围区域的僵尸开悟。如果周围没有可以开悟的僵尸，则会生产阳光。

SOLARSAGE_TOOLTIP.zh: 让僵尸开悟，开悟僵尸会在离开场地过程中提供阳光

SOLARTOMATO_DESCRIPTION.en:
{FLAVOR}Solar Tomato wishes folks would just stop and enjoy the sunshine sometimes.
"Stop," she says. "Enjoy the sunshine. I said stop! Hold it right there! Don't move! I MEAN IT!!!"
SOLARTOMATO_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{FLAVOR}阳光番茄希望大家能够时常驻足享受从天空中洒下的缕缕阳光。

“停！”她说。“驻足享受那阳光！我说了，停下来！就给我停在那儿不准动！不 准 动！！”

SOLARTOMATO_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Solar Tomatoes stun zombies in a 3x3 area, causing each zombie to drop 50 sun.
SOLARTOMATO_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 阳光番茄能眩晕 3x3 范围内的僵尸，并让每只僵尸身上掉落50阳光。

SOLARTOMATO_TOOLTIP.zh: 使僵尸眩晕并掉落阳光

SPEARMINT_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Rainbow mist drifts a fragrant ten miles, mesmerizing thousands of zombies. Like a dream, like a melody, the flowers bloom for a lifetime, and their fragrance lingers forever. Deeply silent, drifting like a cloud.

Voicelines:
谁说女子不如男 (Who says women are inferior to men)
天生丽质难自弃(One cannot give up their natural beauty)
一梦入混沌，烟火撞星辰 (A dream enters chaos, fireworks collide with stars)
云想衣裳花想容 (Clouds evoke thoughts of clothing, and flowers evoke thoughts of appearance)
从容不失优雅，落幕不失华丽 (Composed without losing elegance, and grand without losing magnificence)
离别是为了更好的重逢 (Parting is for a better reunion)
SPEARMINT_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}七彩迷雾，飘香十里，迷倒万千僵尸。似梦，似乐，花开一世，芳香永存。深自缄默，如云漂泊。

配音文案：
谁说女子不如男
天生丽质难自弃
从容不失优雅，落幕不失华丽
一梦入混沌，烟火撞星辰
云想衣裳花想容
离别是为了更好的重逢

SPEARMINT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Rosemary boost female plants or ones belong to her family
SPEARMINT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 迷迭香能加强雌性植物。

SPIKEROCK_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Being the most metal plant, Spikerock has decided to hold his ultimate metal plant concert at Madison Rock Garden. Tickets have been sold out for many harvests.
SPIKEROCK_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}无法被僵尸吃掉
{KEYWORD}弱点：{STAT}三个滚着的僵尸碾过后会被杀死

{FLAVOR}作为最具重金属风格的植物，石地刺准备在麦迪森摇滚花园里举行他的终极重金属植物音乐会。这个消息一出来，门票瞬间就被抢购一空了。

SPIKEROCK_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Spikerocks destroy multiple rolling zombies and damage zombies that walk over them.
SPIKEROCK_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 石地刺可以击破多个滚动的僵尸容器并且伤害踩在他身上的僵尸。

SPIKEROCK_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Metal spikes push all zombies in its lane onto itself, damaging them in the process.
SPIKEROCK_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}用锋利的地刺把所在行的僵尸推到它所在的地方，过程中造成伤害。

SPIKEROCK_PLANTFOOD.en: Metal spikes push all zombies in its lane onto itself, damaging them in the process.
SPIKEROCK_PLANTFOOD.zh: 从地下升出金属刺，将所有僵尸拉到一格内攻击。

SPIKEROCK_TOOLTIP.en: Breaks 3 rolling objects, hurts zombies that step on it
SPIKEROCK_TOOLTIP.zh: 破坏 3 个滚动物体，伤害踏在上面的僵尸

SPIKEWEED_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Although Spikeweed grew up on the seedy side of town, his acupuncture business has been blooming.
SPIKEWEED_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}无法被僵尸吃掉
{KEYWORD}弱点：{STAT}会被滚着的僵尸杀死

{FLAVOR}尽管地刺生活在小镇的偏僻地带，但他的针灸生意还是在蓬勃发展。

SPIKEWEED_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Spikeweeds destroy one rolling zombie and hurt any zombies that step on them.
SPIKEWEED_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 地刺会击破一个滚动的僵尸容器并且伤害踩在他身上的僵尸。

SPIKEWEED_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Spikes push all zombies in its lane onto itself, damaging them in the process.
SPIKEWEED_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}用地刺把所在行的僵尸推到它所在的地方，过程中造成伤害。

SPIKEWEED_PLANTFOOD.en: Spikes push all zombies in its lane onto itself, damaging them in the process.
SPIKEWEED_PLANTFOOD.zh: 从地下升出棘刺，将所有僵尸拉到一格内攻击。

SPIKEWEED_TOOLTIP.en: Breaks 1 rolling object, hurts zombies that step on it
SPIKEWEED_TOOLTIP.zh: 破坏 1 个滚动物体，伤害踏在上面的僵尸

SPLITPEA_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}"It's my turn with the eyebrows," said Frontie. "Fine, we'll split them," said Backie. Sprouted two minutes apart, their eyebrow war is eternal.
SPLITPEA_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}攻击速度：{STAT}向前方发射一颗豌豆，后方发射两颗豌豆

{FLAVOR}“该我用那副眉毛了。”前面的头说。“好吧，咱俩分着用吧。”后面的头回应道。他们发芽仅仅差了两分钟，但对眉毛的争夺战可从没停下过。

SPLITPEA_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Split Peas shoot peas forward and backwards.
SPLITPEA_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 裂荚射手可以向前后两个方向发射豌豆。

SPLITPEA_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Shoots a barrage of peas at both the front and behind the plant, then fires a giant pea behind.
SPLITPEA_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}同时在前、后方发射一连串豌豆，随后在后方发射一颗巨大的豌豆。

SPLITPEA_PLANTFOOD.en: Performs the Plant Food effect of the Peashooter to the front and the Repeater to the back.
SPLITPEA_PLANTFOOD.zh: 给予前面的豌豆射手和后面的双发豌豆不同的叶绿素效果。

SPOOKYSQUASH_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}Deals fire damage to zombies in a 3x3 area with every smash.
{FLAVOR}Spooky Squash is actually a distant cousin of the Squash from the Wild West's Howling Canyon. That's about all anyone knows about him. Who actually remembers their distant relatives anyway? Not everyone is Crazy Dave, after all.
SPOOKYSQUASH_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}每次下落动作都会使3x3范围内僵尸受到一次火焰伤害。
{FLAVOR}阴森窝瓜实际上是窝瓜的远方亲戚，他来自狂野西部的嚎叫峡谷，然后就没有更多印象了，何况谁能清楚记得自家的远方亲戚呢，毕竟不是谁都是疯狂戴夫。

SPOOKYSQUASH_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Smashes zombies and deals fire damage in a 3x3 area with every smash.
SPOOKYSQUASH_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 碾压僵尸且每次下落动作都会使 3x3 范围内的僵尸受到一次火焰伤害。

SPOOKYSQUASH_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Smashes multiple zombies and deals area fire damage.
SPOOKYSQUASH_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}碾压数次僵尸并造成范围火伤。

SPOOKYSQUASH_TOOLTIP.en: Smashes zombies and deals area fire damage.
SPOOKYSQUASH_TOOLTIP.zh: 碾压僵尸并造成范围火伤

SPORESHROOM_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}"My favorite arithmetic operation?" wonders Spore-shroom. "I guess I’d have to say, um, addition. Hang on, no... multiplication."
SPORESHROOM_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}“你问我最喜欢的运算方式是啥？”孢子菇想了想。“应该是加法。不对…是乘法。“

SPORESHROOM_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Spore-shrooms fire spores that create new Spore-shrooms out of defeated zombies.
SPORESHROOM_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 孢子菇发射的孢子在击败僵尸后可以创造出另一个新的孢子菇。

SPORESHROOM_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Lobs three giant spores that deal massive damage, spawns a spore if the zombie is defeated.
SPORESHROOM_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}投掷三枚巨大孢子，造成巨大伤害，如果命中的僵尸被击败了，则生成一株孢子菇。

SPORESHROOM_TOOLTIP.en: Spawns new Spore-shrooms from defeated zombies
SPORESHROOM_TOOLTIP.zh: 在击败的僵尸处生成新的孢子菇

SPRINGBEAN_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}He's the strong, silent type and little is known about Spring Bean. What is known though: his fan club is a million followers strong. And the ladies love him.
SPRINGBEAN_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}把僵尸弹到后面，或者弹进海里
{KEYWORD}弱点：{STAT}弹射后会睡觉

{FLAVOR}他是那种强壮、沉默并且对自己知之甚少的人。但有一点不可否认：他的粉丝俱乐部多达一百万人，而且许多女生都喜欢他。

SPRINGBEAN_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Spring Beans bounce back zombies that get too close. Will bounce them into water if nearby.
SPRINGBEAN_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 弹簧豆可以将靠近的僵尸向后弹。如果附近有水的话，还能弹入水中。

SPRINGBEAN_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Knocks back all zombies on the lawn back a tile or into the water.
SPRINGBEAN_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}将草坪上的所有僵尸击退一格，或击入水中。

SPRINGBEAN_PLANTFOOD.en: Slams down, causing all zombies on the lawn to bounce back to the right.
SPRINGBEAN_PLANTFOOD.zh: 猛地向下弹跳，使草坪上的所有僵尸向右弹。

SPRINGBEAN_TOOLTIP.en: Bounces zombies back and into nearby water
SPRINGBEAN_TOOLTIP.zh: 将僵尸向后弹或弹入附近的水中

SPRINGENING_PREMIUM_PINATA_BUNDLE.zh: 暖春节高级彩陶捆绑包

SPROUTS_STORE_TEXT.en: Need more sprouts? Choose a package below.
SPROUTS_STORE_TEXT.zh: 需要更多幼芽吗？在下方选择一个幼芽包吧！

SPROUT_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Fanilla has always wanted to be a hairdresser, but he can only blow out various styles
SPROUT_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}吹风荚兰一直想成为一名理发师，但是他只能吹出各种造型。

SPROUT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Blow a whirlwind forward that knocks zombies high into the sky.
SPROUT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 吹风荚兰可以向前方发射将僵尸击上高空的旋风。

SPROUT_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: Blow a whirlwind that knock weak zombies out the lawn

SQUASH_DESCRIPTION.en:

STARCHALLENGE_SEASHROOM_LVL1.en: It will travel far, far beyond these hills, far beyond these stars, until it comes close to the sea, for its journey is to the stars and not to the smoke and dust of earth.
STARCHALLENGE_SEASHROOM_LVL1.zh: 它会旅行很远，远过这些山丘，远过这些星星，直到靠近大海，因为它的征途是星辰大海，而非烟尘人间

STARCHALLENGE_SEASHROOM_LVL2.en: Traveling is a love affair, look at the blue sky, embrace the sea, enjoy the sunshine, because there is a dream, so bravely set out!
STARCHALLENGE_SEASHROOM_LVL2.zh: 旅行是一场艳遇，看看蓝天，拥抱大海，享受阳光，因为有梦，所以勇敢出发

STARCHALLENGE_SEASHROOM_LVL3.en: "My heart is like a rock, I can face three mountains and not move, but I can see the four seas and five oceans and come back."
STARCHALLENGE_SEASHROOM_LVL3.zh:
心若磐石, 纵面三山五岳而不动
魂牵鸥鹭, 但观四海五洋且归来

Some zombies have taken advantage of the mushroom party to sneak into the pool! 
Defeat the zombies that took the opportunity to sneak into your house with Sea Mushrooms! 
This level was made by 不知所措Box

STARFRUIT_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Just a small town fruit that travelled to the big city and found his way to the future. His favorite modes of transportation: conveyor belts, hoverboards, and rockets. WEEEEE!
STARFRUIT_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}它只是一个来自小镇的水果，到大城市里找到了他通向未来之路。他最喜欢的交通方式：传送带，喷气滑板和火箭。噫噫噫噫噫！

STICKYBOMBRICE_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Stickybomb Rice has extreme confidence in bombs, rice, and the abstract concept of stickiness. She's published scholarly articles about all three.

{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}爆炸的黏性炸弹会引爆其他的黏性炸弹

STRAWBURST1_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}“Big is good,” says Strawburst. “Though small’s pretty choice as well. And you should never discount medium. I just like sizes, really.”
STRAWBURST1_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}“大？不错。”爆裂草莓说：“小？也还行。中等大小？也很棒。我喜欢哪个？我喜欢大小——这一整个概念。”

STRAWBURST1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Strawbursts grow a berry for small, medium or huge damage!
STRAWBURST1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 爆裂草莓孕育的莓果会不断变大！

{KEYWORD}范围：{STAT}前方3行

{FLAVOR}公主弹簧草作为弹簧王国的第137任公主，最讨厌别人提到她的身份，因为在弹簧王国除了她每个人都是国王或皇后。

STRAWBURST_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Shoots springs that damage zombies and bounce them away.

STRAWBURST_TOOLTIP.zh: 射出弹簧对僵尸造成伤害并将其弹开

STUNION_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Oh sure, everyone knows Stunion as the battle-hardened warrior with the potent breath. But he’s so much more than that. He’s an accomplished pianist. He speaks five languages fluently. Heck, he's the leader of a Cub Shallots group in his spare time. Dude’s got layers. Go on, peel 'em back. You’ll see.
STUNION_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}使用：{STAT}一次性使用，僵尸接触时生效
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}眩晕临近的僵尸

{FLAVOR}所有人都知道眩晕洋葱曾是个久经沙场的战士，连他的呼吸都浑厚有力。但他可远不止于此。他不仅是个颇有造诣的钢琴师，还能熟练运用五种语言。业余时间，他甚至还是小葱队的队长。看看，什么叫做“层”次！具体有多少层？你把他剥开就知道了。

STUNION_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Stunions breathe a stunning cloud of gas on nearby zombies in the lane.
STUNION_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 眩晕洋葱可以呼出口臭雾气来让前面一堆僵尸眩晕。

STUNION_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Releases a large burst of gas in a forward area, moderately stunning all zombies.
STUNION_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}向前方区域释放大量气体，让所有僵尸获得中等的眩晕效果。

STUNION_PLANTFOOD.en: Immediately breathes a large cloud of stunning gas to the right, across three lanes.
STUNION_PLANTFOOD.zh: 立即向右方三行内呼出大量可以晕眩僵尸的气体。

STUNION_TOOLTIP.en: Stuns nearby zombies in the lane
STUNION_TOOLTIP.zh: 眩晕所在行前方的僵尸
