SUNBEAN1_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}As the eldest of the bean brothers, Sun Bean often finds his siblings exasperating. Chili Bean is a little crude, Laser Bean is too far out, and Spring Bean is just plain lazy. Still, he loves them just the same. That's how it is with family.
SUNBEAN1_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}作为豆子兄弟中的大哥，阳光豆经常觉得他的兄弟姐妹很烦。巴豆有点粗俗，激光豆太激进，弹簧豆就是个懒虫。不过，他也同样深爱着他们。这，就是家人的意义。

SUNBEAN1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Sun Beans infect zombies with sun. As a zombie takes damage it generates sun.
SUNBEAN1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 阳光豆可以用阳光之力感染僵尸。被感染的僵尸受到攻击会掉落阳光。

SUNBEAN1_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Increase the amount of sun produces with eaten.
SUNBEAN1_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}提高被吃掉后的阳光产量。

SUNBEAN1_TOOLTIP.en: Zombies that eat it drop sun when damaged
SUNBEAN1_TOOLTIP.zh: 吃掉他的僵尸会在受到伤害时掉落阳光

SUNBEAN_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}In an unprecedented experiment, the Grape brothers stepped into the microwave oven without hesitation, using the effect of electromagnetic waves to fill themselves with plasma energy. This is the story of the birth of Microwave Grapes. "Kids, don't try this at home!"
SUNBEAN_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{FLAVOR}在一次前所未有的实验中，葡萄兄弟义无反顾地踏入了微波炉，利用电磁波的作用，让自己浑身充斥着等离子体能量，这就是微波葡萄诞生的故事。
孩子们，别在家里试这个！

SUNBEAN_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Microwave Grapes bouncing off zombies and knocking them back.
SUNBEAN_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 微波葡萄爆炸，散射出等离子体粒子。

SUNBEAN_TOOLTIP.zh: 微波葡萄爆炸，散射出等离子体粒子

SUNDEWTANGLER_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}Sundew Tangler can trap a Zombie and use it to block other enemies from advancing while periodically producing sun as it leeches the trapped Zombie.

{FLAVOR}"I’ve come to chew bubblegum and drain Zombies - and I’m all out of bubblegum!"
SUNDEWTANGLER_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}阳光茅膏菜可以诱捕僵尸，并用它来阻止其他僵尸前进。同时也可以吸收诱捕僵尸，定期生产阳光。

{FLAVOR}“我来这儿只有两件事要做：嚼泡泡糖和榨干僵尸——而我现在，已经没有泡泡糖了。”

SUNDEWTANGLER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Seemingly innocuous, Sundew Tangler can spring up under unsuspecting Zombies on her tile, trapping them and leeching them to produce sun.
SUNDEWTANGLER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 阳光茅膏菜看似人畜无害，可一旦有僵尸毫无防备踩上她所在的地砖上，她就会突然出现，困住僵尸，随后榨取它的养分，生产阳光。

SUNDEWTANGLER_DESCRIPTION_HINT.en: Sundew Tangler is an extremely efficient trap that can act as a secondary sun producer as well as a wall when it has a zombie in its clutches.
SUNDEWTANGLER_DESCRIPTION_HINT.zh: 阳光茅膏菜是一株高效的陷阱植物，当它抓住僵尸时，既可以生产阳光，也能阻挡僵尸。

SUNDEWTANGLER_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Entangle multiple zombies across the board to temporarily trap them and produce sun.
SUNDEWTANGLER_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}缠住多只僵尸，暂时困住它们，产生阳光。

SUNDEWTANGLER_TOOLTIP.en: Trapped zombies will block other enemies as well as periodically drop sun.
SUNDEWTANGLER_TOOLTIP.zh: 被困的僵尸会阻挡其他僵尸，也会周期性地掉落阳光。

SUNFLOWER_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}After the release of her first major YouTuber video "Zombies On Your Lawn," Sunflower's YouTuber channel has been bursting with fun. She is currently putting the final touches on her reality show TV pitch "Sunflower Thinks She Can Dance."
SUNFLOWER_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}阳光产量：{STAT}普通

{FLAVOR}在哔梨哔梨上发布了她的第一个视频——《有僵尸在你的草坪上》之后，向日葵的频道可以说是如日中天。目前，她正在为自己的真植秀节目《向日葵炫舞秀》做最后的润色。

SUNFLOWER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Sunflowers are essential for you to produce extra sun. Try planting as many as you can!
SUNFLOWER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 向日葵可以为你生产额外的阳光，非常重要。尽量多种一些吧！

SUNFLOWER_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Immediately produces a large amount of sun.

SUNGUN_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Cattail was interviewed regarding its competition with Homing Thistle. It answers "Meow Meow Meow~", which translated mean "There is no problem that can't be solved by being cute~"
SUNGUN_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}猫尾草接受采访时，记者问到：“您是怎么看待与导向蓟之间的竞争关系？”猫尾草面不改色地回答：“喵喵喵~”，翻译过来的意思是--“没什么问题是卖个萌解决不了的~”

SUNGUN_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Fire homing thorns to attack zombies.
SUNGUN_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 发射导向针刺攻击僵尸。

SUNGUN_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}向草坪上随机方向发射一枚巨型导弹。

SUNGUN_TOOLTIP.zh: 发射导向针刺攻击僵尸

SUNSHROOM_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Oh sure, Sun-shroom is known for his ever-present grin and sunny disposition. But truth be told, even he has his dark days. It ain't easy keeping things light when you live in the shadows.
SUNSHROOM_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}对啊，阳光菇的脸上永远都挂着明媚的笑容，心里永远都怀着乐观的态度。但实际上，即便是他，生活中也会有黑暗的日子。在那些被阴影笼罩的至暗时刻，依然保持着自己的光芒，这可不是一件容易的事。

SUNSHROOM_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Sun-shrooms give small suns at first, then normal suns, and finally large suns.
SUNSHROOM_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 阳光菇首先会给予你小阳光，接着是普通阳光，最后会给你大阳光。

SUNSHROOM_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Instantly grows to full size and produces a large amount of sun.
SUNSHROOM_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}立即长大，随后产生大量阳光。

SUNSHROOM_TOOLTIP.zh: 随着时间推移提供更多阳光

SUNTOWER_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}After producing sun, temporarily boosts the production speed of adjacent sun-producing plants and the critical damage of other plants.

{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}When dies, deals explosion damage to the surrounding area and randomly generates a Sunflower or Primal Sunflower on both sides.

{FLAVOR}Every night, Granny White Vensen tells little Laura the sunflower a fairy tale to lull her to sleep. As an old sunflower herself, she's more than happy to do it, and she's quite good at it, too. Oh, that ordinary sunflower over there, you ask? "SUNSHINE EXPLOSION!"
SUNTOWER_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}在产生阳光后暂时加强周围阳光生产类植物的生产速度和其他植物的暴击伤害
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}死亡时对周围区域造成爆炸伤害，并在两侧随机生成一株向日葵或原始向日葵。

{FLAVOR}怀特·文森奶奶每到晚上都会给小罗拉讲童话故事，来哄小向日葵睡觉，作为一颗老向日葵，她很乐意这么做，她也的确很擅长这件事，你说旁边那个普通的向日葵？“阳光爆炸！”

SUNTOWER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Sun Towers produce a massive amount of sun and provide a temporary boost to adjacent plants. When they die, they cause a sunshine explosion.
SUNTOWER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 向日塔可以产生巨大量的阳光，并在产生阳光后暂时加强周围的植物。当她死亡时，造成阳光爆炸。

SUNTOWER_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Immediately produces a massive amount of sun.
SUNTOWER_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}立即产生巨大量阳光。

SUNTOWER_TOOLTIP.en: Gives multiple times as much sun as a sunflower and boosts adjacent plants
SUNTOWER_TOOLTIP.zh: 提供多倍于向日葵的阳光并强化周围的植物

SUN_BANK_DESCRIPTION.zh: 开局时额外增加 {NUMBER} 阳光！

SUN_BREAK_DESCRIPTION.en: Gives bursts of {SUN} sun at regular intervals.
SUN_BREAK_DESCRIPTION.zh: 掉落 {BURSTS} 次数量为 {SUN} 的阳光！

SURVIVE_ZOMBIE_ATTACK.zh: 在僵尸的进攻中生存下来

SWEETHEARTSNARE_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Sweetheart Snare enjoys her alone time. When not defending the lawn, she enjoys reading romance novels and drinking her favorite tea, Rose Tea.
SWEETHEARTSNARE_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}甜心陷阱丛喜欢独处的时光。守护草坪以外的时间，她喜欢泡一杯最爱的玫瑰花茶，在暖香中翻翻言情小说。

SWEETHEARTSNARE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Sweetheart Snare slows and damages zombies as they step through her.
SWEETHEARTSNARE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 甜心陷阱丛可以在僵尸踩过她时对其造成伤害和减速效果。

SWEETHEARTSNARE_DESCRIPTION_HINT.en: Plant Sweetheart Snare and connect her with others, within the same column, to gain damage and slow bonuses.
SWEETHEARTSNARE_DESCRIPTION_HINT.zh: 把甜心陷阱丛种在与相同排其他个体相连接的地方，获得伤害与减速增益。

SWEETHEARTSNARE_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Launches multiple thorns both forwards and backward, while also activating other Sweetheart Snares on the lawn.
SWEETHEARTSNARE_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}向前后发射数根尖刺，同时激活草坪上其他的甜心陷阱丛。

SWEETHEARTSNARE_TOOLTIP.en: Sweetheart Snare slows and damages zombies stepping through her.
SWEETHEARTSNARE_TOOLTIP.zh: 甜心陷阱丛可以减速并伤害踩过她的僵尸。

SWEETPOTATO_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Lotus Pod is a member of the Plant Firearms Fans Club. In order to show his identity, he specially made a revolver shape. Very satisfied with his new look, he decided to show it off to his brother, Lily Pad. When he was going out, he accidentally turn on the TV and saw the news about the zombie invasion of KFW Monks. Upon seeing the top of those monk zombies, Lotus Pod suddenly felt like he didn't want to go out...
SWEETPOTATO_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}莲小蓬是植物枪械爱好者俱乐部的成员，为了展现他的身份，他特意去做了一个左轮手枪的造型。对新造型非常满意的他决定去自己的哥哥睡莲叶那炫耀一番。出门的时候他无意中扫到电视里在播放功夫世界武僧僵尸入侵的消息，看了看那些个武僧的头顶，莲小蓬突然有种不想出门的感觉……

SYNC_DATA_INFO.en:
"By registering your account, your player data will be merged across available player IDs to ensure all progress across devices and platforms is kept. You can also force sync your data for your current player ID to ensure you are up-to-date with what is stored on our servers.
To see your current player IDs, go to Settings -> Download Preferences."
SYNC_DATA_INFO.zh:
注册账号后，你的玩家数据将与可用的玩家 ID 合并，以确保跨设备平台的所有进度都保持统一。你也可以强制同步当前玩家 ID 数据，以确保你与服务器间的数据保持统一。
若要查看当前的玩家 ID，请转到“设置”->“下载首选项”。

SYNC_FAILED_TO_LOAD_BODY.en: We were unable to load your player data from our game servers for. Please find a more stable internet connection or try again later.
SYNC_FAILED_TO_LOAD_BODY.zh: 我们无法从游戏服务器加载你的玩家数据。请寻找更稳定的互联网连接或稍后再试。

SYNC_FAILED_TO_SAVE_BODY.en: We were unable to save your player data to our game servers for. Please find a more stable internet connection or try again later.
SYNC_FAILED_TO_SAVE_BODY.zh: 我们无法保存你的玩家数据至游戏服务器。请寻找更稳定的互联网连接或稍后再试。

SYNC_LOADING_DATA.en: Loading player data from game server...
SYNC_LOADING_DATA.zh: 正在从游戏服务器获取玩家数据…

SYNC_SAVING_DATA.en: Saving player data to game server...
SYNC_SAVING_DATA.zh: 正在将玩家数据保存至游戏服务器…

SYNC_SUCCEEDED_BODY.en: Player data was saved with the game server and reloaded.
SYNC_SUCCEEDED_BODY.zh: 已成功把玩家数据保存至游戏服务器，并且已从游戏服务器重新拉取数据

TALLNUT_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Tall-nut is opening a chain of stores for Tall and Taller gentlemen. "I'll shell out the savings to you!"
TALLNUT_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}阻挡发射的小鬼

{FLAVOR}高坚果为高个子开了一家连锁店。“我会把我的好东西都给你们的！”

TALLNUT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Tall-nuts are heavy-duty wall plants that block low flying zombies.
TALLNUT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 高坚果是一道坚硬防线，可以阻挡飞行僵尸。

TALLNUT_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Heals itself and gains an extra hard armor shell.
TALLNUT_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}治疗自己，额外获得一副坚硬的盔甲外壳。

TALLNUT_PLANTFOOD.en: Becomes encased in metal armor, greatly increasing its health.
TALLNUT_PLANTFOOD.zh: 被包裹在金属盔甲里，极大地提高生命值。

TALLNUT_TOOLTIP.en: Heavy-duty wall that blocks low flying zombies
TALLNUT_TOOLTIP.zh: 能阻挡低空飞行僵尸的坚实壁垒

TANGLEKELP_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Tangle Kelp likes to go deep. He majored in philosophy. Grab a root beer with him, and he'll go on and on about Nietzsche's "Thus Spoke Zucchini" or hold forth on Kant's "Critique of Petunia Reason." It's cool and all, but sometimes you just want to keep the conversation light. Sometimes you just want to talk about the temperature of the water.
TANGLEKELP_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}使用：{STAT}一次性使用，接触时生效

{FLAVOR}缠绕水草主修哲学，喜欢与人深入交流。和他一起干一杯根汁汽水，他就会滔滔不绝地向你讨论泥菜的《密生西葫芦如是说》或糠德的《牵牛花理性批判》，他讨论的时候总是很冷静镇定，但你有时候想让他讨论些轻松点的话题，比如说…水的温度。

TANGLEKELP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Tangle Kelp are aquatic plants that pull the first zombie that nears them underwater.
TANGLEKELP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 缠绕水草是一株水生植物，可以把靠近它的第一只僵尸拖下水。

TANGLEKELP_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Drags up to four random zombies underwater.
TANGLEKELP_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}随机将最多四只僵尸拖入水底。

TANGLEKELP_TOOLTIP.en: Aquatic plant that pulls a zombie underwater
TANGLEKELP_TOOLTIP.zh: 水生植物，将僵尸拉入水中

TARAXACUM_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Taraxacum, as the first plant in the dandelion family to clinch "The Grenade of the Year" at "The Grenade Awards", it adheres to the simplest entrepreneurial philosophy: maximizing the destructive potential of every single seed. While other dandelions fuss over single-shot accuracy or flight trajectories, it has long mastered the truth that quantity breeds quality—after all, what zombie could resist a seed banquet that blankets an entire 3x3 area? By the way, it still refuses to collaborate with any wind-based plants.
TARAXACUM_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}蒲公英，作为首个为蒲公英家族在植物大奖中摘下“年度最佳植物”奖项的植物，它始终坚持最朴素的创业理念：把每颗种子的破坏力发挥到极致。当其他蒲公英还在纠结单发精度或飞行轨迹时，它早已参透了量变引起质变的真理——毕竟有哪位僵尸能够拒绝一场同时覆盖九宫格的种子盛宴呢？顺带一提，它至今拒绝与任何吹风类植物合作。

TARAXACUM_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Taraxacums can shoot out a large number of dandelion seeds, sweeping and damaging a 3x3 area around them.
TARAXACUM_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 蒲公英可以喷射出种子，对周围 3x3 区域扫射伤害并使僵尸减速。

TARAXACUM_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Taraxacum created a big explosion that dealt heavy damage in a 5x5 area.
TARAXACUM_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}蒲公英喷射出大量种子，对 5x5 范围内造成大量伤害的同时眩晕并减速僵尸。

TARAXACUM_TOOLTIP.en: Creates small explosions in an area around it.
TARAXACUM_TOOLTIP.zh: 向四周发射种子，范围伤害

TELEPORTATOMINE1_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Teleportato Mine's heard the "Help me! Help me!" joke a million times before but she smiles anyway. It's a classic!
TELEPORTATOMINE1_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}传送土豆地雷听过上万次“帮帮我！帮帮我！”的笑话了，不过她还是笑得出来。那可太经典了！

TELEPORTATOMINE1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Teleportato Mine teleports zombies to her location, then explodes.
TELEPORTATOMINE1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 传送土豆地雷可以把僵尸传送到她所在的位置，然后爆炸。

TELEPORTATOMINE_DESCRIPTION.en:
{STAT}Range: Three rows and four columns ahead.

{FLAVOR}In the grape family, Succulent Grape has always been the third child, but every time people mention that he is not like Grapeshot and Microwave Grapes, he always says that he is the youngest (a little secret: Succulent Grape is actually short-sighted).
TELEPORTATOMINE_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}攻击范围：三行与前方四列。
{KEYWORD}植物特征：{STAT}绿色植物、强攻植物

{FLAVOR}在葡萄家族中，多肉葡萄一直是老三，但每次大家提及他不像葡萄散弹和微波葡萄的时候，他总是说他是最小的（小秘密：多肉葡萄其实是个近视眼哦）。

TELEPORTATOMINE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Succulent Grape lobs explosive grapes above his head, dealing stun damage.
TELEPORTATOMINE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 多肉葡萄投射头顶的葡萄造成爆炸伤害

TELEPORTATOMINE_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Quickly lobs a barrage of explosive grapes with higher damage to zombies.
TELEPORTATOMINE_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}向草坪上的每只僵尸投掷一颗爆炸葡萄。

TELEPORTATOMINE_TOOLTIP.zh: 多肉葡萄投射头顶的葡萄造成爆炸伤害

TEST_FEASTIVUS_QUEST_DESC.en: Defeat Treasure Yetis before they totally overrun Feastivus!
TEST_FEASTIVUS_QUEST_DESC.zh: 击败宝藏雪人，保护我们的节日庆典！

TEST_WIN_RIFT_LATEST_LEVEL_QUEST_DESC.en: Chase down Dr. Zomboss and earn coins while doing it!
TEST_WIN_RIFT_LATEST_LEVEL_QUEST_DESC.zh: 追击僵王博士并在此过程中赚取金币！

TEST_WIN_RIFT_LATEST_LEVEL_QUEST_TITLE.en: Play Most Recent Penny's Pursuit Level!
TEST_WIN_RIFT_LATEST_LEVEL_QUEST_TITLE.zh: 游玩最新的潘妮的追击关卡！

THREEPEATER_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Threepeater loves playing multiplayer in video games, but split-screen never works out because the left head always cheats.
THREEPEATER_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}伤害细节：{STAT}普通（每颗豌豆）
{KEYWORD}范围细节：{STAT}三行

{FLAVOR}三线豌豆喜欢玩多人游戏，但是分屏通常没有用，因为最左边的那个头总是会作弊。

THREEPEATER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Threepeaters shoot peas in three lanes.
THREEPEATER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 三线豌豆能同时向三行发射豌豆。

THREEPEATER_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Shoots a spread of peas in multiple directions, dealing damage.
THREEPEATER_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}向多个方向射出一大片豌豆，造成伤害。

THREEPEATER_PLANTFOOD.en: Fires off a waving wall of peas across the lawn.
THREEPEATER_PLANTFOOD.zh: 在草坪上发射摆动着的豌豆浪潮。

THRIDANNIVERSARY_EVENTS_INFO_FEASTIVUS.en: Play Events to get special rewards - including plants & costumes! Some Event levels are difficult. Events are limited time! Thank you for accompanying with us for those years!
THRIDANNIVERSARY_EVENTS_INFO_FEASTIVUS.zh: 游玩活动，即可赢取特殊奖励：包括植物和装扮！有的关卡可能会有一点难度！活动时间有限，过了时间可能就不能玩了哦！感谢你的一路陪伴！

THYMEWARP_COSTUME.zh: B级-逆时草乘务员帽装扮

THYMEWARP_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}"Possibilities other to open be to need we." Warp Thyme says, "Limited too far was time to approach unidirectional the that felt always I've."
THYMEWARP_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}使用：{STAT}一次性使用，立即生效
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}回溯僵尸并恢复他们的血量

{FLAVOR}“。度态放开持保见意他其对能可尽该应们我”，道说草时逆“。了局限太性向单的间时得觉直一我”

THYMEWARP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Thyme Warps rewind time, sending zombies back where they started, but healing them in the process.
THYMEWARP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 逆时草可以逆转时间，将僵尸送回开始的位置，并恢复僵尸的血量

THYMEWARP_TOOLTIP.en: Sends zombies back where they started
THYMEWARP_TOOLTIP.zh: 将僵尸送回开始的位置

TIGERGRASS_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Tiger Grass is waiting. The grass tiger waits within. Soon their time will come. And then... the slashes! THE FURY!!!
TIGERGRASS_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}草老虎会随着时间长大
{FLAVOR}虎草潜伏着…而草老虎，则在他的里面潜伏着。很快，时机就到了，然后……劈砍！暴怒！！！

TIGERGRASS_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Tiger Grass spawns a grass tiger who leaps out to attack nearby zombies.
TIGERGRASS_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 虎草可以召唤草老虎，草老虎可以跳出去攻击附近的僵尸。

TIGERGRASS_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Spawn a fully grown grass tiger that deals a large amount of damage to a zombie.
TIGERGRASS_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}生成一只长大的草虎，对僵尸造成大量伤害。

TILETURNIP_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}DJ Tile Turnip changed dance floors with his underground hit "Turnip the Beet." What's his latest mix? When he lays it down, you'll feel the power.
TILETURNIP_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}使用：{STAT}一次性使用，立即生效

{FLAVOR}DJ 瓷砖萝卜用他的地下流行曲“萝卜甜菜”让整个舞池 High 到了极点。他的最新杰作是啥？哼，等他录制好，你就能感受到它的强大了。

TILETURNIP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Tile Turnips create a Power Tile on planting.
TILETURNIP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 瓷砖萝卜可以在种下时创建一个能量瓷砖。

TILETURNIP_TOOLTIP.zh: 在种植处制造能量瓷砖

TIME_TWIST_PINATA_PARTIES.en: Time Twist Piñata Parties are here!
TIME_TWIST_PINATA_PARTIES.zh: 时间风暴彩陶盛宴来了！

TITLESTATE_SCREEN_WAITING_FOR_CDN.zh: 正在从 CDN 获取数据

TOADSTOOL_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Carrot Missile once had the dream of becoming a thin man, but when he discovered that his huge belly could stuff a variety of weapons, he completely gave up on that unrealistic idea. Children also love playing with him because they always think that his belly is full of candy. "Sometimes I have to hide in the dirt," Mischief Radish said helplessly. "I'm really afraid that I will hurt the children who come close to me."
TOADSTOOL_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}捣蛋萝卜曾经拥有过成为一个瘦子的梦想，不过当他发现他巨大的肚子里可以塞入各种各样武器的时候，他就彻底放弃了之前那个不切实际的想法。孩子们也非常喜欢和捣蛋萝卜一起玩耍，因为他们总是以为捣蛋萝卜的肚子里装满了糖果。“有时候我不得不躲在泥土之中”，捣蛋萝卜无奈地说道，“我真的害怕我会伤害到接近我的孩子们。”

TOADSTOOL_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Mischief Radish can launch three types of missiles with different damage.
TOADSTOOL_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 捣蛋萝卜可以发射伤害不同的三种导弹

TOADSTOOL_PLANTFOOD.en: Launch a giant missile to attack all the zombies in the row.
TOADSTOOL_PLANTFOOD.zh: 萝卜变大，发射一枚巨型核弹，攻击本行全部僵尸

TOADSTOOL_TOOLTIP.en: Launch three missiles with different damage
TOADSTOOL_TOOLTIP.zh: 发射伤害不同的三种导弹

TOMBASTIC_24_AD_OFFER.zh: 探陵奇遇广告观看奖励

TOMBASTIC_24_AD_PINATA.zh: 探陵奇遇 2024 广告彩陶

TOMBASTIC_24_MINI_PINATA.zh: 探陵奇遇 2024 迷你彩陶

TOMBASTIC_24_PREMIUM_PINATA.zh: 探陵奇遇 2024 高级彩陶

TOMBASTIC_24_PREMIUM_PINATA_BUNDLE.zh: 探陵奇遇高级彩陶捆绑包

TOMBTANGLER_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Oolong Peach is an underground idol from SSS (Smiling Squony Street). She brings everyone the sweetest singing every day. However, after a incident, Oolong Peach resolutely stands on the front line and brings heal to the plant warriors who fight against zombies. As for that incident, it was just a female zombie eating a can of peaches in front of her. Since then, she has become a more powerful healing plant than Aloe.
TOMBTANGLER_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}前方植物血量降到一定比例时开始治疗。
{KEYWORD}植物特征：{STAT}粉色植物、疗愈植物

{FLAVOR}桃桃乌龙是一名来自微笑瓜街的地下偶像，每日给大家带来最甜蜜的歌声，但是发生了一些变故之后，桃桃乌龙毅然决然地站到了前线，为打击僵尸的植物战士们带来最治愈的问候，至于那次事件，那只不过是一个母僵尸当着她的面吃了一个黄桃罐头。自此之后，她成为了比芦荟更强大的治疗植物。

TOMBTANGLER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Oolong Peach can heal the plant around her.
TOMBTANGLER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 桃桃乌龙可以治愈植物

TOMBTANGLER_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Heal plants around her in 3x3 area.
TOMBTANGLER_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}立即治愈周围的所有植物。

TOMBTANGLER_TOOLTIP.zh: 桃桃乌龙可以治愈植物

TORCHWOOD_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Torchwood and Snapdragon have become fast friends. They like to hang out at either the Tiki Lounge or the Renaissance Faire.
TORCHWOOD_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}能在近程对僵尸造成伤害
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}死亡时燃起一行火焰
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}免疫冻结
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}可以温暖附近的植物

{FLAVOR}火炬树桩和火龙草是对很要好的朋友。他们喜欢在提基酒廊和文艺复兴节那里闲逛。

TORCHWOOD_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Torchwoods turn peas that pass through them into fireballs that deal twice as much damage. They also deal close damage as well as lanewide flame damage on defeat.
TORCHWOOD_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 火炬树桩会将通过火炬的豌豆变为火焰豌豆，火焰豌豆拥有两倍伤害。当僵尸接近时，它们同样可以用火炬攻击僵尸。当被吃掉时，它们会燃起一行的火焰。

TORCHWOOD_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Permanently increases the damage bonus of all the peas that pass through it.
TORCHWOOD_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}永久提升所有穿过豌豆的额外伤害。

TORCHWOOD_PLANTFOOD.en: Permanently turns into a blue-fire version, with blue-fire peas doing twice the damage of fire peas.
TORCHWOOD_PLANTFOOD.zh: 永久变为蓝火版本，蓝火豌豆将会有相对于火焰豌豆两倍的伤害。

TORCHWOOD_TOOLTIP.en: Turns peas into fireballs and does lanewide damage on defeat
TORCHWOOD_TOOLTIP.zh: 将豌豆变成火球，被吃掉后烧伤整行僵尸

TORPEDOFRUIT_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}An amphibious plant that can stun and attack the zombie.
TORPEDOFRUIT_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}水雷果是一种两栖植物，可以攻击最前方的一个僵尸并造成眩晕。

TORPEDOFRUIT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Attack the nearest zombie then cause stun.
TORPEDOFRUIT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 攻击最前方的一个僵尸并造成眩晕。

TORPEDOFRUIT_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Attack zombies ahead then stun them.
TORPEDOFRUIT_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}将前方一格的僵尸击退一段距离并造成眩晕。

TORPEDOFRUIT_TOOLTIP.en: An amphibious plant that can stun and attack the zombie
TORPEDOFRUIT_TOOLTIP.zh: 攻击最前方的一个僵尸并造成眩晕。

TOWER_LEVEL_NAME.zh: 远征之塔 - 第 {LEVEL_NUMBER} 天

TOWER_NIGHT_LEVEL_NAME.zh: 远征之塔 - 第 {LEVEL_NUMBER} 夜

TOWN_LEVEL_NAME.zh: 小镇奇兵 - 第 {LEVEL_NUMBER} 天

TRAFFIC_JAM_DESCRIPTION.zh: 让僵尸的进攻延缓 {NUMBER} 秒！

TRAVELLOG_DAILY_FETCHING.en: Daily Activities are unavailable in offline mode. Fetching data...
TRAVELLOG_DAILY_FETCHING.zh: 日常活动在脱机模式下不可用。正在获取数据。。。

TRAVELLOG_DAILY_NO_INTERNET.en: Daily Activities are unavailable in offline mode. Please check your internet connection and try again.
TRAVELLOG_DAILY_NO_INTERNET.zh: 日常活动在脱机模式下不可用。请检查您的internet连接，然后重试。

TRAVELLOG_DAILY_TIMEOUT.en: There is nothing in here, please go to "Events"!
TRAVELLOG_DAILY_TIMEOUT.zh: 哎呀！这里什么都没有哦，请移步到活动任务！

TRAVELLOG_GENERIC_FAIL.en: Oh no! The Zombies have interfered with your connection. Please try again!
TRAVELLOG_GENERIC_FAIL.zh: 哦，不！僵尸干扰到了你的网络连接。请重试！

TRAVEL_LOG_CLAIM_ALL_TEXT.en: You have {X} completed quests. Claim all your rewards now!
TRAVEL_LOG_CLAIM_ALL_TEXT.zh: 你完成了 {X} 个任务。快领取所有奖励吧！

TUBIFLORA_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}When some plants ask where Tubiflora comes from, no one really knows his origin—he simply appeared one day, and perhaps he might vanish just as suddenly. According to Penny’s detection, Tubiflora is from a universe known as PvZ: Ultimate. Anyway, he is now on your team, just as he once was, to defeat the zombies.
TUBIFLORA_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}当有植物问起仙人球来自哪里的时候，没人知道他是从哪来的，他就像是有一天突然出现的，说不定哪天会消失不见呢？根据潘妮的检测，仙人球来自名为《植物大战僵尸：精华版》的时空。无论如何，现在他会加入你的队伍，就像他以前做的一样，抵御僵尸。

TUBIFLORA_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Tubifloras fire penetrating thorns in all directions when zombies step into the 3x3 area centered on them.
TUBIFLORA_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 仙人球可以当僵尸走进以自身为中心的 3x3 区域后向四面八方射出穿透性尖刺。

TUBIFLORA_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Fires a large number of more powerful penetrating thorns in all directions.
TUBIFLORA_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}向四面八方射出大量更为强力的穿透性尖刺。

TUBIFLORA_TOOLTIP.en: Fires penetrating thorns in all directions
TUBIFLORA_TOOLTIP.zh: 向四面八方射出穿透性尖刺

TUMBLEWEED_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Sumo Melon is a hot-blooded guy. He loves the job of sumo wrestling, refining his skills everyday, because he has a dream, using his sumo power to "dominate the world"! (Well, I'll become Elsu then snipe him, ez)
TUMBLEWEED_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}白瓜相扑手是一个热血青年，热爱的相扑这个行业，他每天刻苦提升自己相扑实力，因为它有一个梦想，自己相扑实力可以 “称霸世界” ！

TUMBLEWEED_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Sumo Memlon uses static brakes to repel zombies with great force.
TUMBLEWEED_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 白瓜相扑手以静制动，可以大力击退僵尸。

TUMBLEWEED_TOOLTIP.en: Hinders zombies and knocks them back
TUMBLEWEED_TOOLTIP.zh: 阻碍僵尸，并将僵尸向后击退

TURKEYPULT_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}In the PvZ Universe town, Tangerine Batter is a big star. With its outstanding baseball skills, he has earned many honors for the plants. Thanks to its stellar performance in the P.Z. Baseball League Championship, he became famous with just one swing. Now, the town's fruit tea shop even wants him to be their ambassador!
TURKEYPULT_DESCRIPTION.zh: 棒打鲜橙可是PvZ Universe小镇上的大明星，它有出色棒球能力，为植物们赢得了很多荣誉；它因在植僵棒球联盟锦标赛中取得优异成绩，一“棍”而红。诺，小镇上的果茶店还想让它作为形象大使呢！

TURKEYPULT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Tangerine Batter can use its bat to launch tangerines. Zombies hit within the single-tile range of the oranges will get a brief stun. Killing the affected zombies within a certain time period will drop 50 suns.
TURKEYPULT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 棒打鲜橙可以用棒子打出橙子，橙子命中的单格范围内僵尸会有短暂的眩晕，在一段时间内击杀命中的僵尸可掉落 50 阳光。

TURKEYPULT_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Launch big tangerines on any zombies in the lawn.
TURKEYPULT_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}向草坪上的每只僵尸打出一颗橙子。

TURKEYPULT_TOOLTIP.zh: 用橙子攻击并眩晕僵尸，击杀后掉落阳光

TUTORIAL_COMPLETE_EGYPT_5.zh: 完成上古埃及第 5 天

TUTORIAL_LEVEL_NAME.zh: 你的房子 - 第 {LEVEL_NUMBER} 天

TUTORIAL_POWERUPS_HAVE_FUN.en: Now have fun with Power Ups!
TUTORIAL_POWERUPS_HAVE_FUN.zh: 尽情享受金手指的乐趣吧！

TUTORIAL_POWERUPS_KILL_ALL_ZOMBIES.en: Kill all the zombies before the timer runs out!
TUTORIAL_POWERUPS_KILL_ALL_ZOMBIES.zh: 在计时结束之前杀死所有僵尸！

TUTORIAL_POWERUPS_USE_POWERUP.en: Great! Now use the Power Up!
TUTORIAL_POWERUPS_USE_POWERUP.zh: 太棒了！现在试试这个金手指吧！

TUTORIAL_POWERUPS_ZOMBIE_WAVE.en: Great, now don't let these zombies eat your brains!
TUTORIAL_POWERUPS_ZOMBIE_WAVE.zh: 很好，别让这些僵尸吃掉了你的脑子！

ULTIMATEFUMESHROOM_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Doominator-shroom, following in the footsteps of Astrofruit, has also journeyed from the universe of Plants vs. Zombies: Fusion into here. Of course, his might has been affected by the distortions of time and space. "But what does that matter? I'm delighted to throw a once-in-a-lifetime fume party for the zombies."
ULTIMATEFUMESHROOM_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}究极大喷菇跟随着究极杨桃大帝的步伐，同样从《植物大战僵尸：融合版》穿越到了这里。当然，他的实力也受到了时空的影响，“但是这有什么关系呢？我很乐意能为僵尸提供一生一次的烟雾派对。”

ULTIMATEFUMESHROOM_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Doominator-shrooms continuously shoot fumes that damage and slightly slow all zombies in an area.
ULTIMATEFUMESHROOM_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 究极大喷菇可以当僵尸走进前方一定区域后向前方持续喷出烟雾，造成伤害，同时略微缓速僵尸。

ULTIMATEFUMESHROOM_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Continuously sprays a stream of fumes that deal damage and chill all zombies.
ULTIMATEFUMESHROOM_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}连续两次长时间喷出一大串烟雾，造成伤害，冷缓僵尸。

ULTIMATEFUMESHROOM_TOOLTIP.en: Continuously shoots fumes that can damage and slow all zombies in an area
ULTIMATEFUMESHROOM_TOOLTIP.zh: 持续喷射可以伤害并缓速前方范围内所有僵尸的烟雾

ULTOMATO1_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Ultomato yawns as unimaginable energies build up inside his being. It’s cool. He can afford to wait. He’s got allllll day.
ULTOMATO1_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}当那令人难以置信的能量于他的体内积聚时，终级番茄打了个哈欠。没事儿，他等得起。他有的是时间。

ULTOMATO1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Ultomatoes charge up slowly, then fire a devastating beam down the lane that damages zombies as long as the charge lasts. Ultomatoes can be made more powerful by planting multiple Ultomatoes on the same tile.
ULTOMATO1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 终级番茄可以缓慢蓄能，然后向当前行发射毁灭性的光束伤害僵尸。终极番茄可以通过堆种来变得更强。

ULTOMATO1_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Explodes dealing a massive amount of damage to all zombies on the lawn.
ULTOMATO1_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}爆炸，对草坪上的所有僵尸造成大量伤害。

ULTOMATO1_TOOLTIP.zh: 在同一地点多次种植以造成更多伤害，使用叶绿素会爆炸

ULTOMATO_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Though named "king of all veggies", Asparagus isn't satisfied with its prestigious title. An avid fan of powered weapons, it believes it only achieves worth in direct action. It even makes the serious declaration "I should only be known for how I fight!"
ULTOMATO_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}浮空植物

{FLAVOR}芦笋享有“蔬菜之王”的美称，然而它却并不以此为傲。从小热爱研究各类热兵器的它只有在战场上才能实现自己的价值。“我只希望大家能够记住战场上热血的我！”芦笋认真地说道。

ULTOMATO_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Asparagus is a floating plant can deal massive damage and stun zombies.
ULTOMATO_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 芦笋战机可以造成巨额伤害，并眩晕僵尸。

ULTOMATO_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}扫射前方的僵尸，造成大量伤害。

ULTOMATO_TOOLTIP.zh: 芦笋战机可以造成巨额伤害，并眩晕僵尸。

UNIVERSE_MAP_TITLE.zh: 疯狂戴夫的时空玉米卷地图

UNLOCK_BEACH_DESC.en: Use a World Key to unlock the holiday horrors of the Big Wave Beach!
UNLOCK_BEACH_DESC.zh: 使用一枚世界钥匙，解锁巨浪海滩的假日恐惧！

UNLOCK_COWBOY_DESC.en: Use a World Key to unlock the pioneering predicaments of the Wild West!
UNLOCK_COWBOY_DESC.zh: 使用一枚世界钥匙，解锁狂野西部的漫天沙尘！

UNLOCK_DARK_DESC.en: Use a world key to unlock the midnight mystery of the Renaissance era!
UNLOCK_DARK_DESC.zh: 使用一枚世界钥匙，解锁复兴时代的午夜之谜！

UNLOCK_DINO_DESC.en: Use a World Key to unlock the mesozoic madness of Jurassic Marsh!
UNLOCK_DINO_DESC.zh: 使用一枚世界钥匙，解锁侏罗纪沼泽原始疯狂！

UNLOCK_EIGHTIES_DESC.en: Use a World Key to unlock the musical mayhem of the Neon Mixtape Tour!
UNLOCK_EIGHTIES_DESC.zh: 使用一枚世界钥匙，解锁炫光魔音游的音乐盛宴！

UNLOCK_FIND_MORE_TOOLTIP.en: Collect limited time seed packets during the {PLANT} event to unlock.
UNLOCK_FIND_MORE_TOOLTIP.zh: 在{PLANT}活动中收集限时种子包来解锁

UNLOCK_FIND_MORE_TOOLTIP_PRODUCT.en: Collect limited time seed packets during the {PLANT} event to unlock.
UNLOCK_FIND_MORE_TOOLTIP_PRODUCT.zh: 在{PLANT}活动中收集限时种子包来解锁

UNLOCK_FOR_PACKETS_CONFIRMED_BODY.en:
You unlocked {UNLOCKED_ITEM}!

Plants unlocked with Seed Packets are not shared between all profiles.
UNLOCK_FOR_PACKETS_CONFIRMED_BODY.zh:
你解锁了{UNLOCKED_ITEM}！

使用种子包解锁的植物不能在其他档案中使用。

UNLOCK_FOR_PACKETS_PROGRESS.zh: 收集 {NUMBER} 份种子包即可解锁！

UNLOCK_FUTURE_DESC.en: Use a World Key to unlock the electric excitements of the Far Future!
UNLOCK_FUTURE_DESC.zh: 使用一枚世界钥匙，解锁遥远未来的尖端科技！

UNLOCK_ICEAGE_DESC.en: Use a World Key to unlock the chilling challenge of the Frostbite Caves!
UNLOCK_ICEAGE_DESC.zh: 使用一枚世界钥匙，解锁极寒冰窟那令人不寒而栗的挑战！

UNLOCK_LOSTCITY_DESC.en: Use a world key to unlock the lost history of the Lost City!
UNLOCK_LOSTCITY_DESC.zh: 使用一枚世界钥匙，解锁失落之城的失传历史！

UNLOCK_MODERN_DESC.en: Use a world key to unlock Small Town's contemporary disaster!
UNLOCK_MODERN_DESC.zh: 使用一枚世界钥匙，解锁小镇奇兵的当代灾难！

UNLOCK_PIRATE_DESC.en: Use a World Key to unlock the marine mischief of the Pirate Seas!
UNLOCK_PIRATE_DESC.zh: 使用一枚世界钥匙，解锁海盗港湾的海上风情！

UNLOCK_WORLD_NAME_KUNGFU.zh: 世界解锁 - 功夫世界第二主线

UNLOCK_WORLD_NAME_LOSTCITY.zh: 世界解锁 - 失落之城

UNLOCK_WORLD_NAME_MEMORYTOUR.zh: 特殊任务 - 回忆之旅

UNUSED_43_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}"Rock, Paper Scissors? Is that a new combat method?" Splendens Blade finds everything around him to be so boring. Singing, dancing, fighting zombies? Those are all tacky plant business. What he's looking for is an honest, heartfelt duel. "Hey you! Yes, Bonk Choy!" Let's have a duel! But what he didn't know was that the plant he challenged was not just Bonk Choy, but also his cohorts. If they took to surrounding him, he would've surely lost. In the end however, the duel ended in a tie. After all, the garden is more focused on maintaining peace, and doesn't want to promote in-fighting.
UNUSED_43_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}“新的决斗方式是什么？石头剪刀布？” 对于凤梨链刃来说，周围的一切都是那么的无聊。唱歌，跳舞，打僵尸？ 那些都是庸俗的植物做的事情。 他所追求的是一场彻底的战斗。 “喂！你！没错，就是那个挥拳头的大白菜！来掰头啊！” 但他不知道的是，他招惹的植物，不仅是眼前的大白菜，还有他的弟子。 如果他们进攻，他就会输。 然而，最终这场战斗以平局告终。 毕竟园子讲和平，不提倡打架。

UNUSED_43_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Spledens Blade can use the chain blade to cause huge damage to zombies.
UNUSED_43_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 凤梨链刃可以使用链刃对僵尸造成巨大伤害。

UNUSED_45_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Chef Cypripedium was used to be one of the top chefs, and the soups he made were extremely delicious. Until one day he came into contact with a new cookbook "The Essence of Offal Cooking" and regarded it as a holy book, and his cuisine began to contain surprising effect.
UNUSED_45_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}厨师杓兰曾经是一名顶级厨师，他做的汤非常美味。直到有一天，他接触到一本新菜谱《拉城烹饪精粹》并把它奉为圣经，他的烹饪便开始产生意想不到的效果。

UNUSED_45_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Cypripedium's soup has a chance to stun zombies
UNUSED_45_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 厨师杓兰的汤有几率击晕僵尸

UNUSED_45_TOOLTIP.zh: 使僵尸眩晕并造成伤害

UNUSED_46_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Dendrobium Windproof have always been the first line of defense against heavy wind, protecting the plant behind them.
UNUSED_46_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}免疫如巨人砸击之类的秒杀伤害。

{FLAVOR}石斛防风网始终坚守在抗风的第一道防线，为身后的植物家人保驾护航。

UNUSED_46_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Dendrobium windscreen has big toughness that you can use to protect your other plants
UNUSED_46_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 石斛防风网有坚固的硬壳，你可以用它来保护你的其他植物

UNUSED_46_TOOLTIP.zh: 阻碍僵尸并保护其他植物

UNUSED_47_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}As a member of the fire brigade, Dripping Diphylleia has extreme enthusiasm for extinguishing fire, down to the smallest flame, and always carries ice water for cooling down very hot objects.
UNUSED_47_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}除了在睡莲叶和花盆上时都不会被啃食。

{FLAVOR}作为消防队的一员，滴水冰莲对灭火的热情无比高涨。哪怕是一点点的火，那也是不能容忍的。她甚至手头有冰水来冷却热的物品。

UNUSED_47_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Reduces the speed of nearby zombies
UNUSED_47_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 滴水冰莲可以使附近的僵尸减速

UNUSED_48_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Stephania idolizes the captain of the National Shield Throwing Team. As he admires his heroic posture of blocking and shield throwing, Stephania has also worked hard and developed proper shield throwing and blocking skills. Don't ask why the shield shatters so easily, it's definitely the problem with the shield as it's just an average consumer's good.
UNUSED_48_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}千金藤的偶像是飞盾国家队的队长。因为仰慕拦网和飞顿的英姿，千金藤也努力培养了飞盾和拦网的能力。不要问盾为什么会破，因为它们都是民用级产品。

UNUSED_48_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 千金藤能造成溅射伤害

UNUSED_49_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Tupistra Stalker is recognized as as one of the best ninjas in the industry, but most will argue that Eggplant Ninja is a far better ninja, Tupistra Stalker doesn't really care much honestly, and recognizes that both sides utilize completely different methods of attack. Tupistra Stalker is more about hiding in the shadows to secure a safer retreat.
UNUSED_49_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}潜行开口箭在忍界是公认的一流玩家，不过据说茄子忍者比潜行开口箭更加强大。 不过潜行开口箭并不在意，因为他认为彼此的战斗方式不同，他更加愿意躲在阴影中来确保自己的安全。

UNUSED_49_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Tupistra Stalker pop up from the ground to damage nearby zombies.
UNUSED_49_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 潜行开口箭可以迅速从地下出现，攻击附近的僵尸

VOIDDRAGON_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}Dark Matter Dragonfruit attacks zombies and puts them in a Shimmer state, reducing their opacity. When opacity reaches 0, the zombie will die unconditionally. This effect is ineffective against Gargantuars, elite zombies, and the Zomboss, but the damage dealt to them will be significantly increased.
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}When attacking zombies affected by Superconduct, the rate of opacity reduction increases.

{FLAVOR}Their ancestors were hunted to the depths of space. Now, their descendants have returned for a refreshing fruit revenge.
VOIDDRAGON_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特点：{STAT}暗物质火龙果攻击僵尸时会使其进入“微光”状态并降低一定不透明度，不透明度降低至 0 时，僵尸将无条件死亡，对巨人僵尸、精英僵尸以及僵尸博士无效，但对其造成的伤害会得到大幅度提升。
{KEYWORD}特点：{STAT}攻击命中受到超导反应影响的僵尸时，不透明度降低速度提升。

{FLAVOR}他们的祖先被追杀至太空深处。如今，后代归来，只为一场冰凉的果味复仇。

VOIDDRAGON_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Accumulate the Shimmer effect to defeat zombies.
VOIDDRAGON_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 积累“微光”效果击杀僵尸。

VOIDDRAGON_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}PlantFood: {STAT}Unleashes a starry field for a certain period of time, continuously attracting meteors with dark matter that will track and attack all hittable enemy targets on the lawn.
VOIDDRAGON_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}展开一定时间的星空领域，并持续吸引带有暗物质的流星雨，流星雨将追踪并攻击场上所有可命中的目标。

WASABIWHIP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 炙热山葵可以挥舞它的燃烧鞭，攻击前后僵尸。

WASABIWHIP_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Spin its flaming whip around, dealing heavy damage to zombies.
WASABIWHIP_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}旋转它的炙鞭，对僵尸造成大量伤害。

WASABIWHIP_TOOLTIP.zh: 鞭打前方或后方的僵尸

WATCH_1_AD_DESC.en: Watch an ad, get some stuff!
WATCH_1_AD_DESC.zh: 广告任务？不如说是超绝任务！看段广告，获取奖励！

WATCH_1_AD_TITLE.en: Ad Quest? More like RAD Quest!

WATCH_MULTIPLE_ADS_DESC.en: Watch some ads, get some stuff, come back and get even more! It's questy!
WATCH_MULTIPLE_ADS_DESC.zh: 看些广告，得些东西，然后回来再得到更多！可以，这很任务！

WATERRABBIT_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}Gain a Max of 5 Chi stacks with each successive Chain of Attacks. Each Stack will upgrade damage and knockback.
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}At Level 5, tap the glowing flower to unleash a devastating Thunderclap Attack.

{FLAVOR}A wise plant once said… "Great results can be achieved with small forces… on your lawn! When it rains… it thunders… and something something …quickness is the essence of a strong lawn defense." What does that even mean?!
WATERRABBIT_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}“真气”攻击强化 1 级：{STAT}1.5 倍
{KEYWORD}“真气”攻击强化 2 级：{STAT}2.5 倍
{KEYWORD}“真气”攻击强化 3 级：{STAT}3.5 倍
{KEYWORD}“真气”攻击强化 4 级：{STAT}4.5 倍
{KEYWORD}“真气”攻击强化 5 级：{STAT}5.0 倍

{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}每轮攻击都可以叠加“真气”，最多叠加 5 层。每叠一层都会提升伤害和击退效果。达到 5 级后，轻点发光的花朵即可释放强大的霹雳雷击。

{FLAVOR}一株智者曾讲到……“尽小者大，慎微者著……草坪上也是如此！像是下雨的时候……打雷的时候……还有那啥……天下武功，唯快不破。”这也太深奥了吧？！

WATERRABBIT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Bun Chi chains 5 quick strikes to attack. After each chain, it increases its Chi Stack, up to 5 times that provides more damage with each stack. At the final stack, tap Bun Chi to unleash the Thunder Clap attack!
WATERRABBIT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 兔极每轮可以快速连续攻击 5 次。每个攻击轮次都会增加它的“真气”堆叠数，最高可以达到 5 层，每多一层都可以提供更高的伤害。到达最后一层后，轻点兔极，即可释放霹雳雷击！

WATERRABBIT_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Immediately triggers thunder clap, dealing damage in a 3x3 area and reducing zombie damage.
WATERRABBIT_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}立即触发霹雳擂击，在 3x3 范围造成伤害，并降低僵尸的伤害。

WATERRABBIT_TOOLTIP.en: Bun Chi increases damage with successive chain strikes!
WATERRABBIT_TOOLTIP.zh: 兔极可以通过连续攻击增强自己的伤害！

WINTERGEDDON_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Eternal Nova: {STAT}can detonate Black Holes left by Paradox-pult.
{FLAVOR}Vortex Melon hails from Plants vs. Zombies: Fusion. He is obsessed with recreating cosmic nebulas right on the lawn. If you see a nebula in the garden, run! That's no gas cloud, it's a massive cluster of frozen melons waiting to drop.
WINTERGEDDON_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}永寂新星：{STAT}究极冰神西瓜可以引爆究极超时空玉米留下的黑洞。
{FLAVOR}究极冰神西瓜来自《植物大战僵尸：融合版》。他总是执着于在花园里还原宇宙中的星云，如果你在花园看见一片星云，赶紧跑，因为那根本就不是星云，那是一大堆还没落下来的冰西瓜。

WINTERGEDDON_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Vortex Melons lob multiple special frozen melons at zombies.
WINTERGEDDON_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 究极冰神西瓜可以投出多个特殊冰西瓜攻击僵尸。

WINTERGEDDON_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Summons a nebula to rain special frozen melons on the rightmost 6 columns.
WINTERGEDDON_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}召唤星云，在战斗场地右侧6列降下特殊冰西瓜雨攻击僵尸。

WINTERGEDDON_TOOLTIP.en: Lobs multiple special frozen melons and detonates Black Holes.
WINTERGEDDON_TOOLTIP.zh: 投出多个特殊冰西瓜攻击僵尸并引爆黑洞

WINTERMELON_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}You may recognize Winter Melon's voice from such incredible documentaries as "It's Cold Up Here," "Ice Bingo," and "Surfin' Swedes."
WINTERMELON_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}发射速度：{STAT}1/2 倍

{FLAVOR}你可能会从《这上面很冷》《冰果》和《冲浪的瑞典人》等大型纪录片中听出冰瓜投手的声音。

WINTERMELON_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Winter Melons do heavy damage and slow groups of zombies.
WINTERMELON_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 减速成群的僵尸并造成大量伤害。

WINTERMELON_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Launches frozen melons at every zombie, dealing both damage and splash damage on impact.
WINTERMELON_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}向每只僵尸发射冰冻西瓜，既可以造成直接伤害，也能造成溅射伤害。

WINTERMELON_PLANTFOOD.en: Chilling, heavy melons are launched up that target every zombie on the lawn.
WINTERMELON_PLANTFOOD.zh: 又冷又重的寒冰西瓜将在草坪上所有僵尸的脑袋上从天而降。

WINTERMELON_TOOLTIP.en: Does heavy damage and slows groups of zombies
WINTERMELON_TOOLTIP.zh: 减慢成群僵尸的速度并造成大量伤害

WINTERMINT_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Rafflesia is one of the most popular employees in the park with children Every time he appears, he will always be surrounded by children. Rafflesia enjoys this feeling very much, "My bubble-blowing skills are the best!" "The children all like to watch me blow bubbles." This is how he introduces himself to others every time. What he doesn't know is that when others nod and smile, most of them will feel confused: Isn't Rafflesia responsible for selling balloons?
WINTERMINT_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}攻击最后方的僵尸
{KEYWORD}植物特征：{STAT}矮个子

{FLAVOR}大王花是公园里最受孩子们欢迎的员工之一，每次他出现的地方总会被孩子们团团围住，大王花很享受这种感觉，“我吹泡泡的技术是最棒的！孩子们都很喜欢看我吹泡泡”每次他都这么向别人介绍自己。他不知道的是，别人在点头微笑的同时大多会感觉很疑惑：大王花不是负责卖气球的吗？。

WINTERMINT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Rafflesia can spit out spore to attack zombies.
WINTERMINT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 大王花可以攻击前方躲在后方的僵尸。

WINTERMINT_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: Big AOE damage, hurray! Now bring it into boss fight then have fun getting soft-locked for using it.

WINTERMINT_TOOLTIP.en: Spit out spores to attack zombies.
WINTERMINT_TOOLTIP.zh: 发射5颗子弹，攻击最后面的僵尸。

WIN_POTW_LTE_QUEST_DESC.en: Earn valuable seeds and MORE, during the Plant of the Week event.
WIN_POTW_LTE_QUEST_DESC.zh: 不止稀有种子，丰富奖励，尽在周度植物星活动！

WIN_POTW_LTE_QUEST_TITLE.en: Win Prizes during your favorite Plant of the Week Event!
WIN_POTW_LTE_QUEST_TITLE.zh: 在粉丝最爱的周度植物星活动中赢取奖励！

WIN_SINGLE_JOUST_MATCH_DESC.en: Go win an Arena match! It's fun!
WIN_SINGLE_JOUST_MATCH_DESC.zh: 说真的，去赢一场竞技场吧！真的很有趣哦！

WITCHHAZEL1_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Witch Hazel paused, unsure how to proceed. Then, all at once, she knew: Use magic, like, ALL THE TIME!
WITCHHAZEL1_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}对巫师僵尸优先使用魔法

{FLAVOR}金缕梅停了下来，不知接下来应该干什么。然后，顷刻之间，她明白了：一直施法！不要停！

WITCHHAZEL1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Witch Hazels use magical sorcery to transform zombies into Puff-shrooms.
WITCHHAZEL1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 金缕梅可以使用魔法巫术把僵尸变成大喷菇。

WITCHHAZEL1_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Transforms a random zombie into a Toadstool.
WITCHHAZEL1_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}随机在草坪上挑选一只僵尸并将其变为忧郁蘑菇。

WITCHHAZEL1_TOOLTIP.zh: 随机选取一只僵尸，把它变为大喷菇

WITCHHAZEL_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Jeweler Pomegranate is the most powerful plant in the city. Many famous local zombies are very happy to paint for him. Jeweler Pomegranate will also pay them compensation. The payment method does not use scanning codes, but the gems are directly "paid", which is clean and tidy.
WITCHHAZEL_DESCRIPTION.zh: 宝石商作为城中最有权势的植物，当地许多有名的僵尸都非常乐意为其作画，宝石商也会支付他们相应的报酬。当然，不是扫码支付，而是“宝石支付”，干净利索。

WITCHHAZEL_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Jewels can be bounced after hitting a zombie
WITCHHAZEL_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 宝石在命中僵尸后可以弹射

WITCHHAZEL_TOOLTIP.zh: 宝石在命中僵尸后可以弹射

WORLDKEY_GIFT_BRIEF_BODY_TEXT.zh: 这把钥匙可解锁新世界！

WORLDKEY_GIFT_COMPLETIONIST_BODY_TEXT.en: Hang on to your keys! You may need them for upcoming Travel Log quests.
WORLDKEY_GIFT_COMPLETIONIST_BODY_TEXT.zh: 守住你的钥匙！你可能需要这些来完成将来的旅行原木任务。

WORLDKEY_GIFT_MIDPLAYER_BODY_TEXT.en: Check your Travel Log for recommended destinations.
WORLDKEY_GIFT_MIDPLAYER_BODY_TEXT.zh: 检查你的旅行原木，获取推荐目的地

WORLDKEY_GIFT_NEWPLAYER_BODY_TEXT.en: This key unlocks new worlds! Check your Travel Log for recommended destinations.
WORLDKEY_GIFT_NEWPLAYER_BODY_TEXT.zh: 这把钥匙可以打开新世界！检查旅行原木，获取推荐目的地。

WORLDKEY_GIFT_TITLE_TEXT.en: Hey, time traveler! Here’s a free World Key.
WORLDKEY_GIFT_TITLE_TEXT.zh: 嘿，时空旅行者！这里有一把免费的世界钥匙。

WORLDMAP_EVENT_BEGHOULED_BEYOND_DEFAULT_.zh: 迷阵锦标赛，“换”出新乐趣！

WORLDMAP_EVENT_BEGHOULED_BEYOND_KIWI_DES.en: Featuring Kiwibeast, the titan of transformation!
WORLDMAP_EVENT_BEGHOULED_BEYOND_KIWI_DES.zh: 野兽猕猴桃，变大变小真的奇妙！

WORLDMAP_EVENT_LOD_BEACH1_HERE_DESC.en: Big Wave Beach Part 1 is here!
WORLDMAP_EVENT_LOD_BEACH1_HERE_DESC.zh: 巨浪海滩第 1 部分现已发布！

WORLDMAP_EVENT_LOD_BEACH1_HERE_TITLE.en: Ride the waves of new zombies.
WORLDMAP_EVENT_LOD_BEACH1_HERE_TITLE.zh: 来看看新僵尸吧！别“浪”哦！

WORLDMAP_EVENT_LOD_BEACH1_TEASER_DESC.en: …and a sneak peek of Big Wave Beach Part 1.
WORLDMAP_EVENT_LOD_BEACH1_TEASER_DESC.zh: 巨浪海滩第 1 部分即将发布！有些内容已经提前偷跑出来了！

WORLDMAP_EVENT_LOD_BEACH2_HERE_TITLE.en: Drop in to Big Wave Beach Party!
WORLDMAP_EVENT_LOD_BEACH2_HERE_TITLE.zh: 顺道来巨浪海滩派对狂欢吧！

WORLDMAP_EVENT_LOD_BEACH2_TEASER_DESC.en: Catch a sneak peek of Big Wave Beach Part 2!
WORLDMAP_EVENT_LOD_BEACH2_TEASER_DESC.zh: 巨浪海滩第 2 部分即将发布！有些内容已经提前偷跑出来了！

WORLDMAP_EVENT_LOD_BEACH2_TEASER_TITLE.en: Homing Thistle has rolled in with the tide.

WORLDMAP_EVENT_LOD_BIRTHDAYZ_DEFAULT_DES.en: Double coin rewards with every win.
WORLDMAP_EVENT_LOD_BIRTHDAYZ_DEFAULT_DES.zh: 每次获胜都可以赢得双倍金币奖励。

WORLDMAP_EVENT_LOD_BIRTHDAYZ_DEFAULT_TIT.en: Meet some old friends at PvZ's Birthdayz Party!
WORLDMAP_EVENT_LOD_BIRTHDAYZ_DEFAULT_TIT.zh: 在《植物大战僵尸》的生日派对中见见几位老朋友！

WORLDMAP_EVENT_LOD_BIRTHDAYZ_REPLAY_DESC.en: Grab a sweet second helping of fun!
WORLDMAP_EVENT_LOD_BIRTHDAYZ_REPLAY_DESC.zh: 吃过蛋糕了？没事儿，再来一块吧。

WORLDMAP_EVENT_LOD_BIRTHDAYZ_REPLAY_TITL.en: Have your cake and eat it, too.
WORLDMAP_EVENT_LOD_BIRTHDAYZ_REPLAY_TITL.zh: 只需要一半的价钱，就能重新游玩今天的生日派对！

WORLDMAP_EVENT_LOD_CHERRY_BOMB_POWERUP_T.en: Choose Cherry Bombs as a Power Up and explode today's Piñata Party.
WORLDMAP_EVENT_LOD_CHERRY_BOMB_POWERUP_T.zh: 用樱桃指来炸翻今天的彩陶盛宴吧！

WORLDMAP_EVENT_LOD_DANDELION_UNVAULT_TIT.en: Dandelion blew in to today’s Piñata Party!

WORLDMAP_EVENT_LOD_DARK_TEASER_DESC.en: Mash it up with new characters from Dark Ages!
WORLDMAP_EVENT_LOD_DARK_TEASER_DESC.zh: 来见见来自复兴时代的新面孔！

WORLDMAP_EVENT_LOD_DARK_TEASER_TITLE.zh: 骑士彻夜不眠，守护着他的公主；我们彻夜不眠，享受着派对的欢乐！

WORLDMAP_EVENT_LOD_DARK_TITLE.en: Party every day until the Knight falls!
WORLDMAP_EVENT_LOD_DARK_TITLE.zh: 夜夜笙歌直至骑兵时代落幕！

WORLDMAP_EVENT_LOD_DESC.zh: 游玩一个特殊的关卡来赢得奖励！

WORLDMAP_EVENT_LOD_DINO1_HERE_DESC.zh: 侏罗纪沼泽第 1 部分，即将发布！

WORLDMAP_EVENT_LOD_DINO2_HERE_TITLE.zh: 回到一亿五千万年前，回望古与今！

WORLDMAP_EVENT_LOD_DINO2_TEASER_DESC.en: Get a sneak peek of Jurassic Marsh, Part 2, right now!
WORLDMAP_EVENT_LOD_DINO2_TEASER_DESC.zh: 侏罗纪沼泽第 2 部分即将发布！有些内容已经提前偷跑出来了！

WORLDMAP_EVENT_LOD_DINO2_TEASER_TITLE.en: The primeval past is coming soon!

WORLDMAP_EVENT_LOD_DINO_TEASER_DESC.en: Sneak a peek at upcoming mesozoic madness in today’s Piñata Party.
WORLDMAP_EVENT_LOD_DINO_TEASER_DESC.zh: 疯狂侏罗纪即将来袭！来今天的彩陶盛宴看看吧。

WORLDMAP_EVENT_LOD_DINO_TEASER_TITLE.en: The ground shakes! Terrible lizards are afoot!
WORLDMAP_EVENT_LOD_DINO_TEASER_TITLE.zh: 大地开始颤动！是可怕的巨蜥开始移动了！

WORLDMAP_EVENT_LOD_EIGHTIES2_HERE_DESC.en: Neon Mixtape Tour, Side B, is here!
WORLDMAP_EVENT_LOD_EIGHTIES2_HERE_DESC.zh: 炫光魔音游，B 面，即将来临！

WORLDMAP_EVENT_LOD_EIGHTIES2_TEASER_DESC.en: And, get a sneak peek of Neon Mixtape Tour, Side B – on now!
WORLDMAP_EVENT_LOD_EIGHTIES2_TEASER_DESC.zh: 炫光魔音游，B 面即将来袭！

WORLDMAP_EVENT_LOD_EIGHTIES_HERE_DESC.en: Neon Mixtape Tour, Side A, is here!
WORLDMAP_EVENT_LOD_EIGHTIES_HERE_DESC.zh: 炫光魔音游，A 面，即将来临！

WORLDMAP_EVENT_LOD_EIGHTIES_TEASER_DESC.en: Catch a sneak peek of Neon Mixtape Tour, Side A, in today’s Piñata Party.
WORLDMAP_EVENT_LOD_EIGHTIES_TEASER_DESC.zh: 炫光魔音游，A 面即将来袭！来今日的彩陶盛宴一睹为快吧。

WORLDMAP_EVENT_LOD_EIGHTIES_TEASER_TITLE.en: Rewind to the ‘80s – call the fashion police!
WORLDMAP_EVENT_LOD_EIGHTIES_TEASER_TITLE.zh: 回到 80 年代，去找时尚警察吧！

WORLDMAP_EVENT_LOD_EXTREME_WEEK_DESC.en: Our hardest mash-up levels all week long.
WORLDMAP_EVENT_LOD_EXTREME_WEEK_DESC.zh: 高难度的彩陶关卡将于本周轮番放送

WORLDMAP_EVENT_LOD_EXTREME_WEEK_TITLE.en: Piñata Party Extreme Super Challenge Week!

WORLDMAP_EVENT_LOD_GHOSTPEPPER_UNVAULT_T.en: Ghost Pepper is haunting today’s Piñata Party!
WORLDMAP_EVENT_LOD_GHOSTPEPPER_UNVAULT_T.zh: 幽灵辣椒缠扰着今天的彩陶盛宴！

WORLDMAP_EVENT_LOD_HALLOWEEN_DEFAULT_TIT.en: Lawn of Doom is on now!

WORLDMAP_EVENT_LOD_HALLOWEEN_GHOST_DESC.en: Haunting the Lawn of Doom for a limited time.
WORLDMAP_EVENT_LOD_HALLOWEEN_GHOST_DESC.zh: 幽灵辣椒限时缠扰着末日草坪

WORLDMAP_EVENT_LOD_HALLOWEEN_GHOST_TITLE.zh: 节日专属植物幽灵辣椒回归了！

WORLDMAP_EVENT_LOD_HALLOWEEN_JACK_DESC.en: Scorching the Lawn of Doom for a limited time.
WORLDMAP_EVENT_LOD_HALLOWEEN_JACK_DESC.zh: 末日草坪，怎能没有炽热的鬼火？

WORLDMAP_EVENT_LOD_HALLOWEEN_JACK_TITLE.en: Special-edition Jack O’ Lantern is here!
WORLDMAP_EVENT_LOD_HALLOWEEN_JACK_TITLE.zh: 节日专属植物南瓜灯在此！

WORLDMAP_EVENT_LOD_HALLOWEEN_WITCHHAZEL_.en: She turns zombies into Puff-shrooms with spoooo-ky magic!
WORLDMAP_EVENT_LOD_HALLOWEEN_WITCHHAZEL_.zh: 她可以用可怕的魔法把僵尸变成小喷菇！

WORLDMAP_EVENT_LOD_HOLIDAY_BIGBRAINZ_CHO.en: Chomper gets an A+ in speed-eating but a D- in table manners
WORLDMAP_EVENT_LOD_HOLIDAY_BIGBRAINZ_CHO.zh: 大嘴花在快速吞食这科上得高分，但在餐桌礼仪上不及格

WORLDMAP_EVENT_LOD_HOLIDAY_BIGBRAINZ_CHO.en: Get Big Brainz at Summer School
WORLDMAP_EVENT_LOD_HOLIDAY_BIGBRAINZ_CHO.zh: 参加暑期班，把自己的头变大吧！

WORLDMAP_EVENT_LOD_HOLIDAY_BIGBRAINZ_DES.en: Featuring the triple-launching fury of the Apple Mortar!
WORLDMAP_EVENT_LOD_HOLIDAY_BIGBRAINZ_DES.zh: 来试试可以同时攻击三排的苹果迫击炮！

WORLDMAP_EVENT_LOD_HOLIDAY_BIGBRAINZ_SNA.en: Thanks to Geometry class, Snapdragon now has a warming radius
WORLDMAP_EVENT_LOD_HOLIDAY_BIGBRAINZ_SNA.zh: 多亏了几何课，火龙草现在能温暖附近植物了

WORLDMAP_EVENT_LOD_HOLIDAY_BIGBRAINZ_SNA.en: Get Big Brainz at Summer School
WORLDMAP_EVENT_LOD_HOLIDAY_BIGBRAINZ_SNA.zh: 参加暑期班，把自己的头变大吧！

WORLDMAP_EVENT_LOD_HOLIDAY_BIGBRAINZ_SNO.en: Snowpea is extra chill after his Thermodynamics class
WORLDMAP_EVENT_LOD_HOLIDAY_BIGBRAINZ_SNO.zh: 寒冰豌豆在上完热力学课程后更加冰冷了

WORLDMAP_EVENT_LOD_HOLIDAY_BIGBRAINZ_SNO.en: Get Big Brainz at Summer School
WORLDMAP_EVENT_LOD_HOLIDAY_BIGBRAINZ_SNO.zh: 参加暑期班，把自己的头变大吧！

WORLD_PREVIEW_DESCRIPTION_APRILFOOLS.en: Ridiculous to the point where the developers don't even know what to say!
WORLD_PREVIEW_DESCRIPTION_APRILFOOLS.zh: 离谱到作者都不知道该说什么！

WORLD_PREVIEW_DESCRIPTION_ATLANTIS.en: Dive into the mysterious undersea ruins and find out the secrets of ancient Greece! Zombies with fish are surging along, hunting for hypoxic brains!
WORLD_PREVIEW_DESCRIPTION_ATLANTIS.zh: 潜入神秘的海底遗迹，探索古希腊传说的奥秘！僵尸与鱼群激流勇进，争夺缺氧的大脑！

WORLD_PREVIEW_DESCRIPTION_BEACH.en: Take a trip back to the '60s and hang ten on the ocean waves! Tides are changing and those gnarly zombies make it not-so-safe to go back in the water!
WORLD_PREVIEW_DESCRIPTION_BEACH.zh: 乘着浪回到 60 年代，感受大海的呼唤！不断变化的海岸线、饥渴的僵尸都让下水游泳危险重重。

WORLD_PREVIEW_DESCRIPTION_CARNIVAL.en: A story about joy and sorrow is about to unfold......
WORLD_PREVIEW_DESCRIPTION_CARNIVAL.zh: 一场关于乐与悲的故事即将上演......

WORLD_PREVIEW_DESCRIPTION_CHINESEGARDEN.en: This is the year 1592, where zombies uphold "Brain Philosophy" and believe that brains are the essence, and without brains, there is no reason. They aspire to seize your brain to achieve the position of the holy undead.
WORLD_PREVIEW_DESCRIPTION_CHINESEGARDEN.zh: 这里是 1592 年，僵尸们崇尚脑学并认为脑即是理，脑外无理。他们渴望获取你的大脑来成就圣尸之位，你能用园林植物抵御吗？

WORLD_PREVIEW_DESCRIPTION_COWBOY.en: Head down the dusty trail for a showdown with the outlaw zombies of yesteryear! Gather up your plants for the big Brain Rush of 1850!
WORLD_PREVIEW_DESCRIPTION_COWBOY.zh: 踏上尘土飞扬的小路，让逃亡于此的僵尸尝尝厉害！植物，在此集结！参与 1850 年那场淘脑潮！

WORLD_PREVIEW_DESCRIPTION_DARK.en: These are holy times. Stop the zombie destruction!
WORLD_PREVIEW_DESCRIPTION_DARK.zh: 这是圣洁的时代。停止僵尸的破坏！

WORLD_PREVIEW_DESCRIPTION_DINO.en: The ground thunders under the awful feet of terrible lizards! Dinosaurs prowl the past, provoking prehistoric zombies into a frenzy of ancient antipathy!
WORLD_PREVIEW_DESCRIPTION_DINO.zh: “轰！轰！”，那是史前巨蜥脚步落在地上的声音。周围是凶猛的恐龙在徘徊，连僵尸也在原始的欲望下变得更为疯狂。

WORLD_PREVIEW_DESCRIPTION_EGYPT.en: Zombies infest one of Earth's earliest civilizations! Tackle mummified monsters and more under the scorching sun of Egypt, circa 2500 BC!
WORLD_PREVIEW_DESCRIPTION_EGYPT.zh: 僵尸侵袭了地球上最早的几个文明之一！在约公元前 2500 年的埃及烈日下对付木乃伊僵尸吧！

WORLD_PREVIEW_DESCRIPTION_EIGHTIES.en: Stock up on hairspray and rewind to the 1980s! With synthesized music and voraciously radical zombies, this heinous dance party will, like, totally tax you to the MAX!
WORLD_PREVIEW_DESCRIPTION_EIGHTIES.zh: 抹上发胶，回到 80 年代，跟随着合成音乐与僵尸一起摇摆！来吧，这场舞会保准让你 High 到极点！

WORLD_PREVIEW_DESCRIPTION_EPICQUEST.en: The fragments of days gone by resurface once more within the pages of the log.
WORLD_PREVIEW_DESCRIPTION_EPICQUEST.zh: 旧日征途中的点点滴滴在日志中再次浮现。

WORLD_PREVIEW_DESCRIPTION_FAIRY.en: This is the place where people say Alice went, but it seems to be full of weirdness...
WORLD_PREVIEW_DESCRIPTION_FAIRY.zh: 这里是人们相传的爱丽丝漫游的地方，但它貌似充满了诡异......

WORLD_PREVIEW_DESCRIPTION_FUTURE.en: In the year 2323, the zombies will have brain extraction down to a science! Can the plants of the future save you from the undead of tomorrow?
WORLD_PREVIEW_DESCRIPTION_FUTURE.zh: 2323 年，僵尸的脑子提取技术已然成为一门新兴的科学！未来的植物能否将你从明日的僵尸口中解救出来？

WORLD_PREVIEW_DESCRIPTION_GTA.en: The year is 1992, gang crime is sweeping the entire West Coast, rap music is prevalent, concentrate your plant firepower to deal with the invasion of gangster zombies!
WORLD_PREVIEW_DESCRIPTION_GTA.zh: 公元 1992 年，帮派犯罪席卷整个西海岸，说唱音乐盛行，集中植物火力，应对帮派僵尸的入侵！

WORLD_PREVIEW_DESCRIPTION_HEIAN.en: In the Heian Ages, Plants vs. Zombies are all about samurai, probably plants will win for sure?
WORLD_PREVIEW_DESCRIPTION_HEIAN.zh: 在平安时代，僵尸和植物们正举行一场武士比赛！植物能赢得胜利吗？

WORLD_PREVIEW_DESCRIPTION_ICEAGE.en: Explore the frozen wastes of prehistory and chill out with the coolest zombies ever. Beware the winds or your plants will be frozen veggies.
WORLD_PREVIEW_DESCRIPTION_ICEAGE.zh: 探索史前的冰冻废墟，与最“冷酷”的僵尸一起“冷静”下来。小心吹来的寒风！它能把你的植物冻成冰块！

WORLD_PREVIEW_DESCRIPTION_KONGFU.en: Welcome to the great competition in the world of martial arts but it feel like the other timelines want to say hi...
WORLD_PREVIEW_DESCRIPTION_KONGFU.zh: 欢迎来到武林天下的大比拼，这里有严重的时间动荡......

WORLD_PREVIEW_DESCRIPTION_KUNGFU.en: The world of martial arts is full of dangers. Those other timelines are no longer here, finally!
WORLD_PREVIEW_DESCRIPTION_KUNGFU.zh: 武林天下，危机四伏，这里才是真正的功夫世界！

WORLD_PREVIEW_DESCRIPTION_LOSTCITY.en: Discover the vanished city of gold, where sun is plentiful and misplaced zombies abound! Use special tiles for extra sun, for these treasure-seekers are no idol threat!
WORLD_PREVIEW_DESCRIPTION_LOSTCITY.zh: 探索失落的黄金之城，那里阳光充裕，迷途的僵尸随处可见！使用特殊地砖来获得额外阳光，因为这些寻宝者可绝非摆设！

WORLD_PREVIEW_DESCRIPTION_MAUSOLEUM.en: The ruins of the previous dynasty are shrouded in dense fog, and hordes of terracotta warriors are getting restless! Zombies full of historical flavor return to the stage of history, protect the artifacts and your brains!
WORLD_PREVIEW_DESCRIPTION_MAUSOLEUM.zh:
前朝的遗迹浓雾重重，群群兵马俑正蠢蠢欲动！
充满历史气息的僵尸重上历史舞台，保护好文物与脑子！

WORLD_PREVIEW_DESCRIPTION_MEMORYTOUR.en: Back to the time of Plants vs. Zombies, let's take a look at the entire PvZ 2! Bring your tasty brains to face waves of zombies from various timelines! Hone your planting skills to experience the profound history between plants and zombies!
WORLD_PREVIEW_DESCRIPTION_MEMORYTOUR.zh: 回到属于PvZ的时间，回顾整个PvZ 2！带好你美味的脑子去面对来自各个时间线的一浪高过一浪的僵尸！训练你的种植经验去感受植物与僵尸之间的深远历史！

WORLD_PREVIEW_DESCRIPTION_MODERN.en: Meet new plants and commit war against some orphan zombies trying to get into your house!
WORLD_PREVIEW_DESCRIPTION_MODERN.zh: 饼干草坪上许多奇奇怪怪的僵尸正在靠近你的家门，它们大多都是小鬼僵尸，这里你可以遇到全新的植物战士！

WORLD_PREVIEW_DESCRIPTION_MUJI.en: Rome wasn't built in a day, but under the control of Dr. Zomboss, it is now filled with various types of Roman zombies. The audience cheers enthusiastically, eagerly anticipating the spectacular moment to witness the epic battle between plants and zombies!
WORLD_PREVIEW_DESCRIPTION_MUJI.zh: 罗马不是一天建成的，但它如今在僵王博士的掌控下，已经充满了各式各样的罗马僵尸。观众们在尽情欢呼，激动地期待着亲眼目睹这场植物与僵尸的壮观战斗的精彩一刻！

WORLD_PREVIEW_DESCRIPTION_PIRATE.en: The year is 1679, the golden age of zombie piracy! Keep your booty close and your plants closer as zombies take to the seas to plunder your brains!
WORLD_PREVIEW_DESCRIPTION_PIRATE.zh: 公元 1679 年，海盗僵尸的黄金时代！僵尸虎视眈眈，盘算着出海掠夺你的脑子。请在你的植物身后躲好！

WORLD_PREVIEW_DESCRIPTION_PLANTAGENET.en: Travel back to the age of plants, the House of Plantagenet! French zombies are coming! Can you lead the plants to victory?
WORLD_PREVIEW_DESCRIPTION_PLANTAGENET.zh: 穿越到植物的年代，金雀花王朝！法国僵尸来势汹汹！你能带领植物走向胜利吗？

WORLD_PREVIEW_DESCRIPTION_RAINBOWMARKET.en: Danger lurks within the neon-lit ancient market. Interdimensional Cyber Zombies are swarming into your house through the data torrent. Focus your fire and use special cards to fend off the zombie invasion!
WORLD_PREVIEW_DESCRIPTION_RAINBOWMARKET.zh: 霓虹闪烁的古老市场暗藏危机，来自异次元的赛博僵尸正随数据洪流涌入你的房子。集中火力，利用特殊卡牌抵挡僵尸的入侵！

WORLD_PREVIEW_DESCRIPTION_SKYCITY.en: This is a vast endless sky. Clouds there are filled with dangerous lightning. Zombies are driving all kinds of dangerous weapons. You will meet an unprecedented challenge. Watch out or you will be gunned down!
WORLD_PREVIEW_DESCRIPTION_SKYCITY.zh: 这是广阔的无尽天空, 云层中满是危险的雷电。僵尸们驾驶着各种危险的武器, 你将遇到前所末着的挑战。当心不要被击落！

WORLD_PREVIEW_DESCRIPTION_STEAM.en: You have come all the way to the Steam Ages. Here, you will make more good friends!
WORLD_PREVIEW_DESCRIPTION_STEAM.zh: 你已经一路来到了危机四伏的蒸汽时代，在这儿，你将结识更多好朋友！

WORLD_PREVIEW_DESCRIPTION_THYMEDEVENT.en: Traversing past and future, uniting every battlefield. The Corridor of Time. Your legend never ends.
WORLD_PREVIEW_DESCRIPTION_THYMEDEVENT.zh: 穿梭过去未来，集结所有战场。时光回廊，你的传奇，永不停歇。

WORLD_PREVIEW_DESCRIPTION_TOWER.en: Travel through mysterious time and space, climb the towering magical tower, and battle against zombie legions from different worlds. Here, use strategy and courage to break through each level, uncovering the ultimate secret hidden at the top of the tower!
WORLD_PREVIEW_DESCRIPTION_TOWER.zh: 穿越神秘时空，攀登高耸入云的魔法之塔，对抗来自不同世界的僵尸军团。在这里，解锁传奇植物、收集神秘礼品，用策略与勇气突破层层关卡，揭开塔顶隐藏的终极秘密！

WORLD_PREVIEW_DESCRIPTION_YOURHOUSE.en: Dr. Zomboss had a sudden idea and created Zombot II to steal your brain and avenge the past!
WORLD_PREVIEW_DESCRIPTION_YOURHOUSE.zh: 僵王博士突发奇想，创造了无畏者二号，夺取你的脑子，一雪前耻！

WORLD_PREVIEW_DESCRIPTION_YOURHOUSEX.en: You defeated Dr. Zombie's Zombot II again, but he used a time rift to send you back to where you started...
WORLD_PREVIEW_DESCRIPTION_YOURHOUSEX.zh: 你再次击败了僵王博士的无畏者二号，但他使用时空裂缝让你回到了最初的地方......

XSHOT_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Sometimes Rotobaga hears the other plants gossiping about each other. "Did you notice that so-and-so has been putting on weight?" they might say. Or, "I hear that so-and-so is dating so-and-so. Can you believe it?"  But Rotobaga isn’t the kind of plant to engage in idle gossip. She’s not interested in talking about anyone behind their leaves. She does her best to just rise above it.
XSHOT_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}浮空植物

{FLAVOR}有的时候，旋转芜菁会听见其他的植物互相议论着什么。他们或许会说：“你注意到某某长胖了吗？”或者是“我听说某某和某某正约会哦，你敢相信吗？”然而旋转芜菁不是那种背地里说闲话的植物。她可不喜欢在植物的“叶后”八卦他们。她尽其所能地去克服这点。

XSHOT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Rotobagas shoot projectiles along the four diagonals, in each direction that has a target.
XSHOT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 旋转芜菁会向四个角的其中几个有目标的角发射子弹。

XSHOT_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Shoots multiple huge rotobagas in four directions.
XSHOT_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}向四个方向射击多颗大号的洋芜菁。

XSHOT_PLANTFOOD.en: Fires a rapid stream of shots in all four diagonal directions.
XSHOT_PLANTFOOD.zh: 向四个对角线方向快速发射大量子弹。

XSHOT_TOOLTIP.en: Shoots along the diagonals, up to four directions at a time
XSHOT_TOOLTIP.zh: 沿对角线射击，最多同时射击四个方向

YETI_FUE_DIALOG_DESCRIPTION.en: When a yeti appears on the map, go after him quickly! If you can spot and defeat him in the level, he'll drop fabulous prizes!
YETI_FUE_DIALOG_DESCRIPTION.zh: 当雪人僵尸出现在地图上，就快去追他！如果你在关卡内找到并击败他，就会掉落绝妙的奖励！

YUCCAGUARDIAN_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Yucca Guardian used to work at the Los Santos Fire Department, but he quit because his red color often caused colleagues to mistakenly hit him with the water hose. Also, please don't ask if he likes to wash his face. He'll get very angry.
YUCCAGUARDIAN_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{FLAVOR}红丝兰曾经在洛圣都消防局工作，但因为他身体的颜色是红色的，经常被同事用水枪误伤，他便放弃了这份工作。同时，请别问他喜不喜欢洗脸，他会很生气的。

{KEYWORD}代码：{STAT}jaynkrow

YUCCAGUARDIAN_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Yucca Guardian fires flaming splash projectiles over three lanes. It can also incinerate incoming projectiles (some special projectiles cannot be incinerated). Incinerated a normal projectile costs it 150 health, while destroying a heavy projectile costs 300 health.
YUCCAGUARDIAN_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 红丝兰护卫可以发射火焰溅射子弹攻击邻近三行的僵尸，并烧毁袭来的子弹（部分特殊子弹无法被烧毁）。烧毁普通子弹会损失自身 150 点血量，烧毁强力子弹则损失 300 点血量。

YUCCAGUARDIAN_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Randomly fires 2 more powerful flaming splash projectiles to any tile on the lawn, causing area explosion damage.
YUCCAGUARDIAN_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}随机发射 2 颗带有更强火焰性质的溅射子弹到场上任意位置并产生爆炸效果，造成范围伤害。

YUCCAGUARDIAN_TOOLTIP.en: Fires flaming splash projectiles and incinerates incoming projectiles
YUCCAGUARDIAN_TOOLTIP.zh: 发射火焰溅射子弹并烧毁袭来的子弹

ZENGARDEN_USE_BOOST_BODY.zh: 将在种植在草坪上时立即获得叶绿素效果。

ZEN_GARDEN_BEE_TUTORIAL_USE_BEE.en: Tap a plant. The bee will speed it up!
ZEN_GARDEN_BEE_TUTORIAL_USE_BEE.zh: 点击一株植物。蜜蜂会加速它的生长！

ZEN_GARDEN_BUY_SLOT_DIALOG_BODY.en: Opens up another pot to plant sprouts and earn sweet loot and boosts!
ZEN_GARDEN_BUY_SLOT_DIALOG_BODY.zh: 开启另一个花盆，种植幼芽，赚取丰厚奖励和强化！

ZEN_GARDEN_DESTROY_BOOST_DIALOG_BODY.en: Are you sure you want to shovel this plant?  It will lose its boost.
ZEN_GARDEN_DESTROY_BOOST_DIALOG_BODY.zh: 你确定要铲掉这株植物吗？铲掉之后，强化就会消失哦！

ZEN_GARDEN_INTRO_TUTORIAL_COLLECT_COINS.en: Here's some coins while you work towards a boost!
ZEN_GARDEN_INTRO_TUTORIAL_COLLECT_COINS.zh: 在你获取强化的路上，还会奖励你一些金币！

ZEN_GARDEN_INTRO_TUTORIAL_RETURN_REMINDE.en: Return to Zen Garden often to boost your plants!
ZEN_GARDEN_INTRO_TUTORIAL_RETURN_REMINDE.zh: 常回禅境花园看看，强化你的植物！

ZEN_GARDEN_INTRO_TUTORIAL_USE_BOOST.en: Sunflower is now boosted! The boost lasts for one level.
ZEN_GARDEN_INTRO_TUTORIAL_USE_BOOST.zh: 向日葵已强化！本次强化只在这一关内生效。

ZEN_GARDEN_INTRO_TUTORIAL_WATER_PLANT_FO.en: She's ready for water. Keep her growing to get a boost!
ZEN_GARDEN_INTRO_TUTORIAL_WATER_PLANT_FO.zh: 可以给她浇水了。让她成长，获得强化！

ZEN_GARDEN_INTRO_TUTORIAL_WATER_PLANT_FO.en: It's a Sunflower! She's thirsty for water.
ZEN_GARDEN_INTRO_TUTORIAL_WATER_PLANT_FO.zh: 这是一株向日葵！她好像很渴。

ZEN_GARDEN_MARIGOLD_TUTORIAL_COLLECT_COI.en: Marigold's growing up! And she has coins for you.
ZEN_GARDEN_MARIGOLD_TUTORIAL_COLLECT_COI.zh: 金盏花长大了！而且她有金币要给你。

ZEN_GARDEN_MARIGOLD_TUTORIAL_COLLECT_COI.en: A batch of coins and she's done!

ZEN_GARDEN_MARIGOLD_TUTORIAL_PLACE_SPROU.en: You may plant another sprout now!
ZEN_GARDEN_MARIGOLD_TUTORIAL_PLACE_SPROU.zh: 你现在可以多种植一株幼芽了！

ZEN_GARDEN_MARIGOLD_TUTORIAL_RETURN_REMI.en: Return to Zen Garden often to earn coins!
ZEN_GARDEN_MARIGOLD_TUTORIAL_RETURN_REMI.zh: 经常回禅境花园看看，获取更多金币！

ZEN_GARDEN_MARIGOLD_TUTORIAL_WATER_PLANT.en: It's a Marigold! She needs water.
ZEN_GARDEN_MARIGOLD_TUTORIAL_WATER_PLANT.zh: 这是株金盏花！她需要浇水。

ZEN_GARDEN_MARIGOLD_TUTORIAL_WATER_PLANT.en: The Marigold is ready for water.
ZEN_GARDEN_MARIGOLD_TUTORIAL_WATER_PLANT.zh: 已经可以给金盏花浇水了。

ZEN_GARDEN_MULTIPLANT_TEXT.en: You may plant multiple sprouts to add a bonus to your chance to get an uncommon or rare plant.
ZEN_GARDEN_MULTIPLANT_TEXT.zh: 你可以种植多株幼芽，以增加得到罕见或稀有植物的概率。

ZEN_GARDEN_UNLOCK_PROMPT_DESCRIPTION.en: Complete Ancient Egypt Day 14 to unlock Zen Garden
ZEN_GARDEN_UNLOCK_PROMPT_DESCRIPTION.zh: 完成上古埃及第 14 天，解锁禅境花园

ZEN_GARDEN_WORTH_NO_SPROUTS.en: The bee will take your plant, but it hasn't grown enough to be worth any sprouts.  Sell anyway?
ZEN_GARDEN_WORTH_NO_SPROUTS.zh: 蜜蜂会买下你的植物，但是那植物还没有长到值任何幼芽的程度。还是要卖吗？

ZNAKELILY_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Znake Lily believes everyone is capable of change and they can turn around. “Except for zombies, those dudes need to be literally transformed and I mean literally.” Znake Lily stated when asked “What about zombies?”.
ZNAKELILY_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}尸讹百合相信所有人都能改变，都能改过自新。“那僵尸呢？”，有人问。尸讹百合答道：“僵尸除外，除非让它们彻底变形——彻彻底底。”

ZNAKELILY_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Znake Lily swirls up enchanted tornados that transform zombies into plant “zomboids” to attack them.
ZNAKELILY_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 尸讹百合可以卷起数阵魔龙卷，把僵尸变形成植物“拟尸”攻击它们。

ZNAKELILY_DESCRIPTION_HINT.en: Znake Lily can transform zombies into strong plant “zomboids” as it levels up.
ZNAKELILY_DESCRIPTION_HINT.zh: 随着等级提升，尸讹百合可以把僵尸变形成强力的植物“拟尸”。

ZNAKELILY_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Launches multiple tornados to transform zombies into various types of plant “zomboids”.
ZNAKELILY_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}发射数阵龙卷风，把僵尸变形成各种植物“拟尸”。

ZNAKELILY_TOOLTIP.en: Targets zombies in a large radius across multiple lanes.
ZNAKELILY_TOOLTIP.zh: 锁定数行内大范围的僵尸。

ZOMBIE_AIR_MISSILE_LAUNCHER_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}He is a minister honored by many zombie pilot, conscientious and hardworking in maintaining aerial order. The zombies are talking about giving him a smart brain for his contributions, though that would be out of the picture until he retires.
ZOMBIE_AIR_MISSILE_LAUNCHER_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}飞弹僵尸是空中飞行俱乐部的部长。他是一位令无数飞行员僵尸们尊敬的部长，一直兢兢业业、任劳任怨地维护着空中的秩序。僵尸们商量着要送他一个聪明的脑子作为回馈，不过这似乎难以在他退休之前实现。

ZOMBIE_AIR_MISSILE_LAUNCHER_DESCRIPTION_.en: Faling to kill it may result in something unexpected.
ZOMBIE_AIR_MISSILE_LAUNCHER_DESCRIPTION_.zh: 如果你没能用手指将飞弹僵尸划飞，它将命中你的飞船造成巨大的伤害。

ZOMBIE_ATLANTIS_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION.en: What difference does it make to float up and down, dive, or fly around? And what's the point of having roadcones in the ocean? Perhaps this is the joint masterpiece of a space philosopher and a seafood artist.
ZOMBIE_ATLANTIS_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION.zh: 上浮下潜和飞来飞去又有什么差别呢？那海洋中路障的存在又有什么意义呢？或许这是空间哲学家和海鲜艺术家的共同杰作。

ZOMBIE_ATLANTIS_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION_HEADE.en: His underwater roadcone barrel makes him twice as tough as the Underwater Basic Zombie.
ZOMBIE_ATLANTIS_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION_HEADE.zh: 他的海底路障桶让他的硬度比普通海洋僵尸强壮两倍

ZOMBIE_ATLANTIS_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION.en: Why doesn't the bucket float away with the buoyancy? Why hasn't the wood rotted from being soaked in water? Any zombie who asks questions like that must have water in their brain. Where's the brain?
ZOMBIE_ATLANTIS_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION.zh: 为什么铁桶没有随着浮力飘走？为什么木头没有被水泡烂？问出这样问题的僵尸脑子一定进水了。哪里有脑子？

ZOMBIE_ATLANTIS_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION_HEADE.en: The iron bucket on his head provides great protection, keeping him from harm.
ZOMBIE_ATLANTIS_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION_HEADE.zh: 头上的铁桶提供了极大的保护使他免受伤害

ZOMBIE_ATLANTIS_DESCRIPTION.en: The Underwater Basic Zombie is full of bad intentions—literally poured into him every time he opens his mouth and yells 'Braaains~'.
ZOMBIE_ATLANTIS_DESCRIPTION.zh: 海洋普通僵尸一肚子坏水，在他每次开口喊“脑子~”的时候灌进去的。

ZOMBIE_ATLANTIS_DIVER_DESCRIPTION.en: The pressure from his peers kept building up, blowing zombies up like balloons. Fortunately, in this new environment, the Deep-Sea Diver Zombie finally understood the true meaning of zombie diving. Is it time to take it off now?
ZOMBIE_ATLANTIS_DIVER_DESCRIPTION.zh: 同行的压力越来越大，都把僵尸吹成了气球。幸亏在新的环境里，深潜僵尸终于明白了僵尸潜水的真谛。该摘掉了吗？

ZOMBIE_ATLANTIS_DIVER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Taking non-direct attacks causes the oxygen tank on his back to rupture and release oxygen, quickly propelling the Deep-Sea Diver Zombie forward.
ZOMBIE_ATLANTIS_DIVER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 受到非直射攻击会让背后的氧气罐破裂喷出氧气，快速带动深潜僵尸向前移动。

ZOMBIE_ATLANTIS_FLAG_DESCRIPTION.en: Underwater zombies believe that the direction of the ocean current represents the direction of brains, so the Underwater Flag Zombie is raised every Friday morning to measure the current, and taken back down every Sunday night.
ZOMBIE_ATLANTIS_FLAG_DESCRIPTION.zh: 海底僵尸们相信洋流的方向代表脑子的方向，所以海洋旗子僵尸每周五早晨都会被升起来用来测定洋流，每周日晚上被收回来。

ZOMBIE_ATLANTIS_FLAG_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: It signals that a big 'wave' of kelp-wrapped zombies is coming.
ZOMBIE_ATLANTIS_FLAG_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 标志着一大“波”身缠海带的僵尸来了。

ZOMBIE_ATLANTIS_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION.en: Legend has it that towering giants tore down the stone pillars, triggering a great flood that submerged the beautiful kingdom. There's also a legend that the seafloor offers affordable flying experience services for certain groups. The Ruins Gargantuar will tell you which legend is true.
ZOMBIE_ATLANTIS_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION.zh: 传说是高耸的巨人拆毁了石柱引发了大洪水，导致了美好王国被淹没。还有传说海底针对特定群体有实惠的飞行体验服务。遗迹巨人僵尸会告诉你哪个传说才是真的。

ZOMBIE_ATLANTIS_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION_H.en: Smash all plants flat, and also throw Imps.
ZOMBIE_ATLANTIS_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION_H.zh: 砸扁一切植物，还会投掷小鬼。

ZOMBIE_ATLANTIS_IMP_DESCRIPTION.en: Beautiful ideals always begin to fester from the smallest places. When these seemingly insignificant things keep piling up, the ideal will eventually sink. The Ruins Imp Zombie loves this theory the most.
ZOMBIE_ATLANTIS_IMP_DESCRIPTION.zh: 美好的理想总是从最微小的地方开始病变的。当这些看似微不足道的东西越来越多，理想终将沉没。遗迹小鬼僵尸最喜欢这套理论了。

ZOMBIE_ATLANTIS_IMP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Can be thrown to a close range to directly attack the submarine.
ZOMBIE_ATLANTIS_IMP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 能被投掷到近点，直接攻击潜水艇。

ZOMBIE_ATLANTIS_LAND_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION.en: The rings on the mysterious orange cone perfectly display the former hierarchical layout of the kingdom. Wearing it will grant you the mystical power of the kingdom's nobility. That's what the advertisement says.
ZOMBIE_ATLANTIS_LAND_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION.zh: 神秘橘色锥体上的圈层完美展示了王国曾经的圈层布局，戴上它将获得王国贵族的神奇力量。广告上是这样写的。

ZOMBIE_ATLANTIS_LAND_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION_.en: His deep-sea roadcone barrel makes him twice as tough as the ordinary underwater zombie.
ZOMBIE_ATLANTIS_LAND_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION_.zh: 他的深海路障桶让他的硬度比普通海洋僵尸强壮两倍。

ZOMBIE_ATLANTIS_LAND_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION.en: The mysterious iron-smelting technology from over ten thousand years ago—wearing it really makes you look one of a kind!
ZOMBIE_ATLANTIS_LAND_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION.zh: 一万多年前的神秘冶铁技术，戴上它看起来真是独一无二！

ZOMBIE_ATLANTIS_LAND_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION_.en: The deep-sea iron bucket on his head provides great protection, keeping him from harm.
ZOMBIE_ATLANTIS_LAND_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION_.zh: 头上的深海铁桶提供了极大的保护使他免受伤害。

ZOMBIE_ATLANTIS_LAND_DESCRIPTION.en: The former beauty of the kingdom sank beneath the sea and became ruins, and the zombies are the ruins themselves.
ZOMBIE_ATLANTIS_LAND_DESCRIPTION.zh: 美好王国的昔日沉入海底成为遗迹，而僵尸正是遗迹本身。

ZOMBIE_ATLANTIS_LAND_FLAG_DESCRIPTION.en: Zombies pursuing brains is a universal truth that transcends time. The flag is the most reasonable prop from that era, yet its technical sophistication runs so deep.
ZOMBIE_ATLANTIS_LAND_FLAG_DESCRIPTION.zh: 僵尸追求大脑是跨越时间的世界公理，旗子又是那个年代中最合理的道具，可它的技术含量却又那么深。

ZOMBIE_ATLANTIS_LAND_FLAG_DESCRIPTION_HE.en: It signals that a big 'wave' of kelp-wrapped zombies is coming.
ZOMBIE_ATLANTIS_LAND_FLAG_DESCRIPTION_HE.zh: 标志着一大“波”身缠海带的僵尸来了。

ZOMBIE_ATLANTIS_PITCHER_DESCRIPTION.en: Fun fact: The Urchin Pitcher Zombie has been a dry scrubber (bath attendant) since ancient times. It's just that zombies don't really like to bathe normally—or they'll take one bath that lasts ten thousand years.
ZOMBIE_ATLANTIS_PITCHER_DESCRIPTION.zh: 冷知识：海胆投手僵尸从古至今都是干搓澡的。只不过僵尸们平时并不爱洗澡，或者就一次性洗上一万年。

ZOMBIE_ATLANTIS_PITCHER_DESCRIPTION_HEAD.en: Throwing sea urchins disrupts plants and oxygen supply.
ZOMBIE_ATLANTIS_PITCHER_DESCRIPTION_HEAD.zh: 投掷海胆，破坏植物与氧气供给。

ZOMBIE_ATLANTIS_POSEIDON_DESCRIPTION.en: The Archon Zombie, in accordance with the divinely granted code, sentences all outsiders to hand over their brains, to be carried out immediately. As for whether this is just or not—let's just say the Archon Zombie never dismounts to pass judgment.
ZOMBIE_ATLANTIS_POSEIDON_DESCRIPTION.zh: 执政官僵尸根据神授法典，判决一切外来者上交大脑，即刻施行。谈其公正与否？只能说执政官僵尸永远不会下马进行判决。

ZOMBIE_ATLANTIS_POSEIDON_DESCRIPTION_HEA.en: Has the ability to control fishes, and can also buff zombies.
ZOMBIE_ATLANTIS_POSEIDON_DESCRIPTION_HEA.zh: 有控制鱼群的本事，也能强化僵尸。

ZOMBIE_ATLANTIS_PRIEST_DESCRIPTION.en: Highly advanced civilization is no different from underwater ruins. High technology and evil magic share the same origin. The authority of the gods in the past is now also conveyed by the Priest Zombie. All of the above come from the same principle.
ZOMBIE_ATLANTIS_PRIEST_DESCRIPTION.zh: 高度文明已与海底遗迹毫无区别，高度科技与邪恶魔法也同宗同源，过去神明的权威现在也是由祭司僵尸传达的。上述这些源自同一个道理。

ZOMBIE_ATLANTIS_PRIEST_DESCRIPTION_HEADE.en: Releases cursed mist that turns plants into Puff-shrooms.
ZOMBIE_ATLANTIS_PRIEST_DESCRIPTION_HEADE.zh: 释放诅咒雾气，将植物变成小喷菇。

ZOMBIE_ATLANTIS_RIDER_DESCRIPTION.en: Swordfish Rider Zombie's dream is to throw a backyard pool party on the ocean floor. But the real problem is how to build an open-air swimming pool underwater.
ZOMBIE_ATLANTIS_RIDER_DESCRIPTION.zh: 剑鱼骑士僵尸的梦想是在海底开一场后院泳池派对，可是如何在海底再制造一个露天泳池成了大麻烦。

ZOMBIE_ATLANTIS_RIDER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Upon colliding with the submarine, he detonates the bombs on his body, dealing massive damage to the submarine.
ZOMBIE_ATLANTIS_RIDER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 碰到潜艇后能引爆身上的炸弹，对潜艇造成大量伤害。

ZOMBIE_BARRELROLLER_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}crushes plants with barrel
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}imps thrown from barrel when destroyed

{FLAVOR}Barrel Roller Zombie is part of a super underground secret awesome club. You probably haven't heard of it. Also, his left arm is slightly longer than his right arm.
ZOMBIE_BARRELROLLER_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}攻击：{STAT}可以用桶碾压植物
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}当桶被摧毁时，会有小鬼僵尸跳出

{FLAVOR}滚桶僵尸是超级地下神秘俱乐部的一分子。你估计没听过这俱乐部吧？没办法，它太神秘了。此外，他的左胳膊比右胳膊稍微长一点。

ZOMBIE_BARRELROLLER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: His rolling barrel crushes plants and provides excellent protection.
ZOMBIE_BARRELROLLER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 他那滚动着的桶可以碾压植物，并为他提供良好的保护。

ZOMBIE_BEACH_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Go to the beach, they said. Put a cone on your head, they said. So, yeah, that's what Pompadour Conehead did. He's at his best when following simple instructions.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}蓬巴杜路障僵尸很喜欢完成别人给他施的简单指令。“到沙滩去”，他照做了；“把路障放到你头上”，他也照做了。

ZOMBIE_BEACH_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: His starfish cone gives him twice the toughness of a normal pompadour zombie.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 他的海星锥帽使他的防御力比普通蓬巴杜僵尸高一倍。

ZOMBIE_BEACH_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Pompadour Buckethead tried to learn to play the ukulele. He figured it would be easier to learn than the guitar on account of how small it is. But his stiff fingers ... they just weren't made for it. Now he just bangs on his bucket. And he's not half-bad either.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}蓬巴杜铁桶僵尸在学习演奏尤克里里琴。他觉得这尺寸可比吉他容易弹多了。但他那又小又僵的手指嘛…很明显不适合这玩意儿。现在就好多了，他敲他那铁桶敲得可开心了！

ZOMBIE_BEACH_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: His scallop shelled bucket gives him great resistance to damage.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 他的贝壳铁桶可以帮助他很好地抵御伤害。

ZOMBIE_BEACH_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Pompadour Zombie recently noticed that he was wearing only one flip-flop. He THINKS he lost the other one while doing the limbo at a bonfire party the other night. But to be honest, that entire night is a little hazy ... and that flip-flop could be anywhere.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}蓬巴杜僵尸最近注意到自己只穿了一只拖鞋。他估计是那天晚上在篝火晚会打杂的时候搞丢了一只。但是，那天晚上雾蒙蒙的…而且拖鞋可能在任何地方。

ZOMBIE_BEACH_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 普通的海滩流浪汉僵尸。

ZOMBIE_BEACH_FEM_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}See that starfish on Bikini Conehead's cone? She put that there herself. She gets a lot of compliments on it too. And sure enough, now it seems like everyone is accessorizing with starfish. She's a trendsetter, that one.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_FEM_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}看到比基尼路障僵尸脑袋上的海星了吗？是她自己放在那儿的，这让她取得了许多赞美。果然，现在似乎每个人都开始往头上放海星了。但是她才是那个时尚弄潮儿，唯一的那个。

ZOMBIE_BEACH_FEM_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION_HEAD.en: Her starfish cone makes her twice as tough as a basic bikini zombie.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_FEM_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION_HEAD.zh: 她的海星锥帽使她的防御力比普通比基尼僵尸高一倍。

ZOMBIE_BEACH_FEM_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Bikini Buckethead had big ambitions. She wanted to do more than just lurch around on a beach all day. Her life's dream: to perform internationally with a synchronized swimming team. Sadly, the nose plug was her undoing. If she only had a nose ...
ZOMBIE_BEACH_FEM_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}比基尼铁桶僵尸有着雄心壮志。她想做的可不仅仅是整天在海滩上闲逛。她一生的梦想，便是与一支水上芭蕾队一起参加国际表演。可遗憾的是，她的鼻塞让这个还未萌芽的梦想破灭了…如果她有一个鼻子的话…

ZOMBIE_BEACH_FEM_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION_HEAD.en: Her scallop shelled bucket provides great protection from damage.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_FEM_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION_HEAD.zh: 她的贝壳铁桶可以帮助她很好地抵御伤害。

ZOMBIE_BEACH_FEM_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Is it weird that we haven't seen any female zombies before? Some say yes. Some say no. Either way, Bikini Zombie is used to breaking new ground. She's not afraid to go where no woman zombie has gone before. You could call her a pioneer. You could call her a hero.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_FEM_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}在之前我们从未看到过女性僵尸，是不是很奇怪？有人说是的，有人说不是。不管怎样，比基尼僵尸开辟了新局面，她不惧怕到以前没有女性僵尸涉足的地方。她可以称为先驱者，也可以称为英雄。

ZOMBIE_BEACH_FISHERMAN_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}pulls plants to the right
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}plants next to him are tossed off the lawn

{FLAVOR}Everyone is tired of Fisherman Zombie's fishing stories. He's always bragging about the size of his catch. Time and time again, he claims to have caught "the big one." But the fact of the matter is, no one has seen him actually catch a fish. Not once. It's more than a little suspicious.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_FISHERMAN_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}把植物向右拖
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}在他旁边的植物会被甩出草坪

{FLAVOR}啊…大伙都听腻了渔夫僵尸在那儿讲自己的钓鱼事迹了。他总喜欢吹牛说自己钓到的鱼有多大，但实际上，都没有人看过他钓到鱼，一次都没有。好像是有点可疑。

ZOMBIE_BEACH_FISHERMAN_DESCRIPTION_HEADE.en: Casts his line to pull far plants to him.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_FISHERMAN_DESCRIPTION_HEADE.zh: 抛出钓鱼绳，把远处的植物拉到他跟前。

ZOMBIE_BEACH_FLAG_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Talk about a disgruntled zombie. Beach Flag Zombie is fed up. None of the other zombies seem to appreciate just how difficult it is for him to swim while holding a flag. Not once have they thanked him for doing the hard work that needs to be done. So it shouldn't come as a surprise: He's been interviewing for jobs elsewhere.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_FLAG_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}海滩旗帜僵尸实在是受够了。其他的僵尸似乎都不知道他举着旗子游泳有多困难。他们一次也没有感谢过他做的这份苦差事。因此，他其实一直在面试其他地方的工作，你应该不会觉得很意外吧。

ZOMBIE_BEACH_FLAG_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Marks the arrival of a huge wet "wave" of zombies.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_FLAG_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 标示着一群僵尸即将随着潮水起落而来袭。

ZOMBIE_BEACH_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}crushes plants with driftwood
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}launches Imp Mermaid when damaged

{FLAVOR}This big guy loves the water. When he's deep down in it, he feels light as a feather. He feels like he's flying. Most importantly, during those precious moments, he feels as if the weight of Imp Mermaid Zombie has been lifted from his shoulders.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}攻击：{STAT}用漂流木砸碎植物
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}在受到一定伤害后扔出人鱼小鬼僵尸

{FLAVOR}这个大家伙很喜欢水。在水里，他感觉自己如鸿毛般轻盈，如鱼儿般自由。最重要的是，在这段宝贵的时光中，他再也不用承受人鱼小鬼僵尸的重量了。

ZOMBIE_BEACH_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION_HEAD.en: Titanic zombie who isn't shellfish with his might.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION_HEAD.zh: 形如泰坦而手持贝壳的僵尸。

ZOMBIE_BEACH_IMP_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Imp Mermaid Zombie couldn't decide whether to wear the top made out of coconut shells or the top made out of seashells. She went with the slinky coconut-shell number because, really, the seashells are soooo last wave.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_IMP_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}人鱼小鬼僵尸不知道自己上半身是该戴椰子壳呢，还是贝壳呢？最后她还是选择了椰子壳，因为她觉得戴贝壳太俗气了。

ZOMBIE_BEACH_IMP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Washes in past your defenses, then flounders forward.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_IMP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 可以被冲到防线后排，然后缓缓前进。

ZOMBIE_BEACH_OCTOPUS_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}bound plants are passive until their octopus is destroyed

{FLAVOR}It started innocently enough. One day, Octo Zombie decided to get a pet octopus. But he loved that octopus so much, he got another and another ... and another. Next thing you know, he was volunteering at an octopus rescue shelter. And now, well, no one wants to tell him, but he's pretty much the undersea equivalent of a cat lady. You should see how many are living at his house. It's quite startling.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_OCTOPUS_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}被章鱼抓住的植物将无法动弹，直到章鱼被击落

{FLAVOR}一天，章鱼僵尸决定养一只宠物章鱼。刚开始还好好的，但他后来对章鱼的爱越来越深，于是一只又一只的章鱼都接连成了他的宠物。之后，他又到一间章鱼收容所当志工。现在嘛…你已经可以把他自己的家称作章鱼收容所了。他屋子里的章鱼数量多得有点吓人。

ZOMBIE_BEACH_OCTOPUS_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Throws octopi at your plants to bind them up.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_OCTOPUS_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 向你的植物投掷章鱼来罩住他们

ZOMBIE_BEACH_SNORKEL_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}submerges to avoid attacks.

{FLAVOR}Snorkel Zombie has a hard time getting the Bikini Zombies. He's tried offering them flowers, jewelry, and even chocolate-covered brains. But nothing seems to work. They just can't seem to see past the snorkel on his face.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_SNORKEL_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}可以通过潜水躲避攻击

{FLAVOR}潜水僵尸追比基尼僵尸追得可苦了。他曾试着给她们送花、珠宝，甚至是巧克力盖脑子，但似乎根本起不到什么作用。毕竟她们根本看不见他呼吸器下的脸。

ZOMBIE_BEACH_SNORKEL_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 潜水僵尸能在水中潜泳

ZOMBIE_BEACH_SURFER_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}can crush a plant with his board
