{FLAVOR}Surfer Zombie took up surfing just last year. At first, he only did it because he thought it would make him look cool. But he was a natural. Now he can hang 10 with the best of them. Now he's headed to the pro circuit. Now he IS cool.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_SURFER_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}攻击：{STAT}可以用冲浪板碾碎植物

{FLAVOR}冲浪僵尸是从去年开始冲浪的。起初，他只是觉得这能让自己变酷，结果没想到自己天赋异禀。现在他已经可以和诸位顶尖选手并排 hang 10 了。目前，你甚至可以在职业联赛中看到他的身影。这真的让他变得很酷。

ZOMBIE_BEACH_SURFER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Surfs past plants on the water, then carries board on land.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_SURFER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 冲浪僵尸在水面上掠过植物，此后在陆地上持板前行。

ZOMBIE_CAKETANKFEASTIVUS_DESCRIPTION.en: #feastivuscaketank is a festive take on the beloved #caketank! It is also trending all over the place. When you spot it remember to take a bite.
ZOMBIE_CAKETANKFEASTIVUS_DESCRIPTION.zh: #蛋糕坦克受人喜爱，而#仲冬圣诞蛋糕坦克是他的节日版本！他也在到处都成为了趋势。你看到他的时候记得咬一口。

ZOMBIE_CAKETANKFEASTIVUS_DESCRIPTION_HEA.en: #feastivuscaketank advances to a set position on the lawn, then emits shocking surprises as its various layers take damage.
ZOMBIE_CAKETANKFEASTIVUS_DESCRIPTION_HEA.zh: #仲冬圣诞蛋糕坦克会走到草坪上的一个固定位置，在受到伤害后，蛋糕层数会减少，随后蹦出惊喜。

ZOMBIE_CAKETANK_DESCRIPTION.en: #caketank is the hot new trend. It is trending all over the place. Look under your bed. It's trending there, too.
ZOMBIE_CAKETANK_DESCRIPTION.zh: #蛋糕坦克是一个新的热门趋势，热门到已经是霸榜的存在了。对了，看看你的床下，它在那儿也很热门哦。

ZOMBIE_CAKETANK_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: #caketank advances to a set position on the lawn, then emits shocking birthday surprises as its various layers take damage.
ZOMBIE_CAKETANK_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: #蛋糕坦克会走到草坪上的一个固定位置，在受到伤害层数减少后，将会蹦出生日惊喜。

ZOMBIE_CAMEL_ALMANAC_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}Arrives in a group of three zombies or more.

{FLAVOR}Each Camel Zombie is an excellent ballroom dancer, practicing every day by holding up mysterious signs with strange symbols. They call it "The Camel Dance."
ZOMBIE_CAMEL_ALMANAC_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}成群出现，一群由三只及以上的僵尸组成

{FLAVOR}每一位骆驼僵尸都是一名出色的舞蹈家，他们每天都通过举着神秘符号来练习。他们称之为“骆驼舞”。

ZOMBIE_CAMEL_ALMANAC_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Arrives in step with other Camel Zombies.
ZOMBIE_CAMEL_ALMANAC_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 与其他骆驼僵尸齐头并进。

ZOMBIE_CAMEL_MANYHUMP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Leader of the many hump camel group.
ZOMBIE_CAMEL_MANYHUMP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 一组多只骆驼的骆驼队的领头驼。

ZOMBIE_CAMEL_ONEHUMP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Leader of the one hump camel group.
ZOMBIE_CAMEL_ONEHUMP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 一组一只骆驼的骆驼队的领头驼。

ZOMBIE_CAMEL_SEGMENT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Just another camel in the group.
ZOMBIE_CAMEL_SEGMENT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 骆驼队中的一只普通骆驼。

ZOMBIE_CAMEL_TWOHUMP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Leader of the two hump camel group.
ZOMBIE_CAMEL_TWOHUMP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 一组两只骆驼的骆驼队的领头驼。

ZOMBIE_CANNON_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}fires imps to mid-lawn
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}explodes into shower of imps if not destroyed quickly

{FLAVOR}The Imps joined the Order of the Cannon Fraternity, Kappa Pea, and quickly rose through the ranks due to the constant firing of their leadership.
ZOMBIE_CANNON_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}攻击：{STAT}发射小鬼僵尸到草坪中央
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}如果不迅速摧毁它，它将发射出一堆小鬼僵尸

{FLAVOR}小鬼僵尸加入了大炮同好会——卡帕豌豆，由于他们的领导经常被发射出去，所以他们升职迅速。

ZOMBIE_CANNON_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Shoots Pirate Imps past your defenses. Eventually it can explode and rain down imps.
ZOMBIE_CANNON_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 发射海盗小鬼僵尸越过你的放线。最终会爆炸并喷出小鬼雨。

ZOMBIE_CARNIE_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION.en: It is a fact that everyone loves clowns, and zombies, and therefore clown zombies.
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION.zh: 众所周知，所有人都喜欢小丑，也喜欢僵尸，因此也会喜欢僵尸小丑。

ZOMBIE_CARNIE_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: The pointy cone provides extra protection for this jolly fellow.
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 尖头路障为这个快乐的家伙提供了额外防护。

ZOMBIE_CARNIE_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION.en: It turns out miniature elephants are a much greater challenge to train than the regular-sized ones. This is especially true if the trainer is a zombie and has no mind.
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION.zh: 事实证明，比起训练常规大小的大象，训练微型大象是更大的挑战。如果训练师是僵尸且没有头脑则尤其如此。

ZOMBIE_CARNIE_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: The bucket-like miniature elephant stand allows this zombie performer to withstand extra damage.
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 像桶的微型大象架子使这位僵尸艺人能承受额外伤害。

ZOMBIE_CARNIE_ARMOR4_DESCRIPTION.en: You're going to want to keep an eye out for that monkey.

ZOMBIE_CARNIE_ARMOR4_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Grinderbox helmet provides extra defense against attack, houses a monkey.
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_ARMOR4_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 研磨箱头盔可以提供对攻击的额外防护，还能藏一只猴子。

ZOMBIE_CARNIE_CANNON_DESCRIPTION.en: The cannon's not such a big deal, but the imps it fires? Yeesh.
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_CANNON_DESCRIPTION.zh: 大炮是没什么大不了的，但从那射出的小鬼僵尸呢？噫！

ZOMBIE_CARNIE_CANNON_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Launches daredevil carnie imps high above the crowds.
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_CANNON_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 向尸群之上高高发射出胆大妄为的游乐园小鬼僵尸。

ZOMBIE_CARNIE_CANNON_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION.en: Veteran Cannon fires three Veteran Carnie Imps at once.
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_CANNON_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION.zh: 魔法大炮一次发射三个爆炸马戏团小鬼。

ZOMBIE_CARNIE_CANNON_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION.en: This cannon is often loaded with a lot of gunpowder... a lot
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_CANNON_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION.zh: 炸弹小鬼每次都在加大魔法大炮内的火药剂量，他的朋友都在劝说他，他却不以为然，他势必要成为马戏团那个最闪烁的星星。

ZOMBIE_CARNIE_DESCRIPTION.en: Carnie Zombie loves the freedom of the open road and would never ever cheat you.
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_DESCRIPTION.zh: 游乐园僵尸热爱开阔道路的自由感并且永远不会欺骗你。

ZOMBIE_CARNIE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: A hard and honest worker at a hard and earnest carnie.
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 费力而真诚的移动式游乐园中努力而正直的员工。

ZOMBIE_CARNIE_FIREBREATHER_DESCRIPTION.en: Always safety-conscious, Firebreather Zombie only breathes fire when there are things nearby that burn easily. That's not all he's confused about, either.
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_FIREBREATHER_DESCRIPTION.zh: 喷火僵尸只在附近有易燃物的时侯才会喷火，十分有安全意识，是吧？当然，这也不是他的全部困惑。

ZOMBIE_CARNIE_FIREBREATHER_DESCRIPTION_H.en: Firebreather Zombie... wait for it... breathes fire. And plenty of it!
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_FIREBREATHER_DESCRIPTION_H.zh: 喷火僵尸…等一下…看，他喷火了！喷了好多！

ZOMBIE_CARNIE_FIREBREATHER_VETERAN_DESCR.en: He is more terrifying than the ordinary Firebreather Zombie, and seems to match the "will-o'-the-wisp" in his name?
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_FIREBREATHER_VETERAN_DESCR.zh: 他比普通的马戏团喷火僵尸更可怕，似乎对上了他名字中的“鬼火”？

ZOMBIE_CARNIE_FIREBREATHER_VETERAN_DESCR.en: Since the last time his neighbor Red Magician Zombie blew up his house, Will-o'-the-wisp Breather was forced to live with him. Of course, Will-o'-the-wisp Breather knew he were not conjured by Red Magician Zombie, later he drank that Magician Zombie's potion as wine.
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_FIREBREATHER_VETERAN_DESCR.zh: 自从上次他的邻居红色魔术师把家炸了之后，鬼火操控者被迫和红色魔术师同居，当然，他会鬼火不是红色魔法师变出来的，他把红色魔法师的药水当酒喝了。

ZOMBIE_CARNIE_FLAG_DESCRIPTION.en: Exciting banners promise fun new experiences for your brain!
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_FLAG_DESCRIPTION.zh: 令人激动的横幅上保证会为你的脑子带来有趣的新体验！

ZOMBIE_CARNIE_FLAG_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Carrying the flag comes with extra benefits and a uniform upgrade.
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_FLAG_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 高举旗帜带来了额外的好处和制服的升级。

ZOMBIE_CARNIE_FLAG_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION.en: Stronger version of Carnie Flag Zombie.
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_FLAG_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION.zh: 马戏团集结僵尸比马戏团旗帜僵尸更强。

ZOMBIE_CARNIE_FLAG_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION_H.en: His appearance often indicates a huge wave of Veteran Carnie Zombies.
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_FLAG_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION_H.zh: 他的出现往往代表一大波拓展马戏团僵尸的入侵。

ZOMBIE_CARNIE_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION.en: He also has a master's degree in 18th-century French poetry.
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION.zh: 他还有 18 世纪法国诗歌的硕士学位。

ZOMBIE_CARNIE_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION_HEA.en: Bashes plants with a heavy barbell just to prove how strong and manly he is.
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION_HEA.zh: 用沉重的杠铃猛击植物，只是为了证明他的强壮与爷们。

ZOMBIE_CARNIE_IMP_DESCRIPTION.en: At the same time, though, you wouldn't want to bet your life on these guys only coming out of cannons.
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_IMP_DESCRIPTION.zh: 但是，与此同时，你可不会想把自己的命押在这些只会从大炮中发射出来的家伙身上。

ZOMBIE_CARNIE_IMP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 经常从游乐园大炮中发射出来。

ZOMBIE_CARNIE_IMP_SPLIT_DESCRIPTION.en: Carnie Imp Split is pursuing solo opportunities, as is Carnie Imp Split.
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_IMP_SPLIT_DESCRIPTION.zh: 单个游乐园小鬼僵尸正在寻求单独表演的机会，毕竟是单个游乐园小鬼僵尸嘛。

ZOMBIE_CARNIE_IMP_SPLIT_DESCRIPTION_HEAD.en: Separating Carnie Imp Twins creates two Carnie Imp Splits.
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_IMP_SPLIT_DESCRIPTION_HEAD.zh: 把游乐园小鬼双子分开，就成了两个单独的游乐园小鬼僵尸。

ZOMBIE_CARNIE_IMP_TWINS_DESCRIPTION.en: They're not actually twins, though they are identical.
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_IMP_TWINS_DESCRIPTION.zh: 尽管他们完全一样，但并不是双胞胎。

ZOMBIE_CARNIE_IMP_TWINS_DESCRIPTION_HEAD.en: Two imps are generously provided for the price of one.
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_IMP_TWINS_DESCRIPTION_HEAD.zh: 以一只的价格慷慨提供两只小鬼僵尸。

ZOMBIE_CARNIE_IMP_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION.en: This is why parents never let their kid play with bomb... but wait imps are probably orphan anyway :V

ZOMBIE_CARNIE_IMP_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION_HE.en: Carnie Imp Veteran always increase the amount of gunpowder in the Veteran Cannon every time. His friends are trying to persuade him, but he doesn't take it seriously. He is bound to become the brightest star in the circus.
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_IMP_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION_HE.zh: 炸弹小鬼每次都在加大魔法大炮内的火药剂量，他的朋友都在劝说他，他却不以为然，他势必要成为马戏团那个最闪烁的星星。

ZOMBIE_CARNIE_MAGICIAN_DESCRIPTION.en: He's such an evil magician that he'll reveal all his secrets for a shiny nickel.
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_MAGICIAN_DESCRIPTION.zh: 他是一个邪恶的魔术师，甚至会为了几个钢镚儿而揭开他所有的秘密。

ZOMBIE_CARNIE_MAGICIAN_DESCRIPTION_HEADE.en: Magician Zombie vanishes zombies and himself forward on the board, and he's got sneaky doves who'll try to fly off with your plants.
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_MAGICIAN_DESCRIPTION_HEADE.zh: 魔术师僵尸可以让自己和场上的僵尸消失，并且它还有试图偷走你植物的鸽子。

ZOMBIE_CARNIE_MAGICIAN_VETERAN_DESCRIPTI.en: Red Magician Zombie is the mentor of Magician Zombie, and his fiery red pigeon show is loved by the zombies.
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_MAGICIAN_VETERAN_DESCRIPTI.zh: 红色魔术师是马戏团魔术师僵尸的导师，他的火红色鸽子表演深受僵尸们喜欢。

ZOMBIE_CARNIE_MAGICIAN_VETERAN_DESCRIPTI.en: Red Magician Zombie is always trying to learn new tricks that other magicians don't know, even looking for inspiration from everything. By coincidence, he watched Kong Fu Zombies. After the performance, inspiration burst out, and he quickly rushed home. Later his home's instantly become "the brightest home" that night. Every zombie passing by stopped and looked at this genius magician with surprised eyes… but that wasn't really his house lol
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_MAGICIAN_VETERAN_DESCRIPTI.zh: 红色魔术师一直尝试学会与其他魔术师不会的新魔术，甚至从歌剧僵影，天尸湖，谦虚与公平等等的一切事物寻找灵感，在一次巧合下，红色魔术师观看了功夫僵尸的表演之后灵感爆发，之后便迅速冲回家中。那天晚上，红色魔术师的家中瞬间爆发出了精彩的光芒，每一个路过的僵尸都停下，用着惊讶的眼神看着这位天才魔术师…

ZOMBIE_CARNIE_MONKEY_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION.en: Tougher and Stronger version of Zombie Monkey
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_MONKEY_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION.zh: 比普通的马戏团猴子速度更快血量更高。
嗷嗷，嗷嗷嗷！嗷嗷嗷嗷嗷嗷？嗷嗷嗷！！！

ZOMBIE_CARNIE_STILTWALKER_DESCRIPTION.en: At such a towering height, Stiltwalker Zombie has an elevated view of things. He refuses, for example, to buy second-hand milk.
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_STILTWALKER_DESCRIPTION.zh: 高跷僵尸站得高，对事物的要求也高。比如说，他拒绝购买二手牛奶。

ZOMBIE_CARNIE_STILTWALKER_DESCRIPTION_HE.en: Stiltwalker Zombie's stilts allow him to walk right over most plants.
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_STILTWALKER_DESCRIPTION_HE.zh: 高跷僵尸可以使他走过大多数植物。

ZOMBIE_CARNIE_STILTWALKER_VETERAN_DESCRI.zh: 气球推销员比高跷僵尸更强。

ZOMBIE_CARNIE_STILTWALKER_VETERAN_DESCRI.en: Balloon Salesman Zombie has been eager to give the balloons he has to every child, but everyone has never actually taken the balloons from the balloon salesman. It seems that he did not realize that it was because of the height problem.
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_STILTWALKER_VETERAN_DESCRI.zh: 气球推销员一直渴望着把自己手上的气球分给每个孩子，但是大家从来没有真正的拿过气球推销员的气球，似乎他并没有发现是因为身高这个问题。

ZOMBIE_CARNIE_TRAPEZE_BLUE_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Working on improving themselves, these talented gymnasts put in years of work to be able to perform these undeath-defying stunts perfectly. All that effort just to be invited to a flimsy place like this with no opportunity to find a better gig. It's quite sad, really.
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_TRAPEZE_BLUE_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}这些天赋异禀的体操选手为了提升自己，付出了多年的努力，只为能完美地表演那些挑战“僵”界的惊人特技。然而，他们所有的心血，换来的却只是一次到这种简陋地方演出的邀请，并且再没机会找到更好的差事了。说实话，这可真够可悲的。

ZOMBIE_CARNIE_TRAPEZE_BLUE_DESCRIPTION_H.en: A group of zombies that perform wonderful tricks by landing one by one on a single tile, with style and elegance to boot!
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_TRAPEZE_BLUE_DESCRIPTION_H.zh: 一群会表演精彩杂技的僵尸，它们会逐一降落到同一个格子上，并且姿态兼具风度与优雅！

ZOMBIE_CATAPULT_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}Lobs projectiles at the last plant in the lane.
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}Crushes plants when driving down the lawn. 

{FLAVOR}Even with two ZCorp factories producing basketballs around the clock, there never seems to be enough.
ZOMBIE_CATAPULT_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}向所在行的最后一株植物投掷子弹。
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}驶过草坪时，会压扁植物。

{FLAVOR}Z 公司的两家工厂全天不休地生产篮球，可就算是这样，篮球似乎都永远都不够用。

ZOMBIE_CATAPULT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Catapult Zombie can lob basketballs over wall type plants with deadly accuracy, making it a serious threat.
ZOMBIE_CATAPULT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 投篮车僵尸可以跨过屏障类植物，以致命的精准度投掷篮球，威胁极大。

ZOMBIE_CHICKEN_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Once released onto the lawn chickens run full speed to peck at your brains.
ZOMBIE_CHICKEN_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 一旦在草地上释放便全速前进以图啄食你的脑子。

ZOMBIE_CHICKEN_FARMER_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}summons zombie chickens when damaged

{FLAVOR}After publishing the fourth study on Ornithology, and four years of research at the Hadron Collider, Chicken Wrangler Zombie has finally solved the riddle of what came first.
ZOMBIE_CHICKEN_FARMER_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}在受到一定伤害后放出僵尸鸡

{FLAVOR}在发表了第四次鸟类学研究成果，以及学习了整整四年的强子对撞机之后，牧鸡僵尸终于解决了是先有鸡还是先有蛋的世纪难题。

ZOMBIE_CHICKEN_FARMER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Releases a flock of chickens once his baling wire is broken.
ZOMBIE_CHICKEN_FARMER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 一但他的栓绳断掉，就会放出一堆鸡。

ZOMBIE_CHINESEGARDEN_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}The cone of Garden Conehead Zombie is made of high-quality golden nan wood. This type of wood is only found in the imperial palace... Wondering where she got this type of wood from? Try guessing how she met her demise first.
ZOMBIE_CHINESEGARDEN_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}当一种奇怪的橘色塑料流行文化传入东方时，富家的僵尸又有了新的彰显富贵的方式。

ZOMBIE_CHINESEGARDEN_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION_.en: A seemingly palace-born conehead zombie, the cone on her head makes her three times stronger than a basic Garden Zombie.
ZOMBIE_CHINESEGARDEN_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION_.zh: 一个看上去很富贵的路障僵尸，头上的路障使她三倍强于园林书生僵尸。

ZOMBIE_CHINESEGARDEN_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}In the censer on his head, it's not filled with ordinary incense ash; it contains immortal dust. Legend has it that applying it to the head for 3,141,592,653 years can lead to enlightenment and ascension to immortality. He has currently endured for 774,907 years.
ZOMBIE_CHINESEGARDEN_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}僵尸们觉得园林铁炉僵尸是个灾星，事实上他只是把自己的脑袋当做香料用而已。

ZOMBIE_CHINESEGARDEN_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION_.en: A buckethead zombie aspiring to achieve immortality, the censer on his head provides him with significant protection.
ZOMBIE_CHINESEGARDEN_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION_.zh: 一个想要得道成仙的铁桶僵尸，头上的香炉为他提供了极大的保护。

ZOMBIE_CHINESEGARDEN_CARPIMP_DESCRIPTION.en: As the saying goes, "Abundance follows the fish!" That's why Imp Koi Zombie has topped the Most Popular Imp rankings for 5,000 consecutive years!
ZOMBIE_CHINESEGARDEN_CARPIMP_DESCRIPTION.zh: 正所谓年年有鱼，所以鲤鱼小鬼僵尸已经在最受欢迎的小僵尸排行里蝉联第一名长达 5000 年！

ZOMBIE_CHINESEGARDEN_CARPIMP_DESCRIPTION.en: Flies over most of your defenses, detonates to damage surrounding plants, then staggers onward.
ZOMBIE_CHINESEGARDEN_CARPIMP_DESCRIPTION.zh: 可以飞越到你的防线后排，爆炸并伤害周围的植物，然后缓缓前进。

ZOMBIE_CHINESEGARDEN_CUJUSTAR_DESCRIPTIO.en: Cuju Star Zombie is a legend in the sport. He owes his fame to his impeccable technique—kicking the ball precisely into people's heads.
ZOMBIE_CHINESEGARDEN_CUJUSTAR_DESCRIPTIO.zh: 蹴鞠明星僵尸在蹴鞠界享有誉名，这得益于他高超的球技——将球精准的踢进别人的脑袋里。

ZOMBIE_CHINESEGARDEN_CUJUSTAR_DESCRIPTIO.en: Kicks a Cuju ball that displaces the first plant hit, then ricochets between plants to deal damage.
ZOMBIE_CHINESEGARDEN_CUJUSTAR_DESCRIPTIO.zh: 踢出蹴鞠攻击植物，蹴鞠会位移命中的第一株植物，随后在植物间弹射造成伤害。

ZOMBIE_CHINESEGARDEN_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}The Garden Zombie believes himself to be quite extraordinary, so he often dresses up like a scholar, carrying a box and revealing his uniqueness. By the way, he also happens to be the waiter at the corner tavern.
ZOMBIE_CHINESEGARDEN_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}因为贫穷的理想主义，书生僵尸与千金脑子小姐的爱情是那么的高不可攀。

ZOMBIE_CHINESEGARDEN_FLAG_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Garden Flag Zombie was originally a fool on the city wall. Since he heard from a fox that always speaks zombie gibberish that the general in the city would appoint him as a flag bearer, he enthusiastically grabbed a flag and started practicing charging.
ZOMBIE_CHINESEGARDEN_FLAG_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}园林旗帜僵尸原本是城头的傻子，自从他从一直会说僵话的狐狸那听到城中的那位将军会封他为旗手后，他便真拉起了旗子，开始练习起了冲锋。

ZOMBIE_CHINESEGARDEN_FLAG_DESCRIPTION_HE.en: Marks the arrival of an overgrown "wave" of zombies.
ZOMBIE_CHINESEGARDEN_FLAG_DESCRIPTION_HE.zh: 象征着一大波中国园林僵尸的登场。

ZOMBIE_CHINESEGARDEN_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPT.en: {FLAVOR}Guardian Gargantuar not only serves as a guardian but also works as a butcher in the east of the city, performs street acts in the west, and manages a paper-cutting shop in the north. If there's any job, you can approach him. He's also in need of a large sum of money to buy fabric for new clothes.
ZOMBIE_CHINESEGARDEN_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPT.zh: {FLAVOR}员外巨人僵尸在许多事项上和大多数僵尸看法不同，因此尝尝打压其他僵尸。但至少在吃脑子这件事上，他和大家的想法都一样。

ZOMBIE_CHINESEGARDEN_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPT.en: He is the dedicated guardian who will smash anything blocking the way, very dedicated to his duty.
ZOMBIE_CHINESEGARDEN_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPT.zh: 会砸扁一切挡路植物的壮硕员外，非常敬业。

ZOMBIE_CHINESEGARDEN_IMP_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Official Imp was once a top scholar in both literary and martial arts. Even now, he can proficiently execute 108 martial arts techniques. He excels in various fields such as music, chess, calligraphy, and painting. Additionally, he's fluent in Western Brain Language. The cost of such skills is that Official Imp has lost all his hair, but at least he has a comforting wig to console him.
ZOMBIE_CHINESEGARDEN_IMP_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}小鬼是个小官，但小鬼这个官可不小。

ZOMBIE_CHINESEGARDEN_IMP_DESCRIPTION_HEA.en: Official Imp will be thrown to the back of your defense line and then use all his lifelong learning to find ways to eat your brain.
ZOMBIE_CHINESEGARDEN_IMP_DESCRIPTION_HEA.zh: 官员小鬼僵尸会被扔到你的防线后排，然后想方设法地吃掉你的脑子。

ZOMBIE_CHINESEGARDEN_IMP_TAOIST_DESCRIPT.en: The real estate agency's newest intern. He specializes in feigning blindness and fake crying.
ZOMBIE_CHINESEGARDEN_IMP_TAOIST_DESCRIPT.zh: 房产中介的新兴员工，擅长装瞎和假哭。

ZOMBIE_CHINESEGARDEN_IMP_TAOIST_DESCRIPT.en: Seeks revenge for the fallen Fengshuist Zombie.
ZOMBIE_CHINESEGARDEN_IMP_TAOIST_DESCRIPT.zh: 为死去的风水学家僵尸复仇。

ZOMBIE_CHINESEGARDEN_POET_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Literati Zombie doesn't have a talent for painting; he just writes characters in a skewed manner to form a painting. In a sense, this can be considered a kind of talent. In fact, it's challenging to find Literati Zombie's paintings because he doesn't have any talent for poetry in the first place.
ZOMBIE_CHINESEGARDEN_POET_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}当你眺望骚客僵尸的一辈子，你会发现虽然他书写了无数个僵尸的故事，但最终留下的却只有他自己。

ZOMBIE_CHINESEGARDEN_POET_DESCRIPTION_HE.en: Literati Zombie will use all his lifelong learning to randomly summon Garden Zombie, Garden Conehead Zombie, and Garden Buckethead Zombie.
ZOMBIE_CHINESEGARDEN_POET_DESCRIPTION_HE.zh: 骚客僵尸会利用他毕生所学随机召唤出园林书生僵尸、园林路障僵尸、园林铁炉僵尸。

ZOMBIE_CHINESEGARDEN_SCIENTIST_DESCRIPTI.en: Fengshuist Zombie uses his compass to locate auspicious burial plots, converse with ancient tombs, and put restless spirits to ease. In other words, he is basically the zombie world's most scientific real estate agent.
ZOMBIE_CHINESEGARDEN_SCIENTIST_DESCRIPTI.zh: 风水学家僵尸用罗盘定位阴宅宝地，与古墓对话，让亡灵安息。换种角度来说，风水学家僵尸是一个僵尸界科学的房屋销售。

ZOMBIE_CHINESEGARDEN_SCIENTIST_DESCRIPTI.en: Harnesses Feng Shui to shift positions and reduce damage dealt by plants, and summons a Taoist Imp upon death.
ZOMBIE_CHINESEGARDEN_SCIENTIST_DESCRIPTI.zh: 利用风水之力使自身产生位移并降低植物造成的伤害，死亡后召唤道童小鬼僵尸。

ZOMBIE_CHINESEGARDEN_UMBRELLA_DESCRIPTIO.en: {FLAVOR}Legend has it that during the deep hours of the night, one can see a woman in red holding a red umbrella on the bridge. Her face is ghastly green, and if she notices you, your soul will be lost immediately.  —A terrifying story from the south of the city.
ZOMBIE_CHINESEGARDEN_UMBRELLA_DESCRIPTIO.zh: {FLAVOR}众所周知，许多典型文化是由某些典型人物引领的，但传播过程中免不了误解、谣传。同样，纸伞僵尸就是其中一个典型文化的源头。

ZOMBIE_CHINESEGARDEN_UMBRELLA_DESCRIPTIO.en: Umbrella Zombie uses her red paper umbrella to deflect anything falling from the sky or distracting her, including throwing projectiles.
ZOMBIE_CHINESEGARDEN_UMBRELLA_DESCRIPTIO.zh: 纸伞僵尸会利用她的红纸伞反弹一切从天而降的事物，包括投掷类植物子弹。

ZOMBIE_CLEOPATRA_DESCRIPTION.en: Cleopatra Zombie was Pharaoh Zombie's wife, and they were married on top of the pyramid.
ZOMBIE_CLEOPATRA_DESCRIPTION.zh: 埃及艳后是法老王的妻子，他们是在金字塔顶结为夫妻的。

ZOMBIE_CLEOPATRA_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Call a sandstorm and bring mummy zombies to protect herself.
ZOMBIE_CLEOPATRA_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 召唤沙尘暴，带来木乃伊僵尸保护自己。

ZOMBIE_COWBOY_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}The sheriff of these here parts. Please pull over the horse and pull out your driver's license, registration, and proof of brains.
ZOMBIE_COWBOY_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}请这片区域的治安官把马靠边停，拿出你的架马证、注册资格证，以及你的有脑证明！

ZOMBIE_COWBOY_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: His cowhide cone gives him twice the toughness of a regular cowboy.
ZOMBIE_COWBOY_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 他的牛皮锥帽使他的防御力比普通牛仔僵尸高一倍。

ZOMBIE_COWBOY_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}A five-time winner of the temporal chili cook-off. Those Egyptian zombies don't know their chili, but Cowboys love their beans. The more you eat, the more you brains.
ZOMBIE_COWBOY_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}他曾五次获得辣椒烹饪大赛的冠军。那些埃及僵尸虽然不知道他们的辣椒，但牛仔僵尸喜欢他们的豆子。吃得越多，脑子越好。

ZOMBIE_COWBOY_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: His chili pot hat makes him greatly resistant to damage.
ZOMBIE_COWBOY_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 他的辣椒壶铁桶让他非常耐打。

ZOMBIE_COWBOY_ARMOR4_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Cart-Head Zombie could probably move a lot faster if he did a handstand and rolled, but he's not thinking that far ahead.
ZOMBIE_COWBOY_ARMOR4_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}矿车僵尸如果把头倒过来，用矿车前进的话，速度可能会快得多，但他没有想到那一步。

ZOMBIE_COWBOY_ARMOR4_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Cart-head Zombie's cart-shaped chapeau provides extra-wheeled head protection.
ZOMBIE_COWBOY_ARMOR4_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 矿车僵尸的矿车为它提供了额外的头部防御。

ZOMBIE_COWBOY_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Cowboy Zombie thinks he's the roughest, toughest, meanest zombie varmint in the west, south and east. He's anxious to test his skills in the central coast region.
ZOMBIE_COWBOY_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}牛仔僵尸觉得自己的坚忍、强壮、冷血无论是在西部、南部还是东部都无人能及。现在，他已经迫不及待想去中部证明自己了。

ZOMBIE_COWBOY_FLAG_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Marks the arrival of a huge dusty "wave" of zombies.
ZOMBIE_COWBOY_FLAG_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 标示着一群尘土飞扬的僵尸即将来袭。

ZOMBIE_COWBOY_FLAG_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Arrows point to the brain on Cowboy Rally's Flag, as if to say, "Hey, everyone, I would like to emphasize this image." It's canny design.
ZOMBIE_COWBOY_FLAG_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}瞧，有两个箭头在指着它旗帜上的脑子，仿佛是在说：“嘿！看到这个脑子了吗！我在强调它哦！”这个设计很棒吧。

ZOMBIE_COWBOY_FLAG_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION_H.en: Cowboy Rally Zombie marks the appearance of a sizable stampede of zombies.
ZOMBIE_COWBOY_FLAG_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION_H.zh: 牛仔集结僵尸和它的旗帜象征着超大波的僵尸即将来袭。

ZOMBIE_COWBOY_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}crushes plants with brand
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}launches Bull Rider when damaged

{FLAVOR}Likes candy.
ZOMBIE_COWBOY_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}攻击：{STAT}用烙铁砸扁植物
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}在受到一定伤害后扔出僵尸牛骑手

{FLAVOR}喜欢吃糖。

ZOMBIE_COWBOY_TACOCHAMP_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Here comes the Taco Champion Zombie! Wait to see how the champion performs this year... Look! He's using his own secretive skill — fire roasting! Eh, well, the tacos are burnt, from all angles.
ZOMBIE_COWBOY_TACOCHAMP_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}玉米卷冠军僵尸闪亮登场！让我们看看本届冠军表现如何……快看！他使出了自己的独门绝技——烈焰烘烤！呃，好吧……这玉米卷，可以说是……焦得全方位无死角。

ZOMBIE_COWBOY_TACOCHAMP_DESCRIPTION_HEAD.en: Breathes fire and damages plants forward.
ZOMBIE_COWBOY_TACOCHAMP_DESCRIPTION_HEAD.zh: 朝前喷射火焰攻击植物。

ZOMBIE_DARK_ARCHMAGE_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Archmage Zombie hates it when others look at his hat; his favorite pastime is putting anyone who dares to stare at him to sleep. Then one day, he walked past a huge mirror...
ZOMBIE_DARK_ARCHMAGE_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}大法师僵尸最讨厌别人看他的帽子，他最经常做的事情就是使敢于注视他的路人陷入沉睡。后来有一天他经过了一面巨大的镜子旁边……

ZOMBIE_DARK_ARCHMAGE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Puts all plants in an area to sleep.
ZOMBIE_DARK_ARCHMAGE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 使一块区域内的植物陷入沉睡。

ZOMBIE_DARK_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Conehead Peasant is just happy to have a cone over his head. Times are tough, man. He knows a lot of zombies don't even have that.
ZOMBIE_DARK_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}路障农民僵尸脑袋上的路障让他觉得日子非常不好过，但同时，他也知道其他僵尸没有这个东西。

ZOMBIE_DARK_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: His stony turret cone makes him twice as tough as normal peasants.
ZOMBIE_DARK_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 他的石制角楼使他的防御力比普通农民僵高一倍。

ZOMBIE_DARK_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}None of the other zombies seem to understand just how versatile Buckethead Peasant's choice of headwear is. Sure, his bucket makes for a great battle helmet. But just last night, he cooked a truly divine brain stew in it. And next time you see his band, check out what he’s using for a kick drum.
ZOMBIE_DARK_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}其它僵尸才不会明白他头上那个桶有多么万能。首先，它在战场上可以用作一个结实的头盔；而就在昨晚，它才刚刚被用来炖了一桶神圣的脑子。对了，下次铁桶农民僵尸开始演奏的时候，注意一下他把什么当作鼓了。

ZOMBIE_DARK_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: His forged bucket provides great protection from damage.
ZOMBIE_DARK_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 他的锻制铁桶可以帮助他很好地抵御伤害。

ZOMBIE_DARK_ARMOR3_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Knight Zombie was just as surprised as anyone when Zombie King promoted him. He'd never say this out loud, but he's not sure he deserves the position. He's not sure he has what it takes to wear the armor. But like they say, "Fake it 'til you make it."
ZOMBIE_DARK_ARMOR3_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}骑士僵尸在受到僵尸国王提拔的时候，连他自己都吓了一跳。他不敢和别人说，但他其实一直很怀疑自己是不是真的有能力站在这个高度上，是不是真的配得上这副盔甲。但有句话不是这么说的吗，"fake it 'till you make it"，说不定装到最后，自己就真的配得上了呢？

ZOMBIE_DARK_ARMOR3_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: His king appointed helm provides amazing protection from damage.
ZOMBIE_DARK_ARMOR3_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 他那由国王授予的头盔保护他免于受到伤害。

ZOMBIE_DARK_ARMOR4_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Dr. Zomboss is well known in the global architect circles. He is the 20 time winner of the Annual Architectural Digest for most impressive medieval design. There seems to be countless variations to his free standing turrets in an open field.
ZOMBIE_DARK_ARMOR4_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}僵王博士在建筑界名闻遐迩。他曾 20 次摘获《年度建筑文摘》最新奇中世纪设计奖。他设计的独立角楼在旷野中仿佛有无数种变体。

ZOMBIE_DARK_ARMOR4_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Turret-Head Zombie’s solid headgear forms the foundation to its sturdy defense and provides it with unparalleled toughness.
ZOMBIE_DARK_ARMOR4_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 角楼头僵尸用牢固的头饰为自己的防御力打下坚实基础，以此获得无与伦比的生命值。

ZOMBIE_DARK_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Someone shouted, "Bring out your undead!" And then Peasant Zombie found himself here. He simply doesn't remember anything that happened before that.
ZOMBIE_DARK_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}只听到了一句：“亡灵，接受召唤吧！”，随后，农民僵尸就发现自己来到了这个地方。而在此前的所有记忆，他怎么想也想不起来了。

ZOMBIE_DARK_FLAG_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}They keep telling Peasant Zombie that there is no greater reward than being granted the banner to carry into battle. But when he sees other Peasant Zombies being granted cones, buckets, and even helms, he thinks maybe they're making that up so they don't hurt his feelings.
ZOMBIE_DARK_FLAG_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}所有人都在告诉农民僵尸，被国王授予一面旗帜带入战场是至高无上的恩赐。但当他看到别的农民僵尸都拿到了路障、铁桶，甚至头盔的时候，他觉得自己被骗了。他们说这些话可能只是不想让自己难过。

ZOMBIE_DARK_FLAG_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Marks the arrival of a huge dark "wave" of zombies.
ZOMBIE_DARK_FLAG_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 标示着一群黑暗的僵尸将蜂拥而至。

ZOMBIE_DARK_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}crushes plants with hammer
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}launches Imp Monk when damaged

{FLAVOR}When Dark Ages Gargantuar wants to find pantaloons that fit him, he has to shop at the "Enormous & Towering" store. He hates it though. It's embarrassing. He just wants to shop for clothes where all the other zombies shop.
ZOMBIE_DARK_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}攻击：{STAT}用锤子砸碎植物
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}在受到一定伤害后扔出小鬼僧侣僵尸

{FLAVOR}每当复兴时代巨人僵尸想要找到一条合身的内裤时，他都必须得去“顶天立地”服装店。他不太喜欢这样，因为这让他觉得自己很尴尬。他唯一的愿望就是去正常僵尸的商店里买衣服。

ZOMBIE_DARK_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION_HEADE.en: Immense zombie who brings the hammer down.
ZOMBIE_DARK_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION_HEADE.zh: 身躯庞大且手头携带锤子的僵尸

ZOMBIE_DARK_IMP_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Frankly, Imp Monk Zombie decided to don the robes because of the sweet haircut that went with them.
ZOMBIE_DARK_IMP_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}坦白地说，小鬼僧侣僵尸决定穿上长袍的原因，是因为它和他的发型搭配起来很可爱。

ZOMBIE_DARK_IMP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Summoned past most of your defenses, then shambles onward.
ZOMBIE_DARK_IMP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 可以被召唤到防线后排，然后缓缓前进。

ZOMBIE_DARK_IMP_DRAGON_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}Immune to fire damage

{FLAVOR}Imp Zombie knows he's too old to wear a dragon costume like a kid on Halloween. But he doesn't care. Let the others judge. His spirit animal is a dragon, and he feels closer to his true self when he's dressed like this.
ZOMBIE_DARK_IMP_DRAGON_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}对火焰伤害免疫

{FLAVOR}小鬼僵尸知道自己已经长大了，不应该再像个小孩子一样，在万圣节穿着火龙装扮了。但他并不在乎，穿自己的衣，让别人说去吧。他的灵魂动物就是龙，只有穿成这样，他才会觉得离真实的自己又更进一步。

ZOMBIE_DARK_IMP_DRAGON_DESCRIPTION_HEADE.en: Spit past most of your defenses, then claws forward.
ZOMBIE_DARK_IMP_DRAGON_DESCRIPTION_HEADE.zh: 可以被巨人扔到你的防线后排，然后迎风而行。

ZOMBIE_DARK_JUGGLER_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Oh sure, everyone loves to laugh at Jester Zombie's clownish routines. But what no one knows is that he has a Master of Fine Arts from the Chewliard Performing Arts School. Heck, he's been on stage with some of the finest classical theatre companies this side of the lawn. But sometimes you just gotta go where the paycheck is.
ZOMBIE_DARK_JUGGLER_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}大家都喜欢嘲笑弄臣僵尸那小丑般的动作。但是，没人知道他是一位来自丘利亚德表演艺术学院的艺术硕士。哎，他曾一直和一些最优秀的古典戏剧公司在草坪的这一边演出。但那地方可拿不到高薪水。

ZOMBIE_DARK_JUGGLER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Returns projectiles that are shot at him.

ZOMBIE_DARK_KING_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}As Shakespeare once wrote, "Uneasy lies the head that wears a crown." And Zombie King couldn't agree more. It is incredibly difficult to get a good night's sleep with a crown on your head. That thing is all kinds of uncomfortable.
ZOMBIE_DARK_KING_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}莎士比亚曾写道：“ 欲戴王冠，必承其重”。僵尸国王完全同意。戴着皇冠想睡个好觉确实很难，那玩意儿太重了。

ZOMBIE_DARK_KING_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Grants knight helms to nearby peasant zombies.
ZOMBIE_DARK_KING_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 可以将周围的农民僵尸变成骑士僵尸。

ZOMBIE_DARK_WIZARD_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}All the zombies agree, Wizard Zombie's powers of transmutation are impressive. But what they don't get is ... why sheep? Everyone knows it would be more helpful if the Wizard used his powers to turn plants into, say, more zombies. But yeah, no one is going to say that to his face.
ZOMBIE_DARK_WIZARD_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}所有僵尸都一致觉得，巫师僵尸的变形能力令人印象深刻。但他们唯一不理解是…为什么要把那些植物变成羊？有没有一种可能，如果把那些植物变成更多僵尸，会对僵尸更有帮助？但没人敢当着他面告诉他。

ZOMBIE_DARK_WIZARD_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 将植物变作愚钝的绵羊。

ZOMBIE_DINO_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION.en: Jurassic Conehead Zombie is trying to get the jump on the whole "traffic cone" idea. He figures it'll be a HUGE market in about 150 million years.
ZOMBIE_DINO_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION.zh: 侏罗纪路障僵尸正在试着大量售卖路障。他觉得这在 1.5 亿年之后会成为一个巨大的市场。

ZOMBIE_DINO_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Cones, or old leftover horns bundled together with string so that they look sort of like a cone, provide some middling protection.
ZOMBIE_DINO_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 或许是路障，或许是老旧的龙角捆在一起，一切都是为了让这玩意儿更像圆锥体，它能提供中等防御。

ZOMBIE_DINO_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION.en: The real question, the burning mystery, is: where did he find blue fur for his outfit?
ZOMBIE_DINO_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION.zh: 世界未解之谜：他在哪里找到的蓝色皮毛给他做装备的？

ZOMBIE_DINO_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Crude drawings of buckets provide as much protection as the real thing.
ZOMBIE_DINO_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 没想到画工粗糙的铁桶画像能和真正的铁桶提供的防御一样多。

ZOMBIE_DINO_ARMOR3_DESCRIPTION.en: Contrary to his name, Jurassic Fossilhead's fossil head isn't actually a fossil. That skull's maybe a week and a half old, tops.
ZOMBIE_DINO_ARMOR3_DESCRIPTION.zh: 侏罗纪化石僵尸的脑袋上戴着的其实并不是什么化石。那块骨头估计才放了一个多星期而已。

ZOMBIE_DINO_ARMOR3_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Fossil skulls not only provide a huge amount of damage absorption, but are also extremely classy.
ZOMBIE_DINO_ARMOR3_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 化石头骨不仅可以承受大量伤害，而且还很优雅美观。

ZOMBIE_DINO_ARMOR4_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}If you were to extract DNA from the Amberhead Zombie and combine it with the DNA of a frog, you'd probably be breaking the law at some point.
ZOMBIE_DINO_ARMOR4_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}如果你把琥珀僵尸的 DNA 提取出来和青蛙的结合，那多半会犯法。

ZOMBIE_DINO_ARMOR4_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Amberhead Zombie's head-engulfing ball of amber provides hardened protection.
ZOMBIE_DINO_ARMOR4_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 琥珀僵尸的脑袋被一块琥珀包裹住，使其可以承受大量伤害

ZOMBIE_DINO_BULLY_DESCRIPTION.en: Jurassic Bully is slow, stupid, and smells bad. But hey, at least he's punctual.
ZOMBIE_DINO_BULLY_DESCRIPTION.zh: 侏罗纪暴徒僵尸又慢、又笨、身上又臭。但是人不可貌相嘛，至少他很…守时。

ZOMBIE_DINO_BULLY_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: A trudging, damage-resistant zombie who is immune to Primal Peashooter's knockback.
ZOMBIE_DINO_BULLY_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 一只步伐沉重、可以抵挡伤害的僵尸。还能免疫原始豌豆射手的击退效果。

ZOMBIE_DINO_BULLY_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Somebody tied rocks to Jurassic Rockpuncher's hands. Being unable to remove them (because he had rocks tied to his hands), he was left with no choice but to roll with it.
ZOMBIE_DINO_BULLY_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}有人把石头绑在了侏罗纪石击僵尸的手上。他其实也不情愿，但是他自己弄不下来啊（因为手上有石头），于是就只好作罢了。

ZOMBIE_DINO_BULLY_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION_HE.en: Jurassic Rockpuncher pummels plants with rocks tied to his hands.
ZOMBIE_DINO_BULLY_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION_HE.zh: 侏罗纪石击僵尸可以用手上绑着的石头砸碎植物。

ZOMBIE_DINO_CHEESE_PUSHER_DESCRIPTION.en: Is he pushing a bucket? No, it's cheese!
ZOMBIE_DINO_CHEESE_PUSHER_DESCRIPTION.zh: 他推的是桶吗？不，它是干酪！

ZOMBIE_DINO_CHEESE_PUSHER_DESCRIPTION_HE.en: The cheese he rolled was so beautiful!

ZOMBIE_DINO_DESCRIPTION.en: Jurassic Zombie is NOT primitive. See, he's wearing a tie and everything!
ZOMBIE_DINO_DESCRIPTION.zh: 侏罗纪僵尸一点也不原始。瞧，他还打着领带什么的呢！

ZOMBIE_DINO_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Regular beard-having zombie from the unimaginable past.
ZOMBIE_DINO_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 普通的大胡子僵尸，来自令人难以想象的过去。

ZOMBIE_DINO_FLAG_DESCRIPTION.en: He's not only got a flag, but he's also got a can-do attitude and a fierce hunger for success. Success and brains.
ZOMBIE_DINO_FLAG_DESCRIPTION.zh: 他不单单有一面旗子，还有那旗子代表的一种力所能及的态度和对成功的强烈渴望。成功和代表智慧的脑子。

ZOMBIE_DINO_FLAG_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Marks the arrival of a huge epochal "wave" of highly anachronistic zombies.
ZOMBIE_DINO_FLAG_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 标示着一群与时代相违的僵尸即将到来。

ZOMBIE_DINO_FLAG_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Where did Jurassic Rally Zombie get his fancy new flag? Nobody knows. It's a mystery. The police should look into it. Or maybe we could get a fund together and hire a detective. It's a real puzzle.
ZOMBIE_DINO_FLAG_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}侏罗纪集结僵尸的旗帜是从哪儿拿来的？这是个千古谜题，没有人知道。警察应该来进行深入研究；或者我们应该成立一个特别基金会，然后雇一个侦探来寻找真相。

ZOMBIE_DINO_FLAG_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION_HEA.en: Jurassic Rally Zombie marks the arrival of large group of zombies.
ZOMBIE_DINO_FLAG_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION_HEA.zh: 侏罗纪集结僵尸和他的旗帜象征着超大波僵尸即将来袭。

ZOMBIE_DINO_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}crushes plants with bone
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}launches Jurassic Imp when damaged
{FLAVOR}Jurassic Gargantuar wonders how there can be zombies millions of years before the advent of humanity. He doesn't let it get in the way of his plant-bashing, though.
ZOMBIE_DINO_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}攻击：{STAT}用骨头砸碎植物
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}在受到一定伤害后扔出侏罗纪小鬼僵尸
{FLAVOR}侏罗纪巨人僵尸一直在想，明明还有几百万年人类才诞生，怎么现在就有僵尸了？但这并不妨碍他去砸碎植物。

ZOMBIE_DINO_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION_HEADE.zh: 中生代马拉基语的史前使用者。

ZOMBIE_DINO_IMP_DESCRIPTION.en: This nasty little nipper can make a serious dent in your defenses if left to his own devious devices.
ZOMBIE_DINO_IMP_DESCRIPTION.zh: 如果你任由他使用自己的诡计，这个讨厌的小东西就会严重破坏你的防线。

ZOMBIE_DINO_IMP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: A weaker, smaller, much more vicious version of the typical Jurassic zombie.
ZOMBIE_DINO_IMP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 一个更弱，更小，但速度更快的侏罗纪僵尸。

ZOMBIE_DISCO_MECH_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}summons disco Jetpack Zombies

{FLAVOR}After some initial problems with the sideburn suspension system, the Disco-tron 3000 went on to become the shufflin' dance-bot of doom it is today.
ZOMBIE_DISCO_MECH_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}可以召唤迪斯科喷射器僵尸

{FLAVOR}在解决了侧燃悬挂系统引发的一些问题之后，迪斯科机 3000 仍是目前为止最为恐怖的毁灭舞步机器人。

ZOMBIE_DISCO_MECH_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Drops in disco zombies when dropping the beat.
ZOMBIE_DISCO_MECH_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 播放音乐时会召唤迪斯科僵尸。

ZOMBIE_DUCKYTUBE_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}Increase movement while on water.

{FLAVOR}It took countless hours for Ducky Tube Conehead to find the perfect starfish to decorate its cone. Look at it! ‘REALLY’ look at it!!! Can you see its magnificence? The Size! The Shape! The Color! No?!?
ZOMBIE_DUCKYTUBE_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}鸭子救生圈路障僵尸花了无数个小时才找到完美的海星来装饰它的路障。看！”真的，看！！！你能看到它的壮丽吗？尺寸！形状！颜色！不你需要再看一遍。

ZOMBIE_DUCKYTUBE_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION_HEAD.en: The starfish cone on his head grants this zombie higher damage resistance than normal Ducky Tubes.
ZOMBIE_DUCKYTUBE_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION_HEAD.zh: 他头上的海星路障赋予这个僵尸比普通的鸭子救生圈僵尸更高的抗伤害能力。

ZOMBIE_DUCKYTUBE_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}Increase movement while on water.

{FLAVOR}It takes a being of great intellect to innovate, to go against existing conventions and do something different. While others may have put buckets on their heads for protection, few have thought to paint it green. Pure genius!
ZOMBIE_DUCKYTUBE_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}创新，打破现有惯例，做一些不同的事情，需要一个有智慧的人。虽然其他人可能会把水桶戴在头上保护自己，但很少有人想过把它涂成绿色。纯粹的天才！

ZOMBIE_DUCKYTUBE_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION_HEAD.en: The surprisingly durable seashell bucket makes this the toughest of all the Ducky Tubes.
ZOMBIE_DUCKYTUBE_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION_HEAD.zh: 令人惊讶的耐用的贝壳桶使它成为所有鸭子救生圈中最坚固的。

ZOMBIE_DUCKYTUBE_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}Increase movement while on water.

{FLAVOR}Many scientists argue over the origins of the Ducky Tube, few can deny its classification. Clearly it is not a duck as some would like to believe.
ZOMBIE_DUCKYTUBE_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}尽管许多科学家对鸭子救生圈僵尸的起源存在争议，但很少有人能否认它的分类。显然，它并不像一些人所希望的那样是一只鸭子。

ZOMBIE_DUCKYTUBE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: With its inflatable duck-like flotation apparatus, the Ducky Tube can quickly waddle its way through water with ease.
ZOMBIE_DUCKYTUBE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: Ducky Tube有了类似鸭子的充气漂浮装置，可以轻松地快速摇摇摆摆地在水中穿行。

ZOMBIE_EGYPT_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}crushes plants with sarcophagus
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}launches Imp Mummy when damaged

{FLAVOR}True fact #1: The pyramids were built in an attempt to make Mummified Gargantuar seem small. It didn't work. True fact #2: The Sphinx isn't missing its nose... that is the face of... Gargantuar.
ZOMBIE_EGYPT_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}攻击：{STAT}用石棺砸碎植物
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}在受到一定伤害后扔出小鬼木乃伊

{FLAVOR}冷知识：木乃伊巨人僵尸其实是用来衬托金字塔有多大的，虽然好像没啥用；冷知识 2：狮身人面像其实并没有失去鼻子，那其实是…巨人僵尸的脸。

ZOMBIE_EGYPT_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION_HEAD.en: Massive zombie from a royal line of mummies.
ZOMBIE_EGYPT_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION_HEAD.zh: 来自埃及王室的巨大木乃伊。

ZOMBIE_EGYPT_IMP_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Imp Mummy prefers to laze around the tomb, hop up on the urns, and scratch at the sarcophagi. The sound of him coughing up a hairball is one you will never forget.
ZOMBIE_EGYPT_IMP_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}小鬼木乃伊僵尸喜欢在墓地周围闲逛，跳上骨灰盒，用指甲划棺材。那刺耳的声音会令你永生难忘。

ZOMBIE_EGYPT_IMP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Thrown over most of your defenses, then slinks onward.
ZOMBIE_EGYPT_IMP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 可以被甩到你的防线后排，然后缓缓前进。

ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_8BIT_DESCRIPTION.en: Being made out of light and positional co-ordinates has no effect on this erzatz zombie’s ravenous hunger for tangy brains.
ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_8BIT_DESCRIPTION.zh: 虽然这只僵尸只是光线与位置坐标相调制的产物，但这丝毫不影响他对脑子的贪婪欲望。

ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_8BIT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Pixelated zombie generated by super cool arcade machine. Comes in regular, cone and bucket flavors.
ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_8BIT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 像素版僵尸是由街机游戏机创造出来的。可能会出现普通、路障、和铁桶风味。

ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_ARCADE_DESCRIPTION.en: When it’s a choice between quarters for games and quarters for laundry, Arcade Zombie is prepared to make the ultimate stinky sacrifice.
ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_ARCADE_DESCRIPTION.zh: 该把多少钱花在洗衣店的游戏机上，又该花多少钱去洗衣服？街机僵尸已经准备好做出他的终极决策了。

ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_ARCADE_DESCRIPTION_HEADE.en: Pushes an arcade cabinet that spits out 8-Bit Zombies.
ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_ARCADE_DESCRIPTION_HEADE.zh: 推着一台可以产生 8 位僵尸的游戏机

ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_ARCADE_VETERAN_DESCRIPTI.en: Winning multiple championships in many arcade competitions, he has his own opinions on video games.
ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_ARCADE_VETERAN_DESCRIPTI.zh: 在众多街机比赛中，蝉联多次冠军，对电子游戏有属于自己的见解。

ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_ARCADE_VETERAN_DESCRIPTI.en: Pushing a game console that can generate 8-bit pixel zombies, but his game console seems to be even cooler and can even generate... Zombotany???
ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_ARCADE_VETERAN_DESCRIPTI.zh: 推着一台可以产生 8 位像素僵尸的游戏机，但他的游戏机好像更炫酷，甚至可以生成...植物僵尸？？？

ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION.en: Neon Conehead Zombie used to be a big believer in de-evolution, but then he forgot what it meant.
ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION.zh: 霓虹路障僵尸曾经是“退化学说”的忠实拥护者，结果后来他连那是什么东西都忘了。

ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION_HEADE.en: Cones provide protection and focus the sound of righteous tunes.
ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION_HEADE.zh: 路障可以阻挡伤害，还能汇聚正义曲调的声音。

ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION.en: Neon Buckethead Zombie had to go all the way to the dump to find a headband he really liked.
ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION.zh: 霓虹铁桶僵尸大老远跑到垃圾场去找那个他真正喜欢的头带。

ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION_HEADE.en: Buckets absorb damage because that’s just what they do.
ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION_HEADE.zh: 他头上的铁桶可以承受伤害，因为…它们本就该这样。

ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_BITPEASHOOTER_DESCRIPTIO.en: In the game consoles of Veteran Arcade Zombie, it is only a virtual existence, but he has turned it into reality.
ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_BITPEASHOOTER_DESCRIPTIO.zh: 在电竞高手的游戏机中，它只是虚拟的存在，但电竞高手硬生生把它变成了现实。

ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_BITPEASHOOTER_DESCRIPTIO.en: Peashooter Zombie from PVZ's Zombotany but in pixel graphic!
ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_BITPEASHOOTER_DESCRIPTIO.zh: 可以像豌豆射手一样攻击，但攻击的是植物，还会吃掉你的脑子！！！

ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_BOOMBOX_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}boom box has no effect on ground plants and Phat Beets

{FLAVOR}Boombox Zombie doesn’t want to buy, sell or process anything; he just really wants to consume your brains.
ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_BOOMBOX_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}音响对地面植物和魔音甜菜无效

{FLAVOR}音响僵尸并不想买、卖或者加工任何东西，他只是真的很想吃了你的脑子。

ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_BOOMBOX_DESCRIPTION_HEAD.en: Holds aloft a boom box that tranquilizes all plants with its heartfelt tunes.
ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_BOOMBOX_DESCRIPTION_HEAD.zh: 他会高举收音机，然后用它播放自己发自内心的曲调感染植物。

ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_BOOMBOX_VETERAN_DESCRIPT.en:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}boom box has no effect on ground plants and Phat Beets

{FLAVOR}He put all his favorite songs into this special boombox, he just had to play them to the right people.
ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_BOOMBOX_VETERAN_DESCRIPT.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}音响对地面植物和魔音甜菜无效

{FLAVOR}他将所有喜爱的歌曲都放进了这个特别收录机中，只需要将它们播放给正确的人就对了。

ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_BOOMBOX_VETERAN_DESCRIPT.en: He would hold the radio high and use it to play his heartfelt tunes to attack the plants. Veteran Boombox Zombie is more obsessed with music than normal Boombos Zombie, so he is very interested in playing his music to the plants.
ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_BOOMBOX_VETERAN_DESCRIPT.zh: 他会高举收音机，然后用它播放自己发自内心的曲调感染植物。特别收录机僵尸对音乐比收音机僵尸更着迷，因此他非常想给植物们播放他的音乐。

ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_BREAKDANCER_DESCRIPTION.en: Delivers only the freshest moves at bargain basement prices.
ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_BREAKDANCER_DESCRIPTION.zh: 最新潮的舞步，最划算的价格！

ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_BREAKDANCER_DESCRIPTION_.en: Kicks zombies forward when transported by the power of rap.
ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_BREAKDANCER_DESCRIPTION_.zh: 因饶舌乐之力起舞的时候，可以把僵尸向前踢动。

ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_BREAKDANCER_VETERAN_DESC.en: Insist on taking part in aerobic exercise, even zombies can be full of energy!
ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_BREAKDANCER_VETERAN_DESC.zh: 坚持参加有氧运动，僵尸也能活力四射！

ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_BREAKDANCER_VETERAN_DESC.en: Because of her harshness, she can kick zombies forward better than Breakdancer Zombie.
ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_BREAKDANCER_VETERAN_DESC.zh: 因为她的严厉，她比霹雳舞僵尸更能催促僵尸前进。

ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_DESCRIPTION.en: He's cutting down on his head-banging so as not to bang his head clean off.
ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_DESCRIPTION.zh: 他最近在尝试减少弹吉他时摇头的次数，以免不小心把头摇掉下来。

ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 普通的音乐爱好者僵尸。

ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_FLAG_DESCRIPTION.en: Fluorescent colors and little yellow plastic strips are the marks of a truly hip, groundbreaking new style of zombie wave flag.
ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_FLAG_DESCRIPTION.zh: 荧光颜料和窄塑料带是真正时髦的标志，是震惊四周的大波僵尸旗帜的新款式。

ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_FLAG_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Marks the arrival of a huge mixtape-making "wave" of zombies.
ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_FLAG_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 标志着由混音带引起的一大波僵尸的来袭。

ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}crushes plants with guitar
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}bashes sonic blast when metal music plays
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}launches Impunk when damaged

{FLAVOR}Hair Metal Gargantuar only knows one chord, but you'd better believe he'll play it all night and then some.
ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}攻击：{STAT}用电吉他砸碎植物
{KEYWORD}攻击：{STAT}当重金属音乐炒热场子时会击打出音波
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}在受到一定伤害后扔出小鬼朋克僵尸

{FLAVOR}重金属巨人僵尸虽然只知道一个和弦，但他还是会经常弹电吉他弹一整晚。

ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION_H.zh: 他所支配的力量是那节奏混乱的摇滚乐。

ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_GLITTER_DESCRIPTION.en: Glitter Zombie inspires zombies everywhere to boogie their brains out, whether it's just one moment or maybe forever, or at least until the lights come on and they're kicking everybody out.
ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_GLITTER_DESCRIPTION.zh: 闪光僵尸会鼓舞各地的僵尸，让它们嗨得把脑袋甩掉。甩掉多久？有可能一小会儿；有可能永远都找不到；还有一种可能，就是得等到活动结束，它们互相把地上各自的脑袋踹出去。

ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_GLITTER_DESCRIPTION_HEAD.en: Trails glamorous rainbows that protect zombies behind her when she's feeling the beat.
ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_GLITTER_DESCRIPTION_HEAD.zh: 在感受到节拍时，拖出一道充满魅力的彩虹，彩虹会保护她身后的僵尸。

ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_GLITTER_VETERAN_DESCRIPT.en: She has been named "The Most Attractive Zombie in the World" for two consecutive years!
ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_GLITTER_VETERAN_DESCRIPT.zh: 她连续两年被评为“全世界最有魅力的僵尸”！

ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_GLITTER_VETERAN_DESCRIPT.en: When she feels the beat, she drags out a charming rainbow that will protect the zombies behind her. Her rainbow is longer and more colorful than Glitter Zombies!
ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_GLITTER_VETERAN_DESCRIPT.zh: 在感受到节拍时，拖出一道充满魅力的彩虹，彩虹会保护她身后的僵尸。她的彩虹比闪光僵尸更长更绚丽！

ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_IMP_DESCRIPTION.en: Impunk’s lyrics have been described as "banal," "incoherent," and "totally expressive of the Zompunk movement at its finest."
ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_IMP_DESCRIPTION.zh: 大家说小鬼朋克僵尸的歌词“平淡乏味”、“语无伦次”，并且“完全表达出了僵尸朋克运动的最佳状态”。

ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_IMP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Tossed past most of your defenses, then rocks out to your detriment.
ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_IMP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 可以被抛到防线后排，然后缓缓前进。

ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_MC_DESCRIPTION.en: MC Zom-B doesn’t want you to know it, but his fancy bling is really just gold-plated zinc he got from his grandma.
ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_MC_DESCRIPTION.zh: 饶舌僵尸并不想让你知道，但他的漂亮小挂坠真的只是从他祖母那里得的镀金锌挂饰。

ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_MC_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Spins microphone to damage nearby plants when he's dropping his sick, sick rhymes.
ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_MC_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 在表演爽爆了的饶舌时转动麦克风伤害附近的植物。

ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_MC_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION.en: After many years of "baptism" from the streets, he has become the Top 1 in the Rap Circle.
ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_MC_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION.zh: 经历了多年来自街头的洗礼，成为了说唱圈的NO.1。

ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_MC_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION_H.zh: 在表演爽爆了的饶舌时转动麦克风伤害附近的植物，比饶舌僵尸攻击力更强。

ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_POPSINGER_DESCRIPTION.en: Pop Singer Zombie shines in her music. She is an avid fan of music. In order to follow her favorite music, she has gained the ability to be immune to all negative effects.
ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_POPSINGER_DESCRIPTION.zh: 流行歌手僵尸在她的音乐中闪亮登场，她是音乐的狂热粉，为了追随她最爱的音乐，她获得了免疫所有负面效果的能力。

ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_POPSINGER_DESCRIPTION_HE.en: Pop singer zombie sings in place for 60 seconds, immune to all negative effects and tranquilizes plants!
ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_POPSINGER_DESCRIPTION_HE.zh: 流行歌手僵尸在原地歌唱 60 秒，免疫所有负面效果，唱歌会催眠植物们！

ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_PUNK_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Weakness: {STAT}Magnet Shrooms pull off his head

{FLAVOR}Punk Zombie’s piercings represent his individuality and his belief in personal freedom, or maybe just that he fell face-first into a sewing machine.
ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_PUNK_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}弱点：{STAT}磁力菇可以吸走他的头

{FLAVOR}朋克僵尸的鼻子穿孔代表了他的个性以及他对个人自由的信仰…额，似乎仅仅是因为他有一次掉进了缝纫机里。

ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_PUNK_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Moshes plants back a space when his jam is playing.
ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_PUNK_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 当他的主场开始时，他就会将碰到的植物往左推一格。

ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_PUNK_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION.en: Learning from the failure of Punk Zombies, he decided to change the material of his hoop. This not only reduced his own weight, it increased his speed, but also prevented him from being killed instantly by Magnet-shroom. It can be said that he killed two birds with one stone!
ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_PUNK_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION.zh: 吸取了朋克僵尸失败的经验，他决定把自己的铁环换一换材质，这样即减轻了自身重量提升了速度，又免于磁力秒杀，可谓是一举两得！

ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_PUNK_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION.en: When his jam starts, he will push the plants he encounters one space to the left. Not only will his head not be sucked away by Magnet-shroom, but he will also be faster than Punk Zombie!
ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_PUNK_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION.zh: 当他的主场开始时，他就会将碰到的植物往左推一格。不仅头不会被磁力菇吸走，速度也比朋克僵尸更快！

ZOMBIE_EXPLORER_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}torch destroys plants on contact
{KEYWORD}Weakness: {STAT}cold attacks extinguish torch

{FLAVOR}His impressive friendly mutton chops have always kept food in them for weeks, making sure his explorations are filled with snacks.
ZOMBIE_EXPLORER_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}火把能烧死接触到的植物
{KEYWORD}弱点：{STAT}冰冻的东西可以熄灭火把

{FLAVOR}了解他的人都知道，他总是把他的食物存在背包里几个星期，确保他在探险时能有足够的东西吃。

ZOMBIE_EXPLORER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Carries a torch that can instantly destroy your plants.
ZOMBIE_EXPLORER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 携带的火把可以瞬间摧毁你的植物。

ZOMBIE_EXPLORER_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Torchlight Zombie has no fear of the dark. That's not because he's always got a torch, however, but rather because as a zombie he has no capacity for fear in the first place.
ZOMBIE_EXPLORER_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}火光僵尸之所以不惧怕黑暗，并不是因为他总是拿着火把，而是因为作为一只僵尸，他从一开始就没有害怕的能力。

ZOMBIE_EXPLORER_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION_HEAD.en: Carries a torch that instantly destroys plants and scorches the earth.
ZOMBIE_EXPLORER_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION_HEAD.zh: 携带可以瞬间摧毁植物的火把，并可以把大地烧焦。

ZOMBIE_FAIRY_TALE_ARMED_GARGANTUAR_DESCR.en:
{KEYWORD}Special:{STAT} Possesses significant damage reduction, drops shield on death!!
{KEYWORD}Weaknesses:{STAT} Too powerful that there are no weaknesses!

{FLAVOR}Throw down a shield to block damage.
ZOMBIE_FAIRY_TALE_ARMED_GARGANTUAR_DESCR.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}强大的减伤能力，手中的盾牌在死亡时会掉落！！
{KEYWORD}弱点：{STAT}强大到似乎没什么弱点！

{FLAVOR}扔下盾牌，抵挡伤害。

ZOMBIE_FAIRY_TALE_ARMED_GARGANTUAR_DESCR.en: The personal bodyguard of the Red Queen Imp, with a heavy shield and astounding capabilities.
ZOMBIE_FAIRY_TALE_ARMED_GARGANTUAR_DESCR.zh: 红皇后小鬼僵尸的贴身近卫，手持重盾，能力出众。

ZOMBIE_FAIRY_TALE_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION.en: As a Poker Zombie, it is very important to move forward bravely. Of course, it is best to have coneheads as armor.
ZOMBIE_FAIRY_TALE_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION.zh: 作为一个扑克牌士兵僵尸来说，勇往直前是非常重要的，当然有路障作为防具是最好的。

ZOMBIE_FAIRY_TALE_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION_HEA.en: The Red Queen Imp's Poker Conehead Zombie
ZOMBIE_FAIRY_TALE_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION_HEA.zh: 红皇后小鬼僵尸麾下的扑克牌路障僵尸

ZOMBIE_FAIRY_TALE_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION.en: As a Poker Zombie, it's very important to keep moving forward, and of course, there's no better armor than a bucket, probably.
ZOMBIE_FAIRY_TALE_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION.zh: 作为一个扑克牌士兵僵尸来说，勇往直前是非常重要的，当然，没有什么防具能比铁桶更好的了，大概。

ZOMBIE_FAIRY_TALE_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION_HEA.en: The Red Queen's Imp's Poker Buckethead Zombie
ZOMBIE_FAIRY_TALE_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION_HEA.zh: 红皇后小鬼僵尸麾下的扑克牌铁桶僵尸

ZOMBIE_FAIRY_TALE_DESCRIPTION.en: As a Poker Zombie, it's important to keep moving forward.
ZOMBIE_FAIRY_TALE_DESCRIPTION.zh: 作为一个扑克牌士兵僵尸来说，勇往直前是非常重要的。

ZOMBIE_FAIRY_TALE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: A common Poker Zombie under the command of the Red Queen Imp
ZOMBIE_FAIRY_TALE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 红皇后小鬼僵尸麾下的普通扑克牌僵尸

ZOMBIE_FAIRY_TALE_FLAG_DESCRIPTION.en: Poker Flag Zombie holds the battle flag high and leads the Red Queen Imp's army to take brains.
ZOMBIE_FAIRY_TALE_FLAG_DESCRIPTION.zh: 扑克牌旗帜僵尸高举着战斗的旗帜，引领红皇后小鬼僵尸的部下掠夺脑子。

ZOMBIE_FAIRY_TALE_FLAG_DESCRIPTION_HEADE.en: Marks the arrival of a huge fairytale "wave" of zombies.
ZOMBIE_FAIRY_TALE_FLAG_DESCRIPTION_HEADE.zh: 标志着一大波童话僵尸的登场。

ZOMBIE_FAIRY_TALE_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION.en:
Special:{STAT} Possesses significant damage reduction, drops shield on death!!
{KEYWORD}Weaknesses:{STAT} Too powerful that there are no weaknesses!

{FLAVOR}Throw down a shield to block damage.
ZOMBIE_FAIRY_TALE_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}强大的减伤能力，手中的盾牌在死亡时会掉落！！
{KEYWORD}弱点：{STAT}强大到似乎没什么弱点！

{FLAVOR}扔下盾牌，抵挡伤害。

ZOMBIE_FAIRY_TALE_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION.en: The personal bodyguard of the Red Queen Imp, with a heavy shield and astounding capabilities.
ZOMBIE_FAIRY_TALE_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION.zh: 红皇后小鬼僵尸的贴身近卫，手持重盾，能力出众。

ZOMBIE_FAIRY_TALE_IMP_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}Will run away and call Guard Cavalry Zombies to come to her rescue!
{KEYWORD}Weakness: {STAT}If you can deal with the Guard Cavalry Zombies, it is not a threat in itself!

{FLAVOR}The rulers of the Fairytale world, although they have little combat power themselves, have many good generals around them.
ZOMBIE_FAIRY_TALE_IMP_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}会逃跑，会呼唤护卫骑士僵尸前来救驾！！
{KEYWORD}弱点：{STAT}如果能处理掉护卫骑士僵尸的话，本身就不是什么威胁！

{FLAVOR}逃跑时会呼唤护卫骑士僵尸前来救驾。

ZOMBIE_FAIRY_TALE_IMP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: When escaping, Guard Cavalry Zombies will be called to the rescue.
ZOMBIE_FAIRY_TALE_IMP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 童话世界中的掌权者，虽然本身没什么战力，奈何身边良将众多。

ZOMBIE_FAIRY_TALE_KNIGHT_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}Charge forward and hit the plants!!
{KEYWORD}Weakness: {STAT}Can reduce the threat level by having a plant to take the damage!

{FLAVOR}Charge forward, kill off the first plant it hits and dropping it's lance.
ZOMBIE_FAIRY_TALE_KNIGHT_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}向前冲锋，冲撞植物！！
{KEYWORD}弱点：{STAT}如果能阻挡冲锋效果的话就能大大降低威胁！

{FLAVOR}向前冲锋，冲撞掉第一棵碰到的植物并扔下骑枪。

ZOMBIE_FAIRY_TALE_KNIGHT_DESCRIPTION_HEA.en: Guard Cavalry Zombie is always late in coming to rescue Red Queen Imp, but he has never been dismissed.
ZOMBIE_FAIRY_TALE_KNIGHT_DESCRIPTION_HEA.zh: 红皇后小鬼僵尸的护卫骑士，虽然总是救驾来迟，但是却迟迟未被开除。

ZOMBIE_FAIRY_TALE_WITCH_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}Some can turn plants into frogs, and some can summon Fairytale Forest zombies!
{KEYWORD}Weaknesses: {STAT}Has no extra defensive capabilities!

{FLAVOR}Turn plants into frogs, which can jump off the battlefield.
ZOMBIE_FAIRY_TALE_WITCH_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}有的能把植物变成青蛙，有的能召唤童话森林僵尸！
{KEYWORD}弱点：{STAT}本身没有任何防护能力！

{FLAVOR}把植物变成青蛙，青蛙可能跳离战场。

ZOMBIE_FAIRY_TALE_WITCH_DESCRIPTION_HEAD.en: Witch Zombie is totally the Fairytale Forest's protagonist, because she can turn plants into frogs.
ZOMBIE_FAIRY_TALE_WITCH_DESCRIPTION_HEAD.zh: 女巫僵尸绝对是童话世界的主角，因为他会把植物变成青蛙。

ZOMBIE_FEASTIVUS_BOBSLED.zh: 圣诞节雪橇车僵尸小队

ZOMBIE_FEASTIVUS_BOBSLED_CREW.zh: 圣诞节雪橇车僵尸队员

ZOMBIE_FEASTIVUS_BOBSLED_CREW_DESCRIPTIO.en: {FLAVOR}Some team members temporarily switched from being ski athletes to bobsled athletes. They heard the pay here was high, but it was actually just a few more Christmas photos of Dr. Zombie.
ZOMBIE_FEASTIVUS_BOBSLED_CREW_DESCRIPTIO.zh: {FLAVOR}有些队员是从滑雪运动员临时转来有舵雪橇运动的。他们听说这里的工资很高，其实不过是多几张僵尸博士的圣诞美照。

ZOMBIE_FEASTIVUS_BOBSLED_CREW_DESCRIPTIO.en: Bobsled helmets can absorb a certain amount of damage
ZOMBIE_FEASTIVUS_BOBSLED_CREW_DESCRIPTIO.zh: 雪橇头盔可为其抵挡一定的伤害

ZOMBIE_FEASTIVUS_BOBSLED_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Sponsors prepared new bobsled models for the Feastivus theme. However, due to the downturn in the ice track laying industry, the attrition rate of this zombie extreme sport is too high, and the Z Company finance department expressed strong dissatisfaction.
ZOMBIE_FEASTIVUS_BOBSLED_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}赞助商为圣诞节主题准备了新的雪橇车型。但是由于冰道铺设行业的不景气，这项僵尸极限运动的损耗率太大，Z公司财务部门表示强烈不满。

ZOMBIE_FEASTIVUS_BOBSLED_DESCRIPTION_HEA.en: Four in a team, can ride a bobsled on the ice track for fast movement
ZOMBIE_FEASTIVUS_BOBSLED_DESCRIPTION_HEA.zh: 四个为一队，可乘坐雪橇车在冰道上快速移动

ZOMBIE_FEASTIVUS_MODERN_LADDER_DESCRIPTI.en: {FLAVOR}The ladder is used to climb up the chimney, but not to deliver gifts to you—instead, the zombie uses itself as your gift.
ZOMBIE_FEASTIVUS_MODERN_LADDER_DESCRIPTI.zh: {FLAVOR}梯子是用来爬上烟囱的，不过可不是为了给你投放礼物，而是僵尸把自己作为你的礼物进行投放。

ZOMBIE_FEASTIVUS_MODERN_LADDER_DESCRIPTI.en: Defends with a ladder, sets up the ladder to allow zombies to bypass your defenses.
ZOMBIE_FEASTIVUS_MODERN_LADDER_DESCRIPTI.zh: 手持梯子防御，架设梯子使僵尸越过你的防线。

ZOMBIE_FEASTIVUS_POLEVAULTER_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Neighborville Daily: Pole Vaulting Zombie, missing for over a decade, has returned! Seeing him nowadays feels like experiencing a wonderful time travel! The only dissatisfaction is with our lovely white fences in the yard, which have lost their function again!
ZOMBIE_FEASTIVUS_POLEVAULTER_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}小镇日报：失踪十几年的撑杆僵尸现已回归！现在这个年头看到他就像经历了一场奇妙的时间之旅一样！唯独表示不满的是我们院子里可爱的白色栅栏，他们又失去作用了！

ZOMBIE_FEASTIVUS_POLEVAULTER_DESCRIPTION.en: Vaults over the first plant encountered, throws the pole when low on health.
ZOMBIE_FEASTIVUS_POLEVAULTER_DESCRIPTION.zh: 跨越遇到的第一颗植物，低生命值时投掷撑杆。

ZOMBIE_FEASTIVUS_ZOMBONI_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Zombie Translator: "ZCorp always wastes its budget. They not only added useless decorations to the Zomboni, but also revoked my driving license to let other zombies drive!" — Mysterious Mullet Zombie
ZOMBIE_FEASTIVUS_ZOMBONI_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}僵尸语翻译器：“Z公司总是浪费预算，他们不仅给冰车加上了毫无用处的装饰，还吊销了我的驾驶执照让其他僵尸开！”——神秘鲻鱼头发型僵尸

ZOMBIE_FEASTIVUS_ZOMBONI_DESCRIPTION_HEA.en: Crushes plants on the road and leaves an ice path behind.
ZOMBIE_FEASTIVUS_ZOMBONI_DESCRIPTION_HEA.zh: 碾压路上的植物，并在身后留下冰道

ZOMBIE_FOOTBALL_MECH_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}pushes plants to the left instead of eating

{FLAVOR}Now past his prime, Mecha-Football Zombie is ready to be put back into the game. Until he gets some brains, concussions aren't a concern.
ZOMBIE_FOOTBALL_MECH_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}将植物向左推进而非啃食它们

{FLAVOR}尽管他的黄金时代已然过去，机甲橄榄球僵尸时刻准备着回到比赛当中。即便是脑震荡也无法阻碍他赢得一些脑子。

ZOMBIE_FOOTBALL_MECH_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 向前推进草地上的植物。

ZOMBIE_FUTURE_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Has tried to calculate the volume of his mathematically perfect cone, but he always ends up dreaming about brain π.
ZOMBIE_FUTURE_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}他曾试图计算出数学上完美的圆锥体体积，但最终沉迷于脑子π当中。

ZOMBIE_FUTURE_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: His poly-polymer cone gives him twice the toughness of regular future zombie.
ZOMBIE_FUTURE_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 他的聚合物路障使他的防御力比普通未来僵尸高一倍。

ZOMBIE_FUTURE_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Other zombies call him old-fashioned for being nostalgic for the year 2008.  It was a simpler time when brains were brains, zombies were zombies, and those punk plants kept to themselves.
ZOMBIE_FUTURE_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}因为怀念 2008 年的那些日子，其它僵尸都称他为老古董。啊，那个时候，一切都是如此单纯，脑子就是脑子，僵尸就是僵尸，而那些植物，还是一如既往的废物。

ZOMBIE_FUTURE_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: His techno-bucket greatly increases his protection from damage.
ZOMBIE_FUTURE_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 他那富有科技感的铁桶让他非常耐打。

ZOMBIE_FUTURE_ARMOR4_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}The force field gets its unique color from frequency harmonics and a liberal dose of purple paint.
ZOMBIE_FUTURE_ARMOR4_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}他头上的力场从频率谐波和自由剂量的紫色涂料中得到其独特的紫色。

ZOMBIE_FUTURE_ARMOR4_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Holo Head Zombie's head-mounted force field provides hyper-protection.
ZOMBIE_FUTURE_ARMOR4_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 全息僵尸头部的力场为他提供了超乎寻常的保护。

ZOMBIE_FUTURE_DESCRIPTION.en: Future zombies look good in red shirts. Future fact #23: Nothing bad happens to red shirts.
ZOMBIE_FUTURE_DESCRIPTION.zh: 未来僵尸穿红色衣服还挺好看的嘛。当然啦，根据《未来守则》第 23 条，穿红衣服是*肯定*不会遭遇不测的。

ZOMBIE_FUTURE_FLAG_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Sometimes Future Flag Zombie regrets having to be at the bleeding edge of zombie wave advancement technology.
ZOMBIE_FUTURE_FLAG_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}蒸汽旗帜僵尸经常因被迫处在促进僵群前进的风口浪尖而后悔。

ZOMBIE_FUTURE_FLAG_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Marks the arrival of a huge future-proof "wave" of zombies.
ZOMBIE_FUTURE_FLAG_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 标示着一群掌握未来的僵尸即将来袭

ZOMBIE_FUTURE_FLAG_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}If you look carefully, you'll notice that Robo-Rally Zombie's flag is a sophisticated piece of hovertech combined with a stick.
ZOMBIE_FUTURE_FLAG_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}如果你仔细观察，你会发现机器集结僵尸的旗帜是空气悬浮器和一根棍子。

ZOMBIE_FUTURE_FLAG_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION_H.en: Robo-Rally Zombie and his flag marks the arrival of an above-average number of zombies.
ZOMBIE_FUTURE_FLAG_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION_H.zh: 机器集结僵尸与其旗帜标示着一群多于平均数目的僵尸即将来袭

ZOMBIE_FUTURE_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}crushes plants with arms
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}randomly burns tiles with laser eyes
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}launches Bug Bot when damaged

{FLAVOR}The imp pilots of the Gargantuar Prime series are handpicked by Dr. Zomboss himself. They are the imp elite.  The small, the mean, and the fearless! But mostly the ones who can drive a stick shift.
ZOMBIE_FUTURE_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}攻击：{STAT}用自己的胳膊砸碎植物
{KEYWORD}攻击：{STAT}激光眼可以摧毁一格地砖的东西
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}受到一定伤害后扔出机器蛛虫

{FLAVOR}擎天巨人僵尸驾驶位上的小鬼僵尸是由僵王博士亲自挑选的。他们是小鬼中的精英。既小，又卑鄙，还无所畏惧！但其实只是大多数僵尸都进不去驾驶室。

ZOMBIE_FUTURE_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION_HEA.en: Has it all: heavy armor, laser eyes, smashing arms, and Bug Bot deployment system.
ZOMBIE_FUTURE_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION_HEA.zh: 这个机器无所不能：重型盔甲、激光眼、粉碎一切的手臂，还有机器蛛虫部署系统。样样精通。

ZOMBIE_FUTURE_IMP_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}He always wanted to "see the world," "be his own boss," and "meet and consume interesting brains." He still doesn't understand how he got stuck in this cramped Bug Bot job 24/7.
ZOMBIE_FUTURE_IMP_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}他总是想“看看外面的世界”、“做自己的老板”、“拥有有趣的灵魂”。但他至今仍不明白自己是怎么被困在这个拥挤不堪的机器蛛虫里 7 天 24 小时不停工作的。

ZOMBIE_FUTURE_IMP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Lands on the lawn past your defenses, then hops forward.
ZOMBIE_FUTURE_IMP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 可以落到防线后排，然后缓缓前进。

ZOMBIE_FUTURE_JETPACK_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}floats over low plants, boosts over most other plants
{KEYWORD}Weakness: {STAT}Tall blocking plants

{FLAVOR}The Jetpack Zombie was an early adopter during the brain acquisition tech explosion of 2113. Little did he know he would be stuck with version 1.0 of the simple jetpack.
ZOMBIE_FUTURE_JETPACK_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}能飘过低矮植物，飞跃过绝大多数植物
{KEYWORD}弱点：{STAT}高大的防御植物

{FLAVOR}喷射器僵尸是 2113 年“脑子获取技术大爆炸”期间的早期新技术采用者。他一点也不知道他会被 1.0 版本的简单喷射背包卡住。

ZOMBIE_FUTURE_JETPACK_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Boosts to float over all but the tallest plant barriers.
ZOMBIE_FUTURE_JETPACK_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 喷射气体并越过除最高那类植物以外的一切障碍。

ZOMBIE_FUTURE_JETPACK_DISCO_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}floats over low plants, boosts over most other plants
{KEYWORD}Weakness: {STAT}Tall blocking plants

{FLAVOR}A zombie who 'lives' for drama, he's an original cast member of the stage musical "Disco is BACK! For Revenge!" His signature dance move is "The Weed Whacker."
ZOMBIE_FUTURE_JETPACK_DISCO_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}能飘过低矮植物，飞跃过绝大多数植物
{KEYWORD}弱点：{STAT}高大的防御植物

{FLAVOR}一个为戏剧“活着”的僵尸，他是原创舞台剧《迪斯科回归！复仇！》的其中一位演员，他的招牌舞步是“一剪没”。

ZOMBIE_FUTURE_JETPACK_DISCO_DESCRIPTION_.en: Boosts to float over all but the tallest plant barriers, in style.
ZOMBIE_FUTURE_JETPACK_DISCO_DESCRIPTION_.zh: 喷射气体并以独特的姿态越过除最高那类植物以外的一切障碍。

ZOMBIE_FUTURE_JETPACK_VETERAN_DESCRIPTIO.en:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}floats over low plants, boosts over most other plants
{KEYWORD}Weakness: {STAT}tall blocking plants

{FLAVOR}Blastronaut's rocket-pack is strictly ornamental; his hovering ability comes from a deep meditative state and from being full of helium.
ZOMBIE_FUTURE_JETPACK_VETERAN_DESCRIPTIO.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}能飘过低矮植物，飞跃过绝大多数植物
{KEYWORD}弱点：{STAT}高大的防御植物

{FLAVOR}航天员僵尸的火箭背包有过精密的装饰，他翱翔的能力来源于深度的冥想与氦气。

ZOMBIE_FUTURE_JETPACK_VETERAN_DESCRIPTIO.en: Blastronaut Zombie boosts to float over all but the tallest plants.
ZOMBIE_FUTURE_JETPACK_VETERAN_DESCRIPTIO.zh: 航天员僵尸喷射气体并越过除最高那类植物以外的一切障碍。

ZOMBIE_FUTURE_PROTECTOR_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}creates a shield to protect from incoming attacks

{FLAVOR}Shield Zombie developed his system using funds from a BiteStarter campaign. The push goal for pushing plants was not met.
ZOMBIE_FUTURE_PROTECTOR_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}创造一面屏障抵挡袭来的猛攻

{FLAVOR}屏障僵尸利用“啃咬创客”活动的资金开发了他的系统。但推动“推动植物”的目标没有实现。

ZOMBIE_FUTURE_PROTECTOR_DESCRIPTION_HEAD.en: Protect himself and nearby zombies with a force field.
ZOMBIE_FUTURE_PROTECTOR_DESCRIPTION_HEAD.zh: 用一幕强力的屏障保护自身及其周围的僵尸。

ZOMBIE_FUTURE_PROTECTOR_VETERAN_DESCRIPT.en:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}shield regenerates over time

{FLAVOR}Deflector Zombie saw what Shield Zombie was doing and said to himself, "BRAAAAAAINS," because that's really the only word zombies know.
ZOMBIE_FUTURE_PROTECTOR_VETERAN_DESCRIPT.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}创造一面屏障抵挡袭来的猛攻

{FLAVOR}偏向器僵尸看了屏障僵尸的行为后，对他说了一声“脑——子！”，因为这是僵尸唯一会说的词。

ZOMBIE_FUTURE_PROTECTOR_VETERAN_DESCRIPT.en: Deflector Zombie protects himself with a powerful force field that stretches across 5 rows.
ZOMBIE_FUTURE_PROTECTOR_VETERAN_DESCRIPT.zh: 偏向器僵尸可以用一个延伸到五行的能量立场保护自己与其他僵尸。

ZOMBIE_GANG_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION.en: Conehead Families are always envied by other gang members because of their hats. In fact, he bought that hat at the Binco clothing store at the street corner, but he never told any zombies.
ZOMBIE_GANG_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION.zh: 帮派街头僵尸总因为他的帽子而被其他帮派成员嫉妒。其实那顶帽子是他在街口的宾客服装店买的，但他从不告诉任何僵尸。

ZOMBIE_GANG_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: His "cone" hat makes him twice as tough.
ZOMBIE_GANG_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 他的帽子可以让帮派僵尸强壮两倍。

ZOMBIE_GANG_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION.en: The workmanship of Buckethead Families' armor is far inferior to the bulletproof vests sold in Ammu-Nation. In fact, it was the result of his car breaking down and the hood being tasteless to eat, but a pity to discard.
ZOMBIE_GANG_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION.zh: 帮派防弹衣僵尸的防弹衣做工远不如武装国度出售的防弹衣，事实上，那是他的车坏了后，引擎盖食之无味，弃之可惜的结果。

ZOMBIE_GANG_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: His "bucket" armor provides great protection from damage.
ZOMBIE_GANG_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 他的防弹衣可以为他最大限度地承受伤害。

ZOMBIE_GANG_DESCRIPTION.en: Brain? Family? Brotherhood? Families Basic Zombie only knows these are quite important, but unfortunately he doesn't know much about any of them, and he wonders why his clothes are the same color as some plants.
ZOMBIE_GANG_DESCRIPTION.zh: 脑子？帮派？兄弟情义？帮派普通僵尸只知道这些相当的重要，可惜他对哪个了解的都不多，并且他很奇怪为什么自己的衣服颜色和一些植物一样。

ZOMBIE_GANG_FLAG_DESCRIPTION.en: The Sweet Flag Zombie is the most loyal member in the gang, always at the forefront of every battle, and also the dumbest member, always at the forefront of every battle.
ZOMBIE_GANG_FLAG_DESCRIPTION.zh: 帮派领袖斯威特僵尸是帮派中最忠诚的成员，每次战斗都走在最前方，同时也是最愚蠢的成员，每次战斗都走在最前方。

ZOMBIE_GANG_FLAG_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Marks the arrival of a huge "wave" of gangster zombies.
ZOMBIE_GANG_FLAG_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 举着旗帜的帮派领袖，通常意味着一大波僵尸的来临。

ZOMBIE_GANG_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION.en: While other zombies crave brains, the Big Smogantuar prefers fast food with extra cheese and soda. "All we had to do, was follow the damn train!" is his catchphrase, but no one knows what it means.
ZOMBIE_GANG_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION.zh: 在别的僵尸渴望脑子的时候，大尸莫克更喜欢额外加着芝士的快餐和苏打水。“我们要做的只是追上那辆火车！”是他的口头禅，没人知道那是什么意思。

ZOMBIE_GANG_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION_HEADE.en: Big Smogantuar not only crushes plants, but can also eat fried food on the lawn to get a boost.
ZOMBIE_GANG_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION_HEADE.zh: 大尸莫克不仅可以碾碎植物，也可以吃到草坪上的油炸食品获得增益。

ZOMBIE_GANG_IMP_DESCRIPTION.en: Cluckin' Bell Imp used to work at a Cluckin' Bell, but he was fired because he was shorter than the cash register and many customers thought the counter was unmanned. At least he kept his Cluckin' Bell uniform as a memento.
ZOMBIE_GANG_IMP_DESCRIPTION.zh: 当当钟小鬼僵尸曾经在一家当当钟工作，但是由于他的身高比收银台低，很多顾客误以为无人营业，他就被开除了，至少他留下来了自己的当当钟制服作为纪念。

ZOMBIE_GANG_IMP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Cluckin' Bell Imp's cute appearance makes it easy to overlook the threat he poses.
ZOMBIE_GANG_IMP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 一位带着当当钟的小鬼僵尸，他可爱的外表容易让人忽视他的威胁。

ZOMBIE_GANG_LOUDMOUTH_DESCRIPTION.en: OZ Loc Zombie always claims his music is classic West Coast rap, but as soon as he appears at a party, half of the participants leave. Tomorrow is his 34th submission to Los Santos Radio; it has been rejected 33 times so far.
ZOMBIE_GANG_LOUDMOUTH_DESCRIPTION.zh: OZ LOC 僵尸总是声称自己的音乐作品都是西海岸经典饶舌，但是派对里他一上场，一半的参与者都会离开。明天是他第 34 次向洛圣都广播电台投稿作品，目前已被退回了 33 次。

ZOMBIE_GANG_LOUDMOUTH_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: OZ Loc Zombie only sings when two or more plants are in front of him, knocking off or permanently hypnotizing plants in an area.
ZOMBIE_GANG_LOUDMOUTH_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: OZ LOC 僵尸在前方出现两株植物时会施展歌喉，将它们击飞或永久催眠。

ZOMBIE_GANG_MOLOTOV_DESCRIPTION.en: "Burn! Burn!" That's the only thing left in the Vagos Molotov Zombie's mouth. Ever since his home was burned down by a families zombie, he has formed an unbreakable bond with molotovs.
ZOMBIE_GANG_MOLOTOV_DESCRIPTION.zh: “燃烧！燃烧！”维戈尸燃烧瓶僵尸嘴中只剩下燃烧。自从他的家被一个帮派僵尸烧了以后，他便和燃烧瓶结下了不解之缘。

ZOMBIE_GANG_MOLOTOV_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Vagos Molotov Zombie rushes past plants and poses a considerable threat with his Molotov cocktails!
ZOMBIE_GANG_MOLOTOV_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 维戈尸燃烧瓶僵尸无视植物阻挡快速入场，并以燃烧瓶对植物造成巨大威胁。

ZOMBIE_GENERAL_CAESAR_PHASE3_DESCRIPTION.en: History records that Roman Caesar Zombie was a leader of impressive size and grandeur, looked up to by all his subjects.
ZOMBIE_GENERAL_CAESAR_PHASE3_DESCRIPTION.zh: 历史记载凯撒僵尸是一个令人印象深刻的领袖，拥有空前规模的威严，受到他所有臣民的景仰。

ZOMBIE_GENERAL_CAESAR_PHASE3_DESCRIPTION.en: Roman Caesar Zombie tosses imperial salad dressing onto plants, making them irresistibly delicious to zombies. He also promotes Roman Zombies, giving them stronger helmets.
ZOMBIE_GENERAL_CAESAR_PHASE3_DESCRIPTION.zh: 凯撒僵尸将帝王沙拉酱撒在植物上，让僵尸无法抗拒其美味，还能使罗马僵尸带上更坚固的头盔。

ZOMBIE_GENERAL_TREADMILL_PHASE3_DESCRIPT.en: Cardio Zombie is all about health, healthiness and healthy lifestyles. He refuses to consume carbs, downing nothing but high-protein brains for every meal. In his opinion, other zombies really need to up their game. NO EXCUSES!
ZOMBIE_GENERAL_TREADMILL_PHASE3_DESCRIPT.zh: 有氧运动僵尸只在乎健康、锻炼，还有绿色的生活方式。他拒绝摄入任何碳水，每顿饭只吃高蛋白的脑子。他觉得其他僵尸真的需要多注意一下这种东西。别找借口！

ZOMBIE_GENERAL_TREADMILL_PHASE3_DESCRIPT.en: Advances to a set spot on the board, then tosses buffing brains at other zombies until he's chased away or retreats on his own.
ZOMBIE_GENERAL_TREADMILL_PHASE3_DESCRIPT.zh: 可以前进到场地上的一个固定位置，然后向其他僵尸抛出富含胆固醇的脑子，直到他被打败或自己撤退为止。

ZOMBIE_GENERAL_ZMECH_PHASE3_DESCRIPTION.en: Z-Mech is taking time out from his PvZ Heroes and PvZ Garden Warfare duties to bring his unique brand of destruction to Plants vs. Zombies 2. Don't worry, though; he's cleared it with his manager.
ZOMBIE_GENERAL_ZMECH_PHASE3_DESCRIPTION.zh: Z 机甲好像在《植物大战僵尸：英雄》和《植物大战僵尸：花园战争》的时空里玩腻了。现在，他想来《植物大战僵尸 2》的世界看看。不必担心，他已经和他的经理沟通过了。

ZOMBIE_GENERAL_ZMECH_PHASE3_DESCRIPTION_.en: Deploys a set of summoning and teleportation technologies to harass, damage and otherwise imperil plants on the board.
ZOMBIE_GENERAL_ZMECH_PHASE3_DESCRIPTION_.zh: 利用召唤与传送技术来袭扰、破坏或用其它方式危及场上植物。

ZOMBIE_GENERAL_ZMECH_Z7_DESCRIPTION.en: A prototype of a certain machine, the Z7 model is powered by even wilder necro-science and Doom-shroom grade chemical agents. This insane technology makes it highly unstable. However, Dr. Zomboss detests anything taller, mightier, and more fear-inducing than himself, so this unit was ultimately scrapped.
ZOMBIE_GENERAL_ZMECH_Z7_DESCRIPTION.zh: 来自某个机器的原型机，Z7 型号，用了更疯狂的死亡科学和末日菇级别的化学材料，疯狂的技术让他极其不稳定，但僵王博士讨厌比他还高大威猛充满恐惧的东西，所以被淘汰了。

ZOMBIE_GENERAL_ZMECH_Z7_DESCRIPTION_HEAD.en: Utilizes superior summoning and teleportation technology to harass, demolish, or otherwise endanger plants on the lawn.
ZOMBIE_GENERAL_ZMECH_Z7_DESCRIPTION_HEAD.zh: 利用更强大的召唤与传送技术来袭扰、破坏或用其它方式危及场上植物。

ZOMBIE_GRINDERHEAD_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION.en: Veteran Grinderhead Zombie doesn't know who created him. He only knows that he needs to move forward. By the way, his hat was bought for $5.99, which is more than the guy who bought the ladder for $8.99.
ZOMBIE_GRINDERHEAD_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION.zh: 他比普通的研磨箱头僵尸更强。

ZOMBIE_GRINDERHEAD_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION_H.en: He's stronger than a regular Grinderhead zombie.
ZOMBIE_GRINDERHEAD_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION_H.zh: 傀儡僵尸并不知道自己是由谁创造的，他只知道他自己需要向前走，对了，他的帽子是花5.99＄买的，这比那个花8.99＄买梯子的家伙赚翻了。

ZOMBIE_HEIAN_AKINNDO_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}Raise the fish basket in his hand to absorb the sun!!
{KEYWORD}Weakness: {STAT}As long as he's with conical hat made in the same technology as Parasol Zombie's parasol, he'll be "invincible"!

{FLAVOR}Lifts up the fish basket and steals suns.
ZOMBIE_HEIAN_AKINNDO_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}举起手中的鱼篓，便会吸收阳光！！
{KEYWORD}弱点：{STAT}戴着和洋伞僵尸一种工艺生产的帽子，他就是“无敌”的！

{FLAVOR}举起鱼篓，掠夺阳光。

ZOMBIE_HEIAN_AKINNDO_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: There's actually a fish in Mino Zombie's fish basket, and the fish likes the taste of sun.
ZOMBIE_HEIAN_AKINNDO_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 蓑衣僵尸的鱼篓里，其实有鱼，而且这条鱼很喜欢阳光的味道。

ZOMBIE_HEIAN_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION.en: Even though he's a samurai, he doesn't have any weapons, instead he wears a special Mount Brainji road cone.
ZOMBIE_HEIAN_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION.zh: 虽然是一名武士，但是并没有配发武器，而是戴上了特色的“富脑山”路障。

ZOMBIE_HEIAN_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Wears a cone with snow on top, makes himself cooler under the bright sun.
ZOMBIE_HEIAN_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 带有雪顶的锥形路障，能在烈日下带给自己一丝清凉。

ZOMBIE_HEIAN_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION.en: This wire barrel might look like it's made with wood, but the rings around it are top level japanned wire rings.
ZOMBIE_HEIAN_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION.zh: 这个铁丝桶帽子虽然看上去是木质的，但是周围那两圈可是货真价实的上漆铁圈。

ZOMBIE_HEIAN_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: This wire barrel gives good protection, at least that how the Samurai Zombies think.
ZOMBIE_HEIAN_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 这个铁丝桶帽子能提供很好的保护，至少武士僵尸们是这样觉得的。

ZOMBIE_HEIAN_FLAG_DESCRIPTION.en: Flag Samurai Zombie holds the flag that marks the war, leading the soldiers of the shogun to take the brain.
ZOMBIE_HEIAN_FLAG_DESCRIPTION.zh: 武士旗帜僵尸高举着战斗的旗帜，引领将军们的部下掠夺脑子。

ZOMBIE_HEIAN_FLAG_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Marks the arrival of a huge wave of samurai zombies.
ZOMBIE_HEIAN_FLAG_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 标志着一大波武士僵尸的登场。

ZOMBIE_HEIAN_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}Crushes plants with kendama

{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}Throws Ninjimp when damaged

{FLAVOR}Shogun Gargantuar is the leader of the Samurai Zombies in this area, when Zomboss is not arround, he would be in charge of leading the zombies to search for brains. The kendama he's holding is a toy he's been playing with back when he was still a kid, as he grew up, he switched it for a bigger one.
ZOMBIE_HEIAN_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}攻击：{STAT}用剑玉砸扁植物

{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}受到伤害时扔出忍者小鬼僵尸

{FLAVOR}将军巨人僵尸是这片区域武士僵尸们的头领，在僵王博士不在的时候，就由他带领其他武士僵尸收集脑子了。而手上的剑玉则是他由小玩到大的玩具，当然，型号也随着他长大而改大了。

ZOMBIE_HEIAN_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION_HEAD.en: The kendama he's holding weighs about 1000 jun.

ZOMBIE_HEIAN_HANABI_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}Once Firework Zombie is out of control, the Firework tube will go out of control as well.
{KEYWORD}Weakness: {STAT}Try making him wet

{FLAVOR}Biu~~~Bang!The fireworks are so beautiful.
ZOMBIE_HEIAN_HANABI_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}一旦失去花火僵尸的操持，烟花筒就会失控
{KEYWORD}弱点：{STAT}被冰冻时会变弱

{FLAVOR}Biu~~~Bang！火光真美妙。

ZOMBIE_HEIAN_HANABI_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Firework Zombie tinkers with his family's firework design every day. Nobody but him knows how it works.
ZOMBIE_HEIAN_HANABI_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 花火僵尸每天都尝试往家传的烟花筒里放入新的元素，除了他自己外谁也不知道该怎么使用他的烟花筒。

ZOMBIE_HEIAN_NINJA_DESCRIPTION.en: Ninjimp often uses smokebombs to tell everyone that he is coming!
ZOMBIE_HEIAN_NINJA_DESCRIPTION.zh: 忍者小鬼僵尸经常会用烟雾弹来告诉大家，他来了！

ZOMBIE_HEIAN_NINJA_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: The pufferfish Ninjimp holds is no ordinary pufferfish. The spikes, they're real.
ZOMBIE_HEIAN_NINJA_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 忍者小鬼僵尸手里的河豚非比寻常，上面的刺，可是真的刺。

ZOMBIE_HEIAN_ONMYOJI_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}Waving his fan, and the wind of luckiness shall blow!

{KEYWORD}Weakness: {STAT}His kariginu doesn't seem to be that tough...?

{FLAVOR}He fanned himself here, and soon the wind began to blow at the shrine.
ZOMBIE_HEIAN_ONMYOJI_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}挥舞手中的扇子，便会刮起幸运的风

{KEYWORD}弱点：{STAT}身上的狩衣起不到防护作用

{FLAVOR}他在这里扇一下扇子，神社不久便刮起了风。

ZOMBIE_HEIAN_ONMYOJI_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Onmyoji Zombies is emphasised at making different-looking fans, this time he's calling this fan he made for the shrine the "Lucky Star."
ZOMBIE_HEIAN_ONMYOJI_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 阴阳师僵尸热衷于制作不一样的扇子，这次他给带来神社的扇子命名为：幸运星。

ZOMBIE_HEIAN_SUSHI_DESCRIPTION.en: He learnt his cooking skills at Mount Brainji Restaurant. The sushi he makes are popular among the zombies.
ZOMBIE_HEIAN_SUSHI_DESCRIPTION.zh: 从富脑山食堂出师，做出来的寿司广受僵尸们欢迎。

ZOMBIE_HEIAN_SUSHI_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Although the sushi made by the sushi chef zombie cannot satisfy the zombies' desire for brains, it still has a fatal attraction for the zombies.
ZOMBIE_HEIAN_SUSHI_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 寿司师傅僵尸的寿司虽然不能满足僵尸们对脑子的渴望，但是仍然对僵尸们有着致命的吸引力。

ZOMBIE_HEIAN_WORKER_DESCRIPTION.en: He's now a beginner samurai after donning the sakayaki wig.
ZOMBIE_HEIAN_WORKER_DESCRIPTION.zh: 戴上月代头的假发后，他就是一名入门武士了。

ZOMBIE_HEIAN_WORKER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: A common samurai zombie under the command of Shogun Gargantuar.
ZOMBIE_HEIAN_WORKER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 将军巨人僵尸麾下的普通武士僵尸。

ZOMBIE_HERO_ELECTRICBOOGALOO_DESCRIPTION.en: "Disco is immortal!" Even if Electric Boogaloo came to PVZ2, his mantra remained the same.
ZOMBIE_HERO_ELECTRICBOOGALOO_DESCRIPTION.zh: “迪斯科不死！”即使霹雳舞王来到了《植物大战僵尸 2》，但口头禅依旧不变。

ZOMBIE_HERO_SUPERBRAINZ_DESCRIPTION_HEAD.zh: 英雄传中的野蛮人僵尸

ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Cave Conehead Zombie was the first zombie to invent the cone. He lashed the horn of a mammoth to a slab of petrified wood ... and boom! A cone! The invention of the cone changed everything for the zombies. EVERYTHING.
ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}洞穴路障僵尸是世界上第一只发明路障的僵尸。他把猛犸象的角和一块石化的木板绑了起来，然后“砰”！一个路障就此诞生了。路障的诞生标志着僵尸的崭新时代已然来临。

ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: His mammoth horn cone makes him twice as tough as normal cave-dwellers.
ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 他的猛犸象角路障使他的防御力比普通的洞穴僵尸高一倍。

ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Cave Buckethead Zombie likes rocks. He likes rocks A LOT. He strapped a rock to his head and called it a bucket. None of the other Cave Zombies know what a "bucket" is, but they like his style.
ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}洞穴铁桶僵尸喜欢石头。超—级—喜欢。他把一块石头绑在头上，把它叫作“铁桶”。其他洞穴僵尸都不知道什么是“铁桶”，但他们喜欢他的命名风格。

ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: His stone "bucket" hat provides great protection from damage.
ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 他的石质“铁”桶可以帮助他很好地抵御伤害。

ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_ARMOR3_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}One day, a Cave Zombie fell head-first into a glacial stream. It had been a bad day already, so he lay there in the frigid water for a long time contemplating the insignificance of his life. When he finally stood up, he discovered that his head was encased in ice. At last, his life had meaning! He was unique! He was Blockhead Zombie! At least, that's his story and he's sticking to it.
ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_ARMOR3_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}有一天，一只洞穴僵尸掉进了一条冰河里。这对于他来说是糟糕的一天，他躺在冰冷的水中很长一段时间，思考着他那毫无意义的生命。而当他站起来时，他发现自己的头被冰块包裹着。终于——他的生命终于有意义了！他成为了独一无二的冰块僵尸！至少他自己是这么说的。

ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_ARMOR3_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: The ice block on his head provides amazing protection from damage.
ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_ARMOR3_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 他的头上的冰块可以帮助他很好地抵御伤害。
