ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_ARMOR4_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Actually, Mammoth Head Zombie used to be an ordinary Cave Zombie. Every day, he would stick his head into the ice flow, aspiring to become a Blockhead Zombie. However, one day, a mammoth stepped on the Blockhead Zombie next to him, flattening him. "So, mammoths are the strongest," he thought. Consequently, he asked Dr. Zomboss for a mammoth head helmet. With this, he was sure he could feast on delicious brains!
ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_ARMOR4_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}其实猛犸头僵尸以前是个普通的洞穴僵尸，他每天都把头伸到冰流里面，想要成为一个冰砖僵尸，可是某一天一头猛犸象直接把他隔壁的冰块僵尸踩扁了，“原来猛犸象才是最强的”他想。于是他求僵王博士打造了一个猛犸头盔，有了这个他一定可以吃到美味的脑子！

ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_ARMOR4_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: The mammoth head helmet on his head provides impeccable protection from damage.
ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_ARMOR4_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 头戴的坚固防具可为其提供更高的防御力。

ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_CHIEF_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Icewind Chief Zombie defeated all other zombies in a leaf-blowing match and became the chief of the zombie tribe, so he decided to hold a sports competition in his tribe. The sprinting champion Dodo Rider Zombie and Yeti Imp, the famous weightlifter Troglobite, and the Frisbee athlete Sloth Gargantuar heard this and came, but there's only one subject in this competition: Inflating balloons....
ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_CHIEF_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}冰风酋长僵尸通过一次吹树叶大赛击败了其他的僵尸当选了整个部落的酋长，俗话说新僵上任三把火，于是他决定在整个部落举行一次运动会，闻讯而来的有著名跑步健将渡渡鸟骑士僵尸和雪人小鬼僵尸、著名举重选手穴居僵尸、著名铁饼运动员树懒巨人僵尸等……这一次的运动会有且仅有一个项目：吹气球……

ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_CHIEF_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Blows cold wind and cool down plants all the plants in the lane.
ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_CHIEF_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 能吹出寒风，冻结前方的植物。

ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_CHIEF_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}During a daily attack, Icewind Chief Zombie suddenly noticed the guy in the cave across from him, wearing a frying pan on his head, pulled out a fan device. As a result, Icewind Chief Zombie was blown away. After being blown away several times, Icewind Chief Zombie learned how to counteract this fan device and transformed into the Veteran Icewind Chief Zombie.
ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_CHIEF_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}在某次日常的进攻中，冰风酋长僵尸突然发现对面洞穴里那个头戴平底锅的家伙拿出了一个扇子装置。于是，冰风酋长僵尸就被吹飞了，被吹的多了，冰风酋长僵尸就学会了如何对抗这个扇子装置，变成了精英冰风酋长僵尸。

ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_CHIEF_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION_.en: Blows cold wind and instantly freezes all the plants in the lane.
ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_CHIEF_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION_.zh: 能吹出极寒狂风，立即冻结前方整行的植物。

ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Cave Zombie was busy painting handprints on cave walls when he was told to start fighting plants. He's not sure why he's fighting plants, but he hopes he can get back to painting soon. He was feeling inspired. He had plans for some big pieces. Art school was finally paying off.
ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}洞穴僵尸正忙着在他的洞穴墙壁上画手印，在这时，僵尸和植物的战争爆发了。他虽然不知道为什么要和植物战斗，但他希望能尽快来完成他的艺术作品。想到这些，他备受鼓舞。他有一些宏大的计划。因为一家艺术学校终于决定收他为徒了。

ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_DODO_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Dodo Rider believes dodos are the future of transportation. He believes a public dodo-riding system is not only a wise expenditure of tax dollars but would help the vast majority of zombies get where they need to go more efficiently. Everyone keeps telling him there's no future in dodos, but he refuses to listen.
ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_DODO_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}渡渡鸟骑士坚信渡渡鸟是未来的交通工具。他相信，搭建一个公共渡渡鸟骑乘系统是一种对纳税开支的明智手法，有助于绝大多数僵尸快速到达他们想到的地方。所有人一直在告诉他渡渡鸟没有未来，但他就是不听。

ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_DODO_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Dodo bird with an imp rider. The dodo can flap and jump over barricades as well as troublesome plants.
ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_DODO_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 渡渡鸟僵尸有着一只小鬼作为骑手。渡渡鸟可以飞越障碍物与棘手的植物。

ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_FLAG_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Cave Flag Zombie has been in the flag-carrying business for a long time. It's been his life's work. He's good at it. But sometimes, just sometimes, he longs for a change. He wonders if he could be good at something else. He wonders if he could leave it all behind and start fresh. He's pretty sure he's having a mid-life crisis.
ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_FLAG_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}洞穴旗帜僵尸做扛旗工作很久了，已经成为了他一生的事业。他擅长这工作，但有时候（真的是有时）期望改变。他希望可以擅长其他的，希望可以把所有都抛开，开始休息。他十分确定他正在经历中年危机。

ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_FLAG_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Marks the arrival of a huge frosty "wave" of zombies.
ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_FLAG_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 标示着一群冷若冰霜的僵尸即将随风而至。

ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}crushes plants with icicle
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}fires off Yeti Imps when damaged

{FLAVOR}Somewhere along the line, Sloth Gargantuar contracted a bad case of Yeti Imps. He used soap, medicinal powders, and a salve made from sloth slobber in an attempt to get rid of them ... to no avail. But the truth is, he's grown used to their presence. The darn things are itchy. They're always squabbling. They nag him endlessly. But at this point, he'd probably miss them if they ever cleared up.
ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}伤害：{STAT}用冰柱砸碎植物

{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}在受到一定伤害后扔出雪人小鬼僵尸

{FLAVOR}某时某地，地懒巨人僵尸被一群雪人小鬼缠住了。他试过用肥皂、药粉，甚至是树懒口水制成的药膏，但结果都无济于事——他没有办法摆脱他们。不过现在他已经习惯了。虽然那些小鬼经常弄得他痒痒的，而且还从早到黑都在不停地吵架，有时候甚至还在他的背后说三道四，但如果有一天他们真的不见了，他估计会很想他们吧。

ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION_HEA.en: Massive sloth skinned zombie with a case of the imps. Carries and throws three imps instead of just one.
ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION_HEA.zh: 肩负数只小鬼并身着巨大树懒皮的僵尸。共计携带三只小鬼用于投掷。

ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_HUNTER_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Shhhhh ... Hunter Zombie didn't actually kill that sabertooth tiger. He found the skin at a thrift store. Also, he's a vegetarian. Tell no one.
ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_HUNTER_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}嘘…其实猎人僵尸根本没有杀死那只剑齿虎。那张皮只是他在一个旧货店里找到的罢了。不仅如此，他其实还是个素食主义者。好啦，别给其他人说。

ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_HUNTER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Zombie that can throw snow balls at range to cool down plants until they freeze into blocks.
ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_HUNTER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 朝临近植物投掷雪球的僵尸，雪球碰到植物后会稍微冻结植物。

ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_HUNTER_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Actually, zombies also hold a sports event every four years. The Veteran Hunter Zombie swept the first season and... ummm... whatever season it is now, he is the champion of champions.
ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_HUNTER_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}其实僵尸每4年也会举办一次运动会，精英猎人僵尸包揽了第一届到。。 额。。现在是第几届来着的冠军，总之，他是冠军中的冠军。

ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_HUNTER_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION.en: Zombie that can throw snow balls at range to freeze plants into blocks instantly.
ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_HUNTER_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION.zh: 朝临近植物投掷雪球的僵尸，雪球碰到植物后会立即冻结植物。

ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_IMP_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Yeti Imp recently took up knitting. He started with a scarf, moved on to mittens and eventually knitted an entire bodysuit out of hair he shaved off of Yeti Zombie. He just loves knitting. When those needles are in his hands, he feels a sense of calm he's never felt before.
ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_IMP_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}雪人小鬼僵尸最近开始学习编织。他从一条围巾开始，然后是手套，最后甚至用雪人僵尸的毛发做了一整件的紧身衣。他喜欢编织，当针在他手中时，他能感到一种从未有过的平静感。

ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_IMP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Thrown over most of your defenses, then ambles onward.
ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_IMP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 可以被甩到你的防线后排，然后向你的脑子前进。

ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_TROGLOBITE_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Troglobite has been pushing ice blocks across the tundra day in and day out for as long as he can remember. It's cold and exhausting work, and frankly, he's ready for a vacation. He'd like to go somewhere sunny and warm for a change. He'd like to relax in the sand. He hears Big Wave Beach is nice this time of year.
ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_TROGLOBITE_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}穴居僵尸从他能记事起，就在日复一日地把冰块推过冻土。这是份又冷又累的活。说真的，他想度个假。他想在一个晴朗又温暖的地方换换口味。他喜欢在沙子中放松。他还听说每年这个时候的巨浪海滩就是个不错的选择。

ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_TROGLOBITE_DESCRIPTION_HEA.en: Strong zombie that can push blocks of ice across the lawn.
ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_TROGLOBITE_DESCRIPTION_HEA.zh: 体魄强健的僵尸，能推动场上的冰块并向前行进。

ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_WEASELHOARDER_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}releases zombie ice weasels when damaged
{FLAVOR}Weasel Hoarder claims she's the one who wrote the song "Pop! Goes the Weasel." And for eons now, she's been demanding royalties for it. But everyone just ignores her. They know that Weasel Hoarder can't even carry a tune, much less write a catchy ditty about the sound vermin make when hugged a bit too tightly.
ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_WEASELHOARDER_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}在受到一定伤害后放出冰鼬

{FLAVOR}冰鼬僵尸一直在声明《砰！冰鼬出来了。》这首歌是她写的。千百年来，她一直在申请自己的版权费，但是没有僵尸理她。他们知道冰鼬僵尸不可能会写歌，更不可能写出一首朗朗上口的歌，一首关于抱得太紧而发出的声音的歌。

ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_WEASELHOARDER_DESCRIPTION_.en: Zombie hiding in a log with a pack of snow weasels. Weasels are released when her log is shattered.
ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_WEASELHOARDER_DESCRIPTION_.zh: 这只僵尸和一群冰鼬一起挤在空树干里。一旦空树干被打碎，冰鼬就会被释放出来！

ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_WEASELHOARDER_VETERAN_DESC.en:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}releases zombie Veteran Ice Weasels when damaged

{FLAVOR}One day, Weasel Hoarder came across a new hollow log. Inside, it discovered an Ice Weasel with two sharp teeth. Next to it was a pine cone. Weasel Hoarder and Ice Weasel both took a bite of the pine cone, and they transformed into the Veteran Weasel Hoarder.
ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_WEASELHOARDER_VETERAN_DESC.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}在受到一定伤害后放出精英冰鼬

{FLAVOR}某天，冰鼬僵尸遇到了一块新的空心木头，在里面发现了一只被冻硬的有两只尖牙的松鼠，在它旁边有一个松果，冰鼬僵尸和冰鼬一起啃了一下松果，然后他们就变成了精英冰鼬僵尸。

ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_WEASELHOARDER_VETERAN_DESC.en: Zombie hiding in a log with a pack of snow weasels. Veteran Weasels are released when her log is shattered.
ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_WEASELHOARDER_VETERAN_DESC.zh: 这只僵尸和一群精英冰鼬一起挤在空树干里。一旦空树干被打碎，精英冰鼬就会被释放出来！

ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_WEASEL_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Once released, weasels run full speed even over ice floes to nibble your brains.
ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_WEASEL_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 一旦被释放，冰鼬就会全速前进，越过浮冰去吃掉你的脑子。

ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_WEASEL_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}This is not an ordinary snow weasel – it's an snow weasel that nibbled on a special pine cone!
ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_WEASEL_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}这可是啃了特殊松果的冰鼬！

ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_WEASEL_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION.en: Once released, Veteran Ice Weasels run full speed even over ice floes to nibble your brains.
ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_WEASEL_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION.zh: 一旦被释放，精英冰鼬就会全速前进，快速地越过浮冰去吃掉你的脑子！

ZOMBIE_IMPOSTER_DESCRIPTION.en: Every imp zombie has an ultimate dream: to reach the kitchen counter without stacking three chairs. This detective trench coat is their "ticket to becoming a corpse" found in the zombie flea market—although the size is obviously designed for a zombie wider than all three of them combined, it just so happens that they fit perfectly inside.
ZOMBIE_IMPOSTER_DESCRIPTION.zh: 每个小鬼僵尸都有个终极梦想：不用垫三个椅子才能够到厨房台面。这件侦探风衣是他们在僵尸旧货市场淘到的“成尸门票”——虽然尺码明显是为一个比他们加起来还宽的僵尸定制的，但正因为如此，他们仨挤进去刚刚好

ZOMBIE_IMPOSTER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Wears a resistant trench coat, contains 3 imp zombies.
ZOMBIE_IMPOSTER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 穿有抗阻的风衣，内含 3 只小鬼僵尸。

ZOMBIE_IMPPEAR_IMP_DESCRIPTION.en: They carry no memory of the zombie they’d been before.
ZOMBIE_IMPPEAR_IMP_DESCRIPTION.zh: 它们没有一点变成小鬼之前的记忆。

ZOMBIE_IMPPEAR_IMP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Zombies converted into Imps by Imp Pear become Imp Pear Imps.
ZOMBIE_IMPPEAR_IMP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 由小鬼梨转化而成的小鬼被称作“小鬼梨小鬼”。

ZOMBIE_INHIBITOR_DESCRIPTION.zh: 在关卡内替换 {ZOMBIE} 只僵尸！

ZOMBIE_INVISIBLE_PLANE_DESCRIPTION.en:
Hint: Lantern Cherry and Lighting Reed can both remove the invisibility effect of Arbiter-X, Rhubarbarian can also defeat it with good timing.

{FLAVOR}With the construction of the Sky City, Dr. Zomboss did not hesitate to spend a lot of money to introduce invisible aircraft. After three days and three nights of experiments in the strong electricity laboratory, and after his hair was burned ten times by strong electricity, the Arbiter-X was finally born! That's right, the most mysterious aircraft in history that fascinates countless zombies. It is said that it can give zombies a sense of security that they have been missing for a long time.
ZOMBIE_INVISIBLE_PLANE_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}伴随着天空之城的建造，僵王博士不惜花重金引入隐形飞行器。在强电实验室历经三天三夜的实验，被强电烧焦了十次头发后，仲裁者 - X型隐形飞行器终于诞生了！没错，一件令无数僵尸们神魂颠倒的史上最神秘飞行器。据说，它能带给僵尸们他们缺失已久的安全感。

ZOMBIE_INVISIBLE_PLANE_DESCRIPTION_HEADE.en: Activate the invisible beam to make the zombies invisible.
ZOMBIE_INVISIBLE_PLANE_DESCRIPTION_HEADE.zh: 发动隐形光束，使身后的僵尸进入隐形状态

ZOMBIE_JACKBOX_DESCRIPTION.en: This zombie shivers, not because he's cold but because he's crazy.
ZOMBIE_JACKBOX_DESCRIPTION.zh: 这种僵尸令人不寒而栗，不是因为他的冰冷身躯，而是因为他的疯狂。

ZOMBIE_JACKBOX_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: A zombie with its own background music and self-destruction.
ZOMBIE_JACKBOX_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 一个自带BGM而且会自爆的僵尸。

ZOMBIE_JTTW_ALLSTAR_DESCRIPTION.en: Each of the Marshal-Star Zombie’s recent defeats has been broadcast live in the Heavens, causing his support rating to drop to –110%.
ZOMBIE_JTTW_ALLSTAR_DESCRIPTION.zh: 元帅明星僵尸近期战斗中的每一次失败都被天庭实况转播，观众对他的支持率下降到了负110％。

ZOMBIE_JTTW_ALLSTAR_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: A zombie clad in full armor charging at your defenses.
ZOMBIE_JTTW_ALLSTAR_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 一位全身包裹铠甲冲击你防线的僵尸。

ZOMBIE_JTTW_ARMOR1.en: Journey to the West Conehead Zombie

ZOMBIE_JTTW_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION.en: He was told that a Journey to the West Conehead Zombie should block the pilgrims heading west, so that’s what he became. However, the roadblock material on the Journey to the West doesn’t seem very sturdy.
ZOMBIE_JTTW_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION.zh: 有人告诉西游路障僵尸应该阻挡往西边走的师徒，所以他成了西游路障僵尸。不过西游路上的路障材质似乎不太结实。

ZOMBIE_JTTW_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: His bamboo cone makes him twice as tough as a normal zombie.
ZOMBIE_JTTW_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 他的竹篓路障让他比普通僵尸强壮两倍。

ZOMBIE_JTTW_ARMOR2.en: Journey to the West Porcelainhead Zombie

ZOMBIE_JTTW_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION.en: The Magnet Sutra holds the secrets of making real magnets. Unfortunately, half of the ancient scroll got soaked, so the zombies could only cobble together a ceramagnet. It was basically a cheap ceramic knockoff of a real magnet.
ZOMBIE_JTTW_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION.zh: 《磁铁经》里记载了磁铁的制造工艺。可惜经书前面一半泡了水，所以僵尸们只发明出了“瓷”铁。

ZOMBIE_JTTW_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: His porcelain can withstand a tremendous amount of damage.
ZOMBIE_JTTW_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 他的铁瓷杯头盔能极大程度地承受伤害。

ZOMBIE_JTTW_BALLOON_DESCRIPTION.en: Once the released lantern flies up and burns out in the sky, the Kongming Lantern Zombie appears.
ZOMBIE_JTTW_BALLOON_DESCRIPTION.zh: 放出的孔明灯飞向天空燃烧殆尽后，孔明灯僵尸便出现了。

ZOMBIE_JTTW_BALLOON_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: The sky lantern carries this zombie over obstacles and ground defenses.
ZOMBIE_JTTW_BALLOON_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 孔明灯会带着僵尸越过障碍及地面防御物。

ZOMBIE_JTTW_CATAPULT_DESCRIPTION.en: The Trebuchet Zombie has always diligently contributed to other zombies’ ‘magical arts’ from behind the scenes.
ZOMBIE_JTTW_CATAPULT_DESCRIPTION.zh: 投石车僵尸一直在幕后兢兢业业的为他人的“仙术”做贡献。

ZOMBIE_JTTW_DESCRIPTION.en: The Journey to the West Zombie journeys westward, covering 108,000 li and enduring eighty-one trials in search of a brain to call his own.
ZOMBIE_JTTW_DESCRIPTION.zh: 西游普通僵尸一路向西，翻越十万八千里，历经九九八十一难，寻求属于他的脑子。

ZOMBIE_JTTW_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: A typical Journey to the West-themed zombie.

ZOMBIE_JTTW_FLAG.en: Journey to the West Flag Zombie

ZOMBIE_JTTW_FLAG_DESCRIPTION.en: The underworld’s real estate market has been crushed by the tourism boom, and many zombies are trying to leave by tampering with the Book of Life and Death so they can take advantage of the Journey to the West Flag Zombie’s recent 20% off discount.
ZOMBIE_JTTW_FLAG_DESCRIPTION.zh: 地府房地产经济被旅游业打压得濒临崩溃，大量僵尸都尝试通过乱改生死簿的方式离开地府，从而享受西游旗子僵尸最近推出的八折优惠。

ZOMBIE_JTTW_FLAG_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Marks the arrival of a monstrous "wave" of zombies.
ZOMBIE_JTTW_FLAG_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 举着旗子的西游僵尸，通常意味着一大波僵尸的来临。

ZOMBIE_JTTW_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION.en: He lifts mountains and moves the earth with unmatched strength – a king on the battlefield. The legendary tale of the Mace Gargantuar speaks for itself.
ZOMBIE_JTTW_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION.zh: 气拔山兮，力盖世，战场上的王者。重锤巨人的传奇故事已无需多言。

ZOMBIE_JTTW_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION_HEADE.en: Crushes plants with his massive mace.

ZOMBIE_JTTW_MINER_DESCRIPTION.en: The Tudigong Zombie has recently become obsessed with spy movies and yearns to contribute his skills to the ‘intelligence’ work at the village gate.
ZOMBIE_JTTW_MINER_DESCRIPTION.zh: 土地公僵尸最近迷上了特工电影，渴望能在村口的“情报”工作中贡献出自己的力量。

ZOMBIE_JTTW_MINER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: This zombie tunnels underground to slip past your defenses.
ZOMBIE_JTTW_MINER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 这种僵尸通过挖隧道来穿过你的防御。

ZOMBIE_JTTW_PONCHO_DESCRIPTION.en: A storyline common in Western films – after all, movies about heading west are basically Westerns, so what’s the problem?
ZOMBIE_JTTW_PONCHO_DESCRIPTION.zh: 西部片里常见的剧情。往西走的片好像也算西部片，没啥问题。

ZOMBIE_JTTW_PONCHO_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Sometimes he tucks away a salvaged wok to use as armor.
ZOMBIE_JTTW_PONCHO_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 有时候他藏着一个收来的铁锅当护甲。

ZOMBIE_JTTW_REDBOY_DESCRIPTION.en: Red Boy, the Holy Infant Great King of Mount Hao, wields the legendary True Samadhi Fire. However, as a zombie, he is hardly suited to sit on any lotus throne.
ZOMBIE_JTTW_REDBOY_DESCRIPTION.zh: 红孩儿是镇守号山的圣婴大亡，神通广大，口吐三昧真火。不过作为一个僵尸，实在不适合坐什么莲花宝座。

ZOMBIE_JTTW_REDBOY_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en:
Fire Bomb: Launches multiple fire missiles periodically, dealing heavy damage to plants.
True Samadhi Fire: Fires a True Samadhi Fire that travels in a straight line and incinerates all plants in its path; can be extinguished by Iceberg Lettuce’s Plant Food effect.
Row Teleport: Periodically teleports to the end of another lane and continues forward.
ZOMBIE_JTTW_REDBOY_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh:
火焰弹：每隔一段时间发射多颗火焰导弹，对植物造成高额伤害。
三味真火：发射三味真火，延直线移动并烧毁所有遇到的植物，可被冰冻生菜的大招熄灭。
位移换行：每隔一段时间，移动至其他行末尾并行进。

ZOMBIE_JTTW_SUPERFANIMP_DESCRIPTION.en: “Tell those crazy little fans who love self-detonation: not only does the gunpowder come from here, but the relish of self-detonation comes from here too!” — *Zombie Minus 3.5 Major Inventions*
ZOMBIE_JTTW_SUPERFANIMP_DESCRIPTION.zh: “告诉那些热爱自爆的疯狂小粉丝们，不仅火药来自这里，自爆这一津津乐道的行为也是从这里传出去的！”——《僵尸负三点五大发明》

ZOMBIE_JTTW_SUPERFANIMP_DESCRIPTION_HEAD.en: An overzealous imp who can detonate the bomb he’s carrying, causing lethal damage to a single plant.
ZOMBIE_JTTW_SUPERFANIMP_DESCRIPTION_HEAD.zh: 一个太过狂热的小鬼，能引爆扛着的炸弹，对单格植物造成致命伤害。

ZOMBIE_JTTW_TRIDENT_DESCRIPTION.en: The Harpoon Demon trains daily with his trident so that when the boisterous Thunder God Lei Gong appears, he can quickly jettison his armor and flee.
ZOMBIE_JTTW_TRIDENT_DESCRIPTION.zh: 鱼叉小妖每天反复练习投掷三叉戟，为的就是在毛脸雷公打进来的时候快速卸甲跑路。

ZOMBIE_JTTW_TRIDENT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: A zombie that deals damage to plants from a distance.
ZOMBIE_JTTW_TRIDENT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 是个远距离对植物造成伤害的僵尸。

ZOMBIE_JTTW_YELLOWBROW.en: Yellow Brow Great Demon King Zombie

ZOMBIE_JTTW_YELLOWBROW_DESCRIPTION.en: Grandpa Yellow Brow, the Yellow Brow Great Demon King. ‘Who once said “might makes right and I alone should rule, with only heroes daring to compete”? Is that really how things should be? Well then… the answer is sure to pound your head if you try to guess.’
ZOMBIE_JTTW_YELLOWBROW_DESCRIPTION.zh: 黄眉爷爷，黄眉大亡。设像显能，与汝赌赛。谁曾言“强者为尊该让我，英雄只此敢争先”？然合当如此？此间之瓜，击颅则痛剧。

ZOMBIE_JTTW_YELLOWBROW_DESCRIPTION_HEADE.en:
Summon Zombies: Swings his wolf‑tooth club to summon a horde of Journey‑to‑the‑West zombies to attack.
Human Sack: Throws a sack that sucks up all plants in its row; can be destroyed by Ash-type plants.
Golden Bowl: Throws a golden bowl that flattens all plants in a 2x2 area.
Row Warp: Does not move forward; periodically jumps to another row.
ZOMBIE_JTTW_YELLOWBROW_DESCRIPTION_HEADE.zh:
召唤僵尸：挥动狼牙棒，召唤大量西游僵尸进攻。
人种袋：投掷人种袋，吸取整行所有植物，可用灰烬破坏。
金钵：投掷金钵，砸扁 2x2 范围内的所有植物。
位移换行：不会往前走，每隔一段时间移动至其他行。

ZOMBIE_KONGFU_BASIC_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Why Kongfu Zombie needs a roadcone for protection? Simple, it's fashionable!
ZOMBIE_KONGFU_BASIC_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}为什么功夫僵尸还需要路障作为保护？答案是，这样显得比较时髦。

ZOMBIE_KONGFU_BASIC_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION_H.en: His helmet roadcone makes him twice as tough as normal zombies.
ZOMBIE_KONGFU_BASIC_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION_H.zh: 他的路障头盔让他比普通僵尸强壮两倍。

ZOMBIE_KONGFU_BASIC_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Don't get me wrong, his original purpose was just to perform the acrobatics of holding a teapot on his head.
ZOMBIE_KONGFU_BASIC_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}不要误会，原本他的目的只是表演头顶茶壶的杂技。

ZOMBIE_KONGFU_BASIC_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION_H.en: His iron teapot headwear provides great protection from damage.
ZOMBIE_KONGFU_BASIC_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION_H.zh: 他的铁茶壶头盔能极大程度地承受伤害。

ZOMBIE_KONGFU_BASIC_ARMOR3_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Even though he was an admiral in life, he still could not escape the fate of death.
ZOMBIE_KONGFU_BASIC_ARMOR3_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}被任命为元帅是功夫僵尸们至高无上的荣耀。

ZOMBIE_KONGFU_BASIC_ARMOR3_DESCRIPTION_H.en: His admiral's helmet provides him with excellent protection.
ZOMBIE_KONGFU_BASIC_ARMOR3_DESCRIPTION_H.zh: 他的元帅头盔能提供他极佳的保护。

ZOMBIE_KONGFU_BASIC_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Don't underestimate these Kong Fu Zombies, they’ve been learning kongfu for many years (although they’ve all been forgotten after becoming zombies)
ZOMBIE_KONGFU_BASIC_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}别小看这些普通僵尸，他们好歹也学了许多年功夫（至于忘了多少就不好说了）。

ZOMBIE_KONGFU_DRINK_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}The bad news is, when he was alive, Drinking Zombie learned Drunken Boxing! The good news is, after becoming a zombie, he had forgotten most of the skills.
ZOMBIE_KONGFU_DRINK_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}坏消息是，喝酒僵尸的醉拳强得可怕！好消息是，他的拳法都忘得差不多了

ZOMBIE_KONGFU_DRINK_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 喝酒后，能进入狂暴状态。

ZOMBIE_KONGFU_FLAG_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Flag Zombie is born a leader, so he doesn't need to know Kong Fu, just knowing how to wave the flag is enough.
ZOMBIE_KONGFU_FLAG_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}旗子僵尸是天生的领导者，因此他不需要会功夫，只需要会舞旗即可。

ZOMBIE_KONGFU_FLAG_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Kongfu Zombie holding a flag, it usually means the approach of a huge wave of zombies.
ZOMBIE_KONGFU_FLAG_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 举着旗子的功夫僵尸，通常意味着一大波僵尸的来临。

ZOMBIE_KONGFU_GONG_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Gong Zombie is Exploding Zombie's brother. They both don't know any Kongfu. The difference is, Gong Zombie is more interested in musical instruments.
ZOMBIE_KONGFU_GONG_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}铜锣僵尸本是自爆僵尸的兄弟，他们都不会功夫，不同的是，铜锣僵尸对乐器更有兴趣。

ZOMBIE_KONGFU_GONG_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Bangs his gong to summon Exploding Zombies.
ZOMBIE_KONGFU_GONG_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 敲锣打鼓，能召唤出自爆僵尸。

ZOMBIE_KONGFU_HAMMER_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Hammer Zombie is known as the "Zombie Whirlwind." He is famous for being able to quickly spin his hammer without feeling dizzy.
ZOMBIE_KONGFU_HAMMER_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}锤子僵尸人称“僵旋风”，他以快速旋转手中的锤子而不头晕著称。

ZOMBIE_KONGFU_HAMMER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Hammer Zombie spins with his hammer, reflecting straight-shot projectiles but not lobbed ones)
ZOMBIE_KONGFU_HAMMER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 能发出锤子旋风，反弹直线而来的子弹。

ZOMBIE_KONGFU_MONK_ARMOR3_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Although he doesn't know martial arts, his toughness earned him a great position in the temple.
ZOMBIE_KONGFU_MONK_ARMOR3_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}他虽不会武功，但硬莽使他在庙里得到了一个很棒的位置。

ZOMBIE_KONGFU_MONK_ARMOR3_DESCRIPTION_HE.en: The admiral's helmet on his head provides him with excellent protection.
ZOMBIE_KONGFU_MONK_ARMOR3_DESCRIPTION_HE.zh: 他头上的元帅头盔能提供他极佳的保护。

ZOMBIE_KONGFU_MONK_BASIC_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Standing, squatting, sitting quietly, and eating brains constitute the daily tasks of Monk Zombies.
ZOMBIE_KONGFU_MONK_BASIC_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}站桩，蹲马步，静坐，外加渴望脑子，这些构成了武僧僵尸的每日任务

ZOMBIE_KONGFU_MONK_BLADE_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}He was famous for his swordsmanship in Tang poetry during his lifetime, and now he is famous for his deadly swordsmanship.
ZOMBIE_KONGFU_MONK_BLADE_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}有僵湖传言说他以唐诗刀法闻名于世，实际上那是躺尸刀法

ZOMBIE_KONGFU_MONK_BLADE_DESCRIPTION_HEA.en: Monk zombie with super attack power.
ZOMBIE_KONGFU_MONK_BLADE_DESCRIPTION_HEA.zh: 拥有超强攻击力的武僧僵尸。

ZOMBIE_KONGFU_MONK_BUCKET_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}In addition to practicing martial arts, this kind of zombie is also responsible for boiling water in the temple.
ZOMBIE_KONGFU_MONK_BUCKET_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}这种僵尸除了练武，还负责庙里的烧水工作。

ZOMBIE_KONGFU_MONK_BUCKET_DESCRIPTION_HE.en: The iron teapot on his head allows him to take great damage.
ZOMBIE_KONGFU_MONK_BUCKET_DESCRIPTION_HE.zh: 他头上的铁茶壶能让他极大地承受伤害。

ZOMBIE_KONGFU_MONK_CONE_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}You thought the Monk Zombie doesn't need to wear armor? You are wrong, in fact, he thought it was his douli he wore when he was alive.
ZOMBIE_KONGFU_MONK_CONE_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}你以为武僧就不用头戴护甲了吗？你错了，其实他以为那是耍帅的斗笠

ZOMBIE_KONGFU_MONK_CONE_DESCRIPTION_HEAD.en: His roadcone makes him twice as tough as normal monk zombies.
ZOMBIE_KONGFU_MONK_CONE_DESCRIPTION_HEAD.zh: 他的路障让他比普通武僧僵尸要厉害两倍。

ZOMBIE_KONGFU_MONK_DRINK_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}He had been punished for breaking the precepts during his lifetime, but now he finally no longer had to worry about this problem.
ZOMBIE_KONGFU_MONK_DRINK_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}因为犯戒而受罚？喝酒武僧僵尸可不用担心这个。

ZOMBIE_KONGFU_MONK_DRINK_DESCRIPTION_HEA.en: After drinking, enters into savage state.
ZOMBIE_KONGFU_MONK_DRINK_DESCRIPTION_HEA.zh: 喝酒后，能进入狂暴状态。

ZOMBIE_KONGFU_MONK_FLAG_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}He was previously responsible for the temple's flag-raising practice.
ZOMBIE_KONGFU_MONK_FLAG_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}武僧旗帜僵尸每天都会清点堂里的旗帜数量。

ZOMBIE_KONGFU_MONK_FLAG_DESCRIPTION_HEAD.en: Waves the flag, leading a huge wave of zombies to approach.
ZOMBIE_KONGFU_MONK_FLAG_DESCRIPTION_HEAD.zh: 挥舞旗帜，引领一大波僵尸前来。

ZOMBIE_KONGFU_MONK_IMP_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}身轻如燕，这不是夸张的修辞手法。

ZOMBIE_KONGFU_MONK_IMP_DESCRIPTION_HEADE.en: As light as a swallow, masters skills of afloat.
ZOMBIE_KONGFU_MONK_IMP_DESCRIPTION_HEADE.zh: 身轻如燕，身怀轻功绝技。

ZOMBIE_KONGFU_MONK_NUNCHAKU_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}During his lifetime, he admired a martial arts master named Bruce Lee until he hit his head while playing nunchaku.
ZOMBIE_KONGFU_MONK_NUNCHAKU_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}双截棍武僧僵尸非常喜欢向其他僵尸炫耀自己的棍法，直到他耍双截棍的时候敲到了自己的头。

ZOMBIE_KONGFU_MONK_NUNCHAKU_DESCRIPTION_.en: Use the nunchaku to bounce back all projectiles fired from the front and knock away all the plants that dare to stand in front of him.
ZOMBIE_KONGFU_MONK_NUNCHAKU_DESCRIPTION_.zh: 使用双截棍弹回一切正面平射的子弹，击飞所有敢于阻挡在他面前的植物。

ZOMBIE_KONGFU_MONK_TORCH_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}Torch burns plant on contact
{KEYWORD}Weakness: {STAT}Freezing attack extinguishes the torch

{FLAVOR}The burning flame limited how quickly he could turn the torch.
ZOMBIE_KONGFU_MONK_TORCH_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}火炬伤害接触的植物
{KEYWORD}弱点：{STAT}冷冻攻击熄灭火炬

{FLAVOR}燃烧的火焰限制了他转动火把的速度。

ZOMBIE_KONGFU_MONK_TORCH_DESCRIPTION_HEA.en: Handheld torch can continuously burn plants.
ZOMBIE_KONGFU_MONK_TORCH_DESCRIPTION_HEA.zh: 手持可以不断烧毁植物的火把。

ZOMBIE_KONGFU_QIGONG_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Qigong Zombie is the true kongfu Zombie, he didn't forget his own martial arts after becoming a zombie, perhaps because he had learned too many martial arts and unable to forget them?
ZOMBIE_KONGFU_QIGONG_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}气功僵尸是真正的功夫僵尸，听说他是某位气功高人的关门弟子。比起蛮力，气功僵尸更喜欢用内力来解决问题。

ZOMBIE_KONGFU_QIGONG_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 能发动气功，吸收前方一横排的植物。

ZOMBIE_KONGFU_SELFEXPLODE_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Exploding Zombie doesn't know any Kong Fu, so he had lived in Kongfu World thinking he was inferior, until he found his talent with explosives and quickly gained status among zombies.
ZOMBIE_KONGFU_SELFEXPLODE_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}自爆僵尸不会功夫，所以他一直很自卑地待在功夫世界，直到他发现了自己的火药天分后，地位骤升。

ZOMBIE_KONGFU_SELFEXPLODE_DESCRIPTION_HE.en: After coming into contact with a plant, the bomb will be detonated, dealing massive damage to plants in a large area
ZOMBIE_KONGFU_SELFEXPLODE_DESCRIPTION_HE.zh: 碰到植物后，能引爆手里的炸弹，对大范围植物造成致命伤害。

ZOMBIE_KONGFU_TORCH_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}torch destroys plants on contact
{KEYWORD}Weakness: {STAT}cold attacks extinguish torch

{FLAVOR}To tell the truth, Torch Kongfu Zombie is an ancestor of Explorer Zombie in Egypt.
ZOMBIE_KONGFU_TORCH_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}火炬伤害接触的植物
{KEYWORD}弱点：{STAT}冷冻攻击熄灭火炬

{FLAVOR}说实话，功夫火把僵尸是埃及探险家僵尸的鼻祖。

ZOMBIE_KONGFU_TORCH_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Carries a torch that can instantly destroy your plants.
ZOMBIE_KONGFU_TORCH_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 手持可以不断烧毁植物的火把。

ZOMBIE_KONGFU_ZOMBOSS_BLADE_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Slash through the Sky from the Flying Fairy, it was the signature skill of the Blade-Wielding Hero, though it's now a flying zombie.
ZOMBIE_KONGFU_ZOMBOSS_BLADE_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}一刀东来，天外飞仙。这是持刀大侠的成名绝技，但他自己更愿意称之为“天外飞僵”。

ZOMBIE_KONGFU_ZOMBOSS_BLADE_DESCRIPTION_.en: Summons Kongfu Zombies, good at using swords and shields.
ZOMBIE_KONGFU_ZOMBOSS_BLADE_DESCRIPTION_.zh: 召唤功夫僵尸，善于使用刀和盾。

ZOMBIE_KONGFU_ZOMBOSS_QIGONG_DESCRIPTION.en: The Qigong Master is known as the most prestigious grandmaster in the Kong Fu World, and his internal energy has conquered countless zombies. However, even such a powerful being sometimes has trouble paying his rent.
ZOMBIE_KONGFU_ZOMBOSS_QIGONG_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}气功教主被称为功夫世界最有威望的宗师，他的一身内力令无数僵尸折服。不过这样的强大存在，有时候也会因为房租而苦恼。

ZOMBIE_KONGFU_ZOMBOSS_QIGONG_DESCRIPTION.en: A master of inner strength, extremely dangerous.
ZOMBIE_KONGFU_ZOMBOSS_QIGONG_DESCRIPTION.zh: 内力的集大成者，极度危险。

ZOMBIE_LOSTCITY_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION.en: No one ever presumes that he’s Dr. Unlivingstone. Just once, though, he wishes that someone would.
ZOMBIE_LOSTCITY_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION.zh: 从来没有人设想过他是死利文斯通博士。他多希望有人会这样想啊，哪怕只有一次。

ZOMBIE_LOSTCITY_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION_HEADE.en: His expedition cone makes him twice as tough as normal adventurers.
ZOMBIE_LOSTCITY_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION_HEADE.zh: 他用来考察的路障使他的防御力比普通冒险僵尸高一倍。

ZOMBIE_LOSTCITY_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION.en: Buckethead Adventurer’s greatest discovery was that one morning, without warning or reason, there was a bucket on his head.
ZOMBIE_LOSTCITY_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION.zh: 铁桶冒险僵尸最大的发现是，一顶铁桶于某日清晨毫无征兆地出现在了他的头顶处。

ZOMBIE_LOSTCITY_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION_HEADE.en: His rugged bucket provides considerable protection from damage.
ZOMBIE_LOSTCITY_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION_HEADE.zh: 他那结实的铁桶提供了使他免于受伤的可靠保护。

ZOMBIE_LOSTCITY_BUG_DESCRIPTION.en: Bug Zombie and Bug make a great team, partly because Bug gives Bug Zombie great mobility, but mostly because they share an intense disinterest in horses.
ZOMBIE_LOSTCITY_BUG_DESCRIPTION.zh: 昆虫僵尸和他们的昆虫是一组很棒的团队。一方面昆虫能给予昆虫僵尸很快的速度，但更多的原因是昆虫僵尸答应以后带它们去看它们感兴趣的马。

ZOMBIE_LOSTCITY_BUG_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Bug carries zombie in over ground defenses and lifts him over barriers.
ZOMBIE_LOSTCITY_BUG_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 昆虫可以带僵尸越过你的防线和较矮的屏障。

ZOMBIE_LOSTCITY_CRYSTALSKULL_DESCRIPTION.en: Unlike the more famous crystal skulls, turquoise skulls are totally non-mysterious and common as dirt.
ZOMBIE_LOSTCITY_CRYSTALSKULL_DESCRIPTION.zh: 与更著名的水晶头骨不同，绿松石头骨完全不神秘，而且就和泥土一样常见。

ZOMBIE_LOSTCITY_CRYSTALSKULL_DESCRIPTION.en: Uses skull to steal sun, then unleashes energy in a destructive beam.
ZOMBIE_LOSTCITY_CRYSTALSKULL_DESCRIPTION.zh: 使用手中的头骨窃取阳光，然后释放带有破坏性的能量光束。

ZOMBIE_LOSTCITY_DESCRIPTION.en: Adventurer Zombie just went looking for a jolly good show, and somehow ended up in the Lost City. "Hmm. Yes. Quite." is all that he would say on the matter.
ZOMBIE_LOSTCITY_DESCRIPTION.zh: 冒险家僵尸试图寻找一个令僵愉快的好节目，并以某种方式离开失落之城。“嗯，没错。差不多。“他的节目表演完了。

ZOMBIE_LOSTCITY_DOCTOR_DESCRIPTION.en: As an incompetent doctor who usually throws out hand syringes, Lost Doctor Zombie is respected by everyone on the surface, but he’s always called a "person who buys his licenses with money" behind his back.
ZOMBIE_LOSTCITY_DOCTOR_DESCRIPTION.zh: 作为一名经常不小心甩出手上针筒的不称职医生，失落医生僵尸表面上很受大家尊敬，但是背地里一直被称作是“那个花钱买执照的家伙”。

ZOMBIE_LOSTCITY_DOCTOR_DESCRIPTION_HEADE.en: Throws a syringe that chills and slows a plant and may also chill and slow adjacent plants.
ZOMBIE_LOSTCITY_DOCTOR_DESCRIPTION_HEADE.zh: 扔出针筒，冷缓命中的植物，同时有概率冷缓其相邻的植物。

ZOMBIE_LOSTCITY_EXCAVATOR_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}blocks incoming projectiles, but is vulnerable to lobbed shots

{FLAVOR}Excavator Zombie once heard a song about having a hammer. He liked the idea, but decided it was too mainstream for him – so he got a shovel. Now he’s confident that he’s clearly the coolest zombie, the others are just too jealous to admit it.
ZOMBIE_LOSTCITY_EXCAVATOR_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}攻击：{STAT}阻挡袭来的子弹，但对投掷攻击脆弱

{FLAVOR}发掘者僵尸听过一首关于拿着锤子的歌。他很喜欢这个主意，但是觉得对他来说太主流了，所以他拿了把铲子。现在他很确信自己就是最炫的僵尸，他人只是嫉妒得不想承认。

ZOMBIE_LOSTCITY_EXCAVATOR_DESCRIPTION_HE.en: Digs up plants and throws them behind him.
ZOMBIE_LOSTCITY_EXCAVATOR_DESCRIPTION_HE.zh: 挖起植物并朝自己身后抛掷。

ZOMBIE_LOSTCITY_FLAG_DESCRIPTION.en: Flag Adventurer Zombie is always shouting "Tally ho!" as he leads the charge. At least, he's shouting it in his head.
ZOMBIE_LOSTCITY_FLAG_DESCRIPTION.zh: 旗帜冒险僵尸在带队的时候总喜欢大喊大叫：“呜呼！”呃，至少他是在脑子里面喊的。

ZOMBIE_LOSTCITY_FLAG_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Marks the arrival of an intrepid "wave" of zombies.
ZOMBIE_LOSTCITY_FLAG_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 标示着一群勇敢无畏的僵尸即将来袭。

ZOMBIE_LOSTCITY_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}throws Lost City Imp when damaged

{FLAVOR}Porter Gargantuar dreams of the discovery that will make him powerful and influential. Maybe then the Imps will be the one carrying him around. It's always nice to have dreams.
ZOMBIE_LOSTCITY_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}在受到一定伤害后投掷失落之城小鬼僵尸

{FLAVOR}脚夫巨人僵尸想像着，他的发现会使他强大而举足轻重。到时候就会是小鬼僵尸背着他走来走去了。有梦总是好的。

ZOMBIE_LOSTCITY_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION_H.zh: 令人恐惧却拥有探索精神的庞然大物。

ZOMBIE_LOSTCITY_GUIDE_DESCRIPTION.en: Lost Guide Zombie got this job not because of his intelligence, but because of the map in his hand. So he seriously thanks his father, who went bankrupt because he liked to search for antique objects.
ZOMBIE_LOSTCITY_GUIDE_DESCRIPTION.zh: 失落向导僵尸能获得这份工作不是因为他的智慧，而是他手上的那张地图，所以他无比感谢他那个因为喜欢到处淘古董而破产的老爹。

ZOMBIE_LOSTCITY_GUIDE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Opens a secret door to allow zombies to travel quickly over a distance.
ZOMBIE_LOSTCITY_GUIDE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 打开一个暗门，让僵尸能快速通过一段距离。

ZOMBIE_LOSTCITY_IMPPORTER_DESCRIPTION.en: Imp Porter is stronger than he looks. He’s also more charming, smarter and has a better education.
ZOMBIE_LOSTCITY_IMPPORTER_DESCRIPTION.zh: 脚夫小鬼僵尸可比他看起来聪明得多。他更有魅力，更聪明，还受过更好的教育。

ZOMBIE_LOSTCITY_IMPPORTER_DESCRIPTION_HE.en: Drops pack on Gold Tile; pack becomes tent from which zombies emerge.
ZOMBIE_LOSTCITY_IMPPORTER_DESCRIPTION_HE.zh: 可以把自己的包袱放到黄金地砖上；然后变成帐篷，僵尸会从帐篷里出来。

ZOMBIE_LOSTCITY_IMP_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Nepotism got Lost City Imp where he is. He’s Bug Zombie’s second cousin thrice removed, but he parlayed that connection into a sweet gig getting carried around in a little box.
ZOMBIE_LOSTCITY_IMP_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}失落之城小鬼是靠裙带关系才到达现在的位置的。他是昆虫僵尸太爷爷的另一个曾孙，相隔三代。他利用这份关系，获得了一份清闲的工作——被装在小箱子里到处背着走。

ZOMBIE_LOSTCITY_IMP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Gets tossed past most defenses, then explores on foot.
ZOMBIE_LOSTCITY_IMP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 越过你的大部分防御，然后徒步探索。

ZOMBIE_LOSTCITY_JANE_DESCRIPTION.en: Wealthy beyond reason, the Parasol Zombie lived a life of luxury – when what she craved was a life of adventure. She funded the expedition to the Lost City and set out to see its wonders for herself, never forgetting to bring her trusty parasol. "In case it rains," she explained – but it only came out sounding like "Brains."
ZOMBIE_LOSTCITY_JANE_DESCRIPTION.zh: 阳伞僵尸过着奢华的生活——而她渴望的却是冒险生活。她资助了对失落之城的考察，开始亲眼看到失落之城的奇观，而且从来没忘记过带上她值得信赖的阳伞。“万一下雨了呢，”她解释道——然而她说话听起来只会像是“脑子”。

ZOMBIE_LOSTCITY_JANE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Parasol provides protection from lobbed projectiles.
ZOMBIE_LOSTCITY_JANE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 阳伞提供了免受投掷物伤害的保护。

ZOMBIE_LOSTCITY_LOSTPILOT_DESCRIPTION.en: He faked his pilot's license and figured nobody would notice. But they did.
ZOMBIE_LOSTCITY_LOSTPILOT_DESCRIPTION.zh: 他伪造了飞行员执照，以为没人会注意到。但僵尸个个都看得清清楚楚。

ZOMBIE_LOSTCITY_LOSTPILOT_DESCRIPTION_HE.zh: 在你的后部防御中落下。

ZOMBIE_LOSTCITY_PHOTOGRAPHER_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}its camera will take a picture, stunning plants, after taking a certain amount of damage

{FLAVOR}He is a professional photographer. He sends the money he earns, along with the brains, back to his family.
ZOMBIE_LOSTCITY_PHOTOGRAPHER_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}照相机受到一定伤害后会拍照眩晕植物。

{FLAVOR}他是一位专业的摄影师，赚到的钱和脑子都会寄给家里人。

ZOMBIE_LOSTCITY_PHOTOGRAPHER_DESCRIPTION.en: Places a camera, then continues moving towards your brains.
ZOMBIE_LOSTCITY_PHOTOGRAPHER_DESCRIPTION.zh: 放置一台照相机，之后继续向脑子前进。

ZOMBIE_LOSTCITY_RELICHUNTER_DESCRIPTION.en: Relic Hunter has hunted some pretty impressive relics in his day. Idols, antiques, curios... he’s hunted 'em all.
ZOMBIE_LOSTCITY_RELICHUNTER_DESCRIPTION.zh: 古物搜寻僵尸在他那个时代已经找到了一些令人印象深刻的遗迹。里面有一些古董古玩…他全给拿走了。

ZOMBIE_LOSTCITY_RELICHUNTER_DESCRIPTION_.zh: 会将自己甩到你的后部防御。

ZOMBIE_LOST_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Given the rarity of traffic in the jungle, it’s a mystery how Conehead Adventurer managed to acquire his headgear. Maybe he ordered it online?
ZOMBIE_LOST_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}考虑到丛林中交通困难，路障冒险僵尸怎么获得他的帽子还是个谜。也许是网上订的？

ZOMBIE_LOST_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: His makeshift cone gives him twice the toughness of a normal explorer zombie.
ZOMBIE_LOST_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 他的临时路障使他的防御力比普通探险家僵尸高一倍。

ZOMBIE_LOST_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Armed with his sturdy kettle and even sturdier moustache, Kettlehead Adventurer is ready to ruin your day and possibly make a stew.
ZOMBIE_LOST_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}他装备着更结实的水壶和胡子，水壶冒险僵尸准备毁掉你的一天并做一碗炖菜。

ZOMBIE_LOST_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: His kettle-bucket gives him great resistance to damage.
ZOMBIE_LOST_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 他的铁质水壶给予他对于伤害的强大抵抗力。

ZOMBIE_LOST_BUGZOMBIE_DESCRIPTION.en: Bug Zombie and Bug make a great team, partly because Bug gives Bug Zombie great mobility, but mostly because they share an intense disinterest in horses.
ZOMBIE_LOST_BUGZOMBIE_DESCRIPTION.zh: 昆虫僵尸和他们的昆虫组成了很棒的团队，昆虫能给予昆虫僵尸很快的速度，但更多的原因是昆虫僵尸答应以后带他们去看他们感兴趣的马。

ZOMBIE_LOST_BUGZOMBIE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Bug carries zombie in over ground defenses and lifts him over barriers.
ZOMBIE_LOST_BUGZOMBIE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 昆虫可以带僵尸越过你的放线和矮的障碍。

ZOMBIE_LOST_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Adventurer Zombie was certain he was the first to rediscover the Lost City. He was less certain after he ran into another 50 Adventurer Zombies at the gift shop.
ZOMBIE_LOST_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}冒险僵尸一直坚信他是第一个发现失落之城的僵尸。直到他在礼品店看到其他 50 个冒险僵尸。

ZOMBIE_LOST_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}throws Lost City Imp when damaged

{FLAVOR}Porter Gargantuar actually provided the bulk of the funding for the expedition. And most of the bulk all around, come to think of it.
ZOMBIE_LOST_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}在受到一定伤害后扔出失落之城小鬼僵尸

{FLAVOR}实际上，脚夫巨人僵尸为这次探险提供的大部分资金。想想看，周围大部分都是这样。

ZOMBIE_LOST_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION_HEADE.zh: 令人恐惧却拥有探索精神的庞然大物。

ZOMBIE_LOST_IMP_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Nepotism got Lost City Imp where he is. He’s Bug Zombie’s second cousin thrice removed, but he parlayed that connection into a sweet gig getting carried around in a little box.
ZOMBIE_LOST_IMP_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}失落之城小鬼是靠裙带关系才到达现在的位置的。他是昆虫僵尸太爷爷的另一个曾孙，相隔三代。他利用这份关系，获得了一份清闲的工作——被装在小箱子里到处背着走。

ZOMBIE_LOST_IMP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Gets tossed past most defenses, then explores on foot.
ZOMBIE_LOST_IMP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 越过你的大部分防御，然后徒步探索。

ZOMBIE_LOST_JANE_DESCRIPTION.en: Parasol Zombie desperately wants to get to the opera before the curtain rises. She’s not going to make it, though, because it’s thousands of miles away on another continent.
ZOMBIE_LOST_JANE_DESCRIPTION.zh: 阳伞僵尸拼命想赶在大幕升起之前赶到歌剧院，但她不可能做到的，因为歌剧院在千里之外、另一块大陆上。

ZOMBIE_LOST_JANE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Parasol provides protection from lobbed projectiles.
ZOMBIE_LOST_JANE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 阳伞提供了免受投掷物伤害的保护。

ZOMBIE_MAUSOLEUM_ARCHER_DESCRIPTION.en: Archer Zombie is a pacifist, deliberately shooting his arrows into empty spaces every time. It seems he doesn't know he has a severe squint.
ZOMBIE_MAUSOLEUM_ARCHER_DESCRIPTION.zh: 弓箭手僵尸是个和平主义者，射箭时每次都故意把箭射向空地。看来他不知道他有严重的斜视。

ZOMBIE_MAUSOLEUM_ARCHER_DESCRIPTION_HEAD.en: Upon appearing, he aims and fires arrows at the nearest plant in his lane.
ZOMBIE_MAUSOLEUM_ARCHER_DESCRIPTION_HEAD.zh: 出场后瞄准它所在行最近的植物发射弓箭攻击。

ZOMBIE_MAUSOLEUM_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION.en: Putting a bowl on the ground as a road sign, then moving it to the top of his head—that's just incredibly cool.
ZOMBIE_MAUSOLEUM_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION.zh: 碗放在地上当路标，然后转移到头顶上，这简直酷毙了。

ZOMBIE_MAUSOLEUM_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION_HEAD.en: The bowl on his head provides a certain amount of protection.
ZOMBIE_MAUSOLEUM_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION_HEAD.zh: 头上的碗为其提供一定防御力。

ZOMBIE_MAUSOLEUM_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION.en: Helmethead Sergeant Zombies often use this thing to hold water, probably because they have water on the brain.
ZOMBIE_MAUSOLEUM_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION.zh: 小兵铁盔僵尸经常用这个东西装水，可能是因为他们脑子进水了。

ZOMBIE_MAUSOLEUM_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION_HEAD.en: The iron helmet on his head provides excellent protection.
ZOMBIE_MAUSOLEUM_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION_HEAD.zh: 头上的铁盔为其提供更多防御力。

ZOMBIE_MAUSOLEUM_ASSASSIN_DESCRIPTION.en: By the time you read the last word of this sentence, the "dagger will be revealed."
ZOMBIE_MAUSOLEUM_ASSASSIN_DESCRIPTION.zh: 当你看到这段话的最后一个字的时候，就要"图穷匕见"了。

ZOMBIE_MAUSOLEUM_ASSASSIN_DESCRIPTION_HE.en: Reveals the dagger and teleports to the first column on the left.
ZOMBIE_MAUSOLEUM_ASSASSIN_DESCRIPTION_HE.zh: 图穷匕见，瞬移到左侧第一列。

ZOMBIE_MAUSOLEUM_CAVALRY_DESCRIPTION.en: He started out as a humble foot sergeant. This "horse" was the ultimate culmination and reward of all his bitter struggles and hardships, worn like a badge of honor by a battle-scarred warrior.
ZOMBIE_MAUSOLEUM_CAVALRY_DESCRIPTION.zh: 他原本是个小兵，这只"马"是他的一切挣扎与困苦的总结果与报酬，像身经百战的武士的一颗徽章。

ZOMBIE_MAUSOLEUM_CAVALRY_DESCRIPTION_HEA.en: Can bounce forward along the tunnels.

ZOMBIE_MAUSOLEUM_DESCRIPTION.en: Sergeant Zombie is optimistic about the latest archaeological discovery—that corvée labor only requires serving 12 years. This is because it is already very close to the correct answer: serving 2,000 years.
ZOMBIE_MAUSOLEUM_DESCRIPTION.zh: 小兵僵尸对考古界的最新发现 —— 徭役只需要服 12 年持乐观态度。因为这离正确答案 —— 服刑 2000 年已经十分接近了。

ZOMBIE_MAUSOLEUM_DRUNK_DESCRIPTION.en: The zombie is drunk... hic... really? I'm not drunk... if I am drunk... I really... can't take it!
ZOMBIE_MAUSOLEUM_DRUNK_DESCRIPTION.zh: 僵尸开打了...嗝...真的假的...我没醉...再说我醉我真的...受不了咧！

ZOMBIE_MAUSOLEUM_DRUNK_DESCRIPTION_HEADE.en: Moves after drinking, and sprays alcohol to stun plants.
ZOMBIE_MAUSOLEUM_DRUNK_DESCRIPTION_HEADE.zh: 移动后喝酒换行，并喷酒使植物眩晕

ZOMBIE_MAUSOLEUM_FLAG_DESCRIPTION.en: Cutting wood for weapons, raising poles for flags, charging towards... brains.
ZOMBIE_MAUSOLEUM_FLAG_DESCRIPTION.zh: 斩木为兵，揭竿为旗，奔向......大脑。

ZOMBIE_MAUSOLEUM_FLAG_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Marks the arrival of a monumental "wave" of zombies.
ZOMBIE_MAUSOLEUM_FLAG_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 引领着一大“波”地宫僵尸的到来。

ZOMBIE_MAUSOLEUM_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION.en: As a great hero in sweeping away the six states, he was deeply loved by the Emperor and was put on the terracotta order list early on.
ZOMBIE_MAUSOLEUM_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION.zh: 作为扫清六合的大功臣，深受皇帝的喜爱，早早被列进了订单里。

ZOMBIE_MAUSOLEUM_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION_.en: With strength to uproot mountains and spirit to overshadow the world.

ZOMBIE_MAUSOLEUM_IMP_DESCRIPTION.en: Colonel Imp's rank is very small, but his contribution to the aesthetics of the Underground Palace is certainly not small.
ZOMBIE_MAUSOLEUM_IMP_DESCRIPTION.zh: 校尉小鬼僵尸的官儿很小，但他对地宫美学的贡献可一点儿也不小。

ZOMBIE_MAUSOLEUM_IMP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: They are typically thrown past your defenses, and then waddle forward.
ZOMBIE_MAUSOLEUM_IMP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 他们通常会被抛过你的防线，而后摇摆前进。

ZOMBIE_MAUSOLEUM_PIGGY_DESCRIPTION_HEADE.en: Smashes through your defenses at high speed.

ZOMBIE_MAUSOLEUM_SHIELD_SEGMENT_DESCRIPT.en: Legend has it that the most powerful Qin shields could deflect crossbow bolts. It was later discovered that this was because the enemy's arrowheads were made of cabbage leaves.
ZOMBIE_MAUSOLEUM_SHIELD_SEGMENT_DESCRIPT.zh: 传说最厉害的秦盾能反弹弩箭，后来发现是因为敌军的箭头都是菜叶子做的。

ZOMBIE_MAUSOLEUM_SHIELD_SEGMENT_DESCRIPT.en: Marches in formation holding a shield.

ZOMBIE_MAUSOLEUM_TAOIST_DESCRIPTION.en: Fangshi Zombie really loves terracotta figures, he has been in the pit as a fan for over 2000 years.
ZOMBIE_MAUSOLEUM_TAOIST_DESCRIPTION.zh: 方士僵尸很喜欢陶俑，已经入坑 2000 多年了。

ZOMBIE_MAUSOLEUM_TAOIST_DESCRIPTION_HEAD.en: Can resurrect Terracotta Generals or transform regular zombies into Terracotta Warriors.
ZOMBIE_MAUSOLEUM_TAOIST_DESCRIPTION_HEAD.zh: 可以复活秦俑将军或是将常规僵尸转化为秦俑。

ZOMBIE_MAUSOLEUM_TOKEN_DESCRIPTION.en: Formation Zombie always boasts that his formation is an ancient secret passed down through generations—until a little zombie catches him secretly flipping through a children's comic of "The Thirty-Six Stratagems" late at night. Oh, and the character "阵" on his hat was written by himself with a brush, and after being rained on three times, most of it has faded.
ZOMBIE_MAUSOLEUM_TOKEN_DESCRIPTION.zh: 布阵僵尸总拍胸脯说自己的阵法是上古不传之秘——直到有小僵尸撞见他熬夜偷偷翻小朋友的《三十六计》漫画。哦对了，他帽子上的“阵”字是自己用毛笔写的，淋了三次雨就掉色大半了。

ZOMBIE_MAUSOLEUM_TOKEN_DESCRIPTION_HEADE.en: Throws formation eyes to create a formation.

ZOMBIE_MAUSOLEUM_VENDOR_DESCRIPTION.en: Hawker Zombie deliberately drops his merchandise simply because he is extremely hungry right now, he is adopting a hunger marketing strategy.
ZOMBIE_MAUSOLEUM_VENDOR_DESCRIPTION.zh: 小贩僵尸故意将自己的商品丢掉只是因为他现在非常饥饿，他正在采取饥饿营销的策略。

ZOMBIE_MAUSOLEUM_VENDOR_DESCRIPTION_HEAD.en: Can walk along the tunnels, dropping 1 Zombie Pig from his cart at regular intervals.
ZOMBIE_MAUSOLEUM_VENDOR_DESCRIPTION_HEAD.zh: 可沿着坑道行走，每隔一段时间从推车上掉下 1 只僵尸小猪。

ZOMBIE_MECH_CONE_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Zombie engineers considered the orange cone the height of zombie protective technology. It wasn't until they perfected the design for the Robo-Cone that someone remembered the bucket.
ZOMBIE_MECH_CONE_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}僵尸工程师认为橙色的路障是僵尸防护技术的最高点。直到他们完成了机器路障的设计，他们才想起来还有铁桶这个东西。

ZOMBIE_MECH_CONE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: The armor-plated cone offers phenomenal protection for its pilot.
ZOMBIE_MECH_CONE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 装甲锥为它的驾驶员提供了不错的保护。

ZOMBIE_MIRROR_QUEEN_DESCRIPTION.en: Mirror Queen Zombie can command cavalry zombies, throw poison apples at plants, and summon a magic mirror to mirror the zombies.
ZOMBIE_MIRROR_QUEEN_DESCRIPTION.zh: 魔镜皇后僵尸能指挥骑兵僵尸，向植物投掷毒苹果，还能召唤魔镜来镜像复制僵尸。

ZOMBIE_MIRROR_QUEEN_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: "Who is the most beautiful zombie in the world?" The queen mastered witchcraft herself, and with the help of the magic mirror, not to mention her beauty, at least her strength was enough.
ZOMBIE_MIRROR_QUEEN_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: “谁是世界上最漂亮的僵尸？”皇后自身掌握巫术，再加上魔镜的辅佐，不提美貌，至少实力已经足够。

ZOMBIE_MIRROR_QUEEN_PHASE1_DESCRIPTION.en: Don't ask me why, Shuttle logic
ZOMBIE_MIRROR_QUEEN_PHASE1_DESCRIPTION.zh: 魔镜皇后僵尸能指挥骑兵僵尸，向植物投掷毒苹果，还能召唤魔镜来镜像复制僵尸。

ZOMBIE_MIRROR_QUEEN_PHASE1_DESCRIPTION_H.zh: “谁是世界上最漂亮的僵尸？”皇后自身掌握巫术，再加上魔镜的辅佐，不提美貌，至少实力已经足够。

ZOMBIE_MODERN_ALLSTAR_DESCRIPTION.en: All-Star Zombie is a third-round draft pick and shows a lot of promise, but come on, his salary demands are beyond ridiculous. Ten million brains per year? For FIFTY YEARS?
ZOMBIE_MODERN_ALLSTAR_DESCRIPTION.zh: 全明星僵尸是第三轮僵尸选秀中的热门人选，并有很大的潜力胜出。但是他的期望薪资实在是太离谱了。每年一百万个脑子？还要持续 50 年？

ZOMBIE_MODERN_ALLSTAR_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: A heavy-duty zombie who charges your defensive line.
ZOMBIE_MODERN_ALLSTAR_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 一只可以冲破你防线的健硕僵尸。

ZOMBIE_MODERN_BALLOON_DESCRIPTION.en: Balloon zombie has no idea where the balloon came from, but he's going with it and he's open to seeing where it takes him.
ZOMBIE_MODERN_BALLOON_DESCRIPTION.zh: 气球僵尸不知道气球是哪里来的，不过他会跟着那气球。他很乐意看看气球会把他带到哪里。

ZOMBIE_MODERN_BALLOON_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Balloon carries zombies over barriers and ground defenses.
ZOMBIE_MODERN_BALLOON_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 气球可以带僵尸飞过你的防线。

ZOMBIE_MODERN_BOBSLED_CREW_CREWDESCRIPTI.en: Bobsled helmets can absorb a certain amount of damage
ZOMBIE_MODERN_BOBSLED_CREW_CREWDESCRIPTI.zh: 雪橇头盔可为其抵挡一定的伤害

ZOMBIE_MODERN_BOBSLED_CREW_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Fun fact: They don't get along very well. They seem to be discussing tactics, but they're actually arguing about who should sit in the front to enjoy the 'priority brain-eating rights'.
ZOMBIE_MODERN_BOBSLED_CREW_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}小知识：其实他们几个人关系并不好。他们看似在商讨战术，但其实在争论谁应该坐在最前面，享受“优先食脑权”。

ZOMBIE_MODERN_BOBSLED_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Look at this brain special forces team! These zombie athletes are 'welded' together by frost, demonstrating the team spirit of 'never abandon a corpse'.
ZOMBIE_MODERN_BOBSLED_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}看看这大脑特攻队！这些僵尸运动员被冰霜“焊”在一起，彰显着“不抛尸、不弃尸”的团队精神

ZOMBIE_MODERN_BOBSLED_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Four in a team, can ride a bobsled on the ice track for fast movement
ZOMBIE_MODERN_BOBSLED_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 四个为一队，可乘坐雪橇车在冰道上快速移动

ZOMBIE_MODERN_DANCER_DESCRIPTION.en: A fella named Tony Baloney knew too much, so he threw out his back on the dance floor. The lesson? Backup Dancers are meant to stay in the background. If you try to stick out too much, the only thing sticking out will be a slipped disc.
ZOMBIE_MODERN_DANCER_DESCRIPTION.zh: 有个叫汤尼.波洛尼的家伙因为知道太多事，在蹦迪中扭伤了腰部。因为伴舞僵尸永远只适合当背景板，不能太突出，否则突出的就是腰部了。

ZOMBIE_MODERN_DANCER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 受迪斯科僵尸召唤出现。

ZOMBIE_MODERN_DISCO_DESCRIPTION.en: Disco is dead, but Disco Zombie is eternal. He evokes a deep nostalgia for a bygone era, yet insists on partying inappropriately all night long on his quest for brains. When your house transforms into a disco hall upon his entry, and your brain sloshes to the funky beat, this artist has finally found what he was looking for.
ZOMBIE_MODERN_DISCO_DESCRIPTION.zh: 迪斯科已死，迪斯科僵尸永恒。迪斯科僵尸会唤起你对逝去之物的敬意，又会不合时宜地在他的食脑之路上彻夜狂欢。当你的屋子在他的踏入下变成了迪斯科舞厅，当你的脑子在舞步节拍中晃满了迪斯科精神，这位艺术家就追求到想要的东西了。

ZOMBIE_MODERN_DISCO_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Summons Backup Dancers to get the party started.
ZOMBIE_MODERN_DISCO_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 让伴舞僵尸与你嗨翻全场。

ZOMBIE_MODERN_DOLPHIN_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Dolphin Rider Zombie was originally a zombie dolphin trainer in the zombie aquarium, until one day his zombie dolphin partner wanted to see the outside world. Dolphin Rider Zombie picked up his partner and took the first step into the outside world adventure!
ZOMBIE_MODERN_DOLPHIN_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}海豚骑士僵尸原本是僵尸水族馆中的一名僵尸海豚训练师，直到有一天他的僵尸海豚搭档说想看看外面的世界。海豚骑士僵尸就抱起他的搭档，迈出了外面世界冒险的第一步！

ZOMBIE_MODERN_DOLPHIN_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Rides a dolphin to move quickly, jumps over the first plant encountered.
ZOMBIE_MODERN_DOLPHIN_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 骑着海豚快速移动，跃过第一颗遇到的植物。

ZOMBIE_MODERN_DUCKY_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION.en: This guy spends every day looking for the person who stacked the roadblock and the swim ring together because when he climbed out of the pool, he got stuck between the roadblock and the swim ring... How unlucky can someone be...
ZOMBIE_MODERN_DUCKY_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION.zh: 这家伙每天都在找那个把路障和游泳圈叠在一起放的家伙，因为他从泳池钻出来的时候同时被路障和游泳圈卡住了...怎么会有这么倒霉的家伙...

ZOMBIE_MODERN_DUCKY_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION_H.en: Moves slower on land than a regular zombie, but faster in water.
ZOMBIE_MODERN_DUCKY_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION_H.zh: 在陆地上移动速度比普通僵尸更慢，但在水中比普通僵尸移动速度更快

ZOMBIE_MODERN_DUCKY_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION.en: This guy always fantasizes about being a knight, so he brought his mount, the "Blazing Yellow Thunder Duck," and his "Invincible Hero Battle Helmet."
ZOMBIE_MODERN_DUCKY_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION.zh: 这家伙总是在幻想自己是一名骑士，所以他找来了他的坐骑“焚天灭地黄色雷霆鸭”和属于他的“宇宙无敌英雄战斗铁头盔”。

ZOMBIE_MODERN_DUCKY_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION_H.en: Moves slower on land than a regular zombie, but faster in water.
ZOMBIE_MODERN_DUCKY_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION_H.zh: 在陆地上移动速度比普通僵尸更慢，但在水中比普通僵尸移动速度更快

ZOMBIE_MODERN_DUCKY_DESCRIPTION.en: Since he accidentally fell into the pool and just happened to dive into a little yellow duck swim ring, he found that he could never be separated from the little yellow duck (in a physical sense).
ZOMBIE_MODERN_DUCKY_DESCRIPTION.zh: 自从他不小心掉进泳池的同时又不小心刚刚好倒栽钻进一个小黄鸭游泳圈之后，他发现他再也无法和小黄鸭分开了（物理意义上的）

ZOMBIE_MODERN_DUCKY_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Moves slower on land than a regular zombie, but faster in water.
ZOMBIE_MODERN_DUCKY_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 在陆地上移动速度比普通僵尸更慢，但在水中比普通僵尸移动速度更快

ZOMBIE_MODERN_LADDER_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}During that glorious time, Ladder Zombie was busy working as a professional window cleaner. Although humans at that time drew their curtains tightly, for zombies, it was indeed necessary to clean the outside glass. Now, he finally has time to pick up his ladder skills again.
ZOMBIE_MODERN_LADDER_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}在那个辉煌的时间，梯子僵尸忙于做专业的窗户清洁工，虽然那个时候的人类都拉紧窗帘，但对于僵尸来说，确实是外侧的玻璃才有必要清理。现在，他终于有时间重拾自己的梯子功夫了。

ZOMBIE_MODERN_LADDER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Defends with a ladder, sets up the ladder to allow zombies to bypass your defenses.
ZOMBIE_MODERN_LADDER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 手持梯子防御，架设梯子使僵尸越过你的防线。

ZOMBIE_MODERN_MINER_DESCRIPTION.en: Digger Zombie spends three days a week getting his excavation permits in order.
ZOMBIE_MODERN_MINER_DESCRIPTION.zh: 矿工僵尸每周都要花三天的时间来等候挖地许可。

ZOMBIE_MODERN_MINER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Can dig past the plants and appear directly in the last row.
ZOMBIE_MODERN_MINER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 可以从最后一排出现直接挖掉植物

ZOMBIE_MODERN_NEWSPAPER_DESCRIPTION.en: You can't really blame him for getting so upset; he was THIS close to finishing the crossword (23 down was "Brains.")
ZOMBIE_MODERN_NEWSPAPER_DESCRIPTION.zh: 因为报纸坏掉而生气真不是他小题大做。他就差那么一点点就可以顺利完成那报纸上的填字游戏了（第 23 行从上往下应该填 “BRAINS”）

ZOMBIE_MODERN_NEWSPAPER_DESCRIPTION_HEAD.en: Newspaper protects zombie, who is then enraged when it is destroyed.
ZOMBIE_MODERN_NEWSPAPER_DESCRIPTION_HEAD.zh: 报纸可以保护他，而如果报纸被打坏，他就会生气

ZOMBIE_MODERN_POGOSTICK_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Boing! Boing! Boing! That's the powerful and effective sound made by the Pogo Zombie.
ZOMBIE_MODERN_POGOSTICK_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}蹦！蹦！蹦！那是蹦蹦僵尸发出的有力且有效的声音。

ZOMBIE_MODERN_POGOSTICK_DESCRIPTION_HEAD.en: Jumps over plants when holding a pogo stick.
ZOMBIE_MODERN_POGOSTICK_DESCRIPTION_HEAD.zh: 拥有蹦蹦杆时不会被植物阻挡，会直接跨过植物

ZOMBIE_MODERN_POGO_DESCRIPTION.en: Sproing! Sproing! Sproing! That's the sound of a powerful and effective zombie doing what he does best.
ZOMBIE_MODERN_POGO_DESCRIPTION.zh: 蹦！蹦！蹦！那是跳跳僵尸发出的有力且有效地声音。

ZOMBIE_MODERN_POGO_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Pogo Zombie hops to bypass your defenses.
ZOMBIE_MODERN_POGO_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 弹跳状态无视除高坚果之外的植物，在死亡或者遇到高坚果会被强制移除跳杆，磁力菇可以吸走他的跳杆；拥有跳杆的跳跳无视土豆雷。

ZOMBIE_MODERN_POLEVAULTER_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Neighborville Daily: Pole Vaulting Zombie, missing for over a decade, has returned! Seeing him nowadays feels like experiencing a wonderful time travel! The only dissatisfaction is with our lovely white fences in the yard, which have lost their function again!
ZOMBIE_MODERN_POLEVAULTER_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}小镇日报：失踪十几年的撑杆僵尸现已回归！现在这个年头看到他就像经历了一场奇妙的时间之旅一样！唯独表示不满的是我们院子里可爱的白色栅栏，他们又失去作用了！

ZOMBIE_MODERN_POLEVAULTER_DESCRIPTION_HE.en: Vaults over the first plant encountered, throws the pole when low on health.
ZOMBIE_MODERN_POLEVAULTER_DESCRIPTION_HE.zh: 跨越遇到的第一颗植物，低生命值时投掷撑杆。

ZOMBIE_MODERN_POLEVAULTING_DESCRIPTION.en: Some zombies take it further, aspiremore, push themselves beyond the normal into greatness. That's Pole VaultingZombie right there. That is so him.
ZOMBIE_MODERN_POLEVAULTING_DESCRIPTION.zh: 一些僵尸渴望走得更远，得到更多，这也促使他们从普通成为非凡，那就是撑杆僵尸。

ZOMBIE_MODERN_POLEVAULTING_DESCRIPTION_H.en: Pole Vaulting Zombie vaults with a pole. But can't get pass Tall-nut
ZOMBIE_MODERN_POLEVAULTING_DESCRIPTION_H.zh: 使用撑杆跳越过前方第一株植物，但会被高坚果阻挡。

ZOMBIE_MODERN_SCREENDOOR_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}During his last visit, the homeowner was not very skilled at defense. After eating the homeowner's brain, he took the screen door from their house.
ZOMBIE_MODERN_SCREENDOOR_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}他上次拜访的那位房主防守并不熟练，吃掉那人的脑子后拿走了他家的纱门。

ZOMBIE_MODERN_SUPERFANIMP_DESCRIPTION.en: Super-Fan Imp has season tickets, subscribes to the team newsletter, and is super pumped about exploding on contact with fans of the opposing team.
ZOMBIE_MODERN_SUPERFANIMP_DESCRIPTION.zh: 超球迷小鬼僵尸每次季票都不会放过，还会订阅球队资讯。而在与敌方球队球员接触时反应会很强烈。

ZOMBIE_MODERN_SUPERFANIMP_DESCRIPTION_HE.en: An all-too-enthusiastic imp who explodes with rah-rah-rah fervor.
ZOMBIE_MODERN_SUPERFANIMP_DESCRIPTION_HE.zh: 一个对球队充满热情的小鬼僵尸。

ZOMBIE_MODERN_ZOMBONI_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Cold soldiers never dies. They just gradually become popular! The album production corpse of 'Space Orcs', with a flowing mullet and the coolest new ride, returns to the scene! He turns your lawn into an ice rink faster than your 'frozen' nerve response speed.
ZOMBIE_MODERN_ZOMBONI_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}老冰不死，甚至逐渐流行！“太空兽人“的专辑制作尸，顶着飘逸鲻鱼头和最酷的新座驾炸场回归！他把你的草坪变成冰场的速度，比你“冻”感神经的反应速度还快

ZOMBIE_MODERN_ZOMBONI_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Crushes plants on the road and leaves an ice path behind.
ZOMBIE_MODERN_ZOMBONI_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 碾压路上的植物，并在身后留下冰道

ZOMBIE_MUMMY_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Conehead Mummy Zombie prefers the circular cone shape over the typical pyramid shape. It's a fashion thing, and Conehead Mummy Zombie always stays ahead of fashion.
ZOMBIE_MUMMY_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}路障木乃伊僵尸更喜欢圆锥形而非金字塔形。这在当时可时尚了，他总是喜欢走在时尚最前线。

ZOMBIE_MUMMY_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: His cobra cone headdress makes him twice as tough as normal mummies.
ZOMBIE_MUMMY_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 他的眼镜蛇路障使他的防御力比普通木乃伊僵尸高一倍。

ZOMBIE_MUMMY_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Buckethead Mummy Zombie graduated Magna Zom Louder from Zombie Academy where he learned to utilize his diaphragm during groaning lessons.
ZOMBIE_MUMMY_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}铁桶木乃伊僵尸毕业于僵尸学院。在那儿他学会了用横膈膜呻吟。

ZOMBIE_MUMMY_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: His sandy bucket greatly protects him from damage.
ZOMBIE_MUMMY_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 他的沙漠铁桶保护他免受外界伤害。

ZOMBIE_MUMMY_ARMOR4_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Pyramid-Head Zombie isn't aware that his pyramid is pyramid-shaped. He's a little slow in that respect.
ZOMBIE_MUMMY_ARMOR4_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}金字塔僵尸的反应有些迟钝，就比如他不知道他的金字塔是金字塔形状的。

ZOMBIE_MUMMY_ARMOR4_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: His pyramid-shaped headgear provides triangular noggin protection.
ZOMBIE_MUMMY_ARMOR4_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 他的金字塔形状头饰提供了如三角形般稳定性的防御。

ZOMBIE_MUMMY_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Is he a mummy? Is he a zombie? It turns out he's a zombie who's rolled himself in toilet paper to protect his fair skin. True fact!
ZOMBIE_MUMMY_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}他是木乃伊还是僵尸？答案是：他是只裹着厕纸的僵尸。他之所以要这样是因为他想保护他那白皙的皮肤。真相果然只有一个！

ZOMBIE_MUMMY_FLAG_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Egyptian Flag Zombie is so far behind he thinks he's in first place. He's clearly living in de-Nile.
ZOMBIE_MUMMY_FLAG_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}埃及旗帜僵尸虽然落后，但是他永远认为自己是第一名。很明显，他住在尼罗河畔。

ZOMBIE_MUMMY_FLAG_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Marks the arrival of a huge sandy "wave" of zombies.
ZOMBIE_MUMMY_FLAG_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 标示着一群僵尸即将随黄沙而来。

ZOMBIE_MUMMY_FLAG_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Sometimes, a regular Flag Mummy Zombie simply isn't enough to inspire the desired amount of terror and disgust. In these instances, upgrading to the Egypt Rally Zombie isn't the sensible choice, it's the only choice.
ZOMBIE_MUMMY_FLAG_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}有时候，普通的旗帜木乃伊僵尸并不足以激起足够的恐惧和厌恶。在这般情况下，把事情推到埃及集结僵尸身上并不算是一个明智的选择，但这也是唯一的选择。

ZOMBIE_MUMMY_FLAG_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION_HE.en: He celebrates with increased vigor and truculence the arrival of a new wave of bandaged baddies.
ZOMBIE_MUMMY_FLAG_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION_HE.zh: 他标志着非常非常多的木乃伊僵尸即将来袭。

ZOMBIE_NEWSPAPER_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Sunday Edition Zombie REALLY loves the comics section, which is why his rage is so all-consuming when it is torn to tatters before he's finished reading it.
ZOMBIE_NEWSPAPER_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}周日版报纸僵尸真的很喜欢里面的漫画部分。怪不得在他还没读完的时候给他打破他会那么生气。

ZOMBIE_NEWSPAPER_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION_HEA.en: The newspaper protects zombie, who becomes enraged when it is destroyed.
ZOMBIE_NEWSPAPER_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION_HEA.zh: 报纸可以保护他，而如果报纸被打坏，他就会生气

ZOMBIE_NUTCRACKER_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}Crushes most nut plants with Nut Chopping action!
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}Will have to recharge after each Nut Chop.
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}Nut Chop can be disabled if the Wind up key is removed or destroyed

{FLAVOR}He was created by Dr. Zomboss to be the nemesis of Wallnut and his kin, but all Nutcracker wanted was to "crack" jokes... too bad he's "nut" so good at it
ZOMBIE_NUTCRACKER_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}攻击：{STAT}可以快速夹碎大多数的坚果类植物！
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}每夹一次都需要时间来恢复。
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}只要拿掉、摧毁掉发条，他就不能再夹坚果了。

{FLAVOR}胡桃夹子僵尸本是僵王博士造出来当作坚果家族的克星的，结果他满脑子想着的却怎么说一口好听的夹子音…然鹅他讲得吼像有一点点“坚难”捏。

ZOMBIE_NUTCRACKER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Nutcracker Zombie can make short work of Nut plants as well as some Wall-like plants.
ZOMBIE_NUTCRACKER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 胡桃夹子僵尸可以快速解决掉坚果类，以及一些其它的防御类植物。

ZOMBIE_PELICAN_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}floats over low plants

{FLAVOR}The Pelican Zombie upgraded from the Seagull Zombie and has no regrets. No egrets, either. Just a pelican.
ZOMBIE_PELICAN_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}掠过低矮植物

{FLAVOR}鹈鹕僵尸是海鸥僵尸的升级版，毕竟乌鹊南飞，虽然没有乌鹊，因为他就是个鹈鹕。

ZOMBIE_PELICAN_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Pelican Zombie crosses water without a plank and flies over low plants.
ZOMBIE_PELICAN_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 鹈鹕僵尸飞越没有甲板的水路，同时掠过低矮植物。

ZOMBIE_PHARAOH_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Speed Details: {STAT}moves like a hungry zombie once free

{FLAVOR}The second cousin once removed of King Rot, he rose to power with his disappearing sarcophagus act, but met his untimely end in an unfortunate goat accident. His tale is told in great detail on the back of his sarcophagus, which no one will ever see.
ZOMBIE_PHARAOH_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}速度细节：{STAT}石棺被打破后会如饥饿的僵尸般行动

{FLAVOR}在罗特国王的第二个堂兄被撤职后，他凭借《消失的石棺法案》取得了权力。但在一次出行中，他不幸被山羊撞下悬崖，早早地结束了自己年轻的生命。他的所有故事都记录在他的石棺后面，但似乎没有任何人能看到。

ZOMBIE_PHARAOH_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: His sarcophagus greatly protects him but slows down a rather fast zombie.
ZOMBIE_PHARAOH_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 他的石棺给予了他超高的防御，却大幅限制了他的速度。

ZOMBIE_PIANO_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}crushes plants with piano
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}causes cowboy zombies to switch lanes

{FLAVOR}Pianist Zombie only knows two songs, and they're both groaners.
ZOMBIE_PIANO_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}攻击：{STAT}用钢琴碾压植物
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}使牛仔僵尸换行

{FLAVOR}钢琴僵尸只会两首歌，而且这两首都是哼哼地呻吟。

ZOMBIE_PIANO_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: His rolling piano crushes plants while his music causes dancing zombies to switch lanes.
ZOMBIE_PIANO_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 他那架前进的钢琴会碾压植物并奏起使僵尸起舞换行的音乐。

ZOMBIE_PIRATE_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Conehead Pirate is a simple zombie. When asked what his favorite dish is, he'd think for a moment, straighten his ascot, and say, "Rrurrarrbrains." Perhaps he could borrow a cup, neighbor?
ZOMBIE_PIRATE_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}路障海盗只是一只平凡的僵尸。当你问他最喜欢的菜是什么时，他会想很长一段时间，然后整理一下他的领带，然后说：“液体脑子。”邻居，他能从你这里借一杯吗？

ZOMBIE_PIRATE_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: His Jolly Roger cone makes him twice as tough as normal pirates.
ZOMBIE_PIRATE_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 他的骨头路障使他的防御力比普通海盗僵尸高一倍。

ZOMBIE_PIRATE_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Buckethead Pirate Zombie is looking for his bucket. Have you seen it? It's where? Up where? Speak up, he can't hear you.
ZOMBIE_PIRATE_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}铁桶海盗僵尸正在寻找他的桶。你看到过他的桶吗？在哪儿？大声点儿，他听不到！

ZOMBIE_PIRATE_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: His sturdy wooden bucket provides excellent protection from damage.
ZOMBIE_PIRATE_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 他结实的木桶可以帮助他很好地抵御伤害。

ZOMBIE_PIRATE_ARMOR4_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Dredged from the deepest of seas, Barrelhead Zombie's barrel is a high-quality cask that fits just a bit too snugly.
ZOMBIE_PIRATE_ARMOR4_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}酒桶僵尸的酒桶是从深海中挖出来的，质量很高，就是有点太贴身了。

ZOMBIE_PIRATE_ARMOR4_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Barrelhead Zombie's keg-like hat provides augmented protection.
ZOMBIE_PIRATE_ARMOR4_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 酒桶僵尸的桶状头饰提供了额外的头部防御。

ZOMBIE_PIRATE_BARREL_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}What could it be? Could it be gold? Or some sort of other kind of treasure?  Who knows!
ZOMBIE_PIRATE_BARREL_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}里面有什么呢？金子？宝藏？谁知道呢！

ZOMBIE_PIRATE_BARREL_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Contains Imp Zombies that launch out when destroyed.
ZOMBIE_PIRATE_BARREL_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 被破坏后会发射小鬼僵尸。

ZOMBIE_PIRATE_CAPTAIN_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}parrot pet steals plants

{FLAVOR}Pirate Captain Zombie isn't actually a captain.  His dry cleaning got mixed up with someone else's, but he thought he looked cool with an eye patch.  Plus, the parrot already knew his name, so he just went with it.
ZOMBIE_PIRATE_CAPTAIN_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}鹦鹉能偷走植物

{FLAVOR}海盗船长僵尸并不是个真正的船长。他干洗的衣帽和别人弄混了，但他觉得戴着眼罩看起来很酷。此外，这个鹦鹉也认识他，所以就跟着他走了。

ZOMBIE_PIRATE_CAPTAIN_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: His parrot can fly away with your plant and then return to him.
ZOMBIE_PIRATE_CAPTAIN_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 他的鹦鹉能在带走你的植物以后再次飞回他身上。

ZOMBIE_PIRATE_CAPTAIN_PARROT_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}can fly to plants in other lanes to carry them away

{FLAVOR}He's a third generation aviation revolutionary. He wants to serve his pirate brethren like his father and his grandmother, Salty Anne, before him.
ZOMBIE_PIRATE_CAPTAIN_PARROT_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}能带走位于其他列的植物

{FLAVOR}他是第三代飞行革命家。他想要服侍他的海盗同胞，就像他的父亲和祖母“咸安妮女王”一样。

ZOMBIE_PIRATE_CAPTAIN_PARROT_DESCRIPTION.en: Quickly flies from the Captain to carry away a plant.
ZOMBIE_PIRATE_CAPTAIN_PARROT_DESCRIPTION.zh: 来自船长僵尸的小鸟儿，每次能偷走一株植物。

ZOMBIE_PIRATE_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Keeping up with the latest pirate trends is always tricky, but remember, he was planking before it was cool.
ZOMBIE_PIRATE_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}跟进最新的海盗潮流总是很棘手，不过记住，他早在“木板趴”变得潮起来之前，就早就开始趴着了。

ZOMBIE_PIRATE_FLAG_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Marks the arrival of a huge salty "wave" of zombies.
ZOMBIE_PIRATE_FLAG_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 标示着一群僵尸即将随着咸潮上溯而来袭。

ZOMBIE_PIRATE_FLAG_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Jolly Roger Zombie and his flag are fused together into a single brain-munching unit. Their teamwork is an inspiration to ghouls everywhere.
ZOMBIE_PIRATE_FLAG_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}海盗旗僵尸和他的旗帜可以完全融合成食脑军团。那旗子可以鼓舞各地的僵尸。

ZOMBIE_PIRATE_FLAG_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION_H.en: Jolly Roger Zombie marks the arrival of lots and lots of zombies.
ZOMBIE_PIRATE_FLAG_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION_H.zh: 海盗旗僵尸标示着非常非常多的僵尸即将来袭。

ZOMBIE_PIRATE_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}crushes plants with shark
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}fires off Pirate Imp when damaged

{FLAVOR}Gargantuar Pirate likes short walks off the plank, moonlit raiding parties, and the smell of cannon fire. A true romantic.
ZOMBIE_PIRATE_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}攻击：{STAT}用鲨鱼砸扁植物
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}在受到一定伤害后扔出海盗小鬼

{FLAVOR}巨人海盗僵尸喜欢在叫甲板上散一小会儿步，喜欢看月光之下的突击队，喜欢闻闻炮火的气味。真是一个浪漫主义者。

ZOMBIE_PIRATE_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION_HEA.en: Enormous zombie who redefines the shark attack.
ZOMBIE_PIRATE_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION_HEA.zh: 这只巨大的僵尸使用鲨鱼进行攻击。

ZOMBIE_PIRATE_IMP_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}He was a bootblack, with a side trade as a pickpocket on the streets of London, but all he stole were oversized footwear. "Time to steal some booty!" was his catchphrase.
ZOMBIE_PIRATE_IMP_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}他是一个擦皮鞋的，兼职伦敦街扒手，但是他偷的都是大号的鞋子。他的口头禅是“是时候偷些战利鞋了！”。

ZOMBIE_PIRATE_IMP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Prefers the compact space of barrels, both cannon and rolling.
ZOMBIE_PIRATE_IMP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 喜欢呆在紧凑的空间内，比如炮管和滚桶。

ZOMBIE_PLANTAGENET_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION.en: His hat on the top of his head isn't to show off his superiority, but it's just stuck on his head and he can't take it off.
ZOMBIE_PLANTAGENET_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION.zh: 他头顶礼帽并不是为了显示高高在上，而只是黏在头上拿不下来了

ZOMBIE_PLANTAGENET_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION_HE.en: His top hat makes him three times stronger than the regular Royal Zombie.
ZOMBIE_PLANTAGENET_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION_HE.zh: 他头上的礼帽使他三倍强于皇室普通僵尸

ZOMBIE_PLANTAGENET_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION.en: The fact is, his crown was stolen from elsewhere. "Grrrr, BRAIN!" He always loves to command the zombies after wearing the crown.
ZOMBIE_PLANTAGENET_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION.zh: 事实上，他头上的皇冠是偷来的。“哇呜啦咳呃脑子！”他戴上皇冠后总是这么爱指使僵尸。

ZOMBIE_PLANTAGENET_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION_HE.en: His crown on the head provides him with great protection.
ZOMBIE_PLANTAGENET_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION_HE.zh: 他头上的皇冠为他提供了极大的保护

ZOMBIE_PLANTAGENET_DESCRIPTION.en: "I am a Royal Zombie!" shouted the ordinary Royal Zombie. Due to the nobility's superiority, he was unwilling to admit his ordinariness.
ZOMBIE_PLANTAGENET_DESCRIPTION.zh: “我叫皇室僵尸！“皇室普通僵尸喊到。由于贵族的高高在上，他并不愿意承认自己的普通。

ZOMBIE_PLANTAGENET_FLAG_DESCRIPTION.en: Royal Flag Zombie holds high the kingdom's flag, leading the zombies to plunder brain.
ZOMBIE_PLANTAGENET_FLAG_DESCRIPTION.zh: 金雀花旗帜僵尸高举着王国的旗帜，引领僵尸们掠夺脑子。

ZOMBIE_PLANTAGENET_FLAG_DESCRIPTION_HEAD.en: Means the arrival of a massive wave of Plantagenet Zombies.
ZOMBIE_PLANTAGENET_FLAG_DESCRIPTION_HEAD.zh: 标志着一大波金雀花王朝僵尸的登场。

ZOMBIE_PLANTAGENET_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTIO.en:
{KEYWORD}Attack method:{STAT} Smashes plants to death with his huge ladle.
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}Throws out Imp Maid Zombie when injured.

{FLAVOR}The food made by the Royal Chef Gargantuar is quite delicious, but he always feels that he hasn't made enough to fill his teeth. His baking tray is always covered with oil and plant residue, so he is often criticized for not meeting hygiene standards.
ZOMBIE_PLANTAGENET_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTIO.zh:
{KEYWORD}攻击方式：{STAT}用面包砸死植物
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}受伤时扔出女仆小鬼僵尸

{FLAVOR}御厨巨人僵尸做出的面包相当美味，就是做的量太大，但他总觉着少得不够塞牙缝。他的烤盘上总是有油和植物残留的汁水，因此经常被批卫生条件不达标。

ZOMBIE_PLANTAGENET_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTIO.en: The royal chef of the Plantagenet, is a big guy.
ZOMBIE_PLANTAGENET_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTIO.zh: 金雀花王朝的御用厨师，是个大家伙

ZOMBIE_PLANTAGENET_IMP_DESCRIPTION.en: Imp Maid Zombies are dressed very elegantly, and they serve you anytime. However, you should be careful of the poisonous apples on their trays.
ZOMBIE_PLANTAGENET_IMP_DESCRIPTION.zh: 女仆小鬼僵尸的衣着十分讲究，她要为你服务，但你要小心她托盘上的毒苹果。

ZOMBIE_PLANTAGENET_IMP_DESCRIPTION_HEADE.en: Imp Maid Zombie will be thrown onto the carpet, bypassing most defenses, and then walk politely forward.
ZOMBIE_PLANTAGENET_IMP_DESCRIPTION_HEADE.zh: 女仆小鬼僵尸会被被扔到地毯上，跨过大多防御，然后礼貌地向前走。

ZOMBIE_PLANTAGENET_NOBLEWOMAN_DESCRIPTIO.en:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}Damage plants on the lane

{FLAVOR}You should know that Royal Noblewoman Zombie used to be a living person who loved jewels. She used various items adorned with gemstones, and even her pillows were made of precious stones. Until one day, the noblewoman jumped from a high place into a pile of gemstones...
ZOMBIE_PLANTAGENET_NOBLEWOMAN_DESCRIPTIO.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}伤害整行植物

{FLAVOR}要知道，皇室贵妇僵尸以前还是个活人的时候，最喜欢宝石了，使用的各种物品都是镶嵌宝石的，甚至连枕头都是宝石做的，直到某一天，皇室贵妇从高处跳进了满是宝石的宝石堆里…

ZOMBIE_PLANTAGENET_NOBLEWOMAN_DESCRIPTIO.en: Waving the fan summons a storm that damages plants.
ZOMBIE_PLANTAGENET_NOBLEWOMAN_DESCRIPTIO.zh: 挥舞扇子召唤风暴伤害植物。

ZOMBIE_PLANTAGENET_ODIN_DESCRIPTION.en: The King of the gods who presides over time, prophecy, kingship, wisdom, healing, magic, poetry, war, and death! Odin!!! He's standing right in front of you! Of course, he's not really Odin, he's just an actor who has just moved into the Plantagenet Castle to perform. However, his Eternal Sword will pierce through your plants, win the final victory, and bring the most perfect performance with your tragedy.
ZOMBIE_PLANTAGENET_ODIN_DESCRIPTION.zh: 传说中司掌时间、预言、王权、智慧、治愈、魔法、诗歌、战争和死亡的众神之王！奥丁！！！就站在你面前！！当然，他可不是真的奥丁，他只不过是刚搬进金雀花城堡演出的演员，但是他的永恒之剑会刺穿你的植物，赢取最终的胜利，以你的悲剧带来最完美的表演。

ZOMBIE_PLANTAGENET_ODIN_DESCRIPTION_HEAD.en: Summon a Gungnir to attack the entire lane of plants in front.
ZOMBIE_PLANTAGENET_ODIN_DESCRIPTION_HEAD.zh: 召唤昆古尼尔攻击前方一整行的植物。

ZOMBIE_PLANTAGENET_PRINCESS_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}Provide buffs to random zombies on the field

{FLAVOR}Royal Princess Zombie wakes up every day on a 5,000 square meter bed and spends an hour walking to the bedside. Afterwards, she spends two hours being dressed by 300 male zombie servants with sixteen-pack abs. At this point, the ordinary day of Royal Princess Zombie has just begun... How elegant, so elegant!!!
ZOMBIE_PLANTAGENET_PRINCESS_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}可以给场上随机僵尸提供增益

{FLAVOR}皇室公主僵尸每天都要从5000平米的床上醒过来，花上一个小时走到床边，之后，被300名拥有十六块腹肌的男仆僵尸花上两个小时打扮，此时，皇室公主僵尸平凡的一天才刚刚开始……优雅，太优雅了！！！

ZOMBIE_PLANTAGENET_PRINCESS_DESCRIPTION_.en: Provides buffs to random zombies on the field.
ZOMBIE_PLANTAGENET_PRINCESS_DESCRIPTION_.zh: 给场上随机僵尸提供增益。

ZOMBIE_PLANTAGENET_WINETASTING_DESCRIPTI.en:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}Thrown Wine can kill plants instantly

{FLAVOR}As a high-end sommelier, he has a unique crystal wine glass and exquisite tasting skills, until he drank a glass of poisoned wine.
ZOMBIE_PLANTAGENET_WINETASTING_DESCRIPTI.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}高伤害
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}有的毒酒能秒杀植物

{FLAVOR}作为高端的品酒师，他有着独一无二的水晶酒杯，哈有高超的品尝技术，直到他喝到了一杯毒酒。

ZOMBIE_PLANTAGENET_WINETASTING_DESCRIPTI.en: Throw poisonous wine, some poison wine can instantly kill plants, some can cause high damage.

ZOMBIE_PONCHO_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}randomly wears a protective metal grate

{FLAVOR}The grate is his most prized possession. The poncho is there just to protect it from getting rusty. Also, he's looking for his mechanical horse.
ZOMBIE_PONCHO_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}随机携带金属壁炉

{FLAVOR}他身上的壁炉是他最珍贵的财产。斗篷只是为了让那东西不生锈。同时，他还在寻找自己丢失的机械马。

ZOMBIE_PONCHO_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Sometimes has a hidden armored plate.
ZOMBIE_PONCHO_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 有时候会携带一只铁板。

ZOMBIE_PROSPECTOR_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}Appears on the left side of the lawn after dynamite explodes.

{FLAVOR}"There once was a zombie who got old, spending all his days looking for gold.  'Til one day in the rain, he finally ate brains... and, wait, where's his other shoe?"
ZOMBIE_PROSPECTOR_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}雷管爆炸时可以出现在草坪的另一端

{FLAVOR}“从前有个僵尸，整天都在找金子，一直找到老。终于，他在一个雨天吃到了脑子…等等，他的另一只鞋呢？”

ZOMBIE_PROSPECTOR_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Launches over your defenses when his fuse burns down.
ZOMBIE_PROSPECTOR_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 雷管的引线烧尽时会越过你的防线。

ZOMBIE_RAINCOAT_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}Insta-kills most ground plants with its Kick attack.
{KEYWORD}Armor: {STAT}Negates damage from Filamint family which is insulated by it’s raincoat.
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}Filamint family damage is effective once the raincoat is shredded.

{FLAVOR}When not raiding the lawns, Raincoat Zombie can always be found raiding the clothing stores around the town. Doesn’t matter if it fits, if it's yellow and brand new, it is good enough. Dr. Zomboss has saved loads of money on laundry since Raincoat Zombie never repeats a raincoat it has worn. The only issue is that not all of them fit Raincoat Zombie. “If it's yellow and new, then it doesn't matter and it will do.” said Raincoat Zombie, admiring itself in the mirror.
ZOMBIE_RAINCOAT_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}攻击：{STAT}用脚猛踢，瞬间消灭绝大多数陆生植物。
{KEYWORD}盔甲：{STAT}雨衣绝缘，可以抵抗白炽薄荷家族的伤害。
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}雨衣破损后，白炽薄荷家族即可造成伤害。

{FLAVOR}在入侵草坪以外的休息时间，雨衣僵尸喜欢去入侵小镇里的服装店。无论合不合身，只要颜色是黄色的，成色是全新的，它都能接受。正因如此，雨衣僵尸每次都只穿新衣服，穿过的坚决不碰，给僵王博士省了一大笔洗衣费。而唯一的问题，可能就只有不合身了。看着镜中帅气的自己，雨衣僵尸说：“是大是小，只要颜色对、没穿过就好。”

ZOMBIE_RAINCOAT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Raincoat Zombie kicks off ground plants and resist damage from Filamint family plants.
ZOMBIE_RAINCOAT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 雨衣僵尸可以踢走陆生植物，并且抵抗来自白炽薄荷家族植物的攻击。

ZOMBIE_RA_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}tries to steal sun

{FLAVOR}Ra Zombie isn't actually named after the Sun God Ra, though that's a common mistake. He just likes to say "Ra" a lot.
ZOMBIE_RA_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}试图偷走阳光

{FLAVOR}太阳神僵尸虽然叫“太阳神”，但他和“太阳神·拉”并没有任何关系。他只是经常“拉拉拉”地叫，并且喜欢太阳罢了。

ZOMBIE_RA_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Tries to steal sun, just for safe keeping.

ZOMBIE_RELICHUNTER_VETERAN_BASIC_DESCRIP.en: His legendary tales are spread everywhere. All zombies have heard about his mysteries and legends. However, these are just legends, but you will become a legend if you tell the truth.
ZOMBIE_RELICHUNTER_VETERAN_BASIC_DESCRIP.zh: 他的威名，僵尸无人不晓；他的传说，世间众说纷纭。但传说止于耳闻，而真相，将让你自己成为传奇。

ZOMBIE_RENAI_HAMLET_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}There are a thousand Hamlets in a thousand readers' eyes. Yet, in the eyes of a thousand plants, there is only one Zombie. No matter what form he takes, he can never escape.
ZOMBIE_RENAI_HAMLET_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}一千个读者心目中有一千个哈姆雷特，而一千个植物心目中只有一个僵尸！不管他怎么变，永远逃不掉！

ZOMBIE_RENAI_HAMLET_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Fires bullets forward, dealing massive damage to plants.
ZOMBIE_RENAI_HAMLET_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 向前方发射子弹，对植物造成大量伤害。

ZOMBIE_RENAI_JULIET_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Juliet Zombie came to life upon the stage, governed by no will but her own and driven by her own pursuits. She was a fervent believer in a love that could defy death itself. Some say that to be a female zombie is to be an actress in the truest sense of the word—a sentiment she embraced as the highest possible praise.
ZOMBIE_RENAI_JULIET_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}朱丽叶僵尸在剧场上苏醒了过来，她不被外人的意愿所左右，有自己的追求和目标，也坚信跨越死亡的爱情。有人说女僵尸是真正的演员，这对于朱丽叶僵尸来说是一种夸赞。

ZOMBIE_RENAI_JULIET_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Floats over your defenses with a parasol.
ZOMBIE_RENAI_JULIET_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 用洋伞飞行越过你的防线。

ZOMBIE_RENAI_ROMEO_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Romeo Zombie could never comprehend the scene in the script that required him to collapse in tears before a grand mansion. After all, it represented a world utterly beyond his grasp, and that, for a zombie, was the truest of tragedies.
ZOMBIE_RENAI_ROMEO_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}罗密欧僵尸对剧本里要求在豪华大别墅前痛哭然后倒下的情节十分不解，毕竟这是他永远得不到的，这是对于僵尸来说真正的悲剧。

ZOMBIE_RENAI_ROMEO_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Charges to the space in front of a target plant; can also cross into an adjacent lane to do so.
ZOMBIE_RENAI_ROMEO_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 突击至目标植物前方，也可跨行移动至其相邻行的植物前方。

ZOMBIE_RENAI_SHERLOCK_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Sherlock Zombie was a professional thespian of the courtroom. From the moment he was dragged to the witness stand until the final verdict, his every move was a meticulously crafted performance. Yet, this trial was but a scene in a much grander play, a stage from which no performance, however exquisite, could ever break free.
ZOMBIE_RENAI_SHERLOCK_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}夏洛克僵尸是专业的法庭演员，从他被拖上证言台开始，到最后判决，无不是精心设计的表演。不过这场庭审是一个更加巨大的剧本，再精致的表演也跨不出去。

ZOMBIE_RENAI_SHERLOCK_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Throws a money bag to the first or second column of the lane. The money bag can crush plants and speed up the zombies in the lane.
ZOMBIE_RENAI_SHERLOCK_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 向本行丢出一个钱袋，钱袋可以压扁植物并使该行僵尸加速。

ZOMBIE_ROMAN_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION.en: Was there enough traffic in Ancient Rome to justify cones? Historians differ. It's a real debate.
ZOMBIE_ROMAN_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION.zh: 古罗马时期的交通真的有必要用到路障吗？历史学家莫衷一是。真是场无休止的争论…

ZOMBIE_ROMAN_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: A traffic cone made of marble provides some protection.
ZOMBIE_ROMAN_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 一个由大理石制成的路障为它提供了一些保护。

ZOMBIE_ROMAN_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION.en: They had buckets just like this back in Ancient Rome. Believe it.
ZOMBIE_ROMAN_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION.zh: 他们古罗马时期就已经有这种桶了。可别不信。

ZOMBIE_ROMAN_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: A fancy bucket with a bit of flair distinguishes this zombie.
ZOMBIE_ROMAN_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 一个花哨的桶外加一点艺术天赋，让这只僵尸与众不同。

ZOMBIE_ROMAN_ARMOR3_DESCRIPTION.en: Did you know that in Ancient Rome, a centurion commanded a century? Isn't that wild?
ZOMBIE_ROMAN_ARMOR3_DESCRIPTION.zh: 你知道吗？在古罗马，一位百夫长能指挥百夫。是不是很野？

ZOMBIE_ROMAN_ARMOR3_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: A higher grade of Roman Zombie.
ZOMBIE_ROMAN_ARMOR3_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 一种更高级别的罗马僵尸。

ZOMBIE_ROMAN_ARMOR4_DESCRIPTION.en: Bust Head Zombie belongs in museum with a big sign that says something like, "WARNING: THIS IS A ZOMBIE!"
ZOMBIE_ROMAN_ARMOR4_DESCRIPTION.zh: 半身像僵尸应当被放置在博物馆内，并且有一个大标语，上面写着“警告：这是一只僵尸！”

ZOMBIE_ROMAN_ARMOR4_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: A bust head means this Roman zombie can take a serious beating.
ZOMBIE_ROMAN_ARMOR4_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 头上的半身像意味着这只罗马僵尸很抗打。

ZOMBIE_ROMAN_BALLISTA_DESCRIPTION.en: Surprise! That exploding vase has a zombie in it! Isn’t that surprising?
ZOMBIE_ROMAN_BALLISTA_DESCRIPTION.zh: 惊喜！那会爆炸的花瓶里有只僵尸！是不是很惊喜？

ZOMBIE_ROMAN_BALLISTA_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: A ballista from Ancient Rome, the Zcorpion Zombie launches an exploding vase at the nearest plant in its lane.
ZOMBIE_ROMAN_BALLISTA_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 来自古罗马的投石机，投石机僵尸会向所在行内最近植物发射会爆炸的花瓶。

ZOMBIE_ROMAN_DESCRIPTION.zh: 他并不明白“十一抽杀”是什么意思。

ZOMBIE_ROMAN_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 你的普通罗马军团僵尸。

ZOMBIE_ROMAN_FLAG_DESCRIPTION.en: In Ancient Rome, flags were often used on the battlefield to direct troop movements. Though come on: how much direction do you really need to shuffle leftward?
ZOMBIE_ROMAN_FLAG_DESCRIPTION.zh: 在古罗马，旗帜常用来在战场中指挥军队行动的方向。虽然但是…僵尸反正都是向左走，真的还需要指挥吗？

ZOMBIE_ROMAN_FLAG_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: The flag indicates more zombies are on their way!
ZOMBIE_ROMAN_FLAG_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 这面旗帜预示着更多僵尸即将来袭！

ZOMBIE_ROMAN_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION.en: He's got a column and he's not afraid to use it.
ZOMBIE_ROMAN_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION.zh: 他可不害怕使用他手上的柱子。

ZOMBIE_ROMAN_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION_HEAD.en: Wears a helmet. Throws an imp AND a net. Just a real piece of work.
ZOMBIE_ROMAN_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION_HEAD.zh: 戴着头盔。可以扔出一只小鬼僵尸和一张网。这是他“僵”生的意义。
