ZOMBIE_ROMAN_HEALER_DESCRIPTION.en: Hot tip: take this one out as fast as you can if you don't want your life turned into a pit of abject misery and despair.
ZOMBIE_ROMAN_HEALER_DESCRIPTION.zh: 提示：如果你不想人生落入充满凄惨与绝望的深渊，就尽快干掉这家伙。

ZOMBIE_ROMAN_HEALER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Uses weird Roman magic to heal zombies.
ZOMBIE_ROMAN_HEALER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 使用奇怪的罗马法术来治疗僵尸。

ZOMBIE_ROMAN_IMP_DESCRIPTION.en: Like all Zombie Imps, Roman Imp keeps turning up where you least want him.
ZOMBIE_ROMAN_IMP_DESCRIPTION.zh: 和其它小鬼僵尸不一样，罗马小鬼僵尸总是会出现在你最不希望他出现的时候。

ZOMBIE_ROMAN_IMP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Small. Impy. Wears a former lion.
ZOMBIE_ROMAN_IMP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 是个穿着旧狮皮的小鬼。

ZOMBIE_ROMAN_MEDUSA_DESCRIPTION.en: Hailing originally from Greece but thriving in Rome, Zombie Medusa takes advice from her snakes based on their charisma and shared personal hisssstory.
ZOMBIE_ROMAN_MEDUSA_DESCRIPTION.zh: 美杜莎僵尸推动被变成石头的僵尸并石化面对他的僵尸

ZOMBIE_ROMAN_MEDUSA_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Zombie Medusa pushes petrified zombies in stone blocks as well as stoneifying zombies and zomboids that face her.
ZOMBIE_ROMAN_MEDUSA_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 原是希腊出身但是在罗马茁壮成长的美杜莎僵尸，基于共同的个人经历，从他的小蛇身上获得关于时髦的建议。

ZOMBIE_ROMAN_SHIELD_ALMANAC_DESCRIPTION.en: The shield protects him from bad reviews and hurtful remarks.
ZOMBIE_ROMAN_SHIELD_ALMANAC_DESCRIPTION.zh: 盾牌可以保护他免受负面评论和恶意言论的侵袭。

ZOMBIE_ROMAN_SHIELD_ALMANAC_DESCRIPTION_.en: A dull-witted, unusually shy Roman zombie who's also carrying a shield.
ZOMBIE_ROMAN_SHIELD_ALMANAC_DESCRIPTION_.zh: 一个迟钝的、特别害羞，还拿着盾牌的罗马僵尸。

ZOMBIE_ROMAN_SHIELD_PAIR_DESCRIPTION.en: When three Roman shield zombies are too many, how about two? Two's a good number, right? It's even, it's prime... it's got everything!
ZOMBIE_ROMAN_SHIELD_PAIR_DESCRIPTION.zh: 3个罗马盾牌僵尸太多了，那么 2 个怎么样？2 是个好数字，对吧？它是偶数、质数…它就是一切！

ZOMBIE_ROMAN_SHIELD_PAIR_DESCRIPTION_HEA.en: A pair of Roman shield zombies.

ZOMBIE_ROMAN_SHIELD_TRIAD_DESCRIPTION.en: This number of shield zombies is three higher than zombies can count.
ZOMBIE_ROMAN_SHIELD_TRIAD_DESCRIPTION.zh: 盾牌僵尸小队的数目比僵尸能数到的最大数字还要多 3 个。

ZOMBIE_ROMAN_SHIELD_TRIAD_DESCRIPTION_HE.en: Three Roman shield zombies in a row.
ZOMBIE_ROMAN_SHIELD_TRIAD_DESCRIPTION_HE.zh: 3 个罗马盾牌僵尸成一排

ZOMBIE_SEAGULL_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}passes over low plants like spikeweed and iceberg lettuce

{FLAVOR}Seagull Zombie has racked up the frequent flier miles and dreams of going to the top colleges in the world on a cerebral gastronomy vacation.
ZOMBIE_SEAGULL_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}能越过如地刺和冰冻生菜这类较低的植物

{FLAVOR}海鸥僵尸已经累积了大量的飞行行程，并且他还梦想着去顶尖大学度过一个美妙的美食假期。

ZOMBIE_SEAGULL_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Crosses watery gaps without a plank and flies over low plants.
ZOMBIE_SEAGULL_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 飞越没有甲板的水路，同时掠过低矮植物。

ZOMBIE_SKYCITY_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}In order to meet the strong wind in the air, Conehead Pilot Zombie purchased a new powerful glue. Even though zombies have suggested he should not to be a Conehead in high altitude, but he thought it was his fashion symbol.
ZOMBIE_SKYCITY_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}为了适应空中强劲的风速，路障飞行员僵尸购买了一款新型强效黏合剂。尽管僵尸们都建议他不要将路障带到高空中，但是他自认为那是他时尚形象的象征。

ZOMBIE_SKYCITY_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: His glued roadcone makes him twice as though as normal pilot zombies.
ZOMBIE_SKYCITY_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 他的强力胶黏上的路障使他的防御力比普通飞行员僵尸高一倍。

ZOMBIE_SKYCITY_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Did you hear that? Updraft impinging bucket makes a thud sound. Yes, that's the zombie's favorite music, it always brings fun to boring lives of zombies. That's why Buckethead Pilots are the most zombies in hot pursuits.
ZOMBIE_SKYCITY_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}听见了吗？上升气流撞击铁桶所发出的哐当声，对，那就是僵尸们最喜爱的音乐，它总是可以给僵尸们枯燥无味的生活带来乐趣。这也是铁桶飞行员僵尸最受僵尸们追捧的原因。

ZOMBIE_SKYCITY_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: His Bucket-shaped hat provides great protection from damage.
ZOMBIE_SKYCITY_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 头顶的桶状零件为他提供了超强的防护能力！

ZOMBIE_SKYCITY_BATTLEPLANE_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}In order to become a good Zombie Fighter, during flight school, he studied 97 flight courses, passed 81 different exams, experienced flight simulations 101 times... He and others always mention their superb flying skills, but those that have sat in his plane seem reluctant to mention this subject again.
ZOMBIE_SKYCITY_BATTLEPLANE_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}为了成为一名优秀的战斗机僵尸，在飞行学校学习期间，他总共学习了97门飞行课程、通过了81场考试、经历了101场模拟飞行演练… …他总是滔滔不绝地和别人提起自己高超的飞行技术，不过坐过他的飞机的僵尸似乎都不愿意再次提及这个话题。

ZOMBIE_SKYCITY_BATTLEPLANE_DESCRIPTION_H.en: Uses machine gun to attack plants and the home ship.
ZOMBIE_SKYCITY_BATTLEPLANE_DESCRIPTION_H.zh: 使用战斗机上的机枪攻击植物和飞船。

ZOMBIE_SKYCITY_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Don’t underestimate the Pilot Zombies. Keeping the balance in the air instead of being upside down isn’t an easy thing. Flying gives them a feeling of freedom - but that's when they still had brains.
ZOMBIE_SKYCITY_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}千万不要小看普通飞行员僵尸，在空中保持平衡而不是四脚朝天并不是一件容易的事情。飞翔带给他们自由的感觉，当然，那是在他们还有脑子的时候。

ZOMBIE_SKYCITY_ELECTRIC_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Lightning Gun Zombie has "Frankenstein" as his nickname. He always stays in his lab to invent more powerful lightning guns. But he’s obviously troubled by his messy, silver hair. "Sometimes, you need to sacrifice your image for science." Lightning Gun Zombie doesn't care.
ZOMBIE_SKYCITY_ELECTRIC_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}闪电枪僵尸拥有 “科学怪人”的外号，他每天都待在实验室里尝试研发更强大的闪电枪。不过他显然对于自己满头飞舞的银发而感到十分的苦恼。“有时候，为了科学是需要牺牲一些自己的形象的。”闪电枪僵尸并不在乎这些。

ZOMBIE_SKYCITY_ELECTRIC_DESCRIPTION_HEAD.en: Uses a lightning gun to attack plants with plasma.
ZOMBIE_SKYCITY_ELECTRIC_DESCRIPTION_HEAD.zh: 使用闪电枪发射电荷攻击植物。

ZOMBIE_SKYCITY_FLAG_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}In Flag Pilot Zombie's opinion, if you want to walk in the forefront of fashion, the bright side of the banner is very important. However, zombies are only concerned about his ability to lead them to find fresh brains, what fashion, and can not be used to eat.
ZOMBIE_SKYCITY_FLAG_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}在飞行旗帜僵尸看来，若是想要走在时尚的前沿，一面鲜明的旗帜是非常重要的。然而，僵尸们却只关心他能否带领他们找到新鲜的脑子，时尚什么的，并不能拿来吃啊。

ZOMBIE_SKYCITY_FLAG_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Leads the arrival of a large wave of flying zombies!!
ZOMBIE_SKYCITY_FLAG_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 引领着一大波飞行僵尸的到来！

ZOMBIE_SKYCITY_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Because of his huge size occupying more flight pathways, he was forced to pay 3 times the travel fee. He was very angry at this and said "I just want to become a carefree imp." Then he looked at his empty wallet and said: "But only sometimes."
ZOMBIE_SKYCITY_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}飞行巨人僵尸因为其庞大的体型占用了更多的飞行道而被迫缴纳三倍的通行费，他对此感到非常愤怒。“说真的，我真的只想做一只无忧无虑的小鬼僵尸。”飞行巨人僵尸无奈地看着干瘪的钱包，“不过只是在某些情况下。”

ZOMBIE_SKYCITY_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION_HE.en: He smashes all plants and throws Imps on the ship.
ZOMBIE_SKYCITY_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION_HE.zh: 砸扁一切植物，向飞船上投掷飞行小鬼僵尸。

ZOMBIE_SKYCITY_GGTIMP_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Flying Imp was troubled by the thought of participating in aerial buisness. But when he found his pilot goggles which intrigued him, he no longer wants to remove it. While becoming a pilot just for a pair of goggles seems dumb, you can't not admit that pair of goggles are awesome.
ZOMBIE_SKYCITY_GGTIMP_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}飞行小鬼僵尸曾经为是否要投身飞行事业而苦恼过，然而当他在飞行商店里找到了那副令他神魂颠倒的护目镜时，他就再也不愿意取下它了。为了戴护目镜而成为飞行员听上去非常的愚蠢，不过你不得不承认，那副护目镜真的很赞。

ZOMBIE_SKYCITY_GGTIMP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Imp Zombie who is good at landing operations
ZOMBIE_SKYCITY_GGTIMP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 擅长登陆作战的小鬼僵尸

ZOMBIE_SKYCITY_TWINSPLANE_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Double-Cabin Aircraft Zombie dreams about "world tour" and "conquer the world" adventure. However, but the brothers never reached a consensus on this issue. "I can't communicate with a no-brained guy!" They are always grumpily complaining to each other.
ZOMBIE_SKYCITY_TWINSPLANE_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}双舱飞行僵尸拥有“环球旅行”、“征服世界”的探险梦。然而他们兄弟俩从未在去哪儿探险这个问题上达成一致。“我简直无法同一个没有脑子的家伙沟通！”他们总是这样气鼓鼓地抱怨对方。

ZOMBIE_SKYCITY_TWINSPLANE_DESCRIPTION_HE.en: Contstantly into plants and your ship
ZOMBIE_SKYCITY_TWINSPLANE_DESCRIPTION_HE.zh: 两个机舱全部被击毁后才会坠落

ZOMBIE_SOLARSAGE_BULLY_DESCRIPTION.en: Transformed into a Solarsage Bully by being transcended by Olive Wood, all of his attributes become laid-back due to his enlightenment. Despite he's muscular, he is even weaker than a basic zombie!!!
ZOMBIE_SOLARSAGE_BULLY_DESCRIPTION.zh: 由神灵橄榄木超度而化为开悟壮汉，由于被开度，各属性都变得佛系，别看他这么强壮，他甚至比普通僵尸还要弱小！！！

ZOMBIE_SOLARSAGE_BULLY_DESCRIPTION_HEADE.en: Very-very-weak zombie, attack on plants with being laid-back.

ZOMBIE_SPORTZBALL_GOALIE_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}For Goalie Zombie, the most embarrassing thing is not missing a goal, but realizing that the opponent is a spike. "Isn't this a foul?" he always asks the referee while lying on the ground, catching his breath.
ZOMBIE_SPORTZBALL_GOALIE_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}对于守门员僵尸来说，最尴尬的不是漏球，而是扑救时发现对面是地刺。“这不算犯规吗？”他躺在地上喘气时总会这么问裁判。

ZOMBIE_SPORTZBALL_GOALIE_DESCRIPTION_HEA.en: Wears gloves that can deflect straight shots and dives to an adjacent row.
ZOMBIE_SPORTZBALL_GOALIE_DESCRIPTION_HEA.zh: 手套可反弹平射子弹，每隔一段时间会飞扑至相邻的行。

ZOMBIE_STEAM_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION.en: Conehead Labor Zombie is very happy about the roadcone on his head, he got promoted to a higher status because of that!
ZOMBIE_STEAM_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION.zh: 工人僵尸对自己脑袋上有路障这事情还挺高兴，因为代表自己升职了！

ZOMBIE_STEAM_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: His roadcone makes him 2 times as tough as normal labor zombies.
ZOMBIE_STEAM_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 他的工人路障帽比普通工人强壮2倍

ZOMBIE_STEAM_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION.en: Buckethead Labor Zombie was rewarded with a salary increase a few days ago. He was very happy, so he asked the forger to forge a labeled iron bucket helmet for him. This iron bucket not only resisted a lot of damage for him, but also highlighted his identity!
ZOMBIE_STEAM_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION.zh: 铁桶工人僵尸前几天得到升值加薪，他甚是高兴，于是让锻造工为他锻造一个标识性的铁桶头盔作为给自己的奖励，这铁桶不止为他抵挡了很多伤害，还突出了他的身份！

ZOMBIE_STEAM_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: His forged iron bucket protects him from harm.
ZOMBIE_STEAM_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 这个锻造的铁桶很好保护他不受伤害

ZOMBIE_STEAM_CLOCKWORK_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Weakness: {STAT}Magnet-shroom can steal face plate

{FLAVOR}Made out of only the most refined scrap metal. Programmed to love work and ask no questions. Under no circumstances should the face plate be removed from the model. Two-day delivery - free shipping.
ZOMBIE_STEAM_CLOCKWORK_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}血量: {STAT}560 (面板) + 340 (尸偶)
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.3
{KEYWORD}弱点: {STAT}磁力菇能吸走它的面板。

{FLAVOR}只用最精炼的废金属制造。程序设定为热爱工作，不问任何问题。在任何情况下您都不得将面板从模型上取下。两日送达，还包邮。

ZOMBIE_STEAM_CLOCKWORK_DESCRIPTION_HEADE.en: Mass-produced machines that are about as unlively (and hungry) as their co-workers.
ZOMBIE_STEAM_CLOCKWORK_DESCRIPTION_HEADE.zh: 批量生产的机器，和它们的同事们一样并非活物（而且感到饥饿）。

ZOMBIE_STEAM_COAL_MINER_DESCRIPTION.en: Coal Miner Zombie was pushing the wheelbarrow in and out every day, only for one day to find out that the gold mines can get rich overnight. This situation continued for 365 days and nights.
ZOMBIE_STEAM_COAL_MINER_DESCRIPTION.zh: 每天推着矿车进进出出，只为了有一天能发现金矿可以一夜暴富，这样子工作的情况也就持续了365个日夜。

ZOMBIE_STEAM_COAL_MINER_DESCRIPTION_HEAD.en: Coal Miner Zombies can pour out coal to destroy your plants, they can only pour out coal once.
ZOMBIE_STEAM_COAL_MINER_DESCRIPTION_HEAD.zh: 可以倒出煤矿秒杀植物，一共可以倒1次

ZOMBIE_STEAM_FLAG_DESCRIPTION.en: Flag Labor Zombie is the most convincing of all zombies. All the zombies are amazed that he can work in a well-organized manner and never work overtime. This time, he was awarded the best employee flag to mark his ability!
ZOMBIE_STEAM_FLAG_DESCRIPTION.zh: 旗帜僵尸是除了监工僵尸外最具有信服力的，所有僵尸都对他可以井井有条的工作并且从来不加班感到神奇，这次还被颁发了最佳员工的锦旗标志他的能力！

ZOMBIE_STEAM_FLAG_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Marks the arrival of a huge wave of steam zombies.
ZOMBIE_STEAM_FLAG_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 标志着一大波蒸汽僵尸的到来

ZOMBIE_STEAM_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Attack:{STAT}Use a giant wrench to smash plants
{KEYWORD}Special:{STAT}Throws an Industrial Imp Zombie when it loses 50% hp

{FLAVOR}Foreman Gargantuar is the head of a small factory. He always ensures that the quality of the items produced by the factory will not be wrong. Although he is usually very strict with the workers and has a very bad temper. He usually likes to smoke cigars, but it does not prevent him from being a good person. .
ZOMBIE_STEAM_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}攻击：{STAT}使用巨型扳手，砸扁接触到的植物 
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}当受到伤害会扔出工业小鬼僵尸 

{FLAVOR}监工巨人僵尸是小型工厂的小头头，一直保证工厂所生产的物品质量不会出现差错，虽然平时对工人非常严苛，而且自己脾气也非常暴躁，平时喜欢吸雪茄，但是不妨碍他是个好人。

ZOMBIE_STEAM_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION_HEAD.en: Smashes all plants and throws imps.
ZOMBIE_STEAM_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION_HEAD.zh: 砸扁一切植物，还会投掷小鬼。

ZOMBIE_STEAM_GENTLEMAN_DESCRIPTION.en: "I’m a noble gentleman, so I pay great attention to my manners, every day I have to dress up neatly, with an umbrella." Every day he’s afraid that the rain will mess up his instrument and look like a gentleman.
ZOMBIE_STEAM_GENTLEMAN_DESCRIPTION.zh: 是一名贵族绅士，所以非常注重自己的仪态，每天出门都要打扮的整整齐齐，每天带着雨伞就是怕下雨弄乱他的仪表看上去不绅士。

ZOMBIE_STEAM_GENTLEMAN_DESCRIPTION_HEADE.en: Flies over past defenses and obstacles.
ZOMBIE_STEAM_GENTLEMAN_DESCRIPTION_HEADE.zh: 可以跨越地面的防御与障碍

ZOMBIE_STEAM_IMP_DESCRIPTION.en: Relying on his relationship with Foreman Gargantuar, he was accepted and gained a position in the factory, he plans to work harder and get smarter.
ZOMBIE_STEAM_IMP_DESCRIPTION.zh: 靠着舅舅是监工巨人僵尸关系，被安排到工厂谋求一个职位，但是他平时工作还是比较刻苦的，而且头脑聪明。

ZOMBIE_STEAM_IMP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: After being thrown onto most of your plants, it continues to walk forward.
ZOMBIE_STEAM_IMP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 被抛到你的大多数植物之后，然后步行前进

ZOMBIE_STEAM_MECHANIC_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}stands in place, cranking out Clockwork Zombies from his machine

{FLAVOR}The invention of Clockwork Zombies has spurred nothing but controversy among the many zombie labor unions. Some think they're a threat to the very unlivelyhoods that the workplace is meant to provide for. Others are critical of their sudden appearance. In general, a lot of mystery and paranoia surrounds their existence. But none know what Mechanic Zombie knows. None of them have noticed the plummeting number of fish in the River Thames as of recently...
ZOMBIE_STEAM_MECHANIC_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊: {STAT}站在原地，从他的机器中不断生产发条尸偶。

{FLAVOR}发条尸偶的发明在众多僵尸工会中引发了争议。一些僵尸认为他们威胁到了工作场所所要提供的僵尸劳动力。另一些僵尸则对它们的突然出现持批评态度。总之，他们的存在充满了神秘和偏执。然而，没有僵尸知道机械技尸还知道什么。他们都没有注意到最近泰晤士河中的鱼类数量急剧下降...

ZOMBIE_STEAM_MECHANIC_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Produces steam-powered Clockwork Zombies from his mysterious machine.
ZOMBIE_STEAM_MECHANIC_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 用他的神秘机器生产蒸汽驱动的发条尸偶。

ZOMBIE_STEAM_STOVE_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Weakness: {STAT}Being hit by chill projectiles will lower the temperature

You're better off without him for his heat-fueled agitation day by day, although he does appreicate a cold drink.
ZOMBIE_STEAM_STOVE_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}弱点：{STAT}被冰系植物击中会降低温度

整日都在高温环境下工作，让他的脾气变得非常暴躁，所以尽量不要去招惹他，不过你去送他一杯冰水他会很高兴的。

ZOMBIE_STEAM_STOVE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Warmer temperatures can cause destruction and damage to plants.
ZOMBIE_STEAM_STOVE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 温度升高会对植物造成毁灭伤害

ZOMBIE_STEAM_WORKER_DESCRIPTION.en: Labor Zombie works night and day diligently, just to make money to buy brain biscuits.
ZOMBIE_STEAM_WORKER_DESCRIPTION.zh: 每天起早贪黑，勤勤恳恳，只为了赚钱可以买点“脑子饼干”吃~

ZOMBIE_SWASHBUCKLER_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}lands four tiles into your lawn

{FLAVOR}He swashes. He buckles. But, he also writes home every third Sunday and sends brains and treasure via post. He's a good zombie at heart.
ZOMBIE_SWASHBUCKLER_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}落在你草坪上的第四格

{FLAVOR}他荡，他抢。但每三个周日他都会给家里人写信并寄上脑子和宝藏。他内心是个好僵尸。

ZOMBIE_SWASHBUCKLER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Swings in on a rope to land midway onto your lawn.
ZOMBIE_SWASHBUCKLER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 用吊索降落在你的草坪上。

ZOMBIE_TOMB_RAISER_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}creates tombstones on the lawn

{FLAVOR}He dreams about playing fetch, running for the brains. He loves burying himself in the yard, and is not yet indoor trained. He's still looking for his tail.
ZOMBIE_TOMB_RAISER_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}在草坪上创造坟墓

{FLAVOR}他做梦都在想着玩“你丢我捡”的游戏，甩着舌头追着脑子奔跑。他也喜欢把自己埋在院子里，偶尔还会“汪汪”地叫两声，用后腿给自己挠痒。可惜，他至今也没有找到自己的尾巴在哪儿。

ZOMBIE_TOMB_RAISER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Throws out bones to create tombstones.
ZOMBIE_TOMB_RAISER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 可以扔出骨头创造出坟墓。

ZOMBIE_TOYCAR_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Toy Car Imp replaced Mecha-Football Zombie at a young age and were able to hit plants.
ZOMBIE_TOYCAR_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}玩具车僵尸小小年纪就取代了机甲橄榄，能够撞飞植物。

ZOMBIE_TOYCAR_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 能够和机甲橄榄一样撞飞植物。

ZOMBIE_TOYCAR_HEADER.zh: 能够和机甲橄榄一样撞飞植物。

ZOMBIE_TREASUREYETI_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Speed Details: {STAT}runs away after a short while
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}carries treasure

{FLAVOR}The rare and wondrous Yeti carries his lunch box up and down Mount Brainer to his isolated mountain lodge.
ZOMBIE_TREASUREYETI_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}速度细节：{STAT}在出来不久后就逃跑
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}携带宝藏

{FLAVOR}神秘又神奇的雪人僵尸带着他的午餐盒在脑子山神出鬼没，似乎是想回到他那与世隔绝的山中小屋。

ZOMBIE_TREASUREYETI_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: A rare and curious creature, he always packs a lunch.
ZOMBIE_TREASUREYETI_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 一种稀有而神秘的生物，身上常带着他的午餐盒

ZOMBIE_TUTORIAL_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}After a wild night, Conehead Zombie woke up holding a mysterious receipt for a cone and industrial strength adhesive.
ZOMBIE_TUTORIAL_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}在一个疯狂的夜晚之后，路障僵尸醒来，手里拿着一张神秘的收据，上面写着“一个圆锥形的路障”和“工业用强力黏合剂”。

ZOMBIE_TUTORIAL_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION_HEADE.en: His traffic cone headpiece makes him twice as tough as normal zombies.
ZOMBIE_TUTORIAL_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION_HEADE.zh: 他的路障使他的防御力比普通僵尸高一倍。

ZOMBIE_TUTORIAL_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}There was a time when Buckethead Zombie was hailed as a zombie genius for his innovative bucket-on-head strategy. It's been a few years, though, and zombies wonder if he's got any surprises left. His secret? He doesn't.
ZOMBIE_TUTORIAL_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}曾经有一段时间，铁桶僵尸因其创新的铁桶对头策略而被誉为僵尸天才。不过已经过去好几年了，僵尸想知道他还能有什么惊奇的发现。他有什么秘密？他没有。

ZOMBIE_TUTORIAL_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION_HEADE.en: His bucket hat makes him extremely resistant to damage.
ZOMBIE_TUTORIAL_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION_HEADE.zh: 他的铁桶让他非常耐打。

ZOMBIE_TUTORIAL_ARMOR4_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}After consultation with various storybook wolves, it was determined that straw helmets and wood helmets were not up to snuff, and that brick helmets had to be seriously considered.
ZOMBIE_TUTORIAL_ARMOR4_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}在看完《三只小猪》的故事之后，他认为草帽和木头帽子不靠谱，于是他戴上了砖头。

ZOMBIE_TUTORIAL_ARMOR4_DESCRIPTION_HEADE.en: Brickhead Zombie's brick head provides thorough brickheaded brickheadness.
ZOMBIE_TUTORIAL_ARMOR4_DESCRIPTION_HEADE.zh: 砖头僵尸的砖头提供了真正的砖头一样的防御。

ZOMBIE_TUTORIAL_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Basic Zombie hates the term 'Basic.' He doesn't consider himself some generic foe or common corpse. He's an individual, darn it, and he's going to make a difference even if it kills you.
ZOMBIE_TUTORIAL_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}普通僵尸讨厌 "普通" 这个词，他不认为自己是随处可见的敌人或平凡的僵尸。他认为自己是独一无二的存在，为了弥补这一点，他会有所作为的，即便是杀了你。

ZOMBIE_TUTORIAL_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 花园中随处可见的普通僵尸。

ZOMBIE_TUTORIAL_FLAG_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}A spelling impaired zombie named "Brian," Flag Zombie keeps thinking the rest of the zombies are talking to him. At least he feels important.
ZOMBIE_TUTORIAL_FLAG_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}旗帜僵尸，名叫“Brian”——布莱恩，是一只有书写障碍的僵尸。因为其他僵尸一直在说着脑子的英文单词“Brain”，他就以为所有的僵尸都在叫他的名字，这让他变得很骄傲。

ZOMBIE_TUTORIAL_FLAG_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: His flag marks the arrival of a huge pile or "wave" of zombies.
ZOMBIE_TUTORIAL_FLAG_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 他的旗帜象征着一大波僵尸即将来袭。

ZOMBIE_TUTORIAL_FLAG_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Rally Zombie splurged on the all-leather flag because, heck, he's worth it.
ZOMBIE_TUTORIAL_FLAG_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}集结僵尸挥动着他的纯皮旗帜，他觉得只有纯皮才配得上他。

ZOMBIE_TUTORIAL_FLAG_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION.en: Rally Zombie and his flag marks the arrival of a large clot or "pile" of zombies.
ZOMBIE_TUTORIAL_FLAG_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION.zh: 集结僵尸和他的旗帜象征着超大波僵尸即将来袭。

ZOMBIE_TUTORIAL_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}crushes plants with pole
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}throws Imp when damaged

{FLAVOR}Gargantuar is the embodiment of power, made real. He is a juggernaut of hunger, from which there is no escape. He is fear unleashed. Well, he's fear slightly leashed.
ZOMBIE_TUTORIAL_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}攻击：{STAT}用电线杆砸碎植物
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}在受到一定伤害后扔出小鬼僵尸

{FLAVOR}巨人僵尸是力量的象征。他主宰着饥饿，没有人能从他手下逃脱。他，霸气外露！额，好像还有点侧露…

ZOMBIE_TUTORIAL_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION_H.en: Gargantuar really is kind of a big deal.
ZOMBIE_TUTORIAL_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION_H.zh: 巨人僵尸是个货真价实的大块头。

ZOMBIE_TUTORIAL_IMP_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}What he lacks in reach he more than makes up for with his bad attitude, or zombadittude as he likes to call it. Don't encourage him.
ZOMBIE_TUTORIAL_IMP_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}他有不少的缺点，却永远只会一个一个地去掩盖它们，而不是改正。态度就这么差。说真的，别鼓励他再这么做了。

ZOMBIE_TUTORIAL_IMP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Is hurled onto the lawn past your defenses, then shuffles ahead.
ZOMBIE_TUTORIAL_IMP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 可以被丢到你的防线后排，然后缓缓前进。

ZOMBIE_TUTORIAL_SCREENDOOR_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Special：{STAT}Penetrating attacks can penetrate the screen door in his hand

He got his screen door from the last inexpertly defended home he visited, after he ATE THE HOMEOWNER'S BRAINS.
ZOMBIE_TUTORIAL_SCREENDOOR_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}穿透性攻击可以穿透铁网门。

{FLAVOR}他上次拜访的那位房主防守并不熟练，吃掉那人的脑子后拿走了他家的铁网门。

ZOMBIE_TUTORIAL_SCREENDOOR_DESCRIPTION_H.en: His screen door is an effective shield.
ZOMBIE_TUTORIAL_SCREENDOOR_DESCRIPTION_H.zh: 他的铁网门在防御性和耐用性上都十分不错。

ZOMBIE_TWISTER_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION.en: Those who travel from one generation to the other through cracks in timelines only appear in Your House.
ZOMBIE_TWISTER_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION.zh: 通过时空裂缝从一代穿越到二代的，仅在Your House（你的房子）出现。

ZOMBIE_TWISTER_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Like the PVZ2 Conehead zombies, they still steal brains without long memory.
ZOMBIE_TWISTER_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 和二代的路障僵尸一样，还是不长记性地夺取脑子。

ZOMBIE_TWISTER_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION.zh: 通过时空裂缝从一代穿越到二代的，仅在Your House（你的房子）出现。

ZOMBIE_TWISTER_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: SAME INFO AS PVZ CONEHEAD ZOMBIE BUT ALTERED A BIT, SELF-EXPLANATORY!
ZOMBIE_TWISTER_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 和二代的铁桶僵尸一样，还是不长记性地夺取脑子。

ZOMBIE_TWISTER_FOOTBALL_DESCRIPTION.zh: 通过时空裂缝从一代穿越到二代的，仅在Your House（你的房子）出现。

ZOMBIE_TWISTER_FOOTBALL_DESCRIPTION_HEAD.zh: 他并不像二代的橄榄球僵尸一样会冲撞，因为他认为那是失去本心，毕竟人家已经把名字改成了全明星僵尸。

ZOMBIE_TWISTER_WORKER_DESCRIPTION.en: Out of unique infos, don't ask
ZOMBIE_TWISTER_WORKER_DESCRIPTION.zh: 通过时空裂缝从一代穿越到二代的，仅在Your House（你的房子）出现。

ZOMBIE_TWISTER_WORKER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 和二代的普通僵尸一样，还是不长记性地夺取脑子。

ZOMBIE_VASE_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}crushes plants with pole
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}throws Imp when damaged

{FLAVOR}The ceramic confines of the Vase Gargantuar's home has done nothing to his endless hunger, his immense power, or his vast destructive potential. However, his footspeed could be better.
ZOMBIE_VASE_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}攻击：{STAT}用电线杆砸碎植物
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}在受到一定伤害后扔出小鬼僵尸

{FLAVOR}尽管花瓶巨人僵尸被陶瓷禁锢，但这并没有改变他无尽的饥饿、巨大的力量，以及那庞大的毁灭潜力。不过，他的步速其实还可以再快点。

ZOMBIE_VASE_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION_HEADE.en: Phenomenally sized zombie stuffed into a tiny unliving space.
ZOMBIE_VASE_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION_HEADE.zh: 庞然大僵屈身于难以生存的弹丸之地。

ZOMBIE_WEST_BULLRIDER_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Had dreams of becoming a rodeo clown but found the clown make-up to just be too creepy.
ZOMBIE_WEST_BULLRIDER_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}他曾有个当牛仔竞技小丑的梦想，但他后来发现小丑妆太吓人了。

ZOMBIE_WEST_BULLRIDER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Gets launched past all but the tallest plants, then proceeds on foot.
ZOMBIE_WEST_BULLRIDER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 可跨过除高植物以外的其他植物，然后步行前进。

ZOMBIE_WEST_BULL_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}launches a low flying imp rider over plants
{KEYWORD}Weakness: {STAT}Tall-nut blocks flying imp

{FLAVOR}He's not an angry bull. He loves flowers, playing in the fields, sitting under trees, and long walks across the pasture. He wants to settle down when he meets the right cow. Too bad he's a robot.
ZOMBIE_WEST_BULL_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}掷出低空飞行的小鬼骑手越过植物
{KEYWORD}弱点：{STAT}高坚果能抵挡飞行小鬼

{FLAVOR}他并不是一头愤怒的公牛。他喜欢花，喜欢在田野玩耍，喜欢在树下乘凉，喜欢的牧场散步。他看到那个“她”时，就想安定下来。真可惜他是个机器牛。

ZOMBIE_WEST_BULL_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Can launch his zombie rider past most of your defenses.
ZOMBIE_WEST_BULL_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 可以在撞到你的防线后扔出僵尸牛骑手。

ZOMBIE_WEST_BULL_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}"Legend" perhaps overstates Rodeo Legend Zombie's status in the rodeo world. Don't tell him that, though, unless you're desperate to hear an hour-long tirade about calf-roping.
ZOMBIE_WEST_BULL_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}“传奇”可能夸大了牛仔传奇僵尸在牛仔竞技中的地位。别给他说这个，除非你想听他叨叨一个小时套小牛的长篇大论。

ZOMBIE_WEST_BULL_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION_HEA.en: Rodeo Legend Zombie smashes a plant and launches his zombie rider past most of your defenses.
ZOMBIE_WEST_BULL_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION_HEA.zh: 牛仔传奇僵尸可以撞碎一株植物，并发射僵尸牛骑手。

ZOMBIE_XZJ_DESCRIPTION.en: He was blacklisted for secretly selling the SHUTTLE series. Not only that, he is also very unreasonable.
ZOMBIE_XZJ_DESCRIPTION.zh: 因偷卖 SHUTTLE 系列而被列入黑名单。不仅如此，他还很蛮不讲理。

ZOMBIE_ZAMBONI_DESCRIPTION.en: Often mistaken for a zombie driving a ice machine, the Zomboni is a totally different life-form more closely related to a space ogre than a Zombie.
ZOMBIE_ZAMBONI_DESCRIPTION.zh: 经常被误以为是在驾驶着造冰车的僵尸，但事实上造冰车僵尸是种完全不同的生物物种，他与太空兽人联系更紧密而不是僵尸。

ZOMBIE_ZAMBONI_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: The Zomboni applies ice, steam and pressure to your plants.
ZOMBIE_ZAMBONI_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 雪橇车僵尸碾压路过的所有植物，并留下冰道。

ZOMBIE_ZCORP_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION.en: ZCorp leads the field in large, cone-shaped pushpins for cranial safety.
ZOMBIE_ZCORP_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION.zh: Z 公司在生产具有高强度保护能力的交通锥的技术上，处于全球领先地位。

ZOMBIE_ZCORP_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: A typical ZCorp employee, except with more on his mind.
ZOMBIE_ZCORP_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 典型的 Z 公司员工，只不过头上多了点东西。

ZOMBIE_ZCORP_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION.en: ZCorp fully complies with all local, state and federal waste disposal ordinances.
ZOMBIE_ZCORP_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION.zh: Z 公司完全遵守每个地方的废物处理条例。

ZOMBIE_ZCORP_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: An environmentally friendly recycle bin protects the employee's noggin from damage.
ZOMBIE_ZCORP_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 环保的可回收垃圾桶能保护这位员工的头，使他免受伤害。

ZOMBIE_ZCORP_CONSULTANT_DESCRIPTION.en: She works for ZCorp AND consults for them. Great gig if you can get it!
ZOMBIE_ZCORP_CONSULTANT_DESCRIPTION.zh: 她为 Z 公司工作，给他们提供咨询。如果你能就职的话会是份不错的工作！

ZOMBIE_ZCORP_CONSULTANT_DESCRIPTION_HEAD.en: ZCorp Consultant disrupts your paradigm and tableflips your bluesky/redocean.
ZOMBIE_ZCORP_CONSULTANT_DESCRIPTION_HEAD.zh: Z 公司顾问僵尸会打破你的桎梏，翻转你的理论。

ZOMBIE_ZCORP_DESCRIPTION.en: He was issued the standard ZCorp coffee mug at orientation.
ZOMBIE_ZCORP_DESCRIPTION.zh: 在迎新会上，公司给了他标准的 Z 公司咖啡杯。

ZOMBIE_ZCORP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 一个被 Z 公司编入的典型员工。

ZOMBIE_ZCORP_FEM_ARMOR1.zh: Z 公司合同工路障僵尸

ZOMBIE_ZCORP_FEM_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION.en: ZCorp contractors may purchase ZCorp office supplies for a small fee.
ZOMBIE_ZCORP_FEM_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION.zh: Z 公司的合同工可以低价购买 Z 公司的办公用品。

ZOMBIE_ZCORP_FEM_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION_HEAD.en: It's the combination of notebook and comically large pushpin that really gives this contractor the edge.
ZOMBIE_ZCORP_FEM_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION_HEAD.zh: 笔记本和大到滑稽的图钉，正是这两样东西组成的联合体给这位合同工带来了微弱优势。

ZOMBIE_ZCORP_FEM_ARMOR2.zh: Z 公司合同工铁桶僵尸

ZOMBIE_ZCORP_FEM_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION.en: ZCorp encourages its contractors to come up with out-of-the-box solutions for keeping their heads safe.
ZOMBIE_ZCORP_FEM_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION.zh: Z 公司鼓励其合同工想出开箱即用的解决方案，以确保他们的头部安全。

ZOMBIE_ZCORP_FEM_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION_HEAD.en: Recycle bins make excellent and environmentally friendly headgear.
ZOMBIE_ZCORP_FEM_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION_HEAD.zh: 他头上的回收垃圾桶能提供保护，确实非常环保呢。

ZOMBIE_ZCORP_FEM_DESCRIPTION.en: ZCorp is so inclusive, they even give contractors free coffee mugs.
ZOMBIE_ZCORP_FEM_DESCRIPTION.zh: Z 公司一切费用全包，甚至会为合同工提供免费的咖啡杯。

ZOMBIE_ZCORP_FEM_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 一个典型的 Z 公司承包商。

ZOMBIE_ZCORP_FLAG_DESCRIPTION.en: ZCorp developed its flag logo in-house and is very proud of it.
ZOMBIE_ZCORP_FLAG_DESCRIPTION.zh: Z 公司内部开发了自己的旗帜标识，并为此感到非常自豪。

ZOMBIE_ZCORP_FLAG_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: The flag is a tremendous way to create brand awareness while also indicating a lot more zombies are about to appear and eat your brains.
ZOMBIE_ZCORP_FLAG_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 他的旗子是一个很棒的方式来树立品牌意识，同时也表明更多的僵尸即将出现，并吃掉你的脑子。

ZOMBIE_ZCORP_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION.en: Head Office Impgantuar's door is always open. It is, however, highly inadvisable to take him up on that offer.
ZOMBIE_ZCORP_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION.zh: 总部巨鬼僵尸总会向你敞开大门，但同时，他不太会接受别人的意见。

ZOMBIE_ZCORP_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION_HEAD.en: His giant noggin is a blunt instrument of smashing.
ZOMBIE_ZCORP_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION_HEAD.zh: 他那巨大的脑袋是一种威吓植物的武器。

ZOMBIE_ZCORP_HELPDESK.zh: Z 公司技术支持僵尸

ZOMBIE_ZCORP_HELPDESK_DESCRIPTION.en: ZCorp HelpDesk is here to help, especially if what you need help with is having too many plants on your lawn.
ZOMBIE_ZCORP_HELPDESK_DESCRIPTION.zh: Z 公司技术支持僵尸提供技术支持，尤其是当你草坪上的植物太多清理不过来时！

ZOMBIE_ZCORP_HELPDESK_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: ZCorp HelpDesk drops in and throws an exploding laptop.
ZOMBIE_ZCORP_HELPDESK_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: Z 公司技术支持僵尸从天而降后会扔出一台爆炸的笔记本电脑。

ZOMBIE_ZCORP_IMP_DESCRIPTION.en: Gargimp Legal delivers cease-and-desists the old-fashioned way: with a baseball bat.
ZOMBIE_ZCORP_IMP_DESCRIPTION.zh: 法务部小人僵尸用一种老派的方式传递着禁止令——棒球棍。

ZOMBIE_ZCORP_IMP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Tiny but fierce, the Gargimp Legal department is the best and the beast in the business.
ZOMBIE_ZCORP_IMP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 小而凶恶的法务部小巨人僵尸在他这一行是干得最好的。

ZOMBIE_ZCORP_RACER_CHAIR_DESCRIPTION.en: Zcorp Chair Racer brings fun and spontaneity to the zcorporate experience.
ZOMBIE_ZCORP_RACER_CHAIR_DESCRIPTION.zh: Z 公司赛椅手僵尸为 Z 公司的氛围带来了乐趣与自主意愿。

ZOMBIE_ZCORP_RACER_CHAIR_DESCRIPTION_HEA.en: Zcorp Chair Racer zooms in at high speed, collides with great impact, and catapults leftward with extraordinary grace.
ZOMBIE_ZCORP_RACER_CHAIR_DESCRIPTION_HEA.zh: Z 公司赛椅手僵尸高速移动，猛地一撞，然后以优雅的姿势跃向左侧。

ZOMBIE_ZOMBIE_BOBSLED_CREW_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Their bobsled might be history, but these zombies are living for the thrill of the chill!
ZOMBIE_ZOMBIE_BOBSLED_CREW_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}就算它们的雪橇成为了历史，这些僵尸仍将“如履厚冰”般前行！

ZOMBIE_ZOMBIE_BOBSLED_CREW_DESCRIPTION_H.en: Zombie Bobsled Crew will carry on even without their trusty sled.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBIE_BOBSLED_CREW_DESCRIPTION_H.zh: 雪橇僵尸小队队员就算失去了它们那值得信赖的雪橇，仍将继续前行。

ZOMBIE_ZOMBIE_BOBSLED_TEAM_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}Crushes Plants.

{FLAVOR}Meet the lean, mean bobsledding machine - the Zombie Bobsled Team! These undead athletes stick together like glue, or should we say frosty ice? They're the epitome of teamwork, never leaving a ghoul behind.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBIE_BOBSLED_TEAM_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}攻击：{STAT}压扁植物。

{FLAVOR}高傲、瘦小，乘着雪橇，匆匆来到——这就是雪橇僵尸小队！这些僵尸运动员总是组团出没，像是被胶水黏在一起……或者说“被冰块冻在一起”可能更合适？它们，便是团队协作的最佳范例；不抛尸、不弃尸，是它们的座右铭。

ZOMBIE_ZOMBIE_BOBSLED_TEAM_DESCRIPTION_H.en: Zombie Bobsled Teams will take any ice trail as an excuse to slide down the lawn.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBIE_BOBSLED_TEAM_DESCRIPTION_H.zh: 雪橇僵尸小队不会放过任何一块冰面，整整齐齐滑入草坪。

ZOMBIE_ZOMBONI_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}Crushes Plants.
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}Creates an ice trail behind it.

{FLAVOR}Introducing the Zomboni - the coolest undead on wheels! Caution: Not your typical ice resurfacer. We repeat, NOT a Zamboni® brand ice resurfacing machine!

This frozen fiend from the north will turn your lawn into a slippery slope of doom faster than you can say "brain freeze!"
ZOMBIE_ZOMBONI_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}攻击：{STAT}压扁植物。
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}在经过的道路后方创造冰道。

{FLAVOR}全新“僵博尼”洗冰车——老冰不死，只是逐渐变平！注意：此款洗冰车并不是普通洗冰车。重申，此款洗冰车并非赞博尼® 洗冰车！

不等你说完“冻得我脑子疼”这六个字，这位从北方远道而来的急冻恶魔就能把你的草坪变为湿滑的末日冰面！

ZOMBIE_ZOMBONI_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: A technological marvel from the great white north, Zomboni ices over your lawn into a barren wasteland.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBONI_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: “僵博尼”洗冰车，来自雪白北方的科技奇迹，驶过你的草坪，把它夷为荒芜废地。

ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_BEACH.zh: 巨鲨潜袭者僵尸机器人

ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_BEACH_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}mouth turbine can pull plants to it
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}summoned zombie sharks can consume plants

{FLAVOR}The Zombot Sharktronic Sub is a true labor of love. Dr. Zomboss obsessed over every detail of the aquatic mechanism of doom as he worked on it day in and day out from the wee hours of the morning until well after dark. He carefully handcrafted the shark's nearly impenetrable exterior skin. He shaved each razor-sharp tooth to a point by hand. And he painstakingly installed the lethal plant-consuming fan inside the machine's horrific maw all by himself. Zomboss shed more than one tear of joy when his masterpiece was complete. Say what you will about the evil genius, but he is passionate about his projects.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_BEACH_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}涡轮机嘴巴可以把植物拉向它
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}召唤出的僵尸鲨鱼能够吞噬植物

{FLAVOR}巨鲨潜袭者僵尸机器人是真正的“爱之杰作”。僵王博士日复一日地从凌晨研究到天黑，用心打磨这台水栖毁灭机甲的每一处细节。他精心制作了巨鲨那几乎牢不可破的外表皮，还把每一颗牙齿打磨得又尖又利。不仅如此，他还煞费苦心地往它的胃里安装了一个用来切碎植物的风扇。当这台杰作横空出世时，僵王泪流满面，兴奋不已。不管你怎么评价这个邪恶天才，不可否认的是，他对他的工作充满热情。

ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_BEACH_DESCRIPTION_HEA.en: The ravenous engine of carnage from the murky depths.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_BEACH_DESCRIPTION_HEA.zh: 潜伏在阴暗海沟中的“鲨”机。

ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_CHINESEGARDEN_DESCRIP.en:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}summons Privacy Screens and Koi Imps

{FLAVOR}To stage a wicked and dreamlike opera, Dr. Zomboss poured all his energy into studying Eastern culture. The result is a mech steeped in legend. Although its existence violates the Great Ming Code regarding temporal integrity, Dr. Zomboss couldn't care less.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_CHINESEGARDEN_DESCRIP.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}召唤屏风和鲤鱼小鬼

{FLAVOR}为了完成一场邪恶而梦幻的戏剧，僵尸博士将大量的精力投进学习东方文化之中，然后充满东方传奇色彩的机甲就诞生了。虽然这违背了《大明律》对于时间完整性的规定，但是僵尸博士可不在乎这个。

ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_CHINESEGARDEN_DESCRIP.en: The mechanical nightmare wandering in the garden.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_CHINESEGARDEN_DESCRIP.zh: 上演一场跨越时空的游园惊梦。

ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_CIRCUS.zh: 风琴致灾者僵尸机器人

ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_CIRCUS_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}can launch Cannonball Imps

{FLAVOR}"Despite the decline of circuses in recent years, I refuse to give up on a form of entertainment with so much history and plant-destroying potential," cackles Dr. Zomboss, all while tapping out a jaunty little tune on his keyboard.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_CIRCUS_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}可以发射小鬼炮弹

"尽管近年来游乐园的数量逐渐下降，但我拒绝放弃这种历史悠久，还有能破坏植物的潜在娱乐方式。”僵王博士咯咯咯地笑着说，同时还在琴键上按出了一段轻快的小曲。

ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_CIRCUS_DESCRIPTION_HE.en: The mystery-filled circus-wagon of terrors and delights.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_CIRCUS_DESCRIPTION_HE.zh: 充满恐惧与欢乐的神秘马戏团大篷车。

ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_COWBOY.zh: 牛车狂战者僵尸机器人

ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_COWBOY_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}missile attacks can target mine carts

{FLAVOR}Ranchers and farmhands abandon your fields. Rumbling down the dusty trail, this wagon was engineered to strike fear into the heart of any horticulturist who should encounter it. Dr. Zomboss normally doesn't take any bull, but this time he made an exception.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_COWBOY_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}导弹攻击会瞄准轨道上的矿车

{FLAVOR}农场主和农民拖着自己煞白的脸，纷纷弃田而去。只见小径尘土飞扬，牛车隆隆作响。它的诞生，就是为了将恐惧送到每个种植者的心中。不到万不得已，僵王博士不会冒险使用这台机器，但这一次，他破例了。

ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_COWBOY_DESCRIPTION_HE.en: The stagecoach of destruction from the western wilds.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_COWBOY_DESCRIPTION_HE.zh: 来自荒原西部的毁灭战车。

ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_DARK.zh: 黑龙驾驭者僵尸机器人

ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_DARK_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}fire breathing attacks destroy plants
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}lobbed fireballs can hatch Imp Dragon Zombies

{FLAVOR}With a rumble of destruction, Dr. Zomboss forged his Dark Dragon in the heart of a volcano. Then he tempered the beast in the chilled waters of Doom Lake. Finally  he fed its furnace with coal from the Mines of Morbidity. And the paint job - that was done by Carl.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_DARK_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}攻击：{STAT}可以喷出火焰摧毁植物
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}投出的火球可以生成小鬼龙僵尸

{FLAVOR}轰隆一声巨响，僵王博士在火山中心创造了这条黑龙；之后，他在毁灭之湖的刺骨冷水中驯服了这头野兽；最后，再用多疾矿洞的煤炭喂满它的熔炉。至于绘图工作嘛——那是卡尔完成的。

ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_DARK_DESCRIPTION_HEAD.en: The desolator of all, from dark times.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_DARK_DESCRIPTION_HEAD.zh: 化世间的一切为荒芜虚空，来自那黑暗的时代。

ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_DINO.zh: 机龙速袭者僵尸机器人

ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_DINO_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}summons dinosaurs

{FLAVOR}With flagrant disregard for temporal tidiness and simple good taste, Dr. Zomboss figured it would be a good idea to build a big metal dinosaur.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_DINO_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}召唤恐龙

{FLAVOR}带着对时间整齐度的公然漠视以及自己的好品味，僵王博士觉得建造一只大型金属恐龙是个好主意。

ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_DINO_DESCRIPTION_HEAD.en: A mechanical means of dinosaurian destruction.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_DINO_DESCRIPTION_HEAD.zh: 恐龙的威力，机械的身躯。

ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_EGYPT.zh: 狮身终结者僵尸机器人

ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_EGYPT_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}missile attack can create tombstones

{FLAVOR}To add that extra bit of wickedness to the Sphinx-inator Dr. Zomboss chiseled his creation from the stonework of cursed tombs. You should not take this instance of reuse and recycle to mean he's going green. The only thing green about him is his tongue.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_EGYPT_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}大炮攻击后，会创造出坟墓

{FLAVOR}为了给狮身终结者增添几分邪恶的感觉，僵王博士用被诅咒的墓碑雕刻出了他的作品。但是，别看他现在回收再利用，他其实一点都不环保。别听信他的鬼话。

ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_EGYPT_DESCRIPTION_HEA.en: The destroyer of plants from the ancient sands.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_EGYPT_DESCRIPTION_HEA.zh: 来自古老沙场的植物毁灭者。

ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_EIGHTIES.zh: 狂舞碎灭者僵尸机器人

ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_EIGHTIES_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}speakers do passive damage (except to ground plants and Phat Beet) and send out shockwave attacks

{FLAVOR}In another world, in another time, Dr. Zomboss would receive the bounty of enthusiastic applause that is his due. Not here and now, though. Nope.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_EIGHTIES_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}扬声器可以造成被动伤害（除了地底植物和魔音甜菜），还会发出冲击波攻击

{FLAVOR}在另一个世界、另一个时间，僵王博士也许能够得到他应得的热烈掌声。不过不是现在，绝对不是。

ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_EIGHTIES_DESCRIPTION_.en: An intimate evening with some of Dr. Zomboss’ most recent and painful explorations.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_EIGHTIES_DESCRIPTION_.zh: 僵王博士会在这个激动僵心的夜晚让你感受痛苦。

ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_FAIRYTALE_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Dr. Zomboss, seeking a more efficient invasion, mobilized three production lines, tripled his steel supply, and tripled his staff. He even digitized his dark magic using a ternary system. While some praised him as a man of his word, his word was always "three."
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_FAIRYTALE_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}僵王博士想用一种更有效率的方式展开入侵，他动用了三条生产线，三倍的钢材，三倍的员工……甚至在把那些黑魔法数字化的时候，他使用了三进制。有人称赞他说一不二，可他说的是三。

ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_FAIRYTALE_DESCRIPTION.en: An evil work that combines technology and fantasy.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_FAIRYTALE_DESCRIPTION.zh: 兼具科技和幻想的邪恶作品。

ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_FUTURE.zh: 明日破译者僵尸机器人

ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_FUTURE_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}missile attacks can destroy Power Tiles

{FLAVOR}When Dr. Zomboss is nestled into the comfy folds of his futuristic cerebral control pod he almost finds it hard to be evil. Of course once he sees a lawn full of happy plants that puts him right back where he needs to be, hungry and evil.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_FUTURE_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}导弹攻击可以摧毁能量地砖

{FLAVOR}当僵王博士依偎在控制仓中那舒适的、如脑子般的褶皱中时，他甚至都不想再邪恶下去了。当然，他一看到草坪上种满了快乐的植物，顿时兴致全无，回到了弥漫着饥饿与邪恶的归属之中。

ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_FUTURE_DESCRIPTION_HE.en: The Power Tile crushing creation from the Far Future.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_FUTURE_DESCRIPTION_HE.zh: 能量地砖毁灭器，遥远未来荣誉出品

ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_ICEAGE.zh: 獠牙驯服者僵尸机器人

ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_ICEAGE_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Dr. Zomboss was real impressed with himself when he came up with the idea to build a weaponized woolly mammoth with the power to blast snow and ice out of its mechanical trunk. But what Dr. Zomboss didn’t realize until it was too late: He’s allergic to mammoth fur. Now he has to load up on allergy medication every time he wants to take the darn thing out for a spin.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_ICEAGE_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}僵王博士还清晰地记得他是怎么想到要创造一个可以喷雪的机械猛犸象的。但当他想起自己对猛犸象的毛过敏时，一切都太晚了。现在，他每想出去溜溜这家伙，都得吃很多的抗过敏药。

ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_ICEAGE_DESCRIPTION_HE.en: The mammoth mech with an ice blast from the past.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_ICEAGE_DESCRIPTION_HE.zh: 来自冰河时代的机械猛犸象。

ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_LOSTCITY.zh: 飞船远航者僵尸机器人

ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_LOSTCITY_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}drops zombies and bags o’ sand

{FLAVOR}After repeated failures with variously robotic engines of destruction, Dr. Zomboss decided to go with a kinder, more eco-friendly lighter-than-air option to sow disaster and discord.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_LOSTCITY_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}扔下僵尸以及沙袋

{FLAVOR}在经历了无数次因机器人被破坏而失败的不堪后，僵王博士决定采用一种更友好、更环保，比空气更轻的手段来制造各种灾难和混乱。

ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_LOSTCITY_DESCRIPTION_.en: The floating fortress from the skies above.

ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_MARKET_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}leaf blower blows away plants and pushes zombies forward
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}fires a tommy gun at plants
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}spawns market cards

{FLAVOR}Programming this machine was quite a chore. One bug denied any attempts at subtracting values from Klepto-Maton's variables, another one made all pointers refer to themselves, and the script broke the binary system once, with the error log showing "Numbers 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8 and 9 are mine!"
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_MARKET_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}吹叶机可吹走植物并将僵尸向前推进
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}使用汤普森冲锋枪射击植物
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}生成卡盒

{FLAVOR}调试这台机器可谓困难重重：一个程序漏洞会阻止任何从贪婪贼盗者变量中减值的操作，另一个漏洞使所有指针自指，脚本还曾一度破坏二进制系统——错误日志竟显示“数字2、3、4、5、6、7、8、9全归我管！”

ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_MARKET_DESCRIPTION_HE.en: A sophisticated machine of avarice, expendable for nefarious means.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_MARKET_DESCRIPTION_HE.zh: 为贪婪而生的精密机械，愿为邪恶目的倾尽所有。

ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_MAUSOLEUM_BIG_SKILL_W.en: Ultimate skill is about to be launched! Please defeat the Lord of the Underground Palace as quickly as possible, and don't let him finish drawing his sword!
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_MAUSOLEUM_BIG_SKILL_W.zh: 终结技即将发动，请尽快击败地宫之主，别让他完成拔剑！

ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_MAUSOLEUM_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}The Lord of the Underground Palace's greatest personal hobby is bathing in a pile of salted fish.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_MAUSOLEUM_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}地宫之主最大的个人爱好是在咸鱼堆里洗澡。

ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_MAUSOLEUM_DESCRIPTION.en: How majestic and awe-inspiring he appears!

ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_PIRATE.zh: 甲板踏行者僵尸机器人

ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_PIRATE_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}cannon can rain down imps past your defenses

{FLAVOR}"Hoist the mizzenmast, batten down the hatches! 15 zombies on a dead man's boat, yo ho ho and a bucket of brains!" Dr. Zomboss had to admit he was really getting into this whole pirate thing. Though he never thought he'd be on a boat on a boat.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_PIRATE_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}小鬼炮能发射出穿越防线的小鬼雨

{FLAVOR}“吊起桅，甲板放北！十五只僵尸朝你飞！做得好，赏有一桶脑！” 僵王博士必须承认他已经沉迷于海盗了，他都没想过自己会坐在一艘船的船上。

ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_PIRATE_DESCRIPTION_HE.en: The plant plundering privateer of the high seas.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_PIRATE_DESCRIPTION_HE.zh: 在公海掠劫植物的私掠船。

ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_RENAI_DESCRIPTION.en:
{FLAVOR}A manuscript page from Dr. Zomboss:
“‘Cowards die many times before their deaths; The valiant never taste of death but once.’ As the youngest doctor of Thanatology, the grand legend of Dr. Zomboss has long transcended every era. To return, to seek revenge, to destroy, and to forge a new mythology! The great Dr. Zomboss shall rise again! The nefarious enterprise of Dr. Zomboss will ultimately prevail! (Note, not for publication: In memory of the fondest moments from my university theatre days.)”
                                   — Dr. Zomboss: The Greatest Memoir Ever! Addendum No. 1616
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_RENAI_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{FLAVOR}一页僵王博士的手稿：
“‘懦夫在未死之前已经多次死亡，勇者一生只尝一次死亡的滋味。’作为最年轻的死亡学博士，僵王博士的伟大传奇早已跨越了每一个时间阶段。重来，复仇，毁灭，创造一段新的神话！伟大的僵王博士一定会再次复出！僵王博士的邪恶事业终将兴盛！（注释，这段不要出版：纪念最美好的大学剧团生活）。”
                                   ——《僵博：史上最棒的回忆录！第1616号增刊》

ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_RENAI_DESCRIPTION_HEA.en: The mastermind behind this theatre is a mix of tragic epics and evil chaos.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_RENAI_DESCRIPTION_HEA.zh: 夹杂悲壮史诗与邪恶混乱的剧场幕后主使。

ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_ROMAN_DESCRIPTION.en:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}Spawns waves of Roman Zombies that serve both as shields and swords.

{FLAVOR}They said some things just don't go together. Oil and Water. Ice and Fire. Zombies and Brainz. But Dr. Zomboss always manages to make the impossible possible. Just look at all the latest cutting edge widgets and gadgets he manages to cram into one mech. A twin turbo V-Imp motor. A 6 cornu sound system. An independent plant crushing 4 wheel suspension.
He definitely blew through his entire year's food budget on this one. 
This would explain why his minions are always out looking for Brainz.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_ROMAN_DESCRIPTION.zh:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}生成一波又一波的罗马僵尸，它们进可如利剑般进攻，退可如盾牌般防守。

{FLAVOR}人们觉得：“冰火相克，水油不溶。僵尸食脑，千载难逢”。而僵王博士，总是能化不可能为可能。瞧，他能把这一系列尖端组件、最新工具塞进一台机甲中，就是最好的证明。里面有一对双涡轮“微鬼”电机，一组 6 角复古音响系统，还有 4 个悬挂式轮胎来碾压植物。
只能说，他肯定把整年的伙食费都搭在这上面了。
怪不得他的手下天天都得出门找脑子吃。

ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_ROMAN_DESCRIPTION_HEA.en: The V-Imp power creation that isn't for a mid life crisis.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_ROMAN_DESCRIPTION_HEA.zh: “微鬼”引擎强力驱动（绝对不是造出来应对中年危机的）

ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_SKYCITY_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Dr. Zomboss spent two days overnight researching, using the zombie industry's most cutting-edge bionic mechanical technology, the Zombot Vulture Fighter's release earned much applause, so much that it is heard that a few zombies clapped so hard until their hands dropped off.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_SKYCITY_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}僵王博士通宵两晚的的研究成果，使用了僵尸界最前沿的仿生机械技术，在秃鹫战机的发布会上赢得了热烈的掌声，听说有不少僵尸手都拍掉了。

ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_SKYCITY_DESCRIPTION_H.en: In wind or rain, lightning or thunder, comes the zombie king of the sky!
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_SKYCITY_DESCRIPTION_H.zh: 呼风唤雨，电闪雷鸣，僵尸界的天空王者！

ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_STEAM_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}“There are no traffic lights here, right?” said Dr. Zomboss standing on his favorite steam train, pointing ahead.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_STEAM_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}“这里没有红绿灯，对吧？”，僵尸博士站在他心爱的蒸汽火车上指着前方说道。

ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_STEAM_DESCRIPTION_HEA.en: Great debut of Dr. Zomboss from Steam Age along with his little trains.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_STEAM_DESCRIPTION_HEA.zh: 来自蒸汽时代的僵王博士和他的小火车们盛大登场。

ZOMBOSSEUM_24_MEGA_BUNDLE.zh: 僵王斗兽场至尊捆绑包

ZOMBOSSEUM_24_MINI_PINATA.zh: 僵王斗兽场 2024 迷你彩陶

ZOMBOSSEUM_24_PINATA_BUNDLE.zh: 僵王斗兽场彩陶捆绑包

ZOMBOSSEUM_24_PREMIUM_PINATA.zh: 僵王斗兽场 2024 高级彩陶

ZOMBOSSEUM_24_PREMIUM_PINATA_BUNDLE.zh: 僵王斗兽场高级彩陶捆绑包

ZOMBOSSEUM_24_PREMIUM_PINATA_PACK.zh: 僵王斗兽场高级彩陶包

ZOMBOSSEUM_24_SUPER_BUNDLE.zh: 僵王斗兽场超级捆绑包

ZOMBOSSEUM_24_ULTIMATE_BUNDLE.zh: 僵王斗兽场终极捆绑包

ZOMBOSS_GRAND_PRIZE_GENERIC.en:
Level Up {PLANTNAME}!
Earn 100% ZPS to fight Zomboss for seed packets!
ZOMBOSS_GRAND_PRIZE_GENERIC.zh:
升级{PLANTNAME}！
让 ZPS 达到 100%，与僵王战斗，赢取种子包！

ZOMBOSS_GRAND_PRIZE_NOTHING.zh:
僵王大奖：
什么都没有！玩得高兴！

ZOMBOSS_GRAND_PRIZE_SUNFLOWER.zh:
僵王大奖：
向日葵种子包

ZOMBOSS_RIFT_POL_DIALOG_BODY.en: Would you like to purchase a Security Gourd to push zombies back and add 30 seconds?
ZOMBOSS_RIFT_POL_DIALOG_BODY.zh: 想要购买一次安全葫卫来击退僵尸，并获得 30 秒的额外时间吗？

ZOMBOSS_RIFT_POL_DIALOG_BODY_TIME.en: Would you like to purchase a Security Gourd to push zombies back and add 30 seconds?
ZOMBOSS_RIFT_POL_DIALOG_BODY_TIME.zh: 想要购买一次安全葫卫来击退僵尸，并获得 30 秒的额外时间吗？

ZOMBOSS_RIFT_POL_DIALOG_BODY_ZOMBIE.en: Would you like to purchase a Security Gourd to push zombies back and add 30 seconds?
ZOMBOSS_RIFT_POL_DIALOG_BODY_ZOMBIE.zh: 想要购买一次安全葫卫来击退僵尸，并获得 30 秒的额外时间吗？

ZOYBEANPOD_DESCRIPTION.en: {FLAVOR}Oak Archer mastered his craft with countless shatters of neighboring windows in his youth, and indeed his old man never took it nicely. His personal diary contains "Zombie Knees: 998/10000" on the final page.
ZOYBEANPOD_DESCRIPTION.zh: {FLAVOR}橡木弓手从小打碎了无数邻居家的窗户玻璃才练到了如今的境界，为此他没有少挨老爸的巴掌。他有一个随身携带的日记，最后一页上写着:“僵尸膝盖：998/10000”。

ZOYBEANPOD_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.en: Zoybean Pods grow from sprouts to full pods, then split open to release helpful plant "zomboids" which attack zombies.
ZOYBEANPOD_DESCRIPTION_HEADER.zh: 橡木弓手可以发射强力的箭矢攻击并缓速前方的僵尸。

ZOYBEANPOD_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.en: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Fires off a stream of arrows.
ZOYBEANPOD_DESCRIPTION_PLANTFOOD.zh: {KEYWORD}叶绿素：{STAT}发射一连串箭矢，缓速僵尸。

ZOYBEANPOD_TOOLTIP.en: Shoots powerful arrows at zombies ahead.
ZOYBEANPOD_TOOLTIP.zh: 发射箭矢攻击并缓速僵尸

kept.zh: {NPC_ENTER:CRAZYDAVE}{NPC_ENTER:WINNIE}{SAY:WINNIE}数据显示，这些遗迹僵尸们似乎要对外来者进行一场判决。

kept.zh: {EXCITED:CRAZYDAVE}我们每天超光速都没被开过罚单！
